steps: 1. You can use chicken broth in place of the chicken bouillon powder. Add 1/4 cup of broth followed by 2 teaspoons of cornstarch dissolved in 1 tablespoPrepare the tomatoes:
2. Slice the tomatoes in half. Remove the tough stem from each half that connects to the vine. Cut each half into equal thirds (you’ll get 6 slices from each tomato).
3. Make the soft scrambled eggs:

4. In a cold, 8 to 10-inch nonstick skillet, add the vegetable oil and beaten eggs. Turn the heat to medium. Once a thin layer of eggs is just beginning to cook on the bottom, push the eggs in one direction to create layers of scrambled eggs.
5. Cook, gently stirring the whole time, until the scramble eggs are mostly set but still slightly wet and shiny, 2 to 5 minutes. Remove the eggs to a plate and, if needed, wipe out the pan.
6. Stir-fry the tomatoes and seasonings:

7. Add the sesame oil to the pan followed by the tomatoes and stir-fry over medium heat until the tomatoes are softened but not mushy, about 3 minutes. Add the chicken bouillon powder, sugar, and white pepper. Toss until combined and the sugar and bouillon have dissolved, about 1 minute.
8. Add eggs, stir-fry, and garnish:

9. Add the eggs back to the pan with the tomatoes. Stir-fry for about 2 minutes to heat through and combine. Taste, adding salt only if needed. Sprinkle with the green onions and serve with steamed rice.on of water, plus salt to taste.
title: Chinese Tomato Egg Stir Fry

steps: 1. Mix the cornflour and 1 tbsp soy sauce, toss in the prawns and set aside for 10 mins. Stir the vinegar, remaining soy sauce, tomato purée, sugar and 2 tbsp water together to make a sauce.
2. When you’re ready to cook, heat a large frying pan or wok until very hot, then add 1 tbsp oil. Fry the prawns until they are golden in places and have opened out– then tip them out of the pan.

3. Heat the remaining oil and add the peanuts, chillies and water chestnuts. Stir-fry for 2 mins or until the peanuts start to colour, then add the ginger and garlic and fry for 1 more min. Tip in the prawns and sauce and simmer for 2 mins until thickened slightly. Serve with rice.
title: Kung Po Prawns

steps: 1. STEP 1 - MARINATING THE BEEF
2. In a bowl, add the beef, salt, 1 pinch white pepper, 1 Teaspoon sesame seed oil, 1/2 egg, corn starch,1 Tablespoon of oil and mix together.
3. STEP 2 - BOILING THE THE NOODLES
4. In a 6 qt pot add your noodles to boiling water until the noodles are submerged and boil on high heat for 10 seconds. After your noodles is done boiling strain and cool with cold water.
5. STEP 3 - STIR FRY
6. Add 2 Tablespoons of oil, beef and cook on high heat untill beef is medium cooked.
7. Set the cooked beef aside
8. In a wok add 2 Tablespoon of oil, onions, minced garlic, minced ginger, bean sprouts, mushrooms, peapods and 1.5 cups of water or until the vegetables are submerged in water.
9. Add the noodles to wok
10. To make the sauce, add oyster sauce, 1 pinch white pepper, 1 teaspoon sesame seed oil, sugar, and 1 Teaspoon of soy sauce.
11. Next add the beef to wok and stir-fry
title: Beef Lo Mein

steps: 1. Cut steak into 1/2-inch strips; brown in hot fat in a large skillet.
2. Remove meat; pour off excess fat.
3. Stir in cornstarch, water, catsup, soy sauce, bouillon cube and pepper.
4. Heat to boiling.
5. Add meat and onion.
6. Cover; simmer for 30 minutes.
7. Add green pepper; simmer for 10 minutes.
8. Serve over rice or noodles. Serves 6.
title: Chinese Pepper Steak

steps: 1. Add carrots to oil, heated.
2. Stir-fry for 2 minutes.
3. Add thinly sliced zucchini and ground beef.
4. Stir-fry for 3 minutes. Combine beef broth, cornstarch, Worcestershire sauce and ginger. Add to hot mixture and heat to boiling, stirring.
5. One-half teaspoon salt may be added, if desired.
6. May be served over rice. Serves 4 or 5.
title: Beef Stir-Fry

steps: 1. Place chicken in a large mixing bowl.
2. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over chicken.
3. Marinate overnight in refrigerator.
4. Cook chicken over medium heat on outdoor grill for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.
5. Baste with marinade every 15 minutes.
6. Serves 6.
title: Lemon Chicken For The Grill

ingredients.text: 11 oz. can mandarin oranges, with juice

steps: 1. Wash and dry chicken pieces.
2. Shake in a paper bag with flour to coat.
3. In a skillet, heat oil and margarine.
4. Add chicken and brown each piece.
5. Drain mandarin oranges and set aside.
6. Mix juice from the can with the lemon juice, orange juice, honey, soy sauce and ginger.
7. Pour sauce over the chicken in skillet.
8. Cover and simmer for 30 minutes or until tender.
9. Add mandarin orange sections for 5 to 10 minutes before chicken is done.
10. Serve with rice.
11. Serves 4.
title: Chicken Mandarin

ingredients.text: 1 to 1 1/2 lb. boneless, skinless chicken breasts

steps: 1. Mix oil with soy sauce, ginger and garlic powder.
2. Place chicken in glass baking dish.
3. Pour sauce over chicken.
4. Cover loosely with wax paper.
5. Cook on High 8 to 10 minutes or until done.
6. Rotate baking dish halfway through cooking time.
7. Serves 4.
title: Microwave Chinese Chicken

steps: 1. Coat chops with flour.
2. Brown in hot oil. Top meat with carrots and onions.
3. Mix remaining ingredients and pour over chops.
4. Cover and cook over low heat, 30 to 35 minutes. Serves 4.
title: Chinese Pork Chops

steps: 1. Brown ground beef in oleo. Add onion and celery. Add rice, pepper, water and soy sauce. Bake at 350°. Makes 6 to 8 servings.
title: Chow Mein Casserole

steps: 1. Heat electric wok or skillet at 325° for 2 to 3 minutes; add oil and heat 1 minute.
2. Add celery, onion and broccoli; stir-fry 2 minutes.
3. Add cabbages and stir-fry 3 minutes.
4. Cover and cook vegetables over low heat 3 minutes.
5. Stir in salt, pepper and Worcestershire sauce.
6. Serve immediately.
7. Serves 6.
title: Stir-Fry Medley

steps: 1. Heat oven to 350°.
2. Place chicken breasts on a cookie sheet. Combine lemon juice, oregano and oil.
3. Baste chicken with lemon mixture.
4. Cook until chicken is done, approximately 35 minutes. Salt and pepper can be added to taste.
5. Serves 4.
title: Louie'S Lemon Chicken

steps: 1. Slice pork into thin narrow strips.

2. Combine 2 teaspoons each cornstarch and soy sauce, ginger and pork; let stand 15 minutes. Meanwhile, combine remaining 2 teaspoons cornstarch, 2 tablespoons plus 1 teaspoon soy sauce, vinegar, garlic powder and 1/2 cup water; set aside.
3. Heat 1 tablespoon oil in hot wok (or a large skillet).
4. Add pork and stir-fry 2 minutes; remove.
5. Heat remaining 1 tablespoon oil in same pan.
6. Add onion and carrot; stir-fry 2 minutes.
7. Add zucchini; stir-fry 2 minutes.
8. Add pork and soy sauce mixture.
9. Cook, stirring, until sauce boils and thickens.
10. Stir in peanuts.
11. Good served over rice.
12. Serves 2 to 3.
title: Pork And Peanut Stir-Fry(Our Favorite Stir-Fry)

steps: 1. Season chicken pieces with salt, garlic powder, paprika, pepper, tarragon and thyme.
2. Place in a shallow baking pan, skin side down.
3. Combine the freshly grated peels, juices and water; pour over chicken.
4. Bake, uncovered, at 375° for about 40 minutes. Turn the chicken and continue baking.
5. Baste with pan juices once or twice until done, in about 35 minutes more.
6. Makes 4 to 6 servings.
title: Orange Chicken

steps: 1. Blend together water, soy sauce, cornstarch, garlic and pepper. Set aside.
2. Heat oil in wok or skillet over medium-high heat.
3. Add chicken and celery.
4. Stir-fry for 4 minutes or until chicken and celery are tender.
5. Add mushrooms and cashews; stir-fry for 1 minute.
6. Mix in soy mixture; cook and stir until sauce is thickened.
7. Serve with rice.
8. Makes 6 servings.
title: Cashew Chicken Stir-Fry

steps: 1. Season chicken with salt and pepper.
2. Place oil in skillet and brown chicken.
3. Mash garlic with salt and add the remaining ingredients.
4. Mix well.
5. Pour this mixture over the brown chicken. Cover and cook at 325° for 40 minutes.
6. Makes 2 servings.
title: Flo'S Lemon Chicken

ingredients.text: 1 c. lean chicken, pork loin or beef round, sliced in strips or legumes

steps: 1. Chop meat and vegetables.
2. Set aside.
3. Heat wok or frypan. Add oil.
4. Add chopped carrots and onion and stir for 2 to 3 minutes.
5. Add remaining vegetables.
6. Stir until they are tender but do not overcook.
7. Push vegetables to the side.
8. Add meat, ginger, pepper and soy sauce.
9. Stir until done.
10. Stir meat and vegetables together.
11. Serve with brown rice.
12. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Stir-Fry

steps: 1. Brown meat.
2. Add water.
3. Bring to boil.
4. Add celery, onions and soy sauce; boil for 15 to 20 minutes.
5. Add cornstarch and sesame oil.
6. Serve over hot rice.
7. Makes 4 to 6 servings.
title: Chop Suey

steps: 1. Coarsely chop chicken, shrimp and mushrooms. Mince green onions and celery. Beat eggs. Blend in salt. Stir in chicken, shrimp, mushrooms, onions, celery and bean sprouts. Heat 1/2 tablespoon oil in an 8-inch frypan over medium-high heat. Reduce heat to medium. Pour 1/4 cup egg mixture into frypan. Cook 1 minute on each side (should be lightly browned). Keep warm in a 200° oven. Repeat until all batter is used, adding more oil as needed. Serve with Foo Yung Sauce. Makes 4 servings.
title: Egg Foo Yung

steps: 1. Combine flour, cinnamon and cloves.
2. Lightly coat chicken pieces in mixture; shake off excess.
3. Heat butter and olive oil in large frying pan over medium heat.
4. When hot, add chicken pieces and brown on both sides.
5. Remove chicken from the pan.
6. Add chopped onion; cook until onion is tender.
7. Return chicken to pan. Add orange juice and raisins.
8. Cover, reduce heat to low and simmer for 30 minutes.
9. Remove chicken from pan; keep warm. Increase heat to high; boil remaining juices rapidly, stirring occasionally until sauce reduces and thickens slightly, about 5 minutes.
10. Place hot cooked rice on a serving platter.
11. Arrange chicken pieces on top.
12. Top with orange sauce; garnish with parsley and orange slices.
13. Serves 4.
title: Cinnamon Orange Chicken

ingredients.text: 1 lb. pork tenderloin, cut in quarters lengthwise, then cut 1/4-inch thick
1 green pepper, seeded and cut into strips

steps: 1. Combine sherry, cornstarch, cumin, garlic and salt in a medium bowl.
2. Add pork slices; stir to coat.
3. Heat oil over medium-high heat in heavy skillet.
4. Add pork mixture; stir-fry about 3 to 4 minutes.
5. Add remaining ingredients.
6. Cover pan; simmer for 3 to 4 minutes.
7. Serve hot with chili salsa, if desired.
8. Serves 4.
title: Southwestern Stir-Fry

ingredients.text: 2 lbs boneless skinless chicken breasts (About 4 pieces)

steps: 1. Combine cornstarch and pepper in resealable food storage bag. Add chicken. Shake to coat with cornstarch mixture.
2. Heat oil in skillet over medium-high heat. Brown chicken about 2 minutes on each side. Place chicken in slow cooker.

3. Combine soy sauce, vinegar, ketchup, sweet chili sauce, sugar, garlic, ginger, pepper flakes, and cashews in small bowl; pour over chicken. (I like my cashews to be softer so I add them during the cooking process, if you want more of a crunch, add them right before serving).
4. Cook on LOW for 3 to 4 hours.
5. Serve over rice. Makes 4-6 servings.
title: Slow Cooker Cashew Chicken

ingredients.text: 2 lb. boneless pork loin, cut into 3/4-inch cubes

steps: 1. In a 1-gallon self-sealing plastic bag, combine all ingredients and mix well.
2. Seal bag and marinate in the refrigerate 8 to 12 hours or overnight.
3. Heat oven to 350°. Remove pork cubes from marinade, discarding marinade.
4. Pat pork dry with paper towel.
5. Place cubes in a single layer not touching in a shallow baking pan and bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes until pork is just tender and lightly browned.
6. Remove to serving platter or chafing dish and serve hot as an appetizer.
7. Makes 16 servings.
title: Chinatown Red-Cooked Pork Treasures

steps: 1. Cut steak into thin strips across the grain.
2. Chop peppers, onions and water chestnuts.
3. Brown steak quickly in oil; remove from pan.
4. Saute peppers, onions and water chestnuts.
5. In separate bowl, mix the soy sauce, brown sugar, cornstarch and water. Combine sauce with steak and vegetables; cook for 3 to 4 minutes. Serve over rice.
6. Garnish with tomato wedges.
7. Serves 4.
title: Pepper Steak

ingredients.text: 1 lb. round steak, cut into strips
8 oz. can sliced water chestnuts, drained

steps: 1. In a large skillet, saute beef in oil until brown.
2. Add cornstarch and blend well.
3. Add broth, water chestnuts, red pepper, scallions, soy sauce and pepper. Bring to a boil; stir in rice.
4. Cover and remove from heat; let stand 5 minutes.
5. Fluff with fork.
6. Makes 4 servings.
title: Shanghai Beef

steps: 1. Place chicken in a lightly greased baking pan.
2. Combine all ingredients and pour over chicken.
3. Bake uncovered at 350° for 1 hour.
title: Baked Lemon Chicken

steps: 1. Brown
2. chicken	in
3. margarine.	Season	with
4. salt
5. and pepper.
6. Add remaining ingredients, except Burgundy and orange slices.
7. Reduce heat and simmer, covered, for 35 minutes.
8. Add Burgundy and cook 10 minutes more.
title: Orange Chicken And Burgundy

ingredients.text: 1 lb steak, sliced into one inch strips
1 fresh mango, peeled and cut into one inch cubes
4 cups cooked white rice, to serve

steps: 1. Combine sugar, soy sauce, garlic, and triple sec in a large bowl an mix well.
2. Add meat, combine and coat. Cover and refrigerate 1 to 4 hours.
3. Drain meat, reserving marinade. Add cornstarch to reserved marinated and mix until blended; set aside.
4. Add oil to a large wok or skillet and bring to medium heat.
5. Stir fry steak for 3 minutes or until almost cooked through.
6. Add broccoli and stir fry for another 3 minutes, or until tender.
7. Add reserved marinade and mango and bring to a boil.
8. Stir constantly for two minutes or until sauce thickens and coats the meat.
9. Add chili powder. Season to taste with pepper.
10. Serve over cooked rice.
title: Chinese Beef And Mango Stir Fry

ingredients.text: 1 lb chicken breast, boneless, skinless, cubed
2 green bell peppers, cored and cut in chunks

steps: 1. In a small bowl, whisk together the oyster sauce, soy sauce, sugar, white pepper, rice wine vinegar and sesame oil. Set aside.

2. In a large, deep skillet or wok, over medium high, heat the vegetable oil until shimmering. Add the chicken and stir fry till lightly browned, 2 or 3 minutes. It should not be completely cooked through yet.
3. Add the green peppers, onion and fresh ginger. Stir fry till the chicken is cooked through and the onions are translucent, about 5 or 6 minutes.
4. Stir in the sauce and cashews. Enjoy!
title: Cashew Chicken

steps: 1. Remove ice glaze from frozen chicken breast by holding under lukewarm running water for approximately one minute.
2. Place chicken in shallow dish in single layer.
3. Combine lemon juice, olive oil, optional red pepper, mustard, garlic, salt, and pepper.
4. Reserve 1/4 cup of the marinade and pour the remaining marinade over the chicken.
5. Refrigerate for 20 minutes.
6. Preheat grill to medium or preheat broiler.
7. Place chicken on the grill or rack of broiler pan and baste with reserved marinade.
8. Grill (or broil 4" from heat source) for 5 minutes.
9. Baste chicken and grill for 3 minuted or until golden.
10. Turn chicken, baste, and grill 6-8 minutes or until juices run clear when the thickest part of the chicken is pierced and temp on instant read thermometer reaches 170.
title: Best Lemon Chicken

ingredients.text: 2 large chicken breasts, boned and skinned
1 1/2 to 2 Tbsp. fresh parsley, chopped (if desperate, use dried)

steps: 1. In one dish, place 1/4 cup flour.
2. In another dish, mix egg with 2 tablespoons water.
3. In third dish or on wax paper, combine bread crumbs, garlic and parsley.
4. Dip chicken pieces in flour, then in the egg mixture, then in crumbs.
5. Chill about 1 hour. Place butter, oil and lemon juice in frying pan.
6. Add chicken; saute for about 7 minutes on each side at low heat.
7. Serve at once.
8. Easy but so good.
9. Chicken can be breaded earlier and refrigerated.
10. Especially good served with a crisp tossed salad and Fettucini Alfredo.
title: Lemon Chicken Ii

steps: 1. Cut chicken in cubes.
2. Place in a small bowl and add 1 tablespoon of cornstarch, 1 tablespoon soy sauce and garlic.
3. Let stand 1/2 hour in the refrigerator.
title: Chicken Stir-Fry

steps: 1. Cook rice as directed on package.
2. Cook chicken and cut into pieces.
3. Stir-fry veggies (Japanese Birds Eye).
4. Add 3/4 cup water and bouillon.
5. Add chicken.
6. Can be thickened, if you wish.
7. Serve over rice.
title: Chicken Stir-Fry

steps: 1. Thinly slice chicken across the grain into bite-size strips.
2. Meanwhile, for sauce, stir together chicken broth, cornstarch, soy sauce, teriyaki, dry sherry, and red pepper. Set aside.

3. Spray a wok or large skillet with nonstick spray coating. Add onion, broccoli, carrot, garlic, and ginger and stir-fry for 3 minutes or until vegetables are crisp-tender. Remove vegetable mixture from wok.
4. Add oil to hot wok. Add chicken and stir-fry for 2 to 3 minutes or until done. Push chicken from center of wok. Stir sauce and add to the center of wok. Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly.
5. Return vegetables to wok. Add water chestnuts and stir all ingredients together to coat with sauce. Cook and stir for 1 to 2 minutes more or until heated through.
title: Sherry-Yaki Chicken Stir-Fry

ingredients.text: 2 cups mixed vegetables (carrot, peas, bell pepper, mushrooms, water chestnuts, etc.)

steps: 1. Combine the cornstarch, water and garlic powder. Add the mixed veggies and onion and toss to coat.
2. Heat the oil over medium heat and stir-fry the vegetables until tender. Add the broccoli and stir-fry 3-5 minutes, until tender.
3. Mix the remaining ingredients together in a small bowl and add to the pan. Cook, stirring, another two minutes before serving.
title: Simple Vegetarian Stir-Fry

ingredients.text: 3 to 4 skinless boneless chicken breasts, cubed

steps: 1. Heat oil in frying pan.
2. Add cubed chicken.
3. Cook until starting to brown.
4. Add onion and green pepper.
5. Cook until chicken is tender, stirring often.
title: Stir-Fry Chicken

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients except pork chops.
2. Marinate pork chops in sauce every 3 hours in refrigerator.
3. Place pork chops evenly in a baking dish, pour sauce on top.
4. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.
title: Chinese Pork Chops

steps: 1. Toss chicken with flour in slow cooker.
2. Stir in all remaining ingredients; cover with lid.
3. Cook on LOW for 6-8 hours or on HIGH for 3-4 hours.
4. Serve with hot cooked rice and green beans.
title: Slow Cooker Orange Chicken

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 400°.
2. Remove and discard giblets and neck from chicken. Trim excess fat. Starting at neck cavity, loosen skin from breast and drumsticks by inserting fingers, gently pushing between skin and meat.

3. Combine 1 teaspoon salt and 1/2 teaspoon black pepper in a small bowl. Rub the salt mixture under loosened skin. Lift wing tips up and over back, and tuck under chicken. Place garlic and lemon in body cavity. Place the chicken, breast side down, on a broiler pan. Bake at 400° for 1 hour or until a thermometer inserted in the meaty part of thigh registers 165°. Let stand for 10 minutes. Discard skin.
title: Roast Garlic-Lemon Chicken

ingredients.text: 1 lb boneless skinless chicken breast, cut into 1/2 inch cubes

steps: 1. Place chicken in a large resealable plastic bag; add 2 tablespoons of lemon juice. Seal bag and turn to coat; refrigerate for 1-2 hours.
2. In a nonstick skillet, saute the onions and garlic on medium heat in oil until tender.
3. Add the chicken, cumin, salt and pepper.
4. Cook on medium - high heat and stir for 5 minutes or until juices run clear.
5. Remove from heat; stir in the tomatoes, cilantro and remaining lemon juice.
6. Serve with salsa.
7. Also good with shredded cheddar and sour cream (optional) on top.
title: Lemon Chicken Tacos

ingredients.text: 1 beef bouillon cube, dissolved in 1/2 c. water

steps: 1. Cut flank steak slantwise into 1/8-inch thick slivers and brown in oil in a large frying pan.
2. Season with salt and pepper. Add onions, garlic, green peppers, celery and bouillon cube. Cover pan tightly and cook over moderate heat until meat and vegetables are tender, about 10 minutes.
title: Chinese Pepper Steak

steps: 1. Pre-heat oven to 350 degrees.
2. Dip chicken in beaten egg mixture.
3. Dredge chicken in crushed cornflakes until well coated.
4. Place chicken on a sprayed baking sheet or in a glass baking dish.
5. Cook in oven for approximately one hour, or until juices run clear.
6. Just before serving chicken, combine honey and marmalade in small microwave-safe bowl.
7. Microwave for approximately one minute until sauce melts and is heated.
8. Plate the chicken and spoon sauce over each piece.
9. Garnish serving plates with fresh parsley and a sliced orange wheel.
title: Crispy Honey-Orange Chicken

steps: 1. Marinate chicken in 2 tablespoons of soy sauce for 30 minutes. Spray nonstick pan with Pam.
2. Brown garlic; add chicken and cook thoroughly.
3. Add bell pepper and onion.
4. Cook until onion is translucent.
5. Combine the other 2 tablespoons of soy sauce, water, cornstarch and red pepper.
6. Add to meat and vegetables.
7. Cook until liquid thickens.
8. Serve over cooked rice.
title: Kung Pao Chicken

steps: 1. Cook rice as directed and drain.
2. Set aside.
3. Stir-fry shrimp, red pepper, and snow peas in oil for 2 minutes.
4. Add remaining ingredients and cook 1 minute.
5. Stir in rice.
title: Catalina Stir-Fry

steps: 1. Mix flour, margarine and sugar.
2. Place in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake for 15 minutes at 325°.
3. Mix remaining ingredients and place on top of the crust.
4. Bake for 25 to 30 more minutes.
title: Chinese Chews

ingredients.text: 1 cup bean sprouts (pressed down firmly in cup)
1 cup cooked small shrimp (or large dice medium)

steps: 1. Place 2 tablespoons oil in large skillet, and cook onions and cabbage over medium-high heat until tender.
2. Remove from heat and drain off excess liquid and set the onions and cabbage to the side.
3. Whisk eggs in a bowl and mix in soy sauce, sesame oil, spices, onion and cabbage mixture, and sprouts.
4. Using a non-stick pan over medium-high heat, heat the remaining 2 tablespoons of oil.
5. Ladle about 4 ounces of the mixture into the hot pan, as you would for pancakes, and sprinkle the shrimp evenly on top of each.
6. Cook for about 3 minutes, or until edges begin to brown, and when jiggled, they slide in the pan.
7. Flip them over and cook another 2 to 3 minutes until cooked through.
8. NOTE: If the Egg Foo Young becomes brown too quickly, finish it by baking in a preheated 350 degree oven for a few minutes.
title: Shrimp Egg Foo Yong (Low Carb And Low Fat)

steps: 1. Sprinkle chicken pieces with 1 t. salt.
2. In large ziploc bag combine flour, remaining 1/2 t. salt and pepper. Coat chicken pieces with the flour mixture.
3. In large frying pan, brown chicken in shortening.
4. While chicken browns, combine remaining ingredients in small bowl.
5. Remove any excess fat from fry pan and pour orange mixture over chicken. Cover and simmer on medium-low heat for 30 minutes, turning 2-3 times, until chicken is tender and cooked through.
title: Orange Chicken Oregano

steps: 1. Make like a pie crust and work up by hand.
2. Press in wax paper lined 9 x 13 pan.
3. Bake in a 350° oven for 10 to 12 minutes until set, but not browned.
title: Chinese Chews

steps: 1. Cut meat into small strips.
2. In bowl, toss meat with the soy sauce, oil, sugar, cornstarch and hot pepper sauce.
3. Cut celery, carrot and green pepper into matchstick thin strips.
4. In a 12-inch skillet over high heat in very hot oil, cook vegetables, stirring frequently until tender-crisp.
5. Remove vegetables to a bowl.
6. In drippings in skillet, cook the meat, stirring quickly and constantly.
7. Return vegetables and mix well.
8. Serve over rice.
title: Stir-Fry Beef, Pork Or Chicken

ingredients.text: 3 whole chicken breasts, cut into bite size pieces (or chicken tenders)

steps: 1. Combine Catsup, soy sauce, salt,Worcestershire Sauce, sugar, sesame oil, cayenne pepper, and chicken broth and set aside.
2. In a bowl, combine cornstarch, sugar, and salt.
3. Toss the chicken with cornstarch mixture.
4. Heat a wok or frying pan to a high heat and add cooking oil.
5. When oil is hot add chicken.
6. Add gingeroot, garlic and onion.
7. Stir fry mixture until chicken is cooked through and opaque.
8. Add bell pepper and carrots, stir fry until tender crisp about 2-3 minutes, then add snow peas.
9. Continue to stir fry until tender crisp.
10. Add catsup/soysauce mixture to chicken and vegetables and cook until it comes to a boil.
11. Add the cashews and serve immediately over a bed of white rice.
title: Cashew Chicken

ingredients.text: 1/4 cup all-purpose flour, or as needed
1 cup panko bread crumbs, or as needed

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C). Grease a baking sheet.

2. Press chicken cubes gently into flour to coat and shake off excess flour. Dip into beaten egg and press into panko bread crumbs. Place the breaded chicken cubes in one layer on the prepared baking sheet.
3. Bake in the preheated oven until no longer pink in the center and the juices run clear, about 20 minutes.
4. Whisk soy sauce, honey, orange juice, cornstarch, garlic powder, and ginger together in a saucepan. Cook over medium heat until sauce begins to thicken, about 5 minutes.
5. Remove chicken cubes from the oven and place in a large bowl. Pour orange sauce over chicken and turn in the sauce to coat.
title: Skinny Orange Chicken

steps: 1. Beat egg, soy sauce, sherry, ginger and garlic salt together in a pie plate. Sprinkle bread crumbs on wax paper. Dip each pork chop into egg mixture, then press into bread crumbs, coating evenly on both sides. Arrange in a single layer on baking dish. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
2. Turn and bake 30 minutes more or until chops are tender and show no pink.
title: Chinese Oven Fried Pork Chops

ingredients.text: 1 (2 1/2 to 3 lb.) frying chicken, cut up

steps: 1. In paper or plastic bag, combine flour, salt and paprika. Brush chicken with lemon juice.
2. Add 2 to 3 pieces of chicken at a time to bag and shake well.
3. In a large skillet, brown chicken in hot Crisco.
4. Dissolve bouillon cube in 3/4 cup boiling water; pour over chicken.
5. Stir in onion, brown sugar, peel and remaining lemon juice.
6. Cover: reduce heat.
title: Lemon Chicken

steps: 1. Slice zucchini and squash into 1/8-inch rounds.
2. Chop tomatoes.
3. Slice onion and separate into rings.
4. Heat the olive oil in a hot wok.
5. Add onion, zucchini and squash.
6. Cook until tender.
7. Add tomatoes and oregano.
8. Add salt and pepper to taste.
9. Stir until tomatoes are warm.
10. Pour into microwave-safe dish.
11. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and microwave on low until cheese begins to melt.
title: Summer Stir-Fry

steps: 1. Sift dry ingredients.
2. Stir in nuts and dates.
3. Mix eggs well. Spread in greased 15 x 10 x 19-inch pan.
4. Bake at 370° for 20 minutes.
5. Cut into squares while warm and roll in powdered sugar.
title: Chinese Chews

ingredients.text: 1 medium chicken breast, cut and deboned

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 325°.
2. Place chicken in baking dish.
3. Combine seasonings and remaining ingredients.
4. Pour over chicken and bake for 30 minutes.
title: Lemon Chicken(Serves 1)

steps: 1. Stir together orange juice, soy sauce and ginger root. Add chicken. Let stand 30 minutes at room temperature. Drain chicken. Reserve sauce. Saute chicken in olive oil. Stir together reserved sauce and cornstarch. Stir into pan and heat until thick and bubbly. Stir in orange sections and cashews.
title: Orange Cashew Chicken

steps: 1. Chop sausage and cook in skillet with butter until cooked through.
2. Remove sausage from pan.
3. Add water to deglaze pan.
4. Add cabbage, soy sauce, and pepper.
5. Cook until desired doneness (about 10 minutes), stirring frequently.
6. Enjoy!
title: Low Carb Stir Fry

steps: 1. Mix together, 1/2 cup butter, 1/2 cup brown sugar, 1 cup flour spread into 9x10 baking pan press down bake at 350°F for 10 minutes.
2. Mix together, 1 cup brown sugar, 2 eggs, 1 tsp vanilla, 1/2 tsp baking powder, 1 cup coconut, 1 cup walnuts; spread over first layer bake at 350°F for 20 minutes.
3. Cut into squares while still warm and roll in powdered sugar.
title: Chinese Chews

ingredients.text: 8 -10 cloves garlic, sliced in half lengthwise

steps: 1. Cut the chicken into 1/2 inch pieces.
2. Slice zucchini into rounds and slice rounds into semi-circles.
3. Heat oil in small to medium saucepan.
4. Salt and pepper chicken to taste, and add to oil along with garlic.
5. Add remaining ingredients and bring to a slight boil.
6. Remove from heat when chicken is no longer pink and zucchini is tender, but still crisp.
title: Garlic Chicken Zucchini Stir Fry

steps: 1. In a large skillet over medium heat, melt the butter.
2. Add all remaining ingredients. Reduce heat to medium-low, cover and cook for 12-15 minutes, stirring occassionally, or until celery is crisp-tender.
title: Chinese Celery

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 190°C Sprinkle the lemon juice over the chicken breasts. Mix the flour, salt and paprika in large plastic bag. Place chicken in the bag and shake the chicken in the flour mixture.

2. Heat the oil in a frypan over high heat and fry the chicken to just brown. Transfer chicken to a baking dish. Sprinkle chicken with the grated lemon rind and soft brown sugar. Cover with slices of lemon and pour over the chicken stock. Cover with foil and bake for 25 - 30 minutes.
3. Serve when ready.
title: Simple Lemon Chicken

ingredients.text: 2 chicken breasts, boned, skinned and cut into 3/4-inch cubes
2 cloves garlic, pressed or finely chopped

steps: 1. Pour oil into 13 x 9 x 2-inch oblong baking dish and microwave, uncovered, at power level High for 4 minutes.
2. While the oil is heating, combine all remaining ingredients, except green pepper and cashews.
3. Add chicken mixture to oil and microwave, uncovered, at power level High for 4 minutes, stirring twice.
4. Add green pepper and cashews.
5. Cover.
6. Microwave at power level High for 4 to 5 minutes, or until green pepper and chicken are cooked, stirring twice.
7. Let stand, covered, 2 to 3 minutes before serving.
title: Chinese Chicken With Cashews

ingredients.text: 1 lb kielbasa, cut up into bite-size pieces (pre-boil and cool if you find it too salty straight from the package)
1/2 head cabbage, coarsely shredded with a knife. Using a Kraut cutter is OK, but the regular grater cuts too finely

steps: 1. Lightly grease big, iron skillet (I like to use my chicken fryer), with canola oil.
2. Brown the Kielbasa. Take it out and put it aside. Drain excess grease.
3. Fry potatoes and carrots, stirring often, until half-cooked.
4. Add onion and keep frying, stirring frequently.
5. When the onion is half-cooked, add the cabbage and continue until everything is completely cooked.
6. Return Kielbasa to the pan, mix well, and serve once it is reheated.
7. This dish travels well and reheats well.
title: Polish Stir-Fry

steps: 1. Cut chicken into 1 1/2-inch strips.
2. Combine ingredients with 1 tablespoon oil and add chicken.
3. Let sit for 15 minutes.
title: Kung Pao Chicken(Hot And Spicy Chicken)

ingredients.text: 1 lb. smoked sausage, cut in strips

steps: 1. Prepare macaroni as per package instructions.
2. Drain well. In skillet, heat oil.
3. Add sausage and carrot; stir-fry 1 minute. Add next 5 ingredients; stir-fry until tender.
4. Stir in macaroni. Heat well.
5. Serve in heated bowl.
title: Sausage Macaroni Stir-Fry

steps: 1. Peel onions and cut into wedges. Beat the thinly sliced meat slightly with a meat mallet.
2. Mix the water and baking soda, pour over steak and leave to stand 1 hour.This helps to tenderise the meat, But not an essential step.
3. Heat 2 tbsp oil in a pan or wok . cook onions until nice and caramelised. Remove the onions from pan and arrange on a plate.
4. Add 2 tbsp oil to the pan ,add the drained steak and cook over high heat to dry the water and brown the meat.
5. Add the sauces, wine and sugar to the pan with the steak . Return to the boil,reduce heat and simmer for 10-15 minutes or until tender.
6. Spoon the meat over the onions and serve.
title: Sizzling Steak ( Chinese)

steps: 1. Combine soy sauce, red wine, cinnamon, honey, garlic, food coloring and brown sugar in a low flat dish. Lay 2 pork tenderloins in marinade. Let sit for 1 hour at room temperature, rotating tenderloins several times. Bake at 350° for 1 hour and test for doneness. Let cool and slice. Use Chinese hot mustard and sesame seeds for dipping.
title: Chinese Barbecue Pork

ingredients.text: 1 lb. round steak, sliced very thin

steps: 1. In medium bowl, mix steak, sherry, soy sauce and 1 tablespoon cornstarch.
2. Dissolve remaining 1 tablespoon cornstarch in broth and reserve.
3. Heat 1 tablespoon oil in large skillet.
4. Add beef and garlic; cook over high heat, stirring constantly, until browned, about 3 minutes.
5. Add remaining 1 tablespoon of oil.
6. Add snow peas and bean sprouts.
7. Cover and simmer over medium heat 3 to 5 minutes.
8. Add beef broth mixture; cook and stir until thickened, about 2 minutes.
9. Sprinkle with walnuts.
title: Stir-Fry Beef And Snow Peas

steps: 1. Place chicken in baking dish.
2. Mix parsley, thyme, salt, pepper, garlic and lemon juice.
3. Pour half over the chicken.
4. Bake 20 minutes.
5. Turn chicken over and pour remaining liquid over chicken.
6. Bake another 15 to 20 minutes or until done.
7. Serve over rice.
title: Lemon Chicken

steps: 1. Cook spaghetti according to package directions. Set aside.
2. Combine all ingredients in a large bowl. Toss and stir to combine.
3. To serve immediately:
4. Spray a 9x13-inch dish with cooking spray. Pour chicken/pasta mixture into dish. Cover with foil and bake at 350°F for 45 minutes or until heated through.
5. To freeze:
6. Place mixture in a large zipper freezer bag. Seal and freeze.
7. To serve:
8. Thaw in fridge. Proceed with cooking directions as above.
title: Lemon Chicken And Pasta Bake - Oamc

ingredients.text: 1 large stalk celery, cut in strips

steps: 1. Skin, bone and cut chicken into bite size pieces.
2. Saute first 4 ingredients in hot oil 5 minutes.
3. Remove from skillet.
4. Saute chicken until tender.
5. Combine cornstarch, soy sauce and broth. Add to chicken and stir until begins to bubble.
6. Cook 1 minute; add vegetables and meat.
7. Serve over rice.
title: Chinese Chicken Dinner

steps: 1. Cream margarine and both sugars; add eggs, then the rest of ingredients.
2. Bake in cake pan 9 x 13-inch at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.
3. These should not be overbaked or they will not be moist.
title: Chinese Chews

ingredients.text: 1 whole stalk celery, cut in 1-inch pieces

steps: 1. Brown hamburger and pork.
2. Saute green pepper and onion, then add to meat.
3. Add the celery and soy sauce.
4. Cover with water just to top of mixture.
5. Simmer 45 minutes to 1 hour.
6. When celery is cooked, add cornstarch to water to thicken.
7. Serve over noodles or rice.
8. Very easy and delicious!
title: Chow Mein

steps: 1. Cut zucchini into thin slices.
2. In a large saucepan combine olive oil and butter. Add zucchini and saute on low heat until tender. Before removing from heat, sprinkle with salt and garlic powder.
3. Place in serving bowl and sprinkle with fresh parmesan cheese.
title: Stir Fry Parmesan Zucchini

ingredients.text: 1 medium green pepper, cut into strips

steps: 1. Cut chicken into 1-inch pieces.
2. Place in a shallow container. Combine next 6 ingredients in a jar; cover tightly and shake well.
3. Pour over chicken and marinate overnight.
4. Combine green pepper, onion and water in a large glass bowl; cover with plastic wrap and microwave 3 to 5 minutes.
5. Drain.
6. Remove chicken from marinade and add to pepper mixture.
7. Cover with plastic wrap and microwave 7 minutes on High; stir and microwave 7 minutes more. Serve over rice.
title: Microwave Marinated Chicken Stir-Fry

steps: 1. Mix eggs and sugar; beat well.	Add all the rest of the ingredients.
2. Bake	in
3. shallow, greased pan at 350°, about 20 minutes.
4. Do not overcook.	Cut in squares.
title: Aunt Camille'S Chinese Chews

steps: 1. In a small bowl, combine the cornstarch, broth and soy sauce until smooth; set aside. In a large skillet or wok, stir-fry vegetables in oil for 4-7 minutes or until crisp-tender. Stir in the soy sauce mixture. Bring to a boil; cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened.
title: Vegetable Stir-Fry

ingredients.text: 4 green onions, diced with some green parts
4 (2-inch long chunks) cooked ham, sliced 3/8-inch thick x 3/8-inch thick

steps: 1. Butterfly shrimp, leaving tail on.
2. Place ham piece in center with 2-inch piece of green part of green onion.
3. Wrap with one piece of bacon and hold with toothpick.
4. Deep fry until bacon is brown.
title: Amazing Mongolian Shrimp

ingredients.text: 1 teaspoon orange extract (found near the vanilla)

steps: 1. Cut chicken into pieces.
2. In one dish, put 2 eggs with a dash of salt. In another put flour with one teaspoon garlic powder.
3. Coat the chicken in the egg, then the flour.
4. Brown the chicken in olive oil in a skillet.
5. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees.
6. Mix the remaining ingredients together to form the sauce.
7. Put chicken in a casserole dish. Put half the sauce over and cook for 15 minutes.
8. Flip and put remaining sauce and cook for another 15 minutes.
9. Serve over white rice.
title: Orange Chicken

steps: 1. Cream butter and sugar.
2. Add other ingredients and mix.
3. For drop cookies, chill dough first.
4. For bars, press ingredients into a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan.
5. Bake in a 325° to 350° oven until set or a light brown.
6. Glaze while still warm with a soft mixture of powdered sugar and lemon juice or water.
7. Cut into squares.
title: Chinese Chews

steps: 1. Cook linguine as directed on package. Heat olive oil in large skillet. Add garlic, zucchini and onions. Stir-fry 3 to 5 minutes until crisp-tender. Add tomatoes, parsley and seasonings. Heat 2 more minutes; remove. Stir in cooked linguine. Top with grated Parmesan cheese. Serve with garlic bread and salad.
title: Italian Pasta Stir-Fry

ingredients.text: 1 lb boneless skinless chicken breast, trimmed of excess fat

steps: 1. Combine soy sauce, dry sherry, and water in medium bowl.
2. Add chicken and stir to break up clumps.
3. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 20 minutes or up to 1 hour.
4. Mix sesame oil, cornstarch, and flour in medium bowl until smooth.
5. Drain chicken in strainer; press out excess liquid.
6. Toss chicken in cornstarch/flour mixture until evenly coated.
7. Use immediately for stir-fry.
title: Marinated Velveted Chicken For Stir-Fry

ingredients.text: 2 boneless skinless chicken breast halves (4 ounces each)

steps: 1. In a small bowl, combine orange juice and soy sauce. Pour 1/4 cup marinade into a large resealable plastic bag; add the chicken. Seal bag and turn to coat; refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Cover and refrigerate remaining marinade.

2. Drain and discard marinade. Place chicken and reserved marinade in an 8-in. square baking dish coated with cooking spray. Spoon marmalade over chicken. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 25-30 minutes or until chicken juices run clear.
title: Baked Orange Chicken

steps: 1. Brown chicken in butter.
2. Add salt and pepper.
3. Mix together brown sugar, cornstarch, ginger, orange marmalade, orange juice and lemon.
4. Add to chicken in frying pan.
5. Cover and simmer, stirring occasionally, for 25 to 35 minutes, until tender.
6. Add 1 thinly sliced orange.
7. Simmer an additional 10 minutes.
8. Serve hot.
title: Orange Chicken

steps: 1. Place chicken pieces in a single layer in a large skillet. Combine orange juice, soy sauce, molasses, dry mustard, garlic powder, cinnamon and ginder. Pour over chicken. Bring to boil, lower heat. Cover and let simmer for 30 minutes, or until chicken is tender. Add green pepper, cook 5 minutes longer.
title: Orange Chicken

ingredients.text: 4 lb. pork loin (back or meaty spareribs)

steps: 1. You will need 4 cups hickory or fruitwood chips.
title: Chinese Smoked Ribs Or Chicken

ingredients.text: 1 lime, juiced, plus lime wedges for garnish

steps: 1. In a blender or food processor, blend together the cashews, cilantro, oil, garlic, soy sauce, brown sugar, jalapeno, lime juice, and 2 tablespoons of water.
2. Blend until a smooth paste.
3. Add salt and pepper to taste.
4. Reserve a third of the marinade for serving with the chicken.
5. Use the rest for coating the chicken.
6. Sprinkle salt and pepper all over the chicken pieces.
7. Coat the chicken pieces with the marinade.
8. Chill for an hour or two.
9. Bring to room temperature before cooking.
10. Preheat broiler or grill.

11. Broil or grill chicken, turning frequently, until golden and crisp and a meat thermometer reads 175°F when inserted into the thickest part of the thigh (not touching a bone), or when the juices run clear (not pink) when cut into with a knife.
12. About 20 to 30 minutes.
13. Serve with lime wedges, reserved marinade, and cilantro.
title: Spicy Garlic Cashew Chicken

steps: 1. Slice steak diagonally across grain into 1/8 inch thick strips. Place in a large heavy-duty. zip lock plastic bag. Set aside.

2. Combine hoisin sauce and remaining 8 ingredients; stir well. Pour marinade over steak; seal bag securely. Marinate in refrigerator 8 hours, turning occasionally. Meanwhile, soak wooden skewers in water for at least 10 minutes to prevent them from burning.

3. Thread steak onto 32 (6-inch) wooden skewers, discarding marinade. Broil 3 inches from heat (with electric oven door partially opened) 2-3 minutes on each side or to desired degree of doneness. You can dress these skewers up by adding toasted sesame seeds and presenting them with roasted chopped scallions. If preferred, serve with a sauce of your choice.
title: Mongolian Meat Sticks

steps: 1. Arrange chicken pieces in baking dish.
2. Mix remaining ingredients and pour over chicken.
3. Marinate several hours or overnight.
4. COVER. Bake in 325 degree oven for 1 hour.
5. Remove cover and baste. Return to over and bake until chicken is tender.
6. Serve with jasmine rice and a green salad.
title: Chicken Cantonese

ingredients.text: 3 lb. boneless chicken breasts (or any chicken parts)

steps: 1. In a large frying pan or electric skillet, brown chicken in butter.
2. Season with salt and pepper.
3. Add remaining ingredients, except Burgundy and orange slices.
4. Reduce heat, cover (can also be put in 375° oven) and simmer, stirring and basting occasionally until tender.
5. Add Burgundy and orange slices.
6. Continue simmering another 10 minutes.
7. Serve hot.
title: Orange Chicken Burgundy

steps: 1. Combine barbecue sauce, orange juice, brown sugar, oil, flour and salt; mix well.
2. Cook, stirring, until mixture comes to a boil and thickens slightly.
3. Add chicken, pineapple, water chestnuts and ginger; cover and simmer 10 minutes.
4. Serve with rice.
title: Mandarin Chicken

steps: 1. Bring a pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add angel hair pasta and cook for 3 to 5 minutes or until al dente; drain.
2. In a small bowl, whisk together the chicken broth, soy sauce, and cornstarch.

3. Heat the oil in a wok over medium-high heat. Stir in the celery, mushrooms, peppers, and onion, and cook about 3 minutes. Add the broth mixture, bean sprouts, and snow peas. Continue to cook and stir about 5 minutes, until vegetables are tender but crisp.
4. In a large bowl, toss together the cooked pasta and the vegetable mixture. Top with chow mein noodles to serve.
title: Vegetable Lo Mein Delight

steps: 1. Heat olive oil in a large skillet or wok over medium heat. Add snow peas, onions and red pepper. Stir-fry for 2 minutes. Add shrimp. Stir-fry for 2 minutes or until shrimp turn pink.
2. Add mushrooms and cook until tender and most of liquid evaporates. Add soy sauce. Serve over rice.
title: Vegetable-Shrimp Stir-Fry

steps: 1. Heat the sunflower oil in preheated wok.
2. Add the grated carrots and leeks to the wok and cook for 2 - 3 minutes, or until the vegetables have just softened.
3. Add the orange segments to the wok and heat through gently, ensuring that you do not break up the orange segments as you stir the mixture.
4. Put the ketchup, brown sugar, and soy sauce in a small bowl and mix together.
5. Add the tomato and sugar mixture to the wok and then cook for another 2 minutes.
6. Transfer the stir-fry to warm serving bowls and scatter with the chopped peanuts.
title: Carrot & Orange Stir-Fry

steps: 1. Combine sour cream and all seasonings in a small bowl and whisk until smooth.
2. Spoon about 1/4 of the sour cream mixture over the bottom of your slow cooker.
3. Arrange chicken in a single layer over top and pour remaining sauce over chicken and spread until even.
4. Cover and cook on low for 3-4 hours.
title: Dill-Lemon Chicken

steps: 1. Clean kale and remove ribs.
2. Spray wok or skillet with cooking spray.
3. Heat on high, add kale and onions.
4. Stir for 1 to 2 minutes.
5. Pour in rice vinegar, soy sauce and sugar.
6. Reduce to medium heat and stir until kale and onions are tender crisp.
7. I cover and reduce heat to medium low and stir occasionally until cooked.
title: Kale And Onion Stir Fry

steps: 1. Mix
2. all together and spread in greased pan.
3. Bake in a 375° oven for 20 minutes.
4. Cut while warm and roll in powdered sugar.
title: Chinese Chews From Alaska(By Jimmie Mae King)

ingredients.text: 3 chicken breasts, cut in 1/2-inch cubes (1 1/2 c.)

steps: 1. Mix and set aside first 4 ingredients.
2. Heat stick-free skillet until very hot.
3. Add oil and chicken and stir-fry until done.
4. Remove chicken.
5. Add sauce ingredients and stir until combined and thick.
6. Return chicken to pan and add peanuts.
7. Heat and serve with rice.
8. (I like onions and green peppers in this, too!)
title: Kung Pao Chicken

steps: 1. Mix ingredients and pour in a greased and floured pan and bake 17 minutes at 350°.
title: Mother'S Chinese Chews

steps: 1. Star anise (available in Asian markets) comes in cellophane bags.
2. Whole ones have a total of eight points, each with an anise seed inside.
3. If you can't find a whole one, just count out eight broken pieces.
4. Use a little more or less to taste but don't omit it since it's an important element in this recipe.
5. The original recipe calls for Chinese rock sugar which imparts a lustrous finish to the gravy.
6. Available in Asian stores.
7. Remove any excess fat from the chicken.
8. Heat oil and brown chicken on all sides.
9. Add the anise, scallions, ginger& garlic and brown slightly.
10. Combine the soy sauces, brown sugar, stock and sherry and pour into the pot with the chicken.
11. Bring to a boil, then turn the heat down until the sauce is simmering slightly.
12. Cook uncovered for 45- 50 minutes, turning and basting every 10 minutes.
13. To serve just pull the meat off with a serving fork.
14. Use the gravy on the chicken and on rice.
title: Red Cooked Chicken, Eastern Chinese Style

ingredients.text: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves (4 ounces each)

steps: 1. Sprinkle chicken with salt and pepper. In a large skillet, brown chicken in butter on both sides over medium heat. Stir in lemon juice and soy sauce. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat; cover and cook for 4-5 minutes or until meat juices run clear.
2. Remove from the heat. Sprinkle each chicken breast with cheese. Cover and let stand for 2-3 minutes or until cheese is melted.
title: Cheese-Topped Lemon Chicken Breasts

ingredients.text: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves, cut into 1/2-inch strips

steps: 1. Place chicken in a large resealable plastic bag. Add cornstarch and toss to coat. Combine soy sauce, ginger and garlic powder. Add to bag and shake well. Refrigerate for 30 minutes.
title: Chicken Stir-Fry

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 pounds uncooked medium shrimp, peeled and deveined

steps: 1. Stir the rice and 1 3/4 cup water together in a microwave-safe bowl. Cover, and cook in the microwave on High for 8 minutes until the water is fully absorbed. Fluff with a fork.
2. Whisk together the soy sauce, water, honey, cider vinegar, and cornstarch in a small bowl. Set the sauce aside.

3. Heat the olive oil in a non-stick skillet over medium heat. Stir in the garlic and cook for 10 seconds. Add the broccoli, carrots, onion, and black pepper; cook and stir until the broccoli and carrots are tender, about 5 minutes. Stir in the mushrooms and cook for 2 minutes. Remove the vegetables from the skillet and set aside.

4. Return the skillet to the heat and pour in the sauce mixture; cook for 1 minute. Add the shrimp to the sauce and stir until the shrimp are bright pink on the outside and the meat is no longer transparent in the center and the sauce thickens, about 3 minutes. Stir the vegetables back into the pan and serve over the brown rice.
title: Easy Shrimp Vegetable Stir Fry

steps: 1. Cut pork into 1/2-inch strips.
2. Core and slice apples.
3. Chop green onions.
4. Stir-fry pork until done; add apples, pepper and onions.
5. Continue to stir-fry until tender-crisp.
6. Add pecans.
7. Mix together the broth, brown sugar, vinegar, cornstarch, Worcestershire, salt and pepper.
8. Add the sauce to the skillet and cook over medium heat.
9. Stir until sauce thickens.
title: Granny Smith Stir-Fry

steps: 1. Trim fat from meat.
2. Sprinkle with salt and pepper.
3. Rub mustard on roast.
4. Place in large Dutch oven; cover and bake at 350° for 2 1/2 hours or until meat thermometer reaches 170°. Drain oranges, reserving liquid.
5. Set oranges aside.
title: Mandarin Pork Roast

steps: 1. Remove the surface layer of fat from the thighs. Rinse and towel dry.
2. In a large non-stick skillet, combine all remaining ingredients.
3. Over medium-high heat, bring the mixture up to a boil, then add the chicken (bones up).
4. Reduce heat to low; cover and simmer for 15 minutes.
5. Remove the cover, turn the chicken pieces over, raise the heat to medium, and cook until the liquid is evaporated and the chicken is glazed, about 10 to 15 minutes.
title: Chinese Citrus Chicken Thighs

steps: 1. Mash garlic.
2. Mix with soy sauce, sugar and salt. Cut pork butt into 3 pieces, lengthwise.
3. Put meat in a shallow dish.
4. Pour garlic mixture over meat.
5. Let meat stand in the refrigerator for 1 hour.
6. Turn meat a few times. Remove meat from dish.
7. Lay pieces on a rack in an uncovered pan.
8. Bake 1 to 1 1/2 hours at 350°. Serve hot or cold.
title: Chinese Roast Pork

steps: 1. Cut chicken into 1/2 inch strips.
2. Stir together cornstarch, soy sauce and garlic.
3. Add chicken strips.
4. Toss to coat.
5. Marinate at least 30 minutes.
6. Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a large skillet.
7. Stir fry chicken until no longer pink.
8. Remove and keep warm.
9. Do not overcook.
10. Add remaining 1 tablespoons oil to skillet.
11. Stir fry broccoli, celery, carrots, and onions until done as you like.
12. Add chicken stock.
13. Add reserved cooked chicken.
14. Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly.
title: Chicken Stir Fry

steps: 1. Saut onion and celery with 1 tablespoon butter. In a large mixing bowl, combine chicken, onion, celery, garlic powder, Worcestershire sauce and mayonnaise. Form into 1-inch balls, using a teaspoon. Place on a cookie sheet and chill for 20 to 30 minutes.
title: Party-Perfect Cashew Chicken Balls

ingredients.text: 6 ounces mild blue cheese, crumbled (about 1 cup)

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350*F and lightly butter or oil a baking dish large enough to hold the chicken breasts in a single layer.
2. Stir together sour cream, blue cheese, lemon zest, lemon juice, and parsley in a bowl and set aside.
3. Combine the flour, rosemary, salt and pepper in a shallow dish and stir to mix.
4. Coat the chicken in the flour evenly, patting to remove excess.
5. Heat the butter and oil in a large skillet over medium high heat just until it is beginning to brown.
6. Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 4 minutes per side, without crowding the skillet (cook in batches, if need be).
7. Transfer the chicken to the baking dish, skin side up if using breasts with skin.
8. Spread the blue cheese mixture evenly over the chicken.
9. Combine the bread crumbs with the melted butter and parmesan cheese, stirring to mix.

10. Sprinkle the mixture evenly over the chicken and bake until the topping is nicely browned and the chicken is cooked through, about 20 minutes (until juices run clear when pierced with the tip of a knife through the thickest part).
title: Blue Cheese And Lemon Chicken

steps: 1. Heat wok or fry pan over medium heat. Add olive oil, then onion and a little salt. Saute until just brown, slightly caramelized.
2. Add sesame oil to pan. Add garlic and bell peppers. Salt, slightly. Saute until peppers reach desired tenderness.
3. Add chicken, soy sauce, honey, and red pepper flakes. Stir-fry until warm.
4. Add ginger and five spice powder. Stir gently.
5. I served this over jasmine rice.
6. Again, please remember this was thrown together on a whim - please adjust to suit your own tastes.
title: Five Spice Chicken Stir-Fry

ingredients.text: 4 boneless chicken breast, cut into cubes

steps: 1. Turn on a multi-functional pressure cooker (such as Instant Pot(R)) and select Saute function. Heat olive oil and add chicken cubes; cook until golden, stirring constantly, about 3 minutes. Stir in chicken broth, brown sugar, soy sauce, carrot, garlic, ginger, and chili powder. Close and lock the lid. Select high pressure according to manufacturer's instructions; set timer for 7 minutes. Allow 10 to 15 minutes for pressure to build.

2. Release pressure using the natural-release method according to manufacturer's instructions, about 10 minutes. Complete releasing pressure carefully using the quick-release method according to manufacturer's instructions, about 5 minutes. Unlock and remove the lid. Reselect Saute function.

3. Whisk cornstarch in 1/4 cup water until fully dissolved. Pour into the pot and stir to combine. Cook until sauce thickens, stirring gently, about 4 minutes. Sprinkle with sesame seeds before serving.
title: Instant Pot® Mongolian Chicken

ingredients.text: 2 tablespoons finely chopped red bell pepper

steps:
1. In a bowl, mix the lemon juice, olive oil, Dijon mustard, garlic, red bell pepper, salt, and pepper. Set aside 1/4 cup of the mixture to use for basting. Place chicken in the bowl, and marinate at least 20 minutes in the refrigerator.
 Watch Now

2. Preheat grill for high heat.
 Watch Now

3. Lightly oil grill grate. Drain and discard marinade from the bowl, and place chicken on the grill. Cook 6 to 8 minutes on each side, until juices run clear, basting occasionally with the reserved marinade.
 Watch Now
title: Grilled Lemon Chicken

steps: 1. Brown meat; add water.
2. Cook until meat is almost done.
3. Add celery, onion, corn syrup and soy sauce.
4. Cook until vegetables are done.
5. Thicken with cornstarch.
6. Serve over rice.
title: Chop Suey

steps: 1. Mix wine vinegar, soy and sugar. Coat chicken with cornstarch. Stir-fry for 5 to 7 minutes and remove. Stir-fry onion, garlic, red pepper and ginger for 1 minute. Add wine vinegar mixture, chicken and peanuts and stir. Serve over rice.
title: Kung Pao Chicken

steps: 1. Beat eggs and add to sugar.
2. Sift all dry ingredients; add dates and nuts.
3. Add flour mixture to other ingredients.
4. Beat well.
5. Line 6 x 11-inch pan with waxed paper and spread dough to depth of 1/2 inch.
6. Bake 40 minutes at 350°.
7. Makes 22 (1 x 3-inch) bars.
title: Chinese Chews

steps: 1. Grate 1 tsp of zest from the lemon, and press 1 tbs of juice.
2. Combine the zest and juice with stock, honey, and soy sauce.
3. Heat oil in a large wok with a cover and brown the thighs.
4. Remove the thighs from oil and add the onion; saute until soft.
5. Add the rice, pepper, and broth mixture; top with the browned thighs.
6. Cover and simmer for 30 minutes or until the liquid is absorbed.
title: Honey-Lemon Chicken Thighs

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 lbs boneless skinless chicken breasts, cubed
8 green onions, cut into 2 nch pieces

steps: 1. Heat a large wok or skillet over high heat.
2. Add oil and when hot add chicken and stir-fry until brown on all sides, about 6 minutes.
3. Remove chicken and set aside.
4. Add pineapple and molasses to wok and stir-fry until pineapple is brown and tender.
5. Stir in the lime juice, red pepper flakes, green onions and chicken.
6. Saute until scallions are bright green and the chicken is fully cooked, about 15 minutes.
7. Toss in ginger and serve over rice.
title: Pineapple Ginger Chicken Stir-Fry

steps: 1. Mix butter, 1/2 cup brown sugar and flour.
2. Spread in greased 10 x 10-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.
3. Mix rest of the ingredients together and spread over mix in pan.
4. Bake 20 minutes. Cut in squares. Roll in powdered sugar while warm.
title: Chinese Chews

steps: 1. Cook ingredients until tender.
2. Cook 1/2 fryer.
3. When cool, cut into pieces to make 2 cups.
title: Chicken Chow Mein

steps: 1. Stir-fry beans, mushrooms and scallions in oil for 4 to 5 minutes.
2. Stir in all remaining ingredients.
3. Cook for another 2 to 3 minutes.
title: Green Bean & Mushroom Stir-Fry

steps: 1. Stir fry garlic for one minute.
2. Add beef strips.
3. Stir fry 2 minutes.
4. Season with salt and pepper.
5. Remove.
6. Add zucchini to pan.
7. Stir fry until tender crisp.
8. Return beef to skillet.
9. Add tomatoes and dressing.
10. Heat through.
11. Serve over pasta.
12. Sprinkle with Parmesan.
title: Italian Beef Stir Fry

steps: 1. Slice the zucchini and potato 1/8-inch thick, then slice lengthwise like shoestrings.
2. Slice onions in strips.
3. Cube the bacon.
4. Put potatoes, bacon and onions in pan and stir-fry about one minute, then add the squash and stir-fry about nine more minutes.
5. It should be a little crisp.
title: Zucchini Stir-Fry

steps: 1. preheat oven to 375.
2. put chicken in a roasting pan.
3. heat remaining ingredients in microwave for 1 minute to warm, and pour over chicken roast the chicken 30-40 minutes, basting with the sauce every 10 minutes.
4. the sauce will thicken.
title: Sticky Lemon Chicken

ingredients.text: 6 pork chops, pork loin chops, centre-cut, bone-in (either thick or thin)

steps: 1. In a bowl, combine hoisin sauce, soy sauce, lime juice, garlic, ginger and pepper. Slash edges of pork chops to prevent curling. Place pork chops in a 9 x 13 pan, and pour marinade over, turning to coat; let stand for at least 30 minutes, or for up to 24 hours (if this is the case, cover and refrigerate, turning occasionally).
2. Place chops on greased grill. Broil, turning once, until juices run clear when pork is pierced, about 8 minutes.
title: Pork Chops With Hoisin And Lime

ingredients.text: 3 oz. sliced water chestnuts (reserve 1/4 c. liquid)

steps: 1. Sprinkle cornstarch over chicken; add soy sauce and let marinate for 15 minutes.
2. Heat 1 1/2 teaspoons oil; brown chicken and remove from skillet.
3. In same skillet, heat remaining oil; add onion and cashews and stir-fry until onion is tender.
4. Add mushrooms and garlic; stir-fry for 1 minute.
5. Return chicken to skillet; add water chestnuts and reserved liquid.
6. Cover and cook until heated through, one to two minutes.
7. Serve sprinkled with green onion.
title: Cashew Chicken

ingredients.text: 3 tablespoons butter or 3 tablespoons margarine, melted

steps: 1. In shallow dish, combine the first five ingredients.
2. Place bread crumbs in another dish.
3. Dip chicken in butter mixture, then coat with crumbs.
4. Place in greased 13x9x2 baking pan; drizzle with remaining butter mixture.
5. Bake uncovered at 350 for 25-30 minutes or until juices run clear.
title: Baked Lemon Chicken

steps: 1. Melt butter in skillet or wok. Saute scallops

2. in melted butter for 3 minutes. Add sliced mushrooms and cook for 2 more minutes. Pour in teriyaki sauce and cook 2 additional minutes. Stir in cashews just before serving. Serve over favorite rice.
title: Scallop Stir-Fry

ingredients.text: 1 (1-lb) head broccoli, cut into florets (3.5 to 4 cups)

steps: 1. Fill bottom part of a steamer with 1 inch of water; bring to boil.

2. Toss chicken with garlic, ginger, scallions, soy sauce, and red pepper flakes, coating breasts well. Place chicken in the steamer basket, pouring remaining soy sauce mixture over chicken. Lower basket into water container, reduce to a rapid summer, and cover with a lid. Steam for 5 minutes.
3. Turn chicken breasts, add broccoli, cover, and continue steaming until chicken is cooked through and broccoli is tender, 5 to 6 minutes more. Serve hot.
title: Chinese-Style Steamed Chicken

steps: 1. Mix together soy sauce, oil, mustard, ginger, pepper and garlic.
2. Add chicken strips to mixture.
3. Marinate 1/2 hour, stirring frequently.
4. Place chicken and mixture in a shallow baking pan.
5. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
6. Baste every 10 minutes.
title: Baked Chicken Chinese Style

ingredients.text: 1 cup vegetable oil, for deep frying

steps: 1. Coat the beef in cornstarch and mix with the ingredients except the green onions.
2. Sautee the garilc and ginger in the 2 teaspoons of vegetable oil (about 2 to three minutes).
3. Put the rest in the skillet and cook.
title: Chinese Beef

steps: 1. Beat egg with 1 teaspoon lemon juice.
2. Combine garlic powder, paprika and flour.
3. Dip chicken in egg, then flour mixture.
4. Brown chicken in margarine.
5. Dissolve bouillon cube in boiling water; add 2 teaspoons lemon juice.
6. Add to skillet with chicken.
7. Cover; let simmer for 20 minutes.
title: Lemon Chicken

steps: 1. Beat together the eggs, bean sprouts, green onions, shrimp, and garlic powder in a bowl until well-combined. Heat the oil in a skillet over medium heat, and scoop about 1/2 cup of the egg mixture into the skillet to make a patty. Fry until golden brown, about 4 minutes per side, and repeat with the remaining egg mixture. Set the patties aside.

2. Whisk together the chicken broth, cornstarch, sugar, vinegar, and soy sauce in a saucepan over medium-low heat until the sauce simmers and thickens, about 5 minutes. Spoon the sauce over the patties.
title: Shrimp Egg Foo Young

ingredients.text: 1 lb. turkey breast, cut into 1/2-inch strips

steps: 1. In a plastic bag, combine salt, pepper, garlic powder and paprika; mix well.
2. Add turkey strips and coat with seasonings. In a skillet (or wok), heat 2 tablespoons oil; stir-fry turkey 3 to 4 minutes or until no longer pink inside.
3. Remove from skillet; keep warm.
4. Add remaining oil, yellow peppers, green peppers and snow peas.
5. Stir-fry 1 minute.
6. Sprinkle with Italian seasoning. Reduce heat and cook 2 minutes until vegetables are tender and crisp.
7. Add turkey and tomatoes.
8. Heat 2 minutes longer until warm through.
title: Garden Fresh Turkey Stir-Fry

ingredients.text: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil, sub. peanut oil, more as needed
1 lb chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces
4 ounces water chestnuts, course shop, approx. 1/2 can
1 cup long grain white rice, cooked
1/4 cup green onion, sliced, with tender green stems for garnish

steps: 1. In a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat, warm the oil.
2. Add the sesame seeds and ginger to the oil and saute until fragrant and seeds golden, about 2 minutes *CAREFUL have a lid ready, it pops!
3. Add the onions, bell pepper and salt. Saute for 1 minute.
4. Add the chicken, more oil if necessary and continue to saute until chicken is cooked through and no longer pink.
5. Add water chestnuts, hoisin sauce, soy sauce, Worcestershire sauce, vinegar. cook until flavors are well blended, about 2-3 minutes.
6. Serve over rice and top with green onions.
title: Stir-Fried Hoisin Chicken With Sesame Seeds

steps: 1. Shred chicken with your fingers.
2. Cut all vegetables into thin strips and keep separate the carrots, cabbage, onion and peppers.
3. Heat stove at medium/high temp and add 2 Tbsp olive oil to a deep pot. Melt a stick of butter.
4. Heat a second deep pot and add 2 Tbsp olive oil. Melt half a stick of butter
5. Place the onion and all the peppers in pot # 2.
6. Place the cabbage in pot # 1.
7. Constantly stir all vegetables in both pots.
8. When the onions are translucent, add the carrots.
9. When the carrots are soft, add the cooked chicken.
10. When all is mixed, add the ketchup and soy sauce.
11. Stir frequently.
12. When the cabbage is soft, combine pot # 2 with pot # 1.
13. Lower the heat to medium or med/low making sure the vegetables don't get too soft.
14. Add lemon juice.
15. Taste and adjust seasoning as needed. (add 1/4 cup ketchup, 1 tsp salt, etc. depending on the size of the cabbage.).
16. Enjoy.
title: Chop Suey Nicaragüense

ingredients.text: 1 lb boneless skinless chicken breast (cut into 1 inch pieces)

steps: 1. Step by step.
2. Prepare rice according to package instructions.
3. Blanch (slightly steam) the broccoli. It should still be fairly crisp.
4. In a small bowl, prepare the sauce by whisking together 1 tablespoon of cornstarch and the water first, then add the chicken broth, garlic, ginger, honey, soy sauce and pepper flakes.
5. Adjust the pepper flakes to your taste. I used only 1/2 tablespoon so my kids could eat it.
6. Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium high heat.
7. In another small bowl, mix the remaining 3 tablespoons of cornstarch, salt and pepper.
8. Throw the chicken pieces into the cornstarch mixture and toss to coat.
9. Working in batches, brown the chicken in the oil.
10. Once all the chicken is browned, put it all back into the skillet.
11. Add the broccoli and the sauce.
12. Cook over for a few minutes more until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce is thickened.
13. Serve the chicken and broccoli mixture over rice.
14. Garnish with green onion and sesame seeds if desired.
title: General Tso'S Chicken (Take Out Fakeout)

ingredients.text: 3/4 lb snow peas, trimmed and halved crosswise
1 lb boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut into 1-inch pieces

steps: 1. In a large bowl, whisk 1 tablespoon of the cornstarch and the cold water together until smooth. Add the garlic, ginger, brown sugar, soy sauce, and red pepper flakes and whisk to combine. Stir in the peas and set aside.
2. In a small bowl, whisk the egg whites, remaining 3 tablespoons of cornstarch, salt, and pepper until well combined. Add the chicken pieces, and toss to coat.

3. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium to medium-high heat. Add 1 tablespoon of the oil, and once shimmering, add half of the chicken from the egg white mixture (be sure to shake the excess off). Cook the chicken until golden on all sides, about 6-8 minutes. Transfer to a plate and tent with foil. Add the remaining oil to the pan and repeat with the other half of the chicken.

4. Reduce the heat under the pan then add the snow pea mixture to the now empty skillet. Cover the pan and cook until the peas are tender and the sauce thickens, about 3-5 minutes. Add the chicken (and any juices on the plate) back to the skillet. Toss to coat with the sauce and, if necessary, finish cooking the chicken through. Serve the chicken on a bed of rice, if desired.
title: Lighter General Tso'S Chicken

steps: 1. Cut the chicken breasts into slivers (1 inch by 1/4 inch).
2. Stir together soy sauce, wine, vinegar, ginger and garlic. Add the chicken pieces, mix so the chicken is coated with the marinade and let stand for at least 15 minutes.
3. Add oil to wok over high heat. When oil is hot, add the walnut pieces. Toss until the color changes, less than a minute. Set aside.
4. Add the scallions to the rest of the oil and fry briefly until the color brightens. Set aside.
5. Add the chicken to the pan, reserving the marinade. Stir-fry until opaque, 1-2 minutes.

6. Add the stock and the reserved marinade and bring the mixture to a boil. Stir the cornstarch in the water so it is evenly dissolved and add it to the mix along with the scallions. Cook and stir until the sauce is thickened.
7. Serve with the walnuts.
title: Chinese Walnut Chicken

steps: 1. Heat oil in large fry pan or wok.
2. Slice pork into bite sized strips.
3. Salt and pepper pork and toss with Hoisin Sauce.
4. Add to oil. Saute 2-3 minutes.
5. Add garlic and cranberry juice. Bring to a boil.
6. Remove pork mixture to a baking dish and keep in a 350 degree oven.
7. Wipe out pan and add 1 T. of oil to it.
8. Add sliced cabbage and soy sauce.
9. Stir fry until wilted but still crunchy.
10. Add pork back to cabbage mix and combine.
11. Serve over rice.
title: Chinese Bbq Pork Stir Fry

steps: 1. Add the oil to a skillet on medium heat. Add the shrimp and saute for a couple of minutes. Remove the shrimp from the skillet and set aside.
2. In the same skillet, saute the bell pepper, shallot, and cayenne peppers for about 7 minutes.
3. Add the soy sauce, wine, vinegar, sugar, and cornstarch to the vegetables, mixing well so the cornstarch cooks through. Add less cornstarch for a thinner sauce.
4. Add the shrimp and let simmer in the sauce for 3 minutes.
title: Chinese-Style Spicy Shrimp

steps: 1. Beat eggs; add next ingredients. Mix well. Add flour slowly. Dough should be somewhat thin. Add remaining ingredients. Dough should be thick enough to hold together.
2. Drop by teaspoon on cookie sheet. Bake in preheated oven at 375° for about 8 minutes or until edges are light brown.
title: Chinese Chewies

ingredients.text: 1 sweet red pepper cut into strips

steps: 1. Slice steak diagonally across grain into thin strips. Set aside. Combine cornstarch and beef broth. Set aside. Pour 1 tablespoon oil into heated wok. Add garlic; stir fry 30 seconds. Add pepper, stir well.
2. Remove and set aside. Pour remaining oil in wok. Add steak and cook 2 minutes. Stir in curry powder. Return other ingredients. Mix well. Serve over rice or pasta.
title: Indian Stir Fry

ingredients.text: 2 medium bell pepper, preferably red or yellow, julienned

steps: 1. Heat oil and skillet; saute onion, bell pepper, carrots, peanuts, ginger, green onion and pepper flakes along with rosemary, if using, until onions are translucent and vegetables are slightly wilted. Add soy sauce and stir well. Add rice and heat through. Serve immediately.
title: Chinese Goobers

steps: 1. In a microwave, melt chocolate and butterscotch chips, stir until smooth. Stir in chow mein noodles and peanuts until well coated.
2. Drop by rounded tablespoonfuls onto a waxed paper-lined
3. . Refrigerate for 2 hours or until set.
title: Chocolate Chow Mein Clusters

steps: 1. Cook pork slightly in a nonstick skillet sprayed with non stick spray just until slightly pink in the center. Let cool 5 minutes and cut into thin strips.

2. Heat oil in large skillet or wok over medium high heat. Stir fry onion and garlic for 2-3 minutes. Add cabbage, carrots, bell pepper, mushrooms, pork, crushed red pepper, salt and pepper; stir fry for 5 minutes until vegetables are crisp tender.
3. Combine chicken broth and cornstarch in a small cup until smooth. Add to skillet; cook and stir gently about 1 minute or until slightly thickened.

title: Twice Cooked Pork Stir Fry

steps: 1. Cut pork into thin strips.
2. Dredge in the flour.
3. Cook quickly but thoroughly in the hot oil.
4. Remove meat from skillet.
5. Add remaining ingredients to drippings and cook 2 minutes until crisp but tender.
6. Stir pork strips in and serve.
title: Stir-Fry Lemon-Honey Pork

steps: 1. In skillet, heat 2 tablespoons oil to 375 degrees.
2. Add the onion and green pepper. Saute just until tender, stirring constantly.
3. Remove to a plate, using a slotted spoon. Add 2 more tablespoons oil and the celery, zucchini, yellow squash and carrots.
4. Cook just until crisp tender.
5. Remove to plate with slotted spoon.
6. Add the remaining 2 tablespoons oil to the skillet.
7. Saute the steak just until it begins to change color. Add the vegetables back to the skillet.
8. Add the soy sauce and stir.
9. Serve immediately over the rice.
title: Beef And Veggie Stir-Fry

steps: 1. Arrange chicken in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
2. Drizzle melted margarine over chicken; sprinkle with paprika.
3. In small bowl, combine onion, salt, rosemary, pepper, orange juice, orange peel and cornstarch; mix well.
4. Pour over chicken.
5. Bake, uncovered, for 40 to 45 minutes, or until tender.
6. Baste occasionally.

steps: 1. Combine cornstarch and pepper in a resealable plastic bag. Add chicken pieces and shake bag to coat with cornstarch mixture.

4. Close and lock lid. Select Slow Cook function. Cook on Low until flavors are well combined and chicken is cooked through, about 2 hours. Garnish with green onions.
title: Slow-Cooked Cashew Chicken

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 375F.
2. Wash chicken under cold water, drain well.
3. In a large bowl combine soy sauce, onions, garlic and ginger, mix well.
4. Add chicken in mixture, make sure chicken gets coated well.
5. Marinate chicken 30-45 minutes.
6. Place chicken in lightly greased baking dish.
7. Combine cinnamon, cloves, and pepper, mix well and sprinkle over chicken.
8. Bake 30 minutes covered, remove cover and bake an additional 10-15 minutes or until chicken is done.
title: 5 Spice Chinese Chicken

ingredients.text: 3 medium bell peppers, seeded and cut into strips (any color combination will work)

steps: 1. Combine first 3 ingredients in a small bowl; set aside.
2. Coat a wok or skillet with non-stick cooking spray; add oil.
3. Place over medium-high heat until hot.
4. Add peppers and stir-fry 4 minutes.
5. Add reserved sauce mixture.
6. Cook, stirring constantly until thickened.
7. Serve over hot, cooked rice.
title: Bell Pepper Stir-Fry

title: Mongolian Beef For 4: $10 Recipe!

ingredients.text: 1 lb raw shrimp, shelled and cleaned

steps: 1. Remove the crusts from the bread.
2. Dice the bread into 1/4-inch cubes.
3. Place on a cookie sheet and dry out in a very low oven (200F/90C).
4. Pat the shrimp dry and mince in a food processor or blender.

6. With wet hands, shape the shrimp paste into 1-inch balls and roll in the bread cubes.
7. Press the cubes fimrly into the shrimp mixture.
8. Heat the oil in a wok or deep, wide pot to 375 F.
9. Cook the shrimp balls in batches until nicely browned and cooked through (this should only take 4 to 5 minutes).
10. Drain on paper towels.
11. Makes approx.
12. 36 balls.
13. Bonnie Stern Cookbook.
title: Hundred Corner Shrimp Balls (Dim Sum)

ingredients.text: 2 c. light brown sugar, packed (1 box)

steps: 1. Mix sugar and melted oleo well.
2. Add flour and eggs; mix well. Add vanilla and pecans and mix well.
3. Pour in greased and floured pan.
4. Bake for 45 minutes at 325°.
5. Remove from oven and cool completely before cutting into squares.
6. Makes 24 cookies.
title: Chinese Chews

steps: 1. Cream butter and sugar.
2. Add beaten eggs, then the flour that has been sifted with the cream of tartar and the soda.
3. Mix well. Add dates, nuts and flavoring.
4. Spread in 8-inch pan.
5. Bake 35 to 40 minutes at 350°.
title: Chinese Chews

ingredients.text: 6 fryers, cleaned, washed and quartered (you may use all breasts, leg quarters or pieces)
1 1/2 Tbsp. garlic powder (adjust if too much for you)

steps: 1. Melt margarine; add garlic powder and Worcestershire sauce. Turn heat off and add lemon juice.
2. Mix all these ingredients well.
3. Do not let mixture boil after adding lemon juice.
4. (This is called "juice" hereafter.)
5. Dip chicken in juice, letting some drip off, then lay on grill.
6. (Can be done on gas grill, but we find an old-fashioned charcoal grill is best.)
7. Continue to dip and turn for about an hour or until chicken is done, depending on size of pieces.
8. Main thing is to dip and turn many times during the course of cooking to get more flavor throughout chicken.
title: Grilled Lemon Chicken

ingredients.text: 4 boneless chicken breasts, cut into small pieces

steps: 1. Beat egg with 1 tablespoon lemon juice.
2. Combine flour, garlic powder and paprika.
3. Dip chicken in egg mixture, then flour mixture.
4. Saute chicken in margarine in a skillet.
5. Dissolve bouillon in boiling water and add remaining lemon juice.
6. Add to skillet.
7. Cover and simmer 20 minutes or until tender.
title: Lemon Chicken

steps: 1. Heat oils in a wok or wide pan. Add garlic and onions and cook approximately 2 minutes.
2. Add peppers, broccoli and mushrooms. Cook until onions and peppers soften, approximately 3-4 minutes.
3. Add ginger, hoisin, fish sauce, soy sauce and sriracha. Stir well.
4. Mix cornstarch into the water and add to vegetables, along with carrots and snow peas. Allow to simmer until sauce begins to thicken, approximately 5-7 minutes.
5. Serve over rice or noodles.
title: Ginger Garlic Vegetable Stir Fry

steps: 1. Put chicken in a shallow pan.
2. Sprinkle salt and pepper on top.
3. Inset lemon in cavity.
4. Bake, breast up, at 350° for 1 hour, breast down at 350° for 1/2 hour and breast up at 400° for 1/2 hour.
title: Lemon Chicken

steps: 1. Slightly heat oil in wok or frying pan.
2. Add onions and stir a few moments.
3. Add the meat and let simmer for 5 minutes.
4. Add the carrots and green pepper and stir-fry a few moments.
5. Add the mushrooms, bean sprouts and soy sauce; stir-fry a few more moments and serve with rice.
title: Stir-Fry Beef

steps: 1. In a medium bowl, combine chicken, 2 tablespoons soy sauce, 2 teaspoons cornstarch and ginger; toss until well blended.
2. In a small bowl, mix remaining soy sauce, water, sugar and remaining cornstarch.
3. Set aside.
4. Heat 2 tablespoons salad oil in skillet. Add chicken and stir over high heat for 3 minutes.
5. Remove with slotted spoon.
6. Add remaining salad oil to pan and heat.
7. Add carrots and onion; stir-fry 3 minutes; add zucchini and stir-fry 2 minutes more.
8. Return chicken to skillet and add soy sauce.
9. Cook until mixture thickens.
10. Serve with rice.
title: Stir-Fry Chicken

steps: 1. In a large, stainless-steel saucepan, brown the chicken, patted dry and seasoned with salt and pepper, in batches, in the butter over moderate-high heat, transferring it to a plate as it is browned.
2. Pour off all but 2 tblsps of the fat from the saucepan.
3. Add the flour mixture, cinnamon and ginger to the saucepan and cook the roux over low heat, stirring, for 3 minutes.
4. Add the orange juice in a stream, whisking.
5. Bring the liquid to a boil, stirring, and simmer the sauce until slightly thickened.
6. Stir in the honey, almonds and the raisins and arrange the chicken in the skillet in one layer (or as close to it as you can).
7. Simmer the chicken, covered, for 30 minutes, or until it is tender.
8. Transfer to a plate and tent with foil to keep warm.
9. Skim the fat from the sauce and reduce it over moderate-high heat until it is thick enough to coat back of spoon.
10. Add the orange slices and heat over low heat until the slices are heated through.
11. Nap the chicken breasts with the orange slices and some of the sauce.
12. Pass the remaining sauce separately.
title: Orange Chicken With Almonds

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
2. Cream shortening and sugar.
3. Add eggs and vanilla.
4. Mix flour and salt with nuts, coconut and dates.
5. Fold flour mixture into creamed mixture.
6. Bake in greased 8 x 8 inch baking dish for 20 minutes.
7. Cool slightly on a rack before cutting into bars.
title: Chinese Chews

ingredients.text: 1/2 pound shrimp, peeled, deveined and roughly chopped
