steps: 1. In a skillet over medium heat, heat sesame oil and lightly fry the onions, celery and sprouts. Stir in cornstarch and add shrimp, soy sauce and salt. Stir until well blended. Remove from heat and transfer to a bowl.

2. Return the pan to the heat, and add the beaten eggs. Fry the eggs while stirring gently. Return the vegetable and shrimp mixture to the pan while the eggs are still liquid. Finish frying until eggs are fully cooked.
title: Egg Foo Young

steps: 1. Put chops into the stoneware. In a small bowl, combine sugar, spices, soy sauce, ketchup, and garlic. Pour evenly over the top of chops. No need to add any other liquid. If you had an onion in the house, it might be a nice addition, but not necessary for flavor.

2. Cover and cook on low for 6-8 hours, or on high for about 4. If your chops are frozen they will take longer to cook. The longer you cook the meat, the more tender it will, but it might fall off the bone.
title: Peking Pork Chops - Slowcooker

steps: 1. Chop or slice zucchini.
2. Add onion.
3. Stir-fry until crisp-tender.
4. Add cheese; toss and serve.
5. Very quick and delicious.
6. I use garlic butter to saute veggies.
title: Zucchini Stir-Fry

steps: 1. Slice chicken in long thin strips.
2. Dip in batter.
3. Deep fry in vegetable oil.
title: Chinese Chicken Fingers

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
2. Arrange chicken breast in a single layer, top side up, in a baking dish.
3. In a small bowl combine orange juice, soy sauce, brown sugar and ginger.
4. Pour over the Chicken.
5. Bake for 35 minutes.
6. Remove chicken from pan.
7. Combine cornstarch with the Splenda and 1/2 cup of water.
8. Stir until smooth and then stir into pan juices.
9. Put chicken back in pan, top side down in the sauce.
10. Bake 10 to 15 minutes longer or untill sauce is thickened and chicken is tender.
11. Garnish with orange slices and parsley.
title: Ginger Orange Chicken

steps: 1. Beat together margarine, sugars and eggs until creamy.
2. Then add salt and flour, coconut, chocolate chips and pecans.
3. Pour in two 9-inch cake pans, greased and floured.
4. Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.
5. Let cool and sprinkle with powdered sugar or leave plain.
title: Chinese Chews

steps: 1. Cut up chicken into bite-sized pieces and marinate in salt and Accent for 1/2 hour.
title: Cashew Chicken

ingredients.text: 1 lb chicken breast, cut into thin strips (boneless, skinless)
1/2 bunch broccoli, cut into florets (3 cups)
2 carrots, thinly sliced on the diagonal

steps: 1. Cook rice according to package directions, omitting salt and fat.

2. Meanwhile, combine chicken, orange zest, 1 tablespoons cornstarch and 1 tablespoons soy sauce in a large bowl and toss to coat. Combine orange juice, broth, honey, sesame oil, pepper flakes, remaining 2 teaspoons cornstarch and remaining 1 tablespoons soy sauce in small bowl.

3. Heat 1 teaspoons canola oil in wok or large nonstick skillet over medium high heat until very hot. Add chicken and stir fry until lightly browned, about 3 minutes; transfer to a plate. Return skillet to heat and add remaining 1 teaspoons canola oil. Add ginger and garlic; stir fry until fragrant, about 15 seconds. Stir in broccoli and carrots and stir fry until broccoli is bright green, about 2 minutes. Pour in orange juice mixture; bring to a boil and cook until thickened, about 1 minute. Add chicken and cook until heated through, about 1 minute. Divide chicken mixture and rice among 4 plates.
title: Spicy Szechuan Orange Chicken - Ww

steps: 1. 1.	Combine chicken breasts and lemon juice in a bowl just large enough to hold them comfortably. Cover and marinate overnight, turning occasionally
2. 2.	The next morning, drain chicken, pat dry and place in a ziplock bag containing the flour, salt, paprika and pepper. Shake.
3. 3.	Preheat oven to 350°
4. 4.	Fry chicken in corn oil until well browned and crisp (about 10 minutes)
5. 5.	Place chicken in a shallow baking dish and sprinkle with lemon zest and brown sugar
6. 6.	Mix chicken stock and lemon extract and pour over chicken
7. 7.	Place a thin lemon slice over each chicken breast
8. 8.	Bake at 350° for 35-40 minutes
title: Chicken-Lemon Chicken (Mom)

steps: 1. Make the sauce by heating 4 tsp. vegetable oil in a medium saucepan over medium/low heat. Don't get the oil too hot. Add ginger and garlic to the pan and quickly add the soy sauce and water before the garlic scorches. Dissolve the brown sugar in the sauce, then raise the heat to medium and boil the sauce 2-3 minutes or until sauce thickens a little bit. Remove sauce from heat.

2. Slice the flank steak against the grain into 1/4 inch slices. Tilt the blade of your knife at about a 45 degree angle to the top of the steak so you get wider cuts. Dip the steak pieces into cornstarch to apply a very thin dusting to both sides of each piece of beef. Let the beef sit about 10 min. so the cornstarch sticks. As the beef sits, heat up 1 c. oil in a wok (or skillet). Heat the oil over medium heat until its hot, but not smoking. Add the beef to the oil and saute for just 2 minutes, or until beef just begins to darken on the edges. Stir the meat around a little bit so that it cooks evenly.

3. After a few minutes, use a large slotted spoon to take the meat out and onto paper towels, then pour most of the oil out of the skillet. Put the pan back over the heat, dump the meat back into it and stir-fry for 1 minute. Add the sauce, cook for 1 minute while stirring and add green onions. Cook for 1 more minute. Now at this point you can either remove the beef with a slotted spoon or tongs and discard the sauce (this is what P.F. Chang's does) OR thicken the sauce with a cornstarch-water mixture to desired thickness and serve it over rice with the beef.
title: Mongolian Beef

steps: 1. Peeled and slice carrots in 2" pieces and place in crockpot.
2. Add 1/2 inch chucks of bell pepper.
3. Add garlic, finely chopped.
4. Top with 3/4" cubed chicken.
5. Sprinkle salt, pepper, ginger on top of chicken and add frozen OJ.
6. Cover and cook for 4-6 hours on low.
7. Just before serving add orange slices, serve over rice and top with chopped green onion.
title: Crockpot Orange Chicken

ingredients.text: 4 (100 g) boneless skinless chicken breasts (4 oz)

steps: 1. Place the chicken breasts side by side in a shallow dish (non reactive, not metal).
2. Mix together the lemon juice, garlic, honey, balsamic vinegar, 1 tablespoon olive oil and 1 tablespoon chopped parsley and pour over the chicken.
3. Turn the breasts over until well coated and the marinate in the fridge for 30 minutes.
4. Brush a non stick griddle or skillet/fry pan with the remaining oil and heat until very hot.

5. Lift the chicken breasts from the dish (reserve the marinade) and and put them in the pan/griddle and sear quickly for 1 to 2 minutes on each side until the chicken browns, lower the heat and add the reserved marinade cook for about 10 minutes or until the chicken is done, turning the breasts once or twice.
6. Once cooked transfer to serving plate and cover each with an equal amount of the zest and the remaining parsley.
7. Cut the lemon into wedges and serve with the chicken.
8. Suggested you accompany with rice and steam vegetables.
title: Seared Lemon Chicken

ingredients.text: 1 large sweet red pepper, cut into 1-inch chunks
1 small onion, cut into thin wedges

steps: 1. In a small bowl, combine cornstarch and sugar. Stir in water, soy sauce and sesame oil until smooth; set aside.

2. In a large nonstick wok or skillet, stir-fry broccoli in hot oil 3 minutes. Add pepper, onion, garlic and ginger; stir-fry 2 minutes. Reduce heat. Stir soy sauce mixture; stir into vegetables with nuts. Cook and stir 2 minutes or until thickened.
title: Almond Vegetable Stir-Fry

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients (except the pork) in a bowl large enough for the pork and set aside.
2. Trim pork to remove visible fat.
3. Slice into thin (1/8") slices.
4. Add pork to sauce and stir to cover meat.
5. Marinate at least 1 hour, but can sit in fridge overnight.
6. Place pork with its marinade in an ovenproof dish.
7. Bake at 375 for 45 minutes to 1 hour.
8. Tip: sauce is very good. Consider making extra and serve with rice.
title: Chinese Bbq Pork

steps: 1. Mix the yogurt with the seasonings place in a plastic bag with the chicken. Marinate for 2 hours to overnight.
2. Pound chicken in the bag with the marinade to 1/2 thick and grill, saute, skewer or bake until lightly browned and cooked through.
3. Serve with rice or pasta and salad and enjoy!
title: Marvelous Middle-Eastern Marinated Yogurt Lemon Chicken

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients except the meat and mix well.
2. Pour mixture over the meat and marinate overnight.
3. Place meat in a roasting pan.
4. Bake covered at 350° for about 3 hours or until done.
5. Serve with rice.
title: Chinese Pork Roast

ingredients.text: 3 pounds skinless, boneless chicken breast halves

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). Grease a 9x13-inch baking dish.
2. Place chicken breast halves into prepared baking dish. Whisk lemon juice, honey, olive oil, garlic, and oregano together in a bowl and pour the mixture over chicken breasts.

3. Bake in the preheated oven until chicken is no longer pink inside, the juices run clear, and an instant-read meat thermometer inserted into the thickest part of a breast reads 180 degrees F (80 degrees C), about 45 minutes. Baste chicken with pan juices every 15 minutes while baking.
title: Oregano-Lemon Chicken

steps: 1. Grill chicken with vegetables; add soy sauce, salt and pepper. Serve over a bed of wild rice.
title: Chicken Stir-Fry

steps: 1. Drain pineapple.
2. Reserve 1/3 cup of juice.
3. Slice chicken in strips.
4. Stir-fry with garlic and ginger in oil.
5. Add pineapple, carrots, onions and pepper.
6. Steam for 2 to 3 minutes.
7. Stir in spaghetti.
title: Chicken Stir-Fry

steps: 1. Once the fat has been removed from the chicken, place the chicken in ovenware container.
2. Season.
3. Add lemon juice and the chicken broth.
4. Garnish with paprika.
5. Cover and cook in oven at 350° for about 40 minutes.
title: Lemon Chicken

ingredients.text: 1 lb boneless skinless chicken breast, cut in 1-inch pieces
1 green bell pepper, seeds removed and cut in 1-inch pieces

steps: 1. In a bowl whisk together : olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, thyme, salt and pepper. Add the pieces of chicken and toss to coat well. Let marinade for 15 minutes. (You can prepare the pieces of chicken until that step and cover with plastic wrap. They'll be good until 24 hours in the fridge).

2. Prepare barbecue to medium-high heat. Remove the chicken from the marinade and put them on 8 metal skewers (or wood skewers but soaked in water), alternate with the pieces of green bell pepper. Put the skewers on a greased grill and cook 12 to 16 minutes or until the chicken is golden and is not pink inside. Turn the chicken skewers occasionnaly.
title: Lemon Chicken Skewers

steps: 1. Mix butter, flour, and white sugar. Spread in an 8 x 12 inch baking pan.
2. Bake in pre-heated oven at 325 degrees F (165 degrees C) for 15 minutes.
3. Beat eggs. Add brown sugar, nuts and coconut. Spread over baked crust.
4. Bake for another 30 minutes. When completely cool, dust with confectioners' sugar.
title: Chinese Chews Ii

steps: 1. For the chicken: Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat and preheat oven to 325°F. While oil is heating, season chicken with salt and pepper.
2. Dip chicken in egg (beaten), then cornstarch, and fry in the oil until lightly golden brown, but not cooked through.
3. Remove chicken from pan and place on paper towel-lined plate briefly, cut the chicken breasts into 1-2 inch pieces, then place in a single layer in a baking dish.

4. For the sauce: In a medium bowl, whisk together the coconut milk, sugar, and vinegar. Pour the sauce over the chicken and bake for about an hour, stirring the chicken every 15 minutes. Once cooked through, let stand for at least 5 minutes to allow the sauce to thicken. Serve immediately over rice or however is desired.
title: Chinese Coconut Chicken

ingredients.text: 1 cup chopped onion (, 1 medium to large)

steps: 1. Combine salt, cayenne pepper, chili powder and paprika.
2. Sprinkle over chicken.
3. Set aside.
4. Place onion, celery, bell peppers and garlic in bottom of slow cooker.
5. Place chicken on top.
6. Mix orange juice, peel, honey, Worcestershire sauce and ginger.
7. Pour over chicken.
8. Cook for 6 to 8 hours on low.
title: Orange Chicken Crock Pot

ingredients.text: 1/2 cup thinly sliced green bell pepper
1 clove garlic, minced or 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder
1/4 cup prepared instant chicken broth, and seasoning mix (prepared according to packet directions, at room temperature)

steps: 1. In 9 or 10" nonstick skillet, heat oil over medium heat.
2. Add onion, carrot,pepper and garlic; saute about 5 minutes or until onion is translucent.
3. Reduce heat to low; add cabbage; cover skillet; cook stirring occasionally, about 10 minutes or until cabbage wilts.
4. Add frankfurter; cook until heated through.
5. Meanwhile in measuring cup or small bowl stir broth, cornstarch and soy sauce until cornstarch dissolves; pour over franfurter mixture; cook and stir until slightly thickened.
title: Frankfurter Vegetable Stir-Fry

ingredients.text: 2 lb. chicken pieces (can use legs, thighs, breasts or cubes)

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients (except chicken).
2. Place chicken in heavy plastic bag (or bowl/container) and pour marinade over chicken.
3. Marinate in refrigerator for several hours or overnight. Bake at 350° for 50 minutes or cook on grill until chicken is done.
title: Debbie'S Lemon Chicken

ingredients.text: 1 lb. round steak, sliced in thin strips
1/2 c. celery, cut in small pieces

steps: 1. Heat margarine in skillet.
2. Add meat and fry until richly browned. Add onion, garlic, green peppers, celery, pepper and 2 to 3 cups water.
3. Cover and cook 20 to 50 minutes or until meat is tender. Add water as necessary. During the last 10 minutes, add beef bouillon. Blend cornstarch with 2 tablespoons water and soy sauce.
4. Stir into meat mixture and cook, uncovered, 5 minutes longer. Serve on rice.
title: Chinese Pepper Steak

steps: 1. Sprinkle chicken with seasoned salt and basil leaves. Pour lemon juice over top. Bake in a preheated 400 degree oven for 40 minutes. Turn chicken over half-way through cooking.
title: Lemon Chicken

ingredients.text: 4 chicken breast (halves, 2 lb.), cut into thin strips

steps: 1. Heat 2 tablespoons salad dressing in large skillet.
2. Add chicken and garlic powder.
3. Add veggies.
4. Stir-fry until chicken is cooked.
5. Reduce heat; stir in remaining dressing and soy sauce. Serve over hot cooked rice.
title: Chicken Veggie Stir-Fry

steps: 1. Skin chicken and place in baking pan.
2. Combine remaining ingredients and mix thoroughly.
3. Pour over chicken, turning pieces to coat.
4. Bake, uncovered, 1 hour at 350°.
5. Turn and baste once.
title: Honey Lemon Chicken

ingredients.text: 1 lb. chicken breast, cut in 1/8-inch strips
4 to 6 green onions, cut in 1/2-inch lengths

steps: 1. In small bowl, combine chicken with soy sauce, wine and ginger. Let stand 15 to 30 minutes.
2. Preheat 1 tablespoon oil in wok, uncovered, at medium high, about 2 minutes.
3. Add carrots; stir-fry 2 minutes.
4. Add 1/2 cup chicken broth; cover and steam 4 minutes. Remove carrots.
5. Heat 1 tablespoon oil in wok.
6. Add broccoli and celery; stir-fry 2 minutes.
7. Push up the side.
8. Add onions and mushrooms; stir-fry 2 minutes.
9. Remove all vegetables.
10. Heat 1 tablespoon oil in wok.
11. Add 1/2 of the chicken with marinade; stir-fry 2 to 3 minutes.
12. Push up the side.
13. Repeat with remaining meat.
14. Return vegetables to wok.
15. Combine remaining 1/2 cup chicken broth, cornstarch and sugar.
16. Stir into chicken and vegetable mixture and cook until thickened.
17. Serve with rice.
title: American-Style Stir-Fry

steps: 1. Mix all together.
2. Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.
3. Last 10 minutes, sprinkle chow mein noodles on top.
title: Oven Chop Suey

ingredients.text: 1 pound boneless skinless chicken breasts, cut into strips

steps: 1. Cook pasta according to package directions. Meanwhile, in a small bowl, combine the cornstarch, soy sauce, vinegar, hoisin sauce, ginger and garlic; set aside.
2. In a large skillet or wok, stir-fry chicken in 1 tablespoon oil for 5-8 minutes or until no longer pink. Remove with a slotted spoon. Drain pasta and set aside.

3. Stir-fry broccoli and carrots in remaining oil for 5-6 minutes or until crisp-tender. Stir cornstarch mixture and add to the pan. Bring to a boil; cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened. Stir in chicken and pasta; heat through. Sprinkle with peanuts.
title: Stir Fry Chicken Lo-Mein

ingredients.text: 8 ounces tofu, firm sliced in 16 pieces
1 chili pepper, red, sliced in thin rings

steps: 1. Salt and pepper the shrimp.
2. Put in 1 tablespoon oil and 1 garlic clove.
3. When golden, add shrimp.
4. When pink take out.
5. Add oil and garlic.
6. When golden, add tofu; lightly brown.
7. Add shrimp garlic mixture.
8. Add chili pepper.
9. Add soy sauce.
title: Tofu And Shrimp Stir Fry, Xia Ren Dou Fu

ingredients.text: 1/2 lb round steak, sliced very thin across grain
1 cup onion, sliced into rings and separated

steps: 1. mix cornstarch, 2 T soy sauce, and 2 T sherry in a bowl.
2. add meat and stir to coat.
3. set aside to marinate for 1 hour turn meat every 15 minutes.
4. in small bowl mix 1 T soy sauce, 2 T sherry, sugar and salt. set aside.
5. heat oil in uncovered wok to 375 or nonstick skillet on medium high heat.
6. add onions, lemon juice, green onion, garlic and stir fry for 2 minutes.
7. add beef and soy sauce mixture and stir fry 2-4 minutes until beef is done and onions are still crispy.
8. serve over rice.
title: Beef And Onion Stir Fry

ingredients.text: 1 bunch green onions, cut into 1-inch pieces

steps: 1. Split chicken breast in half; skin and debone.
2. Cut into 1 1/2-inch cubes.
3. Put cornstarch in paper bag or plastic baggie. Add chicken pieces and toss lightly to coat.
4. Heat oil in electric frying pan.
5. Add chicken and garlic.
6. Stir-fry at 375° until chicken is lightly brown.
7. Add soy sauce, vinegar, sugar and water to skillet.
8. Cover and cook 3 minutes at 250° or until chicken is cooked through.
9. Uncover skillet; add green onions and cayenne pepper.
10. Heat 2 minutes longer and enjoy.
title: Szechuan Chicken

steps: 1. Add the beef and onions to a small frying pan; cook the beef until no longer pink.
2. Cook the onions until soft and golden, about 5 - 8 minutes.
3. Place a wok over a medium heat, add 1 tablespoon of soy sauce.
4. Add the beef and onion, bean sprouts, noodles, Worcestershire sauce, garlic, water and finally the other tablespoon of soy sauce.
5. Cook for about 15 minutes, stirring continuously, until the noodles and heated through and the bean sprouts are cooked.
title: Beef Chow Mein

steps: 1. Melt butter in roasting pan; add lemon juice.
2. Arrange chicken pieces in single layer; turn to coat.
3. Sprinkle with paprika and pepper.
4. Cover with foil.
5. May be prepared up to a day ahead to this point.
6. Bake at 250° for one hour and 45 minutes.
7. Uncover and bake 15 minutes more at 400° until golden brown.
8. Thicken gravy; serve with brown rice.
title: Lemon Chicken

steps: 1. Cut chicken into 1" pieces. Mince the garlic.
2. Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain and keep warm.
3. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add chicken and garlic and cook, stirring frequently, for about 5 minutes until browned. Reduce heat to medium.

4. In a bowl, whisk together the broth, lemon juice, cornstarch, salt and pepper. Add to chicken in skillet. Heat to boiling; reduce heat and simmer about 2 minutes, until thickened, stirring frequently.
5. Add snow peas and cook 3 minutes longer.
6. Toss hot pasta with sauce and garnish with parsley.
title: Lemon Chicken Fettuccine With Snow Peas

ingredients.text: 1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes, dried (optional or increase the amount for a spicier kick)
6 medium carrots, peeled and julienned (or use pre-washed & cut small carrot sticks)
1 lb snow peas, trimmed (or use pre-washed)
1/2 lb spaghetti, whole wheat (cooked per package instructions)

steps: 1. In a small bowl, whisk together chicken broth, soy sauce, vinegar, sesame oil, red pepper flakes (optional) and honey. Set aside.
2. Fill a 5-quart pot 2/3 full of water, salt if desired and bring to a rolling boil. Cook pasta according to package directions until al dente.

3. Drizzle olive oil into a large skillet, and bring to medium-high heat. Once the oil is glistening and fragrant, add snow peas and carrots. Season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, for 8-10 minutes or until crisp-tender. Remove from heat and cover.

4. Once pasta is cooked, drain as much water as possible from the noodles. Add the noodles to the veggies in the skillet, pour sauce over all and combine thoroughly. Cover and cook on low heat for another 2-3 minutes in order to allow the noodles and veggies to absorb as much flavor from the sauce as possible.
5. Serve and enjoy!
title: Easy Veggie Lo Mein

steps: 1. Brown chicken pieces and place in 9 x 13-inch pan.
2. Combine orange juice, orange rind, paprika, mustard, margarine and ginger root.
3. Pour over chicken.
4. Cover and bake for one hour.
5. Turn after 30 minutes.
6. Serve with rice and peas.
title: Baked Orange Chicken

steps: 1. Mix first three ingredients and press in bottom of a 10 x 10-inch pan.
2. Bake at 375° about 10 minutes.
title: Chinese Chews

ingredients.text: 3 large fresh tomatoes, very ripe, roughly chopped

steps: 1. Slice the steak diagonally, against the grain, into 1/8-inch strips.
2. Heat a large no-stick skillet and brown the meat quickly over very high heat. Set aside.
3. Reduce heat to medium-high and add the onion and bell pepper into skillet and stir fry for one minute.
4. Add the soy sauce, sherry and 1/3 cup of water. Stir in the seasonings and cover. Allow to cook for 3-4 minutes.
5. Uncover and add tomatoes. Mix the cornstarch in the 2 teaspoons of spring water and add to the skillet. Stir and continue cooking for two more minutes.
6. Serve by plating up the rice on the bottom, then the vegetable blend, then the steak strips on top.
title: Low-Calorie Chinese Pepper Steak

steps: 1. Stir-fry first 3 ingredients in oil for 3 minutes, then add next 3 ingredients and stir-fry for another 3 minutes, covered. Then add last 3 ingredients and stir-fry another 3 minutes.
2. Do not overcook.
title: Indian Summer Stir-Fry

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°F Cut zested lemons in half, squeeze out juice into a small bowl and set aside halves. Add zest, barbecue sauce, and seasonings to the lemon juice; mix well.
2. Place chicken in baking pan. Place 2 of the lemon halves along with the mashed cloves of garlic and roesmary sprig into the cavity of the chicken.
3. Rub skin of chicken all over with remaining 2 lemon halves and discard. Tie legs together with twine.
4. Bake 1 1/2 - 2 hours or until chicken is cooked through to 170F brushing with the barbecue sauce mixture every 5 min during the last 20 minutes of baking.
5. Remove chicken from oven, and discard lemon halves and garlic cloves from chicken cavity. Skim fat from drippings in pan, and serve with the chicken.
title: Barbecue Lemon Chicken In The Oven

ingredients.text: 1 tablespoon finely chopped or grated ginger

steps: 1. Combine first 6 ingredients in a bowl. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Add soy sauce mixture; cook until lightly thickened, about 1 minute. Add vegetables and red pepper flakes. Cook, stirring constantly, until vegetables are soft, about 1 minute. Add shrimp and 1/4 cup water. Cook, stirring often, until shrimp are just cooked through, 2 to 3 minutes more. Divide among 4 bowls; serve immediately.
title: Spicy Shrimp And Vegetable Stir-Fry

steps: 1. peel potato and wash eggplant and bell peppers.

2. cut the potato in 1/2 inch and eggplant in 1 inch chunks, the traditional way is to cut slanted into triangular shaped pieces for faster cooking, but really any shape will do, i keep the pieces small to make this a quick dish to cook. cut bell peppers into 1 inch pieces.
3. poor 2 T oil into a pan to heat over medium high heat.
4. stir fry the potatoes for around 5 minutes or until almost done, transfer to a plate.
5. while the veggies are cooking, cut the green onion into 2 inch long pieces, peel and crush the garlic, and mix the corn starch with 1 T of water; set aside.

6. add 2 more T of oil in the same pan, stir fry the eggplants (they really suck up the oil, you may add a bit more if needed) stir fry about 30 sec. reduce to med low heat and cook covered, stirring occasionally for about 5 more minutes or until almost done, add bell peppers, cook for another minute or so.
7. transfer the veggies to the plate with the potatoes.
8. add 1 T of oil in the pan, heat under med-high heat, add garlic to the oil, lightly stir fry to release the flavors in the garlic.
9. add the precooked veggies, and the green onion, stir fry for about a minute, add soy sauce, sugar and 1 T water (more or less soy sauce to taste).
10. add corn starch water to thicken the sauce up a bit, remove from heat and enjoy your authentic north-eastern Chinese dish.
title: Treasures Of The Earth (Chinese Stir Fry)

ingredients.text: 1 lb. boneless chicken breast, cut into 1/2-inch cubes
1/4 lb. fresh snow peas, trimmed and cut in half

steps: 1. Combine first six ingredients; toss with chicken.
2. Refrigerate 30 minutes.
3. In a small bowl, combine chicken broth, cornstarch, water and oyster sauce.
4. Set aside.
5. In a wok or large skillet, heat 2 tablespoons oil over medium-high.
6. Add ginger root, garlic and onions; stir-fry 1 minute.
7. Add chicken and continue to stir-fry until chicken is white.
8. Remove chicken and vegetables from pan.
9. Add remaining oil; stir-fry carrots 3 minutes or until crisp-tender.
10. Add mushrooms and pea pods; stir-fry 1 minute. Return chicken and vegetables to pan.
11. Stir broth mixture and pour into skillet; cook and stir until the sauce is thickened.
12. Serve immediately.
title: Chicken Mushroom Stir-Fry(Serves 6)

steps: 1. Mix first three ingredients together and press into 8-inch square pan.
2. Bake for about 15 minutes at 350°.
3. Mix remaining ingredients together.
4. Pour on crust and bake for 20 to 25 minutes at 350°.
5. Cool; cut into squares.
title: Chinese Chews

ingredients.text: 1 tsp. hot sauce (if spicy flavor is desired with soy sauce)

steps: 1. In 8-inch skillet with lid, place vegetable oil and meat. Cook on medium heat until brown (do not overcook).
2. When meat is ready, turn heat to high and add vegetables and garlic.
3. Stir to mix, then cover and let steam.
4. Check and stir occasionally.
title: Pork Vegetable Stir-Fry(For 1)

steps: 1. Skin chicken; cut from bones into 1-inch cubes.
2. Combine sauce: water, soy sauce, honey, vinegar and cornstarch.
3. Blend; set aside. Preheat wok at 325° for 2 minutes.
4. Add oil.
5. Add chicken; stir-fry 2 to 3 minutes.
6. Add peppers and cashews.
7. Stir 1/2 minute.
8. Add onions, garlic, ginger and crushed pepper.
9. Fry 1 minute.
10. Add sauce without stirring 1 minute, then stir 1 minute.
11. Serve with rice or noodles.
title: Cashew Chicken

steps: 1. This recipe is for smaller size slow cookers. Do not try in a large one unless you double or triple the amounts.
2. 1. Wash tenderloin in an cold water rinse.
3. 2. Rub ginger all over meat. Spread hoisin onto meat, flipping once to cover. Place in ziploc bag to marinate overnight.
4. 3. Place marinated meat into slow cooker in morning. Sprinkle with minced garlic.
5. Low heat setting: 6-8 hours.
6. High heat: setting 4 hours.
7. Slice and serve the marinade and meat over rice. Or Shred and serve on buttered Crusty rolls.
title: Danielle Lapointe'S Crock Pot Hoisin Tenderloin

steps: 1. Bone and pound the chicken breasts.
2. Dredge with flour.
3. Melt the butter in a baking pan.
4. Coat chicken on all sides, turning skin side up if not boneless.
5. Bake at 375 degrees, brushing with pan drippings for 30 minutes.
6. Meanwhile, make the lemon baste, where you mix 1/3 cup lemon juice, minced onion, garlic and salt and pepper.
7. Brush chicken with part of the baste, and bake, brushing with the remaining baste for 30 minutes longer or until done.
8. Serve with rice and a vegetable.
title: Baked Lemon Chicken

steps: 1. In a small saucepan, combine juice, sugars and salt; bring to a boil, stirring to dissolve sugar. Cook, uncovered, 10-15 minutes or until mixture reaches a glaze consistency. Remove from heat; stir in mustard and orange zest.

2. Sprinkle chicken with lemon pepper. On a lightly greased grill rack, grill chicken, covered, over medium heat 6-8 minutes on each side or until a thermometer reads 170°, brushing occasionally with some of the sauce during the last 5 minutes. Serve with remaining sauce.
title: Grilled Orange Chicken Thighs

steps: 1. Drain the tofu, and then remove excess moisture by cutting it in half lengthwise and microwaving on high, uncovered, for two minutes. Gently squeeze out and wipe off excess moisture, then throw tofu in the freezer for one or two hours before removing to thaw in the fridge -- this will give the tofu a slightly heavier texture.

2. Cut tofu into bite-sized pieces. Combine garlic, ginger, red pepper flakes, apple juice, brown sugar, ketchup, apple cider vinegar, water, and soy sauce in a small bowl. Pour half of the mixture over the tofu and reserve the other half for later. Marinade tofu for at least 30 minutes.

3. Drain any excess marinade from tofu (into your reserve marinade for later). Coat tofu pieces in flour. Heat oil over medium heat in a large frying pan and fry tofu until golden brown on all sides. (Add more oil as needed, but cook it all out before proceeding).
4. Add reserved marinade to pan, bring to a boil, then lower heat and simmer for 20 minutes. Serve over rice.
title: Chinese Bourbon Tofu

steps: 1. Combine lemon juice, turmeric, garlic and onion in a large bowl.
2. Add chicken, turning to coat with marinade.
3. Marinade in fridge for 8 hours or overnight, turning occasionally of marinade doesn't cover chicken.
4. Remove chicken from marinade.
5. Sprinkle lightly with salt and pepper.
6. Grill or broil chicken and onions until done, turning once.
7. Serve topped with onions.
title: Turmeric Lemon Chicken

ingredients.text: 2 (10 3/4 ounce) cans cream of mushroom soup
4 tablespoons soy sauce (I use low sodium)

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees.
2. In a large saucepan, saute celery and onion in butter until tender.
3. Stir in soup and chicken broth.
4. Simmer 5 minutes.
5. Add chicken and soy sauce.
6. Cook over low heat 5 minutes.
7. Stir in rice.
8. Spoon into a 9x13 inch baking dish and bake until liquid bubbles to the surface, 15-20 minutes.
9. Sprinkle noodles and nuts on top and brown in oven.
title: Cashew Chicken Casserole

steps: 1. Heat oil in wok and stir-fry beef and onions in batches until golden brown.
2. Return meat mixture to wok, add beans and stir-fry 2 minutes more.
3. Mix remaining ingredients and add to pan. Stir until sauce thickens.
4. Serve with rice.
title: Barbecue Beef Stir Fry

ingredients.text: 1 pound beef flank steak, sliced 1/4 inch thick on the diagonal
2 bunches green onions, cut in 2-inch lengths

steps: 1. Heat 2 teaspoons of vegetable oil in a saucepan over medium heat, and cook and stir the garlic and ginger until they release their fragrance, about 30 seconds. Pour in the soy sauce, water, and brown sugar. Raise the heat to medium-high, and stir 4 minutes, until the sugar has dissolved and the sauce boils and slightly thickens. Remove sauce from the heat, and set aside.

2. Place the sliced beef into a bowl, and stir the cornstarch into the beef, coating it thoroughly. Allow the beef and cornstarch to sit until most of the juices from the meat have been absorbed by the cornstarch, about 10 minutes.
3. Heat the vegetable oil in a deep-sided skillet or wok to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C).

4. Shake excess cornstarch from the beef slices, and drop them into the hot oil, a few at a time. Stir briefly, and fry until the edges become crisp and start to brown, about 2 minutes. Remove the beef from the oil with a large slotted spoon, and allow to drain on paper towels to remove excess oil.

5. Pour the oil out of the skillet or wok, and return the pan to medium heat. Return the beef slices to the pan, stir briefly, and pour in the reserved sauce. Stir once or twice to combine, and add the green onions. Bring the mixture to a boil, and cook until the onions have softened and turned bright green, about 2 minutes.
title: Mongolian Beef And Spring Onions

steps: 1. Cook macaroni according to package directions.
2. In large frying pan, cook ground beef, green pepper, onion, celery and mushrooms until vegetables are tender and meat is browned; drain off fat.
3. Add crushed tomatoes, beef bouillon cubes, salt and pepper to taste.
4. Mix in cooked macaroni and simmer on low 15 to 20 minutes.
title: Joann'S American Chop Suey

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients; mix well.
2. Bake in 2 square 8 x 8-inch pans for 30 minutes at 325°.
3. Cool and cut in squares; sprinkle with powdered sugar.
title: Chinese Chews

ingredients.text: 2 bunches green onions, cut into 2 inch pieces
salt and ground black pepper to taste

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C).

2. Whisk together the oyster sauce, Dijon mustard, hoisin sauce, ginger, honey, and soy sauce in a bowl until combined; stir in the green onions. Spread about 1/4 of the mixture into the bottom of a 9x13-inch baking dish. Arrange the pork chops over the sauce in a single layer, and pour the remaining sauce over the chops, covering them completely.

3. Bake in the preheated oven until the chops are no longer pink at the center and the juices run clear, 30 to 40 minutes. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center should read 145 degrees F (63 degrees C). Baste once or twice while baking.
4. Drain the liquid in the baking dish into a saucepan. Turn on the oven's broiler, and place the chops underneath the broiler until caramelized and brown, 1 to 2 minutes.

5. Whisk the cornstarch with water in a small bowl, and whisk the mixture into the pan juices. Set the saucepan over medium heat, and bring the sauce to a simmer, whisking constantly until thickened, 1 to 2 minutes. Season to taste with salt and black pepper. Serve sauce with chops.
title: Honey Hoisin Pork Chops

ingredients.text: 8 ounces pineapple chunks (225 ml, reserve the juice)
2 tablespoons cornflour, mixed with a little water (cornstarch)

steps: 1. Place the cooked chicken pieces, pineapple pieces and the chopped onion into a casserole dish.
2. Stir all other ingredients together in a pot until it gets a glazed look.
3. Pour sauce over the chicken, onion and pineapple pieces.
4. Cover and bake at around 375 degrees Fahrenheit for one to one and a half hours.
title: Cantonese Chicken

steps: 1. Brown the sausage and set aside.
2. Combine all ingredients in a 5-quart saucepan (a Dutch oven works best).
3. Bring it to a boil and cook just until vegetables are tender-crisp.
4. In a small dish mix 1/4 cup cornstarch and 1/4 cup water.
5. Add to the vegetable and meat mixture.
6. Cook just until thickened.
7. Serve over rice or noodles.
title: Chow Mein

steps: 1. Remove skin from chicken and slice into thin strips.
2. Trim green onions and slice thin.
3. Slice carrots thin.
4. Dice green pepper.
5. Saute chicken quickly in vegetable oil until it turns white.
6. Stir in green onions, pepper and carrots.
7. Saute 2 minutes.
8. Stir in soy sauce; cover and cook about 3 minutes until vegetables are crispy tender.
9. Blend cornstarch into chicken broth until smooth.
10. Stir into meat and vegetable mixture.
11. Cook, stirring constantly until sauce thickens and boils, about 3 minutes.
12. Serve over rice.
title: Stir-Fry Chicken

steps: 1. Chop the stems and the leaves of the bok choy, keep separate.
2. Heat coconut oil over medium-high heat, add garlic, ginger, onion and stems of bok choy. Cook and stir for 3-5 min until slightly tender.
3. Add leaves and continue to cook and stir for 3-5 min longer.
4. Serve, top with toasted sesame seeds.
title: Quick And Easy Bok Choy

ingredients.text: 1 large green pepper, cut into strips
2 celery ribs, cut into diagonal slices

steps: 1. Slice pork across the grain into 1/8-inch strips.
2. Brown pork strips in oil in large skillet over medium-high heat.
3. Push meat to side of skillet.
4. Add mushrooms, pepper, zucchini, celery, carrots, and garlic; stir-fry about 3 minutes.
5. Combine broth, soy sauce, and cornstarch.
6. Add to skillet and cook, stirring, until thickened; cook 1 minute longer.
7. Serve over rice.
title: Vegetable Pork Stir-Fry

ingredients.text: 3 boneless skinless chicken breast halves, cut into 2-inch strips
3 green onions, white and green parts, cut into 2-inch lengths

steps: 1. Coat a large nonstick skillet with nonstick spray and warm over med-high heat.
2. Add the garlic & ginger and cook for 30 seconds.
3. Add the chicken and cook, stirring constantly, for 3-4 minutes or until no longer pink.
4. Transfer to a plate.
5. Add the broccoli and cook, stirring constantly,for 3 minutes or until it's crisp-tender.
6. Return the chicken to the skillet and add the green onion.
7. Meanwhile, in a small bowl combine the hoisin sauce, oil, and red pepper flakes.
8. Pour into the pan and cook, stirring constantly, for 2 minutes or until all is blended.
9. Stir in cashews and serve.
title: Spicy Cashew Chicken Stir Fry

ingredients.text: 3 boneless skinless chicken breasts, pounded thin and chopped into bite-size pieces
1 red pepper, seeded and thinly sliced
2 small potatoes, peeled and chopped (I used red)
2 cups unsweetened coconut milk (or one 14-ounce can cup chicken broth)
1/2 cup cashews, cilantro, cooked rice for serving

steps: 1. Add chicken pieces, red peppers, potatoes, and onions to the slow cooker.

2. In a medium bowl whisk together chicken broth, curry powder, cumin, salt, and cayenne pepper. Pour mixture into slow cooker and stir to coat chicken and veggies. Cover and cook on high for 2-3 hours or on low 4-5 hours.
3. about 10-15 minutes before serving, stir in coconut milk. Stir just before serving and top with cashews and freshly chopped cilantro.
4. NOTES.

5. *If you have red curry paste on hand, I like to swap out 1 tablespoon of curry powder for 1 tablespoon of the red paste. You can also add up to 1 tablespoon of garlic powder for an extra flavor boost.

6. *If you prefer a little bit thicker curry (like I do) whisk together 3 tablespoons cold water and 2 tablespoons corn starch. Stir into crockpot about 30-45 minutes before serving and cook on high until ready to serve.
title: Slow Cooker Coconut Curry Cashew Chicken

steps: 1. Heat oil in a deep skillet; saute onion and celery 5 minutes. Mix in pork, soy sauce and bean sprouts.
2. Add to the skillet, stirring steadily to the boiling point.
3. Cook 3 minutes longer. Serve with rice and chow mein noodles.
title: Pork Chow Mein

steps: 1. In a large skillet, cook and crumble turkey with vegetables in sesame oil over medium-high heat until turkey is no longer pink, 8-10 minutes, breaking up turkey into crumbles. Stir in hoisin sauce, vinegar, soy sauce, ginger and garlic; cook and stir over medium heat until sauce is slightly thickened, about 5 minutes. Serve in lettuce leaves.
title: Hoisin Turkey Lettuce Wraps

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees F (220 degrees C).
2. In a 9x13 inch baking dish, grate the peel from 1/2 the lemon, squeeze out the juice (about 1/4 cup) and add to peel with the oregano, garlic, oil, salt and pepper. Stir until mixed.
3. Remove skin from chicken pieces and discard. Coat chicken pieces with the lemon mixture and arrange, bone-side up, in the baking dish. Cover dish and bake for 20 minutes. Turn and baste chicken.
4. Reduce heat to 400 degrees F (205 degrees C) and bake uncovered, basting every 10 minutes, for about 30 more minutes. Serve chicken with pan juices.
title: Mediterranean Lemon Chicken

ingredients.text: 4 lbs baby back ribs (2 to 4 racks)

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 400°F with rack in middle. Line a 17- by 12- by 1-inch baking pan with foil.
2. Puree ginger, garlic, soy sauce, and oil in a blender, then transfer to a bowl and whisk in hoisin sauce and honey. Reserve 1/2 cup sauce and coat ribs with remainder.
3. Arrange ribs, meaty sides down, in pan and bake, turning and basting once with some of reserved sauce halfway through baking, until cooked through, about 40 minutes.
4. Turn on broiler. Brush ribs, meaty sides up, with remaining sauce. Broil 4 to 5 inches from heat until edges are lightly charred, 4 to 8 minutes.
title: Chinese Barbecued Baby Back Ribs

steps: 1. In a skillet, saute chicken in margarine and oil.
2. When brown, remove chicken and discard margarine and oil.
3. Add sherry, lemon juice, salt and pepper.
4. Simmer 2 minutes, stirring constantly. Remove from heat and slowly add half and half.
5. Heat until sauce begins to bubble.
6. Add chicken and simmer 20 minutes until tender. Transfer to a serving dish and pour over top.
7. Garnish with lemon slices and parsley.
title: Lemon Chicken

ingredients.text: 6 (6 ounce) skinless, boneless chicken breast halves

steps: 1. Melt 1 tablespoon butter in a skillet over medium heat. Stir in the almonds, and cook until light brown and toasted, about 4 minutes.

2. Place the chicken breasts between two sheets of plastic wrap or waxed paper; flatten using a meat mallet or rolling pin. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Melt 3 tablespoons butter in a large skillet over medium meat; add the chicken breasts, and cook 1 minute on each side. Combine 1/2 cup almonds, cream, Dijon mustard, marmalade, and red pepper flakes with chicken, stirring to blend. Cook until sauce thickens, about 10 minutes. Serve chicken topped with sauce and remaining almonds.
title: Almond Orange Chicken

ingredients.text: 2 lbs large raw shrimp, shelled, de-veined, and washed
3 large green chilies, cut lengthwise in half

steps: 1. Saute onions and chilies in oil until onions are golden brown.
2. Add tomatoes and salt. Cook until the tomatoes have broken down. Add a little water if necessary.
3. Add the curry powder, garlic powder, and ginger powder.
4. Stir and cook for two minutes.
5. Add coconut milk and stir.
6. Add shrimp and toss them until they're well coated. Cook until they turn pink.
7. Serve with steamed rice.
title: Coconut Szechuan Shrimp

ingredients.text: 1 lb. lean boneless beef round steak

steps: 1. Trim excess fat from meat; cut meat in 1/4-inch thick strips. Cut carrots and broccoli stems into 1/2-inch slices and separate broccoli flowerets.
2. Combine water, soy sauce, cornstarch and sugar.
3. Heat 1/2 oil in work or skillet over medium heat.
4. Add broccoli stems, flowerets and carrots.
5. Stir-fry until hot but crisp, 3 to 4 minutes.
6. Remove vegetables and add remaining oil to wok or skillet.
7. Add beef strips, not more than 1/3 at a time; stir-fry 4 to 5 minutes or until meat is light brown.
8. Add soy sauce mixture.
9. Cook until thickened and clear, stirring continuously.
10. Add vegetables, garlic powder and thoroughly stir. Serve immediately over hot rice if desired.
11. Makes 4 servings.
title: Heart Healthy Beef Stir-Fry

ingredients.text: 1/2 c. celery, sliced on a slant

steps: 1. Heat oil in a wok or pan and stir-fry celery and onion over high heat for 2 to 3 minutes, separating the onion "layers."
2. Add soy sauce, sugar and broth; bring to a boil.
3. Add bean sprouts and chicken and stir to combine.
4. Dissolve cornstarch in water and add gradually to sauce.
5. Simmer gently until it thickens.
6. Serve over chow mein noodles.
7. Serves 4.
title: Chicken Chow Mein

steps: 1. In a large nonstick skillet, heat mirin and soy sauce til boiling over medium-high heat. Slice the bok choy in half and add to the skillet. Salt and pepper (go lightly on the salt because of the soy -- I didn't add any) and cook 3-5 minutes or when pierced with a fork it is tender.
title: Quick And Easy Bok Choy

steps: 1. Mix sugar, eggs, salt and vanilla.
2. Add sifted flour and baking powder.
3. Fold in dates and pecans.
4. Spread in 8 x 8 x 2-inch greased pan.
5. Bake at 350° until done, approximately 25 minutes.
6. Cut into squares while warm.
title: Chinese Chews

ingredients.text: 3 boneless skinless chicken breast cut into cubes

steps: 1. Place the chicken into a bowl along with the egg and oil, stir to combine.
2. In another bowl mix the flour and cornstarch together.

3. Dredge the chicken in small batches in the flour mixture until evenly coated, then cook in a deep fryer set at 375 degrees for 4 minutes then drain on paper towel, continue cooking the chicken until all pieces are fried.
4. While you are cooking the batches of chicken make the sauce, in a sauce pan add a little more oil and saute the garlic over medium heat just until tender, be careful not to burn it.
5. Add the remaining items and bring to a boil and cook for 3 minutes, then turn down to simmer and let reduce until thick, make sure to keep an eye on it and stir constantly so it does not burn.
title: Crispy Orange Chicken

steps: 1. Coat chicken with flour.
2. In skillet, heat oil and margarine; brown the chicken.
3. Drain off fat.
4. Drain mandarin oranges saving juice.
5. Mix juice with lemon juice, honey, soy sauce, orange juice and ginger.
6. Pour sauce over chicken, cover and simmer 45 minutes or until tender.
7. Remove chicken, thicken with cornstarch.
8. Add chicken and mandarin oranges.
9. Serve over rice.
title: Chicken Mandarin

ingredients.text: 1 (10.75 ounce) can condensed cream of chicken soup

steps: 1. Heat the shortening in a skillet over medium-high heat. In a bowl, mix the flour, condensed soup, seasoned salt, pepper, and salt. Dip chicken in the mixture to coat, and fry in the skillet until golden brown.
2. Place chicken in a slow cooker. Mix the chicken broth, brown sugar, and orange juice concentrate in a bowl, and pour over chicken in the slow cooker.
3. Cover, and cook 2 to 3 hours on Low or 1 to 2 hours on High.
title: Amazing Slow Cooker Orange Chicken

ingredients.text: 1 to 1 1/2 c. cubed boneless chicken breast

steps: 1. In large skillet, heat 2 tablespoons oil.
2. Add chicken and half of soy sauce.
3. Cook until chicken is done, about 5 or 6 minutes; set aside.
4. In another large skillet, heat remaining oil.
5. Add vegetables, almonds and remaining soy sauce.
6. Cook about 7 to 10 minutes.
7. Add chicken during last few minutes to reheat. Serve with rice.
8. Makes 4 to 5 servings.
title: Chicken Stir-Fry

steps: 1. Mix the 1 tablespoon lemon juice and egg.
2. Mix the 1/4 cup flour, garlic powder and paprika.
3. Dip the chicken in the lemon juice and egg mixture, then into the flour mixture.
4. Saute in the margarine.
5. Mix the bouillon, boiling water and 4 tablespoons lemon juice.
6. Add the chicken.
7. Cover and simmer 20 minutes.
8. Stir 1 tablespoon flour into sauce after removing breasts.
9. Serve over rice.
title: Lemon Chicken

ingredients.text: 1 lb. egg noodles (Asian lo mein noodles- fresh or dried)
1 cup cooked beef, pork or chicken (shredded)
3 stalks scallions, washed and cut into 1" pieces.

steps: 1. Cook noodles in boiling salt water until al dente. Rinse under cold water. Drain.
2. Mix 2 T soy sauce with noodles and set aside. (You can use Oyster Sauce)

3. Stir any of the beef, pork or chicken in 1 T oil. Mix 1/2 t salt and 1 t cornstarch. Add this to the stir-fry. Remove it from the pan and set it aside. Add 3 T oil to wok and stir-fry cabbage ,and bamboo shoots. Add meat mixture to wok. Mix well. Beat egg and add it slowly to wok on top of everything. Add noodles. Toss until noodles are blended in with everything. Add 3 T Oyster sauce or soy sauce. You can add the scallions as garnish or throw them into the stir fry to cook them.
title: Lo Mein

ingredients.text: 1 lb boneless skinless chicken breast, cut into strips
1 small sweet red pepper, cut into strips

steps: 1. Heat sesame oil in nonstick skillet or wok. Add garlic and ginger, and stir for about 30 seconds.
2. Add chicken and cook in hot oil 4 to 5 minutes, or until chicken is no longer pink.
3. Remove chicken from skillet. Add pea pods, red pepper, and mushrooms, and cook, stirring, until tender-crisp, about 3 minutes. Sprinkle with pepper.
4. Combine applesauce, vinegar, soy sauce, cornstarch, and chicken broth.
5. Add chicken to vegetables, add sauce mixture and sliced apples, and cook until sauce is thickened and clear, about 4 minutes. Serve over steamed rice.
title: Ginger Apple Chicken Stir-Fry

ingredients.text: 2 tbsp Chinese rice wine or dry sherry
5-6 scallions, green part only, cut into 1 inch lengths

steps: 1. Heat a wok until hot, add the cashews and dry-fry over low to medium-heat for 1-2 minutes until golden brown. Remove and set aside.
2. Cut the red bell pepper in half and remove the seeds. Slice into thin strips. Skin the chicken fillet and cut into thin finger-length strips.
3. Heat the wok again until hot, add the oil, and swirl it around. Add the garlic and let it sizzle in the oil for a few seconds. Add the bell pepper and chicken and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
4. Add the rice wine or sherry and hoisin sauce. Continue to stir-fry until the chicken is tender and all the ingredients are evenly glazed.
5. Stir in the sesame oil, toasted cashews and scallions. Serve immediately.
title: Chicken And Cashew Stirfry

ingredients.text: 1 (10.75 ounce) can condensed cream of chicken soup

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
2. In a large skillet over medium high heat, saute the ground beef for 5 minutes. Add the onion and celery and saute for 5 more minutes.

3. In a separate medium bowl, combine the almonds, rice, soup, water and soy sauce. Mix together well and add to the beef mixture. Place this into a lightly greased 9x13 inch baking dish. Top with chow mein noodles.
4. Bake at 350 degrees F (175 degrees C) for 20 minutes.
title: Chow Mein Noodle Casserole

steps: 1. Slice vegetables.
2. Cut chicken up.
3. Heat oil in pan.
4. Cook chicken until done.
5. Pour lemon juice over chicken; remove when tender.
6. Add vegetables.
7. Add soy sauce and cook 2 more minutes. Serve over rice.
title: Stir-Fry Chicken

steps: 1. Cook noodles, drain and rinse.
2. Heat 1 tablespoon oil in large skillet.
3. Tilt to coat evenly.
4. Add egg and tilt again.
5. When egg is set, remove.
6. Cut into strips.
7. Set aside.
8. In same skillet, cook pork in 2 more tablespoons oil until browned.
9. Add celery and onion; cook 2 minutes.
10. Add chicken broth.
11. Combine cornstarch, salt, pepper, ginger and soy sauce.
12. Stir into pork mixture.
13. Cook and stir until thickened and boil 1 minute.
14. Remove.
title: Pork With Chinese Flavor

steps: 1. Prep the cucumbers:
2. Peel the cucumbers. Cut them into quarters, lengthwise. (If the seeds are bitter, scrape out the seeds and discard.) Cut the cucumbers again, crosswise, into 1/2-inch thick pieces.
3. Toss the salad:
4. Place cucumbers into a serving bowl. Sprinkle with salt. Toss with sesame oil, seasoned rice vinegar, basil (if using), and chili flakes. Sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds if using.
title: Sesame Cucumber Salad

steps: 1. In a wok add chicken broth and wait for it to boil.
2. Next add salt, sugar, white pepper, sesame seed oil.
3. When the chicken broth is boiling add the vegetables to the wok.
4. To thicken the sauce, whisk together 1 Tablespoon of cornstarch and 2 Tablespoon of water in a bowl and slowly add to your soup until it's the right thickness.
5. Next add 1 egg slightly beaten with a knife or fork and add it to the soup slowly and stir for 8 seconds
6. Serve the soup in a bowl and add the green onions on top.
title: Egg Drop Soup

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 c. cooked shrimp, cut in small pieces

steps: 1. In a large skillet or wok, heat oil over medium-high heat.
2. Add mushrooms, onion and ginger; stir-fry for 1 minute.
3. Push vegetables aside.
4. Pour egg into skillet and scramble.
5. Stir in rice and gently, separate grains.
6. Add shrimp and soy sauce; stir until thoroughly heated.
7. This kitchen tested recipe makes 4 servings.
8. Contains 189 calories.
title: Shrimp Fried Rice

ingredients.text: 4 cups Water (not Needed If You Are Using Precooked Rice)
1/2 teaspoons Salt (also Not Needed If Using Precooked Rice)
2 cups Long Grain White Rice, Uncooked (or Substitute 4 Cups Of Precooked Rice For 2 Cups Uncooked)
2 whole Small Carrots, Sliced Into 1/8" Pieces

steps: 1. In a 3-quart stockpot bring water to boil then add rice and a pinch of salt. Cover the pot and bring to boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook on low for 20-25 minutes. I usually make this earlier in the day so that it has a chance to dry out. Or you can use leftover rice-if you do, you'll need at least 4 cups.
2. While rice is cooking, chop all of the other ingredients so you are ready to go.
3. In a 12" skillet, cook bacon on medium-high until crispy. Remove bacon to a dish and pour out all but 3-4 tablespoons of bacon grease.

4. In the remaining grease saute the onions and carrots for a couple of minutes. Then push them to one side and add the beaten eggs. Stir and cook the eggs just like you are making scrambled eggs. Once they have solidified, stir together with the carrots and onions.
5. Dump the rice on top of the cooked egg/veggie mixture.
6. Pour the soy sauce into the rice mixture and stir together until everything is completely coated and brown.
7. Start by adding 2 tablespoons of sugar to the rice and add the bacon too. Stir well to combine, then taste. If you think it's the best thing you've tasted in a long time STOP!
8. If not, add one more tablespoon of sugar. You really do need to balance the soy and sugar to get the right flavor.
9. Serves 6-8.
10. Enjoy!
title: Fried Rice

steps: 1. Heat large skillet or wok over medium-high heat until hot. Add oil and heat until it ripples.
2. Add broccoli, garlic, soy sauce and ginger root.
3. Stir-fry for 2 to 4 minutes or until broccoli is crisp-tender.
4. Serves 8 (1/2 cup each).
title: Broccoli Ginger Stir-Fry

steps: 1. Lay bacon slices over heating base of wok.
2. Turn heat control to 350°.
3. Fry bacon until crisp, about 6 minutes.
4. Remove bacon. Drain on paper towel and crumble.
5. Stir-fry onion 2 minutes in bacon drippings.
6. Add cold rice and stir-fry for 7 to 8 minutes. Add soy sauce, water and bacon.
7. Reduce heat to 250°.
8. Clear wok base by moving rice up along sides.
9. Pour eggs on base of wok. Stir-fry for 3 to 4 minutes or until eggs are cooked.
10. Break in pieces; mix in rice.
11. Reduce heat to warm 200° for serving.
12. Makes 4 servings.
title: Fried Rice

steps: 1. In a large skillet, heat 2 tablespoons of oil.
2. Add eggs and cook, stirring, until set.
3. Remove from skillet; set aside.
4. Add remaining 1 tablespoon of oil to skillet and heat.
5. Add ham, green onions and bean sprouts.
6. Stir-fry for 2 minutes.
7. Stir in eggs. Add rice and stir to mix the ingredients.
8. Add remaining ingredients and stir to combine.
9. Heat through; serve hot.
10. Serves 4.
title: Fried Rice

ingredients.text: 6 green onions, finely chopped (using most of the tops)

steps: 1. Cook rice (omit salt and butter).
2. In frypan, heat olive oil and garlic.
3. Saute onions.
4. Add rice and soy sauce; mix well. Pour egg over rice and cook egg.
5. Serve hot.
6. Serves 4.
title: Quick Fried Rice

ingredients.text: 1 Tbsp. fresh ginger root, finely chopped

steps: 1. Peel cucumbers; slice thinly.
2. Mix remaining ingredients and pour over cucumbers.
3. Stir carefully; chill.
4. Makes 6 servings. Preparation Time:
title: Chinese Cucumber Salad

ingredients.text: 1 c. cooked meat, chicken, pork, etc.

steps: 1. Prepare and measure the vegetables.
2. Use only the white part of the onion. Slice and save the green part until later.
3. Beat egg and egg white together.
4. Pour egg into a nonstick skillet and cook. Remove from pan. Cool and cut into strips.
5. Heat 1 teaspoon oil. Add garlic, celery, onion and pepper. Stir constantly for about 2 minutes. Add second teaspoon of oil, then add cooked rice. Now add the meat.
6. Stir constantly until heated through. Stir in bean sprouts.
7. Mix the soy sauce, lemon juice and ginger and stir into the vegetables.
8. Place on a platter and put egg strips and green onions over over top.
9. Serves 4.
title: Fried Rice

ingredients.text: 1 or 2 Tbsp. cornstarch, blended with small amount of water

steps: 1. Heat oil in wok or deep skillet; add chicken cubes and stir-fry until half cooked.
2. Add broccoli, mushrooms, water chestnuts and onion.
3. Stir-fry.
4. Add chicken broth, soy sauce and blended cornstarch, cooking until thickened.
5. Serve over white rice.
6. Serves 3 or 4.
title: Chicken Broccoli Stir-Fry

steps: 1. Beat eggs and water together just to blend; set aside.
2. Heat oil until hot in large frying pan or wok over medium heat.
3. Add green onions and stir-fry 30 seconds.
4. Add eggs and scramble. Stir in rice and cook until heated, gently separating grains.
5. Add shrimp and soy sauce; cook and stir until thoroughly heated. Serve immediately.
6. Makes 6 servings.
title: Shrimp Fried Rice

steps: 1. Combine the first 5 ingredients; stir well.
2. Set aside.
3. Trim off outer leaves of broccoli and remove tough ends of stalks. Wash broccoli in cold water.
4. Cut stalks diagonally into 1-inch thick slices.
5. Cut flowerets into 1-inch pieces.
6. Pour oil around top of preheated wok, coating sides.
7. Allow to heat at medium high (325°) for 2 minutes.
8. Add broccoli; stir-fry 2 minutes.
9. Add onion; stir-fry 3 minutes.
10. Add soy sauce mixture; cover and reduce heat to low (225°).
11. Cook 5 minutes, or until broccoli is crisp-tender.
12. Yields 6 servings.
title: Stir-Fry Broccoli

steps: 1. Combine chicken, soy sauce and salt.
2. Marinate 15 minutes. Lightly brown rice in oil in large skillet over medium heat; stir frequently.
3. Add chicken with soy sauce and broth.
4. Cover and simmer 20 minutes.
5. Stir in onion, green pepper, celery and cabbage; cook until vegetables are tender and liquid is absorbed. Push mixture to sides of pan.
6. Add eggs; cook until almost set. Blend into rice mixture.
7. Serve hot.
8. Serves 6.
title: Chicken Fried Rice

steps: 1. Snap off the tough stems of asparagus spears.
2. Cut the stalks into 1/2-inch slices.
3. Heat oil in a 12-inch skillet, add garlic, salt, and asparagus.
4. Saute over moderate heat for 2 minutes.
5. Pour in chicken broth and bring to a boil.
6. Mix cornstarch, water, and soy sauce.
7. Add to asparagus, stir and bring to a boil again.
8. Stir for 1 minute, add pepper and serve at once.
9. Serves 4.
title: Asparagus Chinese Style

ingredients.text: 1 c. shrimp, chicken or pork (all should be cooked; choose 1)
4 c. cold, cooked long grain rice

steps: 1. Rub cooked rice with wet hands so all the grains are separated.
2. Beat eggs with the 1/4 teaspoon salt.
3. In a wok or wide frying pan, heat 1 tablespoon oil over medium heat; add green onions and stir-fry for about 30 seconds.
4. Add eggs and stir and cook until soft curds.
5. Remove from pan.
6. Add carrots and peas; stir-fry for 2 minutes and set aside.
7. Heat the remaining 2 tablespoons oil in pan; add rice and stir-fry for 2 minutes to heat through.
8. Stir in soy sauce and shrimp, chicken or pork (choose only one).
9. Add eggs and fold in until they are in small pieces.
10. Season with salt.
11. Makes 4 or 5 servings.
title: Fried Rice

steps: 1. In large saucepan, bring to boil 1 cup rice in 2 1/4 cups water. Reduce heat to low heat and cook until all water is absorbed (approximately 20 minutes) or follow package directions. In large skillet, drizzle 1 to 2 tablespoons olive oil and fry the 4 pork chops. Cut chops into bite-sized pieces. Discard bones and pieces of fat. Add sliced peppers, onion and celery to skillet and cook with chops (pieces) until vegetables are tender. Add cooked rice to the ingredients in skillet; mix thoroughly. Break eggs into the skillet mixture and continue cooking mixture until eggs are cooked throughout the other ingredients, mixing as they cook. Add soy sauce and stir thoroughly. Serves 4.
title: Okinawan Fried Rice

steps: 1. Cook pasta according to package directions. Omit salt; drain and set aside. Spray grid with nonstick cooking spray. Prepare coals for grilling. Place chicken, bell peppers and squash on grill for 10 to 12 minutes. Cool and cut into 1-inch pieces. Combine parsley, garlic, lemon peel, salt and black pepper in bowl. Toss chicken, vegetables and pasta. Makes 8 servings.
title: Lemon Chicken And Vegetables(Diabetic)

steps: 1. Saute onion, green pepper and garlic in oil in skillet for 5 minutes or until tender.
2. Add carrots and rice.
3. Cook for a minute, stirring constantly.
4. Stir in eggs; cook until eggs are set, stirring frequently.
5. Add ham.
6. Yields 4 servings.
title: Ham Fried Rice

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 400°.
2. Dissolve bouillon cubes in 2 cups hot water (I do this in a microwave).
3. Brown rice in 3/4 stick margarine in Dutch oven.
4. When rice is brown add onion and carrot, stirring constantly.
5. Add beef bouillon and stir.
6. Immediately cover and place in oven.
7. Bake at 400° for 20 minutes.
8. Serves 4 to 6 people.
9. I use a cast iron Dutch oven for this.
10. The rice comes out really fluffy.
title: Fried Rice

steps: 1. Combine vinegar, water, soy sauce and cornstarch in a small dish; mix well and set aside.
2. Heat oil in a wok or heavy skillet over medium heat.
3. Add onion and ginger root; stir-fry for 1 minute.
4. Add red and green cabbage.
5. Stir-fry for 3 to 5 minutes or until tender.
6. Add vinegar mixture.
7. Bring to a boil, stirring constantly.
8. Serve hot.
9. Makes 3 servings.
title: Two Cabbage Stir-Fry

ingredients.text: 1 lb. chicken, boneless, cut in strips
4 c. broccoli, bok choy, celery, carrots, red pepper pepper, cut up
3 Tbsp. soy sauce or to taste, just before serving

steps: 1. In wok, heat 2 tablespoons peanut oil and stir-fry chicken until opaque.
2. Remove and put into a bowl.
3. Stir-fry vegetables, garlic and ginger along with mushrooms and green onion for 1 minute.
4. Add broth with cornstarch until mixture thickens.
5. Add chicken and toss together.
6. Serve over rice.
7. Serves 4.
title: Stir-Fry Chicken With Vegetables

ingredients.text: 1 bunch green onions, cut in 1-inch pieces

steps: 1. Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in large skillet.
2. Cook egg for 1 minute until set, but moist.
3. Remove to plate and cut in 1-inch strips. In remaining tablespoon of oil, stir-fry green onions for 2 minutes.
4. Add rice, chicken, peas, soy sauce and ginger. Stir-fry 3 to 4 minutes.
5. Add egg.
6. Cook 1 minute.
7. Serves 6.
title: Chicken Fried Rice

steps: 1. Fry shrimp in oil in a deep frying pan for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
2. Add eggs, mushrooms, salt and pepper.
3. Fry over medium heat for 5 minutes, stirring constantly.
4. Add rice and soy sauce; fry for 5 minutes, stirring frequently.
5. Mix with chopped scallions.
6. Serves 6.
title: Shrimp Fried Rice

ingredients.text: 1 lb. chicken, cut into bite size pieces

steps: 1. Heat oil in skillet or wok.
2. Stir-fry chicken.
3. Add vegetables to stir-fry.
4. Add soy sauce and rice and cook until heated through.
5. Serves 6.
title: Chinese New Year Rice

ingredients.text: 1/2 c. Cooked chicken, pork or ham, finely chopped

steps: 1. In a medium skillet, cook the chicken, onion and mushrooms in the oil until tender, add rice and soy sauce. Cook over a low heat for 5 minutes, stirring occassionally with a fork. Add egg, parsley and pepper. Cook for a further 5 minutes stirring constantly. Serves 5-6.
title: Fried Rice

steps: 1. In wok or skillet, heat oil over medium heat.
2. Add carrots and chicken. Stir fry for 1 minute.
3. Add eggs and pepper.
4. Stir fry for 1 minute.
5. Add rice and soy sauce.
6. Stir fry for 5 minutes. Garnish with scallions.
7. Makes 6 servings.
title: Chicken Fried Rice

ingredients.text: 2 large tomatoes, cut in thin wedges

steps: 1. Combine vegetables. Toss lightly.
2. Heat oil in skillet.
3. Add vegetables and sprinkle with sugar, salt and pepper.
4. Cover and cook 10 minutes over medium heat, stirring twice during cooking period.
5. Makes 6 servings.
title: Stir-Fry Vegetables

steps: 1. Comibne the broth, lemon juice, vegetables, and pepper in a large pot.
2. Bring to a boil, then cover partially and simmer until vegetables are tender (~20 minutes).
3. Blend butter and flour until smooth.
4. Add a spoonful of the mixture into the the hot soup a little at a time. Stir well after each addition.
5. Simmer soup for 10 minutes, stir often.
6. In a seperate bowl, beat the yolks until light yellow.
7. Add 2-3 spoonfuls of the hot soup mixture to the yolks and mix well.
8. Return the yolk/soup mixture to the pot.
9. Add in the rice and chicken.
10. Cook until heated through.
11. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
title: Greek Lemon Chicken Soup

ingredients.text: 2 cups white rice (Just a little undercooked, I use "minute rice" and cook it in 2 cups of water for 4 minutes in the m)

steps: 1. In a wok or frying pan heat oil and butter until very hot.
2. Add peppers and chives and cook for about 2 to 3 minutes.
3. Add eggs and cook like scrambled eggs.
4. Add rice and soy sauce and cook, moving rice around constantly until done (About 2 minutes).
5. You can also add some black pepper if you like.
6. Serve right away or keep warm until serving.
title: Simple Fried Rice

steps: 1. Prepare all the veggies for a stir-fry, cut carrots and bell peppers into juilienne strips, about 1/8 inch thick.
2. Cut cabbage into 1/4 inch slices.
3. In a wok, fry the onion over high heat with the paprika, garlic, and ginger until browning begins.
4. Stir in the tomato and stir-fry briefly.
5. Add carrots and stir fry for 1 minute.
6. Place the cabbage slices on top of the mixture without stirring.
7. Cover tightly and continue cooking for one minute only.
8. Stir in the bell pepper slices.
9. Serve with rice.
title: Tibetan Cabbage Stir-Fry (Logo Petse)

steps: 1. In a large skillet, cook the rice in oil over medium heat, stirring, until golden brown.( About 7 minutes.).
2. Add salt, water, bouillon and soy sauce.
3. Cover tightly and simmer 20 minutes.
4. Brown ground beef. Drain.
5. Stir meat, onions, celery and green pepper into rice.
6. Cover and simmer 10 minutes longer or until all liquid is absorbed and rice is tender.
title: Chinese Beef & Rice

steps: 1. In a skillet coated with cooking spray, saute green pepper until crisp-tender. Add egg substitute; cook and stir until egg is completely set. Chop egg into small pieces. Add rice and soy sauce; heat through.
title: Fried Rice

ingredients.text: 1/2 head cabbage, cut up or shredded

steps: 1. Stir-fry the ingredients in a large skillet.
2. Add 1/4 cup cooking sherry if desired (or can flavor with soy sauce).
title: Stir-Fry Cabbage

ingredients.text: 4 cups broccoli florets, in bite-size pieces

steps: 1. In a bowl combine soy sauce, vinegar & sugar, then set aside.
2. In a skillet over medium heat, add sesame seeds & cook for 1 minute, then remove seeds & set aside.
3. To the skillet add oil, red pepper, ginger & garlic & cook for 30 seconds, then add broccoli & cook for another minute.
4. Add soy mixture, then cover the pan & cook for 2 minutes, before sprinkling the sesame seeds over the broccoli & serving.
title: Szechuan Broccoli (Chinese)

steps: 1. Heat oil in large skillet.
2. Stir-fry pepper and onion one minute.
3. Add soy sauce and rice.
4. Cook and stir until hot.
title: Basic Fried Rice

ingredients.text: 1 pound skinless, boneless chicken breasts, cut into 1/2-inch pieces

steps: 1. Heat oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Add onion and garlic and sautee 2 minutes, until soft. Place chicken in saucepan and sautee 5 minutes, until browned on all sides, stirring frequently. Add rice and cook 1 minute, until translucent. Stir in soy sauce to coat rice.
2. Add carrots, chicken broth, salt and pepper and bring mixture to a boil. Reduce heat, cover and simmer 30 minutes, until liquid is absorbed and rice is tender.
3. Stir in peas and green onions and heat through.
title: Chicken Fried Rice

steps: 1. Beat eggs with sesame oil.
2. Scramble in large skillet on medium heat, breaking into small pieces and remove from pan.
3. In same skillet, saute onions until tender.
4. Add frozen peas and cook several minutes until peas are warm.
5. Add rice and scrambled eggs. Toss with soy sauce and heat until warm.
title: Fried Rice

steps: 1. Place oil in skillet over high heat.
2. Add garlic and stir-fry 30 minutes.
3. Add vegetables to time it takes to cool.
4. Mix cornstarch and soy sauce, add to vegetables.
5. Cover and cook until vegetables are tender but crisp, 2 to 3 minutes.
title: Stir-Fry Vegetables

ingredients.text: 6 c. fresh asparagus, cut in bias pieces 1 1/2-inches long

steps: 1. Heat large skillet; add salad oil and when hot, add the asparagus.
2. Sprinkle with seasonings.
3. Cover.
4. Lift skillet slightly above high heat and shake it constantly while cooking. Cook asparagus only until tender, 4 to 5 minutes.
5. Reduce heat to medium if necessary, during last minute or so of cooking.
6. Don't overcook!
title: Chinese Style Asparagus

ingredients.text: 3/4 pound fresh asparagus, cut into 1-inch pieces
2 small plum tomatoes, cut into thin wedges

steps: 1. In a small bowl, combine the cornstarch, broth, soy sauce and 1/2 teaspoon ginger until blended; set aside. In a nonstick skillet or wok, stir-fry the remaining ginger in canola oil for 30 seconds. Add asparagus and onions; stir-fry for 3 minutes. Add mushrooms; stir-fry for 1 minute.
2. Stir cornstarch mixture and add to skillet. Bring to a boil; cook and stir for 1 minute or until thickened. Reduce heat. Add tomatoes and sesame oil; cook 1 minute longer.
title: Asparagus Tomato Stir-Fry

steps: 1. Place onions and carrots in bottom of 3-4 quart crock pot. Top with chicken thighs.
2. Combine remaining ingredients except for cornstarch and 3 tablespoons water in small bowl and blend well; pour into crock pot.
3. Cover and cook on low for 8-9 hours until chicken is tender.
4. Remove chicken from crock pot and shred, using two forks. Return to crock pot.
5. In small bowl, combine cornstarch and 3 tablespoons water and blend well. Add to crock pot along with shredded chicken.
6. Stir and cook on high for 15-20 minutes until liquid is thickened.
7. Serve over hot cooked rice or couscous.
title: Crock Pot Lemon Chicken With Carrots

steps: 1. put cabbage and scallion in a bowl.
2. heat remaining ingredients to boil and lower heat, cook until sugar is dissolved.
3. pour over cabbage, toss to combine.
title: Hot And Sour Cabbage Salad

steps: 1. Wash spinach and chop into 5-cm segments.
2. In wok, bring some water to a boil. Add spinach, blanch briefly, remove, and drain.
3. Empty water from wok, heat to dry, add oil and swirl to heat well. Add garlic and toss just a moment until fragrant but not burned. Add spinach, salt, and MSG, tossing after each addition.

4. Turn off heat, drizzle with sesame oil, transfer to platter, and serve as part of a Chinese meal. (For a Chinese meal, serve rice, a soup, and one dish per person, selecting a balanced variety of dishes.).
title: Suan Rong Bo Cai (Chinese Garlic-Fried Spinach)

steps: 1. Cool rice.
2. Mix with other ingredients and put into greased casserole dish.
3. Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.
title: Chinese Rice

steps: 1. Fry chopped bacon until crisp; remove from fat.
2. Saute onion, celery and green pepper in bacon drippings until tender.
3. Remove vegetables.
title: Fried Rice

steps: 1. Melt margarine in frypan.
2. Stir in cabbage and stir-fry for 5 minutes.
3. Add drained corn, cover and cook 5 minutes.
4. Season to taste.
title: Corn And Cabbage Stir-Fry

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients except oil.
2. Add oil, beating slowly.
3. Use this dressing over Chinese cabbage or lettuce with sliced bananas.
title: Banana And Chinese Cabbage Salad

ingredients.text: 6 medium carrots, cleaned and sliced into 1/4-inch pieces
1 Tablespoons light soy sauce, if desired
1/2 cup of water, or so, to aid in cooking

steps: 1. 1) Heat oil in large frying pan over medium heat.
2. 2) Add garlic and cook for about 2 minutes.
3. 3) Stir in next 8 ingredients.
4. 4) Add 2 Tablespoons water. Cover and cook 10-15 minutes, until tender, stirring occasionally.
5. 5) Add small amounts of water, as needed, throughout the cooking period to avoid burning vegetables.
6. 6) Add soy sauce, a few minutes before serving, if desired
title: Garden Stir-Fry Vegetables

ingredients.text: 4 chicken thighs, skin removed but bone in tastes best

steps: 1. Add chicken to the skillet, add sliced carrots, mix orange juice and soy sauce together and pour over the chicken. Place on stove and cover; bring to boil, reduce heat and simmer for about 15 minutes, or until chicken is tender. Can use boneless, skinless breasts, but the sauce isn't as flavorful. I also double the amounts of liquid, as I like to have extra sauce.
title: Skillet Orange Chicken With Carrots

steps: 1. Cook all dressing ingredients except salad oil until sugar is dissolved. Cool.
2. Add oil.
title: Chinese Chicken Salad

steps: 1. In a small bowl beat the eggs with water.
2. Melt the butter in a large skillet or a wok over medium heat or until sizzling.
3. Add in eggs and leave flat for about 2 minutes or until cooked through; remove to a plate then chop.
4. Heat oil in the same skillet; add in onion and saute until softened (about 3-4 minutes, adding in the garlic the last 2 minutes of cooking time).
5. Add in cold rice, soy sauce, sesame oil and black pepper; stir-fry tossing continuously for about 5 minutes (adding in more soy sauce and black pepper if needed to suit taste).
6. Stir in the egg, chicken, veggies and green onion.
title: Chicken Fried Rice

steps: 1. Brown ground beef in skillet just until pink.
2. Add green pepper, onion and salt and pepper to taste.
3. Mix well, cook, covered until ground beef in cooked through; drain, stir in rice and soy sauce.
4. Cook for 5 minutes longer, adding water if necessary.
title: Fried Rice(Serves 6)

ingredients.text: 2 cups Cooked Shredded Chicken (more Or Less As You Prefer)

steps: 1. 1. In a small bowl mix the first 4 ingredients well and refrigerate for 10 minutes.
2. 2. In a large bowl combine chicken and lettuce.
3. 3. Saute the almonds in butter.
4. 4. Add almonds to the chicken and lettuce.
5. 6. Pour the vinegar mixture over the salad and mix well.
6. Enjoy!
title: Chinese Chicken Salad

steps: 1. Heat 1 tablespoon oil 1 to 2 minutes. Add the eggs and stir-fry until eggs are set and moist. Remove eggs.
2. Heat 2 tablespoons oil 1 to 2 minutes and add rice.
3. Stir-fry 1 to 2 minutes. Remove rice.
4. Heat 1 tablespoon oil 1 minute.
5. Add celery. Stir-fry 1 minute. Add bean sprouts and mushrooms. Stir-fry 1 minute. Stir-fry green onions and soy sauce. Return rice and egg to pan. Stir-fry 30 seconds and serve.
title: Fried Rice

steps: 1. Stir-fry asparagus, onion and garlic in butter until tender in large nonstick skillet about 5 to 7 minutes.
2. Stir in remaining ingredients; heat.
3. Gives 4 to 5 servings.
title: Stir-Fry Asparagus

steps: 1. Combine the sesame oil, eggs, and egg whites in a small bowl; stir well, and set aside.

2. Heat vegetable oil in a large nonstick skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add egg mixture, and stir-fry 2 minutes. Add rice; stir-fry 3 minutes. Add green peas, salt, and pepper; stir-fry 5 minutes. Add bean sprouts and green onions; stir-fry 2 minutes. Serve immediately.
title: Egg Fried Rice

steps: 1. Cut partially frozen steak across grain, diagonally, into thin slices.
2. Cut slices in 1 1/2-inch strips.
3. Combine 3 tablespoons soy sauce, 2 tablespoons cornstarch, 2 tablespoons oil and gingerroot.
4. Stir in meat strips.
5. Cover and refrigerate about 2 hours.
6. Stir together broth, remaining 2 tablespoons soy sauce, remaining 2 tablespoons cornstarch and oyster sauce; set aside.
title: Beef And Broccoli

steps: 1. Peel the cucumbers, cut in half crosswise and then in half lengthwise.
2. Scoop out the seeds and discard. Cut into strips about 2 in (5 cm) long and 1/2 in (1 cm) wide.
3. Sprinkle cucumber strips with salt and mix thoroughly. Set aside for at.

4. least 10 minutes at room temperature. Drain the cucumbers and squeeze out all the excess liquid with your hands. Clean the scallions and cut them into 2 in (5 cm) lengths, cut these into thin strips, and add to the cucumbers. Add the rest of the ingredients and mix.
title: Szechuan Cucumber Salad

steps: 1. In large skillet, heat oil; saute green onions until tender. Stir in rice and soy sauce.
2. Cook over low heat 5 to 10 minutes, stirring occasionally with a fork.
3. Push rice mixture to side of skillet; stir in eggs and pepper.
4. Cook over low heat 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
5. Stir in peas.
6. Heat thoroughly.
7. Serve with additional soy sauce, if desired.
title: Fried Rice

ingredients.text: 3 cups cold cooked long-grain rice (white, brown, or Texmati rice)
1 1/2 cups cooked black-eyed peas (rinsed and drained if canned)

steps: 1. Let the oil get hot in a large skillet over medium heat.
2. Add in the onion; stir/saute 5 minutes or until softened.
3. Add in the rice, tomatoes, lemon juice, Worcestershire, Tabasco, salt, and pepper; stir-fry for 5 minutes, breaking up any clumps of rice.
4. Stir in black-eyed peas and parsley; cook, stirring, until the peas are hot.
5. Adjust seasonings to taste and serve.
title: Southern Fried Rice

ingredients.text: 1 small onion, peeled and finely chopped

steps: 1. Scramble eggs in butter and set aside.
2. In wok or large frypan over medium heat, saute onion in oil until transparent.
3. Add vegetables, and cook, stirring for 3 minutes.
4. Add sugar, fish sauce and soy sauce and mix well.
5. Add rice and cook about 5 minutes, stirring frequently until all food is hot.
6. Chop up scrambled eggs; mix in and serve.
title: Mrs. Tran'S Fried Rice

ingredients.text: 1 lb chopped boneless skinless chicken breast (raw or cooked)

steps: 1. In a large pot over medium heat, cook the carrots, celery and onion in the olive oil for about 7 minutes. Add chicken broth, chicken, quinoa, lemon juice and pepper. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer until quinoa is tender, 20 minutes.
2. Add spinach and cook until tender.
title: Lemon Chicken Soup With Quinoa

ingredients.text: 1 1/4 lbs boneless skinless chicken, cut in 1-inch pieces

steps: 1. In a large frying pan or wok, heat oil over medium high. Add chicken cubes and stir-fry for 3 minutes, until chicken becomes opaque.
2. Remove with a slotted spoon and set aside.
3. Add broccoli; stir fry 1-2 minutes. Add mushrooms, scallions, soy sauce, sherry, and ginger.
4. Stir fry 2 more minutes. Add dissolved cornstarch and reserved chicken.
5. Cook until heated through and sauce has thickened.
title: Stir Fry Chicken And Broccoli

steps: 1. Toast sesame seeds on shallow baking tray at 350F for 5 minutes. Alternatively, you may buy toasted sesame seeds from supermarkets.
2. Place water and chicken in pan. Make sure chicken is well covered with water.
3. Add spice powder and soy sauce before bringing slowly to boil. Simmer over low fire, covered until chicken is just cooked.
4. When chicken has cooled, cut into slices.
