5. Chop celery diagonally and boil in chicken broth for a minute. Towel dry celery to remove excess moisture from celery.
6. Combine rest of ingredients and mix well with chicken and celery. Serve with sesame seeds.
title: Chinese Sesame Chicken With Celery Salad

ingredients.text: 3/4 lb boneless skinless chicken breast, cut in strips
1/2 lb asparagus, cut into diagonal pieces (discard tough part of spear)

steps: 1. In a glass dish, stir together soy sauce, lemon juice, lemon zest and cornstarch.
2. Add chicken and coat well with marinade. Cover and refrigerate for 15 to 30 minutes.
3. Heat oil in a large, nonstick skillet over medium-high heat.
4. Add garlic and fry till softened.
5. Reserving the marinade, add the chicken, followed by scallions, asparagus, and carrot.
6. Stir-fry for 3 to 4 minutes, or until chicken is no longer pink.
7. Add marinade and cook until sauce is slightly thickened, about 1 minute.
title: Lemon Chicken And Asparagus Stir Fry

steps: 1. Snap off and discard tough ends of asparagus.
2. Cut spears into 1/4 slanting slices.
3. Place wok over high heat; when wok is hot, add oil.
4. When oil begins to heat, add garlic and ginger and stir once, then add asparagus and stir-fry for 1 minute.
5. Add water, cover and cook 2 to 3 minutes.
title: Chinese Ginger Garlic Asparagus

steps: 1. Saute onions, ham, green peppers and rice.
2. Add eggs, soy sauce and salt to other mixture.
3. Saute.
title: Chinese Fried Rice

ingredients.text: 1 c. diced meat (pork, ham or chicken)

steps: 1. Heat 2 tbsp. oil. Stir-fry meat until done. Add onion, corn and egg. Fry 2 minutes longer. Remove from heat. Heat 6 tbsp. oil; fry rice and add rest of mixture.
title: Stir Fry Rice

steps: 1. In a skillet, cook beef untilno longer pink, and drain.
2. In a large bowl, beat eggs, and pepper.
3. In a skillet, heat 2 tablespoons, oil over medium heat.
4. Add eggs to skillet.
5. As eggs set, lift the edges, letting uncooked portion flow underneath.
6. When eggs are completely cooked, remove from skillet, and cut into strips.
7. Return to pan.
8. Stir in remaining ingredients.
9. Cook and stir over low heat in remaining oil for 5 minutes, or until heated through.
title: Beef Fried Rice

ingredients.text: 1 lb turkey breast, cut into strips
1 None small chili pepper, seeded and cut into thin rings
3 None carrots, peeled and cut diagonally into slices

steps: 1. Cook the rice in boiling salted water according to package directions.

2. Heat the oil in a large, nonstick frying pan. Fry the turkey over a high heat for 3-4 minutes until brown on both sides and remove it. Add the chili, leeks and carrots and cook in the hot oil over a medium heat, for 3-4 minutes. Stir in the cooked rice and turkey, and saute for 2-3 minutes. Whisk the eggs and soy sauce together. Pour the mixture into the pan, and cook while stirring for about 2 minutes, and season to taste.
title: Turkey Strips With Chili And Egg Fried Rice

ingredients.text: 10 shrimp, peeled and cut into small chunks (may be cooked or uncooked)

steps: 1. Shrimp are optional or may be substituted with chicken.
title: Shrimp Fried Rice

ingredients.text: 6 ounces salmon, sliced into bite sized pieces

steps: 1. Heat olive oil in 8" skillet over medium high heat.
2. Add onion and carrots saute until softened.
3. Add green & red bell Peppers,salmon and cook for another 1 minutes.
4. Add rice, tossing to mix well; stir-fry for 3 minutes.
5. add seasoned salt ,Taste the mixture and season more or not.
title: Salmon Fried Rice

steps: 1. Cook bacon, 5 slices at a time, in a large wok until crisp. Remove bacon and all but 3 Tblsp. of bacon drippings. Stir fry onion and celery in bacon drippings until almost tender. Add mushrooms, rice and soy sauce. Cook 5 minutes over low heat, stirrring occasionally. Stir in egg and cook only until egg is set. Turn onto a serving dish. Crumble bacon over top and serve immediately.
title: Bacon & Egg Fried Rice

ingredients.text: 2 cups tofu cubed, amount depends on your preference

steps: 1. Using your KitchenAid(R) Cast Iron Cookware over high heat, bring your chicken stock, grated ginger and soy sauce to a boil. In a small bowl or cup, mix together a few tablespoons of the chicken stock from your KitchenAid(R) Cast Iron Cookware with the cornstarch until blended together and there are no more lumps.

2. Slowly pour the cornstarch mixture into the chicken stock and stir until dissolved and the stock has thickened a bit. Turn the heat to a low simmer and then slowly pour in your beaten eggs, while stirring your soup in one direction. Add in the tofu, turn off the heat and add in the green onions. Taste and add a touch more soy sauce if needed. Serve immediately and enjoy.
title: Chinese Egg Drop Soup

ingredients.text: 3-4 tablespoons soy sauce, or more to taste.

steps: 1. In a pan over medium heat, add 1/2 tsp olive oil. Add the eggs and scramble slightly with a pinch of salt and pepper (optional), until barely cooked. Remove from a pan and put it into a bowl. Set aside.

2. Pour 1/2 tsp olive oil in medium heat. Add onion, carrots, peas, and garlic. Saute for about 5 minutes or until the onion, peas, and carrots are soft. Then, add the cooked quinoa (how to cook Quinoa), green onions, soy sauce, and oyster sauce and stir-fry until incorporated, about 2 minutes.
3. Add in the eggs and stir to combine. Finally, add the sesame oil, and remove from heat.
title: Quinoa Fried Rice Recipe

ingredients.text: 3 cups Cooked Rice (preferably Jasmine, But Brown Rice Can Also Be Used)

steps: 1. Heat a tablespoon of oil in your wok over medium high heat. Add your eggs, stir and scramble them. Once they are firm remove them from the wok and set aside.
2. Add the last tablespoon of oil to the pan and cook your onions and carrots for about 2 minutes, or until slightly soft.
3. Add your ham and stir-fry for an additional 2 minutes. Add peas and rice. Stir-fry to warm everything through.
4. Season with salt, white pepper, and soy sauce Stir in scallions.
5. Continue to stir fry for another 3 minutes. Serve.
title: “Banquet” Fried Rice

steps: 1. Dice bacon and fry until crisp.
2. Remove bacon and saute onions and celery in bacon fat.
3. Cook until tender.
4. Add mushrooms, rice and soy sauce.
5. cook for 10 minutes on low heat, stirring occasionally.
6. Stir in beaten egg and cook only until egg is done.
7. Add crisp bacon and mix well.
8. Serve with roast or grilled meats and poultry.
title: Chinese Fried Rice With Bacon And Mushrooms

ingredients.text: 1 lb. fresh green beans, cut into 1-inch pieces

steps: 1. In a large nonstick skillet or wok, stir-fry beans over medium-high heat in oil for 2 minutes. Add sweet pepper and mushrooms; stir-fry 2 minutes longer. Add green onions and garlic; stir-fry for 1 to 2 minutes.
title: Stir-Fry Sesame Green Beans

steps: 1. Start out by putting together the dough for your dumplings. Mix together the flour, salt and baking powder. Then slowly add in your ice water. Keep adding it in until you have enough to form a nice dough ball. Knead your dough for about 5 minutes and then set it the side and let it rest while you work on the other end of the soup.

2. In a large pot add together your stock, chicken, carrots, celery, garlic, basil, oregano, and celery salt. Heat it up on medium heat and let the chicken cook through. When the chicken is cooked, remove it and set it to the side.
3. Now grab up your dough and roll it out about 1/4" thick with your rolling pin. Cut it into small squares and place them in your hot broth. As they cook up, they will rise to the top of the broth.

4. While your dumplings are cooking, go ahead and shred your chicken up. Add it to your soup. Last but not least, add in the half and half and give it a couple swirls around the pan to incorporate everything together.
title: Chicken And Dumpling Soup

steps: 1. In pan on top of stove, saute onion in butter, add rice.
2. Put chicken over rice.
3. Make a hole in the middle and add butter and eggs and stir until cooked.
4. Mix all ingredients together and sprinkle with soy sauce to taste.
title: Chicken Fried Rice

steps: 1. Bring water and rice to a boil in a saucepan. Reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and simmer until the rice is tender and liquid has been absorbed, 20 to 25 minutes. Cool.
2. Melt butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Saute onion, garlic, and chile pepper in hot butter until fragrant and lightly browned, 5 to 7 minutes.
3. Stir cooked rice, egg, soy sauce, and sesame oil into onion mixture. Cook and stir until egg is cooked through and rice is coated and heated through, 3 to 5 minutes.
title: Chappy'S Garlic Fried Rice

steps: 1. Bring 1 cup of water to a boil in saucepan and stir in rice. Remove from heat. Cover and let stand 5 minutes.
title: Chinese Style Fried Rice

steps: 1. Bring water to a boil in a small saucepan, stir in instant rice.
2. Remove from heat, cover, and let stand for 5 minutes.
3. In a skillet, melt butter and lightly cook egg.	Add onion and rice and saut, stirring over medium heat until mixture is slightly browned.
4. Mix water with soy sauce and stir into rice.
5. Cover and cook until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed.
title: Quick Chinese-Style Fried Rice

steps: 1. Mix the first 4 ingredients together.
2. Refrigerate several hours or overnight.
3. Add remaining ingredients to first mixture just prior to serving.
4. Serve on bed of lettuce.
title: Mandarin Chicken Salad

steps: 1. Mix
2. all together.
3. Put in refrigerator overnight, then eat. May add banana before serving.
title: Mandarin Salad

steps: 1. In a saucepan, bring broth to a boil. Stir in rice. Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 45-50 minutes or until liquid is absorbed and rice is tender. Remove from the heat; cool. Cover and refrigerate overnight.

2. In a bowl, combine turkey and soy sauce; cover and refrigerate. In a large nonstick skillet, cook and stir the egg over medium heat until completely set. Remove and set aside. In the same skillet, saute onion, green pepper and celery in oil until tender. Add rice and turkey; cook and stir over medium heat for 6-8 minutes. Add lettuce and reserved egg; cook and stir for 1-2 minutes. Serve immediately.
title: Turkey Fried Rice

steps: 1. Heat oil in large skillet or wok; saute onion over medium-high heat for 2 minutes; add garlic and saute for 1 minute.
2. Push onions and garlic to side; pour eggs onto bottom of wok; cook and stir eggs for 1-2 minutes until firm; stir onions, garlic, and eggs together.
3. Add meat, rice, green onions, and any additional veggies from optional list** below to wok; stir and toss until evenly mixed and almost heated through.
4. Add bean sprouts and soy sauce to wok; stir until heated through; serve (or put away for later meal) and enjoy!

5. For variety you may add (at same time as meat) any of the following **optional veggies: Sliced mushrooms, sliced water chestnuts, thinly sliced celery, snow peas, (thawed) peas & carrots, chopped green pepper, finely shredded cabbage, or slivered almonds ~ Just don't be afraid to experiment and use whatever's in your refrigerator!
6. Note: Including 1/2 teaspoon sesame oil with the vegetable oil gives the rice a really wonderful flavor!
title: Cantonese Fried Rice

ingredients.text: 1 1/4 lbs pork tenderloin, trimmed of fat
1 red bell pepper, cut into short, thin strips

steps: 1. Prepare noodles according to package directions.
2. Meanwhile, cut pork crosswise into 1/4-inch thick slices; cut slices in half.
3. Heat oil in a large deep nonstick skillet over medium-high heat until hot.
4. Add pork, garlic and ginger; stir-fry 3 minutes or until pork is no longer pink.
5. Transfer mixture to a bowl; set aside.
6. Add bell pepper and snow peas to skillet; stir fry 1 minute.
7. Combine broth and cornstarch; mix well.
8. Add broth mixture, hoisin sauce and soy sauce to skillet; bring to a boil, stirring constantly.
9. Add pork mixture; stir-fry 1 minute or until pork is cooked through.
10. Drain noodles; transfer to 6 serving plates.
11. Spoon pork mixture over noodles; sprinkle with green onions.
12. Garnish with peanuts or cashews, if desired.
13. SUBSTITUTION TIP: Use sugar snap peas if snow pea pods are not available.
14. NUTRITIONAL INFORMATION:.
15. Based on individual serving.
16. Calories: 416.
17. Total Fat: 10 g.
18. Carbohydrates: 49 g.
19. Protein: 29 g.
title: Hoisin Pork And Noodles

ingredients.text: 2 chicken breasts (boneless, skinless, cut in small pieces)

steps: 1. Steam rice, 2 cups water and 1 tablespoon oil in covered saucepan or rice cooker about 20 minutes.
2. Remove from heat and let stand another 20 minutes.
3. In small amount of oil in wok or skillet, saute chicken until done.
4. Remove from wok.
5. In wok, steam carrot, celery and onion pieces in 1/2 cup water until tender and water is absorbed.
6. Add peas and a little oil and saute a couple of minutes.
7. Remove all ingredients from wok.
8. Warm 1/4 cup oil in wok and dump in rice.
9. Stir and add soy sauce.
10. Add in previously cooked chicken and veggies.
11. Green part of onion may be reserved uncooked for garnish.
title: Fried Rice

Just remember to stir often and keep a close eye on it. Once it absorbs all the water, take it off of the heat so it doesn't stick and scorch in the pan. It's precooked!

2. Place your wok on the stove and turn the heat on medium high. Coat the entire inside surface of the wok with olive oil & butter, and add enough to cover the bottom about a 1/4 of an inch. Once the oil is starting to get good and hot, toss in the pre-cooked rice. Let this sizzle and stir for a moment, and then make a well in the bottom for the onions, garlic, and eggs. Add a little oil if needed. Brown the onions, garlic, and eggs and then stir the rice back in on top of it. Keep stirring and mixing until the eggs are thoroughly cooked. 3. until thick and clear. Add 2 Tbsp. butter and 2 Tbsp lemon juice.
title: Sweet And Sour Beets

steps: 1. Mix together ingredients.
2. Place chicken or ribs in shallow pan; pour on sauce.
3. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
4. Good on pork chops also.
title: Sweet And Sour Chicken Or Ribs

steps: 1. Mix first 6 ingredients.
2. Shape into small balls.
3. Put gingerale and ketchup into large pot and bring to a boil.
4. Add meatballs ,cover and simmer for 2 hours.
title: Tangy Sweet And Sour Meatballs

steps: 1. Heat a skillet over medium heat. Cook beef, breaking apart as little as possible, until browned and still the size of peas, 5 to 7 minutes. Add Worcestershire sauce, salt, and pepper. Stir gently and remove mixture from pan.

2. Melt butter in the skillet. Add onion and bell pepper; cook and stir until browned, 5 to 7 minutes. Return beef mixture to the skillet and stir to combine. Let filling cool while preparing the wrappers.

3. Lay egg roll wrappers on a flat surface. Place 1/2 a slice of American cheese onto each. Add 3 tablespoons of the filling on top of each egg roll. Pull the bottom left corner over the filling and fold the two sides in, moistening edges with water as you go; roll tightly.
4. Heat about 1 inch oil in a large saucepan over medium-high heat. Add 3 to 4 egg rolls at a time and fry until browned, 3 to 4 minutes. Repeat with remaining egg rolls.
title: Philly Cheesesteak Egg Rolls

steps: 1. Cut chicken in pieces.
2. Season the chicken with salt and pepper.
3. Combine the honey and soy sauce.
4. Pour over the chicken and bake for 1 hour.
title: Sweet And Sour Chicken

ingredients.text: 3 cups flour, sifted with a pinch of baking powder
4 slices white bread, cut into cubes

steps: 1. Beat eggs, salt& milk in a large mixing bowl; add flour gradually.
2. Continue beating with a large spoon (the dough must be smooth& stiff enough to hold its shape).
3. Stir in bread cubes last.
4. Have a clean, wet towel ready.
5. Shape the dough with wet hands into an oblong, roll in a towel& drop into a large kettle of salted boiling water.
6. Boil, covered, for 45 minutes.
7. Remove the towel& slice the dumpling 1/2 inch thick (if not sliced immediately, the steam cannot escape& the dumplings will be soggy& hard).
8. Keep hot until ready to serve.
title: Bread Dumplings (Houskove Knedliky)

steps: 1. Cut mandarins in half lenghtways (skin on). Remove pips and place cut side up in a microwave dish and add 3/4 cup water. Cover and microwave on high 15 minutes (or boil 25 minutes) & drain.
2. In a food processor blend sugar and mandarins to a paste and leave to cool.
3. Add eggs and mix, then add almond meal and baking powder and mix well. Line a shallow 20 cm cake tin with baking paper and pour in the batter, smooth the top.
4. Bake at 180c for about 50 minutes, until firm in the centre. Cool in the tin before turning out.
5. Serve warm or cool, with thickened cream and additional mandarine segments.for decoration.
title: Flourless Mandarin Cake

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 400°. Prick all potatoes with a fork, and bake on a jelly-roll pan 1 hour.
2. Cool potatoes 20 minutes. Peel and mash until smooth. Add cheese and next 4 ingredients, and stir until smooth. Fold in flour just until blended.
3. Divide dough into 4 equal portions; dust with flour. Roll each into a 3/4-inch-diameter rope on a well-floured surface. Cut into 1-inch pieces; place dumplings on a lightly floured baking sheet.
4. Cook dumplings, 10 to 12 at a time, in 3 qt. boiling water over medium-high heat, 3 minutes. Remove with a slotted spoon.
title: Sweet Potato Dumplings

ingredients.text: 2 1/2 pounds fresh collard greens, tough stems removed and leaves torn into bite-size pieces

steps: 1. Cook the bacon in a large Dutch oven over medium heat until browned and crisp, about 8 minutes, stirring often. Transfer bacon pieces into a bowl with a slotted spoon, leaving the drippings in the pan.

2. Stir water, vinegar, sugar, salt, and black pepper into the bacon drippings until the sugar has dissolved; bring the mixture to a boil. Place collards into the boiling mixture, and stir to mix well. Cover the Dutch oven, reduce heat to a simmer, and cook until the greens are tender, 30 to 45 minutes. Drizzle in a little more water or vinegar if greens become too dry.
3. Spoon greens into a serving dish, and sprinkle with the cooked bacon pieces.
title: Sweet And Sour Greens

steps: 1. Soak bread crumbs in milk for 5 minutes.
2. Combine crumb mixture with meat, eggs and next four ingredients.
3. Shape into balls about an inch in diameter.
4. Heat shortening in skillet and brown meat balls.
5. Place meat balls in cooker pot.
6. Add grape jelly and barbecue sauce, dill weed and pepper.
7. Cook on low for 4 hours.
title: Sweet And Sour Swedish Meat Balls

steps: 1. In a saucepan, combine sugar, salt, bouillon cube, vinegar, catsup and soy sauce. Bring to a boil over medium heat on stove top. Stir mixture to dissolve sugar and bouillon cube. Remove from heat. Place wings in a crock-pot and cover with sauce. Cover and simmer 5 to 6 hours. Remove wings and increase heat to highest setting.
title: Sweet And Sour Chicken Wings

steps: 1. In bowl, combine meat, crumbs, eggs and 2 teaspoons bouillon; shape into 1 1/4-inch balls.
2. In large skillet, brown meatballs. Remove from pan.
3. Pour off fat.
4. In skillet combine preserves, lemon juice and 2 teaspoons bouillon.
5. Over low heat, cook and stir 15 minutes.
6. Add meatballs; simmer uncovered 10 minutes. Refrigerate leftovers.
7. Makes about 4 dozen.
title: Sweet And Sour Meatballs

steps: 1. Brown beef and onion; drain.
2. Add cabbage, carrots, soy sauce, pepper and salt to taste.
3. Try not to cook the cabbage and carrots too long.
4. Sit off heat.
5. In a large skillet, heat oil on medium-high to medium heat.
6. Take egg rolls out one at a time. Place beef mixture in center of roll.
7. Fold up like a baby's diaper.
8. Wet one end to hold in place.
9. Place in hot oil until golden brown.
10. Turn over and brown the other side.
11. Drain on paper towels.
12. Dip in sweet and sour sauce.
title: Chinese Egg Rolls

steps: 1. Cream the margarine and add the sugar.
2. Beat until light.
3. Add egg yolks and almond extract. Blend well. Add sifted flour and chopped almonds.
4. Mix thoroughly.
5. Form dough into balls.
6. Place on ungreased baking sheet.
7. Press down with a fork.
8. Bake at 325° for 15 minutes.
9. Makes 4 dozen.
title: Chinese Almond Cookies

steps: 1. Combine water and lentils; bring to a boil.
2. Cover, reduce heat and simmer 1/2 hour.
3. Add chopped onion and cook 15 minutes more.
4. Add remaining ingredients.
5. Add more water if lentils look dry.
6. Continue to simmer for 10 minutes.
7. If the lentils are not tender, add a little more water and soak a few more minutes. Serve over rice, bulgur or millet.
title: Sweet And Sour Lentils

steps: 1. Mix first 7 ingredients well.
2. Blend in flour mixture and almonds.
3. Shape into 1-inch balls on ungreased cookie sheet. Flatten with a glass; brush with slightly beaten egg white.
4. Place an almond half on each cookie, pressing in slightly.
5. Bake at 375° for 10 to 15 minutes.
title: Chinese Almond Cookies

steps: 1. Pour milk over crumbled bread. Add meat, egg and seasonings. Mix well. Form into walnut-sized balls. Brown in shortening. Shake pan to help balls retain shape. Place in saucepan.
title: Sweet And Sour Meatballs

ingredients.text: 1 cup unsalted butter, at room temperature

steps: 1. Preheat the oven to 375°. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Sift together the flour, cream of tartar, salt and baking soda.

2. Cream together the butter and sugar with a hand mixer. Blend in the beaten egg and almond extract. Add the dry ingredients to the creamed mixture and mix until the dough takes on a flaky, moist consistency. Gather the crumbly mixture together using your hands or a spatula.
3. To make the topping, chop up the almonds (most easily done by hitting a few times with a mallet) and combine in a small bowl with the five-spice powder and brown sugar.

4. To form the cookies, roll dough into 1 1/2-inch diameter balls between the palms of your hands. Place on the prepared baking sheet. Flatten to about 1/2-inch thickness, lightly brush top with the egg wash and generously sprinkle with the topping. Bake for 11-12 minutes.
title: Chinese New Year Almond Cookies

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients thoroughly with mixer, except for the frozen green peas.
2. Heat small square electric skillet to 325°. Oil lightly.
3. Pour mixture into skillet until egg starts to firm. Sprinkle a few frozen green peas on top of egg mixture.
4. Starting closest to you, roll the egg away from you like a jelly roll, using 2 spatulas.
5. Cool slightly in pan to shape.
6. Place on cutting board.
7. Slice 1/4-inch thick.
title: Egg Roll

steps: 1. Melt first two ingredients in double boiler just to smoothness.
2. Stir in noodles and marshmallows.
3. Spoon drop onto wax paper.
4. Refrigerate to set.
5. Great taste!
title: My Chinese Candy

steps: 1. Brown sugar in large skillet.
2. Add hot water, oleo and sugar. Let simmer until all is dissolved.
3. This may be transferred to large baking dish.
title: Kentucky Caramel Dumplings

steps: 1. Mix hamburger, onion, salt and rice together.
2. Form into balls.
3. Place balls into baking pan.
4. Mix together ketchup, sugar, vinegar and water to make sauce.
5. Pour sauce over meatballs. Cover with foil.
6. Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.
title: Sweet And Sour Meatballs

steps: 1. Mix ingredients.
2. Shape into 1-inch balls.
3. Place on safe rack and cook covered for 6 minutes on Full power or until done.
4. Drain fat.
title: Sweet And Sour Meatballs(In The Microwave)

steps: 1. Cream together margarine, vanilla and powdered sugar.
2. Add chopped nuts and then add flour, 1/2 cup at a time.
3. Let cream together until velvety smooth.
4. Shape into 1-inch squares.
5. Bake 45 minutes at 280°.
6. Cool and then roll in powdered sugar.
title: Dumpling Cookies

steps: 1. Sift flour and salt into a large bowl; create a well-like indentation in the center.
2. Beat egg lightly, pour into indentation in the flour and mix well.
3. Sprinkle with cold water, wet your hands, and knead the mixture into a smooth dough.
4. Place dough in a bowl and cover with a damp cloth, refrigerate for 30 minutes to an hour.
5. Sprinkle a wide work area or board with flour. Roll out the dough until it is paper thin and its edges are even in thickness. The wonton skins will be partially transparent.
6. Cut dough in 2–3-inch (5–7.5 cm) strips, flour lightly, then stack one on top of the other and cut the strips into 2–3-inch (5–7.5 cm) squares.
7. Place skins on tray and cover with a damp cloth until ready to use.
title: Wonton Wrappers

steps: 1. Bring water to a boil in sauce pan.
2. Stir in margarine until melted; remove from heat.
3. Add flour and salt; mix well.
4. Knead lightly on floured surface.
5. Roll 1/4 at a time to 1/8-inch thickness on lightly floured surface.
6. Cut into 1 inch squares. Bring broth to a boil in large sauce pan.
7. Drop dumplings into boiling broth.
8. Simmer for 20 minutes or until dumplings are tender.
9. Yield: 8 servings.
title: Dumplings

steps: 1. Drop by spoonfuls into chicken stew.
2. Dip spoon into boiled stew first (the dough will slide off easier).
3. Cover pan and cook 15 minutes.
4. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Country Dumplings

steps: 1. Sift flour with baking powder and salt.
2. Cut in shortening until mixture is as fine as cornmeal.
3. Add liquid and mix very lightly until a soft dough is formed.
4. Drop from teaspoon on boiling meat stew.
5. Cover very tightly and cook without removing cover 12 minutes.
6. Serves 6.
7. Keep covered while cooking to prevent sogginess.
8. Richer dumplings may be made by using 1 beaten egg and 1/4 cup milk, instead of 1/2 cup milk.
title: Dumplings

steps: 1. Process onion in blender until minced.
2. Add oil, sugar, vinegar, Worcestershire sauce and catsup.
3. Process until well mixed.
4. Yield:
5. 12 servings.
title: Sweet And Sour Dressing For Spinach Salad

steps: 1. Combine flour, baking powder and salt.
2. Cut in shortening.
3. Add milk to make a stiff dough.
4. Roll out to about 1/8 inch thickness and cut into 1-inch squares, 1 to 1 1/2-inch strips or diamonds. Sprinkle lightly with flour and drop into boiling ham broth.
5. Cover loosely and boil gently for 8 to 10 minutes.
6. Yield:
7. 6 to 8 servings.
title: Rolled Dumplings

steps: 1. Cook chicken until done.
2. Mix rest of ingredients well.
3. Drop by teaspoon onto pieces of chicken.
4. Steam 12 minutes.
5. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Mommy'S Dumplings

steps: 1. Sift flour; measure and sift with baking powder and salt.
2. Cut in shortening.
3. Add sufficient milk to make a drop batter.
4. Drop by spoonfuls into boiling liquid.
5. Cover closely and cook about 10 minutes.
6. The liquid must be kept boiling during the entire 10 minutes.
7. Serve at once.
8. Makes 8 servings.
title: Drop Dumplings

steps: 1. Blend together milk and Bisquick (makes 8 dumplings).
2. Cook tomatoes and water until bubbly.
3. Drop dumplings by spoonful onto tomatoes.
4. Cook uncovered 10 minutes, then covered for 10 minutes. Serves 4.
5. Recipe can be doubled.
title: Tomato And Dumplings

steps: 1. Clean chicken; rub skin with baking soda and wash off carefully.
2. Cut up chicken; peel off excess fat.
3. Fit chicken pieces completely in cooking kettle.
4. Add salt; cook 1 1/2 to 2 hours or until tender.
5. Sift flour, baking powder and salt.
6. Add milk and stir until mixture is dampened.
7. Add parsley; stir until distributed evenly.
8. Add to chicken.
9. Cook until done.
10. Remove chicken to platter and dumplings to gravy bowl.
11. Makes 5 to 6 servings.
title: Stewed Chicken And Dumplings

ingredients.text: 3 slices wheat bread, cut into cubes

steps: 1. Saute bread cubes in lard until golden brown.
2. Grate potatoes; add flour, salt and eggs.
3. Beat mixture lightly.
4. Stir in bread cubes.
5. Mix well and form dumplings.
6. Cook in boiling water for 20 minutes.
7. Kettle should be covered during cooking.
8. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Potato Dumplings

steps: 1. Place all ingredients in a small bowl.
2. Blend well with wire whisk or fork.
3. Makes 6 servings.
title: Sweet And Sour Salad Dressing

ingredients.text: 1 lb. medium shrimp, peeled with tails left on

steps: 1. Make a marinade by combining the egg white, cornstarch, sesame oil and salt.
2. Marinate the shrimp in the mixture for up to 2 hours.
3. When ready to prepare, heat the vegetable oil in a skillet over high heat and add the shrimp.
4. Stir until shrimp are barely pink.
5. Remove with a slotted spoon and set aside.
6. Remove half the oil from the skillet; add the garlic and stir for a few seconds over high heat.
7. Add the oyster sauce.
8. Return the shrimp to the skillet and cook until done.
9. Do not overcook.
10. Garnish with the scallion.
11. Serves 4.
title: Shrimp With Garlic And Oyster Sauce

ingredients.text: 1/2 c. sugar (adjust to tartness of berries)

steps: 1. Make batter first.
2. Cream the butter with 3/4 cup sugar.
3. Add egg and vanilla.
4. Stir in flour and baking powder alternately with milk; set aside.
5. Put berries and 1/2 cup sugar into a pan with a little water (slightly less than would cover the berries).
6. Bring to a boil.
7. Into boiling blueberry mixture, drop tablespoons of batter.
8. Cover pan tightly; cook over gentle heat 5 to 7 minutes. Serve immediately, topped with vanilla ice cream or whipped cream.
title: Blueberry Dumplings

steps: 1. Heat thoroughly Serve over chicken fried in egg & cornstarch, with fried rice .
title: Sweet & Sour Sauce

steps: 1. Combine all dry ingredient together.
2. Cut in shortening.
3. Add milk and mix.
4. Drop by spoonfuls into simmering soup or stew.
5. Cook 10 minutes uncovered, and 10 minutes covered.
6. DO NOT TAKE THE LID OFF UNTIL THE 10 MINUTES ARE UP.
title: Never Fail Dumplings

ingredients.text: 1/3 cup fresh parmesan cheese, grated (be sure to use fresh)

steps: 1. In a bowl, combine Bisquick, parmesan and oregano.
2. Add milk and stir until a dough forms.
3. With Bisquick-dusted hands, roll dough into 12 balls.
4. Add the dumplings to soup; cover and simmer until dumplings are cooked through, about 10 minutes.
title: Cheese Dumplings

steps: 1. Cook berries and sugar with enough water to cover. Combine flour, baking powder and salt. Cut in shortening until the texture of peas. Add milk and mix. Drop dumplings into boiling berry mixture and cook 10 minutes, uncovered, and 10 minutes, covered. Serve with a scoop of vanilla ice cream or whipped cream.
title: Blueberry Dumplings

steps: 1. In a large bowl combine the flour, baking powder and salt.
2. Cut in the shortening with a pastry blender until the mixture forms fine crumbs.
3. Stir in enough hot water to make a firm but manageable dough.
4. In a 4-quart saucepan, heat the broth to boiling.
5. Add the butter; let the butter melt and float to the top of the broth.
6. On a floured board, roll out the dough to 1/16 inch thickness.
7. Cut into 2 inch squares.
8. Drop the dumplings one at a time into the boiling broth.
9. Reheat the broth to boiling over high heat.
10. Reduce the heat to medium and cook dumplings uncovered until tender, about 15 minutes.
11. Spoon the dumplings into a serving dish with some of the cooking liquied and serve.
12. Can be added to a variety of soups and broths.
title: Delaware Slippery Dumplings

steps: 1. In a saucepan, combine cornmeal, salt and water; bring to a boil over medium-high heat, stirring constantly. Cook and stir until very thick. Reduce heat; cook and stir for 3 minutes. Remove from the heat. Stir in corn, butter, onion and pepper; let stand for 3 minutes. Add egg; mix well. In a bowl, combine 3/4 cup flour and baking powder. Add to cornmeal mixture; beat well. Shape into 1-1/2-in. balls; roll in remaining flour to lightly coat. In a Dutch oven or kettle, bring broth to a boil. Add dumplings. Cover and simmer for 15 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in a dumpling comes out clean (do not lift the cover while simmering).
title: Corn Dumplings

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients together in a bowl.
2. Let stand to cool. Refrigerate for several hours.
3. Roll out thin on a floured board, cut in desired squares and place on an ungreased cookie sheet to freeze.
4. Loosen with spatula and put in plastic bags to freeze. They can be used without freezing.
5. Cook in boiling chicken broth for 15 minutes or until tender.
title: Dumplings

steps: 1. Mix together.
2. Drop dumplings into the edge of the soup pan using a lg. tablespoon.
3. Cook dumplings in soup with the cover off for the first 10 mins., then cook with cover on for 10 minutes.
title: Grammie Bea'S Herbed Dumplings

steps: 1. Heat hoisin, honey, gingerroot and garlic in a small saucepan over medium heat.
2. Allow sauce to simmer for 2-3 minutes then remove from heat.
3. Reserve 1/4 cup of sauce.
4. Lightly score diagonal cuts across the hot dogs.
5. Liberally brush hot dogs with sauce.
6. Preheat a gas or charcoal grill for the direct grilling method, using medium heat.
7. Place hot dogs on grill rack, about 4 to 5 inches from the heat. Cook hot dogs over direct medium heat to an internal temperature of 165 degrees F for 10-12 minutes, basting often with the sauce.
8. During last 3 to 4 minutes, open hot dog buns and lightly toast them over indirect heat.
9. Brush buns with reserved hoisin sauce.
10. Place hot dogs into heated buns.
11. Sprinkle chopped green onions atop hot dogs.
title: Hoisin Glazed Hot Dogs

ingredients.text: 2 well beaten eggs (I use extra larga)

steps: 1. Mix ingredients in a bowl.
2. Stir until smooth.
3. Dip spoon into boiling water.
4. Push small amounts of dough in water.
5. Keep dipping spoon in boiling water as spoon cools.
6. Boil for 3 minutes.
7. Drain in colander.
8. Rinse with water, if desired.
title: Slovak Egg Dumplings

steps: 1. Stir together sugar, vinegar, Worcestershire sauce, onion, and ketchup until the sugar has dissolved. Whisk the vegetable oil into the onion mixture until incorporated. Cover and refrigerate 1 hour; shake well before using.
title: Sweet And Sour Salad Dressing

steps: 1. Peel, cut in halves and core large tart apples.
2. Make a dough as follows:
3. Take 2 1/2 cupfuls of flour, a heaping teaspoonful of baking powder, 1 teaspoonful of salt and sift together.
4. Rub 2/3 of a cupful of lard with the flour.
5. Mix with enough cold water to make a dough easily handled.
6. Divide the dough into 6 parts. Roll each part large enough to enclose half an apple.
7. Press the dough firmly around each piece of apple and bake in a moderate oven.
8. Serve with sweetened cream, flavored with lemon or any preferred flavoring.
title: Santa Fe Baked Apple Dumplings

steps: 1. Sift flour.
2. Measure and sift with baking powder, salt and sugar. Cut in shortening and add milk. Turn into lightly floured board. Roll in sheet 1/4-inch thick.
3. Cut in 4-inch squares. Place 1/2 cup thinly sliced peaches in each square.
4. Sprinkle with sugar.
5. Dot with butter.
6. Moisten edges of dough.
7. Press lightly together. Place in baking pan. Bake in hot oven at 425° for about 35 minutes.
title: Peach Dumplings

steps: 1. Mix flour, baking powder and salt in a bowl. Stir in egg, milk and parsley.
2. Drop by spoonfuls on top of simmering liquids (not boiling or they will fall apart) and COVER.
3. Check to see if dumplings are set after approximately 15 - 30 minutes. After they are set, they should be fine on dish for about 2 hours.
title: Nif'S Easy Baking Powder Dumplings (Crock Pot Or Stove Top)

ingredients.text: 1 1/3 lbs boneless skinless chicken breasts, thinly sliced
1 piece (3/4 inch) ginger, peeled and grated
2 tsp sambal oelek (Indonesian ground chili paste)

steps: 1. Heat 1 tsp of the oil in a wok on high heat. Stir-fry the nuts until lightly browned. Remove from the wok.
2. Heat the remaining oil in the wok on high heat. Stir-fry the chicken, in batches, until browned. Remove from the wok.

3. Add the garlic, ginger and sambal to the wok and stir-fry until fragrant. Return the nuts and chicken to the wok with the sauces and sherry and stir-fry until heated through. Add the onion and stir-fry until combined. Season to taste and serve.
title: Almond Chicken Stir-Fry

ingredients.text: 680 g boneless skinless chicken breast halves

steps: 1. Combine the first 5 ingredients in a bowl.
2. Mix well.
3. Place chicken breasts between 2 sheets of wax paper and pound lightly with a mallet or other heavy flat object to flatten slightly.
4. Transfer chicken to a dish.
5. Add marinade and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
6. Turn on broiler.
7. Place breasts in a shallow baking dish.
8. Brush with half the marinade.
9. Broil for 4-5 minutes.
10. Turn, brush with the remaining marinade, and broil for another 4-5 minutes or until browned.
11. Serve with pan juices.
12. Serve sprinkled with parsley and garnished with lemon slices.
title: Greek Lemon Chicken For Those Who Want To Lose Weight

ingredients.text: 2 tablespoons white wine or chicken broth
6 boneless skinless chicken breast halves (5 ounces each)

steps: 1. In a small bowl, combine the first six ingredients. Pour 3/4 cup marinade into a large resealable plastic bag. Add the chicken; seal bag and turn to coat. Refrigerate for at least 8 hours or overnight. Cover and refrigerate remaining marinade.

2. Drain chicken and discard marinade. Lightly oil the grill rack. Grill chicken, covered, over medium heat or broil 4 in. from the heat for 5 minutes. Turn; grill or broil 4-9 minutes longer or until a thermometer reads 170°, basting occasionally with reserved marinade.
title: Herbed Lemon Chicken

steps: 1. Combine first 5 ingredients in a large zip-top plastic bag; add pork to bag. Seal and marinate in refrigerator 2 hours, turning bag once.
2. Preheat oven to 425°.

3. Remove pork from bag, reserving marinade. Place pork on the rack of a broiler pan or roasting pan coated with cooking spray; place rack in pan. Bake at 425° for 15 minutes. Sprinkle pork with sesame seeds; bake an additional 5 minutes or until a thermometer registers 160° (slightly pink). Place pork on a cutting board; let stand 10 minutes. Cut into (1/2-inch-thick) slices.
4. Pour reserved marinade into a small saucepan; bring to a boil. Cook until reduced to 1/3 cup (about 2 minutes); serve with pork.

title: Hoisin Pork Tenderloin

ingredients.text: 1/2 bunch green onion, sliced in 1-inch pieces

steps: 1. Cook noodles according to directions (mine were 3 mins). Drain and rinse under cool water. Combine noodles and sesame oil and set aside.
2. Combine oyster and soy sauce with sugar and pepper in small bowl and set aside.
3. Heat wok or large skillet and add oil. Add ginger and garlic and stir fry ten seconds. Add shrimp and stir fry until pink, about 1 minute. Add onions and sherry; stir fry 15 secs.
4. Add 1/2 of the bean sprouts and fry 15 secs, then add the rest of the sprouts and stir fry.
5. Add oyster sauce and noodles and stir fry until thoroughly heated, about 2 minutes.
title: Shrimp Lo Mein

ingredients.text: 4 chicken breast halves, cut into 1-inch pieces
1 c. snow peas, diced into large pieces

steps: 1. Mix 1 tablespoon oil, 4 teaspoons soy sauce and 2 teaspoons cornstarch in small bowl. Stir in chicken to coat.
2. Cover and refrigerate 30 minutes.
title: Stir-Fry Chicken

ingredients.text: 2 tablespoons soy sauce (I use light Kikoman)
1 garlic, clove finely minced or 1 teaspoon garlic powder
3 scallions, thinly sliced on an angle (green onions)

steps: 1. In a large skillet saute ground turkey.
2. Break up pieces with a wooden spoon.
3. Cook until no longer pink about 7-8 minutes.
4. Drain any fat.
5. Add tomato sauce, hoisin sauce, water, soy sauce, rice vinegar, garlic, ground ginger.
6. Stir to combine.
7. Simmer covered for 10 minutes.
8. Stir occassionally.
9. Divide mixture equally over 6 aplit roll bottoms.
10. Sprinkle with sliced scallions.
11. I sprinkle mine with some toasted sesame seeds.
title: Chinese Sloppy Joes

ingredients.text: 8 oz. beef sirloin steak, cut in strips

steps: 1. Heat oil in a medium skillet.
2. Cook and stir green pepper in oil until crisp-tender.
3. Remove and keep warm.
4. Add steak strips to skillet.
5. Cook and stir until brown.
6. Add browned steak strips to green pepper.
7. Keep warm.
8. Mix water and cornstarch together; set aside.
9. Stir broth, soy sauce, sherry, garlic and ginger into drippings in skillet.
10. Add cornstarch mixture.
11. Cook and stir until mixture is thick and bubbly.
12. Stir in green pepper and steak.
13. Serve over rice, if preferred.
title: Chinese Pepper Steak

steps: 1. Heat a pan of water a a frying pan with a little oil,.
2. Take the meat of the bones, dice the onion and pepper,.
3. When the water is boiling add the rice,.
4. Put the chicken,pepper and onion in the frying pan,.
5. Stir until Onion in browner, and chicken is starting to brown, add frozen peas,.
6. When peas are cooked take the frying pan off the heat,and cover with a lid or plate,.
7. When rice is cooked add the sauce's ( and a table spoon of chutney if you want) to the chicken and stir it all together,.
title: Simple Chicken Stirfry

steps: 1. Brown chicken in skillet coated with nonstick spray.
2. Remove chicken and set aside.
3. Combine water, soy sauce, ketchup, pepper, garlic, sugar, scallion and apple juice.
4. Add to pan and cook over medium heat 1 to 2 minutes.
5. Reduce to low, add chicken and cook, covered, until tender (20 to 25 minutes).
6. Remove chicken. Dissolve cornstarch in 1 tablespoon water, add to pan mixture and cook over medium heat until thick (3 to 4 minutes).
7. Pour sauce over chicken on platter.
8. Sprinkle with seed.
title: Chinese Sesame Chicken

steps: 1. Combine orange juice concentrate, soy sauce, ginger, garlic, sesame oil and chili flakes in a bowl.
2. Add chicken pieces (either cut or whole).
3. Marinate 4-6 hours minimum (you get more orange flavor the longer it marinates).
4. *For whole chicken pieces, it can be grilled on a BBQ or in a skillet.
5. *For cut chicken pieces, it works great as a stir-fry over rice. (NOTE: for cut/smaller pieces of chicken, marinate for for closer to 2-3 hours).
6. Sprinkle chicken with sesame seeds and orange zest, serve and enjoy.
title: Lori'S Low Calorie Orange Chicken

steps: 1. Place each chicken breast in the center of a 12-inch square piece of aluminum foil.
2. Fold sides of foil up so the lemon juice won't run out.
3. Halve the lemons and squeeze the juice of 1/2 lemon over each chicken breast, then sprinkle each with 1/4 teaspoon tarragon and black pepper.
4. (I also add 1/2 to 1 teaspoon of wine, poured over each piece of chicken.)
5. Fold foil together and seal well.
6. Bake wrapped chicken in shallow baking dish at 350° for 45 minutes.
7. Makes 4 servings.
title: Light And Easy Lemon Chicken

steps: 1. Toast the peppercorns in a pan, then crush them coarsely and mix with the salt. Rub the chicken with the peppercorn mixture, inside and out. Leave to stand for a few hours.

2. 2. Place a large sheet of foil in a roasting tin so the foil hangs well over the sides of the tin. Sprinkle the sugar and tea leaves over the foil, put a rack in the tin and place the chicken on it. Bring the foil up over the chicken and fold together to seal. Cook in a preheated moderately hot oven (190°C/375°F, Gas Mark 5) for 30 minutes.

3. 3. Unwrap the chicken and brush with the sesame seed oil. Return to the oven and roast, uncovered, for a further 5 to 10 minutes or until golden brown. Cut the chicken into serving pieces. Serve hot, garnished with Chinese parsley.
4. Note: If you prefer, the chicken can be boiled or steamed for 30 minutes or until tender then roasted for 15 minutes. Chicken breasts or legs can be used instead of a whole chicken.
title: Chicken Smoked Chinese Chicken

ingredients.text: 2 cans cream of chicken, mushroom or celery soup (whatever you like best)

steps: 1. Boil or cook chicken breasts in microwave until done.
2. Saute onions and celery in margarine for 5 minutes.
3. Add chicken broth, soy sauce and soup.
4. Simmer 2 minutes.
5. Add chicken.
6. Place rice in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch pan.
7. Pour mixture on top.
8. Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes.
9. Put cashews on top.
10. Bake 5 minutes more.
title: Cashew Chicken Casserole

steps: 1. Cook until vegetables are tender.
2. Serve over rice with chow mein noodles and soy sauce.
title: Beef Chow Mein

steps: 1. Prepare elbow macaroni according to package directions.
2. Brown ground beef; saute onion and pepper.
3. Mix all ingredients together and heat.
title: Grandma Eleanor'S American Chop Suey

steps: 1. Mix together ingredients and paint on the chicken.
2. Bake for one hour at 350 degrees; then 15 minutes at 400 degrees.
title: Orange Chicken

steps: 1. Arrange ribs in large roasting pan.
2. Combine remaining ingredients.
3. Pour over ribs.
4. Cover pan with foil.
5. Bake 45 minutes at 350°, turning ribs once or twice.
6. Transfer ribs to grill.
7. Reserve sauce.
8. Set grill as high above gray coals as possible.
9. Cook for 20 to 30 minutes or until meat is browned and tender, turning and basting frequently with sauce.
title: Chinese Barbecue Spareribs

ingredients.text: 1 pound boneless skinless chicken breasts, cut into 1/2-inch cubes
1/4 pound fresh snow pea pods, trimmed and cut in half

steps: 1. In a bowl, combine first six ingredients; toss with chicken. Refrigerate for 30 minutes. In a small bowl, combine the cornstarch, broth, oyster sauce and water until smooth. Set aside.

2. In a wok or large skillet, heat 2 tablespoons oil over medium-high. Add ginger, garlic and onions; stir-fry 1 minute. Add chicken and continue to stir-fry until the chicken is no longer pink. Remove chicken and vegetables from pan. Add remaining oil; stir-fry carrots 3 minutes or until crisp-tender. Add mushrooms and pea pods; stir-fry 1 minute. Return chicken and vegetables to pan. Stir broth mixture and pour into skillet, cook and stir until the sauce is thickened. Serve immediately.
title: Chicken Mushroom Stir-Fry

steps: 1. Season pork chops with salt and pepper.
2. Heat oil in nonstick skillet over medium high heat.
3. Add pork chops and saute until golden brown on both sides.
4. Stir together vinegar, orange juice, brown sugar and ginger.
5. Pour over pork chops in skillet.
6. Turn up heat and boil liquid for about 2 minutes or until about half the liquid is left in the pan.
7. Remove from heat and remove chops from skillet.
8. Add mandarin oranges to the sauce.
9. Spoon sauce over pork chops before serving.
title: Mandarin Orange Pork Chops

steps: 1. Cut pork into 1-inch thick strips.
2. Mix the last 4 ingredients and soak the pork in it.
3. Spread the pork in a baking pan and bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until done.
4. Baking pan should be dry and pork fat starting to come out.
title: Chinese Barbecue Pork

steps: 1. Cream together the margarine and sugar.
2. Add eggs and flour; mix well.
3. Add nuts and vanilla.
4. Bake in a 9 x 13 x 2-inch greased and floured pan at 325° for 45 minutes.
5. Sprinkle powdered sugar on top while hot.
6. When slightly cooled, cut into squares.
title: Chinese Chews

ingredients.text: 1 pound uncooked medium shrimp, peeled and deveined
1 cup frozen stir-fry vegetable blend, thawed

steps: 1. In a small bowl, combine cornstarch and water until smooth. Stir in the soy sauce, garlic powder and ginger; set aside.
2. In a

3. or wok, stir-fry broccoli in oil for 2 minutes. Add red pepper and onions; stir-fry for 2-3 minutes or until vegetables are crisp-tender. Add the shrimp, Oriental vegetables and garlic; cook 3 minutes longer.
4. Stir cornstarch mixture and stir into shrimp mixture. Add the peanuts. Bring to a boil; cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened.
title: Easy Shrimp Stir Fry

ingredients.text: 4 -5 lbs pork spareribs, cut into individual pieces

steps: 1. Have your butcher cut the rack of ribs the long way down the middle, then you can cut them between the bones into small pieces.
2. Place the ribs into a shallow baking pan in a somewhat single fashion.
3. Combine the water, brown sugar, soy sauce, garlic and dry mustard into a small saucepan.
4. Heat the sauce until the brown sugar is dissolved and the mustard isn't floating on the surface.
5. Pour the sauce over the ribs in the shallow pan.
6. Cover with aluminum foil and bake at 350* for about an hour.
7. Remove the foil and stir the meat.
8. Allow to cook 45 minutes more or longer, stirring every 20 minutes so the sugars don't burn, until the meat is very tender.
9. We love this served over rice, but can be used just as is on the plate!
title: Dry Garlic Ribs-Canadian Chinese Style

ingredients.text: 12 ounces chicken breast tenders, cut in thirds
1/4 cup fresh lemon juice (start with 2 Tbsp, mix, taste and add more if you wish)
1/4 cup red bell pepper, sliced into 2-inch strips
1/4 cup green bell pepper, sliced into 2-inch strips

steps: 1. Mix 1 teaspoons cornstarch and 1 tablespoons soy sauce in a small bowl. Add sliced chicken tenders. Place in refrigerator and marinate for 10 minutes.
2. Stir the lemon juice, 1/4 cup soy sauce, chicken broth, ginger, garlic, Splenda and 1 teaspoons cornstarch together in a medium sized mixing bowl.

3. Heat oil in a medium size frying pan. Add chicken and cook over med. high heat for 3-4 minutes or until just done. Add sauce and sliced peppers. Cook 1-2 minutes more or until sauce thickens and peppers are slightly tender.
4. Serve with rice or Asian noodles.
title: Diabetic Asian Lemon Chicken

ingredients.text: 2 cups broccoli florets, steamed and drained

steps: 1. Heat 2 tbs. oil in wok or skillet over high heat. Add onions and cook until tender. Add garlic and ginger and cook until onions are golden brown. Add chicken and celery and cook until chicken is cooked through, about 5 minutes. Transfer to platter.

2. Add remaining oil. Add flour and stir until turning brown. Mix in broth, soy,and mustard. Boil until thickened. Add in chicken and broccoli, turning to coat. Mix in cashews and cook until heated through.
3. Transfer to platter and serve with rice.
title: Chinese Restaurant Ginger Cashew Chicken

steps: 1. Rinse and cut chicken into bite sized pieces. Rinse and cut snow peas into 1 inch long pieces. Heat a nonstick skillet to medium high and add the chicken; stir fry about 2 minutes and then add snow peas and teriyaki sauce. Stir fry for about 2 to 3 more minutes until chicken is cooked through.
title: Chicken And Snow Peas Stir-Fry

steps: 1. Break the eggs into the bowl. Removing the egg white clinging to the yolk will make for a smoother and more uniform surface.
2. Add the sake, sugar, and salt.
3. Beat the mixture to produce a smooth, consistent texture, but not so much as to create a foam. If you accidentally get air bubbles, let the bowl sit for a few minutes while they pop.
4. Dissolve the cornstarch in the water—it will be closer to a paste than a fluid—and then add it to the egg mix.
5. Heat the pan over medium heat. If you are not using a non-stick pan, you will need to oil the surface.
6. Pour 3–4 tablespoons (40–50 ml) of the egg mixture all at once onto the pan.
7. Swirl the pan to spread the mixture thinly and evenly.
8. Allow the mixture to cook until the edges start to dry out. Remove the pan from the heat, and let the egg mixture continue to cook for 30 seconds from the heat in the pan.
9. Flip the omelet over and return the pan to the heat for 30 seconds.
10. Remove the omelet from the pan, and allow it to cool. You can store these omelets in the refrigerator for a few days.
11. Shape the sushi rice into oblong shapes.
12. Place a piece of sushi rice in the center of one of the egg wrappers.
13. Fold the edges of the wrapper over to enclose the rice.
title: Inarizushi (Stuffed Sushi)

steps: 1. Heat the oil in a pan, fry the sliced onion until golden brown, then add the tonkatsu (see recipe here), placing it in the middle of the pan. Mix the dashi, soy, mirin and sugar together and tip three-quarters of the mixture around the tonkatsu. Sizzle for a couple of mins so the sauce thickens a little and the tonkatsu reheats.

2. Tip the beaten eggs around the tonkatsu and cook for 2-3 mins until the egg is cooked through but still a little runny. Divide the rice between two bowls, then top each with half the egg and tonkatsu mix, sprinkle over the chives and serve immediately, drizzling with a little more soy if you want an extra umami kick.
title: Japanese Katsudon

steps: 1. Combine soy sauce, sherry, garlic powder, ginger and honey. Stir together.
2. Put ingredients in a Ziploc bag along with the steak.
3. Marinate 4 hours or overnight.
4. Place steak on broiler or barbecue grill.
5. Baste often with remaining marinade sauce.
6. You can reserve remaining marinade sauce for another meal.
7. Serves 4.
title: Teriyaki Steak

steps: 1. Combine first 7 ingredients for marinade.
2. Marinate chicken overnight.
3. Preheat gas grill.
4. Cook chicken with cover down on medium setting 20 minutes, turning once.
5. Saute mushrooms and onion in margarine and soy sauce until tender in skillet over medium flame.
6. Spoon sauteed mushrooms and onion over each chicken breast; top with cheese slices.
7. Cook with cover down 5 additional minutes or until cheese is melted.
8. Makes 4 servings.
title: Smothered Teriyaki Chicken

steps: 1. Place steaks in shallow pan.
2. Mix remaining ingredients, except butter.
3. Pour over salmon.
4. Let stand 20 minutes, turning occasionally.
5. Remove steaks from marinade.
6. Brush both sides with melted butter and broil 5 to 7 minutes on each side or until browned and easily flaked.
7. Serves 4.
title: Salmon Steaks Teriyaki

steps: 1. Combine teriyaki sauce, brown sugar, green onion and lemon juice.
2. Marinate pork chops in mixture.
3. Set in refrigerator 1 to 2 hours.
4. Place chops in broiler pan.
5. Broil 6 minutes on each side.
6. Serves 4.
title: Teriyaki Pork Chops

steps: 1. Stir first 4 ingredients in bowl; set aside.
2. Heat oil in nonstick skillet over medium-high heat.
3. Sprinkle chicken with pepper.
4. Cook for 4 to 5 minutes per side.
5. Transfer to platter; keep warm.
6. Add green onions, ginger and garlic to skillet.
7. Cook 1 minute.
8. Add soy mixture and cook one minute more.
9. Pour over chicken.
10. Makes 4 servings.
title: Chicken Teriyaki

steps: 1. Heat the oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.
2. Stir in the snow peas and the mushrooms and cook until they are tender, about 4 minutes or so.
3. Place the cooked veggies in a serving bowl and pour over the teriyaki sauce and toss to distribute the sauce evenly and serve warm.
title: Teriyaki Snow Peas And Mushrooms

ingredients.text: 1 pound(s) uncooked boneless, skinless chicken breast
1 medium scallion(s), finely chopped (green part only)
16 piece(s) lettuce, use tender, inner Romaine leaves

steps: 1. Instructions

2. * Combine ginger, garlic and broth in a large skillet; bring to a simmer. Add chicken in one layer; return to a simmer. Cover and simmer, turning chicken over after 15 minutes, until chicken is cooked through, about 30 minutes. Remove from heat and let chicken sit in broth for 5 minutes.
3. * Reserve 3 tablespoons of cooked broth; discard remainder. Cut chicken into bite-size pieces and place in a medium bowl; add celery, red pepper and scallion.
4. * In a cup, combine teriyaki sauce, reserved broth and black pepper; stir well. Pour over chicken mixture and toss to combine.
5. * To serve, arrange 4 lettuce leaves on each of 4 plates. Spoon 1/4 cup of chicken mixture into each leaf. Pick up each leaf and eat with your hands. Yields 4 filled leaves per serving.
title: Ginger-Teriyaki Chicken

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 lbs boneless sirloin steaks, cut into 1 1/4 inch cubes
1 large green pepper, cut into pieces

steps: 1. In a bowl, combine soy sauce, oil, brown sugar, garlic, ginger and salt; mix well. Pour half of the marinade into a large resealable plastic bag; add beef and turn to coat. Seal; refrigerate for 4-8 hours, turning occasionally. Cover and refrigerate remaining marinade.
2. Drain meat, discarding marinade. On metal or soaked wooden skewers, alternate meat, mushrooms, green pepper, onion and tomatoes.
3. Grill, uncovered, over medium heat for 3 minutes on each side. Baste with reserved marinade. Continue turning and basting for 8-10 minutes or until meat reaches desired doneness.
title: Teriyaki Kabobs

ingredients.text: 1 teaspoon fresh ginger, grated (I buy a nub, peel it, freeze it, then grind it when needed using a cheese grater)
1 cup teriyaki sauce (I *highly* recommend Soy Vay brand)

steps: 1. Cut chicken thighs into bite size pieces.
2. Saute garlic and chicken on medium (med-high depending on your stove) in olive oil until chicken is golden and cooked through.
3. Add teriyaki and ginger, heat about 5 minutes.
4. Add mango, heat until just warm-about 2 minutes.
5. Enjoy over rice or as is.
title: Mango Teriyaki Chicken

steps: 1. Place eggs in a large saucepan and cover with cold water. Bring to a boil; remove from heat, cover, and let sit until eggs are cooked through, about 10 minutes. Drain hot water; cover eggs with cold water.
2. Peel eggs and place in a quart-size Mason jar.

3. Combine soy sauce, water, sugar, minced onion, and sesame oil in a saucepan over medium heat. Cook and stir until sugar is dissolved, 3 to 5 minutes. Cool briefly, about 5 minutes. Pour over eggs in the jar.
4. Refrigerate eggs until flavors are absorbed, at least 6 hours.
title: Teriyaki Eggs

steps: 1. Melt margarine.
2. Mix with teriyaki sauce and garlic powder. Pour over catfish and let marinate for at least 30 minutes.
3. Grill until tender.
title: Teriyaki Catfish

steps: 1. Mix dry ingredients.
2. Add eggs.
3. Add water to make a batter of medium thick consistency.
4. Good for fish and vegetables.
title: Tempura Batter

steps: 1. Whisk the ingredients together and add the prepared veggies or shrimp into the bowl.
2. Fold to coat evenly.
3. Carefully drop individual pieces into hot oil of choice.
4. Fry until lightly browned.
5. Remove from oil with slotted utensil to paper towels.
6. Season to taste.
title: Favorite Tempura Batter

ingredients.text: 2 whole chicken breasts, skinned and boned

steps: 1. Cut boned chicken into 1-inch lengths.
2. Slice green onions into 1-inch lengths.
3. Alternate chicken and green onions onto bamboo skewers.
4. Mix remaining ingredients and pour over chicken/onion skewers.
5. Marinate for 30 to 45 minutes.
6. Arrange 8 to 10 skewers on round glass plate or shallow baking dish for 3 to 4 minutes on High.
7. Microwave remaining skewers as needed.
title: Yakitori(Microwave)

steps: 1. Mix together.
2. Cut up a 3 to 4 pound beef roast into 1 1/2-inch cubes.
3. Pour teriyaki sauce over meat.
4. Cover and marinate overnight in refrigerator.
5. Cook on grill.
title: Teriyaki

steps: 1. Cut chicken into 1-inch pieces.
2. Coat skillet with cooking spray.
3. Add chicken pieces and cook thoroughly.
4. Add teriyaki sauce, onions, and peppers.
5. Cover and cook on low-medium 5-10 minutes.
6. Mix cornstarch with a little water, and stir thoroughly. Add to chicken in skillet, and simmer on medium 10 minutes, or until sauce is thickened.
7. Serve over cooked white rice.
title: Teriyaki Chicken

ingredients.text: 2 whole boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut into 1-inch pieces

steps: 1. Combine teriyaki sauce and sugar in a small bowl.
2. Stir in chicken and marinate for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. Remove chicken; reserve 2 tablespoons marinade.
3. Combine reserved marinade, water and cornstarch in a small bowl; set aside.
title: Bits O' Teriyaki Chicken

steps: 1. Prepare Creamy Grits; cover and keep warm.
2. Cook bacon in a large skillet over medium-high heat 9 minutes or until crisp; remove bacon, and drain on paper towels, reserving drippings in skillet. Crumble bacon, and set aside.

3. Sprinkle scallops with 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1/8 teaspoon pepper. Heat drippings over medium-high heat until hot. Add scallops, in 2 batches, and cook 3 minutes. Turn and cook 3 minutes. Remove scallops.

4. Add butter to pan. Add onion and garlic; saute, stirring often, 2 minutes. Stir in bell pepper and edamame; cook 2 minutes or until crisp-tender. Add wine, and cook 30 seconds, stirring to loosen particles from bottom of skillet. Add bacon, remaining 1/4 teaspoon salt and 1/8 teaspoon pepper, and tomatoes; cook, stirring constantly, 5 minutes or until tomatoes soften. Return scallops to pan; cook 1 minute or just until thoroughly heated. Remove from heat, and stir in basil. Serve over Creamy Grits.
5. Note: Stir the grits just before serving, adding a small amount of hot chicken broth or water if necessary to achieve desired consistency.
title: Scallop Skillet With Bacon, Edamame, Basil, And Creamy Grits

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 450°.
2. Combine the first 6 ingredients in an 8-inch square baking dish; stir with a whisk to combine.
3. Add fish to baking dish; spoon sauce over fish.
4. Bake at 450° for 15 minutes or until fish flakes easily with a fork, basting occasionally with sauce.
title: Orange Teriyaki Salmon

steps: 1. Crack the eggs into a bowl
2. Mix in sugar, salt, and milk
3. Stir until smooth
4. Pour the liquid into a square frying pan (for making tamagoyaki) until the surface is covered
5. When no longer liquid, use a spatula to roll the egg from one edge of the frying pan to the other
6. Add more liquid
7. Roll the egg roll created in the previous step over the newly added egg to make a larger roll (much like making a large snowball)
8. When all liquid is gone, you're done
title: Western Style Tamagoyaki (卵焼き)

ingredients.text: 1 cup water, COLD (its very important that it's cold!)
1 medium eggplant, peeled and sliced in disks (about 8 pieces)
1 zucchini, peeled and sliced in disks (about 8 pieces)
1 sweet potato, peeled and sliced into disks (about 8)

steps: 1. Mix the salt, flour, and water together until smooth and no lumps. (Use cold because it helps the batter/veggies absorb less oil).
2. Place in freezer.
3. Prepare vegetables by peeling and slicing.
4. Pour the oil into a pan and heat over medium heat.
5. When oil is hot, dip veggies in batter then oil.
6. Fry until lightly browned.
7. Do small amounts at a time. It will be less messy and much easier to manage.
title: Vegetable Tempura

steps: 1. In lg plastic bag, mix first 6 ingredients.
2. Add steak, turn to coat, and refrigerate for 8 hours or overnight.
3. Drain and discard marinade.
4. Grill, covered, over med heat for 5-8 minutes on each side to desired doneness.
title: Grilled Teriyaki Sirloin

steps: 1. Rub ginger and salt into thighs and let sit & marinade for 30 minutes.
2. After marinating, use paper towel to dry chicken, remove as much ginger pulp as possible.
3. Heat oil in frying pan over medium heat. Add chicken and fry until golden brown on one side.
4. Flip and add 3 T. sake and cover pan with lid.
5. Steam chicken until just cooked (4-6 min).
6. Prepare the teriyaki sauce- Mix honey, mirin, sake, and soy sauce- stir to combine.
7. Remove lid and drain remaining lid and oil. Use paper towel to dry the pan.
8. Turn heat up to high and add terikayi sauce. Let boil while you repeatedly flip chicken to coat evenly. It will be done when most liquid evaporates. It should have a thick glaze.
9. Pour glaze over chicken. Serve with white rice.
title: Pan-Fried Chicken Teriyaki-Yaki

steps: 1. Mix all in bowl.
2. Add to skillet with a little oil; cook about 30 minutes on medium heat, turning chicken a couple of times. Serve on cooked rice bed.
title: Teriyaki Chicken

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients together and mix through cooked rice.
title: Sushi Vinegar Mixture

steps: 1. Rinse chicken and pat dry, and place wingettes on broiler pan.
2. Broil 10 minutes on each side.
3. Transfer wingettes to large slow cooker.
4. Combine remaining ingredients in a large bowl, and spoon over wingettes.
5. Cook on high for 2 hours, stirring once during cooking to coat chicken evenly with sauce.
title: Teriyaki Wingettes

steps: 1. In a large bowl, mix together the ginger, soy sauce, sake and mirin. Add the sliced pork, cover, and marinate for about 1 hour.

2. Heat the oil in a skillet or wok over high heat. Add the pork, and fry until brown. The pork should have a dark crispy look to it. Do not cook on low or medium heat, as the juices will not cook fast enough to get a crispy texture. Discard leftover marinade.
title: Japanese Ginger Pork

steps: 1. Blend 1 yolk and 1 cup beer.
2. Stir in 1 cup of flour.
3. Place 1 cup flour in another bowl.
4. Dip food to be fried in liquid mixture, roll in flour and deep fry.
5. When needed, make a new batch of mixture with remaining ingredients.
title: Tempura Batter

ingredients.text: 3 green onions, chopped, white and dark green parts separated
1 teaspoon vegetable oil, or as needed

steps: 1. Whisk soy sauce, sake, mirin, brown sugar, white parts of green onions, and ginger together in a saucepan; bring to a simmer and cook until sugar dissolves and marinade flavors combine, about 5 minutes. Pour marinade into a bowl and cool to room temperature.
2. Pour 1/2 the marinade into a resealable plastic bag. Add chicken thighs, coat with the marinade, squeeze out excess air, and seal the bag. Marinate in the refrigerator, 30 minutes to 1 hour.
3. Set oven rack about 6 inches from the heat source and preheat the oven's broiler. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil and grease with vegetable oil.
4. Arrange chicken thighs on prepared baking sheet. Discard excess marinade.

5. Broil chicken in the preheated oven for 5 minutes. Flip thighs and broil for 5 minutes more. Flip thighs again and brush each thigh with reserved marinade. Continue to broil, brushing with reserved marinade every 1 to 2 minutes, until cooked through, about 12 minutes. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 165 degrees F (74 degrees C). Garnish with dark green parts of green onions.
title: Chef John'S Chicken Teriyaki

steps: 1. Trim fat from steak and slice lengthwise into 1/2 inch strips; place in a large glass bowl.
2. Combine all remaining ingredients; pour over meat and toss gently.
3. Cover and refrigerate at least 2-3 hours or overnight.
4. Drain and discard marinade.
5. Loosely thread meat strips onto skewers.
6. Grill over medium-hot coals, turning often, for 7-10 minutes or until meat reaches desired doneness.
7. Remove from skewers and serve.	These are great with a salad & baked potato, but my kids make a meal out of them by themselves because they are so good and tender.
title: Teriyaki Finger Steaks

steps: 1. Trim excess fat from thigh. Marinate in the mirin, soy sauce and sugar for 30 minutes.
2. Drain, reserving the marinade and pat dry.
3. Cook the chicken in the oil, skin side down. Brown and then cook the other side.
4. Add 3 tablespoons water to the reserved marinade and pour over the chicken. Cover and simmer until cooked through.
5. Remove the cover, raise the heat and reduce the sauce to a glaze.
6. Blanch the asparagus in salted water.
7. Toss the chicken and asparagus in the glaze.
title: Chicken Thighs Teriyaki

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients together. Put roast in crock-pot and pour mixture over it. Cook on low 6 to 8 hours.
title: Crock-Pot Teriyaki Pork

steps: 1. Mix until all is combined good.
2. Do not overbeat.
3. Keep batter cold.
4. (Can set bowl in a large bowl with ice to keep batter cold.)
title: Tempura Batter

steps: 1. In a small bowl, whisk the teriyaki sauce, oil and brown sugar. Pour 1/2 cup marinade into a large resealable plastic bag; add the pork, ginger and pepper. Seal bag and turn to coat; refrigerate for 4 hours. Cover and refrigerate remaining marinade.
2. Drain and discard marinade. Moisten a paper towel with cooking oil; using long-handled tongs, lightly coat the grill rack.

3. Prepare grill for indirect heat, using a drip pan. Place pork over drip pan and grill pork, covered, over indirect medium-hot heat for 20-27 minutes or until a thermometer reads 145°. Let stand for 10 minutes before slicing. Serve with reserved marinade.
title: Teriyaki & Ginger Pork Tenderloins

ingredients.text: 500 g beef (Scotch fillet is the best)

steps: 1. Cut the beef in strips and cut the veges in pieces.
2. Fry beef with butter then add veges and fry till they are cooked.
3. Add brown sugar and soy sauce and simmer for 2-3 minutes.
4. Sprinkle on sesame seeds!
5. You can use any kind of your favorite vegetables.
6. Serve it with rice or Udon noodles.
title: Easy Sukiyaki Style Beef Stir Fry

title: The Best Teriyaki Recipe Ever!

4. Dip each avocado piece into the batter and fry until golden, approximately 1 minute.
5. Remove the fried avocado pieces and season.
title: Tempura Avocado.

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
2. In a small bowl, combine the ketchup, brown sugar, vinegar, teriyaki sauce and mustard.
3. Spray and 8X8 inch baking dish with non-stick cooking spray.
4. Place 1/2 of the sauce into the bottom of the baking dish. Place the chicken breasts on top of the sauce and cover the chicken with the remaining sauce.
