steps: 1. Spread the tomato paste on the pita bread. Shred the mozarella and the ham. Add the cheese on the bread and then the ham. Put into the oven until the cheese has melted. And enjoy!
title: Mega Easy Pita Pizza

steps: 1. Mix flour, baking powder, salt, and 1/2 of RawSpiceBar's Sumac Za'atar.
2. Slowly pour in the olive oil, mixing while pouring. Add the warm water and mix again until the dough comes together into a ball.
3. Knead dough continuously for 5-10 minutes. Add flour to coat as you go along and continuously fold the dough in half from either side; the dough will be firm and this is normal.
4. Once kneaded, allow to rest for 10-15 minutes.
5. Transfer the risen dough onto a floured surface. Punch to allow accumulated air to escape.
6. Divide the dough into 10 pieces, forming each into a ball.
7. Using the heels of your hands, flatten the balls from either side. Use your thumb and index finger to fully flatten and stretch the dough into a 6" diameter.
8. Turn the grill or cast iron pan, if you have one, to medium high heat. Brush with oil.
9. Add the flatbreads a few at a time, allowing space between each. Leave for 2-3 minutes until golden brown and slightly puffy on either side.

10. Sprinkle finished flatbreads with remaining 1/2 of RawSpiceBar's Sumac Za'atar packet or add spices to olive oil and dip flatbreads in as you eat. Serve as soon as they are ready- these flatbreads are best right out of the pan. Dip them in the broth of your posole, roll them up with chunks of veggies or meat or dip and, most importantly, be creative- enjoy!
title: Navajo Flatbreads With Sumac Za’Atar

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°.
2. Cream margarine and sugar until light.
3. Add eggs, one at a time, beating thoroughly after each.
4. Add sifted dry ingredients alternately with milk, beating until smooth.
5. Add vanilla, raisins and nuts. Pour 3/4 of batter into a 10-inch tube pan lined on bottom with waxed paper.
6. Mix remaining batter with cocoa and cinnamon and spoon onto batter in pan. Run a knife through batter to marbleize.
7. Bake at 350° about 1 hour and 15 minutes.
8. Let stand in pan 5 minutes, then turn out on rack; peel off paper. Cool and sprinkle with powdered sugar.
title: Moroccan Pound Cake

steps: 1. Peel and quarter potatoes, boil until tender.
2. while potatoes are boiling, brown ground meat until no longer pink.
3. Add onion, seasonings, beef broth and worcestershire;simmer over low heat for 10 minutes or until onions are crisp tender.
4. Remove meat from heat and stir in frozen vegetables. Set aside.
5. Mash potatoes in bowl with butter, add milk to taste.
6. Place beef & veg in 9x11 casserole dish. Top with shredded cheddar.
7. Spread mashed potatoes on top. Use a fork to make peaks in the potatoes if you wish.
8. Bake uncovered in 400 degree F oven until bubbling and brown. (about 40 minutes).
title: Shawarma Spiced Shepherds Cottage Pie

ingredients.text: 1 lb boneless skinless chicken breast, cut into 1-inch pieces
2 cups pineapple chunks (about 1/2 cored, peeled pineapple)
1 red bell pepper, cut into chunks
3 tablespoons frozen orange juice concentrate, thawed

steps: 1. Soak wooden skewers in water for 30 minutes; drain.
2. Preheat grill to medium-high heat.
3. Using 8 long wooden skewers, (two, side by side, for each kabob) thread chicken alternately with peppers and pineapple onto skewers, to create 4 kabobs.
4. Mix barbecue sauce and juice; brush on kabobs.
5. Grill kabobs 8 to 10 minutes or until chicken is cooked through, brushing occasionally with remaining sauce.
title: Sweet Bbq Chicken Kabobs

steps: 1. Preheat the oven to 350°. Spread the nuts on a baking sheet and bake for 12 minutes, until the skins are blistered; let cool. Leave the oven on. Transfer the nuts to a kitchen towel and rub off the skins, then transfer to a food processor and pulse until coarsely chopped.
2. Add the chocolate, 2/3 cup of the sugar and the cinnamon to the food processor and pulse until the chocolate and nuts are finely chopped and the same size.

3. Unwrap the phyllo and cover with a sheet of plastic wrap. Generously butter a 9-by-13-inch metal baking pan. Butter and stack 8 sheets of phyllo. Trim the edges. Ease the stack into the pan. Sprinkle about 2 cups of the filling over the phyllo. Butter and stack 2 more phyllo sheets; fold them in half crosswise and place over the filling. Sprinkle on another 2 cups of the filling. Top with 2 more buttered, folded sheets and 2 cups of filling. Butter and stack 3 more phyllo sheets, fold them in half and place over the filling. Fold in the overhanging phyllo on top and brush generously with butter. Using a ruler and a sharp knife, cut the baklava (through the top and bottom) into 3-inch squares (there will be a bit left on one long side). Cut each square in half to make triangles.
4. Bake the baklava for 25 minutes, then lower the oven temperature to 300° and bake for 50 minutes longer, until golden.

5. In a saucepan, bring the water, honey and the remaining 2 cups of sugar to a boil. Simmer over moderate heat for 10 minutes. Immediately ladle the hot syrup over the hot baklava and let stand until completely cool, at least 4 hours and preferably overnight.
title: Chocolate-Hazelnut Baklava

steps: 1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease and flour a 9 inch square baking dish.

2. In a medium bowl, stir together the flour, 3/4 cup of sugar, baking powder, salt, cinnamon and cloves. Cut in the shortening until it is in very small pieces, then mix in the milk and egg using an electric mixer on low speed. Mix for about 1 minute, scraping the bottom of the bowl at least once to avoid lumps. Stir in walnuts by hand. Pour into the prepared pan, and spread evenly.
3. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes in the preheated oven, until a knife inserted into the center of the cake comes out clean. Cool cake in the pan for about 30 minutes while you prepare the honey syrup.
4. In a saucepan, stir together 1/4 cup of sugar and the water. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, and simmer for about 5 minutes. Stir in the honey and lemon juice, and remove from heat.
5. Make slashes in the top of the cake in a diamond pattern using a knife. Pour the hot syrup over the top of the cake.
title: Karithopita

steps: 1. Place chicken in greased crock pot.
2. Top the chicken with onions, lemon pepper and oregano.
3. Cook on low for 6-8 hours.
4. 10 minutes before serving, remove the chicken and shred it with two forks.
5. It should just fall apart.
6. Put the shredded meat back into the pot.
7. Stir in the yogurt.
8. To make the sandwich, split open your pita bread and spoon the chicken inside.
9. This would be wonderful with some sliced tomatoes and cucumbers and some hummus on the side.
10. Enjoy!
title: Greek Chicken Pita Pockets - Crock Pot!

steps: 1. Add all ingredients in the order suggested by your bread machine manual and process on the dough cycle according to the manufacturers instructions.
2. Preheat the oven to 500 degrees.
3. At the end of the dough cycle divide the dough into 8 equal pieces.
4. On a floured board with floured fingers, press each piece into a circle.
5. Use a floured rolling pin to roll each into a very think 6 inch circle. Do not roll more than absolutely necessary, or they will not puff up.
6. Place on non stick baking sheets.
7. DO NOT LET RISE.
8. Immediately bake until each pita puffs up and browns, about 12 to 15 minutes.
9. Preparation time will depend on the length of your dough cycle in your bread machine, plus rolling time.
10. Turn over half way through cooking, to get a bit of colour on both sides.
title: Herbed Pita Bread - No Fat No Sugar

steps: 1. Combine ground beef with 1/2 of the minced garlic and 1 tablespoon chopped onion in a large bowl. Mix with your hands until fully incorporated. Shape meat mixture into 1 1/2-inch oblong patties; you should have 12 to 14 meatballs.

2. Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Brown patties in batches in the hot skillet until crispy on both sides and no longer pink in the center, about 10 minutes. Set meatballs aside in a rimmed serving dish.

3. Reduce heat to medium and stir remaining chopped onion into drippings in the skillet. Season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring constantly, until onion has softened and turned translucent, about 5 minutes. Stir in remaining garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Stir in Roma tomatoes, dried parsley, and ras el hanout. Pour in water. Cook until tomatoes are soft, about 5 minutes.
4. Pour tomato sauce over meatballs to serve.
title: Algerian Kefta (Meatballs)

steps: 1. Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. In a roasting tin, toss together the chicken, cumin, paprika, 1 tbsp olive oil and seasoning. Cook for 40 mins until the chicken is crisp and cooked through.

2. Meanwhile, tear up 1 pitta bread and place in a small bowl. Pour over a couple of tbsp chicken stock and leave to soak. Dry-fry the walnuts in a frying pan for about 3 mins until golden and toasted. Set aside. Heat the remaining oil in the pan and cook the onion and garlic until softened. Place the softened pitta bread, onion mixture and most of the nuts into a blender. Pour over the rest of the chicken stock and whizz together until a rough paste forms. Return the mixture to the pan. Add the cream and lemon juice, season and keep warm.

3. When the chicken is cooked, arrange on a platter. Stir the coriander through the sauce and spoon into a bowl. Roughly chop the remaining walnuts and scatter over the chicken. Toast the pittas, cut into wedges and serve alongside
title: Roasted chicken with creamy walnut sauce

steps: 1. Trim stem from eggplant.
2. Bake at 400° until flesh is soft and skins begin to crisp.
3. Cool for 15 minutes.
4. Split eggplant open and scoop out the flesh.
5. (Scrape the flesh without tearing the skin; this enhances the smoky flavor of the dip.)
6. Mash the flesh until relatively smooth.
title: Baba Ghannouj(Appetizer)

steps: 1. Peel onions. Wash cucumbers. Combine salt and water. Slice onions (optional bell pepper) and cucumbers with peel into 1/4-inch slices. Soak for 1 hour in the salt and water solution. Ice can be added to ensure crispness. Boil together the remaining ingredients. Remove onions and cucumbers from water mixture. Drain and add to the vinegar mixture. Bring just to a boil, about 10 minutes or until tender (do not overcook). Pack slices and liquid into hot, thoroughly cleaned jars. Let stand a couple of days before eating.
title: Appetizer Shrimp Kabobs

steps: 1. Mix in a bowl.
2. Add meat; toss to coat.
3. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour or less, depends on quantity of meat you are marinating.
4. Grill.
title: Marinade(For 16 To 20 Chops, Beef Or Chicken Or Kabobs)

steps: 1. Mix together and marinate beef or venison 8 hours or overnight.
title: Shish Kabob Marinade

steps: 1. Combine lemon juice, mint and ginger in a large bowl
2. Pour 4 cups of boiling water over mixture and stir well. Let steep for 30 minutes. Meanwhile...
3. Pour the other two cups of water over sugar in another bowl to form a syrup. Mix well to assure that the sugar dissolves completely.
4. Cool syrup to room temperature, approximately 30 minutes.
5. Strain the mint-lemon-ginger mixture in a fine mesh sieve.
6. Add the sugar syrup to the strained liquid and add 3-4 cups of water depending on how strong/tart you want the lemonade to taste.
7. Refrigerate until chilled, at least 1 hour.
8. Add ice cubes to a pitcher and pour lemonade on top.
9. Serve, preferably with a sprig of mint in each glass.
title: Turkish Mint Lemonade

steps: 1. Combine well and store in jar.
2. Use to season rice, lentils, meats, etc.
title: Middle Eastern Spice Mix

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients in one bowl.
2. Mix until it's the correct consistency using hand or bowl mixer.
3. Add water one tablespoon at a time if the consistency is too dry.
4. Store in a sealed container in refrigerator for up to two days.
title: Spicy Three Pepper Hummus

steps: 1. Throw all your ingredients into a blender, and puree until smooth.
2. If you prefer things a little more acidic (such as I), add a touch more orange juice.
3. Close your eyes, feel the sun, smell the spiced air, hear the Arabic bartering, and drink.
4. Perfect hearty breakfast, or as a mid-morning/mid-afternoon snack (as a half portion).
title: Green Moroccan Smoothie

ingredients.text: 10 uncooked jumbo shrimp, peeled and deveined (8-10 ounces)

steps: 1. In a large bowl, whisk the first seven ingredients until blended. Reserve 1/4 cup marinade for basting. Add shrimp to remaining marinade; toss to coat. Refrigerate, covered, 30 minutes.

2. On each of 10 metal or soaked wooden appetizer skewers, alternately thread one shrimp, one pineapple chunk and an onion chunk. Grill, covered, over medium heat or broil 4 in. from heat 4-6 minutes or until shrimp turn pink, turning occasionally and basting with reserved marinade during the last 2 minutes.
title: Grilled Shrimp Appetizer Kabobs

steps: 1. Split the eggplant lengthwise; brush them with 1 T of the olive oil. Place the eggplant cut-side down on a sheetpan and roast at 450°F for 20-30 minutes or until the eggplant is very soft. Allow the eggplant to cool to room temperature.
2. When they are at room temperature scoop out the flesh of the eggplant with a spoon and discard the skins. Place the flesh of the eggplant in a colander to drain for about 20 minutes.

3. Place the drained eggplant in a food processor along with the lemon juice, tahini, garlic, salt, cayenne pepper, ground cumin and the remaining tablespoon of olive oil. Puree until the mixture is smooth and thick. Refrigerate at least 1 hour before serving.
title: Baba Ghanouj (Roast Eggplant Puree)

steps: 1. Place everything in food processor until smooth.
title: Sunflower Seed Hummus

steps: 1. Combine the garbanzo beans, spinach, olive oil, lemon juice and tahini in a large food processor. Pulse until combined. Add the feta, red pepper flakes, garlic and salt. Pulse until combined. Taste and add salt or more red pepper flakes if desired.
title: Spinach And Feta Hummus

steps: 1. Bring stock and 1/2 teaspoon salt to a boil in a medium saucepan. Remove pan from heat, and stir in couscous; cover and let stand 5 minutes. Fluff with a fork; cover and keep warm.
2. Melt butter in a small skillet over medium heat; cook 3 minutes or until browned and fragrant. Add butter, next 4 ingredients, and remaining 1/4 teaspoon salt to couscous; toss well to combine.
title: Herbed Browned Butter Couscous

steps: 1. In a mortar (or food processor), crush garlic and salt together.
2. Transfer to a medium mixing bowl and add chickpeas, lemon juice, tomatoes, parsley and cayenne.
3. Toss well to mix.
4. Taste for balance of flavors, adding more lemon juice, parsley or cayenne to taste.
5. Put hummus in serving bowl and and drizzle with the olive oil.
6. Serve room temperature or chilled.
title: Whole Grain Hummus

ingredients.text: 2 tsp cumin seeds, toasted and ground

steps: 1. Peel and chop carrots into 1" chunks. Toss with 2 tsp olive oil and generous sprinkling of salt. Place in preheated 425F oven, roast for 25 minutes, until just tender and starting to brown. Transfer to pot and add water to cover. Bring to boil and cook until carrots are fully tender and falling apart. Drain and reserve water.

2. Mix garlic, paprika, cumin and 2 T parsley. Heat a small pan over medium heat. Add 2 T olive oil and cover bottom of pan before adding spice mixture. Fry for a few seconds, until fragrant. Add 1/4 cup reserved carrot water and cook until water mostly evaporates.
3. Put cooked carrots, spices, remaining olive oil, 1 T vinegar and salt into food processor and pulse to get a rough puree. Stir in remaining parsley. Taste to see if it needs more vinegar or salt.
4. Serve with pita, chips or crostini.
title: Moroccan Carrot Spread

steps: 1. Place all ingredients in food processor fitted with the S blade and process until smooth. Stop occasionally to scrape down the sides of the bowl with a rubber spatula. Stored in a sealed container in the refrigerator, zucchini hummus will keep 5 days.
2. ve
3. Serve with salad, crudites, or as spread for a "sandwich" or green-leaf wrap.
title: Zucchini Hummus

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients in a food processor or blender and puree to desired consistency.
2. To thin, add 1 tbsp water at a time.
title: Asian Hummus

steps: 1. Strain the chickpeas and blend them in a food processor. Add the rest of the ingredients to the food processor and mix well for about two minutes. Refrigerate for four hours or more. Adjust seasoning if needed.
2. Serve with Ozery's mini pitas or crackers.
title: Hearty Hummus

steps: 1. Place the water, vinegar, sliced garlic and coriander seeds into a small saucepan and bring to the boil, simmer for 10 minutes and leave to cool.
2. Slice the Cucumbers to about 1/3rd inches thick (I used a slicer to make sure they were all the same thickness) place in a plastic bowl and sprinkle the salt in layers over the cucumber.
3. cover and leave for at least 4 hours stirring every so often - this dehydrates the slices (and forces the water out of the cucumber)) this is d one so that the vinegar will penetrate easily.
4. Rinse the cucumber 3 times, changing the water completely every time. Leave to drain and dry off.
5. Pack into sterile glass jars carefully and pour in the liquid, spooning in the garlic and coriander seeds. Seal and leave in a cupboard for one to two weeks. Serve and enjoy.
title: Pickled Lebanese Cucumber

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees.
2. Drain and rinse the garbanzo beans. Put in a medium sized bowl and smash with a fork.
3. Add the rest of the ingredients and mix well.
4. Form into small balls, about 1 1/2 inches in diameter and slightly flatten. Place onto an oiled baking pan.
5. Bake for 15 minutes on each side, until nicely browned (since it's baked, only the part actually touching the pan will be browned and crispy).
6. Serving suggestion: Stuff in mini pita pockets with hummus, tahini sauce, tomatoes, lettuce and/or cucumber.
title: Baked Falafel

ingredients.text: 200 g apples, peeled and coarsly grated

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients together.
2. Don't add salt, it would soak water!
3. Refrigerate at least one hour.
4. Serve and enjoy.
title: Persian Style Carrot Salad

steps: 1. Soak apricots and raisins in water for 1/2 hour.
2. Cook rice according to directions.
3. Preheat oven to 375°.
4. Grease a baking dish.
5. In a skillet, melt the margarine and saute the onion, green pepper and curry, until the vegetables are soft but not browned. Add the almonds to the skillet.
6. Drain and chop the apricots.
7. Mix the rice, apricots and raisins with the sauteed vegetables.
8. Place the mixture in the greased baking dish and bake in oven for 30 minutes.
title: Festive Syrian Rice

ingredients.text: 2 potatoes, peeled and very thinly sliced

steps: 1. Bring the water to a boil in a large pot, add the salt, and then boil the washed rice for ten minutes; drain and reserve.
2. Dip the potato slices in the melted butter and use them to line the bottom AND sides of the same pot you just boiled the rice in.
3. Pour any leftover butter in the bottom of the pot.
4. Now, very carefully (don't move the potatoes), place the partially cooked rice into the potato-lined pot.
5. Cover the pot with a teatowel and then its lid and place over medium-low heat; this steams the rice and cooks and browns the potatoes.
6. This will take about 1/2 hour, but carefully check the rice for doneness and the potatoes for browning after about 20 minutes.
7. When the rice and potatoes are done (potatoes will be browned and crispy), remove from heat and remove lid and teatowel.
8. Place a large platter over top of pot and very carefully invert the pot.
9. The whole thing should slide out; if some potatoes come away, put them back where they belong.
10. I was told the crust is called the"tadiq" and it is the part the family members all fight over.
11. I admit that, when I tried to make this dish, it all fell apart; it was tasty though.
title: Persian Rice

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients in a bowl and chill for at least 1 hour before serving.
title: Turkish Salad

steps: 1. In a medium saucepan, stir the clotted cream, butter and cornflour over a low-ish heat and bring to a low simmer. Turn off the heat and keep warm.
2. Meanwhile, put the cheese and nutmeg in a small bowl and add a good grinding of black pepper, then stir everything together (don’t add any salt at this stage).

3. Put the pasta in another pan with 2 tsp salt, pour over some boiling water and cook following pack instructions (usually 3-4 mins). When cooked, scoop some of the cooking water into a heatproof jug or mug and drain the pasta, but not too thoroughly.

4. Add the pasta to the pan with the clotted cream mixture, then sprinkle over the cheese and gently fold everything together over a low heat using a rubber spatula. When combined, splash in 3 tbsp of the cooking water. At first, the pasta will look wet and sloppy: keep stirring until the water is absorbed and the sauce is glossy. Check the seasoning before transferring to heated bowls. Sprinkle over some chives or parsley, then serve immediately.
title: Fettucine alfredo

steps: 1. Mix preceding and spoon over chicken.
2. Bake, covered, for 45 minutes at 370°.
3. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Parmesan Chicken

steps: 1. Brown meat in 3-quart saucepan.
2. Drain.
3. Add sauce and simmer 10 minutes.
4. Cook lasagne according to directions.
5. Drain.
6. Rinse and lay out on foil or wax paper to keep from sticking.
7. Combine cheeses, eggs, parsley, salt and pepper.
8. Pour about 1/2 cup meat sauce in bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking pan.
9. Arrange 4 to 5 noodles lengthwise across sauce, overlapping edges.
10. Spread 1/3 of cheese mix over noodles and top with 1 cup meat sauce.
11. Repeat layers of lasagne, cheese and meat sauce twice.
12. Top with a layer of lasagne and remaining meat sauce.
13. Sprinkle with additional Parmesan. Cover with foil and bake at 350° about 30 minutes or until hot and bubbly.
14. Remove foil and bake additional 10 minutes.
15. Allow to stand about 10 minutes before cutting.
16. Yields 10 to 12 servings.
title: Lasagne

ingredients.text: 8 oz. tomato sauce (1/2 c. and 1/2 c.)*

steps: 1. Mix ground beef, bread crumbs, salt and oregano with a spoon in a large bowl.
2. Stir in *1/2 cup tomato sauce.
3. Spread meat mix in ungreased 10-inch pizza pan or on the bottom and side of 10-inch pie pan.
4. Pour *1/2 cup tomato sauce on top of meat mixture. Spread kidney beans on top of tomato sauce.
5. Cut cheese into strips and arrange in crisscross design on beans.
6. Bake uncovered at 425° for 20 minutes.
7. Makes 4 servings.
title: Pizza With A Hamburger Crust

steps: 1. In 2-quart glass casserole, cook ground meat on High for 5 to 6 minutes.
2. Drain.
3. Stir in spaghetti sauce and 1/2 cup water and salt.
4. Microwave, covered, on High for 5 to 6 minutes.
5. Layer sauce, half of noodles, 1 cup cottage cheese and half the grated cheese.
6. Repeat layers, ending with sauce.
7. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
8. Microwave, tightly covered, on High for 30 to 35 minutes or until bubbly.
9. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.
10. Serves 6 to 8.
title: One Step Lasagna

steps: 1. Bake at 425° for 15 minutes or until crust browns.
2. Lightly spoon flour in measure cup; level off.
3. In large bowl, combine flour and potato flakes; cut in margarine.
4. Stir in milk with a fork.
5. Dough will be stiff.
6. With floured fingers, press dough in ungreased 12-inch pizza pan.
7. Form ridge along edge.
8. Brown beef in skillet; drain.
9. Blend in remaining ingredients except cheese. Spread mixture evenly onto baked crust.
10. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake an additional 10 minutes or until cheese melts.
11. Makes 4 to 6 servings.
title: Pizza

steps: 1. Combine spaghetti, eggs and Parmesan cheese.
2. Place half of the mixture in a greased baking dish.
3. Add half the Mozzarella cheese. Repeat with remaining spaghetti and Mozzarella cheese. Bake at 325° for about 25 to 35 minutes.
4. Let stand about 10 minutes. Cut in squares and serve with spaghetti sauce. Serves 4.
title: Baked Spaghetti

ingredients.text: 6 chicken breast halves, boneless and skinless

steps: 1. Heat oven to 400°.
2. Spray 15 x 10 x 1-inch pan with no-stick cooking spray.
3. Dip chicken in margarine.
4. Coat with combined remaining ingredients.
5. Place in prepared pan.
6. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until tender.
7. Makes 6 servings.
8. Preparation time: 30 minutes.
title: Parmesan Chicken Breast

steps: 1. Brown beef and onion in skillet over medium heat.
2. Drain. Stir oregano and salt into beef.
3. Lightly brush tortillas with oil.
4. Bake on two large baking sheets at 400° for 3 minutes. Spoon beef mixture evenly over tortillas. Top with equal amounts of tomato.
5. Sprinkle with basil and cheeses.
6. Return to oven and bake 12 to 14 minutes or until tortillas are lightly browned. Serves 4.
title: Tortilla Pizzas

steps: 1. Cook noodles.
2. Brown ground beef with onion.
3. Add salt, pepper, garlic, etc., to taste.
4. Then add sour cream and spaghetti sauce and stir well.
5. Pour noodles in bottom of large pan.
6. Then pour sauce mixture over noodles.
7. Then top with Mozzarella cheese.
8. Bake at 400° for 25 to 30 minutes.
9. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Quick Lasagna

steps: 1. Brown onions and meat in skillet.
2. Mix with spaghetti, tomatoes, cheese and salt.
3. Place in greased baking dish. sprinkle crumbs on top.
4. Dot with butter and bake in moderate oven (350°) for 30 minutes.
5. Serves 6 people.
title: Creole Pork And Spaghetti

ingredients.text: 3 chicken breasts, split and skinned (6 halves)

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°.
2. Combine bread crumbs, cheese and seasonings in a shallow dish.
3. Dip chicken in crumb mixture.
4. Coat both sides.
5. Melt margarine in a baking dish in oven.
6. Add chicken, turning to coat both sides with margarine.
7. Bake, uncovered, for 1 hour.
8. Yield:
9. 6 servings.
10. Exchange per 1-piece serving equals 4 lean meats.
title: Parmesan Chicken Bake

steps: 1. Boil noodles while frying bacon in butter.
2. Mix whipping cream and eggs in bowl with salt and pepper.
3. Add Parmesan cheese last. Drain noodles and put back in pot.
4. Add crumbled bacon and all other ingredients.
5. Keep pot on stove on high heat for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
6. Must be served hot as soon as cooking has completed.
7. Serves 4 to 5 people.
title: Pasta Carbonara

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°.
2. Bake pie crust for 6 to 8 minutes until set; allow to cool.
3. Layer pie crust with 3/4 cups of cheese, then spaghetti sauce, pepperoni, onion and remaining 3/4 cup cheese.
4. In a medium-sized bowl, combine eggs, cream, salt and pepper; mix thoroughly and pour over filling.
5. Place on cookie sheet and bake for 45 to 50 minutes, or until top is golden and knife inserted in center comes out clean.
6. Cool for 15 minutes; cut into wedges.
7. Yields 6 servings.
8. Preparation time:
9. 1 hour and 30 minutes.
title: Quiche Italiano

ingredients.text: 16 oz. spaghetti, break into 2-inch pieces and cook according to pkg. directions
1 lb. ground beef, browned and drained

steps: 1. In greased 9 x 13-inch pan, combine spaghetti, margarine, salt, pepper, egg and Parmesan cheese.
2. Layer cottage cheese on top. Combine ground beef, onion, green pepper and garlic and layer over cottage cheese.
3. Add 1 teaspoon sugar to spaghetti sauce and pour over ground beef layer.
4. Top with grated Mozzarella cheese.
5. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
6. Serves 8 to 10.
title: Baked Spaghetti

ingredients.text: 12 oz. (about 3 c.) ziti, cooked and drained

steps: 1. Heat oven to 350°.
2. Have a
3. 2-quart casserole dish ready.
4. Mix ziti, 1 cup marinara sauce, 1/2 cup Mozzarella, the Ricotta and Parmesan in the casserole.
5. Top with remaining sauce and Mozzarella.
6. Cover and bake 45 minutes.
7. Serves 6.
title: Baked Ziti

steps: 1. Prepare pasta; drain.
2. Place in casserole dish.
3. Pour sauce over pasta.
4. Sprinkle cheese on top.
5. Cover.
6. Microwave on Medium/high 10 minutes.
7. Serves 6.
title: Quick Italian Casserole

ingredients.text: 8 oz cream cheese, cut into bits

steps: 1. In large saucepan combine cream cheese, parmesan, butter and milk, stirring constantly until smooth.
2. Toss pasta lightly with sauce, coating well.
3. Leftovers freeze well.
4. Makes 4 servings.
title: Fettuccine Alfredo

ingredients.text: 6 chicken breast halves, boned and skinned

steps: 1. Combine cheese, bread crumbs and butter. Coat chicken breasts with mustard, then dip into crumb mixture.
2. Place in 9 x 13-inch baking pan.
3. Bake at 425° for 15 minutes or until chicken is done. Serves 6.
title: Parmesan Chicken

steps: 1. Saute green pepper, onion and parsley in butter or oleo.
2. Add beef and cook until brown.
3. Cook spaghetti in 1 gallon of water with 2 tablespoons salt.
4. Wash and drain.
5. Combine all ingredients (2 1/2 tablespoons salt).
6. Mix and bake in pans in 350° oven for 30 minutes.
7. Serves 50.
title: Italian Delight

steps: 1. Put beef and sausage in skillet. Add water and cook at medium heat until browned, stirring constantly to break up lumps.
2. Add other ingredients except cheese.
3. Mix well and place in 6 open-face hamburg buns. Cut cheese in strips and spread on buns. Place buns on cookie sheet and into a preheated 350° oven. Bake for 12 minutes.
4. Serves 6.
title: Pizza-Burgers

ingredients.text: 1 tsp. fennel seed (more for spicier sausage)

steps: 1. Mix ingredients thoroughly in a bowl.
2. Cover and let sit in refrigerator overnight; do not freeze.
3. Next day, form into 4 patties and fry or use in combination with other recipes.
4. Yields 4 servings.
5. Serving size:
6. one 3-ounce patty.
title: Italian Sausage

steps: 1. Heat oven to 400°.
2. Spray 10 x 15-inch pan with nonstick spray. Melt margarine and mix dry ingredients in separate bowl.
3. Dip chicken breasts in margarine.
4. Coat with breadcrumb mixture.
5. Place in pan.
6. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until tender.
7. Serves 6.
title: Parmesan Chicken Breasts

ingredients.text: 6 chicken breast halves, skinned and boned

steps: 1. Place each piece of chicken between 2 sheets of waxed paper; flatten to 1/4-inch thickness with meat mallet.
2. Combine flour, salt and pepper.
3. Dredge chicken in flour mixture.
4. Melt butter in large skillet over medium heat.
5. Add chicken.
6. Cook 3 to 4 minutes on each side or until golden brown.
7. Remove chicken; drain on paper towels.
8. Keep warm.
9. Add lemon juice and lemon slices to pan drippings in skillet.
10. Cook until thoroughly heated.
11. Pour lemon mixture over chicken and sprinkle with parsley.
12. Yields 6 servings.
title: Chicken Piccata

steps: 1. Cook lasagna noodles according to package.
2. Drain, chill in cold water for 5 minutes and re-drain.
3. In large baking pan, layer 1/4 meat sauce (spaghetti sauce), 1/3 of noodles, cottage cheese, Mozzarella and Parmesan ending with meat sauce and Parmesan.
4. Cover with foil and bake in 375° oven for 30 minutes or until bubbly. Remove from oven and let stand for 10 minutes before serving. Yields 12 servings.
title: Lasagna Supreme

steps: 1. Heat oil in skillet.
2. Combine flour, salt and pepper.
3. Flour chicken and brown in hot oil.
4. Add mushrooms, onions and wine. Cook and cover over very low heat for 45 minutes.
5. Serve with rice or pasta alfredo.
6. Yields 4 servings.
title: Chicken Marsala

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°.
2. Blend crumbs (crackers), Parmesan cheese, parsley and seasonings. Dip each chicken piece in melted butter, then in crumb mixture.
3. Arrange in casserole dish. Pour remaining butter over chicken.
4. Bake 1 hour.
5. Do not turn or cover.
6. Serves 8.
title: Parmesan Chicken

steps: 1. Layer macaroni and Cheddar cheese alternately in 2-quart baking dish until all ingredients are used.
2. Combine tomato and seasonings in bowl, mixing well.
3. Pour tomato mixture over macaroni and cheese.
4. Bake, covered at 400° for 45 minutes.
5. Add Mozzarella cheese.
6. Bake, uncovered, 15 minutes longer.
7. Yields 4 servings, about 430 calories each.
title: Pizza Casserole

ingredients.text: 4 or 5 boneless skinless chicken breasts, cut in half

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°.
2. In a small bowl, blend sour cream and egg; set aside.
3. In a medium bowl or shallow pan, mix bread crumbs and cheese.
4. Dip each piece of chicken in sour cream mixture and then roll in bread crumb mixture to coat completely.
5. Place chicken in a lightly oiled shallow baking pan.
6. Bake until chicken is tender, about 45 minutes.
7. Serves 4.
title: Italian Baked Chicken

steps: 1. Mix. flour with pepper and paprika and lightly dust chicken breasts.
2. Melt butter in hot skillet.
3. Saute chicken gently over low heat until golden on both sides and juices run clear.
4. Remove to platter and keep warm in 200° oven.
5. Pour wine into skillet, scraping brown bits into wine.
6. Add mushrooms and cook until wine is reduced by 1/2.
7. Pour sauce over chicken and sprinkle with parsley.
8. Serves 2.
title: Marsala Breast Of Chicken

ingredients.text: 3 oz. (about 3/4 c.) mild goat cheese (i.e. montrachet)

steps: 1. Cook fettuccine until al dente.
2. While pasta is cooking, heat oil and garlic in small saucepan over low heat just until mixture is hot and remove from heat.
3. Drain fettuccine well and in a bowl, toss oil mixture, parsley, mint, tomato, goat cheese and salt and pepper to taste.
4. Serves 2.
title: Fettuccine With Cherry Tomatoes, Goat Cheese And Herbs

steps: 1. In large skillet, cook onion in butter until tender; add fish, lemon juice, oregano, zucchini and mushrooms.
2. Cover and simmer 10 minutes.
3. Top with tomato and cheese; cover and simmer 2 minutes or until cheese melts.
4. Serves 4.
title: Skillet Fish Italiano

ingredients.text: 2 loaves frozen bread dough (Italian, French or pizza)

steps: 1. Thaw bread dough.
2. Divide each loaf into 5 parts each.
3. One at a time, roll each dough piece on a floured board or stretch with your hands, making 10 (7-inch) squares.
4. Fold each dough square over half a cheese slice to form a turnover and pinch edges to seal.
5. (You can also ladle 1/3 cup sauce onto center of each square before making turnover, but the sauce tends to leak out.)
6. Heat sauce in a medium pan 10 to 15 minutes until bubbly.
7. Place calzones about 2 inches apart on a baking sheet sprayed with no-stick spray.
8. Preheat oven to 350°.
9. Bake for 15 minutes. Turnovers will be golden brown when done.
10. Ladle sauce on top of turnovers.
11. Makes 10 servings.
title: Calzones

ingredients.text: 2 large eggplants, sliced lengthwise into 1/4-inch strips

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
2. Sprinkle both sides of the peeled egg plant slices with 1/2 tsp salt and 1/4 tsp pepper.

3. Place strips of egg plant and the chopped onions on a non stick baking sheet, in a single layer, and bake for 5 to 7 minutes; turn the strips over and bake a little longer until the eggplant is slightly soft. You should still be able to lift the slices but they should be soft. Stir up the onions; they should be translucent. If one is done before the other, take it out of the oven until both are cooked.
4. Mix together the ricotta, egg white, green onion and remaining salt and pepper.
5. Spread 1 1/2 cups of tomato sauce on the bottom of a 9x13" oven proof casserole.
6. Place a layer of eggplant and onion, using about one third.
7. Cover with half of the ricotta mixture.
8. Add another layer of veggies (1/3).
9. Cover with the rest of the ricotta.
10. Add the rest of the veggies.
11. Add the remaining tomato sauce on top.
12. Sprinkle with the mozzarella and parmesan cheeses.
13. Cover with foil and bake for 1 hour at 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
14. Remove foil and bake another 5 to 10 minutes until the cheese is nicely browned.
title: Vegetable Lasagna Without The Lasagna

steps: 1. Mix dry ingredients in plastic baggie.
2. Mix egg and milk.
3. Dip chicken in egg and milk, then place in baggie; shake well.
4. Place in pan.
5. Pour 1/2 stick melted butter over.
6. Bake at 350° for 1 hour uncovered.
title: Parmesan Chicken

steps: 1. Heat butter and half and half in a 2-quart saucepan over low heat until butter is melted.
2. Stir in Gruyere cheese, Parmesan cheese, salt, pepper and garlic.
3. Cook, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes.
title: Four-Cheese Fettuccine

steps: 1. Lightly spoon flour into dry measuring cups; level with a knife. Follow manufacturer's instructions for placing flour and next 6 ingredients (flour through mustard) into bread pan, and select dough cycle; start bread machine.
2. Remove dough from machine (do not bake). Turn the dough out onto a floured surface, and knead for 30 seconds. Cover dough, and let rest for 10 minutes.

3. Roll dough into a 10 x 8-inch oval on a lightly floured surface. Sprinkle the ham and cheese onto half of oval, lengthwise, leaving a 1-inch border. Fold dough over filling, and press the edges and ends together to seal.

4. Cover a large baking sheet with parchment paper, and dust with cornmeal. Place loaf, seam side down, on prepared pan. Make 3 diagonal cuts 1/4-inch deep across the top of loaf using a sharp knife. Cover and let rise in a warm place (85°), free from drafts, 1 hour or until doubled in size.
5. Preheat oven to 350°.
6. Uncover dough; brush with egg. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes or until browned. Cool slightly.
title: Ham-And-Swiss Stromboli

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients.
2. Spread into a baking pan.
3. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.
4. Cut into squares.
title: Zucchini Pizza

steps: 1. Brown ground beef; drain.
2. Add onions and bell pepper; saute. Add sauce and sugar; heat.
3. Spread thin layer of sauce on bottom of casserole, then layer noodles, meat sauce and grated Mozzarella. Keep layering ending with cheese.
4. Bake at 350° until cheese is melted (about 30 minutes).
5. You may add mushrooms to sauce if desired.
6. Freezes well.
title: Spaghetti Casserole

steps: 1. Brown meat and drain. Add sauce and water and simmer 10 minutes. Combine rest of ingredients in separate bowl and mix well. In large pan, layer as follows: 1 cup meat sauce on bottom, layer of lasagna pasta, 1 1/2 cups of meat
2. sauce, 1/2 cup cheese mix, lasagna pasta, 1 1/2 cups meat sauce, 1/2 cheese, lasagna pasta and rest of meat sauce. Bake at 350° for 55 to 60 minutes, covered, then 10 minutes uncovered.
title: Virgina'S Easy Bake Lasagna

steps: 1. In a small skillet, saute onion and green pepper in oil until tender. Place tortillas on an ungreased
2. . Top with onion mixture, oregano, garlic powder, tomato and cheese.
3. Bake at 400° for 8-10 minutes or until cheese is melted. Cut each pizza into four wedges.
title: California Pizzas

ingredients.text: 3 lbs zucchini, cut into long thin strips (or other summer squash)

steps: 1. Heat a large skillet or roasting pan over medium heat. Add the olive oil and heat until the oil shimmers. Add the garlic and cook until light golden, about 5 minutes.
2. Add the zucchini and cook for a few minutes without turning. Add salt and cook another 3 to 4 minutes, stirring occasionally, until barely tender.
3. A mandolin is great for this.
title: Zucchini "Spaghetti"

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees.
2. Place the whole head of garlic in tin foil and drizzle with olive oil. Close up the tin foil.
3. Cook the garlic for an hour. Let cool a little.
4. Cut the top of the head of garlic horizontally.
5. Squeeze out the softened garlic.
6. Add to skillet with 1 tablespoon of the oil and 2 teaspoons of Parmesan.
7. Cook for 1 minute and mix thoroughly.
8. Take the leftover spaghetti (Follow pasta box instructions in the original cooking) and drop in the garlic Parmesan olive oil. Mix well and heat through - 1 - 2 minutes.
9. Top with grated Parmesan and then more oil.
10. Put the shredded mozzarella in the center of the pasta. Spread out a little.
11. Place on the top rack in a 325 degree oven and bake until the cheese melts and browns about 5 minutes.
12. Serve and enjoy!
title: Garlic Cheese Spaghetti

steps: 1. Mix last 5 ingredients together.
2. Heat oven to 400°.
3. Spray a 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan with Pam.
4. Dip chicken in melted butter and roll in dry mixture.
5. Place on prepared pan and bake for 30 to 35 minutes or until tender and brown.
title: Parmesan Chicken

steps: 1. Cook pasta according to package directions.
2. Drain.
3. Combine cream and butter in saucepan. Cook over medium low heat until butter is melted.
4. Add to hot pasta alternately with parmesan cheese, tossing to mix well.
5. Serve hot.
6. May add sauteed scallops, shrimp, chicken or even sliced mushrooms and season with black pepper.
title: Fettucini Alfredo

steps: 1. Blend and press in pan.
2. Bake at 350° until light brown.
title: Blueberry Pizza

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees.
2. Add the mozzarella and cream cheese to a microwave safe bowl and microwave for 1 minute. Stir to combine and return to microwave until cheese has melted, about 30 more seconds.
3. Stir in the almond flour, egg, salt, and Italian seasoning to combine.
4. Place the dough on a large sheet of parchment paper. Top with a second sheet of parchment.
5. Roll the dough out into a 12 inch diameter circle.
6. Remove the top piece of parchment and transfer the bottom sheet with the dough on it to a pizza pan.
7. Bake for 12 minutes or until golden brown.
8. Remove from the oven and spread with the mayonnaise. Sprinkle on the lettuce, tomatoes, bacon.
title: Low Carb Blt Pizza

ingredients.text: 22.5 ounces bread flour, plus more for dusting (630g; about 4 1/2 cups)
1.125 ounces Extra Virgin olive oil (32g; about 3 tablespoons)

steps: 1. Combine flour, sugar, salt, and yeast in bowl of food processor. Pulse 3 to 4 times until incorporated. Add olive oil and water. Run food processor until mixture forms ball that rides around the bowl above the blade, about 15 seconds. Continue processing 15 seconds longer.

2. Transfer dough ball to lightly floured surface and knead once or twice by hand until smooth ball is formed. It should pass the windowpane test. Divide dough into three even parts and place each in a covered quart-sized deli container or in a zipper-lock freezer bag. Place in refrigerator and allow to rise at least 1 day, and up to 5. Remove from refrigerator, shape into balls, and allow to rest at room temperature for at least 2 hours before baking.
title: Basic New York-Style Pizza Dough Recipe

steps: 1. Mix flour, garlic, oregano, eggs and milk.
2. Pour into a 13 x 9-inch pan.
3. Sprinkle hamburger on top.
4. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.
5. Add desired sauce and toppings; bake another 15 minutes.
title: Homemade Pizza

steps: 1. preheat oven to 425°F.
2. combine mayonnaise, ranch seasoning and garlic to make a "sauce".
3. Spread evenly over crust. Sprinkle on half the mozzarella. Layer on all the vegetables and olives. Top with the remaining mozzarella and the parmesan cheese.
4. Bake 18-22 minutes or until pizza crust is cooked. Serve immediately.
title: Garden Ranch Pizza-Pampered Chef

steps: 1. Brown chopped beef and drain.
2. Before layering the ingredients in a baking dish, mix Ricotta cheese with the eggs and cubed Mozzarella cheese.
3. Add salt and pepper to taste.
4. In a baking dish, cover the bottom with tomato sauce, then layer alternately the noodles, meat, Ricotta mixture and tomato sauce until pan is full or you run out of ingredients.
5. The top layer should be noodles.
6. Bake for 30 minutes at 275° or until hot and the top layer is crispy.
7. Let stand 30 minutes before serving.
title: Mom'S Lasagna

steps: 1. Note: The ingredient amounts for this recipe are estimates. The amount you'll need depends on the size of pizza you plan to make, so adjust accordingly.
2. 1. Preheat oven (with a pizza stone if you have it) to 450.
3. 2. Roll out pizza dough on a floured surface or pizza peel.
4. 3. Liberally spread Nutella over the dough, leaving a 1/2" border. Top with a healthy dose of raspberries or any other berries you have on hand.
5. 4. Bake for about 15 minutes or until the crust is cooked to your liking.
title: Raspberry + Nutella Pizza

steps: 1. Cook noodles and drain well.
2. Heat sauce, chicken and seasonings.
3. Spoon enough sauce to cover bottom of a 9 x 9-inch baking dish.
4. Layer half of the noodles, sauce and cheese. Repeat, ending with Parmesan cheese on top.
5. Bake at 375° for 20 minutes or until bubbly.
title: Italian Noodle Bake

ingredients.text: 8 oz. lasagna noodles, cooked as directed on pkg.

steps: 1. Place zucchini in microwave-safe dish.
2. Cover, but leave one corner to vent.
3. Cook 5 minutes on High or until tender-crisp. Stir in mushrooms. Cover and cook 5 minutes longer. Drain off liquid; set aside.
title: Vegetable Lasagna(Microwave)

steps: 1. Mix ziti, Ricotta, Mozzarella, egg, salt, pepper and 1 1/2 cups sauce.
2. In a 13 x 9-inch baking dish, spread 1/2 cup sauce, then spoon macaroni mixture in and gently pat down with back of spoon.
3. Top with remaining 1 1/2 cups sauce; sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
4. Bake at 350° for about 45 minutes.
5. Let stand 5 minutes before cutting into squares.
6. Serve with additional sauce if desired.
title: Baked Ziti

steps: 1. Stir yeast and sugar into lukewarm water, using a fork. Let stand in a warm place until a creamy layer forms on top of the water, about 10 minutes.

2. Mix flour and salt in a large bowl. Mix olive oil into flour and stir for 2 minutes. Pour yeast mixture and beaten egg into flour mixture and stir to make a stiff dough. Turn dough out onto a floured work surface and knead until springy and smooth, about 8 minutes. Place dough into a floured bowl and cover with a piece of plastic wrap wiped with a thin film of olive oil.
3. Let dough rise until doubled, about 1 hour. Punch down and roll out to desired shape.
title: Italian Pizza Dough

steps: 1. Mix cheese and crackers; dip pieces of chicken in melted butter and then roll in dry mixture.
2. Place in baking dish; bake uncovered at 375° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.
title: Parmesan Chicken

steps: 1. Saute' prawns, green onions, cilantro, garlic, curry paste and curry powder in margarine.
2. When prawns are half cooked, add wine and sour cream and reduce; add half-and-half.
3. Season with salt and pepper.
4. Bring to a simmer and blend in cheese. Add penne and garnish with parsley.
title: Penne Bombay

steps: 1. Heat oven to 350.
2. Use 2 quart baking dish.
3. Combine eggplant, tomatoes. zucchini, artichoke hearts and cheese.
4. In small non-stick skillet, heat oil and add garlic.
5. Cook and stir 2 minutes.
6. Mix in pasta sauce.
7. Pour sauce over vegetables.
8. Cover and bake 45 minutes. Cool slightly. Serve.
title: Italian Vegetable Cheese Bake

ingredients.text: 6 fresh asparagus spears, cut into 2-inch pieces
1 small plum tomato, peeled,seeded and diced

steps: 1. Cook pasta according to package directions.
2. Meanwhile, in a large skillet, saute the shrimp, asparagus and garlic in oil for 3-4 minutes or until shrimp turn pink.
3. Add the mushrooms, broth, tomato, salt and pepper flakes; simmer, uncovered, for 2 minutes.
4. Drain pasta.
5. Add the pasta and seasonings to skillet; toss to coat.
6. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
title: Shrimp Pasta Primavera

steps: 1. Preheat grill for medium heat and lightly oil the grate.

2. Brush one side of each zucchini round with olive oil; brush the opposite side with pizza sauce. Evenly divide red onion, roasted red pepper, mushrooms, goat cheese, mozzarella cheese, garlic, and Italian seasoning over each zucchini round.
3. Grill zucchini pizzas over preheated grill until zucchini is tender, about 10 minutes.
title: Grilled Zucchini Pizza With Goat Cheese

steps: 1. Melt butter in a small saucepan over a low heat.
2. Off the heat add the cream and the grated parmesan.
3. Put back on the fire to heat the sauce through and melt the cheese.
4. Do not boil.
5. Stir in the salt and pepper.
6. Cook the fettuccine in plenty of boiling salted water.
7. Drain well.
8. Combine the noodles and the sauce and leave to stand covered for two minutes before serving.
title: Fettuccine Alfredo

steps: 1. Cook bacon in a 12-inch nonstick skillet over moderate heat, turning over occasionally, until crisp, then transfer with tongs to paper towels to drain. Reserve 2 tablespoons bacon fat in a small bowl and discard remainder. Wipe skillet clean with paper towels and reserve. When cool, finely crumble bacon.
2. While bacon cools, vigorously whisk together eggs, parmesan, cream, basil, salt, and pepper in a bowl until foamy.

3. Cook garlic and parsley in reserved bacon fat in skillet over moderate heat, stirring, 1 minute (do not brown garlic). Add scallions and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 3 minutes. Add egg mixture and cook, stirring occasionally to scramble eggs and form large curds, lifting up cooked egg around edge with a heatproof rubber spatula to let raw egg flow underneath, until eggs are just set. Stir in crumbled bacon, top with chopped scallions and basil, and serve immediately.
title: Eggs Carbonara With Basil And Parmesan

steps: 1. In a mixing bowl, beat the ricotta until it is creamy.
2. add the eggs, prosciutto, grated romano, mozzarella and parsley, beat to combine.
title: Cheese And Prosciutto Manicotti Filling

steps: 1. Scramble and brown sausage.
2. Drain.
3. Melt cheese in double boiler.
4. Saute onion and green pepper.
5. Drain.
6. Add sausage, green pepper and onion to cheese.
7. Spread on party rye bread.
8. Bake 10 minutes at 350°.
9. This makes enough for 2 loaves of bread.
title: Party Pizza

ingredients.text: 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil, plus more (1/2 oz)

steps: 1. Combine sugar, olive oil, yeast, and 2 cups cold water in bowl of a stand mixer fitted with a dough hook.
2. Let sit until foamy, about 8-10 minutes.
3. Mix flour and salt in a bowl.
4. With motor running, slowly add flour mixture.
5. Mix until a smooth dough forms, about 8-10 minutes.
6. Transfer dough to a greased baking sheet.
7. Cover with plastic wrap.
8. Let sit at room temperature 1 hour.
9. Divide dough into 4 balls.
10. Transfer to a greased 9 inch by 13 inch dish.
11. Brush tops with olive oil.
12. Cover with plastic wrap.
13. Refrigerate for 48 hours. Makes four 12 oz balls.
title: Naples-Style Pizza Dough

steps: 1. Gently cut the flour, salt, and beaten egg into the cheese until the whole forms into a ball. Keep a little cream on hand in case it becomes too dry. If a little flour is left at the bottom that is OK. The finished product should look rough and unfinished, but all ingredients smoothly integrated. Roll into snakes about 3/4" in diameter and cut into 1/2" pieces. Drop into boiling water and wait until they float BUT allow a little longer, until if puffs up. Serve immediately with perhaps pesto or any sauce, or over spinach with asiago or parmigiano. [To make spinach gnocchi, boil spinach leaves gently, process with a little of its water, and add to dough when mixing.]
title: Ricotta Gnocchi

ingredients.text: 1 pound fresh collard greens, cut into 2-inch pieces

steps: 1. Heat oil in a Dutch oven; add bacon, and cook until crisp. Add onion, and saute 5 to 7 minutes or until tender. Add garlic; saute 1 minute.

2. Stir in collard greens, salt, and pepper; saute over medium heat 5 minutes or until greens wilt. Stir in chicken broth. Reduce heat to medium-low; cover and cook mixture 45 minutes or until greens are tender.
3. Pour greens mixture through a wire-mesh strainer into a container, reserving greens and pot liquor. Whisk molasses and butter into pot liquor.
4. Stir greens into Risotto.
5. Place 1 cup Collard Green Risotto in each of 6 bowls. Ladle pot liquor mixture evenly on top. Serve immediately.
title: Collard Green Risotto And Pot Liquor

steps: 1. In a small bowl, dissolve yeast in warm water. Add the tapioca flour, milk powder, xanthan gum, gelatin, Italian seasoning, vinegar, oil, salt, sugar and 2/3 cup brown rice flour. Beat until smooth. Stir in enough remaining brown rice flour to form a soft dough (dough will be sticky).
2. On a floured surface, roll dough into a 13-in. circle. Transfer to a 12-in. pizza pan coated with cooking spray; build up edges slightly. Cover and let rest for 10 minutes.
3. Bake at 425° for 10-12 minutes or until golden brown. Add toppings of your choice. Bake 10-15 minutes longer or until crust is golden brown and toppings are lightly browned and heated through.
title: Gluten-Free Pizza Crust

steps: 1. Cook the fettuccine according to package directions.

2. Meanwhile, in a large skillet, saute the ham, peas, walnuts, onion, thyme and pepper in oil until heated through. Drain fettuccine. Add to ham mixture and toss to coat. Sprinkle with cheese; cover for 1 minute or until cheese is melted.
title: Ham & Pea Fettuccine

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°.
2. Cook pasta according to package directions, omitting salt and fat.

3. While pasta cooks, place walnuts in a single layer on a baking sheet. Bake at 350° for 8 minutes or until toasted. Place 1/3 cup hot walnuts, salt, and garlic in a food processor; process until nuts are finely ground. Microwave milk at HIGH 1 minute or until hot. Add hot milk to food processor; process until smooth. Chop remaining walnuts.

4. Drain pasta, reserving 1/4 cup pasta water. Combine pasta, walnut cream, chopped walnuts, and pepper in a bowl; toss to coat. If necessary, add reserved pasta water, 1 tablespoon at a time, to thin walnut cream. Sprinkle with Romano cheese. Serve immediately.
5. Crema di noci (KREH-mah dee NOH-chee) means "cream of walnut." Toasted walnuts are pureed into butter as a base for this pasta sauce.
title: Linguine With Crema Di Noci

steps: 1. Cook pasta as directed on package.
2. Meanwhile, combine broth and flour in medium saucepan.
3. Stir in cream cheese, 2 Tbls. of the parmesan cheese, the nutmeg and pepper;
4. cook 2 min., stirring constantly with a wire whisk until mixture boils and thickens.
5. Drain pasta. Toss with sauce.
6. Sprinkle with remaining parmesan cheese and parsley.
title: Smarter Fettuccine Alfredo

steps: 1. Mix and spoon over chicken pieces.
2. Bake in 375° oven for 45 minutes.
title: Parmesan Chicken

ingredients.text: 8 ounces cream cheese, cut in bits

steps: 1. Cook and drain the pasta according to package directions.
2. In large saucepan combine cream cheese, Parmesan, butter and milk, stirring constantly until smooth.
3. Toss pasta lightly with sauce, coating well.
4. Leftovers freeze well.
title: Olive Garden Fettuccine Alfredo

steps: 1. Mix 2 (of a three package set) packages of dry yeast with warm water.
2. Set aside.
3. Mix rest of ingredients.
4. Add yeast mixture to other mixture.
5. Let rise until double in bulk.
6. Divide into two balls.
7. Spread on greased pizza pans.
8. Bade 400 for 10 minutes.
9. Remove from oven and put on sauce, then pizza ingredients.
10. Bake 10-15 minutes longer.
title: Rose'S Pizza Dough

ingredients.text: 1 lb medium shrimp, shelled and deveined

steps: 1. Cook pasta. Drain.
2. In large skillet, heat butter and oil. Add garlic, shallots, clam juice and wine. Raise heat to medium high and boil uncovered until sauce is slightly reduced, about 3 minutes.
3. Add shrimp, reduce heat to medium, and cook until pink and opaque. Stir in parsley and pepper. Toss pasta with sauce.
title: Garlic Shrimp Linguine

steps: 1. Cook the pasta according to package instructions. About 2 mins before the end of the cooking time, ladle out 2/3 cup cooking water and reserve, then add the peas. Drain pasta and peas in a colander.

2. Pour the reserved pasta water back into the pan and heat. Add the salmon and cook for 2 mins over a low heat. Stir in the cooked pasta, arugula, ricotta and lemon juice and warm gently. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Pour into a serving dish.
title: Penne With Salmon And Arugula

steps: 1. Mix and spread on pizza pan or cookie sheet.
2. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
3. Cool.
title: Fruit Pizza

steps: 1. In a bowl, mix together water and sugar. Sprinkle with yeast. Allow to sit 10 minutes. Add salt, olive oil, and flour. Knead until very smooth. Divide dough in half. Roll each piece into a 12-inch circle. Place on lightly greased baking sheet and let rise 20 minutes. Flatten each and top with pizza toppings. Bake at 425 degrees for 15 minutes.

2. If you choose to use this recipe for garlic or cinnamon bread sticks, bake untopped for 5 minutes. Remove from oven, top with margarine of choice and either garlic salt or cinnamon sugar mixture. Return to oven for about 3 minutes. Remove from oven and cut into breadsticks.
title: Favorite Pizza Crust

steps: 1. Combine flour, salt, pepper and oregano. Dredge chicken in mixture. Heat oil and butter in skillet. Brown chicken on both sides. Add wine, mushrooms and garlic. Cover and simmer about minutes until tender.
title: Chicken Marsala

steps: 1. Spray a slow cooker container with olive oil-flavored cooking spray. In prepared container, combine zucchini and onion. Add undrained tomatoes, Italian dressing, and sugar (or splenda). Mix well to combine.
2. Cover and cook on LOW for 4 to 6 hours. Mix well before serving.
title: Crock Pot Italian Zucchini

ingredients.text: 1 lb Italian sausage, cut into 1in thick slices

steps: 1. Coat slow cooker with cooking spray.
2. Place bell peppers, onion and garlic on bottom.
3. Arrange sausage over vegetables.
4. Combine marinara sauce and wine, pour over all.
5. Cover and cook 8 hrs on low heat or 4 hrs on high.
title: Italian Sausage And Peppers

ingredients.text: 16 -20 ounces pasta, cooked and drained (ziti, rigatoni or penne)
1 lb ground beef, cooked and drained
4 cups cheese, shredded (Mozzarella or italian blend)

steps: 1. Cook pasta and drain.
2. Mix pasta, spaghetti sauce, cooked ground beef, Parmesan cheese and 2 cups of Mozzarella cheese well.
3. Spread mixture in a 9 x13 baking dish.
4. Top with remaining 2 cups of grated Mozzarella cheese.
5. Bake at 350 degrees Fahrenheit for 30 minutes or until bubbly and the cheese on top has melted.
title: Easy Baked Ziti

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients and form small meat balls.
2. Place in a pie plate and microwave on High until meat balls are almost fully cooked (about 6 to 7 minutes).
3. Rearrange once.
4. Give dish 1/2 turn during cooking.
5. Repeat procedure until all meat balls are cooked. Add to spaghetti sauce the last hour of simmering.
title: Spaghetti And Meat Balls

ingredients.text: 6 slices bacon, cooked, drained and crumbled

steps: 1. Cook zucchini in a large saucepan, covered with boiling salted water until crisp and tender (5 minutes).
2. Drain well.
3. Saute onion and green pepper in oleo until tender.
4. Stir in sauce and spices. Heat through.
5. Separate egg yolk and white.
6. Chop white.
7. Add zucchini.
8. Use 11 x 7 1/2 x 1 1/2 inch dish.
9. Line with a little sauce, layer of zucchini, 1/2 of sauce, cheese, 1/2 of sauce and bacon.
10. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.
title: Zucchini Italiano

steps: 1. Cook pasta according to directions.
2. Saute bacon till fat is rendered.
3. Add thawed peas and saute 1 to 2 minutes.
4. Add shrimp, stirring until just done.
5. Add butter, lower heat so butter melts slowly.
6. In a bowl combine ricotta, salt & pepper and parm. cheese.
7. Just before serving, whisk in cheese mixture.
8. Drain pasta and toss with cheese mixture.
9. Add bacon and toss.
title: Penne Pasta With Shrimp & Bacon

steps: 1. Crumble beef into a microwave safe colander; place colander in a 9-inch pie plate.
2. Cover with wax paper; microwave at High 5 to 6 minutes or until meat is no longer pink, stirring after 3 minutes.
3. Combine beef, sauce, water and wine.
4. Spread 1/3 of mixture in a lightly greased 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish.
5. Arrange 4 lasagna noodles on sauce.
6. Layer 1 cup cottage cheese and 1 cup Mozzarella cheese over noodles.
7. Spoon 1/2 of remaining sauce over cheese.
8. Repeat process again.
9. Sprinkle with Parmesan.
10. Cover with plastic wrap, folding back one corner for steam to escape. Microwave at Medium 32 to 35 minutes, give dish half-turn after 15 minutes.
11. Uncover and sprinkle with remaining Mozzarella cheese and microwave for 2 minutes.
12. Yields 6 large servings.
title: One-Step Microwave Lasagna

steps: 1. In a
2. , saute onion and red pepper in oil for 2 minutes. Add zucchini; saute 4-5 minutes or until vegetables are crisp-tender. Add garlic; cook 1 minute longer.
3. Stir in the corn, tomato, basil, salt and Italian seasoning; cook and stir until heated through. Sprinkle with cheese. Serve immediately.
title: Fast Italian Vegetable Skillet

steps: 1. Drain ricotta cheese in cheesecloth-lined colander for 30 minutes. Combine the ingredients and mix thoroughly until well combined. You may want to make a double batch if you are making lasagne or manicotti.
title: Herbed Ricotta Filling For Manicotti Ravioli Or Lasagne

steps: 1. Prepare pasta.
2. Drain and keep warm.
3. Melt butter.
4. Stir in half and half, cheese and pepper.
5. Keep stirring until cheese melts and mixture thickens.
6. Add parsley and pour over warm pasta. Stir pasta thoroughly and serve immediately.
title: Angel Alfredo

steps: 1. Cook noodles according to package directions.
2. Cook beef on top of stove, drain.
3. Spread 1/4 spaghetti sauce in ungreased pan or slow cooker.
4. Layer with 1/3 noodles, 1/3 beef, 1/3 sauce, 1/3 cheese. Repeat layers twice.
5. Cover and bake 30-45 min at 350 degrees or 4 hours in a slow cooker.
title: Quick Egg Noodle Lasagne

steps: 1. Cook meat.
2. Add onion, pepper, tomato sauce and spices. Simmer for 20 minutes.
3. Spray a 9 x 13-inch pan with Pam.
4. Cook noodles and put noodles in pan.
5. Pour meat mixture over noodles. Sprinkle with cheese.
6. Top with mushrooms.
7. Cover with foil.
8. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.
title: Pizza Hot Dish

steps: 1. Spread dough over your lightly greased pizza pan and bake until light brown according to directions on package.
2. While dough is baking, prepare glaze.
3. Mix cream cheese, sugar and vanilla.
4. Mix and spread over cooled cookie dough.
5. Now get your favorite fruit mixtures such as sliced kiwi, strawberry, peaches, fruit cocktail, bananas or any fruit your family likes and arrange on top of the cream cheese.
6. Put glaze over top of fruit and refrigerate 2 hours before serving.
title: Fruit Pizza

steps: 1. Cream margarine, sugar and egg; mix well.
2. Add plain flour, baking powder, salt and vanilla.
3. Make into ball and chill.
4. Roll out to fit 12-inch pan.
5. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.
title: Fruit Pizza

ingredients.text: 1 lb. boneless chicken breasts (without skin), cut in strips

steps: 1. Heat oil; add pepper, onion, garlic and mushrooms and saute until tender.
2. Remove vegetables and saute chicken strips until they are tender and begin to brown.
3. Add the wine and broth, tomatoes and spices.
4. Simmer until thick.
5. Serve over pasta.
title: Chicken Cacciatore(To Be Served Over Medium-Size Spaghetti)

steps: 1. Cook fettuccine according to package directions; drain.
2. In a large skillet, melt butter over low heat. Add fettuccine and stir until coated. Sprinkle with cheese and pepper; toss to coat.
title: Parmesan Fettuccine

steps: 1. Grind together the 3 ingredients.
2. Mix with mayonnaise to make it the consistency of tuna fish.
3. Spread on party rye and broil until bubbly.
title: Party Pizzas

ingredients.text: 1 pound cooked medium shrimp, peeled and deveined

steps: 1. Cook fettuccine according to package directions. Meanwhile, in a large saucepan, melt butter. Stir in flour until smooth; gradually add half-and-half. Bring to a boil; cook and stir for 1 minute or until thickened. Drain fettuccine; stir into pan. Stir in the shrimp, cheese and salt; heat through. Sprinkle with parsley before serving.
title: Shrimp Fettuccine Alfredo

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 to 2 c. milk or light cream
1 lb. tomato, basil linguine or other pasta of choice

steps: 1. Combine 2 tablespoons olive oil, garlic and onions in frying pan.
2. Saute until tender.
3. Spice to taste (basil, freshly ground pepper and seasoning salt).
4. Mix by shaking milk and cornstarch. Add to onion mixture.
5. Cook until thick.
6. Add rinsed scallops. Cook for about 5 to 10 minutes.
7. Add wine.
8. Simmer.
9. Pour over cooked linguine.
title: Scallops And Linguine

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).

2. Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until hot; fry tortillas, one at a time, until golden brown, 2 to 3 minutes per side. Transfer fried tortillas using tongs to a baking sheet.
3. Spread salsa onto each fried tortilla; top with Cheddar cheese and Parmesan cheese.
4. Bake in the preheated oven until cheese is melted, about 8 minutes.
title: Quick And Easy Mexican Pizza

steps: 1. Mix together well and pat into a jelly roll or pizza pan. Bake at 350° until edges begin to brown, approximately 15 minutes. Cool completely.
title: Fruit Pizza (Serves 8)

steps: 1. Make pastry and pat on pizza pan.
2. Bake at 350°
3. for 15 minutes.
4. Mix cheese, sugar, vanilla and nuts.
5. Pour over crust and bake 10 minutes.
6. Spread filling and chill.
title: Cherry Pizza

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients and pat into pan.
2. Bake depending on what you are using it for.
title: Pie Crust(Can Also Be Used For Homemade Pizza Crust.)

steps: 1. Mix yeast with warm water and let stand for 10 minutes.
2. Mix lemon juice with milk and set aside.
3. In a large bowl combine both flours, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, salt, and butter. Mix well.
4. Add the yeast and milk mixtures to the dry mixture. Knead well, then let rise in the bowl for 30 minutes (or longer) with a clean towel covering it.
5. Divide dough into 8-10 balls. Roll a ball out to about 1/8" thick, and about 6" diameter. *Sprinkle flour on your counter top and on your rolling pin to keep dough from sticking to the surfaces.*

6. Pizza - spread a spoonfull of sauce leaving the outer inch of dough oncovered. Add about 3 tbsp of pizza toppings (ie 1 tbsp cheese, 1 tbsp ham, 1 tbsp pineable) to the middle. Fold dough in half and pinch edges closed.
7. Other fillings - get creative with leftovers - anything that is freezable and bakable will be great!
8. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
9. Let cool 5 minutes before serving, or cool completely then wrap individually in wax paper then freeze. Best if reheated in an oven, but can be heated in the microwave too.
title: Pizza Pocket And Calzone Dough

steps: 1. Remove casing from sausage and brown.
2. Do the same with the ground beef.
3. Drain well.
4. Add all the other ingredients and beat well in a saucepan until cheese is melted.
5. Spread on 60 slices of party rye bread.
6. Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.
7. Or place on a cookie sheet and freeze, then bake for 15 minutes.
title: Polish Pizza

steps: 1. Fry hamburger. Before it loses pink color, add onions and pepper. Continue frying until done. Add tomatoes, tomato paste, Italian seasoning, oregano, salt and pepper to taste.
2. Cook 15 minutes.
title: Lasagne

steps: 1. Cook and drain noodles.
2. Set aside.
3. Brown beef; drain off fat.
4. Add spaghetti sauce.
5. Combine cheeses, eggs and oregano. Grease a 9 x 11-inch pan and layer, starting at the bottom sauce, noodles (3), cheese (1/2), sauce, noodles (3), cheese, noodles (last 3) and sauce.
6. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
7. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
8. Let sit 10 minutes before serving to firm up.
title: Lasagne

steps: 1. Beat eggs, Ricotta cheese and grated cheese.
2. Add salt. Gradually add flour.
3. Knead.
4. Cut into small pieces; boil in salted boiling water (about 4 quarts).
5. Can cover with favorite red sauce or serve with butter and grated cheese.
6. Boil for 20 minutes; drain.
title: Cheese Gnocchi

steps: 1. Warm milk slightly, then mix all ingredients together.
2. Knead mix on slightly floured surface.
3. For best results, let this lie for 2 to 3 hours.
4. Knead onto pan, making small crust edge on outside of pan.
5. Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes, until baked through.
title: Pizza Crust

steps: 1. Cream sugar, butter and shortening.
2. Add egg yolks, beating after each addition. Dissolve soda in buttermilk and add alternately with flour to egg mixture.
3. Add coconut.
4. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites.
5. Add vanilla and nuts.
6. Bake in three 8-inch greased and floured pans in a moderate oven at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.
7. Cool and frost with cream cheese frosting.
title: Italian Cream Cheese

steps: 1. Slice chicken into 1 x 1-inch pieces.
2. Saute mushrooms.
3. Soak chicken in egg for 1 hour.
4. Roll chicken in bread crumbs.
5. Brown chicken in butter.
6. Place chicken and juices into casserole dish. Cover with mushroom and chicken broth.
7. Top with cheese.
8. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
title: Italian Chicken

steps: 1. Melt oleo in casserole dish.
2. Saute onions and carrots.
3. Add rice and saute until opaque.
4. Add bouillon cubes, bay leaf, salt, thyme and water.
5. Bring to boil.
6. Simmer 15 to 20 minutes.
7. Stir in parsley.
8. Serves 12.
title: Risotto (Rice With Vegetables)

steps: 1. Mix together until smooth in a large microwave-safe bowl.
2. Add 3 cups boiling water; stir well.
3. Cover with Saran wrap and microwave on High for 7 to 10 minutes.
4. Remove; stir well.
5. If too thick, more water may be added.
6. Put back into microwave for 7 to 10 more minutes on High.
7. This is done in 15 to 20 minutes. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Polenta(Microwave)

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 lb. new potatoes, cut into quarters

steps: 1. Place potatoes in microwave-safe dish.
2. Drizzle with oil; sprinkle with basil, oregano, garlic, salt and pepper.
3. Cover with waxed paper; microwave on High for 7 to 9 minutes, or until potatoes are tender.
4. Stir halfway through cooking time.
5. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese; microwave 1 minute on High.
6. Makes 4 servings.
title: Easy Italian Potatoes(Microwave)

steps: 1. Partially boil potatoes with skins.
2. When cool, cut into quarters.
3. Place on a cookie sheet sprayed with nonstick cooking spray.
4. Sprinkle dressing over top and bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.
5. Potatoes should be nicely browned.
6. Serves 4.
7. Each serving contains 88 calories, 2.3 g protein, 0 fat, 0 chol. and 67 mg sodium.
title: Potatoes Italian

steps: 1. In bowl, whisk together vinegar, oregano, basil, garlic, salt and pepper to taste.
2. Add the oil in a stream, whisking, and whisk the marinade well.
3. In a large resealable plastic bag, combine vegetables with marinade.
4. Seal the bag, pressing out excess air. Let marinate overnight in refrigerator, turning the bag several times.
5. Serve on a bed of torn lettuce.
6. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Antipasto Salad

steps: 1. Cook ziti as package directs.
2. Saute mushrooms in butter for 5 minutes.
3. Combine them with cream, broccoli and basil.
4. Cook about 5 minutes.
5. Add ziti, salt and pepper, continuing to cook a few minutes longer.
6. Remove from heat; add Parmesan cheese and mix well.
7. Serves 6.
title: Ziti With Broccoli

steps: 1. In large skillet saute
2. green pepper, onion, garlic and basil in heated olive oil.
3. Saute until all peppers are tender but not brown.
4. Stir
5. in
6. rice,
7. tomatoes, salt, pepper, water and bouillon cubes.
8. Cook covered over
9. low
10. heat for 20 to 25 minutes.
11. Makes 10 to 12 servings.
title: Rice With Tomatoes(Risotto Con Pomodoro)

steps: 1. Steam carrots, zucchini, corn and green beans until tender; put aside to cool.
2. Cook pasta according to package directions; drain and set aside to cool.
3. Using blender or food processor, puree cottage cheese until smooth.
4. Blend in skim milk, basil and parsley.
5. Combine vegetables and pasta.
6. Pour sauce over vegetables and pasta; mix thoroughly.
7. Serve at room temperature. Serves 6.
title: Fettuccine With Vegetables

steps: 1. Look for good yellow/orange color; hard squash that is heavy. Wash squash.
2. Pierce with tip of sharp knife in several places. Allows steam to escape.
3. Place squash on paper towel in microwave. Microwave uncovered on High 18 to 23 minutes, turning over after 8 minutes, until tender when pierced with tip of sharp knife.
4. Let stand uncovered 10 minutes.
5. Cut crosswise in half; remove seeds and fibers.
6. Scrape fork across squash to pull flesh into strands. Serve with spaghetti or clam cause or serve with sprinkled grated cheese.
7. Yields 4 servings, 60 calories per serving.
title: Squash Spaghetti(Microwave)

steps: 1. In a 1-quart casserole dish, stir green onions, butter, parsley flakes, Italian seasoning and salt together.
2. Microwave, covered, on High for 1 1/2 to 2 minutes or until onions are tender.
3. Stir in potatoes.
4. Cook, covered, on High for 5 to 7 minutes.
5. Add Parmesan cheese, tossing to coat.
6. Makes 4 servings.
title: Italian Herbed Potatoes

steps: 1. Cook noodles and drain.
2. Melt the butter, then add rest of ingredients.
3. Pour over noodles and toss lightly.
title: Noodles Alfredo

ingredients.text: 1 1/4 lb butternut squash, peeled, cut into 3/4 inch pieces
1 None medium red onion, peeled, halved, cut into thick wedges
1 None large red pepper, cut into 3/4 inch pieces
7 oz fresh reduced-fat ricotta cheese, crumbled

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 400°F. Line a baking tray with parchment paper.
2. Arrange squash, onion, pepper and tomatoes on prepared tray. Lightly coat with olive oil and season. Bake for 30 mins, or until vegetables are browned and tender.
3. Cook gnocchi in boiling, salted water for 5 mins, or until they float to the surface. Use a slotted spoon to remove gnocchi from pan and distribute between serving bowls.
4. Arrange vegetables and ricotta over gnocchi and drizzle with oil. Top with basil. Serve immediately.
title: Gnocchi With Roasted Vegetables

steps: 1. Cook broccoli to tender crisp and cool slightly.
2. In a large bowl, add broccoli, onions, black olives and peppers.
3. Add Italian dressing and toss to coat evenly.
4. Chill for 1-2 hours and stir before serving.
5. Serve as a salad or over pasta.
title: Italian Broccoli Salad

ingredients.text: 3 ounces green beans, chopped into small pieces

steps: 1. Heat oil and butter in large pan, add onions, cook over medium heat until onions are pale golden brown. Add carrots, cook 2 to 3 minutes, stirring occasionally. Repeat this procedure with the potatoes, then the celery, zucchini, beans and cabbage.
2. Stir in water, crumbled stock cubes and undrained, mashed tomatoes. Bring to boil, reduce heat, cover, simmer 1 1/2 to 2 hours or until soup is thick.
3. During last 15 minutes of cooking, stir in cannellini beans.
4. Season with salt and pepper. If desired, grated parmesan cheese can be stirred into the soup before serving or served separately with the soup.
title: Minestrone

steps: 1. In a large saucepan, slowly pour water into the cornmeal, stirring constantly, until free of lumps. Stir in rest of water and salt. Cook on medium-low heat for 20 to 30 minutes, stirring frequently, until thick and smooth. Be especially vigilant during last 10 minutes to prevent scorching. When polenta is done, spoon will stand up in the middle and mass will cling together and pull away from the sides. Remove from heat and turn onto countertop, baking sheet or cutting board that has been wet down with cold water to prevent sticking. Smooth out polenta with spatula. Let cool 30 minutes. Brush the bottom and sides of baking dish with some of the melted butter. Brush the rest of the butter on top of the polenta. Cut the polenta into small rounds. Take all of the little 4-sided pieces of the polenta from between the rounds and place them in a baking dish. On top of these, make an overlapping row of rounds leaning up against the sides of the dish (like tile roof tops). Crumble Gorgonzola over the top and bake in a 450° oven for 20 minutes. Can be covered and refrigerated until baking time.
title: Polenta Gnocchi With Gorgonzola

steps: 1. Cook linguine according to package directions. Meanwhile, in a large bowl, combine the cucumber, tomatoes and onions. Drain linguine; rinse under cold water. Add linguine to vegetable mixture. Drizzle with dressing; toss to coat. Refrigerate until serving.
title: Italian Linguine Salad

steps: 1. Boil a large pot of water enough to cover the spagetti squash.
2. Cut the spaghetti squash into 4 pieces.
3. Season with whatever you want, i used garlic salt and onion powder.
4. Once boiling add the squash, onions, garlic and butter.
5. Cook for 20 min covered.
6. Remove and separate spaghetti from the skin.
title: Easy Spaghetti Squash

steps: 1. Bring sugar, oil, vinegar, celery, mustard and salt to a boil. Let cool before pouring over cabbage.
2. Marinate in a covered dish.
title: Italian Slaw

ingredients.text: 1 (3 pound) spaghetti squash, halved and seeded

steps: 1. Combine spaghetti squash, vegetable broth, rosemary, and salt in a multi-functional pressure cooker (such as Instant Pot(R)). Close and lock the lid. Select high pressure according to manufacturer's instructions; set timer for 7 minutes. Allow 10 to 15 minutes for pressure to build.
2. Release pressure carefully using the quick-release method according to manufacturer's instructions, about 5 minutes. Unlock and remove lid.
title: Easy Instant Pot® Spaghetti Squash

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 400°F.
2. Combine first eleven ingredients in a 4 quart baking dish.
3. Cover tightly and bake for 1 hour, stirring once or twice.
4. Blend in remaining ingredients. Cover and bake until cheese melts, about 10 minutes.
5. Serve immediately.
title: Italian Cheese Chowder

steps: 1. cut squash in half and seed. place 1/4 inch water in microwave-safe dish. place squash in the dihs, the cut sides down- the sides will overlap. cover with plastic wrap and microwave on high for 13 minutes. shred squash and add 1/4 cup cooking liquid to it in large bowl.
2. dress with olive oil and cheese. season and serve.
title: Cacio E Pepe Spaghetti Squash

steps: 1. Boil and drain spaghetti.
2. Cut cleaned vegetables in small pieces.
3. Toss in a large bowl.
4. Add spaghetti and Salad Supreme to taste.
5. Add Italian salad dressing, about 1 cup, a little at a time.
6. You may need more dressing according to size of vegetables.
title: Spaghetti Salad

ingredients.text: 2 small zucchini, sliced or 1 (16 oz.) can
3 beef bouillon cubes, in 1 1/2 c. hot water

steps: 1. Slice sausage in 1/2-inch rings and brown in oil.
2. Add onion and carrot and cook 5 minutes more.
3. Add bouillon and remaining ingredients except beans.
4. Simmer for 1 hour.
5. Add beans and cook 20 minutes more.
6. Put in 1 tablespoon sugar and 1/4 teaspoon pepper during the last 20 minutes of cooking.
title: Minestrone

steps: 1. Combine salad ingredients, drizzle with dressing.
2. Chill 2 hours before serving.
title: Italian Market Salad

ingredients.text: 3 lbs spaghetti squash, cooked and cooled enough to handle
10 ounces frozen spinach, thawed and squeezed

steps: 1. Pre heat oven to 350.
2. Split cooked squash lengthwise and remove seeds. Use fork to pull off in long strands. Place in large mixing bowl and toss with flour, garlic, and salt until well combined.
3. Blend ricotta, spinach and parmesan in food processor until smooth.

4. To assemble spread 1/2 cup pasta sauce on the bottom of shallow 6 cup baking dish. Top with spaghetti squash, arranging evenly and compactly. Top spaghetti squash with ricotta mixture. Spread remaining pasta sauce over ricotta. Cover with sliced mozzarella.
5. Place lasagna dish on baking sheet, bake uncovered for 40 to 50 minutes in a 350 oven or until cheese is lightly brown on edges and juices bubble.
title: Spaghetti Squash Lasagna (No Pasta Noodles)
