steps: 1. Pierce squash several times with a fork; place in an 11 x 7-inch baking dish. Microwave, uncovered, at HIGH 6 minutes. Cut in half lengthwise; discard seeds. Place squash, cut sides up, in baking dish; add water. Cover tightly with heavy-duty plastic wrap, turning back 1 corner to allow steam to escape. Microwave at HIGH 5 minutes or until tender. Drain and cool 15 minutes.
2. While squash cools, melt butter in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Add onion and garlic; saute 2 to 3 minutes or until onion is tender.

3. Using a fork, remove spaghetti-like strands from squash. Add strands (about 3 cups) to pan; cook 2 minutes or until thoroughly heated. Transfer to a bowl; add Parmesan cheese and remaining ingredients, and toss well.
title: Lemon-Sage Spaghetti Squash

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
2. Halve the squash and scrape out the seeds, arrange in a baking dish, cut sides down, Add 1/2 inch of water to the dish and cover it with foil.
3. Bake the squash 45 minutes or until it is slightly soft when pressed.
4. Scrape the stringy flesh with a fork and put into a bowl. Then toss the squash shreds with the butter, salt and pepper to taste.
5. Stir in parsley if desired.
title: Buttered Spaghetti Squash

steps: 1. Cut squash in half lengthwise, remove seeds. Place squash, cut side up, in a microwave-safe dish with 1/4 cup water. Cover with vented microwave-safe plastic wrap; cook on high for 7-10 minutes, depending on size. Add more cooking, 1 minute at a time, if necessary. Let stand 5 minutes. With fork "comb" out strands. Do not discard shell. Saute sausage, bell peppers, onion, garlic in a large skillet over medium-high heat until sausage browns and vegetables are tender. Mix in spaghetti sauce and dried oregano or Italian spices. Mix squash strands with sausage mixture. Spoon filling into squash shells. Place filled squash shells on baking sheet. Sprinkle with grated cheese. Bake uncovered until heated through, about 20 minutes.
title: Low-Carb Spaghetti Squash

ingredients.text: 12 ounces penne pasta, cooked, drained and cooled

steps: 1. Combine sour cream, milk, mayonnaise, sugar, parsley, vinegar and black pepper in a blender. Process until smooth and creamy. Cover and refrigerate 45 minute.
2. Combine cooked pasta, peas and bell peppers into a large bowl.
3. Pour dressing over top and toss slightly until ingredients are coated.
4. Serve immediately or cover and refrigerate and serve within 2 days.
5. Time does not include the 45 minutes for the dressing in the refrigerator.
title: Penne Salad With Peppers And Peas

steps: 1. Mix together and press into pizza pan or 2 pie pans.
2. Bake 20 minutes at 450°.
3. Top with favorite pizza topping as with any regular pizza sauce, meats and cheese, etc.
4. Bake 10 minutes, longer.
title: Rice Pizza

ingredients.text: 1 lb asparagus, trimmed to 2 inch lengths

steps: 1. Prepare the pasta according to the package directions.

2. Meanwhile, heat the oil in a large nonstick pan, over medium-high heat. Add the tomato, garlic, and red pepper flakes; cook stirring occasionally until the tomato is softened, about 5 minutes. Add the asparagus, broth and lemon juice; bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer until the asparagus is tender, about 3 minutes longer.
3. Add the pasta, ham, basil and parmesan to the pan; toss to combine.
title: Penne With Asparagus, Ham, And Basil (Weight Watchers)

steps: 1. Bring water to the boil with salt and crushed garlic. Gradually sprinkle in cornmeal, stirring constantly until mixture thickens. Reduce heat to low and stir constantly for 5-10 minutes until very thick.
2. Spoon mixture in a greased lamington tin and smooth evenly. Allow to cool for 1 hour.
3. Turn polenta out of tin and cut into 4cm squares. Heat olive oil and butter in a pan and fry pieces on both sides until golden brown, about 5 minutes.
4. Serve with your favourite pasta sauce or as an accompaniment to grilled and roast meats.
title: Fried Polenta

steps: 1. Cut the ham, cheese, tomatoes, celery and pepper into bite-size pieces.
2. Add to the cold cooked spaghetti.
3. Add the Italian dressing and toss well.
4. Chill well before serving.
title: Spaghetti Salad

ingredients.text: 3 cups Medium Mushrooms (Shitake or Porcini), stems removed

steps: 1. Bring a large pot of generously salted water to a boil.

2. Heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in a large pan or skillet over medium heat and saute mushrooms, seasoned with salt and covered, for 15-20 minutes, or until softened. Stir occasionally and reduce heat if mushrooms start to burn.
3. Add spinach to mushrooms and pour in lemon juice ( I used 2 T of lemon juice). Cook until wilted, then add walnuts.
4. Cook pasta according to packaging directions, or until just al dente. Drain (reserving 1/2 cup pasta water) and set aside.
5. Add heavy cream to the spinach and mushrooms, stirring well, and mix in Parmesan cheese. If sauce is too thick, add pasta water one tablespoon at a time.
6. Taste and season with salt and pepper if necessary.
7. Pour drained pasta into the sauce and toss will to coat thoroughly. Cook on low heat for 5 minutes, or until sauce thickens and sticks to pasta.
title: Creamy Penne Florentine With Mushrooms And Spinach

steps: 1. Toss all until well coated.
2. Add Parmesan cheese last and toss again.
3. Make ahead of time as it tastes better.
4. Enjoy!!
title: Pasta Pizza Salad

ingredients.text: 1 spaghetti squash, halved lengthwise and seeded

steps: 1. The oven must be at high degree before cooking.
2. Put the squash, in a medium baking pan.
3. Bake the squash in the hot oven for about one hour.
4. Slush the flesh of the squash with a sharp fork and put in a bowl.
5. Add pine nuts. Make tastier with cheese and butter. Add salt and pepper as much as desired.
6. Serve immediately. Bon Appetit!
title: Spaghetti Squash Recipe

ingredients.text: 1 lb asparagus (trimmed, and cut into 2-inch pieces)

steps: 1. Mix garlic powder into dressing.
2. Toss dressing with asparagus.
3. Roast asparagus in 400 degree oven for 15 to 20 minutes.
4. Sprinkle with parmesean and place under broiler for about 3 minutes.
title: Roasted Italian Asparagus With Parmesan

ingredients.text: 100 g grape tomatoes, cut in halves

steps: 1. Put the spaghetti on boil, partially covered, with about 3 cups water and 1/2 teaspoon of salt.
2. In a separate pan, heat 1 teaspoon olive oil. Add the grape tomatoes and sautee for 2 minute Add the grated garlic and stir to coat tomatoes with them, about 20 seconds.
3. Add the chopped spinach, toss with the tomatoes. Cook for about 3 min, until spinach is wilted. Add the basil and stir. Turn off heat and wait until spaghetti is done.

4. When spaghetti is done, drain about 1/2 cup of cooking liquid from spaghetti into the pan with the spinach and tomatoes and start heat on low. Discard the remaining cooking liquid if any. Add the grated parmesan to the pan and bring to a boil for about 30 seconds, mixing to make sure the parmesan melts.
5. Pour the contents of the pan into the spaghetti pot and stir over a medium flame until liquid is almost gone, 2-3 minutes. Done!
6. Tip: The spinach tends to clump together because of the cheese. You can separate it or leave it; the spinach clumps have a nice texture of their own.
7. Tip: I was surprised to discover this tastes almost as good with no cheese at all. So you can make a much healthier version. It is also tolerant to different amounts of olive oil.
title: Spinach And Grape Tomato Spaghetti

ingredients.text: 1 cup chopped fresh spinach, tightly packed

steps: 1. Heat olive oil in large skillet.
2. Add garlic, onin and spinach and saute until onion is soft and spinach just wilted.
3. Remove from heat and stir in Ricotta cheese.
4. Spread mixture over dough, leaving 1/2 to 1 inch border.
5. Layer remaining ingredients.
title: Spinach Pizza Topping

steps: 1. In a greased quart dish arrange half the potatoes and half the onion.
2. Sprinkle with half the cheese (both); repeat layers.
3. Heat oven to 400°.
4. In small bowl combine soup, milk, Italian seasoning and garlic powder; spoon over potatoes.
5. Cover and bake one hour. Uncover; bake 10 minutes or until potatoes are tender.
title: Italian Scalloped Potatoes

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Wash potatoes and cut into thin wedges. Put into a bowl and stir in Italian Dressing. Coat a 9x13 pan with the olive oil and spread potatoes on top. Cook 45-60 minutes or until golden brown.
title: Italian Baked French Fries

steps: 1. Cook noodles.
2. Cook milk, cornstarch, and onion, stirring frequently, until thick and bubbly.
3. Then cook 2 more minutes.
4. Spread 2 tbs sauce in dish.
5. Place 3 noodles in bottom.
6. Layer everything else except 1/2 cup mozzarella.
7. Arrange 3 noodles on top and add remaining mozzarella.
8. Bake 30 minutes at 375°F.
title: Ham And Broccoli White Lasagna

ingredients.text: 1 medium zucchini, halved lengthwise and cut into 1/4-inch-thick slices
1 medium yellow onion, cut into 1/4-inch-thick rounds
1 large red bell pepper, cut into 1/4-inch-thick slivers
8 ounces penne pasta (I used homemade fettucini noodles, but any pasta will work)

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 500°F.
2. In a medium bowl, add zucchini, tomatoes, eggplant, onion, bell pepper, 2 teaspoons basil, 2 tablespoons vinegar, oil, salt, pepper, and toss.
3. Place in a single layer on a large cookie sheet lined with foil and bake 15 to 20 minutes or until vegetables are tender when pierced with a knife and just beginning to brown.
4. Cook pasta. Drain and transfer to a large bowl.
5. Add sour cream, vegetables, 2 teaspoons basil, 2 tablespoons vinegar, and toss to combine.
6. Crumble feta cheese over the top.
title: Roasted Balsamic Vegetables With Penne

steps: 1. Grate cabbage and carrot. Chop onion.
2. Pour 3/4 cup sugar over and mix.
3. Bring rest of ingredients to a boil and pour over cabbage mixture.
4. Mix.
5. Will keep weeks in refrigerator.
title: Italian Cole Slaw

steps: 1. 1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees F.
2. 2. Line rimmed sheet pan with parchment paper or use a casserole dish.

3. 3. n a large mixing bowl add 2 garlic cloves, breadcrumbs, parsley, onion, egg, 1 teaspoon Italian seasoning, 1 teaspoon salt, and 1/2 teaspoon black pepper. Stir until combined and add ground beef; mix by hand until just incorporated.
4. 4. Form 1" meatballs and place in a single layer on sheet pan. Meatballs should be touching. Drizzle with olive oil and bake 20 minutes.
5. 5. Meanwhile bring a large stock pot of water to a boil and season generously with salt. Cook pasta according to al dente package directions.
6. 6. Drain in colander and rinse with water; set aside.

7. 7. Return pot to stove over medium heat and add 1 tablespoon olive oil, remaining Italian seasoning, and remaining garlic; saute for 2 minutes. Season with 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper. Stir in broth and crushed tomatoes and bring to a boil; simmer 5 to 8 minutes.
title: Spaghetti And Meatball Soup

ingredients.text: 1 small yellow onion, cut in half and very thinly sliced

steps: 1. Cut the spaghetti squash in half and remove the seeds. Place in a covered dish with a 1/4 inch of water and microwave for 10 -12 minutes.
2. In a medium sized skillet over medium heat, add the butter, onions, red pepper and thyme and cook until the onions are slightly brown in color. Salt and pepper to taste.
3. Using a fork, scrape the insides of the squash and transfer to a small bowl.
4. Combine the squash, onions, sour cream and half the cheese together and mix well. Transfer the mixture to a buttered baking dish and top with remaining cheese.
5. Place into a 375° for 15 - 20 minutes until golden brown on top.
title: Spaghetti Squash Au Gratin

steps: 1. 1. Wash cauliflower and dry thoroughly; cut into smaller chunks, about 1.5 inches or so.
2. 2. Preheat oil to 350 degrees F.
3. 3. Coat cauliflower pieces in egg, then roll in breadcrumbs.
4. 4. Gently place breaded pieces in hot oil, cook until browned.
5. 5. Remove from oil with slotted spoon, place on a plate lined with paper towel.
title: Italian Fried Cauliflower

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 450 F.

2. Split the squash in half from stem to bottom and scrape out seeds. Line a rimmed baking tray with aluminum foil. Season the flesh of the spaghetti squash with olive oil and salt. Place the halves into the pan flesh side down and roast for 30 minutes.

3. Here's the trick ... When done remove pan from oven and set it on a rack. Let the squash "steam" for about 15 minutes, flesh side down. Turn it back over and let it cool until you are able to handle it.
4. Scrape the flesh out with a large fork. Serve!
title: Perfectly-Roasted Spaghetti Squash

ingredients.text: 1 cup raw, grated (or chopped in food processor) cauliflower*

steps: 1. Makes 4, 1-slice servings. Can be doubled for a larger pizza
2. Preheat oven to 450 degrees.

3. Spray a cookie sheet with non-stick spray or use parchment paper. (Optional: Use coconut oil and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese before laying dough onto baking surface. Increases calories but I like health benefits of coconut oil. Some in this forum may not appreciate using this oil.)
4. In a medium bowl, combine cauliflower, egg, mozzarella and all desired spices. Press evenly on baking pan or pizza stone.
5. Bake at 450 degrees for 12-15 minutes (up to 20 minutes if you double the recipe). You may turn over once if desired.

6. Remove the pan from the oven. To the crust, add sauce, then toppings and cheese. (Get creative and top with chopped apples and cheese or your own combinations of whatever you like on a pizza. Some examples to choose from are jack cheese, onion, fresh or dried tomatoes, artichokes, shredded/cooked chicken, turkey pepperoni, pineapple, mushrooms, marinara sauce, bell peppers, whatever peppers you like, fresh mushrooms, fresh basil...your imagination is the limit.)
7. Place under broiler, on high heat, until cheese is melted.
8. Reheats nicely and can still be held in the hand, even the next day. (If you don't press "dough" too thin, make small rounds and add enough egg to hold together.)
9. Pizza crusts can be frozen after the initial baking and used later.

10. *If using frozen cauliflower, prepare according to package directions. After cooked and slightly cooled, shred cauliflower with a cheese grater, (or grater blade on food processor) and then measure for the recipe. (An "unpacked/loose" cup.) Be sure to drain WELL.
11. Guestimate~Approximately 2 1/4 cups of 1" cauliflower would grate into one cup of grated (or riced) cauliflower.
12. For lower calories, substitute two egg whites for whole egg and low or no fat mozzarella cheese.
13. Don't spread this too thin or it will fall apart; if it's too thick, it's doughy in the middle.
title: Cauliflower Pizza

steps: 1. Cook fettuccine as label directs; adding spinach for the last 5 minutes of cooking; drain.
2. In saucepan, mix milk and cornstarch until smooth.
3. Add butter and salt.
4. Cook on med-hi heat, stirring, until mixture boils.
5. Stir in Parmesan and bleu cheese.
6. Add to drained fettuccine; toss to coat well.
7. Sprinkle with parsley.
title: Cheese And Spinach Fettuccine

ingredients.text: 1 medium butternut squash (3 pounds), peeled, seeded and cut into 1/2-inch cubes

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 425°. Divide squash between 2 greased 15x10x1-in. baking pans. Drizzle with oil; toss to coat. Bake, uncovered, stirring occasionally, until tender, 20-25 minutes.

2. Meanwhile, cook noodles according to package directions. In a small saucepan, combine milk and rosemary. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat; simmer, uncovered, for 10 minutes. Strain, reserving milk, and set aside. Discard rosemary.

3. In a Dutch oven, heat butter over medium heat. Add garlic; saute 1 minute. Stir in flour, salt and pepper until blended. Gradually add milk. Bring to a boil. Cook and stir until slightly thickened, about 2 minutes. Reserve 1 cup sauce; stir squash into remaining sauce.

4. Reduce oven setting to 375°. Drain noodles. Spread reserved sauce into a greased 13x9-in. baking dish. Layer with 3 noodles, half of squash mixture, half of fontina cheese and 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese. Repeat layers. Top with remaining noodles. Beat cream until soft peaks form. Spread over top. Sprinkle with remaining Parmesan cheese.
5. Bake, covered, for 30 minutes. Uncover; bake until bubbly and golden brown, 10-15 minutes longer. Let stand for 15 minutes before cutting.
title: Golden Butternut Squash Lasagna

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees F. Prick potatoes all over with fork. Bake 70 minutes or until soft. Cool 10 minutes or until easy to handle.

2. Lightly flour baking sheet. Slice potatoes in half and scoop flesh into large bowl. Mash until no lumps remain, but potatoes are still fluffy. Fold in flour, egg, salt and pepper. Divide dough into 8 balls and transfer to lightly floured work surface.

3. Roll 1 dough ball into long strand about 3/4" thick. Cut into 1" pieces, and place pieces on prepared baking sheet (although this is not mentioned in magazine, now is the time to get fancy making indentations with a fork if you so choose, so that your gnocchi will have the pretty, familiar pattern -- just roll each 1" piece between your palms a bit then press with the tines of a fork before placing on baking sheet). Repeat with remaining balls of dough.

4. Bring large pot of water to a boil. Drop quarter of cut gnocchi into pot and cook 2 minutes, or until gnocchi rise to surface (my gnocchi were extremely fat, so I let them boil about a minute after they popped to the surface and they seemed to come out fine). Transfer to serving bowl, and repeat with remaining gnocchi. If serving later, toss with vegetable oil to keep gnocchi from sticking together. Otherwise, top with desired sauce and serve.

5. I found that I only needed half of these for a VERY FILLING dinner for two. The other half kept quite well in the fridge tossed with oil to be served with another sauce on another night; I just reheated them by boiling for a couple of minutes. The good news is that these can be frozen quite easily. While they are spread on their baking sheet, freeze them through, then pop them in freezer bags until needed. To heat, place frozen gnocchi in boiling water for 7 to 8 minutes. Make a lot and have homemade yumminess whenever you want.
title: Potato Gnocchi

steps: 1. 1. Preheat oven to 375°F. Pierce squash with knife a couple of times. Place on baking sheet and place in oven for about 1 hour, or until the squash is easily pierced with a knife. Increase oven temperature to 400°F.

2. 2. Let cool and slice in half. Remove seeds from squash with spoon. Scoop out squash insides into a large bowl. Add olive oil, mozzarella cheese, thyme, oregano, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder and paprika. Mix together until evenly distributed.

3. 3. In an 8x8 glass baking dish, place squash mixture in pan. Spread evenly. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese on top evenly. Sprinkle panko on top evenly. Place in oven and cook until panko becomes golden brown, about 20 minutes. Serve immediately and enjoy.
title: Cheesy Spaghetti Squash

ingredients.text: 2 garlic cloves, chopped, large (3 if small)

steps: 1. Using a 4 liter pot, cover the rice with water and bring to boil.
2. Simmer for 20 minutes, then cool until cold.
3. Add the eggs, parmesan cheese, salt, parsley and garlic and mix by hand.
4. Mold the balls into desired shape.
5. Then fill a deep frying pan with mazzola oil ...enough to cover at least half of a rice ball...heat oil and carefully add the rice balls.
6. The balls will cook fast, so make sure to turn them quickly, when golden brown place on plate to cool.
title: Italian Rice Balls

steps: 1. Rinse broccoli; cut into flowerets.
2. Cook in boiling salted water for 5 minutes.
3. Drain.
4. Peel and chop onion.
5. Clean and slice mushrooms.
6. Heat butter in a large skillet.
7. Saute onion and mushrooms with basil, oregano and salt until soft.
8. Add broccoli. Sprinkle with flour.
9. Stir to combine.
10. Add milk.
11. Heat to a boil, stirring.
12. Lower the heat.
13. Cook for 3 to 4 minutes.
14. Add Cheddar cheese and half of Parmesan.
title: Penne With Broccoli

ingredients.text: 1 cup fresh okra (or 1 package frozen cut okra)

steps: 1. Clean and wash okra. Dice all but 6. Add 3 cups of water to a large saucepan. Add salt. Add diced and whole okra. Bring okra to boil for 5 minutes. Remove pan from heat. Save whole okra aside for garnish.
2. Measure 2 cups of liquid from the cooked okra to use for cooking your cou-cou.
3. Mix cornmeal in a large bowl with enough cold water to moisten and blend it together. Stir the cornmeal slowly into the reserved liquid and okra. Use a wooden spoon to mix together.

4. Return pot to stove over medium heat, and continue stirring okra and cornmeal. Cook and stir about 15-20 minutes. Insert wooden spoon into center of the cou-cou If spoon stands up in the pot and is easily removed from cornmeal, your cou-cou is done.
5. Cou-cou should be firm when it's done. If the cou-cou is oose and creamy looking, you have used too much water. If too much water is used, let cou-cou stand uncovered over low heat to "dry out."
6. When cou-cou is done, turn the entire mixture into a buttered serving bowl and garnish with whole okra.
title: Cou Cou (Caribbean Polenta)

steps: 1. Slice the squash in half lengthwise and scoop out the seeds. Place squash, cut side down, in a baking dish. Add water and cover tightly with foil. Bake at 375° for 20-30 minutes or until easily pierced with a fork.

2. Meanwhile, melt butter in skillet. Add the onion, garlic, mushrooms, herbs and seasonings; saute until onion is transparent. Add the tomatoes; cook until most of the liquid has evaporated. Set aside.
3. Scoop out the squash, separating strands with a fork.
4. Combine squash, tomato mixture and all remaining ingredients except Parmesan cheese. Pour into a greased 2-qt. casserole. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
5. Bake, uncovered at 375° for 40 minutes or until heated through and top is golden brown.
title: Fresh Spaghetti Squash Casserole

ingredients.text: 2 to 3 small potatoes (unpeeled), cut into 3/4-inch pieces
1 1/2 medium red onions, cut in 1-inch pieces

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 400°. Combine first 8 ingredients in a large roasting pan. Add olive oil and toss to coat well.
2. Bake until vegetables are tender, stirring occasionally, about 45 minutes. Add broccoli.
3. Bake until crisp and tender (about 10 minutes).
title: Oven Roasted Vegetables With Rigatoni

steps: 1. Place whole potatoes in a pot covered with water to cover. Bring to a boil and simmer until they are soft, about 45-50 minutes. Peel the skins from the potatoes while they're still warm. Use a food mill or potato ricer on the finest setting and pass the potatoes through onto a clean work surface.

2. Make a well in the center of the potatoes and sprinkle with all of the flour. Add the egg and salt to the center of the well and use a fork to pierce the yolk. Beat the egg with the fork gradually incorporating the potato and flour. Once the egg is mixed in, bring the dough together and knead until the dough ball is dry to the touch, about 4-5 minutes.
title: Potato Gnocchi From Scratch

ingredients.text: 1 spaghetti squash, halved lengthwise and seeded

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Lightly grease a baking sheet.

2. Place spaghetti squash with cut sides down on the prepared baking sheet, and bake 30 minutes in the preheated oven, or until a sharp knife can be inserted with only a little resistance. Remove squash from oven and set aside to cool enough to be easily handled.

3. Meanwhile, heat oil in a skillet over medium heat. Cook and stir onion in oil until tender. Add garlic; cook and stir until fragrant, 2 to 3 minutes. Stir in tomatoes and cook until tomatoes are warmed through.
4. Use a large spoon to scoop the stringy pulp from the squash and place in a medium bowl. Toss with the vegetables, feta cheese, olives, and basil. Serve warm.
title: Spaghetti Squash I

ingredients.text: 1 pound prepared pizza dough, room temperature
3/4 pound fresh asparagus, trimmed and cut into 2-inch pieces

steps: 1. Grease a large

4. Sprinkle crust with mozzarella and feta cheeses; top with asparagus. Bake at 450&deg until crust is golden and cheese is melted, 10-15 minutes. Sprinkle with lemon zest and red pepper flakes. Top with anchovy fillets if desired.

ingredients.text: 1/4 c. grated or shredded Parmesan cheese

steps: 1. Stab squash several times (to keep it from exploding) and put it in your microwave on High for 12 to 15 minutes.
2. Then slice it open and scoop out and discard the seeds.
3. Now take a fork and start scraping at the "meat" of the squash.
4. Simply stir in everything else.
5. Stir until the butter is melted and serve.

title: Zucchini And Bell Pepper Frittata

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 375°.
2. Crumble sausage into a large skillet. Cook over medium heat for 5 to 7 minutes, breaking up clumps, until cooked through and lightly browned.
3. Remove from skillet and drain.
4. Spoon into 10-inch pie pan. Top with hash browns and Cheddar cheese.
5. Beat eggs with milk and pepper.
6. Pour over hash browns and cheese.
7. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
8. Bake 30 to 35 minutes until slightly puffed and a knife inserted in center comes out clean.
9. Makes 6 servings.
title: Breakfast Pizza

steps: 1. Preheat to 350 degrees.

2. Saute onion and mushrooms in nonstick, ovenproof 12" skillet over medium-high heat until soft and most of liquid from mushrooms has cooked off, about 10 minutes. Add spinach leaves and saute an additional 5 minutes. Remove from heat.
3. Whisk eggs together with cheeses and remaining ingredients.
4. Pour egg mixture into skillet of spinach and mushroom mixture, stirring to combine.
5. Bake for 15 minutes or until set. Let stand 5 minutes before cutting into 8 wedges.
title: Veggie Frittata With Spinach And Mushrooms

ingredients.text: 1 cup Shredded Cheese (Cheddar, Swiss Or Combination), Divided

steps: 1. In a medium cast iron (or other oven proof) skillet, press the shredded potatoes down into it and let them get crispy and golden for 8 minutes over medium heat. Add the bacon, onion, mushrooms, Brussels sprouts and thyme and saute for 5 minutes or until tender and bacon is crisp. Stir in 1/2 cup of the cheese.

2. Whisk together milk, eggs and pepper and pour into the skillet. Let cook for about 5 minutes or until the edges are cooked through. Top with the remaining cheese and place skillet under the broiler for 5 more minutes, until it is golden brown and bubbly.
title: Cheesy Bacon And Brussels Sprouts Frittata

ingredients.text: 1 bunch Asparagus, Tough Ends Removed Then Cut Into 1/2 Inch Pieces

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350 F.
2. In a medium bowl, whisk together eggs, milk, salt, pepper, garlic powder and basil. Set aside.

3. In a large (8 to 10 inch) cast iron skillet, heat olive oil over medium heat. Saute asparagus for 5-10 minutes, or until tender. Add cooked and crumbled bacon into the skillet and stir to combine. Pour egg mixture over asparagus mixture. Top with mozzarella cheese.

4. Remove skillet from the stove top and put it into the oven. Bake for 20-25 minutes or until lightly browned on top and middle is set. Remove from oven and let it cool for 5 minutes. Serve immediately. Enjoy!
title: Asparagus And Bacon Frittata

ingredients.text: 1 1/4 lb butternut squash, peeled, deseeded, diced
1 None medium red onion, cut into thin wedges

steps: 1. Preheat broiler.

2. Heat olive oil in an 8 inch frying pan. Cook squash and onion over medium heat, covered loosely and stirring occasionally, for 15 mins, or until tender. Add garlic and cook until fragrant. Whisk together eggs, milk and 1 tbsp chives. Season then pour over squash mixture. Drop spoonfuls of ricotta over top and sprinkle with Parmesan. Cook over low heat, uncovered, for 5 mins, or until edges are set.
3. Transfer to oven and broil until lightly browned and just set. Sprinkle with remaining chives.
title: Squash And Ricotta Frittata

ingredients.text: 1/3 cups Shredded Reduced-Fat Extra-Sharp Cheddar Cheese

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°F.

2. Coat a frying pan with cooking spray and place over medium high heat. Add onion to the pan and saute for 2 minutes or until lightly browned. Add ham into the pan and saute with onions for 3 more minutes. Remove from heat and cool at least 5 minutes.
3. In a large mixing bowl, combine remaining ingredients and stir with a whisk or electric mixer on low until well combined. Add ham mixture and continue to mix until well combined.
4. Spoon mixture into 24 mini muffin cups that have been sprayed with cooking spray. Bake for 20 minutes or until set.
5. Can be stored overnight in refrigerator or frozen. If reheating from frozen, do so in the microwave for 20 seconds for 3 mini frittatas.
title: Mini Ham And Cheese Frittatas

steps: 1. In small bowl, rinse rice in several changes of cold water; drain in strainer; set aside.
2. In 1 quart saucepan, combine rice, water and 1/2 teaspoon salt.
3. Heat to boiling over high heat; cover and reduce heat to low.
4. Cook rice until tender, about 40 minutes.
5. Drain well.
6. Heat oven to 350°.
7. In 9-inch skillet with heat proof handle, heat oil over medium heat.
8. Add onion, garlic and mushrooms.
9. Cook, stirring, until vegetables brown and most of the liquid evaporates, about 5 minutes.
title: Wild Rice And Mushroom Frittata

ingredients.text: 14 oz butternut squash, peeled, thickly sliced
6 None large eggs, at room temperature

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 425°F. Grease a deep 8 inch round cake pan. Line base and sides with parchment paper. Place pan on a baking sheet.

2. Place pepper on a separate baking sheet and roast 15 mins, until skin blisters. Remove from oven, place in a covered bowl and let stand 5 mins. Peel, remove seeds and thinly slice. Reduce oven temperature to 350°F.
3. Meanwhile, place potato and squash in a steamer over a saucepan of simmering water. Cover and cook for 10-15 mins, until tender. Drain.
4. Arrange half each of pepper, potato and squash over base of pan. Top with half each of spinach, mozzarella, scallion and ricotta. Repeat layers, finishing with ricotta.

5. Whisk eggs, egg whites, sour cream, oregano and garlic in a large bowl and season to taste. Pour mixture over vegetables. Cover with foil and bake for 40 mins. Remove foil and return to the oven to bake for another 35-40 mins, until just set at center. Stand in pan for 1 hr or until cooled. Remove from pan, cut into wedges and serve.
title: Vegetable And Sour Cream Frittata

ingredients.text: 10 ounces frozen spinach, thawed and squeezed
1 cup sharp cheddar, shredded and divided

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
2. In a large bowl combine eggs, milk and half of each cheese; beat together and set aside.
3. Heat a large ovenproof non-stick skillet over medium high heat and add bacon.
4. Cook until crisp, stirring often, about 5 to 7 minutes. Remove with slotted spoon and drain on paper towel; set aside.
5. To same skillet add spinach, garlic, red onion, rosemary, sage, salt and pepper. Cook stirring frequently about 3 to 5 minutes.
6. Reduce heat to low and pour in egg mixture, gently stirring to evenly combine ingredients.
7. Let cook just until edges begin to set, about 4 to 6 minutes.
8. Place skillet in preheated oven and continue to cook about 15 minutes longer, until a knife comes clean when entered into the center.
9. Top with remaining cheese the last 5 minutes of cooking to brown lightly.
title: Earthy Herb Spinach And Bacon Frittata

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees.
2. Spray two mini non-stick muffin tins (each with 24 cups) with nonstick spray.
3. Fill prepared cups almost to the tops with egg mixture.
4. Bake until eggs puff and are just set in center, about 8-10 minutes.
5. Using a rubber spatula, loosen frittatas from the cups and slide onto a platter.
6. Serve immediately or at room temperature.
title: Mini Frittatas - Giada De Laurentiis

steps: 1. Beat eggs, milk, salt, green pepper and onion together.
2. Brown sausage and drain.
3. Combine egg mixture and sausage and pour over bread.
4. (Break bread beforehand and put in 9 x 13-inch pan.) Spread cheese on top.
5. Let sit overnight in refrigerator.
6. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.
title: Breakfast Pizza

steps: 1. Dissolve yeast and splenda in 3/4 cup warm water and let sit for about 8 minutes.
2. In a separate bowl, combine oat flour and salt.
3. Pour yeast mixture over flour and mix well.
4. Knead for about 2 minutes.
5. Spread onto lightly greased pan using the remaining water to smooth crust onto pan.
6. Bake at 500 for 10-12 minutes, or until golden brown.
title: Oatmeal Pizza Crust

steps: 1. Crack the eggs into a large bowl and whisk with a fork.
2. Add the Parmesan to the eggs, stir until well combined, then add the spaghetti. Mix well until all the pasta is covered with egg.
3. Set a medium-sized pan over a medium heat and toss in the pancetta. Fry for a few minutes until it begins to crisp.
4. Leaving a little of the fat from the pancetta in the bottom of the pan, remove the cooked pancetta and toss it into the bowl with the pasta and egg. Give it all a good mix.
5. Set the pan back on the heat and spoon in the pasta mixture.
6. Fry the frittata gently on one side for a few minutes until golden brown.
7. When the frittata begins to come away at the edges of the pan, flip it over and fry on the other side for a further 3 to 5 minutes, until golden brown.
8. Serve piping hot.
title: Spaghetti Frittata

steps: 1. Make pizza crust as directed.
2. Brown sausage.
3. Spread over crust.
4. Layer hash browns.
5. Mix 4 eggs and milk; season to taste and pour over pizza.
6. Sprinkle shredded cheese on top.
7. Bake at 425° for 20 minutes.
title: Breakfast Pizza

steps: 1. Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit (149 degrees Celsius).

2. Cream the Butter and Sugar in the bowl of an electric mixer fitted with a paddle attachment until smooth. Scrape down the bowl. Add the Vanilla Extract and Lemon Zest and mix until well incorporated.
3. Chef's Note: It is not necessary to beat the Butter and Sugar until very light and airy in texture, as with many other recipes, as trapped air is not necessary to leaven the final product.
4. In a separate bowl, mix together the dry ingredients including the Flour, Corn Meal, Oats and Salt.
5. With the mixer on low speed, stir in the dry ingredients in thirds. Continue mixing until the Streusel Dough is just combined.
6. Using your hands, crumble the Streusel Dough in a thin layer onto a parchment or silpat lined sheet tray.

7. Bake the Streusel for up to one hour, checking it every 15 minutes and breaking up any large pieces with a spatula. The Streusel is done when it begins to lightly brown and becomes dry and crumbly.
8. Set the Streusel aside to cool. When it is fully cool, break up any remaining large pieces with your hands or in a food processor. Do not over-process the Streusel.
9. Storage: The Streusel will keep well in an airtight container at room temperature for several weeks. The Streusel can also be frozen for several months.
title: Vanilla Polenta Oatmeal Streusel

steps: 1. 1. Preheat oven to 350 F.

2. 2. Heat a large saute pan (10-12 inch size and oven safe) to medium heat and add 1 tablespoon canola oil and mushrooms. Saute for about 5 minutes stirring occasionally until lightly browned. Remove mushrooms from pan and set aside in a bowl.

3. 3. Reduce the heat to medium low and add onions. Add additional canola oil if needed. Saute for 8 minutes or until onions have softened. Add roasted red peppers and toss together for a few moments then remove the vegetables from the pan and add them to the bowl with the mushrooms.
4. 4. Remove pan from heat and very carefully wipe it clean with a paper towel. Return pan to burner and add butter. Heat pan to medium heat.

5. 5. In a large bowl whisk eggs and milk until fully combined. Add to pan once butter is fully melted and slightly bubbly. Add mushrooms, pepper, onions, and spinach to eggs. Stir gently to distribute veggies evenly. Cook for 2 minutes and then sprinkle diced cheese over top. Transfer to oven and cook for 10-12 minutes.
6. 6. Serve warm or at room temperature.
title: Double Cheddar And Vegetable Frittata

steps: 1. Mix the cooked spaghetti with beaten eggs, milk and grated cheese.
2. Press into a 13 x 9-inch casserole dish.
3. Sprinkle Mozzarella cheese over entire pan.
4. Top with spaghetti sauce. Bake in a 350° oven for 25 to 30 minutes.
5. If using a glass pan, lower heat to 325° and cook 30 to 35 minutes.
6. Makes 8 to 10 servings.
7. This recipe can be cut in half.
8. Bake in a 10-inch round pie pan; makes 4 to 5 servings.
title: Spaghetti Pie

steps: 1. Heat oven to 400°.
2. Grease 10 x 1 1/2-inch pie dish.
3. Cook ground meat and onion over medium heat until meat is brown; drain. Spread in pie plate.
4. Beat milk, baking mix, eggs, salt and pepper until smooth, 15 seconds in blender on high or 1 minute with hand beater.
5. Pour into pie plate. Bake 25 minutes.
6. Top with spaghetti sauce and cheese; bake for another 15 minutes.
7. Cool 5 minutes.
8. Yields 6 to 8 servings.
title: Impossible Pizza Burger Pie

steps: 1. Combine all of the ingredients, beat for 5 minutes at medium speed, let rest at room temp, covered, for 1 hour.
2. Scoup the sticky dough into a lightly greased 9x13 pan.
3. Cover the pan, let the dough rise for 1 hour until it looks bubbly.
4. Bake the focaccia in an oven preheated to 400°F for 25 minutes, or until it's golden brown.
5. Sprinkle with freshly grated parmesean cheese and/ or fresh rosemary about 5 minutes before the end of the baking time.
6. Remove from oven and cool on a wire rack.
title: Easy Focaccia

steps: 1. I use my kitchenaid mixer to do this recipe.
2. Preheat oven to 325 degrees.
3. Beat eggs, egg whites, Splenda and almond extract until smooth.
4. Add flour, baking pwdr.
5. ,soda and salt.
6. Mix until well blended.
7. This will be a sticky batter.
8. Add cranberries and almonds and mix until incorporated.
9. Divide dough in 1/2 making long but flat dough lined on a greased parchment paper.
10. Bake for 20-25 minutes or until lightly browned.
11. Remove from oven and let cool on cookie sheet for 10 minutes.
12. Reduce oven temp to 300 degrees.
13. Slice with serated knife each roll about 20 slices.
14. I start on a diaganol and keep slicing till the end.
15. Stand each slice up on bottom and bake at least 25- 30 minutes.
16. Watch so they don't overbrown.
17. Cool on wire racks.
title: Sugar Free Cranberry Almond Biscotti

steps: 1. In a medium bowl, whip the eggs and sugar with an electric mixer at high speed. Mix for 6 to 10 minutes, until mixture is thick and pale. Combine the flour and baking powder together. Gradually add the flour to the egg mixture. If the dough is still sticky, you can add more flour.
2. On a lightly floured surface, roll the dough into long log shapes, about 1 1/2 inches in diameter, and as long as your cookie sheet. Cover with a clean towel, and let them sit out overnight.

3. Preheat oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). Remove the rolls of dough from the cookie sheets and place them on a lightly floured surface. Cut into 1 1/2 inch long pieces. And return them to the baking sheets.
4. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes in the preheated oven, until they are a light brown. Remove from baking sheets to cool on wire racks. These cookies can be stored for a month in an airtight container.
title: Italian Teething Cookies

steps: 1. Brown ground beef in skillet. Drain off excess fat.
2. Place ground beef, seasoned with salt and pepper if desired, in bottom of shallow baking dish.
3. Cook 2 cup mashed potatoes according to box directions.
4. Layer mashed potatoes over ground beef.
5. Drain juice from diced tomatoes and cover mashed potatoes with diced tomatoes and onions.
6. Sprinkle parmesan cheese and parsley over tomatoes and onions.
7. Cook in a 350°F oven for 30 minutes.
title: Simple Italian Potato Pie

steps: 1. Cream butter, sugar and shortening.
2. Add egg yolks and then add other ingredients alternately.
3. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites.
4. Makes 3 layers.
5. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until done.
title: Italian Creme Cake

ingredients.text: 1/2 cup firmly packed light brown sugar

steps: 1. Beat butter and sugars in a large bowl at medium speed with an electric mixer until light and fluffy. Add eggs, beating well; beat in molasses.
2. Combine flour and next 7 ingredients; add to butter mixture, beating at low speed until blended. Stir in almonds.
3. Divide dough in half; using floured hands, shape each portion into a 9" x 2" log on a lightly greased baking sheet.
4. Bake at 350° for 28 minutes or until firm. Cool on baking sheet 5 minutes. Remove to a wire rack to cool 10 minutes. Reduce oven temperature to 300°.

5. Cut each log diagonally into 3/4"-thick slices with a serrated knife, using a gentle sawing motion. Place slices on ungreased baking sheets. Bake 8 to 10 minutes; turn cookies over, and bake 8 to 10 more minutes. Cool completely on wire racks.
title: Gingerbread Biscotti

steps: 1. Combine buttermilk and gelatin in a small bowl; set aside to soften.
2. Combine cream, sugar, liqueur, zest, and vanilla bean in a small saucepan. Bring to a simmer. Remove from heat.
3. Stir in buttermilk mixture, whisking until all gelatin solids are dissolved; strain.
4. Evenly divide mixture among 12 (1 3/4-ounce) silicone molds. Refrigerate for 4 hours.
5. To unmold, gently pull edges of custards to loosen. Invert onto plate or shortbread cookie to serve.
title: Buttermilk-Grand Marnier Panna Cotta

steps: 1. Cream butter and sugar.
2. Add eggs and beat well.
3. Stir together flour, baking soda and baking powder.
4. Add alternately to butter mixture with sour cream.
5. Stir in lemon extract last.
6. Drop by teaspoons on lightly greased baking sheet. Bake 8-10 min. at 350. Remove to wire rack to cool.
7. Make thin icing of powdered sugar and milk. You can color the icing with food color. Dip tops of cookies into icing. Sprinkle tops with colored sprinkles, finely chopped nuts, or leave plain.
8. Allow icing to dry before storing cookies.
title: Italian Wedding Cookies

steps: 1. Mix together the eggs, sugar, vegetable oil, vanilla, and lemon juice until well combined
2. Mix in the flour, baking powder and cinnamon
3. Finally, add in the almonds and chocolate chips
4. Preheat oven to 350°
5. With wet, cold hands, roll out 2 loaves, approximately 12" long x 3 /12" wide x 3/4" thick.
6. Bake on cookie sheets for 25-30 minutes until lightly brown. Cool for 10-15 minutes.
7. Cut into 1"wide slices, then bake again for 10 minutes until golden brown.
title: Chocolate Chip Almond Biscotti

ingredients.text: 1 cup Almonds, Coarsely Chopped Or Slivered

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F.

2. In a large bowl, beat sugar and butter together until light and fluffy. Beat in almond and vanilla extracts and eggs. Stir in flour, baking powder and baking soda. Stir in almonds until evenly combined.

3. Mixture will be coarse and crumbly. Pour half of the mixture onto a lightly floured surface and knead gently by hand until the dough holds together. Form the kneaded half of the dough into a 10x3 inch rectangle, rounding edges slightly. The form will be rough-looking.
4. Repeat the kneading and forming process with the remaining half of the dough.

5. Place both logs onto a baking sheet and bake for 20-25 minutes, until golden brown and center is firm to the touch. Cool on the cookie sheet for 15 minutes. Transfer each form to the cutting board and use a serrated knife to slice into 1/2-1 inch cookies.
6. Place the slices, cut side down, back onto the cookie sheet. Bake for 15 minutes or until crisp and light brown. Be sure to check the undersides of the cookies to avoid over baking.
7. Cool completely on a wire rack. Serve with your favorite hot beverage-tea, coffee, or cocoa!
title: Almond Biscotti

ingredients.text: 1 medium red bell pepper, cut into strips
32 saltine crackers, any variety (i.e. low sodium)

steps: 1. Cook and stir red pepper, onion, zucchini and italian seasoning in butter or margarine in large skillet until tender.
2. Layer half each of the crackers, vegetable mixture and cheese in lightly greased 8x8x2-inch baking pan.
3. Repeat layers, ending with cheese.
4. Beat eggs and milk in bowl; pour evenly over cheese layer.
5. Bake at 350 degrees for 30-35 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean.
title: Cracker And Vegetable Lasagna

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees F.
2. Mix uncooked beef, bread crumbs, oregano, salt and egg.

3. Press mixture evenly against bottom and side of ungreased 9 inch pie plate. Spread mushrooms, bell pepper, pepperoni and olives and then a thin layer of cheese on top of beef mixture. Repeat the layer without the cheese. This should fill up the pie.
4. Pour tomato sauce over toppings.
5. Bake uncovered for 25 minutes and the beef is no longer pink in center and the juice is clear.
6. Carefully drain the juices.
7. Sprinkle with cheese bake until the cheese is light brown.
8. Let stand 5 minutes.
title: Crustless Pizza Pie

steps: 1. Mix the buttermilk and soda and let stand. Beat egg whites until stiff. Cream sugar, oleo and shortening. Add egg yolks, one at a time, beating well after each. Add buttermilk alternately with flour to creamed mixture. Stir in vanilla. Fold in beaten egg whites. Gently stir in nuts and coconut. Bake in 3 or 4 layer pans at 325° for 25 minutes.
title: Italian Cream Cheese Cake

steps: 1. Stir yeast in warm water and let stand for 5 minutes.
2. In large bowl, beat 1 cup of flour with yeast mixture, adding salt, to make a smooth batter. Beat in 2 1/4 cups of remaining flour. Dough will be stiff.
3. Turn onto a floured board, and knead for 10 minutes. Slam the dough down onto the counter at least 6 times!

4. Form dough into a smooth ball, and place in a greased bowl with a lid or plastic wrap. Cover and allow it to double in size (90 minutes). Punch dough down and form ball again. Cover. Let it double again (60 minutes). Punch down dough. Roll into a flat big ball.
5. Place on a greased baking sheet or use parchment paper. Cut into the top 4 shallow cuts, forming a big X.
6. Cover with a cloth and let it rise for 30 minutes.
7. Bake at 375F for 30 minutes.
8. *Using parchment paper allows the bread to just slide off the paper and pan right onto your cutting board. Also, put covered bowl into oven with light on, and it will rise better.
title: Easy Round Italian Bread

steps: 1. Mix together dry ingredients.
2. Add remaining ingredients and mix well.
3. Divide dough in half. On greased baking sheet, form 2 logs about 2 inches wide and 13 inches long.
4. Bake 25 minutes at 350 degrees, then cool on rack for 5-10 minutes.
5. Slice with serrated knife at 1/2 inch intervals.
6. Return to oven for 10-15 minutes more, turning once.
7. Cool completely and store in airtight container.
8. If you have trouble handling the dough because of stickiness, add a little more flour, but not more than 1/4 cup. Try oiling your hands or using a rubber spatula and wax paper.
title: Hearty Whole Wheat Biscotti

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°F.
2. In a food processor, combine sugar, flour, baking powder and salt, process for a few seconds.
3. Add butter and vanilla, process until mixture resembles coarse cornmeal.
4. Add chocolate chips and eggs and pulse until dough is evenly moistened.
5. Divide dough into 4 equal pieces, press onto pans as logs.
6. Bake for 25 minutes, then remove from oven and cut into diagonal 1" slices.
7. Turn slices on sides and return to oven for 5-10 minutes.
8. Let cool.
title: Chocolate Chip Biscotti

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 300. Position rack in the middle of oven.
2. Combine flour, baking soda, and salt; mix thoroughly with fork.
3. Whisk together the eggs, sugar, vanilla and orange extracts, and orange zest in a medium bowl.
4. Mix in the orange juice.
5. Using a rubber spatula, stir in dry ingredients until just combined.
6. Stir in chocolate chips.

7. The batter will be thick and sticky (typical biscotti batter). Scrape the batter onto a baking sheet. (I cover my baking sheet with aluminum foil, then spray it with baking spray.) Using two spatulas, divide batter into two loaves, about 14" long and about 2.5" wide. Try to put at least 2.5" between the loaves; straighten the edges of the loaves with spatulas.
8. Bake for 35 minutes, or until firm but springy when pressed with fingers.
9. Cool for ten minutes in the pan. Then move loaves to a cutting board, and with a sharp knife (serrated is best), slice loaves on teh diagonal in 1/2" slices.
10. Lay the biscotti on the baking sheet, cut side down, and bake for another 12 minutes.
11. Take the biscotti out of the oven, turn them over, and bake another 12-15 minutes, or until golden brown.

12. Note: If you don't want the biscotti to pick up a darker color, handle the second baking this way: Rather than laying the slices cut-side down, stand them upright, and bake them for a total of 24-30 minutes.
13. Remove the biscotti from the oven and cool on a cooling rack.
14. Medrich notes that the flavor will become stronger, and the biscotti will become more tender, after being stored for 2-3 days in an airtight container.
title: Orange-Chocolate Chip Biscotti

ingredients.text: 1 tablespoon brown sugar, or to taste (optional)

steps: 1. Preheat an oven to 375 degrees F ( degrees C).
2. Place spaghetti squash halves in glass baking dish, cut sides up. Place one tablespoon butter in each half. Divide the cinnamon, cloves, nutmeg, allspice, and brown sugar between the two halves.
3. Bake until a fork pierces squash easily, about 50 minutes.
4. Use a fork to shred and separate the strands from the peel and transfer squash to a bowl. Mix the brown sugar into the squash, tossing lightly until well incorporated.
title: Sweet And Easy Spaghetti Squash

ingredients.text: 6 to 8 c. flour (more or less, at least 3 lb.)

steps: 1. Combine sugar, flour (add flour as needed before and after eggs are added), baking powder and lard.
2. Work with hands until crumbly.
3. Then add eggs, flour and vanilla; work again until hand rollable.
4. Shape cookies into balls, sticks and twist.
title: Grandma'S Old-Fashioned Italian Cookies

ingredients.text: 7 -9 ounces water (I started with 8 oz. and ended up adding a little bit more)

steps: 1. Set bread machine on dough setting and let mix and rise once.
2. Shape and form into rolls.
3. Bake 25-30 min at 350°F.
title: Italian Herb Rolls

steps: 1. Sift flour, baking powder, cinnamon, nutmeg, salt, cloves, and ginger together in a large bowl.

2. Beat white sugar, butter, and brown sugar together in another bowl using an electric mixer until light and crumbly. Add eggs; beat for 1 minute. Add pumpkin puree, molasses, and vanilla extract; beat until well blended, about 1 minute. Blend in the flour mixture using the mixer or a wooden spoon until dough is sticky and incorporated.
3. Cover dough with waxed paper; refrigerate for 1 hour.
4. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Line 2 baking sheets with parchment paper.

5. Dip your hands into a small bowl of water. Shape the dough into two loaves that are 1 inch high, 3 to 4 inches wide, and 10 inches long, Place each loaf onto a baking sheet; top with pumpkin seeds.
6. Bake in the preheated oven until bottoms are dry, 20 to 24 minutes. Let cool for 5 minutes. Reduce oven temperature to 275 degrees F (135 degrees C).
7. Transfer loaves to a flat work surface. Cut each into 10 diagonal slices about 1/2 inch thick. Place sliced biscotti back on the baking sheet.

8. Continue baking until light golden brown, about 20 minutes. Reduce oven temperature to 200 degrees F (95 degrees C). Continue baking until dry, about 20 minutes more. Transfer to wire racks to cool.
title: Pumpkin Biscotti

ingredients.text: 3 c. fresh spinach leaves, washed and dried
1/3 c. pine nuts, almonds or walnuts

steps: 1. In blender or processor, puree all ingredients until smooth. Toss with hot cooked pasta (approximately 1 pound).
2. Makes 4 servings.
title: Spinach Pesto

steps: 1. Saute chopped onion in margarine.
2. Add flour to make paste. Add water and tomato paste.
3. Stir and add additional water until you have a sauce the consistency you like.
4. Serve over rigatoni or large macaroni shells.
5. Sauce serves 4 to 6 people.
title: Omi'S Spaghetti Sauce

steps: 1. Blend in food processor, blender or in a shaker.
2. If using processor, garlic is minced with a metal blade.
3. Makes 8 servings.
title: Italian Salad Dressing

ingredients.text: 2 c. fresh basil leaves, coarsely chopped

steps: 1. Place all ingredients, except cheese, in food processor; process with on/off turns until smooth.
2. Stir in cheese.
3. Serve pesto over cooked pasta; use as dressing for potato salad.
4. Mix with rice.
5. Use in soup or as a topping for vegetables.
6. Makes 6 servings.
title: Pesto Sauce

ingredients.text: 2 cloves garlic, crushed (not pressed with a garlic press)

steps: 1. In a mortar and pestle, grind basil with salt, pine nuts and garlic.
2. If using food processor, add oil as well, adjusting thickness depending on desired use.
3. Add the cheese and mix well. for tossing with pasta, be sure pesto is not too stiff.
4. For layering in a cheese torta, keep the pesto at a paste-like consistency.
6. (Makes enough pesto to serve 6 servings of pasta when thinned with olive oil.
title: Pesto

ingredients.text: 1/4 cup roasted red pepper (found in a jar in pickle dept.)

steps: 1. Soften cream cheese to room temperature.
2. Place half of the cream cheese, pesto and milk in a blender or food processor - blend until smooth.
3. Remove and place into a shallow bowl or plate.
4. Clean out blender/food processor.
5. Place half (4 oz) of the cream cheese and the red peppers in a blender or food processor. Cover and blend 30 to 40 seconds until smooth.
6. Place red pepper mixture on top of the pesto mixture.
7. Place in a the refrigerator to chill for 1 hour before serving.
8. Serve with Wheat Thins or your choice of crackers. You can dip the crackers in the dip or use a spreader.
9. Note: Makes 9 servings of 2 Tablespoons each. If you want to make a larger serving for a party, double recipe.
title: Layered Pesto And Roasted Red Pepper Dip

steps: 1. Blend basil leaves, garlic, pine nuts, and olive oil in blender to make a paste.
2. Cook pasta to taste, al dente is recommended.
3. Toss drained pasta with paste while still hot.
4. Add Parmesan cheese and toss again.
5. Serves 4 as a main dish or 6 as a side dish.
6. Refrigerate leftovers immediately.
title: Pasta Pesto

steps: 1. Toast the almonds in a pan first if they are raw.
2. Put all the ingredients into a food processor and blend until it turns into a fine paste
3. Taste and adjust the seasoning if needed, store in an air tight glass jar.
title: Vegan Pesto

ingredients.text: 2 tablespoons ketchup, Low Sodium or 2 tablespoons Italian sauce, prepared
1/2 teaspoon olive oil, if Frying, for frying

steps: 1. 1.	In a large bowl mix: ground meat, garlic powder, black pepper, italian seasoning, parsley, onions, seasoned bread crumbs, ketchup/or sauce, green pepper, and 1 egg.
2. 2.	Mix the meat and other ingredients, by hand until well blended. Then roll into approximately 15 meatballs(2" in diameter) or for more meatballs make them smaller.
3. 3.	Then add directly into your sauce, make sure all meatballs are submerged under the sauce. Cook in sauce and stir ocassionally until they reach 165 degrees, approximately 2 hours.
4. **Continue to next step if you prefer to fry them up a little first.
5. 5.	In a large frying pan, add the olive oil and heat. After heated about 1 minute drop in your meatballs and turn with a fork and cook till browned on all sides.
6. 6.	Add meatballs and brown on all sides. Then set them aside on a paper towel to drain off some of the fat. Repeat until all meatballs are browned.
7. 7.	Then add them into your sauce cooking them approximately 1 1/2 hours. Until they reach 165 degrees.
title: Italian Meatballs Pat'S Reciepe

steps: 1. Mix and spread on party rye bread.
2. Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.
title: Pizza Snacks

steps: 1. Melt the half and half, cream cheese and margarine together in a sauce pan.
2. When nice and bubbly hot slowly add the parmesan cheese.
3. Next add the garlic.
4. Simmer on low for about 20 minutes.
5. **Note, this sauce will separate. It's ok, when mixed with your pasta it will taste great and not be separated. I think it has something to do with the low fat oils.
title: Lower Fat Alfredo Sauce

steps: 1. Stir over 10 cups of popcorn.
2. Put in a jelly roll pan and put in a 300° oven for 15 minutes.
title: Pizza Popcorn

ingredients.text: 1 spaghetti squash, halved lengthwise and seeded
1 cup kale, stems removed and leaves chopped

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C). Grease a baking sheet.

2. Place squash skin side down on prepared baking sheet. Bake until cooked through, about 1 hour. Remove from oven; cool for 10 minutes. Once squash is cool enough to handle, scrape flesh into string-like strands with a fork. Place in a bowl and set aside.
3. Melt 1 tablespoon of butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add onion; cook and stir until onion begins to turn translucent. Stir in kale and mushrooms; reduce heat to medium low.
4. Stir in squash, remaining 2 tablespoons butter, garlic salt, Italian seasoning, and red pepper flakes; cook for 2 minutes. Remove from stove and place squash mixture in a large bowl.
5. Stir olive oil and pesto into the squash mixture. Slowly add grated Parmesan cheese, stirring until evenly mixed.
title: Pesto Spaghetti Squash

ingredients.text: 2 cups milk (for a thinner sauce, add up to one extra cup)

steps: 1. In a large saucepan over low heat, melt butter. Slowly stir in flour, one tablespoon at a time, whisking after each addition.
2. Add cream cheese in pieces and stir in milk slowly. Stir til melted.
3. Stir in garlic and salt and sprinkle in parmesan cheese, while stirring to combine.
4. Stir until thickened over low heat. remove and serve over pasta.
title: Alfredo Sauce Thin Or Thick

ingredients.text: 2 c. fresh basil leaves (include tender part of stem), loosely packed

steps: 1. Place basil, oil, garlic and 1/4 cup of pine nuts in a food processor; process for about 15 seconds.
2. Stir in remaining ingredients.
3. Serve over warm pasta.
title: Pesto

steps: 1. Toss everything into a food processor or blender, and make it into a nice puree. Make sure to scrape the edges before blending again, just to make sure you get everything incorporated.

2. The great thing about making any type of pesto is that you can use it on anything, and it stays great in the refrigerator for a handful of days. You can even put some in your ice cube trays and freeze them until later use. Great, vibrant and bold flavors that will keep you coming back for more.
title: Pea Pesto

steps: 1. Place walnuts, pine nuts, salt, pepper, garlic, butter, basil, and parsley in to a blender or food processor. Turn the blender on, and add the olive oil in a slow, steady stream. Continue processing until a soft paste has formed. Fold in Parmesan and Romano cheeses. Store in the refrigerator covered by 1/4 inch of olive oil to prevent the surface from turning brown.
title: The Best Pesto Ever

steps: 1. Heat oven to 200C/fan 180C/gas 6. Toss the potatoes with 2 tsp oil and some seasoning. Tip onto a large baking tray, then roast for 20 mins, stirring halfway, until crisp, golden and cooked through.

2. Meanwhile, put eggs in a small pan of water, bring to the boil, then simmer for 8-10 mins, depending on how you like them cooked. Plunge into a bowl of cold water to cool for a few mins. Peel away the shells, then cut into halves.

3. In a large salad bowl, whisk together the remaining oil, red wine vinegar, capers and chopped tomatoes. Season, tip in the onion, spinach, tuna and potatoes, then gently toss together. Top with the eggs, then serve straight away.
title: Tuna Nicoise

steps: 1. Preheat the oven to 180°C/350°F/Gas Mark 4. Grease and line the base of an 8 in round spring form cake tin with baking parchment
2. Break the chocolate into a heatproof bowl and place over a saucepan of gently simmering water and stir until it melts. (or melt in the microwave for 2-3 mins stirring occasionally)

3. Place the butter and sugar in a mixing bowl and cream together with a wooden spoon until light and fluffy. Gradually beat in the eggs, adding a little flour if the mixture begins to curdle. Fold in the remaining flour with the cooled, melted chocolate and milk. Mix until smooth.
4. Spread the mixture into the cake tin and bake for 50-55 mins or until firm in the centre and a skewer comes out cleanly. Cool for 10 minutes, then turn out and cool completely.
title: Chocolate Gateau

steps: 1. Cut the aubergines in half lengthways. Place them on the board, cut side down, slice in half lengthways again and then across into 1.5cm chunks. Cut off the courgettes ends, then across into 1.5cm slices. Peel the peppers from stalk to bottom. Hold upright, cut around the stalk, then cut into 3 pieces. Cut away any membrane, then chop into bite-size chunks.

2. Score a small cross on the base of each tomato, then put them into a heatproof bowl. Pour boiling water over the tomatoes, leave for 20 secs, then remove. Pour the water away, replace the tomatoes and cover with cold water. Leave to cool, then peel the skin away. Quarter the tomatoes, scrape away the seeds with a spoon, then roughly chop the flesh.

3. Set a sauté pan over medium heat and when hot, pour in 2 tbsp olive oil. Brown the aubergines for 5 mins on each side until the pieces are soft. Set them aside and fry the courgettes in another tbsp oil for 5 mins, until golden on both sides. Repeat with the peppers. Don’t overcook the vegetables at this stage, as they have some more cooking left in the next step.

4. Tear up the basil leaves and set aside. Cook the onion in the pan for 5 mins. Add the garlic and fry for a further min. Stir in the vinegar and sugar, then tip in the tomatoes and half the basil. Return the vegetables to the pan with some salt and pepper and cook for 5 mins. Serve with basil.
title: Ratatouille

steps: 1. For the topping, boil the potatoes in salted water until tender. Drain and push through a potato ricer, or mash thoroughly. Stir in the butter, cream and egg yolks. Season and set aside.

2. For the filling, melt the butter in a large pan. Add the shallots, carrots and celery and gently fry until soft, then add the garlic. Pour in the wine and cook for 1 minute. Stir in the tomato purée, chopped tomatoes and stock and cook for 10–15 minutes, until thickened. Add the shredded chicken, olives and parsley. Season to taste with salt and pepper.
3. Preheat the oven to 180C/160C Fan/Gas 4.
4. Put the filling in a 20x30cm/8x12in ovenproof dish and top with the mashed potato. Grate over the Gruyère. Bake for 30–35 minutes, until piping hot and the potato is golden-brown.
title: Chicken Parmentier

steps: 1. The day before you want to make the dish, scatter half the salt, half the garlic and half of the herbs over the base of a small shallow dish. Lay the duck legs, skin-side up, on top, then scatter over the remaining salt, garlic and herbs. Cover the duck and refrigerate overnight. This can be done up to 2 days ahead.

2. Pour the wine into a saucepan that will snugly fit the duck legs in a single layer. Brush the salt off the duck legs and place them, skin-side down, in the wine. Cover the pan with a lid and place over a medium heat. As soon as the wine starts to bubble, turn the heat down to the lowest setting and cook for 2 hours, checking occasionally that the liquid is just barely simmering. (If you own a heat diffuser, it would be good to use it here.) After 2 hours, the duck legs should be submerged in their own fat and the meat should feel incredibly tender when prodded. Leave to cool.

3. The duck legs are now cooked and can be eaten immediately – or you can follow the next step if you like them crisp. If you are preparing ahead, pack the duck legs tightly into a plastic container or jar and pour over the fat, but not the liquid at the bottom of the pan. Cover and leave in the fridge for up to a month, or freeze for up to 3 months. The liquid you are left with makes a tasty gravy, which can be chilled or frozen until needed.

4. To reheat and crisp up the duck legs, heat oven to 220C/fan 200C/gas 7. Remove the legs from the fat and place them, skin-side down, in an ovenproof frying pan. Roast for 30-40 mins, turning halfway through, until brown and crisp. Serve with the reheated gravy, a crisp salad and some crisp golden ptoatoes.
title: Duck Confit

steps: 1. Heat the oil in a large flameproof casserole dish and stir-fry the mushrooms until they start to soften. Add the chicken legs and cook briefly on each side to colour them a little.

2. Pour in the passata, crumble in the stock cube and stir in the olives. Season with black pepper – you shouldn’t need salt. Cover and simmer for 40 mins until the chicken is tender. Sprinkle with parsley and serve with pasta and a salad, or mash and green veg, if you like.
title: Chicken Marengo

steps: 1. Pare eggplant and cut into large cubes.
2. Slice zucchini thickly.
3. Cut bell pepper into large pieces and coarsely chop the onion.
4. Cut the tomatoes into large pieces.
5. Place all ingredients into a 4-quart kettle.
6. Cover and cook over medium heat.
7. Stir occasionally until vegetables are crisp-tender, about 10 minutes. Don't overcook!
8. Serves 8.
title: Ratatouille

steps: 1. Preheat the oven to 375 F. In a blender or food processor, combine the milk, heavy cream, sugar, flour, eggs, egg yolk and vanilla and blend until smooth. Arrange the berries in a buttered 10-inch pie plate and pour the batter over them. Bake for 35 to 45 minutes, or until the flan is puffed and golden. Sift confectioners' sugar over the top and serve warm. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Blueberry Clafoutis

ingredients.text: 2 c. chopped broccoli (frozen), thawed and drained

steps: 1. Heat oven to 400°.
2. Lightly grease a pie plate (10 x 1 1/2-inch).
3. Mix broccoli and onion in pie plate.
4. Beat remaining ingredients, except cheese, for 1 minute with mixer or 15 seconds in blender.
5. Pour into pie plate and top with cheese.
6. Bake until golden brown and knife inserted in middle comes out clean (35 to 40 minutes).
7. Let stand for 5 minutes before cutting.
8. Makes 6 servings.
title: Crustless Quiche

ingredients.text: 1 lb. carrots, scraped and processed in blender

steps: 1. Cook carrots until tender.
2. Drain.
3. Process carrots in blender or food processor until smooth.
4. Stir in eggs and remaining ingredients.
5. Spoon into lightly greased 1 quart baking dish.
6. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until set. Serves 8. Delicious!
title: Carrot Souffle

ingredients.text: 3 ounces white chocolate, imported finely chopped

steps: 1. Position rack in center of oven and preheat to 300 degrees F.
2. Whisk egg yolks and 1/4 cup sugar in a medium bowl.
3. Bring cream and the remaining 1/4 cup sugar to simmer in heavy medium saucepan; reduce heat to low.
4. Gradually add chopped white chocolate to the cream mixture and whisk until smooth.
5. Gradually whisk the hot white chocolate mixture into yolk mixture, then whisk in vanilla.
6. Pour the mixture through a fine sieve, then ladle custard into four 10-oz custard cups (if you use 4 oz ramekins, it will fill about 7 of them).
7. Place the filled cups in large baking pan and add enough hot water to pan to come halfway up sides of cups.
8. Bake at 300 degrees F until the custards are set in the center, about 1 hour.
9. Carefully remove the custards from water and let cool.
10. Cover (plastic wrap works fine) and refrigerate.
11. Just before serving, preheat the broiler.
12. Sprinkle 1/2 tablespoon sugar over each custard.
13. Broil until the sugar caramelizes, watching carefully, which will take about 2 minutes.
14. Serve hot, or refrigerate up to 1 hour and serve cold.
15. Makes 4 servings.
title: Mmm... White Chocolate Creme Brulee

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients and pour into a greased pie plate. Bake at 325° for 30 to 40 minutes.
2. Makes 6 servings.
title: Zucchini Tomato Quiche

steps: 1. Blend all ingredients well.
2. Pour into a greased 2-quart baking dish.
3. Bake at 400° for 15 minutes, then lower temperature to 300° and bake for 45 minutes more.
4. May substitute pumpkin or squash for carrots.
5. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Carrot Souffle

ingredients.text: 1 c. shredded or sliced Cheddar cheese

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 425°.
2. Sprinkle bread bits over bottom of buttered 1-quart baking dish.
3. Cover with cheese.
4. Mix eggs, milk, mustard, salt and pepper.
5. Pour over cheese.
6. Bake for 20 minutes or until lightly browned on top.
7. Serves 4.
title: Cheese Souffle

steps: 1. Place chicken and almonds in pie shell, then Swiss cheese. Beat eggs slightly in medium bowl. Blend in milk, salt, mace and pepper. Pour over cheese. Sprinkle on Parmesan cheese. Bake in a preheated oven for 30 to 35 minutes or until a knife inserted near the center comes out clean. Allow to stand 10 minutes before serving. Makes 6 servings.
title: Chicken Quiche Amandine

steps: 1. Pour this over bacon stuff.
2. Bake at 350° for 55 to 60 minutes.
3. Cut and serve.
4. (You can use ham instead of bacon.) Serves 6.
title: Impossible Quiche

steps: 1. Peel and cut eggplant.
2. Peel and cut tomatoes into 6 slices; cut green pepper into 4 rings each.
3. Combine herbs; set aside. Place 6 eggplant slices in greased 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish. Drizzle with 1/4 teaspoon olive oil.
4. Lightly salt and pepper and 1/4 teaspoon herb mix.
5. Layer 6 onion rings, 6 tomato slices and 6 green peppers on top.
6. Repeat oil and seasonings.
7. Sprinkle each stack of vegetables with 1/4 teaspoon minced garlic.
8. Repeat seasoned layers with remaining ingredients in a second 12 x 8 x 2-inch dish.
9. Cover and bake at 350° for 40 minutes.
10. Uncover and sprinkle with 2 tablespoons Parmesan and Gruyere.
11. Bake 5 minutes more.
12. Makes 12 servings.
title: Eggplant Provencal

steps: 1. Bring half and half, cream and sugar to boil, then remove from flame.
2. Let cool.
3. In bowl, lightly whisk yolks while slowly adding sugared creme.
4. Add Kahlua; remove any froth from the top.
5. Ladle mixture in ramekins and bake approximately 20 to 25 minutes at 325° in water bath, lightly covered with foil (they are ready when bounce to touch).
6. Refrigerate until completely cooled.
7. Cover top with coating of sugar and caramelize.
8. Serve immediately.
9. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Kahlua Creme Brulee

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 450°. In a large frying pan, fry bacon until crispy. Remove from pan and drain on paper towels.
2. Pour out all bacon fat except 2 tablespoons.
3. Saute zucchini and onion in bacon fat over medium heat until tender, about 10 minutes.
4. Remove from heat and set aside.
5. In a large mixing bowl, mix together eggs, milk, cheeses and pepper. Spread zucchini mixture in bottom of an uncooked pastry shell. Sprinkle bacon pieces over the zucchini mixture.
6. Pour the egg mixture into the pastry shell and bake for 15 minutes at 450°.
7. Turn oven heat down to 350° and bake for another 40 to 45 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean. Serve warm or cold.
8. Serves 8.
title: Bacon Zucchini Quiche

ingredients.text: 1/3 c. part-skim or fat-free Mozzarella, diced

steps: 1. In a large bowl, combine the zucchini, onion and mushrooms.
2. In a medium bowl, mix together the cornstarch and 1 tablespoon of the milk, then stir in the remaining milk.
3. Beat in the eggs and seasonings.
4. Stir the egg mixture into the vegetables, then stir in the cheese.
5. Pour into a 9-inch pie plate and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
6. Yield:
7. 4 servings.
title: Zucchini Souffle

steps: 1. Combine water and chocolate squares in 1-quart measure or 1-quart glass casserole.
2. Cook with microwave energy, 3 to 4 minutes or until the chocolate melts.
3. Stir well and blend in sugar and salt.
4. Cook 1 1/2 minutes.
5. Cool to room temperature. Fold in 1/2 cup whipped cream.
6. Store in refrigerator.
7. To serve, place one heaping tablespoon in each cup and fill with hot milk. Stir well.
8. Makes 8 to 10 servings.
title: French Chocolate

steps: 1. Grease 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking pan.
2. Beat eggs in large bowl. Add remaining ingredients and mix well.
3. Pour into pan.
4. Bake in 350° oven (in low 1/3 of oven) until tester inserted comes out clean, about 35 to 45 minutes.
5. Cool slightly before cutting; can be doubled.
6. Serves 10 people.
title: Zucchini Quiche

steps: 1. Fry bacon; drain and crumble.
2. Fry onion in bacon fat. Sprinkle bacon, cooked onion and cheese in 10-inch pie pan that has been lightly greased.
3. Beat remaining 5 ingredients until smooth, 15 seconds in blender or 1 minute by hand.
4. Pour into pie pan on top of cheese/bacon/onion.
5. Bake 35 to 40 minutes at 400° until knife in center is almost clean.
6. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.
7. Serves 6.
title: Quiche Quickie

steps: 1. Cook and drain sausage.
2. Wash in water and drain to remove excess grease.
3. Beat well with whisk all of the eggs.
4. Add milk and mustard; beat again.
5. Add cubed bread and sausage; mix well. Pour into 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
6. Top with grated cheese.
7. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
8. Serves 8 to 10.
title: Cheese-Sausage Souffle

steps: 1. Fry bacon until crisp.
2. Drain on paper towel; reserve drippings in skillet.
3. Set aside.
4. Saute garlic, onion and mushrooms in skillet until tender.
5. Stir in reserved bacon, flour and seasoned salt.
6. Set aside.
7. Cut tomatoes in 1/2-inch slices. Place half of the slices in a lightly greased 8-inch square baking dish.
8. Spoon half of bacon/onion mixture over tomatoes.
9. Sprinkle with 3 tablespoons Parmesan cheese.
10. Repeat layers.
11. Dot with butter.
12. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.
13. Yields 6 servings.
title: Tomatoes Provencale

steps: 1. Beat with beater
2. until
3. frothy
4. first	4
5. ingredients. Stir in cubed cheese.
6. Pour
7. into
8. greased deep 1-quart casserole. Bake at 350° for 30
9. minutes
10. or until golden brown and fluffy. Serve with bacon,
11. sausage	or
12. ham
13. and hash browns. May be served as a breakfast or brunch.
14. Serves 4.
title: Egg Souffle

ingredients.text: 2 medium sweet red peppers, chopped (green peppers are okay)

steps: 1. Cook and stir onion slices in oil until tender.
2. Stir in remaining ingredients except parsley.
3. Reduce heat; cover and simmer 3 minutes.
4. Uncover and cook over medium heat, stirring constantly until liquid is evaporated.
5. Watch carefully; turn into serving dish and sprinkle with parsley.
6. Makes 6 servings, 130 calories per serving.
title: Ratatouille

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350. Mix 1/2 cup nonfat milk with the dry milk. Whisk in remaining milk, egg, sugar, and vanilla. Blend Well.
2. Strain into a large bowl, skimming off any foam or bubbles.

3. Divide mixture among 6 ramekins or custard cups. Place in a water bath and bake until set around edges, but still loose in the center, about 40 to 50 minutes. Remove from oven and leave in water bath until cooled.
4. Remove cups from water bath and chill for at least 2 hours, or up to 2 days.
5. When ready to serve, sprinkle about 2 teaspoons of sugar over each custard.
6. For best results, use a small, hand held torch to melt sugar.
7. If you do not have a torch, place under boiler until sugar melts.
8. Re chill custards for a few minutes before serving.
9. Serves 6.
title: Low Fat Creme Brulee

steps: 1. Layer half the bread cubes, ham, cheeses and remaining bread cubes in 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
2. Beat eggs, milk and seasonings in bowl.
3. Pour over layers.
4. Chill overnight.
5. Combine cornflakes and butter in bowl.
6. Sprinkle over layers.
7. Bake at 375° for 40 minutes.
8. Makes 10 servings.
title: Ham And Cheese Souffle

steps: 1. Brown sausage and drain well.
2. Mix other ingredients.
3. Add sausage.
4. Refrigerate overnight.
5. Bake, covered, in a 350° oven for 45 minutes.
6. Uncover.
7. Bake 15 minutes at 325°.
8. Serves 8 to 10.
title: Egg Sausage Souffle

steps: 1. Cover with distilled water and refrigerate overnight.
2. Grate a small apple into a bowl.
3. Spoon in Museli.
4. Top with a dollop of yogurt.
5. Makes 4 servings.
title: Museli(Delicious Morning Starter)

steps: 1. Heat oven to 350°.
2. Cook and stir zucchini, mushrooms and onions in butter over medium heat until tender.
3. Place remaining ingredients in blender.
4. Blend until smooth.
5. Stir into vegetable mixture.
6. Pour into greased 9-inch quiche dish or pie pan.
7. Bake 30 minutes.
8. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.
9. Cut wedges; serve warm.
10. Serves 6. No crust needed.
title: Vegetable Quiche

steps: 1. Peel, cook and mash eggplant.
2. Combine eggplant, soup, cheese, bread crumbs, onion, catsup, salt and egg yolks; mix well.
3. Beat egg whites until stiff, but not dry.
4. Fold into eggplant mixture. Pour in greased 2-quart dish.
5. Bake at 375° for 45 minutes or until a knife inserted in center comes out clean.
6. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Eggplant Souffle

steps: 1. Butter a 9-inch pie pan and line with bread crumbs.
2. Cut zucchini into thin slices.
3. Allow to drain on paper towels. Saute squash in olive oil.
4. Drain again on paper towels.
5. Melt margarine; add flour.
6. Add scalded milk, stirring until thickened. Stir in cheese, egg and seasonings.
7. Add zucchini and ladle into prepared pan.
8. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until set.
9. Serves 4.
title: Zucchini Crumb Quiche

steps: 1. Place a medium saucepan over medium heat and add oil.
2. When oil is hot, add onions and sweat them until translucent.
3. Add cream, chicken stock and herbs.
4. Bring mixture to a simmer, then turn off heat and set mixture aside.
5. Slice the root vegetables thin and place them in alternating fashion in a casserole dish, filling dish just 3/4 full.
6. Strain cream mixture through a fine sieve and pour it over the vegetables in the casserole.
7. Sprinkle top with bread crumbs and cover dish with aluminum foil.
8. Bake at 400° for 45 minutes to 1 hour or until vegetables are soft and tender.
9. Remove foil from top of casserole and bake for 15 minutes, until bread crumbs are golden brown.
10. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.
11. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Stephen Putnam'S Root Vegetable Gratin

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 lb. sausage, cooked, drained and crumbled

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients together in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
2. Cover and refrigerate overnight.
3. Uncover and bake at 350° for 1 hour. Serves 8 to 10.
title: Egg Souffle

steps: 1. Heat milk and butter in upper part of double boiler. Add seasonings to eggs and beat until very light. Add eggs to hot milk and blend well. Cook over gently simmering water for 30 minutes. Serve on warm platter. Garnish with a sprig of parsley.
2. Makes 6 servings.
title: Quick Egg Souffle

steps: 1. Spread ham, cheese and onion over bottom of quiche dish or pie
2. plate.
3. Then, place remaining ingredients in blender. Cover and
4. blend at high speed for 1 to 2 minutes.
5. Pour this blender mixture
6. over
7. ingredients
8. in
9. pie
10. plate.
11. Bake
12. in preheated 350°
13. oven
14. for
16. to 55 minutes or until a knife inserted in the middle comes out clean.
17. Makes 6 servings.
title: Quick Quiche

steps: 1. Grease or spray quiche dish with Pam.
2. Sprinkle ham, cheese and onions in dish.
3. Beat remaining ingredients and pour into dish.
