4. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes in 400° oven or until golden brown and knife comes out clean.
5. Cool 5 to 10 minutes.
6. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Ham And Swiss Quiche

ingredients.text: 1 c. shredded crabmeat, ham or cooked sausage

steps: 1. Blend all ingredients by hand until well mixed.
2. Pour into lightly buttered quiche pan or 9-inch deep dish pie plate.
3. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes or until top is lightly browned and center is set.
4. Serves 4 to 5.
title: Zucchini Quiche

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°.
2. Saute onion and green pepper.
3. Grate cheese and mix with flour.
4. Stir in bacon, onion and green pepper. Spread in bottom of pie shell.
5. Mix remaining ingredients and pour into shell.
6. Bake on top of a cookie sheet for 35 to 40 minutes or until browned and filling is set.
7. Serves 6.
8. This can be made ahead of time.
9. Freezes well, cooked or uncooked.
title: Quiche

steps: 1. Brown sausage; drain.
2. Combine all ingredients.
3. Place in a covered bowl and refrigerate overnight.
4. Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
5. Bake 45 minutes at 350°.
6. Excellent for brunch. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Sausage And Egg Souffle

steps: 1. Cut chicken into serving size pieces; pound thin.
2. Beat eggs, water, green onions and mustard in medium bowl.
3. Dredge chicken in flour.
4. Dip in egg mixture, coating well.
5. Coat with bread crumbs, pressing crumbs into chicken.
6. Melt margarine in skillet, add oil and heat.
7. Saute chicken for 5 minutes on each side or until done.
8. Makes 3 to 4 servings.
title: Dijon Chicken Breast

steps: 1. Mix eggs, milk and flour.
2. Fold in ham, cheese, onion and seasonings.
3. Pour mixture into pie shell.
4. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes or until knife inserted comes out clean.
5. Serves 4.
title: Ham And Cheese Quiche

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients.
2. Bake in greased pie plate at 350° for 30 minutes until golden brown.
3. Serves 6.
title: Firemen Zucchini Quiche

steps: 1. Remove crust from bread.
2. Tear bread in pieces and pour melted margarine over it.
3. In blender, mix eggs, milk and seasonings. Add crumbled cheese.
4. Blend only until smooth.
5. Add bread, blend until smooth. Pour into buttered casserole and bake at 350°, uncovered, about 40 to 45 minutes.
6. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Mock Cheese Souffle *

ingredients.text: 1/4 c. coarsely chopped sweet red pepper
4 medium tomatoes, peeled and cut into wedges

steps: 1. Saute eggplant and zucchini in oil in a large skillet over medium heat for 6 to 8 minutes, stirring occasionally.
2. Add peppers and onion; cook 6 minutes, stirring occasionally.
3. Add garlic; cook 2 minutes.
4. Add remaining ingredients, except parsley.
5. Cover and reduce heat; simmer 5 minutes.
6. Sprinkle with parsley.
7. Remove bay leaf.
8. Yields 8 servings.
title: Ratatouille Supreme

steps: 1. Mix first five ingredients.
2. Heat shortening in frypan until moderately hot.
3. Drop mixture by large spoonfuls into fat.
4. Fry slowly and turn with spatula to brown on other side.
5. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Carrot Croquettes

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Blind bake pastry, lined with foil filled with beans, for 15 minutes or follow your recipe's blind baking instructions. Remove foil and beans, brush with dijon mustard, and bake another 5 minutes.
2. Whisk together the eggs, season them well with salt and pepper, and then whisk in the milk and cream.
3. Remove the crust from the oven. Sprinkle the pancetta, scallions, and half the cheese over the bottom, then pour in the egg and cream mixture and sprinkle the remaining cheese over the top.
4. Bake until set, 30-40 minutes. I take it out when there is still a slight wobble in the very center. If you prefer a firmer texture leave it oven until there is no wobble.
title: Date And Pancetta Quiche

ingredients.text: 4 pints cherry tomatoes, tops cut off

steps: 1. 1. Preheat oven to 350°F.
2. 2. Give the cherry tomatoes a squeeze to remove the seeds; set aside.
3. 3. Divide the butter among 6 six-ounce ovenproof baking cups. Sprinkle them with the sugar.
4. 4. Fill each cup with the cherry tomatoes, adding a layer of sun-dried tomatoes in the middles.
5. 5. Cover loosely with foil and bake for 1 hour.
6. 6. Gently press down the tomatoes (which will have shrunk), molding them to the shape of the cups. Bake, covered, for 45 minutes more.
7. 7. Remove from the oven. Increase temperature to 425°F.
8. 8. Roll the pastry out to 1/8 inch thick. Cut out 6 four-inch circles and poke them all over with a fork.
9. 9. Top each cup with a pastry circle, pressing to seal. Bake for 15 minutes.
10. 10. Remove and let cool for 15 minutes. Run a small, sharp knife around the rims and invert the tarts onto plates.
title: Tomato Tartes Tatins

steps: 1. Spray a 9-inch glass pie dish with non-stick spray and sprinkle the breadcrumbs over the bottom and sides of the dish. Shake the dish around to distribute evenly.

2. Slice the white and light green parts of the leek 1/2 inch thick. Boil 4 cups of salted water and add leeks. Boil 3 minutes. Remove from heat and add spinach and kale. Set aside for 30 minutes for greens to wilt and soften. Drain, rinse with cold water, squeeze out the water, and set aside.
3. Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Whisk egg whites until frothy and then whisk in the whole eggs. Whisk in milk, salt, pepper, nutmeg, tarragon, and basil.
4. Scatter the greens mixture in the bottom of the pie plate over the breadcrumbs. Sprinkle on the goat cheese. Pour egg mixture over the greens and bake 25 minutes. Cool 5 minutes before serving.
title: Crustless Quiche With Greens, Herbs, And Goat Cheese

ingredients.text: 1 large can salmon, boned and drained

steps: 1. Drop from teaspoon into deep hot fat.
2. Turn once; remove and drain.
3. If you want larger croquettes, drop from a tablespoon. These are good hot or cold.
title: Different Salmon Croquettes

steps: 1. Brown ground beef and drain well.
2. Mix well beaten eggs with remaining ingredients and add to drained ground beef.
3. Pour into unbaked pie shells.
4. Bake in 350° oven for 40 minutes or until well done.
title: Hamburger Quiche

steps: 1. Crumble and cook sausage; drain well.
2. Mix with all other ingredients.
3. Pour into 9 x 13-inch ungreased glass dish.
4. Cook at 350° for 1 hour.
5. This tastes best when covered and refrigerated overnight before cooking.
6. A great breakfast dish!
title: Sausage Souffle

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 400°F. Brush six 8-oz ramekins with some of the melted butter. Sprinkle with breadcrumbs to coat, shaking out excess.
2. Combine remaining butter in a saucepan over high heat with flour and mustard; cook, stirring, 1 minute. Remove from heat.
3. Gradually blend in milk until smooth. Return to heat; cook, stirring, until mixture boils and thickens. Reduce heat to low; simmer 3 minutes. Allow to cool slightly.
4. Whisk egg yolks into sauce. Add crabmeat, cheese, parsley and zest; season to taste.
5. In a large bowl, using an electric mixer, beat egg whites until soft peaks form. Using a large metal spoon, gently fold into crab mixture.
6. Spoon mixture evenly among ramekins; place on an baking sheet. Bake 15-20 minutes, until well risen and just set. Serve immediately.
title: Crab Souffles

steps: 1. Butter each slice of bread on one side.
2. Place 8 slices, butter side down, in a buttered baking dish.
3. Spread ham, cheese and onion on bread.
4. Top with remaining 8 slices of bread, butter side up. Mix eggs and milk.
5. Pour over casserole.
6. Cover with foil.
7. Store in refrigerator overnight.
8. Before baking, sprinkle with paprika. Bake for 1 hour at 325°, uncovered.
title: Ham Souffle Sandwich

steps: 1. In a large bowl, cream shortening and sugar. Beat in egg. Combine flour, baking powder, salt and nutmeg. Add to creamed mixture alternately with milk (batter will be stiff).

2. Fill greased miniature muffin cups two-thirds full. Bake at 350° for 20-25 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean. Combine sugar and cinnamon. Remove puffs from pans; immediately roll in butter, then in cinnamon-sugar. Serve warm.
title: Mini French Puffs

ingredients.text: 1 fennel bulb, outer leaves removed, roughly chopped
1 medium onion, skin removed, cut in half then sliced
4 large ripe tomatoes, deseeded and roughly chopped
2 tablespoons fresh sage (dried can be used instead of fresh)
2 tablespoons fresh basil (dried can be used instead of fresh)
1 sprig fresh thyme (dried can be used instead of fresh)

steps: 1. Fry the onions and garlic gently in the olive oil in a large saucepan.
2. Add the chopped fennel and cook for approximately five minutes.
3. Add the white wine, simmer for ten minutes.
4. Add the chopped tomatoes and the herbs.
5. Cover the pot and simmer for fifteen minutes.
6. Remove lid and simmer further uncovered to thicken sauce if preferred.
7. Just prior to serving add the lemon juice and salt and pepper to taste.
8. May be served cold.
title: Fennel Provencal

ingredients.text: 1 pound parsnips, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch pieces

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 400°. Place first 4 ingredients in a large roasting pan. Drizzle with olive oil, add sea salt and pepper, and toss to coat. Roast vegetables 1 hour 10 minutes or until tender.

2. Transfer vegetables to a lightly greased 13- x 9-inch baking dish. Stir in cream, fontina, and 1/2 tablespoon parsley; sprinkle top with Parmesan, breadcrumbs, and remaining 1/2 tablespoon parsley. Bake 10 minutes more or until bubbly. Serve hot.
title: Root Vegetable Gratinata With Cream And Fontina

steps: 1. Place flour in mixing bowl. Combine oil and milk and add to flour, all at once.
2. Mix quickly with a fork until mixture forms into a ball. Roll dough out between sheets of waxed paper to a 12-inch circle.
3. Line an 8 or 9-inch pie plate with the pastry and crimp the edges.
4. Pierce dough in several places with fork. Bake at 450° for 10 minutes or until golden brown. Cool before filling.
title: Quiche Crust

ingredients.text: 1 cup unsalted butter, cut into pieces

steps: 1. Process cucumber in a food processor until liquified. Strain and measure 1 cup cucumber liquid.
2. Combine cucumber liquid, cream, and lemon juice in a saucepan; bring mixture to a boil. Reduce heat, and simmer 25 to 30 minutes or until reduced to 1/2 cup.
3. Reduce heat to low; whisk in butter, 1 piece at a time. (Do not overheat or sauce will separate.) Stir in salt and ground white pepper.
title: Cucumber Beurre Blanc

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°F.
2. Mix milk, flour and eggs well.
3. Add the remaining ingredients and pour into 8 X 8 greased baking dish.
4. Bake for 40-45 minutes.
5. Let sit 10 minutes before serving.
title: Lazy Day Brunch Casserole (Crustless Quiche)

steps: 1. Brown sausage; drain.
2. Reserve 2 tablespoons of fat.
3. Saute onions and pepper in fat for 2 or 3 minutes.
4. Combine cheese and flour.
5. Stir in sausage, pepper and onion.
6. Spread in pie crust shell.
7. Mix remaining ingredients and pour into shell.
8. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes, until you can tell it is set in the center. Bake at 375°.
title: Sausage Quiche

steps: 1. Brown meat; drain off fat.
2. Combine all ingredients and pour in 1 (9 or 10-inch)
3. pie shell. Bake at 375° for 30 to 40 minutes.
title: Hamburger Quiche

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 c. milk (some cream may be used)

steps: 1. Crumble bacon into pie shell, cover with grated cheese.
2. Beat eggs; add milk, salt and seasonings.
3. Pour over cheese.
4. Bake at 450° for 10 minutes, then 350° for 25 minutes.
title: Simple Quiche

steps: 1. Layer bread and cheese in a casserole dish.
2. Mix eggs, milk, salt and beat well.
3. Pour mixture over bread and refrigerate overnight.
4. Next day, Bake at 400 for 45 minutes in double boiler.
title: Egg Souffle (Liz)

steps: 1. Thoroughly rinse leeks to remove sand.
2. Trim green portion off leeks.
3. Starting 1/4 inch from root cut in quarters.
4. Dice onion and peel and dice potatoes.
5. Melt butter in saucepan and simmer leeks and onions until limp.
6. Add stock and potatoes.
7. Add salt, pepper and garlic powder and simmer until potatoes are tender. Pass through food mill.
8. Return to saucepan.
9. Add half and half and milk.
10. Heat almost to the boiling point.
11. Stir often.
title: Vichyssoise

steps: 1. Heat oven to 350°.
2. Prick bottom and sides of pie shells; bake for 5 minutes, then take out.
3. Sprinkle bottom of pie shells with Swiss cheese first, then ham, broccoli and cauliflower.
title: Angela'S Ham And Vegetable Quiche

ingredients.text: 1 slice bacon (cooked crisp & crumbled as garnish) (optional)

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 200°C Peel onion, leaving the root-end intact. Cut the non-root end top from the onion & trim the root-end slightly to allow the onion shell to sit flat.
2. Remove as much of the inside pulp as poss w/o tearing the shell & set the onion top + inside pulp aside. Bake shell in the oven for 10 minute Do not turn off the oven.
3. Rough chop the onion top + inside pulp. In a non-stick skillet, combine the chopped onion w/sugar + cayenne pepper & simmer till soft. Add cream + egg yolk, stir to mix well & remove from heat.
4. Mound onion mixture into the onion shells & bake for 7 minute Allow to cool slightly, sprinkle w/crumbled bacon (if using) & serve immediately w/entree of choice.
5. NOTE: For those of you who might be put off by the process for preparing the onion shells, this can easily be prepared & served in ramekins.
title: Onion Creme Brulee

steps: 1. Brown hamburger and onion.
2. Beat eggs and remaining ingredients.
3. Drain hamburger, then add to egg mixture.
4. Pour into quiche pan and bake 35 to 40 minutes at 350°.
title: Captain'S Quiche

steps: 1. Sprinkle the cheese, flour and ham into pie crust. Combine the remaining ingredients. Beat until smooth and pour evenly over cheese and ham. Bake at 400° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.
title: Quiche Lorraine

ingredients.text: 8 slices meat (bacon, sausage or ham), cooked and crumbled

steps: 1. In a 9 x 13-inch pan, arrange bread in pan (with crusts already cut off).
2. In
3. large bowl, beat the eggs;
4. add remaining ingredients and
5. your
6. choice
7. of
8. meat.
9. Pour over bread. Bake in 350° oven for
10. 40 to 50 minutes.
11. Dish can be made the night before.
12. Just cover and store in refrigerator.
title: Egg Souffle

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees.
2. Coat 4 (6 ounce) ramekins with cooking spray; sprinkle evenly with breadcrumbs, tilting and turning dishes to coat sides completely.
3. In a heavy saucepan, melt butter over medium heat.
4. Add onion and cook for 1 minute.
5. Sprinkle with flour.
6. Cook, stirring, until mixture begins to pull away from pan.
7. Gradually whisk in milk.
8. Return to medium heat; cook, stirring, for 3 minutes or until thickened and bubbly.
9. Remove from heat.
10. Whisk in a large bowl, the egg yolks, salt, pepper, dry mustard, and garlic powder.
11. Temper the yolk mixture, by putting some of it into the onion milk sauce, then add all the onion milk sauce back into large bowl of yolks.
12. In a medium sized bowl, beat the egg whites and cream of tartar until stiff peaks form that do not fall over when the whisk is lifted.
13. Gently fold the egg whites and Cheddar into cooled sauce in large bowl.
14. Divide mixture evenly among four custard cups.
15. Sprinkle with Parmesan.
16. Put custard cups on a baking sheet so that they are easier to handle.
17. Bake for 20 minutes.
18. Souffle should still be moist in center; do not overcook and yes it will fall but that is the nature of a souffle.
title: Individual Cheese Souffles

steps: 1. Fry and drain sausage.
2. Sprinkle eggs with salt and pepper; beat in milk.
3. Layer 1 cup cheese and all sausage, crumbled.
4. Pour in milk and egg mixture.
5. Top with other cup of cheese.
6. Bake 30 minutes at 350° or until fork inserted in center comes out clean. Rub butter on crust edges before baking and lay foil loosely over top for any extended baking time.
title: Sausage Quiche

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 200°C and butter two ramekins.
2. Divide the blackberries between the prepared ramekins, leaving some for later (optional).
3. In a bowl add the almond meal, flour, milk, sugar, eggs, vanilla and salt. Mix well until you have a smooth batter.
4. Pour the batter over the fruit (dotting the tops with the leftover blackberries).
5. Place the dishes on a baking tray and bake in the middle of the oven for 30 minutes, or until the tops are golden.
6. Transfer to a wire rack and allow to cool for a few minutes.
7. Serve warm with whipped cream.
title: Blackberry Clafoutis

ingredients.text: 2 green bell peppers, cut into 1/2-inch pieces
2 garlic cloves, minced and mashed to a paste
1/2 c. packed fresh basil leaves, rinsed, spun dry and torn into pieces

steps: 1. In a heavy kettle, heat the oil over moderately high heat until it is hot, but not smoking and in it, saute the eggplant, stirring, until it is golden.
2. Reduce the heat to moderately low.
3. Add the onions and the bell peppers and cook the mixture, stirring, until the onions are softened.
4. Stir in the tomatoes, the garlic, the basil, the oregano, the thyme and salt and pepper to taste and cook the mixture over low heat, stirring occasionally, for 20 to 25 minutes or until done.
5. Ratatouille may be served hot or at room temperature over your favorite pasta.
title: Ratatouille

steps: 1. Blend eggs well. Grate cheese. Add 1/3 cup of grated cheese for each egg. Blend well.
2. Add black pepper and mustard. Pour in a souffle dish.
3. Bake at 350 degrees for approximately one hour or until golden brown.

4. For cheese souffle, check with Larousse or any competent French cook, you need to separate the yolks and the whites, mix the yolks in with a roux, add gruyere, whisk the eggs separately to a soft peak, and then layer (or 'fold') but NEVER stir the whites into the cheese and egg mixture, transfer to a well-buttered deep dish, bake immediately at medium heat WITHOUT opening the oven until fully done. Much easier to time in ramikins (10-15 mins, but you'll need to experiment to get it right for your own oven).
title: Cheese Souffle

ingredients.text: 6 tablespoons unsalted butter, plus more to butter a 6-cup gratin dish
2 1/3 cups grated swiss cheese, preferably Gruyere (about 6 ounces)

steps: 1. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F.

2. Butter a 6-cup gratin dish, and set it aside. Melt the butter in a saucepan, then add the flour, and mix it in well with a whisk. Cook for 10 seconds, and add the milk in 1 stroke, and mix it in with a whisk. Keep stirring with the whisk until the mixture thickens and comes to a strong boil, which will take about 2 minutes. It should be thick and smooth. Remove from the heat, and stir in the salt and pepper. Allow about 10 minutes for the white sauce to cool.

3. Meanwhile, break the eggs into a bowl, and beat well with a fork. Add the eggs, the cheese and the chives to the cooled sauce, and mix well to combine. Pour into the buttered gratin dish and cook immediately, or set aside until ready to cook.
4. Bake for 30 to 40 minutes, or until the souffle is puffy and well browned on top. Although it will stay inflated for quite awhile, it is best served immediately.
title: Maman'S Cheese Souffle

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°F.
2. Pound chicken breasts until they are thin.
3. Stir together mustard, honey, salt and pepper.
4. Spread or paint dijon mixture generously on chicken breasts.
5. Crush Ritz crackers into fine crumbs.
6. Press crumbs onto mustard coated chicken until chicken is thoroughly coated with crumbs.
7. Place chicken on a baking sheet or jellyroll pan and bake at 350F for 30-40 minutes or until crispy, turning chicken once during cooking, if desired.
title: Crispy Honey Dijon Chicken

steps: 1. In heavy saucepan, combine milk, cream, and vanilla bean; cook over med-low heat until bubbles form around edge of pan. Do not boil. Meanwhile place egggs and egg yolks in bowl. Combine sugar & cornstarch; beat into eggs.

2. Gradually pour in hot milk mixture, stirring constantly. Return to pan and cook over med-low heat, stirring until thick enough to coat back of metal spoon. Strain into 4 cup (l L) baking dish or 6 indiv custar cups. Let cool, stirring occas, refrigerate for at least 6 hrs or until firm.
3. About 2 hrs before serving, evenly spread Hazelnut Praline over custard place on baking sheet and broil for 3-4 mins or until praline is dark golden brown. refrigerate until chilled.
title: Light Creme Brulee

steps: 1. Fry bacon.
2. Spread frozen pie crust with 1 tablespoon melted butter.
3. Crumble bacon into bottom of pie and add Swiss strips. Mix 2 cups heavy cream with 4 eggs and 1/4 teaspoon salt and pepper.
4. Pour over bacon and Swiss.
5. Bake at 425° for first 15 minutes.
6. Drop temperature to 350° and bake another 30 minutes.
title: Bacon And Swiss Quiche

steps: 1. Mix in order and cook 45 minutes at 350°.
title: French Coconut

steps: 1. Melt butter; blend in flour.
2. Add milk all at once.
3. Cook and stir until thick and bubbly; cook and stir 1 minute more.
4. Remove from heat.
5. Add ham, onion and mustard.
6. Chill well.
7. Shape mixture into 8 to 10 balls.
8. Roll in bread crumbs.
9. Shape into cone, handling lightly.
10. Combine egg and water; dip cone in mixture and roll again in crumbs.
11. Fry in deep, hot fat (365°) for 1 1/2 to 2 minutes.
12. Drain.
title: Ham Croquettes(Leftovers)

ingredients.text: 4 cups vegetables, cut into bite-sized pieces (onion, broccoli, eggplant, zucchini, mushrooms, etc.)
1 tablespoon tarragon, fesh and finely sliced

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
2. Heat the olive oil in a pan.
3. Saute the begetables (onions first if you use them) until they become tender.
4. Season with salt and pepper.
5. Remove from heat, mix in tarragon and set aside.
6. Beat the eggs, cream and half and half together until well mixed.
7. Place the piecrust in a pie dish.
8. Sprinkle half the cheese onto the piecrust, follwed by the vegetables and the remainder of the cheese.
9. Pour egg mixture over filling.
10. Place quice on a cookie sheet on your oven's middle rack.
11. Bake for 35 to 45 minutes until the center of the quice no longer jiggles.
12. Remove the quiche from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes before you slice it.
13. Tip: If the quiche is watery, it is overcooked; adjust your cooking time.
title: Fresh Vegetable Quiche

ingredients.text: 1/4 cup sugar, for browning (turbinado if using a blowtorch, light brown sugar if using a broiler)

steps: 1. In a heavy-bottomed sauce pan, heat cream, milk and split vanilla bean almost to a boil, over medium-high heat. Watch the pot carefully, as the cream will scorch and bubble over if allowed to boil. As soon as it begins to simmer, remove pan from heat. Let sit at least 5 minutes to infuse cream with the vanilla.

2. Meanwhile, whisk sugar, cornstarch and egg yolks together in a large bowl. Slowly pour the cream mixture into the yolks, whisking constantly. If baking custards right away, remove vanilla bean; otherwise, cover and refrigerate with bean in custard up to two days.
3. Preheat oven to 325 degrees with the rack in the middle position. Set 8 6-ounce ramekins in a large casserole pan (you can use smaller or larger dishes; the cooking time will vary only slightly).

4. Divide the custard mixture into ramekins (about 3/4 cup in each). Fill the casserole pan with very hot tap water 1/2 of the way up the ramekins and carefully transfer to the oven. Bake just until set, about 25-30 minutes (time will vary depending on your oven), turning the pan once if the custards seem to be setting unevenly. The custards shouldn't bubble during cooking. If they do, remove immediately.

5. When done, the custards should be set on the edges and jiggle very slightly in the middle when shaken. You don't want them to be too firm. Remove from oven and allow to cool in water 10 minutes before carefully removing from casserole dish.

6. If serving right away, keep custards at room temperature. If not cooking right away, refrigerate uncovered at least 2 hours, then cover. If chilled, remove from refrigerator and allow the custards to come up to room temperature, about 45 minutes.

7. Using a blowtorch: When ready to serve, sprinkle turbinado sugar, about 1-2 teaspoons each, and place dishes on a nonflammable surface. If you do not have turbinado sugar you can use granulated but just use a very thin layer or it may brown too much in some spots.

8. Following manufacturer's directions, light blowtorch and bring to medium heat. Using a circular motion and being sure to get the edges, caramelize the sugar directly and completely with flame. The crust should turn a deep golden brown color. Garnish with fresh fruit and/or cookies if desired.

9. Using the broiler: Refrigerate the custards up to a day. Dry the brown sugar (you can do a large batch and save it) on a cookie sheet in a 200-degree oven for 20 or 30 minutes. Let cool and run through a sieve or sifter. It will hold indefinitely.

10. Preheat boiler. Sprinkle a thin layer of brown sugar, about 2 teaspoons, on each chilled custard, using a finger to gently spread it evenly across the top. Position a rack 3 or 4 inches from broiler. Place sugared brulees one or two at a time under heat, carefully moving dishes slightly to caramelize sugar evenly (a broiler's heat is rarely even).

11. This takes a little practice and a lot of concentration, so you might want to do one or two as an experiment before you try it with company. When evenly caramelized, set aside and continue with the rest. Garnish with fresh fruit and/or cookies if desired.
title: Creme Brulee

3/4 cup light cream (or 1 cup evaporated milk)

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350. Lightly grease/spray a 2-qt casserole dish.
2. In a large skillet, melt butter. Add leeks and mushrooms, and salt, pepper and paprika cover and saute for 10-12 minutes; Remove from heat.
3. Add light cream, parmesan cheese and swiss cheese. Stir to combine well; pour into prepared casserole dish. Sprinkle breadcrumbs on top.
4. Bake at 350 for 20-25 minutes.

steps: 1. Heat oven to 350°.
2. Mix rice, 2 of the egg whites and 1/4 teaspoon rosemary.
3. Press onto the bottom and sides of lightly greased 10-inch quiche dish or pie plate for crust.

steps: 1. Crumble and brown sausage. Drain and cool.
2. In a large bowl, beat eggs, then add milk, salt, and dry mustard.
3. Add bread cubes; stir.
4. Add cheese and browned sausage; mix well.
5. Cover and refrigerate overnight.
6. Next morning, place in a 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes.

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 400°F. Grease a 12-cup madeleine baking pan.
2. Beat eggs, granulated sugar, 2 tbsp sifted powdered sugar and lemon peel in medium bowl with electric mixer until pale and thick.

3. Triple-sift flours; sift flour over egg mixture. Pour butter and lemon juice down the side of the bowl, then fold ingredients together. Drop rounded tablespoons of batter into each cup of the madeleine pan.
4. Bake for 10 mins, or until a skewer comes out clean. Tap hot pan firmly on work surface to release madeleines. Place on wire rack to cool.
5. Dust with remaining sifted powdered sugar to serve.
title: Lemon Madeleines

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 375°.
2. Melt butter; stir in flour and mix well.
3. Add milk, diced onion, salt and cheese.
4. Heat until slightly thickened.
5. Pour over potatoes.
6. Bake 1 hour.
7. Serves 6 to 8 people.
title: Potatoes Au Gratin

steps: 1. Melt butter in a heavy saucepan over low heat.
2. Add flour, stirring until smooth.
3. Cook 1 minute, stirring constantly. Gradually stir in milk; cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until thickened and bubbly.
4. Add onion and cheese, stirring until cheese melts.
5. Beat egg yolks; stir a small amount of hot sauce mixture into egg yolks.
6. Mix well.
7. Stir egg yolk mixture and spinach into sauce mixture.

9. Fold into sauce mixture.
10. Pour into a greased 1 1/2-quart casserole.
11. Place casserole in a shallow baking pan. Fill pan 1-inch deep with water.
12. Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes or until a knife inserted in center comes out clean. Yield:
13. 8 servings.
title: Spinach Souffle

ingredients.text: 5 c. cooked onions, drained and chopped

steps: 1. Mix onions, 4 cups cheese, flour and 6 tablespoons butter. Pour into a 2-quart casserole. Melt 1 tablespoon butter and mix with bread crumbs. Sprinkle remaining cheese on top of onions, followed by bread crumbs. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Serves 8 to 10.

2. Stir in cheese.
3. Save 6 asparagus spears for top.
4. Chop the rest into 1-inch length.
5. Lay on bottom of pie shell.
6. Pour in liquid.

2. Pour into 2-quart casserole.
3. Sprinkle 1 cup grated cheese on top. Bake in oven at 350° for 30 minutes.
4. Serves 10 to 12 people.

2. Stir until well blended.

3. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes or until thoroughly heated.
4. Serves 4.

4. Add remaining potatoes.

4. Season sauce with salt and pepper.

6. Stir in ham and onion.
7. Alternate layers of potatoes and sauce in greased 2-quart baking dish.
8. Bake for 45 minutes.
9. Add remaining cheese and bake until cheese is melted.
10. Serves 6 to 8.

4. Bake at 350° for one hour.
5. Serves 4 to 6.

3. Gently stir until all potatoes are covered with dressing.

4. Stir in milk.
5. Increase heat to medium; cook until bubbly and thickened, stirring constantly.

7. Stir in carrots and parsley flakes.
8. Spread in shallow 1 1/2-quart baking dish.
9. Sprinkle with crumb mixture. Bake in a 350° oven about 20 minutes or until bubbly and crumbs are golden brown.
10. Yields 8 servings.
11. Contains 220 calories per serving.
title: Carrots Au Gratin

steps: 1. Melt butter in 4 qt saucepan. Stir in sugar, then cook onions over medium heat until golden brown, about 10 minutes.
2. Stir in flour until well-blended with the onions and pan juices. Add water, wine, and beef broth; heat to boiling. Reduce heat to low. Cover soup and simmer 10 minutes.
3. Cut French bread into 4 1-inch thick slices. Toast the slices at 325 degrees just until browned. Reserve remaining bread.

4. Ladle soup into four 12-ounce oven safe bowls. Place one slice of toasted bread on top of soup in each bowl. Fold Swiss cheese slices and fit onto toasted bread slices. Place soup bowls on cookie sheet.
5. Bake at 425 degrees for 10 minutes, or until cheese is melted. Serve immediately.
title: French Onion Soup

ingredients.text: 1 (2 1/2 pound) butternut squash - peeled, seeded, and cut into 3/4-inch chunks

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish.

2. Melt the butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Stir in the onions and garlic; cook until the onions soften and turn golden brown, about 10 minutes. Add the butternut squash and brown sugar. Continue cooking and stirring until the butternut squash begins to brown on the edges, but is still somewhat firm in the center, about 10 minutes more. Scrape the squash into the prepared baking dish, and pour in the chicken broth. Wrap tightly with aluminum foil.

ingredients.text: 1 small bell pepper, cut into 1/4-inch strips

steps: 1. Mix first four ingredients gently with salt.
2. Heat the margarine in a large skillet until hot.
3. Pour the vegetables into skillet.
4. Cover tightly.
5. Cook at medium heat for about 8 minutes, stirring gently twice.
6. Sprinkle cheese on top of mixture.
7. Cover and cook until cheese is melted.

steps: 1. Preheat the oven to 375°.
2. Lightly grease a 10-inch quiche dish or pie pan.
3. Set aside.
4. In a 10-inch skillet, melt butter over moderate heat.
5. Add leeks, potatoes, salt and pepper.
6. Cook for 1 minute.
7. Add the water; simmer, covered, for 12 minutes.
title: Crustless Leek And Potato Quiche

steps: 1. Preheat the oven to 375 F (190 C).
2. Pour the white wine into a very large saucepan, or soup pot. Add the peeled and sliced shallots, salt and pepper, and gently saute until they begin to soften.

3. Add handfuls of the fresh spinach and keep turning it over as it cooks, you want to gently wilt it and have it reduce to about half it's volume, but NOT to be cooked down to mush. This should only take about 2-3 minutes for all of the spinach.
4. Pour all of the spinach/shallot mixture into a large mixing bowl, and let cool a little. (You will have some wine left in the bottom of the pan, and yes, it goes into the mixing bowl too).
5. While the spinach is cooling, beat the five eggs in a seperate bowl.
6. The add the flour to the spinach mixture and mix it in well, then add the Gouda cheese, milk, the finely diced sundried tomatos, and finially the beaten eggs. Mix well.
7. Pour the mixture into a shallow quiche dish approx: 11 inches x 1 1/2 inches deep (27 cm x 4 cm deep) that has been sprayed with a small amount of baking spray.

8. Sprinkle the un-toasted pine nuts on the top of the quiche and bake at 375 F (190 C) for between 45-55 minutes. To test that it is cooked, a wooden skewer should come out clean and the top will be a little puffed up and golden brown.
9. Serve warm and enjoy the sublety of the wine flavours as they compliment the rest of the spinach quiche.

7. Bake uncovered at 350 degrees for 30-35 minutes or till center is set.

2. Preheat oven to 350°. Microwave broccoli and water, covered, on high until broccoli is tender, 2-3 minutes. Let stand for 5 minutes; drain. Pulse broccoli in a food processor until blended.

3. In a small saucepan, melt butter over medium heat. Stir in flour and cayenne pepper until smooth. Gradually whisk in milk. Bring to a boil, stirring constantly; cook and stir until thickened, 1-2 minutes. Transfer to a large bowl; stir in cheese, mustard, salt, pepper and broccoli. steps: 1. Press hash browns into bottom and sides of 9-inch pie plate. Drizzle with butter. Bake at 425° for 25 minutes. Combine the ham, cheese and green pepper. Spoon over crust.
title: Hash Brown Breakfast Quiche

steps: 1. Blend together ingredients well.
2. Use filling right away, do not freeze.
title: Cottage Cheese Crepe Filling

ingredients.text: 1/2 lb. bacon, cooked into small bits

steps: 1. Prick bottom and sides of pie shells.
2. Bake at 450° for 10 minutes.
3. Let cool.
4. Combine ingredients and mix in blender.
5. Pour into cooled pie shells.
6. Bake, uncovered, at 325° for 45 minutes until knife comes out clean.
7. Let stand 15 to 30 minutes before serving.
8. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Quiche Lorraine(Makes 2 Pies!)

steps: 1. Beat potatoes; mix with rest of ingredients and put into greased casserole dish.
2. Cover with topping and bake at 350° for 35 minutes.
3. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Sweet Potato Souffle

steps: 1. Mix together until crumbly.
2. Spread on top of casserole.
3. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.
4. Serves 10.
title: Sweet Potato Souffle

ingredients.text: 3 c. mashed cooked sweet potatoes (about 2 large, peeled)

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°.
2. Combine mashed sweet potatoes with the rest of the ingredients.
3. Beat well by hand or with mixer.
4. Fold into buttered 2-quart baking dish.
5. Bake for 45 to 50 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean and top is firm and golden.
6. Serves 6.
title: Sweet Potato Souffle

steps: 1. Peel and boil potatoes until soft; drain and cool potatoes. Mash.
2. Add sugar, flour, cream and eggs, then add nutmeg and melted butter.
3. Bake for 15 minutes at 350°, then put on topping of marshmallows and brown.
4. Yields 6 servings.
title: Sweet Potato Souffle

steps: 1. Combine potatoes, butter, sugar and vanilla.
2. Mix well, preferably with electric mixer.
3. Add milk slowly.
4. Add beaten eggs.
5. Mix well.
6. Texture should be light and fluffy.
7. Fold in coconut, nuts and raisins; pour into 3-quart (2835-ml) buttered casserole.
8. Bake at 350° (177°C) for 30 to 45 minutes or until firm.
9. Place marshmallows on top and return to oven.
10. Increase temperature to 375° (190°C) and bake until marshmallows are golden brown.
11. Yields 8 to 10 servings.
title: Sweet Potato Souffle

ingredients.text: 3 1/2 pounds sweet potatoes, peeled and diced

steps: 1. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil over medium-high heat. Add sweet potatoes, cover, and cook until soft, about 10 minutes. Drain, and set aside.
2. Preheat oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). Lightly grease a 2 quart souffle dish. Sprinkle dish with 1 tablespoon white sugar, shaking dish to evenly coat bottom and sides.

3. Place the sweet potatoes into the bowl of a food processor. Add the butter, 3/4 cup sugar, heavy cream, eggs, cloves, nutmeg, cinnamon, vanilla, and salt. Process until mixture is smooth. Pour into prepared souffle dish.
4. Bake the sweet potato mixture in preheated oven for 20 minutes. Lower oven temperature to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
5. Bake the sweet potato mixture until edges are slightly browned, about 40 minutes more. Serve warm or at room temperature.
title: Gourmet Sweet Potato Souffle

steps: 1. Mix together sweet potatoes, sugar, salt, eggs, 1/3 stick margarine, milk and vanilla.
2. Pour into greased baking dish.
title: Sweet Potato Souffle With Topping

steps: 1. In large bowl, whisk together eggs, milk, melted butter, flour sugar and salt until smooth.

2. Heat a medium-sized skillet or crepe pan over medium heat. Grease pan with a small amount of butter or oil applied with a brush or paper towel. Using a serving spoon or small ladle, spoon about 3 tablespoons crepe batter into hot pan, tilting the pan so that bottom surface is evenly coated. Cook over medium heat, 1 to 2 minutes on a side, or until golden brown. Serve immediately.
title: Dessert Crepes

steps: 1. Cream butter and sugar.
2. Beat egg yolks; add to creamed mixture.
3. Beat egg whites until stiff; add to creamed mixture. Add vanilla; mix well.
4. Stir in flour.
5. Chill overnight.
6. Drop by spoonfuls onto well-greased waffle iron.
7. Cook 1 1/2 minutes on high until golden.
title: Grandma Debrun'S French Cookies

steps: 1. Mix in order given.
2. Put in unbaked pie shell and bake until firm in a 350° oven.
title: French Coconut Pie

ingredients.text: 4 large sweet potatoes, cooked and mashed

steps: 1. Combine
2. sugar,
3. margarine, syrup and eggs.
4. Beat until creamy.
5. Stir in potatoes.	Pour mixture into a greased baking dish.
6. Sprinkle with topping.
title: Hattie Coffer'S Sweet Potato Souffle

ingredients.text: 3 sq. unsweetened chocolate, melted and cooled

steps: 1. In small mixer bowl cream sugar and butter about 4 minutes or until fluffy.
2. Stir in cooled chocolate and vanilla.
3. Add eggs, one at a time, beating on medium speed of electric mixer after each addition and scraping sides of bowl constantly.
4. Fill baked pastry shell and chill several hours or overnight.
5. Whip cream with remaining 1/4 cup powdered sugar and Amaretto until firm. Spread on top of pie.
title: French Silk Pie

steps: 1. Brush a little egg white on unbaked pie shell and bake at 400° about 1 minute.
2. This prevents a soggy crust.
3. Beat eggs lightly; add other ingredients and pour into pie shell.
4. Bake 10 minutes at 400°, 15 minutes at 375° and 15 to 20 minutes at 350°.
title: French Coconut Pie

steps: 1. Heat oven to 350°.
2. Beat eggs with fork; stir in sugar, melted butter, lemon juice, vanilla and coconut.
3. Bake 40 to 45 minutes or until inserted knife comes out clean.
title: French Coconut Pie

steps: 1. Melt butter.
2. Mix in flour and nuts.
3. Pat into 13 x 9-inch pan.
4. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
title: French Cream Cake

steps: 1. Mix in order given and bake in an unbaked pie shell at 350° for 45 minutes or until done.
title: French Raisin Pie

steps: 1. Add all dry ingredients together and mix well.
2. Combine wet ingredients and add to the dry.
3. Beat in an electric mixer (strong) on high for 3 minutes.
4. Pour into an 8 x 4 inch loaf pan (or use oiled hands and spatula to shape into 2 thin, tallish baguettes on baking paper). Let rise in a warm place for 30 minutes.
5. Brush the top with oil (you must do this step! Otherwise the crust is yuk) and bake at 180 C or 350 F for 50-60 minutes.
6. Variations-Add olives, sundried tomatoes, italian herbs and a little parmesan to make a nice foccacia! (instead of making two baguettes shape into a square or round).
title: Chickee'S Favourite Gluten Free Sandwich (Or French!) Bread

steps: 1. Mix ingredients together a salt shaker.
2. Sprinkle on fries fresh from the oven or fryer!
title: French Fry Seasoning

steps: 1. In small mixer bowl, blend sugar, butter, chocolate and vanilla
2. on
3. low speed.
4. Gradually add milk; beat until smooth and fluffy.
5. Makes enough for 2 (9-inch) layers or 3 (8-inch) layer cakes.
title: French Silk Frosting

ingredients.text: 2 Tbsp. fresh basil, chopped or 1 tsp. dried basil

steps: 1. In a colander, mix zucchini with salt.
2. Let stand until zucchini is limp and liquid has drained.
3. Rinse and drain zucchini well, squeezing out as much water as possible.
4. While zucchini is draining, heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a wide frying pan over medium heat.
5. Add onion; stir often until soft.
6. Remove from heat.
title: Zucchini Madeleines(A Quickie Appetizer)

steps: 1. In a small saucepan, combine vinegar, tarragon, parsley and garlic powder.
2. Simmer over medium heat 1 to 2 minutes, stirring occasionally.
3. Place mayonnaise in a small bowl and add the vinegar mixture, stir until smooth and creamy.
title: Shortcut Bearnaise Sauce

steps: 1. Be sure to add in order and beat well after each item. Especially the vinegar.
2. Cook until thick, stirring constantly. Cool well before using.
title: Dressing For Banana Croquettes

steps: 1. Dredge chicken in flour, nutmeg and salt.
2. Brown in oil and butter.
3. Transfer to casserole.
4. Saute celery and onion until golden; stir in ham and seasonings.
5. Add to chicken.
6. Place quartered onion around chicken (stick onion with cloves if desired), add mushrooms.
7. Heat brandy, pour over chicken, ignite. Add wine, cover and cook in 350° oven for 1 1/2 hours.
title: Coq Au Vin(Chicken In Wine Sauce)

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients together.
2. Beat on high with mixer for 15 minutes.
title: French Red Dressing

steps: 1. Whisk together vinegar, shallot, salt, mustard, and pepper until salt is dissolved. Add oil in a slow stream, whisking until emulsified.
title: French Vinaigrette

steps: 1. Heat oven to 180C/160C fan/gas 4. Slice the tops off the tomatoes and reserve. Scoop out most of the pulp with a teaspoon, being careful not to break the skin. Finely chop the pulp, and keep any juices. Sprinkle the insides of the tomatoes with a little sugar to take away the acidity, then place them on a baking tray.

2. Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a large frying pan, add the onion and garlic, then gently cook for about 10 mins until soft but not coloured. Add the lamb, cinnamon and tomato purée, turn up the heat, then fry until the meat is browned. Add the tomato pulp and juice, the rice and the stock. Season generously. Bring to the boil, then simmer for 15 mins or until the rice is tender and the liquid has been absorbed. Set aside to cool a little, then stir in the herbs.

3. Stuff the tomatoes up to the brim, top tomatoes with their lids, drizzle with 2 tbsp more olive oil, sprinkle 3 tbsp water into the tray, then bake for 35 mins. Serve with salad and crusty bread, hot or cold.
title: Stuffed Lamb Tomatoes

steps: 1. Pound the garlic with sea salt in a pestle and mortar (or use a small food processor), until the garlic forms a paste. Whisk together the oil, lemon juice, zest, dill and garlic. Mix in the lamb and combine well. Cover and marinate for at least 2 hrs or overnight in the fridge. If you’re going to use bamboo skewers, soak them in cold water.

2. If you’ve prepared the lamb the previous day, take it out of the fridge 30 mins before cooking. Thread the meat onto the soaked or metal skewers. Heat the grill to high or have a hot griddle pan or barbecue ready. Cook the skewers for 2-3 mins on each side, basting with the remaining marinade. Heat the pitta or flatbreads briefly, then stuff with the souvlaki. Add Greek salad (see 'Goes well with', right) and Tzatziki (below), if you like.
title: Lamb and Lemon Souvlaki

steps: 1. Wash, shell and devein shrimp.
2. In large skillet, add butter and saute shrimp 30 seconds on each side.
3. Mix together lemon juice, oregano, garlic salt, pepper and dry mustard.
4. Pour over shrimp; simmer 1 minute.
5. Add dry sherry and simmer 2 minutes longer.
6. With slotted spoon, remove shrimp to a bed of rice pilaf. Boil butter-shrimp mixture about 2 minutes, until reduced to about half.
7. Pour over shrimp and rice.
8. Yield:
9. 4 servings.
title: Jumbo Shrimp A La Greek(Garides)

steps: 1. Halve peaches and remove pit.
2. Mix honey and balsamic together well.
3. Place peaches cut side down on heated grill.
4. Grill until starting to turn tender and nice grill marks appear.
5. Turn over.
6. Brush top liberally with honey-balsamic glaze.
7. Continue grilling until peaches are tender. Brushing with more glaze if desired.
8. Immediately add crumbled feta to center of peaches.
9. Serve warm.
title: Balsamic-Honey Grilled Peaches With Feta

ingredients.text: 1 tablespoon fresh oregano, chopped or 1/2 teaspoon oregano, dried

steps: 1. Combine broth, peel, lemon juice, oregano, capers, cornstarch and garlic. Set aside.
2. Cut pork tenderloin into 1-inch slices. Season with salt and pepper.
3. In a large nonstick skillet heat oil over medium-high heat. Cook pork half at a time for 1-2 minutes per side or until browned. Transfer to a platter.

4. Reduce heat to medium. Stir chicken broth mixture; add to skillet. Cook and stir for 1 minute. Return pork and accumulated juices to skillet. Cook for 2-3 minutes or until juices run clear (160F.), turning once. Spoon sauce over pork to serve.
title: Greek Pork Tenderloin Medallions

ingredients.text: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves (6 ounces each)

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°. Pound chicken breasts with a meat mallet to 1/2-in. thickness. Place in a greased 15x10x1-in. baking pan. Mix 1 teaspoon basil, 1 teaspoon rosemary and 1/2 teaspoon garlic salt; sprinkle over chicken. Bake, uncovered, 18-20 minutes or until a thermometer reads 165°. Cut chicken into thin strips.

2. Meanwhile, in a 6-qt. stockpot, cook orzo according to package directions, adding spinach during the last minute of cooking. Drain and return to pan. In a small bowl, whisk oil, mustard, oregano and remaining basil, rosemary and garlic salt; add to orzo. Add tomatoes, 1 cup Asiago cheese, feta cheese, pine nuts and chicken; toss to combine. Sprinkle with remaining Asiago cheese.
title: Mediterranean Chicken And Orzo

steps: 1. Finly grate cucumber and squeeze out the water using hands or cheesecloth
2. Combine yogurt, garlic, oil, lemon juice, and salt in a bowl. Cover and refrigerate. Let stand at least 24 hours for best results.
3. Add cucumber and fresh dill to the yogurt mixture and stir. Serve slightly chilled.
title: Tzatziki

ingredients.text: 1/4 cup chopped fresh parsley, or to taste

steps: 1. Mix yogurt, garlic, oregano, and black pepper together in a bowl. Add chicken to yogurt marinade, coating all sides. Cover and refrigerate for 4 hours.
2. Preheat an outdoor grill for medium-high heat and lightly oil the grate.

3. Remove chicken from yogurt marinade; place on preheated grill. Cook for 6 minutes; flip and sprinkle with feta cheese. Cook until chicken is no longer pink in the center and juices run clear, 4 to 6 more minutes. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 165 degrees F (74 degrees C). Garnish with fresh parsley.
title: Greek Feta Chicken

steps: 1. Mix spices, oil, broth in a small bowl.
2. Put roast in crock pot.
3. Poke it all over with a knife.
4. Pour the liquid mixture over the roast.
5. Cook on low 6-8 hours.
6. Shred roast in the crock pot- it will fall apart easily using just 2 forks.
7. Let it soak up the liquid.
8. Serve with pita bread, feta cheese, tomatoes.
9. Or serve over garlic couscous or mashed potatoes.
title: Mediterranean Pork Roast (Crock Pot)

ingredients.text: 3 1/4 pounds watermelon, rind removed, cut into 1 1/2-inch blocks
2 large fresh basil leaves, very thinly sliced

steps: 1. Using a small melon baller, scoop out the top of each watermelon block. Divide feta among melon hollows. Top each block with basil.
title: Feta-Stuffed Watermelon Blocks

steps: 1. Cook the pasta following package directions.
2. Meanwhile, make a dressing by combining the olive oil, lemon zest and juice, mustard and garlic.

3. Once cooked, drain the pasta and put back in the warm pot. Mix in the crumbled feta, tomatoes, spring onions and dressing. Heat gently til feta melts a little. This dish can be served warm or refrigerated as a packed lunch.
title: Lemon And Feta Pasta

ingredients.text: 2 cups yogurt (greek, makes a huge difference in the taste)
1/2 cup cucumber (of diced or grated English peeled)

steps: 1. Prepare all ingredients in advance. Combine oil and lemon juice in a medium mixing bowl. Fold the yogurt in slowly, making sure it mixes completely with the oil. Add the garlic, according to taste, and the cucumber and cumin.
title: Tzatziki

steps: 1. Mix
2. together
3. and roll out thin.
4. Cut out with biscuit cutter.
5. Bake at 375° for 5 minutes.
title: Trilby(Greek)

ingredients.text: 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato (not packed in oil)

steps: 1. Soak sun-dried tomatoes in enough boiling water to just cover them.
2. Set aside.
3. Heat oil in nonstick skillet over medium high.
4. Add onion and cook, stirring, for 3 to 4 minutes, or until softened.
5. Remove skillet from heat and transfer onions to small bowl.
6. Drain tomatoes, discarding the soaking liquid or reserving it for another use.
7. Add chopped tomatoes to onions and stir in basil and feta.
8. Cut a horizontal slit in each chicken breast to form a pocket.
9. Stuff each with 1/4 of cheese mixture.
10. Return skillet to medium-high heat.
11. Add the chicken breasts and saute for 6 minutes.
12. Carefully turn them and cook another 6 minutes, or until chicken is cooked through.
title: Chicken Breasts Stuffed With Feta & Sun-Dried Tomatoes

ingredients.text: 1/2 c. warm milk (to dilute baking soda)

steps: 1. Cream room temperature margarine and Crisco.
2. Add sugar.
3. Add eggs, spices, baking powder and baking soda-milk mixture, mixing well with mixer after each addition.
4. Add flour, 1 cup at a time, mixing after each, until consistency is pliable.
5. Chill dough.
title: Greek Kouloudia

steps: 1. Brush mushrooms clean and trim ends.
2. Saute mushrooms in the olive oil for 5 minutes.
3. Add remaining ingredients and simmer for 10 minutes, over very low heat.
4. Remove from heat and allow to cool.
5. Then refrigerate at least 6 hours, or a day to give flavors a little time to develop.
title: Greek Marinated Mushrooms

steps: 1. Mix all together and dip chicken in.
2. Remaining mixture will keep well in refrigerator.
3. Bake chicken 1 hour or until chicken is brown and well done.
4. Serve on rice or as main dish.
title: Mediterranean Chicken

steps: 1. Combine yogurt, garlic, rosemary and pepper in a shallow dish. Add chicken; turn to coat.
2. Refrigerate 1 to 3 hours.
title: Broiled Feta Chicken

ingredients.text: 1/3 cup finely chopped fresh mint leaves

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Wrap beet in foil and roast for 1 hour, or until tender. Let cool then peel and coarsely chop.
2. Transfer chopped beet to a food processor along with yogurt, ricotta, garlic and lemon juice. Pulse until combined. Transfer to a serving bowl and fold in herbs.
title: Beet Tzatziki

ingredients.text: 1 tbsp fresh oregano leaves, chopped, plus extra leaves to serve
1 None medium eggplant, cut lengthwise into 8 (1/3 inch) slices
2 None large potatoes, cooked, peeled, sliced into 1/4 inch rounds

steps: 1. Preheat broiler.

2. Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Cook onion and garlic for 3 mins, until soft. Add ground beef and cook for 5 mins, stirring, until browned. Add tomato puree and oregano. Reduce heat and simmer for 10 mins.

3. Meanwhile, lightly coat a cast iron grill pan with oil and place over high heat. Cook eggplant slices for 3 mins per side, until tender. Arrange on a baking tray in a single layer. Top with 2 tbsp ground beef mixture, cover with 2 potato rounds, another 2 tbsp ground beef and an eggplant slice. Repeat with remaining ingredients to make four stacks. Top each with grated mozzarella. Broil for 2 mins, until cheese melts. Sprinkle with oregano leaves and serve.
title: Moussaka

ingredients.text: 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour, or as needed
4 ounces reduced-fat cream cheese, cut into pieces
1/2 pound shredded cooked chicken, or more to taste

steps: 1. Melt butter in a skillet over medium-high heat. Saute mushrooms and onions in hot butter until soft and caramelized, about 5 minutes.
2. Pour 1/2 cup chicken stock into the skillet and bring to a boil while scraping the browned bits of food off of the bottom of the pan with a wooden spoon.

3. Gradually stir flour into mushroom mixture; cook and stir until light golden brown, about 30 seconds. Add remaining chicken stock to mushroom mixture; simmer, stirring occasionally, until sauce thickens, about 5 minutes.
4. Stir yogurt into sauce; add cream cheese and stir until cheese melts and sauce is thickened, about 2 minutes. Stir chicken into sauce and cook until heated through, about 5 minutes more.
title: Greek Yogurt Chicken Stroganoff With Mushrooms

steps: 1. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add zucchini and oregano; saute until zucchini is golden brown, about 4 to 6 minutes.
2. Remove skillet from heat and add parsley; toss to combine. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Sprinkle feta cheese over top just before serving. Yields about 1/2 cup per serving.
title: Sauteed Zucchini With Oregano And Feta (Ww 1 Point)

steps: 1. Preheat an oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).

2. Brush each salmon fillet on all sides with olive oil and arrange into the bottom of a glass baking dish with the skin side facing down. Scatter the tomatoes, feta cheese, onion, basil, and olives over the fillets; sprinkle with the lemon juice.
3. Bake in the preheated oven until the salmon flakes easily with a fork, about 20 minutes.
title: Greek-Style Baked Salmon

ingredients.text: 1 lb medium shrimp, peeled and deveined

steps: 1. Cook orzo in salted water according to package directions without added fat.
2. Drain and set aside.
3. Meanwhile, heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
4. Add onion, pepper and garlic; cook until soft, stirring occasionally, about 3 minutes.
5. Add tomatoes and oregano; bring to a simmer. Add shrimp and cook until shrimp are bright pink and cooked through, about 5 minutes.
6. Spoon cooked orzo into shrimp mixture; stir to combine.
7. Remove from heat and stir in basil.
8. Spoon about 1 1/4 cups of orzo-shrimp mixture onto each of six plates and top each with 1 teaspoon of feta.
title: Greek Shrimp With Orzo

steps: 1. In a small skillet, saute onion and garlic in 1 teaspoon oil until tender. Stir in the tomatoes, lemon juice, basil, salt, cinnamon and pepper. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat; simmer, uncovered, for 15 minutes.

2. Meanwhile, brush eggplant slices with remaining oil. Broil 4 in. from the heat for 1-2 minutes on each side or until lightly browned. Spread 2 tablespoons sauce mixture into a greased 3-cup baking dish. Top with half of the eggplant slices. Spread with 1/2 cup sauce mixture. Repeat layers.
3. Cover and bake at 350° for 20 minutes. Uncover; sprinkle with cheese. Bake 5-10 minutes longer or until cheese is melted.
title: Moussaka

ingredients.text: 12 ounces uncooked medium shrimp, peeled and deveined

steps: 1. Cook pasta according to package directions. Meanwhile, in a large skillet, saute shrimp in oil until shrimp turn pink. Add the garlic, salt and pepper; cook 1 minute longer. Remove and set aside.

2. In the same skillet, heat 1/2 cup broth, lemon juice and dried basil. In a small bowl, combine cornstarch and remaining broth until smooth; stir into the pan. Bring to a boil; cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened. Stir in spinach and shrimp; cook until spinach is wilted.
3. Drain pasta; serve with shrimp mixture. Sprinkle with cheese and fresh basil.
title: Mediterranean Shrimp Skillet For Two

ingredients.text: 12 kalamata olives, pitted and coarsely chopped

steps: 1. Cook pasta in boiling water until al dente.
2. Saute the sundried tomatoes, green onion and olives in a large skillet over medium high heat for a minute or two.
3. Add the garlic, red pepper flakes and pepper. Saute one minute more, then toss with the pasta.
4. Top with the cheese.
title: Coyote Grill'S Mediterranean Pasta

ingredients.text: 3 medium potatoes, peeled and quartered lengthwise
6 medium carrots, peeled and cut crosswise into 1-inch pieces
1 teaspoon cornstarch, dissolved in 1 tablespoon cold water

steps: 1. Remove the leaves from the artichokes and scoop out the chokes, leaving the bottoms. Discard the leaves. Cut the bottoms in half. Put them in cold water with 2 tablespoons of lemon juice added. When ready to use, drain and pat dry.
2. Pour the olive oil into a 6-quart saucepan. Saute the onions until soft. Add the potatoes and carrots and cook for about 5 minutes.

3. Add the artichoke bottoms, 4 1/2 cups of hot water, the dill and salt. Cover and bring to a boil over medium heat. Simmer until the potatoes, carrots and artichoke bottoms are fork-tender, about 12 to 15 minutes. Do not stir, but occasionally lift and move the pan back and forth (gentle shaking) to move the mixture around and keep it from sticking to the bottom of the pan, but be careful not to break up the vegetables. Reduce the heat to a low simmer while preparing the avgolemono sauce.

4. To make the avgolemono sauce, beat the eggs well in a small bowl, then slowly add 2/3 cup of lemon juice. Add the dissolved cornstarch and then slowly add about a cup of broth from the cooked vegetables, stirring all the while.
5. Pour the sauce over the vegetables and cook on low for about 3 minutes. Remove from the heat and allow to stand 10 minutes before serving.
title: Aginares Avgolemono (Artichoke Bottoms In Avgolemono)

ingredients.text: 1-1/4 pounds lean boneless pork, thinly sliced
6 pita breads (6 inches), halved and warmed

steps: 1. In a small bowl, combine the yogurt, cucumber, dill and seasoned salt; cover and refrigerate for 6 hours or overnight.

2. In a large resealable plastic bag, combine the oil, lemon juice, mustard, garlic, oregano and thyme; add pork. Seal bag and turn to coat; refrigerate for 6 hours or overnight, turning occasionally.
3. Drain and discard marinade. In a large skillet, stir-fry pork for about 4 minutes or until juices run clear. Stuff into pita halves; top with cucumber sauce, tomato and onion.
title: Greek Pitas

steps: 1. Rub the chicken inside and out with the cut surface of the lemon.
2. Rub outside with two tablespoons softened butter.
3. Place on rack in a roasting dish and bake in a 375° oven for 1/2 hour per pound.
4. Remove chicken and keep warm.
title: Greek Roast Chicken

steps: 1. Pre-heat oven to 425 (make sure your beets are about the same size so they will cook uniformly).
2. Wash beets and cut off tops and bottom so beets sit flat on pan. (I use parchment paper in the pan because beets are a bit messy).
3. Drizzle olive oil over beets.
4. You can either use spray garlic or put cloves of garlic in
5. the pan with the beets.
6. Add salt and pepper to taste.
7. Roast beets until they are tender (if they are rather large that could take an hour or more).
8. When you can stick a knife/fork into the beets they are done...take out of oven and let them cool.
9. When they are cool take the skin off of the beets and slice them nice and thin and put them on a platter.
10. Sprinkle Balsamic Vinegar on them ...salt /pepper to taste and them some goat cheese/feta whatever cheese you prefer.
11. You can serve these either cold or warm ...either way they are delicious.
title: Roasted Beets With Feta Cheese & Balsamic Vinegar

steps: 1. Bring water and quinoa to a boil in a saucepan. Reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and simmer until quinoa is tender and water has been absorbed, 15 to 20 minutes. Transfer quinoa to a large serving bowl and let cool completely.
2. Drizzle olive oil over cooled quinoa and stir. Fold olives, feta cheese, tomatoes, and basil through the quinoa.
title: Greek Quinoa

steps: 1. Peel the cucumber and cut in half lengthwise. Remove seeds using a spoon then grate the cucumber into a small bowl. Stir in the yogurt, garlic, salt and chopped mint. Chill for at least 30 minutes before serving to develop the flavor.
title: Tzatziki Ii

steps: 1. Heat stock in a small saucepan until hot
2. Combine the eggs, egg white, lemon juice, and salt in the top of a double boiler and beat with an electric mixer at high speed until frothy.
3. Add 1 cup hot stock in a stream, beating, then stir in the remaining 1 cup stock.
4. Set over simmering water and cook sauce, whisking, until slightly thickened.
title: Avgolemono

ingredients.text: 1 (1.5 pound) salmon fillet, skin removed and quartered

steps: 1. Combine lemon juice, capers, olives, vinegar, garlic, and enough water to cover the salmon in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Bring to a boil and add salmon. Reduce heat to medium-low. Let simmer, covered, until salmon is opaque and easily flaked with a fork, about 10 minutes.

2. Remove salmon from the liquid. Let liquid simmer until reduced by half, about 5 minutes. Add tomatoes and basil; cook and stir the sauce until tomatoes begin to break down, about 3 minutes. Spoon sauce over the salmon to serve.
title: Poached Mediterranean Salmon

ingredients.text: 1 None spring onion, very finely chopped

steps: 1. Heat oven to 325°F. Layer the prepared vegetables in a greased ovenproof dish, adding anchovies between each layer. Sprinkle over the olives, drizzle with 4 tbsp olive oil, and season with salt and pepper. Pour in the stock and bake for 1 hour.
2. 15 minutes before the end of cooking, sprinkle over the rosemary. When cooked, mix together the garlic, green onion, and 1 tbsp olive oil. Pour over the vegetables and serve hot.
title: Mediterranean Vegetable Casserole

steps: 1. In a bowl, combine the zucchini, tomato, olives and onion. Combine oil, lemon juice, oregano, garlic salt and pepper; pour over vegetables and toss to coat. Place on a double thickness of heavy-duty foil (about 23 in. x 18 in.). Fold foil around vegetables and seal tightly.
2. Grill, covered, over medium heat for 10-15 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
title: Grilled Greek-Style Zucchini

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Place the tomatoes in a large baking dish. Spoon the olive oil and garlic over the tomatoes. Sprinkle with the salt and pepper and toss. Place on top rack of oven and roast for 20 minutes. Remove from oven and stir in shrimp, parsley and lemon juice. Sprinkle with the feta. Place in oven for another 10-15 minutes. Serve warm with bread and salad.
title: Roasted Tomatoes With Shrimp And Feta Cheese

ingredients.text: 1 lb boneless skinless chicken breast, four 4 oz pieces

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 400. Coat a baking dish with cooking spray.
2. Combine seasoning and flour. Lightly coat chicken with cooking spray then coat each breast with flour mixture. Place chicken in prepared dish and bake until cooked through, about 20 minutes.
3. In a bowl, combine scallions, lemon juice, curry powder, dressing, avocado, tomatoes, and olives.
4. Divide chicken breasts between four plates and top with avocado salsa.
title: Ww Mediterranean Chicken

ingredients.text: 2 lbs boneless skinless chicken breasts, cut into medallions

steps: 1. In a large saute pan, heat an ample amount of vegetable oil over medium-high.
2. Place the chicken medallions in the pan and saute on both sides until browned.
3. Add the garlic, oregano and basil.
4. When the garlic starts to brown, add the white wine and chicken stock. Let simmer for 2-3 minutes.
5. Add the tomatoes, olive oil, lemon juice, salt and pepper, spinach and feta cheese.
6. Toss well while simmering for about 1 minute more.
7. Add to the hot, cooked pasta (reheat first if necessary; toss well and serve.
title: Mediterranean Penne Chicken

ingredients.text: 12 1/3 ounces firm silken tofu (this is one package of Mori-Nu)

steps: 1. Cut the seeds out of the cucumber (you don't have to be too picky about this!), and finely chop or grate it.
2. Put the tofu, cucumber, lemon juice and salt in a food processor and blend until completely smooth.
3. Taste for lemon and salt. Stir in the dill.
4. Pour into a serving bowl and enjoy chilled or at room temperature. Besides being a great dip for veggies or tomato slices, it's wonderful on Tofu Gyros.
5. Keeps well for 1 week. You may want to add a tablespoon or so of water the next day, as it tends to thicken slightly.
title: The Best Tzatziki

steps: 1. Preheat an outdoor grill for medium-high heat and lightly oil the grate.

2. Mix ground beef, feta cheese, minced onion, red bell pepper, mint, parsley, garlic powder, onion powder, seasoned salt, and black pepper together in a large bowl until evenly mixed; shape into 6 patties.

3. Cook the burgers until they are beginning to firm, and are hot and slightly pink in the center, 4 to 5 minutes per side. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center should read 140 degrees F (60 degrees C).
title: Feta Burgers

steps: 1. Mix first 6 ingredients in large bowl. Set tomato mixture aside. Cook pasta in large pot in salted water until just tender but still firm to bite, stirring occasionally. Drain. Add hot pasta to tomato mixture and toss to coat. Season to taste with salt and pepper and serve.
title: Greek Style Penne

ingredients.text: 2 medium cucumbers, chopped fine or shredded and squeezed of most of its liquid

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl and stir well to incorporate all ingredients.
2. Cover with plastic wrap or place in a plastic container with lid and chill well.
3. Stir again before serving.
title: Tzatziki

ingredients.text: 8 boneless skinless chicken breast halves (6 ounces each)

steps: 1. In a small bowl, whisk the first eight ingredients until blended. Pour 1 cup marinade into a large resealable plastic bag. Add chicken; seal bag and turn to coat. Refrigerate 1 hour. Cover and refrigerate remaining marinade.

2. Preheat oven to 350°. Arrange lemon slices in two greased 11x7-in. baking dishes. Drain chicken, discarding marinade in bag. Place chicken over lemon slices. Mix spice blend ingredients; sprinkle over chicken. Drizzle with reserved marinade. Bake, covered, 35-40 minutes or until a thermometer reads 165°.
title: Mediterranean Baked Chicken With Lemon

steps: 1. Peel and devein shrimp but leave tails intact.
2. Prepare linguini according to package directions.
3. Drain.
4. Keep warm.
5. In a 12-inch skillet over medium-high heat, heat 2 tablespoons oil; add shrimp.
6. Cook 4 minutes, stirring frequently, until shrimp are tender and just pink.
7. Using a slotted spoon, transfer shrimp to a plate.
title: Mediterranean Shrimp Linguine

steps: 1. Combine all of the marinade ingredients and place chicken breast in the marinade. Refrigerate the chicken for one hour or up to overnight.
2. Place chicken breast in a heated frying pan and saute with the marinade. Saute the chicken for about 6-8 minutes on each side.

3. Place the chicken on a heated griddle for about 4-5 minutes on each side so that each side of the chicken will become golden. While the chicken is on the griddle continue to simmer the marinade on LOW. Place the chicken back into the marinade and serve.
title: Greek Style Chicken

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. In a medium bowl whisk to combine: lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, mustard, and oregano
3. Put your Turkey into a gallon sized Ziploc bag and add marinade
4. Let sit for at least an hour, overnight is best!
5. Bake for 45-60 minutes or until Turkey is done
6. Serve with a yummy side dish!
title: Mediterranean Turkey Breasts

ingredients.text: 3 -4 minced fresh garlic cloves, to taste
3 tablespoons minced fresh mint leaves, to taste
3 fresh plum tomatoes, halved lengthwise, seeded, and cut into julienne strips
1 1/2 cups crumbled feta cheese, to taste

steps: 1. Halve two of the eggplants lengthwise, score there pulp deeply with a sharp knife (careful not to pierce the skins).
2. With a grapefruit knife, scoop out the pulp, reserving it, and leaving 1/2-inch thick shells.
3. Sprinkle the shells with salt and pepper; invert (turn over) on paper towels to drain for 30 minutes.
4. Cut the reserved pulp, and the remaining whole eggplant into 1/2-inch pieces.
5. Transfer to a colander; toss with salt, and let them drain for 30 minutes.
6. Pat the shells dry with paper towels, brush them with 1 Tbsp oil.
7. Broil them on a rack of a broiler pan under a preheated broiler, about 4 inches from the heat for 5 minutes, or until they are tender.
8. In a skillet, heat the remaining 3 Tbsp olive oil over moderately high heat until it is hot, but not smoking.
9. Saute the eggplant pieces (that have been patted dry), stirring until they are golden.
10. Stir in the chopped onion and the garlic; cook over medium heat until onion is softened.
11. Remove the skillet from the heat; stir in the parsley, mint, tomatoes and feta cheese, adding salt and pepper to taste; stir to combine.
12. Divide the filling among the shells mounding/heaping it.
13. Broil the stuffed eggplants in a large flameproof baking dish for 5 minutes, or until the filling is bubbly and golden-- delicious!
title: Greek-Style Stuffed Eggplant (Aubergine)

ingredients.text: 1 1/3 cup feta cheese, cut into 20 cubes
6 cups button mushrooms, halved if large

steps: 1. In a bowl, beat the egg and season with black pepper. Place the breadcrumbs in a second bowl. Roll the feta in the egg, then the breadcrumbs.

2. Heat 6 tbsp oil in a large skillet or frying pan. Add the arugula and deep fry for 30 seconds. Lift out with a slotted spoon and drain on kitchen towels. Clean the pan and heat 4 tbsp oil in it. Fry the feta until crispy all over, then remove and drain on paper towels.

3. Clean the pan again and heat 3 tbsp oil. Saute the mushrooms over a high heat, turning, until browned. Remove from the pan. Add 2 tbsp oil to the pan and fry the tomatoes for 3 mins, turning. Meanwhile, cook the pasta in boiling salted water according to the pack instructions. Drain, reserving the water.
4. Add the mushrooms and sugar to the tomatoes and cook until just caramelized. Season with salt and black pepper. Add the vinegar and 2/3 cup of the pasta water. Simmer for 1 min.
5. Toss together the pasta, tomatoes and feta. Divide between 4 serving plates and sprinkle over the arugula.
title: Linguine With Fried Feta, Arugula And Cherry Tomatoes

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
2. Arrange chikcen in 13x9-inch baking dish.
3. Drizzle with tablespoon of the lemon juice. Season with salt and pepper. Top with feta cheese, and drizzle with remaining lemon juice.
4. Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until chicken is cooked through. Sprinkle with tomatoes and parsley.
title: Easy Feta Chicken Bake (Gluten Free)

steps: 1. whisk together flour, salt, pepper and organo.
2. chop the roast into cubes, one or two inches.
3. put beef in a plastic bag along with flour mixture.
4. shake up the bag to coat the meat well.
5. place instant pot in saute mode and add olive oil to grease the pot.
6. saute onions, garlic, shallots and meat together until lightly browned (about 4 or 5 minutes). don't burn it.
7. mix in broth, wine, balsamic vinegar and dates.
8. cancel saute mode, put lid on and seal valve. use manual mode to cook for 40 minutes.
9. when done, allow depressurize using 'natural release' method.
10. serve over rice, mashed potatoes, or calliflower.
title: Instant Pot Mediterranean Beef Stew

ingredients.text: 2 slices whole wheat bread, or your favorite bread

steps: 1. Heat a skillet over medium heat. Butter one side of each slice of bread. On the non buttered side of one slice, layer the feta cheese, Cheddar cheese, red onion and tomato. Top with the other slice of bread with the butter side out.
2. Fry the sandwich until golden brown on each side, about 2 minutes per side. The second side always cooks faster.
title: Greek Grilled Cheese

steps: 1. Mix ingredients well. I use a stand mixer.
2. Allow to rest in refrigerator a couple of hours.
3. Grill or broil and serve with the condiments described above.
4. I like Jenny-O, Butterball, or Honeysuckle ground turkey. Their package size =1.25 lbs.
title: Turkey Gyro Burgers

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Spray a 2 quart baking dish with nonstick cooking spray.

2. Cook beef, onion and 1 1/2 teaspoons of the garlic in a large skillet over medium heat, stirring fequently, until the meat is browned and crumbly. Mix in the the tomatoes, parsley, oregano, cumin, cinnamon and salt.
3. Spoon beef mix into the prepared dish. Arrange pita bread on top of the beef.
4. Bake until the filling is bubbly and pitas are golden, 20-25 minutes.
5. Meanwhile, combine cucumber, yogurt, mint and remaining garlic; mix well. Serve sauce with casserole.
title: Gyro Casserole

ingredients.text: 3/4 lb boneless skinless chicken breast, cut into 1/2 inch strips
2 zucchini, halved lengthwise and thickly sliced
1 red bell pepper, cut into thin strips

steps: 1. Cook the rotini according to package directions.
2. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat, add chicken. Cook and stir abou 5-7 minutes, or until chicken is golden brown.
3. Remove chicken and add garlic, zucchini and red bell pepper to the pan. cook and stir until pepper is tender.
4. Add tomatoes, water, and dill. Bring to a boil then reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes.
5. Remove from heat.
6. Stir in sour cream and feta. Add chicken and pasta, mix well.
7. Serve immediatly.
title: Rotini With Chicken, Zucchini, And Feta

steps: 1. To strain your own yogurt: Put the yogurt in a thick napkin or cloth. Put it in a strainer and put the strainer over a bowl to catch the excess liquid. Refrigerate them both in a bowl over night.
2. In a small bowl, peel and grate the cucumber. Drain well.
3. To drain the cucumber you can use a strainer or you can squeeze the grated cucumber between your hands. You can also use the salt at this point to absorb the excess water from the cucumber.
4. In the same bowl add the vinegar, olive oil, garlic, salt and pepper.
5. Add the strained yogurt and mix well.
6. Refrigerate overnight.
title: My Homemade Tzatziki

ingredients.text: 2 Tablespoons Olive Oil (may Not Need All Of It)

steps: 1. 1. Preheat oven to 400°F.
2. 2. Place cherry tomatoes in a baking dish or cookie sheet with sides.
3. 3. Drizzle olive oil over tomatoes, toss to coat.
4. 4. Sprinkle salt and pepper over tomatoes, toss.
5. 5. Bake for 10-15 minutes or just until tomato skin begins to crack.
6. 6. Remove from oven and place tomatoes in a serving dish. Mix with feta and cilantro.
title: Roasted Tomatoes And Feta

steps: 1. Cook beef, onion, garlic, oregano and 1/4 tsp salt over medium-high heat 5 to 7 minutes, until beef is thoroughly cooked; drain.
2. Meanwhile, mix cucumber, tomato, yogurt, dill and remaining salt.
3. Mix olives in with beef.
4. Spoon one quarter of the beef mixture onto half a pita.
5. Top each with a spoonful of yogurt mixture and Feta.
6. Fold pita in half and serve with remaining yogurt sauce.
title: Beef And Feta Pitas

ingredients.text: 1 small red onion, thinly sliced and seprated into rings

steps: 1. Arrange tomato and onion slices on a plate. Sprinkle with the feta cheese, parsley, salt and pepper. Drizzle with oil. Cover and refrigerate for 15 minutes.
title: Greek Tomatoes

steps: 1. Heat oven to 375 degrees. Mix all the ingredients. Spread over chicken breasts. Bake for 45 minutes.
title: Greek Yogurt Chicken

ingredients.text: 1 stick celery, trimmed and finely chopped
2 tsp finely chopped fresh oregano leaves
1 large red bell pepper, finely chopped
2/3 cup pitted black olives, finely chopped
1 tbsp coarsely chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley

steps: 1. Preheat the oven to 425°F. Line two baking pans with parchment paper.

2. Using a small knife, cut a 1/4-inch border inside each eggplant half. Scoop out the flesh without breaking the skin. Reserve flesh for another use. Place eggplant shells, cut-side-up on prepared pans. Cover with foil. Bake 25 mins.

3. Meanwhile, heat half the oil in a large skillet on medium heat. Cook onion, celery, garlic and oregano, stirring, 3 mins or until soft. Add pepper; cook, stirring, 3 mins or until soft. Stir in tomato, and lemon peel and juice. Remove from heat. Stir in feta and olives; season to taste.
4. Combine breadcrumbs, Parmesan cheese and parsley in a medium bowl; season to taste.
5. Reduce oven temperature to 400°F.
6. Spoon pepper mixture into eggplant halves; top with breadcrumb mixture. Bake 25 mins or until eggplant is tender. Drizzle with remaining oil before serving.
title: Greek Baked Eggplant

ingredients.text: 3 green onion, chopped into thin slices

steps: 1. Toss everything together in a bowl. Because I love things puckery, and I know many don't, my advice is to start with 2 Tablespoons of vinegar, give it a taste, and add more if you think it's necessary. As a side, this salad serves 4, although I've taken to eating it as a main dish.
title: Radish And Feta Salad

ingredients.text: 1 small green pepper, seeded, cut into 1/4-inch strips

steps: 1. In large bowl, toss together lettuce, tomatoes, cucumber, onion and green pepper.
2. Top with cheese.
3. In a separate small bowl, whisk together oil, vinegar, water, garlic, oregano and black pepper.
4. Pour over salad and gently toss.
5. Serves 4.
title: Greek Vegetable Salad

steps: 1. Steam beans for 5 minutes or until just tender.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together vinegar, mustard, garlic, oregano and pepper. Add beans and toss to coat.
3. Makes 4 servings.
title: Mediterranean Green Beans(Lo-Fat)

ingredients.text: 1/2 cup quinoa, uncooked and well rinsed

steps: 1. Rinse the quinoa in a strainer.
2. In a small saucepan, add the quinoa and 1 cup of water. Bring to a boil over high heat, then cover and reduce heat to simmer until water is absorbed, about 10-15 minutes.
3. Meanwhile, heat a skillet over medium heat and add the olive oil and garlic and onion.
4. Cook the garlic in the oil until the edges of the garlic turns very light brown, being careful not to burn the garlic (reduce heat to low if necessary).
5. When the quinoa is done cooking, add it to the skillet along with the spinach.
6. Stir it together until the spinach wilts.
7. Add the crumbled feta cheese and stir to combine. Makes 2 servings.
title: Quinoa With Spinach And Feta Cheese

steps: 1. Steam beans until crisp-tender.
2. Combine the cabbage and Feta cheese in a bowl.
3. Mix the olive oil, vinegar and thyme in a small bowl.
4. When beans are done, refresh them in cold water until cooled.
5. Add to cabbage mixture and toss with dressing.
6. Serves 4.
title: Greek Vegetable Salad

ingredients.text: 2 medium navel oranges, peeled and sliced
2 slices red onion, separated into rings

steps: 1. In a large bowl, combine the oranges, onion, oil, salt and pepper; gently toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours.
2. Using a slotted spoon, remove orange mixture to lettuce-lined plates.
title: Mediterranean Orange Salad

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients and stir well.
2. Serve immediately.
title: Scd Greek Salad

steps: 1. Clean leeks.
2. Discard green tops.
3. Cut in half lengthwise. Clean mushrooms; cut in half.
4. Clean zucchini; cut into 3-inch pieces and into 1/2-inch slices (also carrots and green beans).
title: Greek Vegetables
