steps: 1. Arrange figs and feta on a serving platter. Drizzle with oil and season. Sprinkle with mint and serve.
title: Fig, Feta And Mint Salad

ingredients.text: 1/4 teaspoon black pepper (or more, to taste)

steps: 1. Wash beans and break them in half or slice them lengthwise.
2. Place in a large pot of cold water.
3. Heat the oil in a large skillet and saute the onions until soft and translucent.
4. Drain green beans and add to the skillet.
5. Add the rest of the ingredients.
6. Cover and simmer over moderate heat for about 1/2 hour.
title: Greek Green Beans

ingredients.text: 4 small onions, sliced and separated into rings

steps: 1. Remove outer leaves and stalks from cauliflower.
2. Trim off any blemishes on head.
3. Separate head into flowerets.
4. Wash cauliflower well; drain.
5. Heat oil in large skillet over low heat. Add onions, carrots and garlic; cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
6. Add wine, water, lemon juice, tomato paste, bay leaves, coriander seed, salt and pepper; bring to boiling.
7. Add cauliflower; simmer for 15 minutes, or until cauliflower is just tender.
8. Transfer cauliflower to serving dish with slotted spoon. Heat liquid until the volume is reduced to about 1 1/2 cups; remove bay leaves.
9. Pour over cauliflower in serving dish.
10. Chill several hours.
title: Cauliflower Greek Style

steps: 1. In a large bowl, combine the tomatoes, green bell pepper, cucumber, red onion, olive oil, and lemon juice. Refrigerate until thoroughly chilled. Sprinkle with feta cheese before serving.
title: Greek Salad Iv

steps: 1. Cook rice in broth with butter until tender.
2. Beat egg whites until they form peaks.
3. Add egg yolks and lemon juice.
4. Slowly combine mixture with broth and rice so eggs do not cook.
5. Serve hot with pepper and Italian bread chunks.
6. Enjoy!
title: Avgolemono Soup(Greek Rice Soup)

ingredients.text: 2 lbs baking potatoes, peeled and cubed (you can also use red potatoes)

steps: 1. Place potato in a large saucepan; cover with water and bring to a boil. Cover, reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes or until potato is very tender.
2. Drain potato; return to pan. Beat at high speed of mixer until smooth. Add milk, feta cheese, sour cream, salt, oregano and pepper; beat well.
title: Feta Mashed Potatoes

ingredients.text: 3 cups cooked black beans, rinsed and drained

steps: 1. Combine black beans, oil, vinegar, parsley, and scallions and marinate a minimum of 1 hour.
2. (Overnight is best) Before serving add feta, tomatoes and green peppers.
title: Black Bean Salad With Feta

ingredients.text: 1/2 cup fresh lemon juice (2 lg lemons)

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees.
2. Place potatoes in a large baking dish.
3. Add remaining ingredients to the dish and toss until well coated.
4. Bake uncovered about 50 minutes until tender and brown on the edges.
5. Turn the potatoes halfway into cooking time and add more water if the water is all absorbed.
6. Turn on the broiler for a few minutes to make them nice and brown.
title: Greek Lemon-Roasted Potatoes

ingredients.text: 6 plum tomatoes small, cut into wedges

steps: 1. Preheat the oven to 400°F. Spread the eggplant and onion slices on a large baking pan. Drizzle with the olive oil. Roast for 15 mins, turning halfway through cooking, until softened and beginning to turn golden around edges. Set aside to cool.
2. Place spinach, eggplant, onions, tomatoes and feta in a large bowl. Whisk the dressing ingredients in a small bowl; season. Drizzle over the salad; toss.
title: Eggplant And Feta Salad

ingredients.text: 3/4 cup pitted black olives (such as kalamata)

steps: 1. In a medium bowl, toss together the grated carrots, cilantro, feta, and olives.
2. Pour the lemon juice into a small bowl; slowly drizzle in olive oil, whisking to blend.
3. Pour dressing over carrot mixture, toss to combine, and sprinkle with toasted cumin seeds.
4. Note: Nutritional analysis is per serving.
title: Fresh Carrot, Feta, And Black Olive Salad

ingredients.text: 2 lb. red potatoes, thinly sliced (about 6 medium)

steps: 1. Layer potatoes in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan or baking dish. Sprinkle with salt.
2. Set aside.
title: Potatoes Moussaka *

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees.
2. Combine water, lemon juice, oil, garlic, salt, oregano and pepper in bowl.
3. Peel potatoes and leave whole.
4. Place potatoes in baking dish and pour liquid over all.
5. Bake for 30 minutes and turn potatoes over.
6. Repeat this procedure until potatoes are cooked and the liquid has reduced.
7. Serve potatoes with a spoonful of the reduction.
8. Enjoy!
title: Roasted Greek Potatoes

steps: 1. Cook beans for 7 minutes in boiling water or until tender crisp.
2. Drain; rinse with cold water.
3. Toss beans with dressing, cheese, onion and dill in large bowl.
4. Serve immediately or refrigerate for several hours.
title: Green Beans And Feta With Dill

ingredients.text: 3 cups rice, mix from a box prepare as instructed on box (I typically choose Near East's rice pilaf)
1/2 lb asparagus, tough roots discarded, cut into 1 inch pieces
1 lb shrimp, uncooked, shelled, and cut into bite size pieces

steps: 1. In large saute pan, heat oil over medium high heat. Add onion and garlic, saute for about 2 minutes, until onions are translucent.
2. Add tougher asparagus pieces, continue to saute for about 1 minute. Add remaining asparagus and continue to saute for another minute.
3. Add shrimp, saute for 1 minute.
4. Add chicken broth, continue stirring. Cook until shrimp turn completely pink.
5. Add all spices, stir to coat.
6. Add prepared rice mix and feta. Stir to completely incorporate rice, feta, and shrimp/asparagus mixture.
7. Enjoy!
title: Shrimp, Asparagus, And Feta Almost Risotto

steps: 1. Combine the first 4 ingredients in a large bowl. Add vinaigrette, and toss gently to coat.
title: Tomato And Cucumber Salad With Feta

ingredients.text: 1 lb. carrots, sliced lengthwise in quarters

steps: 1. Place carrots in saucepan along with remaining ingredients. Cover.
2. Bring to a boil.
3. Simmer for 5 minutes.
title: Greek Carrots

steps: 1. Prepare 5 cups of coarse rice and water in the rice cooker as its measure.
2. Add mixed vegetables, butter and salt (less or more as preferred) into rice cooker.
3. Activate rice cooker as per rice cooker's manual.
4. Mix well the rice & ingredients when it's cooked, add more salt if needed.
5. Scoop out the cooked rice on plate and garnish however you like it.
title: Nando'S Mediterranean Rice Copycat

steps: 1. In a large bowl, whisk the vinegar, mustard, garlic, oregano and pepper.
2. Add the beans and toss to coat.
title: Mediterranean Green Beans

steps: 1. In a large frying pan, heat oil over medium heat. Add onion and green pepper and cook until softened.
2. Add tomatoes, green beans and garlic. Cover and reduce heat to low. Cook until beans are tender 12-15 minutes.
3. Season with salt and pepper.
title: Greek Green Beans

steps: 1. Whisk together orange juice, vinegar and honey. Drizzle olive oil into mixture and whisk until blended; set aside.
2. Place beets through the shredding disc of a food processor. Toss beets with half of dressing mixture.
3. Toss romaine with remaining dressing and divide among 4 salad plates.
4. Top each plate with beets.
5. Sprinkle with pistachios and feta cheese.
title: Beet Salad With Pistachios And Feta

steps: 1. Combine the rice, turkey, tomatoes and olives. In a small bowl, combine the yogurt, mint, vinegar and lemon-pepper. Pour over rice mixture; toss to coat. Sprinkle with cheese if desired.
title: Greek Rice Salad

ingredients.text: 3 c. (8 oz.) uncooked pasta, cheese tortellini or spirals

steps: 1. Cook pasta and drain; cool.
2. Combine lemon juice, olive oil, spices and garlic in container.
3. Mix until well blended and of a thick and creamy consistency.
4. Chill.
5. Combine cooled pasta with rest of ingredients and large bowl.
6. Pour dressing over salad and toss gently to coat evenly.
7. Serve immediately.
title: Greek Rotini Salad

steps: 1. Toss tomatoes, cucumber, onion, feta and olives in a serving bowl.
2. Sprinkle with oregano.
3. Whisk oil and vinegar in a small bowl; season to taste with salt. Drizzle the dressing over the salad.
title: Ultimate Greek Salad

ingredients.text: 1 cup reduced-sodium vegetable broth, meatless option or 1 cup reduced-sodium chicken broth, meat option

steps: 1. Thaw and squeeze the spinach. The tomato halves should NOT BE OIL PACKED.
2. In large pot of boling water cook the fettuccine until just tender. Drain well.
3. Meanwhile in saucepan, bring broth [your choice], spinach, tomatoes, and garlic to a boil over high heat. Reduce, simmer, cover and cook until spinach is warmed through about 5 minutes.
4. Stir in ricotta and pepper. Cook until warmed thru about a minute. Transfer to a large bowl. Add pasta and feta. Toss to combine. Divide into serving bowls and serve.
5. For Vegetarian use the meatless broth option. Chicken broth is NOT meatless.
title: Fettuccine With Spinach And Feta Cheese

steps: 1. Whisk vinegar, oil, dill, oregano, garlic, salt and pepper in a large bowl.
2. Add lettuce, chicken, sun-dried tomatoes, cucumber, onion, olives and feta; toss to coat.
title: Greek Salad With Shredded Chicken

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients, and chill well.
2. You might wish to add blanched and cooled green beans for a variation, and perhaps a little wine vinegar.
title: Salmon And Feta Salad

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 400°.
2. Heat greased oven-safe skillet in oven for about 5 minutes.
3. Beat eggs with water.
4. Add rice, cheeses, picante sauce, cilantro and oregano.
5. Pour mixture into prepared skillet.
6. Top with tomatoes.
7. Bake for 40 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean.
8. Makes 6 servings.
title: Tomato-Feta Frittata

ingredients.text: 1 whole Roma Tomato, Seeded And Chopped

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°F and spray a muffin tin with nonstick spray. Set aside.

2. In a large bowl, whisk together eggs, milk and cream cheese. I used an immersion blender to get the mixture nice and smooth. Add feta, tomato, corn, olives, salt, pepper, mustard, garlic and basil and stir together. Scoop mixture into prepared muffin tin, filling 12 cups equally. They should be just about full.

3. Bake frittatas for 25-30 minutes until a toothpick inserted into one comes out clean. Sprinkle tops of frittatas with grated Asiago cheese and broil for 3-4 minutes until lightly browned and melted. Let sit for 2-3 minutes before removing from muffin tin, or they'll fall apart as you take them out. They will sink as they cool.
4. The mini frittatas reheat nicely if you have leftovers. Just keep them in an airtight container in the fridge for 2-3 days.
title: Mini Tomato, Olive & Feta Frittatas

steps: 1. In a large non-stick ovenproof skillet, heat the oil over medium heat; cook the onion, zucchini and garlic, stirring often, for 5 to 8 minutes or until softened.
2. Meanwhile, in a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, milk, salt and pepper; stir in the red pepper and dill.
3. Pour into the skillet; reduce the heat to medium-low.
4. Sprinkle with the feta and olives; cook for 10 minutes or until the bottom and side are firm yet the top is still slightly runny.
5. Broil for 3 to 5 minutes or until golden brown and set.
6. Cut into wedges.
title: Zucchini, Red Pepper And Feta Frittata

steps: 1. Whisk eggs in a small bowl until smooth.

2. Preheat a nonstick skillet over medium heat. Pour in eggs. Scatter feta cheese, avocado, tomatoes, olives, and basil over 1 side. Cook until bottom is golden brown, about 5 minutes. Fold over; cook until center is set, about 3 minutes more.
title: Avocado Greek Omelet

steps: 1. Preheat the oven to broil. Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in an ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat; add onion and cook 3 minutes or until the onion becomes translucent.
2. Meanwhile whisk together the eggs, egg whites, salt, and pepper. Pour over the onion mixture and cook just until the eggs begin to set.
3. Scatter roasted red peppers, feta, oregano, and olives evenly over the surface. Place under the broiler 3 minutes or until the mixture rises slightly, becomes bubbly and set.
4. Transfer to a serving plate, cut into 6 pie shaped wedges and serve.
title: Roasted Red Pepper, Feta, Oregano, And Black Olive Frittata

steps: 1. Scramble the eggs and fry on a pan, just like any omelet. I listed 3 because that's how many I use, but use however many you like.
2. When the egg is cooked, sprinkle feta and parmesean in the middle. Drizzle the sauce on top.
3. Fold it however you like to fold omelets, serve.
title: Feta Omelet

steps: 1. Please don't be afraid of Quinoa (pronounced "keen-wa") if you've never heard of it. It's one of the oldest grains known to man and is naturally gluten free. It's also the highest protein grain you can find. It has a consistency similar to couscous, but it's gluten free (unlike couscous which is made from semolina wheat and full of gluten).
2. Note: To make this healthier and/or casein (dairy) free, leave out the cream, butter and cheese.
3. 1. Have all ingredients ready to go, because this cooks quickly.
4. 2. In a small bowl, whisk the eggs and half-and-half together.
5. 3. In a skillet over low/medium heat, add the eggs and begin to scramble as they cook.
6. 4. Add the other ingredients.
7. 5. Continue to gently scramble until eggs are cooked through and the ingredients are mixed together.
8. This is one hearty breakfast that is full of nutrients and flavor, but it won't leave you feeling full and bloated. Just satisfied. Yum!
title: Greek Quinoa Breakfast Scramble

ingredients.text: 1/4 cup low-fat milk (I used soy milk)

steps: 1. First put your oats in the mug and pour the milk inches.
2. Add cinnamon and mix it all up.
3. Put in the microwave for about 1 minute (on max temperature).
4. Add Greek yogurt and mix.
5. Put back in the microwave for 1/2 minute (on 440W)
6. Wait for it to cool down a bit and mainly for oats to suck in the liquid which makes it softer.
7. ( The reason I put the oatmeal in microwave twice is because I like it when oats suck in the milk and it all gets soft.).
title: Quick Greek Yogurt Oatmeal In A Mug

ingredients.text: 1/2 medium head cauliflower, cut into 1-inch-wide florets (3 cups)

steps: 1. Beat eggs with 1/4 teaspoon salt.

2. Heat oil in a 10-inch heavy nonstick skillet over medium-high heat until it shimmers, then saute cauliflower until browned and tender, 5 to 9 minutes. Reduce heat to medium, then add garlic, 1/4 teaspoon salt, and 1/8 teaspoon pepper and saute 1 minute.

3. Pour eggs over cauliflower. Cook, lifting edges to let uncooked egg run underneath and shaking skillet occasionally to loosen omelet, until almost set, 4 to 5 minutes. Slide out onto a large plate. Put skillet over omelet and, using pot holders, firmly hold plate and skillet together, then invert omelet back into skillet and cook 1 to 2 minutes. Slide out onto plate and sprinkle with feta and parsley.
title: Cauliflower And Feta Omelet

ingredients.text: 1 leek, only the white part, chopped

steps: 1. Cook the cauliflower in a mixture of lightly salted milk and water. Add enough water to cover the cauliflower
2. Leave to cool, drain reserving the liquid, and then blend to a thick puree. Adjust the density of the puree by the adding the reserved liquid
3. Heat the oven to 180°C and lay a round cake tin or tart mold with parchment paper
4. Saute the leek on butter until it softens. Season with salt and sugar while sauteing
5. In a large bowl, mix eggs, flour and baking powder
6. Add the cauliflower puree, leek, garlic, feta cheese, cayenne pepper and parsley and mix together
7. Season to taste with salt and pepper
8. Pour the mixture to the mold and bake for approximately 30 minutes
9. Serve warm or cold
title: Roasted Frittata With Leeks, Cauliflower And Feta Cheese

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Lightly spray a 9-inch round cake pan with non-stick cooking spray. Set aside.
2. In a large skillet, heat olive oil over medium heat. Add spinach and cook until wilted. Season with salt and pepper, if desired.
3. In a large bowl, whisk eggs, almond milk, salt, pepper, and garlic powder. Fold in cooked spinach and feta cheese. Pour mixture into prepared pan.
4. Bake for 32-25 minutes, or until firm and toothpick inserted in middle comes out clean. Remove from oven and let cool for 5 minutes.
5. Serve immediately. Enjoy!
title: Spinach And Feta Frittata

steps: 1. Cream the cream cheese, then mix in next 4 ingredients.
2. Pour into pie shell.
3. Refrigerate for 24 hours.
4. Makes 6 servings.
title: Yogurt Pie(From A Greek Cookbook)

steps: 1. In large mixing bowl, beat butter until light and fluffy. Add the sugar and beat for 10 minutes on medium speed. Add four of the eggs, one at a time, and beat well after each addition. Beat in the vanilla. Combine the flour, baking powder, and salt in a separate bowl. Add to the butter mixture and stir to form soft, cohesive dough. Add flour if dough is too soft to handle easily.
2. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F. Grease cookie sheets

3. Lightly flour a work surface. Break off 1 inch lumps of dough and roll on floured surface into ropes about 7 inches long and 1/4 inch in diameter. Cross the ends and twirl dough in a loop in the opposite direction, forming a braid. Place on cookie sheets about 1 inch apart.
4. Beat remaining egg. Brush onto braids for glaze and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Bake 20 to 25 minutes. Let cool on cookie sheets for 10 minutes, then remove to racks to cool completely.
title: Greek Egg Biscuits

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 450 F. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and set aside.
2. Mix together the flour, salt and pepper in a bowl. Create a well in the center of the flour mixture and add the yogurt. Stir until just incorporated. Add cheese and stir briefly.

3. Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat dough to about 1-inch thick. Cut biscuits using a floured biscuit cutter or knife. Combine dough scraps and roll out again to make remaining biscuits.
4. Place biscuits on the prepared baking sheet and brush the tops with the egg wash. Bake for 10-15 minutes, until the tops are light golden brown. Serve warm!
title: Peppery Greek Yogurt Cheddar Biscuits

steps: 1. Pre-heat the oven to 180c and line a baking tray with baking paper.
2. Beat the butter for 8-10mins until very pale and thick.
3. Add the 2 tbsp icing sugar and beat well again.
4. Add the egg yolk and vanilla and whisk until incorporated, then mix in the brandy.
5. Sift in the flour and baking powder and mix until you have a thick dough (it will be difficult to mix with an electric mixer at this stage).
6. Place the mixtuer in plastic wrap and refridgerate for 30 minutes.
7. Form the dough into small balls (about the size of cherry tomatoes) and put them on a baking tray, leaving a reasonable (but not excessive) amount of room between each ball.
8. Bake for approximately 20 mins or until they are lightly golden.
9. Remove from oven and leave to cool for 10-15 minutes.
10. Meanwhile, line another tray with baking paper and sprinkle with half of the icing sugar.
11. Place the slightly cooled biscuits in a single layer on top of the icing sugar and sprinkle the remaining icing sugar on top.
12. Store in an airtight container.
title: Kourapiedes (Greek Biscuits)

ingredients.text: 2/3 cup finely chopped red bell pepper
1 1/2 teaspoons chopped fresh oregano, or 1/2 teaspoon dried

steps: 1. 1. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add onion and bell pepper; cook, stirring often, until the onion is tender, about 5 minutes. Transfer to a large bowl and let cool for 10 minutes.
2. 2. Meanwhile, preheat oven to 400 degrees F. Coat a mini-muffin pan with cooking spray.
3. 3. Whisk whole-wheat pastry flour, all-purpose flour, baking powder, oregano, sugar, garlic powder and salt in a medium bowl.

4. 4. Stir milk, feta, egg, tomato paste and olives into the onion mixture. Make a well in the dry ingredients; add the wet ingredients and stir until just combined. Fill the prepared muffin cups two-thirds full.
5. 5. Bake the muffins until lightly browned, 13 to 15 minutes. Cool in the pan for 5 minutes before turning out onto a wire rack. Serve warm or at room temperature.
title: Fitness Magazine'S Mini Greek Pizza Muffins

steps: 1. Prepare syrup:
2. In a small sauce pan, make syrup. Bring to a boil orange juice (1 cup), water (1 cup), and sugar (1 cup). Reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes. Remove syrup from stove and allow to go cold.
3. Prepare cake:
4. Pre-heat oven to 350 degrees.
5. In an 8x12 or 12' diameter round cake pan, melt the butter and spread on all sides.
6. Mix flour and baking powder in a small bowl.
7. Separate egg yolks and whites. In a separate bowl, beat egg whites until they form a stiff peak.
8. In a separate large bowl, beat the egg yolks until light yellow. Add sugar, orange zest, and vanilla and blend well.
9. To the egg yolk mixture, add the egg whites a little at a time, alternating with 2 Tbs of flour mixture until all used.
10. Pour the batter into the buttered pan. Bake for 35 minutes.
11. Remove cake from oven and allow to cool slightly. Poke holes in cake with skewer. Pour syrup over cake and allow to soak in.
12. Once cake has completely cooled, turn onto cake plate and serve.
13. Enjoy!
title: Greek Orange Cake (Pantespani)

ingredients.text: 1/2 lb. (2 c.) grated sharp Cheddar cheese

steps: 1. Beat eggs, whole wheat flour, cottage cheese, Cheddar cheese and salt in large bowl until smooth.
2. Add fresh spinach.
title: Greek Cheese And Spinach Squares

ingredients.text: 750 g sweet potatoes, cut into 2cm pieces (kumara)
1 red onion, cut into thin wedges
100 g reduced-fat feta cheese, cut into 1cm pieces

steps: 1. Preheat over to 200°C or 180°C fan-forced. Line 2 large baking trays with baking paper. Arrange sweet potato on 1 prepared tray and lightly spray with oil. Bake for 20minutes. Add onion to tray. Bake for 20 minutes or until vegetables are tender and lightly browned. Cool for 5 minutes.
2. Place tomatoes on remaining prepared tray and lightly spray with oil. Bake for 30 minutes or until tender and lightly browned.

3. Meanwhile, place sweet potato mixture into a large bowl. Add feta and rosemary and season with freshly grown black pepper. Toss to combine. Lightly spray a 20cm (base measurement) round ovenproof baking dish with oil. arrange sweet potato mixture over base of dish. Poor over egg, pressing vegetables down with a spatula to cover with egg. Bake in oven with tomatoes for 25-35 minutes or until golden and set.
4. Set frittata aside for 5 minutes. Cut into wedges and serve with roasted tomatoes.
title: Sweet Potato, Red Onion & Feta Frittata

steps: 1. Preheat your oven to 375°F In one bowl, mix flour, salt, and baking powder.
2. In a second bowl mix the sugar and softened butter until fluffy. Stir in the vanilla, milk and egg. MIx thoroughly. Now slowly blend in the flour mixture until thoroughly mixed.

3. Take about a teaspoon of dough and roll on floured counter. Roll until it s about 5" long, then fold in half and twist. Pinch the ends together. Put on cookie sheet and brush with mix of yolk and milk. Sprinkle the sesame seeds over the top.
4. Bake about 13 minutes, until they turn golden brown. Serve cool.
title: Greek Easter Cookies - Koulourakia

steps: 1. Grease 10-in. fluted pan with shortening; lightly coat with 2 tablespoons flour. Set aside.

2. In a large bowl, beat the sugars, oil, buttermilk, eggs and extracts until well blended. Combine the remaining flour, baking powder, salt, cinnamon, cloves and baking soda; gradually beat into the sugar mixture until blended. Stir in pecans.
3. Transfer to prepared pan. Bake at 325° for 50-60 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean.
4. Cool for 10 minutes before removing from pans to wire racks to cool completely. Dust with confectioners' sugar.
title: Greek Spice Cake

ingredients.text: 400 g flour (I use white flour here)
50 g flour (I use white flour here)
40 g olive oil (plus 10 g. oil for soaking tomatoes if needed)
100 g black olives (pits removed, see tips about olives below)

steps: 1. Use kitchen scissors to cut sun-dried tomatoes into small slivers and place in a cup or small bowl.

2. Add two teaspoons olive oil and toss to coat the dry tomato pieces, allow to soak for a few minutes. If your sundried tomatoes were preserved in oil, just chop loosely with a knife and do not add extra oil. Set aside while you begin preparing the dough.
3. Put water and yeast into Thermomix bowl.
4. Add sugar, egg, olive oil, rosemary, and 400 g. of the flour (keep the remaning 50 g flour for later use). Knead for 4 minutes on interval speed.
5. Put measuring cap in place and allow to rest in Thermomix for 15 minutes.
6. Add salt, about half the olives, about half the tomato and knead again for 2 minutes on interval speed.
7. Allow to rise in Thermomix for 30 minutes. (Keep the measuring cap off, so the expanding dough can pop through the hole if needed.).

8. After 30 minutes, remove lid and pull the glutinous dough away from sides of bowl. Remove as much dough as possible from Thermomix but it doesn't need to be absolutely clean. Put dough onto a work surface or silicone mat and make an indentation in the middle. Add remaining olives and tomato. Bundle up the dough to close over the new additions, return to Thermomix bowl and add the remaining 50 g flour and set to knead for 1 minute on interval speed.

9. Remove from Thermomix, shape into round or oval loaves on parchment-lined pan, making sure to allow room for expansion and cover with a kitchen towel. Put a pan of water in bottom of oven and begin to preheat the oven at 200°C/400°F. Allow shaped loaves to rise ON TOP of the stove in the warmth of the pre-heating oven for 30 minutes.
10. Make sharp cuts along the top of the loaves and bake for about 35 minutes (two smaller loaves) or 45 minutes if making one large loaf.
11. Allow to cool for two hours before serving.
title: Mediterranean Bread In The Thermomix

steps: 1. Place all ingredients into the bread machine bowl except the yeast, cheese and spinach.
2. Place yeast in yeast hopper, and with 10 minutes left in the last kneading cycle add spinach and cheese.
3. Walk away!
title: Bread Machine Spinach And Feta Bread

ingredients.text: 7 oz pumpkin, peeled, deseeded, grated (about 2 cups)

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 375°F. Line a 12-cup muffin pan with paper liners.

2. Heat half the oil in a non-stick skillet on medium heat. Add bacon; cook for 1-2 mins, until starting to brown. Add garlic and pumpkin; cook, stirring occasionally, for 5 mins, or until pumpkin is soft. Remove from heat. Cool.

3. Sift flour and salt into a large bowl. Stir in Parmesan and three-quarters of feta. In a separate bowl, whisk together egg, buttermilk and remaining oil, until combined. Season with salt and pepper.
4. Add buttermilk and pumpkin mixtures to flour mixture. Using a large metal spoon, stir until just combined. Do not over-mix.
5. Spoon mixture into prepared liners. Scatter remaining feta over tops of muffins. Bake for 20-25 mins, until a skewer inserted comes out clean.
6. Let cool in pan for 5 mins, then turn out on to a wire rack. Serve warm or at room temperature.
title: Pumpkin, Bacon, And Feta Muffins

steps: 1. Coat 12 muffin cups with no-stick spray.
2. Place the onions in a small bowl.
3. Microwave on high for 1 minute.
4. In a medium bowl, mix the buttermilk, egg, honey and oil.
5. In a large bowl, mix the flour, cornmeal, baking soda, cumin, pepper, coriander, oregano and baking powder.
6. Stir in the feta and onions.
7. Pour the buttermilk mixture over the flour mixture.
8. Mix with a rubber spatula until the dry ingredients are moistened.
9. Spoon the batter into the prepared muffin cups, filling them about 3/4 full.
10. Bake at 450 degrees for 15 minutes.
title: Feta Corn Muffins

ingredients.text: 1/4 cups Melted Coconut Oil (or Canola Oil)

steps: 1. 1. Heat a lightly greased griddle or skillet over medium heat. In a large bowl whisk together the egg and brown sugar until smooth. Add melted coconut oil, vanilla, yogurt and milk. Quickly whisk together.
2. 2. Add the flour, baking powder and salt and stir until just combined.

3. 3. Pour about 1/3 cup of batter onto the hot griddle or skillet. Fit as many as you can onto the griddle but don't crowd them. Cook until the edges look dry, then flip over the pancakes and cook for another few minutes until both sides look brown. Remove the cooked pancakes to a plate and repeat with the remaining batter.
4. 4. Serve hot with syrup or toppings of choice.
5. Recipe adapted from Pinchofyum.com.
title: Whole Wheat Pancakes With Greek Yogurt

ingredients.text: 1/2 medium cucumber, peeled, seeded, and diced
1 cup plain yogurt (preferably goat's or sheep's milk)

steps: 1. Toss cucumber with 1/4 teaspoon each of salt and pepper in a colander and drain 15 minutes.
2. Mince and mash garlic to a paste with 1/4 teaspoon salt, then whisk together with olive oil, yogurt, and 1/4 teaspoon pepper.
3. Squeeze out any excess water from cucumbers with your hands, then stir cucumbers into yogurt mixture. Season with salt.
4. Cover and chill 1 hour.
title: Tzatziki (Gyro Sauce)

ingredients.text: 1 1/4 cups feta cheese, crumbled and DIVIDED
10 ounces frozen spinach, thawed and well-drained

steps: 1. In a mixing bowl, beat cream cheese, 1 cup of feta, milk and basil until well-blended. Spread in bottom of 9" pie plate.
2. Top with drained spinach, then tomato, then green onion, then black olives, then remaining feta cheese.
3. Cover and refrigerate about 1 hour before serving.
title: 6-Layer Mediterranean Dip

steps: 1. Simply pour all ingredients into a container (bottle is best).
2. Shake vigorously until well mixed.
3. Store tightly at room temperature.
title: Greek Salad Dressing

steps: 1. Char peppers directly over gas flame or in broiler until blackened on all sides. Enclose in paper bag 10 minutes. Peel, seed, and quarter peppers. Puree peppers, oil, garlic, and cheese in processor. Season with salt and pepper. Chill at least 3 hours or overnight. We only processed it long enough to get a fine grained consistency but it firms up quite a bit when cold.
title: Roasted Red Pepper With Feta Dip

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients.
2. Refrigerate in an air-tight container for up to 2 days.
3. It says a serving size is 1 tablespoons.
title: Cooking Light Easy Tzatziki Sauce

ingredients.text: 1/3 cup butter, cut into1/2 inch cubes
1/3 cup feta cheese, cut into small cubes
1 1/2 tablespoons sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained and chopped

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 400 °F
2. Butter or lightly spray a 9 inch cake pan. Set aside.
3. In a large bowl whisk together the flour, sugar, baking powder and salt until combined.
4. Cut butter into flour mixture using a pastry blender until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
5. Make a well in the center of the dry ingredients, add the milk, and stir gently with a wooden spoon until mixture forms moist clumps. Do not over mix.
6. Gather dough together with hands and place on a lightly floured surface.
7. Knead until smooth.
8. Roll dough with a floured rolling pin into a 16x 10 inch rectangle.
9. With a knife or metal spatula evenly spread pesto over dough. Sprinkle with feta cheese and sun-dried tomatoes.
10. Starting at the short end, roll dough into a cylinder, brushing off any excess flour as you roll.
11. With a sharp knife, cut dough in half, and then in half again (4 pieces).
12. Cut each quarter into 3 equal pieces and place in the prepared pan, cut- side up. (12 pieces).
13. Brush lightly with olive oil and sprinkle with freshly grated parmesan cheese.
14. Bake in preheated oven for 15 minutes or until lightly browned on top and toothpick inserted in center of scone comes out clean.
15. Cool on wire rack.
title: Pesto, Feta, And Sun-Dried Tomato Scones

ingredients.text: 1 medium cucumber, peeled, seeded, cut into 1/4-inch cubes

steps: 1. Place cubed cucumbers in strainer set over bowl. Toss with 1/2 teaspoon salt and let sit to drain, about 30 minutes. Gently pat cucumbers dry with paper towel.
2. Place the cucumber in a small bowl, and mix with garlic, yogurt, and dill. Season to taste with salt. Refrigerate until ready to serve.
title: Perfect Tzatziki Sauce

steps: 1. 1. Prepare the Potatoes
2. Boil the potatoes with their skins on until tender.
3. Let them cool completely (preferably overnight), then peel and mash them finely.
4. 2. Make the Dough
5. In a bowl, combine mashed potatoes, flour, semolina, and salt.
6. Knead the mixture until you get a smooth, non-sticky dough.
7. 3. Shape the Šúĺlance
8. Divide the dough into portions and roll each into a thin rope (about 1.5 cm in diameter).
9. Cut into 3 cm-long pieces and roll between your palms to shape small dumplings.
10. 4. Cook the Dumplings
11. Bring a pot of salted water to a boil.
12. Drop in the dumplings in batches and cook until they float to the surface (about 2-3 minutes).
13. Drain and transfer to a bowl.
14. 5. Prepare the Topping
15. In a separate bowl, mix ground poppy seeds and powdered sugar.
16. Melt the butter and keep it ready.
17. 6. Assemble the Dish
18. Drizzle the cooked dumplings with melted butter.
19. Toss them in the poppy seed-sugar mixture until evenly coated.
20. 7. Serve and Enjoy
21. Serve warm, optionally with a dusting of extra powdered sugar or a drizzle of honey.
title: Šúĺlance s Makom

steps: 1. Fry the finely chopped onions and minced meat in oil. Add the salt and pepper. Grease a round baking tray and put a layer of pastry in it. Cover with a thin layer of filling and cover this with another layer of filo pastry which must be well coated in oil. Put another layer of filling and cover with pastry. When you have five or six layers, cover with filo pastry, bake at 200ºC/392ºF for half an hour and cut in quarters and serve.
title: Burek

steps: 1. Wash and peel the potatoes and cut into similarly sized pieces for even cooking.
2. In a large soup pot, boil the potatoes and the bay leaves in salted water for 20 minutes. Discard the bay leaves.

3. If you're not using a bag of ready-cut curly kale, wash the bunches thoroughly under cool running water to get rid of all soil—you wouldn't want that gritty texture in your finished dish. Trim any coarse stems and discard any brown leaves. With a sharp knife, cut the curly kale into thin strips.
4. Peel and chop the shallots.

5. In a frying pan or skillet, melt 1 tbsp. of butter and saute the shallots for a few minutes before adding the curly kale and 2 tbsp. of water. Season and cook for about 10 minutes, or until tender.
6. Warm the milk on the stove or in the microwave.

7. Drain, shake and dry the potatoes with kitchen towels before mashing with a potato masher or ricer. Working quickly, add the warm milk and the remaining butter. Season to taste with nutmeg, salt, and pepper.
8. Mix the cooked curly kale through the cooked mashed potato mixture.
9. Top with slices of the smoked sausage and serve hot with your favorite mustard or gravy.
10. Serve and enjoy!
title: Stamppot

steps: 1. Heat the oil in a pan. Add the chopped vegetables and sauté until tender. Take a pot, empty the beans together with the vegetables into it, put the sausages inside and cook for further 20 minutes on a low heat. Or, put it in an oven and bake it at a temperature of 180ºC/350ºF for 30 minutes. This dish is even better reheated the next day.
title: Croatian Bean Stew

ingredients.text: 2 lb. sauerkraut, washed and well drained
1 1/4 c. dark brown sugar, firmly packed
4 slices lean bacon, cut in half

steps: 1. Spread sauerkraut in buttered 9 x 12-inch casserole dish. Cover with the tomatoes and juice and sprinkle the brown sugar on top.
2. Arrange the bacon on top and bake at 300° for 2 hours. Remove from oven and cut bacon in pieces and stir back into mixture.
3. Bake 1 hour.
4. Add water so mixture does not dry out. Serves 8.
title: Baked Sauerkraut Wirth

steps: 1. Trim steak of all fat and bone.
2. Cut into 1/2 x 4-inch strips. Brown strips slowly in margarine.
3. Add onion, mushrooms, salt, pepper and mustard.
4. Cook and brown until tender.
5. Add cream cheese and milk.
6. Stir over low heat until cheese melts and all is creamy. Serve over hot noodles.
7. Garnish with parsley if desired.
8. Serves 6.
title: Beef Stroganoff

ingredients.text: 1 lb. kielbasa, cut into serving-sized pieces

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients in slow cooker.
2. Add enough water to cover all ingredients.
3. Cover.
4. Cook on high 30 minutes, and then on low 6 hours.
5. Serve while hot.
6. Yield: 4 to 6 servings.
title: Sauerkraut And Kielbasa

steps: 1. Broil chops on preheated broiler 4 inches from heat 2 minutes on each side.
2. Heat oil in large skillet.
3. Add onion and garlic. Cook over medium heat until softened.
4. Add 1/4 cup water and remaining ingredients except apple.
5. Top with chops and simmer, covered, on low heat about 1 hour or until chops are tender.
6. Then stir in apple slices and simmer about 3 minutes.
7. Serves 2.
title: Skillet Pork And Sauerkraut

steps: 1. Crumble beef into a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish.
2. Sprinkle with mushrooms and onion.
3. Microwave on High for 7 or 8 minutes, stirring twice.
4. Stir in next 5 ingredients with 1 cup water; mix well.
5. Microwave covered on High for 7 minutes; stir once.
6. Stir in buttermilk and parsley flakes.
7. Microwave covered for 2 or 3 minutes or until hot.
8. Yields 4 servings.
title: Microwave Hamburger Stroganoff

steps: 1. Boil potatoes in water for 10 minutes.
2. Add apples and boil until tender.
3. Drain and mash mixture.
4. Add sugar and lemon juice. Add butter, spices and mix well.
5. Cook bacon and crumble; set aside.
6. Saute onion.
7. Mix onion with bacon and sprinkle over mixture.
8. Serves 6 to 8.
title: German Heaven And Earth

steps: 1. Cut kielbasa in 2 1/2 inch pieces on the diagonal; place in large skillet with beer.
2. Cover and simmer 10 minutes.
3. In small bowl stir together sugar, cornstarch, mustard and horseradish.
4. Add to skillet; bring to boil for 1 minute, until thickened.
5. Makes 6 to 8 servings, 475 calories for 6 servings.
title: Spiked Kielbasa

steps: 1. Mix sauerkraut, 1 cup crumbs, Worcestershire sauce, salt and egg.
2. Form into 16 balls.
3. Roll in remaining crumbs.
4. Brown in oleo until golden.
5. Serve with
6. ham.
7. Yields 8 servings.
title: Sauerkraut Balls

steps: 1. Cook onion in butter until transparent.
2. Add ground beef. Cook, stirring until beef is light brown.
3. Add the flour, salt, pepper, mushrooms and soup.
4. Cook for 5 minutes.
5. Add the sour cream and simmer for 15 minutes longer.
6. Serve over cooked rice or cooked egg noodles.
7. Garnish with paprika.
8. Makes 4 servings.
title: Hamburger Stroganoff

steps: 1. Saute beef and onions in hot oil.
2. Place uncooked noodles on top of meat.
3. Mix remainder of ingredients and pour on top.
4. Press noodles down to moisten well.
5. Do not stir.
6. Bring to a boil, then turn heat on low.
7. Cover and simmer 30 minutes.
8. Serves 6.
title: Quick Beef Stroganoff

steps: 1. Place kielbasa in a large pot; cover with water.
2. Bring to a boil; simmer for 45 minutes.
3. Add sauerkraut.
4. Continue to simmer for 30 minutes.
5. Serve with horseradish or mustard.
6. Serves 14 people.
title: A Polish Farewell To Lent

steps: 1. Fry bacon until crisp.
2. Remove from pan.
3. Drain.
4. Crumble. Saute onion in bacon grease until wilted but not brown.
5. Add sauerkraut, tomatoes, brown sugar and salt.
6. Cook over low heat for 45 minutes.
7. Add bacon.
8. Serve.
9. Yields 4 to 6 servings.
title: Sauerkraut And Tomatoes

ingredients.text: 1 lb. round steak, cut in strips

steps: 1. Coat meat strips with flour, brown in butter or margarine. Push to one side of pan.
2. Saute onion, garlic and mushrooms.
3. Stir mixture together, cover pan and simmer for 5 minutes.
4. Combine mushroom juice, sour cream, tomato sauce and seasonings.
5. Pour over meat.
6. Simmer about 30 minutes or until tender.
7. Sprinkle with grated cheese and brown, if desired.
8. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Beef Stroganoff

ingredients.text: 2 lb. beef stew meat, cut in 1-inch chunks

steps: 1. Place meat in slow-cooking pot; cover with sliced onion. Combine garlic, catsup, Worcestershire sauce, brown sugar, salt, paprika and mustard.
2. Stir in water and pour over meat.
3. Cover and cook on low for 9 to 10 hours.
4. Turn control to high.
5. Dissolve flour in small amount of cold water and stir into meat mixture. Cook on high for 10 to 15 minutes or until slightly thickened. Serve goulash over noodles or rice.
6. Makes 5 to 6 servings.
title: Hungarian Goulash

steps: 1. Brown steak over medium heat in butter; salt and pepper.
2. Stir in 1 cup beef broth, mushrooms, garlic, onion, pimento, salsa and sour cream.
3. Simmer 20 minutes.
4. Mix flour and remaining 1/2 cup broth, then stir into mixture to thicken.
5. Serve over hot egg noodles.
6. Serves 4.
title: Beef Stroganoff(With Zip)

steps: 1. Brown meat and onion in hot oil.
2. Place uncooked noodles on top of meat.
3. Mix remaining ingredients and pour over the noodles. Do not stir.
4. Bring to a boil.
5. Turn heat low.
6. Cover and simmer 30 minutes or until noodles are tender.
7. Serves 6.
title: Budget Beef Stroganoff

ingredients.text: 3 bouillon cubes, dissolved in 2 c. hot water

steps: 1. Saute mushrooms and onions in 2 tablespoons butter; remove from pan. Trim fat and bone from steak. Cut into strips.

2. Melt additional butter (2 tablespoons) in pan. Toss strips of meat in flour. Brown meat in butter. Add salt and bouillon cubes. Simmer, stirring occasionally, until meat is tender, about 1 1/4 hours. Add mushrooms, onions and sour cream. Heat and serve over noodles or rice. Serves 6.
title: Beef Stroganoff

ingredients.text: 2 cups fresh tomatoes, chopped, with juices

steps: 1. Combine the sauerkraut, tomatoes, and rice in a casserole pan. Season well.
2. Cover and bake at 425 degrees for 45 minutes, or until the water is all gone and the rice is done.
3. Uncover and sprinkle the top with Parmesan. Bake for a few more minutes until the cheese is melted.

4. This is super krauty. You can use the juice if you want it to really taste like kraut, or you can substitute it for water, or you can wash your kraut if you want it to be less on the kraut side. I like my mouth to water.
title: Tomatoes With Sauerkraut: A Casserole

ingredients.text: 1 None ripe avocado, peeled, flesh chopped

steps: 1. For the blini batter, sift the flour and a pinch of salt into a large bowl and make a well in the center. Whisk together the buttermilk and egg and add to the flour, whisking constantly, until smooth. Cover with cling wrap and chill for 30 mins.
2. Meanwhile, heat a large frying pan over moderate heat. Cook the bacon, stirring, for 3-4 mins or until crisp. Drain on paper towels.

3. Wipe pan clean and place over medium heat. Brush pan with melted butter. Drop 6 teaspoons of batter into pan one at a time and cook for 1-2 mins or until bubbles appear on the surfaces and bottoms are golden. Flip and cook for 1-2 mins, until golden. Transfer to a wire rack to cool then arrange on a serving platter. Top with sour cream, avocado, bacon and freshly ground black pepper.
title: Blinis With Bacon And Avocado

steps: 1. Place eggs in a saucepan, and cover completely with cold water. Bring water to a boil for one minute. Cover, remove from heat, and let eggs stand in hot water for 10 to 12 minutes. Remove from hot water, and cool. Peel. Score spirals into the white of the eggs, from the tops to the bottoms, using a sharp knife.
2. In a small saucepan, heat oil. Add garlic, and cook over medium heat until it begins to brown. Stir in sugar and soy sauce. Remove pan from heat.
3. Place eggs in sauce, and turn to coat. When eggs are nice and dark, and the sauce is thick and syrupy, remove from sauce. Serve.
title: Polished Eggs

steps: 1. Cream butter and sugar, add egg and vanilla.
2. Stir in flour mixed with cream of tartar and soda.
3. Form small balls. (Refrigerate dough before making balls.)
4. Put on ungreased cookie sheet, flatten with glass that has been dipped in fine sugar. Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes or until lightly browned.
title: Heidesand(German)

steps: 1. Drain and cut sauerkraut.
2. Brown onion lightly in butter.
3. Add ham and brown.
4. Add garlic and flour; stir in bouillon, sauerkraut and parsley.
5. Cook until thick.
6. Spread in pan and chill for 2 hours.
7. Make into walnut size balls.
8. Dip in flour; then in mixture of egg and milk beaten together.
9. Roll in bread crumbs and deep fry.
10. Drain on paper towels.
11. Yields about 50.
title: Sauerkraut Balls

ingredients.text: 2 lbs sirloin steaks, cut into thin strips

steps: 1. In large fry pan, cook steak, mushrooms and onions in hot oil until golden brown.
2. Add bouillon, water, wine, salt, tomato paste and mustard.
3. Cover; simmer about 20 to 30 minutes or until tender.
4. Combine flour and water.
5. Stir into meat mixture. Cook stirring constantly, until mixture comes to boil.
6. Reduce heat; stir in sour cream. Heat, but Do Not Boil.
7. Serve over hot noodles.
title: Beef Stroganoff

steps: 1. Break up chocolate and melt in 60 mls of the milk over a low heat.
2. Stir in remaining milk.
3. Heat till very hot and well combined.
4. Pour into a mug and add vodka.
5. Adorn with whipped cream if desired.
title: Brown Russian

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 lb. thinly sliced round steak (1/4-inch thick)
3 medium dill pickles, cut in quarters lengthwise
6 medium carrots (about 1 lb.), cut in quarters lengthwise (optional)

steps: 1. Salt and pepper steak.
2. Spread with mustard, sliced bacon, onion and dill pickle.
3. Roll up and fasten with nails or toothpicks.
4. Then brown in skillet.
5. Put in roaster and cover with hot water.
6. Bake at 350° for 2 1/2 to 3 hours.
7. Thicken gravy with cornstarch.
title: Beef Rouladen

ingredients.text: 1 medium head cabbage, cut in wedges
4 medium carrots, peeled and cut in 2-inch pieces

steps: 1. Bake in a covered pan in a 370° oven for 1 hour or until veggies are tender.
title: Kielbasa Dinner

ingredients.text: 2 granny smith apples, peeled and chopped

steps: 1. In a large heavy saucepan combine the sauerkraut, the apples, the wine, the broth, the brown sugar, and the caraway seeds and simmer the mixture, covered, stirring occasionally, for 1 hour.
2. The sauerkraut may be made 1 day in advance, kept covered and chilled, and reheated.
title: Sauerkraut With Apple And Caraway

steps: 1. Wash kraut in cold water.
2. Cook over low heat with 1/2 cup water.
3. Cut bacon in small pieces and brown with onion.
4. Drain fat off bacon.
5. Add kraut; add caraway seed and sugar.
6. Cook 1 1/2 hours.
title: Sauerkraut

steps: 1. Heat oil, brown meat.
2. Remove meat, saute onions in pan. Return meat to pan, stir in 1 1/2 c. water.
3. Add rest of ingredients; bring to a boil.
4. Place in a baking pan and bake at 300° for 2 hours, keeping tightly covered.
title: Ukranian Goulash

steps: 1. Brown hamburger and onions.
2. Add rest of ingredients except cheese.
3. Stew on low heat on top of stove, approximately 1/2 hour. Add cheese and heat until melted.
title: Miriam'S Noodle Goulash

steps: 1. Melt the butter in a large skillet.
2. Add the onion and sliced mushrooms and cook until the onion is soft and translucent, about 12 minutes.
3. Add the cornstarch to 1/2 cup of the chicken stock and stir until completely dissolved.
4. Stir in the remaining chicken stock, tomato paste, paprika, basil and nutmeg, and simmer for 10 minutes.
5. Add the turkey and sherry, and simmer until heated through.
6. Stir in the sour cream and serve immediately.
title: Turkey Stroganoff

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 ounces fat-free sugar-free instant chocolate pudding mix (or substitute a 1.0 ounce box fat-free sugar-free instant VANILLA pudding mix to make White Russians)

steps: 1. Combine EITHER flavor instant pudding mix with milk ~ whisk until smooth and pudding begins to thicken.
2. Add remaining ingredients and mix until thoroughly combined.
3. Pour into popsicle molds, add handles, and freeze until firm (6 hours or overnight).
4. NOTE: To eliminate air bubbles in your molds, partially fill, then bump them several times on tabletop!
5. NOTE: 3-ounce paper cups may be substituted for popsicle molds ~ freeze mixture about 45 minutes before adding popsicle sticks!
6. To release popsicles, run hot water over outside of popsicle molds for about 5-7 seconds.
7. If popsicles have flaws after un-molding, then lick like crazy to smooth them out!
title: Black Or White Russian Poptails

steps: 1. In a medium saucepan, combine sugar, evaporated milk, beaten egg yolks and shortening.
2. Cook and stir over medium heat until mixture comes to a boil.
3. Remove from heat.
4. Stir in vanilla, coconut and pecans.
5. Cool 15 minutes.
6. Spread only between layers and on top of cake.
title: German Chocolate Coconut Pecan Topping

steps: 1. Stir well.
2. Roll out dough, cut out with cookie cutter.
3. Make small indentation in the middle of kolache.
4. Put jelly or jam in the middle of the indentation.
5. Put on pan and bake for 10 minutes at 425°.
title: Kolache

steps: 1. Shred cabbage and pack in sterile jars.
2. Pour in hot liquid and seal.
title: Sauerkraut

steps: 1. Brown hamburger; drain.
2. Add onion, pepper, tomatoes and seasonings.
3. Stir in sour cream.
4. When ready to serve, cut French bread in half.
5. Cover each half with the hamburger mixture.
6. Cover with shredded cheese.
7. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes until cheese is melted.
title: Beef Stroganoff Sandwich

steps: 1. Brown ground beef.
2. Arrange in layers the macaroni, ground beef and sauce in a large casserole dish.
3. Cover and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
title: Burger Goulash

steps: 1. On dough board, measure flour.
2. Make a well in the center. Add egg and salt.
3. Knead well until dough is smooth.
4. Let stand a few minutes, then roll out thinly and cut into little squares. Cook in boiling water about 10 minutes.
5. Drain and add to prepared sauerkraut.
title: Haluski With Sauerkraut

ingredients.text: 4 chicken breasts, boneless, skinless, cut into bite-size pieces

steps: 1. 1. Rinse the chicken breasts and pat them dry with paper towel. Slice the chicken into bite-size pieces.

2. 2. Prepare 3 small bowels for a dipping assembly-line. In the first bowl, place flour. In the second bowl, crack the egg and beat it with a fork. In the third bowl, stir the bread crumbs with the parmesan cheese.

3. 3. Coat each piece of chicken with the contents of each bowl in order and arrange on a plate: first coat with flour, then coat with egg, and finally coat with the bread crumbs - parmesan cheese mixture.
4. 4. Heat olive oil in a frying pan over medium heat. Add breaded chicken pieces to pan. Flip when color of breading is medium brown (about 3 minutes).
5. 5. After chicken pieces are cooked through, remove from pan and place on a plate between pieces of paper towel to drain oil.
6. 6. Enjoy!
title: Safta'S Schnitzel

ingredients.text: 4 potatoes, peeled and cut into 1 inch cubes
1 green bell pepper, cut into thin slices
1 red bell pepper, cut into thin slices
16 ounces kielbasa, cut into 1 inch pieces

steps: 1. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook potatoes for 10 minutes.
2. Add peppers, onions and seasonings, cover and cook for 5 more minutes.
3. Stir in kielbasa and sauerkraut, cover, and cook for 15 minutes, or until onions are caramelized.
title: Polish Skillet With Kielbasa

steps: 1. Brown chops in oil and margarine.
2. Add garlic, onion, sage and apple.
3. Saute few minutes.
4. Stir in pepper and wine.
5. Place sauerkraut on top of chops.
6. Cover; heat to boiling.
7. Reduce heat to simmer.
8. Cook 40 to 45 minutes.
title: Pork Chops And Apple And Sauerkraut

steps: 1. Cut butter into very small pieces.
2. Combine all ingredients and mix with pastry blender until it resembles coarse meal.
3. Press into pan and bake 5 minutes at 350°.
title: Apple Bavarian Torte

steps: 1. Cream shortening.
2. Add sugar gradually and cream thoroughly. Add remaining ingredients and blend.
3. Shape in 1-inch balls.
4. Bake in 400° oven for 15 minutes.
5. While still warm, roll in confectioners sugar.
title: Russian Rocks Or Snowballs

steps: 1. In a shallow dish, combine beer, oil, salt, garlic powder and pepper.
2. Marinate steak, covered, overnight in refrigerator or several hours at room temperature.
3. Drain.
4. Broil steak 3-inches from heat for 5 to 7 minutes on each side for medium rare.
title: Stroganoff Steak Sandwich

steps: 1. *You must mix dough thoroughly to make a nice Kifli.
title: Cream Cheese Crescents(Hungarian Kifli)

steps: 1. Add salt to egg yolks; beat 10 minutes.
2. Add sugar and vanilla; knead until dough blisters.
3. Roll out very thin.
4. Cut, twist and fry in deep fat.
5. Sprinkle with powdered sugar.
title: Polish Bow Ties

steps: 1. Mix vinegar, sugar and jalapeno peppers.
2. Simmer ingredients for 20 minutes.
3. Add wieners and simmer another 10 minutes.
4. Cool and serve.
title: Polish Wieners

steps: 1. Cook
2. in skillet.
3. Keep stirred.
4. Add corn and tomatoes last. Cover and simmer 15 minutes.
5. Add bacon chipped up.
title: Okra Goulash

steps: 1. Mix first 5 ingredients in bowl until consistency of medium dough.
2. Shape into 2-inch balls.
3. Chill for 3 hours.
4. Beat egg whites in mixer bowl until soft peaks form.
5. Add sugar gradually, beating until stiff.
6. Fold in 1/2 teaspoon vanilla, cinnamon and walnuts.
7. Roll each dough ball into a circle on floured surface. Cut into wedges; spread with walnut mixture.
8. Roll up from wide end.
9. Shape into crescents on ungreased cookie sheet.
10. Bake at 350° for 12 to 15 minutes or until brown.
title: Hungarian Kifliks

ingredients.text: 1 ounce Lipton Onion Soup Mix (1 package)

steps: 1. Place Chicken in the bottom of the crockpot; top with the mushrooms. In a mixing bowl combine sour cream, soup, soup mix, and wine until well blended. Pour over the chicken and mushrooms.
2. Cook on low heat for 6-8.
title: Crock Pot Chicken Stroganoff

ingredients.text: 10 ounces frozen raspberries, in syrup, thawed

steps: 1. In small saucepan, sprinkle gelatin over cold water; let stand for 1 minute.
2. Add sugar; cook and stir over low heat until gelatin and sugar are completely dissolved.
3. Remove from heat.
4. Whisk in sour cream and vanilla.
5. Refrigerate until slightly thickened.
6. Fold in whipped topping.
7. Pour into a 4 cup mold coated with cooking spray.
8. Refrigerate until firm.
9. For Sauce:
10. Drain raspberries, reserving syrup; set berries aside.
11. Add enough water to the syrup to measure 3/4 cup.
12. In small saucepan, combine cornstarch and sugar.
13. Stir in syrup mixture until smooth.
14. Bring to a boil; cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened.
15. Remove from heat; stir in berries.
16. Refrigerate until serving.
17. To serve, unmold dessert on serving plate; top with raspberry sauce.
title: Sour Cream Bavarian

steps: 1. Note you will also need a clean quart-sized mason jar with lid and ring.

2. Pull the 3 outer leaves off the head of cabbage and set aside. Remove the core then shred the remaining cabbage in a food processor, mandolin or finely chop with a knife. Add the shredded cabbage, shredded apples, ginger and sea salt to a big bowl.
3. Massage the cabbage mixture with your hands until it breaks down and becomes soft (about 10 minutes).

4. Place the cranberries and chopped up orange into a food processor and pulse into small chunks. Add this to the bowl with the cabbage and mix and squeeze the mixture together. The cabbage and fruit will release juices at this point and become very wet.

5. Pack the cabbage tightly in a quart size mason jar, pushing it all the way down until it submerges in its own juices (this is the brine). Leave about 11/2 inches of space from the top of the jar. If there is not enough brine to cover the cabbage, add more brine by combining a teaspoon of sea salt with 1 cup of water.

6. Roll up the reserved cabbage leaves and place them in the jar to push the cabbage under the brine. Screw on the jar loosely so gas can escape as fermentation takes place. Set on the counter for 7 days in a cool, shaded place. During fermentation the sauerkraut will bubble a little and become cloudy. If scum appears, remove it with a spoon.
7. Remove the rolled up cabbage leaves and toss in the garbage before eating.
title: Orange Apple Cranberry Sauerkraut

steps: 1. Brown meat and drain.
2. Rinse sauerkraut and drain.
3. Put all together and mix well.
4. Cover and bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.
5. The last 15 minutes, put slices of cheese on top and return to oven (uncovered).
title: German Skillet

steps: 1. Brown hamburg and onion in large skillet.
2. Drain off fat. While browning hamburg, cook macaroni according to directions on package in large saucepan.
3. When both are done, combine in large skillet with the tomatoes.
4. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Let simmer 30 minutes and serve.
title: Goulash

steps: 1. This is a spicy mixture that can be used as either a sauce or a dip.
2. Bake eggplant 1 hour at 350°, then slit skin on one side to drain while cooking.
3. Peel cooked eggplant, skin the tomatoes, then chop very fine the eggplant, tomatoes and onions.
4. Mix them all together along with other ingredients.
5. May be served warm as a sauce or chilled as a Fritos dip.
title: Ikrah (Ee-Krah)(Russian Origin)

steps: 1. Put salt and pepper on meat.
2. Place in deep ovenproof dish. Add spices and vegetables.
3. Heat vinegar and water to boiling. Pour over meat.
4. Cool, cover and refrigerate.
5. Let marinate 48 hours, turning meat twice a day.
title: Sauerbraten

steps: 1. Cut the potatoes and carrots into small uniform cubes.
2. Place them in a large pot and fill with water.

3. Add salt and vinegar. Bring it to a boil over medium high heat, and then reduce the heat to medium and continue to cook until the potatoes are cooked through, about 15 minutes. Drain the potatoes and let it cool to room temperature.
4. Meanwhile, cut the sausage and pickles into small cubes, and chop the green onions.
5. Cut the hard-boiled eggs into small cubes as well.
6. If using fresh dill, chop them as well.
7. In a large bowl, combine potatoes, carrots, sausage, pickles, peas and green onions.
8. Add mayo and dill and mix until well combined.
9. Salt and pepper to taste. Cover with a plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 1 hour before serving.
title: Potato Salad (Olivier Salad)

steps: 1. Add chicken to a large Dutch oven or stock pot
2. Cover with water
3. Bring to a boil and simmer for 2 to 2 1/2 hours, skimming any impurities off the top to insure a clear broth
4. If your pot is big enough, add the vegetables and spices for the last hour of the cooking time

5. My Dutch oven wasn’t big enough to hold everything, just the chicken and other bones filled the pot, so I cooked the meat/bones for the full cooking time, then removed them, and cooked the vegetables and spices separately
6. Strain everything out of the broth
7. Bone the chicken, pulling the meat into large chunks
8. Slice the carrots
9. Return the chicken and carrots to the broth
10. Cook noodles according to package instructions if you’re using them
11. Add noodles to bowl and then top with hot soup
title: Rosol (Polish Chicken Soup)

steps: 1. Put cucumber in a sieve. Sprinkle with 1 tsp salt and the sugar, then leave for 10 mins. Add fennel.
2. Mix soured cream, lemon juice, vinegar and dill, then season with black pepper and add to fennel mix.
title: Cucumber & fennel salad

steps: 1. Clean and peel the potatoes and cut them into even size chunks. Boil them in salted water for about 10 min and then add the cleaned and chopped apples into the boiling water. Add the cinnamon stick as well. Leave to boil for another 10 minutes or until both apples and potatoes are to your liking. I like mine to be fairly chunky but that is a personal preference
2. In the mean time bake the streaky bacon in a dry frying pan until crispy and set aside to drain on paper towels.

3. Slice a few apple pieces and melt a little butter in a fryin pan. Add the apple slices to it and add a bit of maple syrup into the pan as well as some cinnamon. Let it simmer until the apple is soft.
4. Prepare a plate with one whisked egg and one plate with sesame seeds. Cut your cheese into the required size. The smaller it is, the easier it is too handle.
5. Dip the cheese into the egg and make sure it coats all sides. Then dip the cheese into the sesame seeds and make sure it is covered everywhere.

6. Heat a non stick frying pan on high until nice and hot. Put the cheese slice in and bake until the sesame seeds are brown. You have to do this rather quickly or the cheese will melt completely. Turn and bake the other side.
7. Drain the apples and potatoes and mash them together. Taste and add cinnamon and salt where needed. Remove the cinnamon stick before mashing
title: Apple Potato Mash (Hete bliksem)

steps: 1. Place the raisins and prunes into a small bowl and pour over enough water to cover. Add lemon juice and let soak for at least 1 hour. Drain. Roughly chop the prunes.
2. Meanwhile, heat the butter in a large pan, add the onion, and cook for 5 minutes. Add cubed lamb, ground lamb, and crushed garlic cloves. Fry for 5 minutes, stirring constantly until browned.
3. Pour 2/3 cup (150 milliliters) of stock into the pan. Bring to a boil, then lower the heat, cover, and simmer for 1 hour, or until the lamb is tender.
4. Add the remaining stock and bring to a boil. Add rinsed long-grain white rice and a large pinch of saffron. Stir, then cover, and simmer for 15 minutes, or until the rice is tender.

5. Add the drained raisins, drained chopped prunes, and salt and pepper to taste. Heat through for a few minutes, then turn out onto a warmed serving dish and garnish with sprigs of flat-leaf parsley.
title: Lamb Pilaf (Plov)

steps: 1. Chop the beetroot, add water and stock cube and cook for 15mins. Add the other ingredients and boil until soft. Finally add the beans and cook for 5mins. Serve in the soup pot.
title: Beetroot Soup (Borscht)

steps: 1. Cook potatoes in salted water.
2. Cool slightly; peel and thinly slice.
3. Add onions and next 3 ingredients.
4. Mix and keep warm. Cook bacon crisp and drain, reserving drippings.
5. Mix vinegar, sugar and water with cool bacon drippings.
6. Heat to simmering. Add very slowly to beaten egg, beating constantly.
7. Pour over potatoes.
8. Add crumbled bacon and parsley.
9. Mix lightly and serve warm.
10. Makes 8 servings.
title: German Potato Salad

steps: 1. Cook potatoes in boiling water about 20 to 30 minutes or until tender.
2. Do not overcook.
3. Cool and peel; quarter potato and slice thinly.
4. Set aside.
5. Fry bacon and onion together in large skillet until bacon is crisp and onion is tender.
6. Add flour, sugar, salt, pepper and bacon drippings.
7. Heat, stirring constantly until bubbly.
8. Add water and vinegar.
9. Boil for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
10. Gently stir in potato slices and heat through.
11. Makes 4 to 6 servings.
title: Hot German Potato Salad

ingredients.text: 1 to 1 1/2 lb. kielbasa, cut into 1-inch pieces

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients in a large Dutch oven.
2. Cover and cook over medium heat, 10 to 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
3. Yield: 6 servings.
title: Cabbage Kielbasa

steps: 1. Fry bacon; drain. Return 4 tablespoons fat to skillet. Add celery, onion, flour and salt. Cook gently until tender.
2. Add sugar, vinegar, pepper and water. Bring to boil and pour over potatoes in baking dish. Cover and heat for at least 30 minutes at 350°. Serves 12. Can also be heated in crock-pot.
title: Hot German Potato Salad

steps: 1. In a large skillet, combine cabbage, onion and kielbasa. Cover.
2. Cook over medium heat 15 to 20 minutes until cabbage and onions are soft and clear.
3. Stir in sour cream.
4. Heat through. Makes 4 servings.
title: Kielbasa And Cabbage

ingredients.text: 1 lb. fully cooked kielbasa, cut in 1/2-inch pieces

steps: 1. Saute cabbage, onion and garlic in oil for 5 minutes or until tender.
2. Combine water, vinegar and brown sugar.
3. Add to cabbage. Stir in remaining ingredients.
4. Bring to boil.
5. Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 60 to 70 minutes or until vegetables are tender. Makes 8 to 10 servings.
title: Kielbasa Cabbage Soup

steps: 1. Cook potatoes in salted water until just tender.
2. Peel and cut into slices, about 1/4-inch thick.
3. Fry bacon and onion until tender.
4. Combine flour, salt, celery seed and sugar in small bowl; add water and vinegar.
5. Stir slowly into bacon-onion mixture; cook on low heat until mixture boils and is thick and smooth.
6. Add potatoes and parsley; stir gently.
7. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Hot Potato Salad(Or German Potato Salad)

steps: 1. Cook potatoes in skin until tender.
2. Cool, peel and thinly slice.
3. Fry bacon until crisp.
4. Add onion and cook one minute. Blend in flour, salt, sugar and pepper.
5. Add vinegar and water. Cook 10 minutes, stirring well.
6. Pour over sliced potatoes.
7. Add celery seed and parsley.
8. Toss gently.
9. Serve
10. warm.
11. Yields 6 portions.
12. Great served with roast beef or baked ham.
title: German Hot Potato Salad

steps: 1. Cook onion in butter until tender.
2. Add potatoes, salt and 1 cup water.
3. Cover and cook 15 minutes or until tender.
4. Blend flour, paprika, sour cream and milk until smooth.
5. Add to potato mixture.
6. Heat, stirring, for 1 minute.
7. Season to taste.
8. Serves 6.
title: Hungarian Potato Soup

steps: 1. Cut bacon in 1-inch pieces and fry.
2. Reserve 2 tablespoons bacon grease.
3. Blend sugar, onion, flour and seasonings into grease in large frying pan. Gradually add water and vinegar. Boil 1 minute. Add potatoes and bacon. Cook 5 minutes. Serves 6.
title: Hot German Potato Salad

steps: 1. Sift flour, salt and nutmeg together in a bowl. Pour eggs and 1/3 cup water into flour mixture, heat with a wooden spoon. add enough water to make the dough slightly sticky, yet keeping it elastic and stiff.

3. Using a spaetzle machine or a colander with medium holes, press the the noodles into a large pot full of boiling salted water. Cook noodles in the water about 5 minutes or until they rise to the surface. Lift noodles out and drain on paper towels.
5. Brown noodles in melted butter over low heat, makes 4 or 5 servings
title: Spaetzle Noodles

steps: 1. Mix cabbage, onion and pepper.
2. Add sugar.
3. In pan mix oil, vinegar, celery seed, mustard seed and salt.
4. Bring mixture to a boil and cook 3 minutes.
5. Pour over slaw.
6. Seal and refrigerate for at least 3 hours before serving.
7. Serves 8 to 10, depending on size of cabbage.
title: Russian Slaw

steps: 1. Wash potatoes and parboil in their jackets 30 minutes.
2. Cut a slice off of top of each potato and reserve for later use.
3. Scoop out the potato with a spoon, leaving shells intact.
4. Finely chop the scooped out portion and add sour cream, egg yolks, cheese, dill, salt and pepper.
5. Mix well and spoon the mixture into the potato shells, mounding it over the top.
6. Top potatoes with the reserved slices.
7. Arrange potatoes in baking dish, over which pour melted butter.
8. Bake in a 350° oven for 1 hour, basting often with butter.
9. Serves 6.
title: Stuffed Baked Potatoes(German Style)

steps: 1. In skillet, fry bacon until crispy.
2. Pour off all but 1/4 cup of drippings.
3. In drippings stir in onions, vinegar, sugar and pepper.
4. Cook and stir over low heat until mixture simmers.
5. Pour over potatoes and toss to combine.
6. Garnish with crumbled bacon. Serves 6 to 8.
title: German Hot Potato Salad

steps: 1. Cook bacon crisp and crumble.
2. Reserve 1/4 cup drippings. Peel potatoes and cut into 1/2-inch cubes.
3. Place potatoes on 24 x 18-inch rectangle of heavy-duty foil.
4. Combine salt, pepper, celery seed, sugar, flour and onion flakes; sprinkle over potatoes.
5. Combine vinegar and reserved bacon drippings; pour over potatoes.
6. Add radishes, if desired.
7. Sprinkle bacon over top. Fold foil and seal tightly.
8. Place on cookie sheet and bake at 425° for 1 hour.
9. Yields 4 to 6 servings.
title: German Potato Salad

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients together.
2. Refrigerate 24 hours before serving.
3. Serves 6.
title: Sauerkraut Salad

steps: 1. Brown diced bacon and onion.
2. Add flour and stir until smooth. Combine water, vinegar, sugar, salt and pepper.
3. Add slowly to bacon and onion mixture.
4. Add sliced potatoes and mix lightly. Cover tightly and simmer 20 minutes.
5. Makes 6 to 8 servings.
title: Hot German Potato Salad

steps: 1. Mix sugar, vinegar and salt together.
2. Pour over other ingredients and marinate at least 12 hours.
3. Serves 12 to 15.
title: Sauerkraut Salad

steps: 1. In a large kettle, fry bacon until crisp; add onion and saute until golden.
2. Stir in sugar and cook until lightly brown.
3. Add cabbage and apples.
4. Mix well.
5. Cover and cook approximately 30 minutes.
6. Add caraway seed, wine and water.
7. Cover and cook another 20 minutes.
8. Season with salt and vinegar.
9. Serves 8 people.
title: Bavarian Cabbage

steps: 1. Cook potatoes in their jackets until tender; peel and slice while hot.
2. Heat bacon in a skillet.
3. Add onion and celery; saute until golden.
4. Heat to boiling the stock and remaining ingredients. Combine all ingredients in skillet.
5. Gently stir with the potatoes. Serve at once with parsley.
6. Leftovers can be served chilled. Makes 6 servings.
title: German Potato Salad

steps: 1. Saute bacon in large pan.
2. Remove bacon and saute onions in drippings.
3. Stir in flour, salt, sugar, mustard, water and vinegar.
4. Stir until thickened, add cut up potatoes and bacon pieces.
5. Serve immediately. (This dish can all be done in the microwave too.)
title: Hot German Potato Salad

steps: 1. Chop onion, pepper, celery, pimentos and sauerkraut.
2. Mix all ingredients and let stand in refrigerator at least 24 hours before serving.
title: Sauerkraut Salad

steps: 1. Boil, peel and dice potatoes.
2. Fry bacon to crisp.
3. Reserve fat to make dressing.
4. Add bacon to potato.
5. Mix remaining ingredients in bacon fat; cook until thick and glossy.
6. Pour over potatoes.
7. Makes six 1/2-cup servings.
title: German Potato Salad

ingredients.text: 6 medium potatoes (about 2 1/2 lb.), peeled and sliced

steps: 1. Put bacon and green onions in 1-quart casserole dish and cover. Microwave at High (100%) until bacon is light brown, 5 to 7 minutes.
2. Stir in vinegar, sugar and salt.
3. Set aside.
title: German Potato Salad

steps: 1. Fry bacon until crisp.
2. Drain and save approx 1 tbsp bacon drippings in skillet.
3. Add onion and saute until tender.
4. Add beans. vinegar, and sugar.
5. Heat until hot.
6. Heat until hot.
7. Serve.
title: German Style Beans

steps: 1. Chop cabbage coarsely.
2. Do not shred cabbage.
3. Mix the first 3 ingredients.
4. Heat remaining 6 ingredients, just until sugar dissolves.
5. Pour over cabbage mixture.
6. Refrigerate at least 24 hours before serving.
7. Yields about 1/2 gallon of slaw.
8. This may be kept in the refrigerator for several weeks.
title: German Slaw

ingredients.text: 3 lb. boneless chuck, trimmed and cut into 1/2-inch pieces
2 red bell peppers, seeded and chopped fine

steps: 1. In an 8-quart heavy kettle, cook bacon over moderate heat, stirring until crisp.
2. Transfer with a slotted spoon to a large bowl.
3. In the fat remaining in the kettle, brown boneless chuck in small batches over high heat, transferring it as it is browned with slotted spoon to a large bowl.
title: Goulash Soup

steps: 1. In a medium bowl, stir together the mozzarella cheese, mayonnaise and garlic. Chill until serving.
title: Russian Cheese Salad

steps: 1. In Dutch oven, brown kielbasa slices.
2. Drain.
3. Reserve 2 tablespoons of drippings.
4. Set sausages aside.
5. Add onion and cabbage to drippings.
6. Cook until lightly browned (7 minutes). Add carrots and chicken broth.
7. Cover and simmer 30 minutes, until vegetables are tender.
8. Add sausages.
9. Heat thoroughly.
title: Cabbage Kielbasa Soup

steps: 1. Combine cabbage, onion, bell pepper and cover with sugar.
2. In small sauce pan, combine Wesson oil, vinegar, salt, celery seed, mustard seed and bring to boil.
3. Remove from heat and pour over cabbage mixture.
4. Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours.
title: German Slaw

steps: 1. Layer cabbage and onions in very large bowl.
2. Put vinegar, sugar and spices in saucepan and bring to a boil.
3. Mix in salad oil and pour over contents of bowl.
4. Stir occasionally for several hours.
5. Best if made 1 to 2 days in advance.
6. Does not require refrigeration.
title: German Cole Slaw

steps: 1. Arrange cabbage and onions in bowl.
2. Bring to a boil, sugar, celery, mustard, salt and vinegar.
3. Add oil; pour over cabbage and onions.
4. Chill for several hours.
5. This slaw will keep in refrigerator for 3 weeks.
title: German Slaw

ingredients.text: 1 c. sugar (can use half artificial sweetener)

steps: 1. Boil sauerkraut in water for 15 minutes; drain and cool.
2. Heat sugar in vinegar until dissolved.
3. Cool; add Wesson oil.
4. Mix all together.
5. Store in refrigerator.
title: Sauerkraut Salad

ingredients.text: 5 medium potatoes, peeled, diced and cooked

steps: 1. Fry bacon crisp.
2. Reserve 2 tablespoons drippings. Saute onion in dripping.
3. Add vinegar, sugar, mustard, salt, pepper and celery seed.
4. Add flour to water and shake until dissolved.
5. Then add to mixture.
6. Heat to boil.
7. Add bacon.
8. Pour over potatoes.
title: German Potato Salad(Hot Or Cold)

steps: 1. Cook bacon until crisp; drain and reserve 1/4 cup fat from bacon.
2. Cook onion in the fat until tender.
3. Blend flour, sugar, salt and celery seed; add vinegar and 1 cup water and cook until thickened.
4. Add bacon, potatoes and eggs.
title: German Potato Salad

steps: 1. Boil potatoes until tender. Cool, then slice thinly. Cook bacon until crisp then crumble. Mix all ingredients together. Refrigerate until ready to serve. Heat in microwave until lukewarm just before serving.
title: German Potato Salad

steps: 1. In a good-sized frying pan, fry the bacon until crisp.
2. Remove bacon from pan and drain on a paper towel.
3. Pour bacon grease out of pan and add butter.
4. Saute onion until soft.
5. Add the potatoes and brown lightly.
6. Chop or crumble the bacon.
7. In separate bowl, whisk together eggs, salt, pepper and milk.
8. Pour egg mixture over onions and potatoes and add bacon pieces.
9. Cook, stirring occasionally, until eggs are set.
title: German Farmer'S Breakfast

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients and bake on waffle iron as directed by manufacturer.
2. Serve warm sprinkled with powdered sugar.
title: German Waffles

steps: 1. Cook sausage and onions on medium heat until sausage is no longer pink.
2. In a medium size bowl beat eggs (add two tablespoons of milk if desired) then add to sausage.
3. Cook and scramble eggs until almost completely set.
4. Add cheese and stir until eggs are done and cheese is melted.
title: Breakfast Goulash

steps: 1. Melt butter in a skillet on medium heat.
2. In a small bowl, beat together eggs, milk and salt.

3. Dip bread slices one at a time in egg mixture, and fry in butter until bolden brown. After turning once, top each slice of bread with a slice of muenster cheese. Cover skillet until the cheese is melted.
4. Serve and enjoy.
title: German French Toast

steps: 1. Bring water, salt, and pepper to boil in a slow cooker set to High. Stir in steel cut oats, cover, and cook 90 minutes.
2. In a large bowl, mix beef, pork, and onions. Stir into the oat mixture, and reduce heat to Low. Cover, and continue cooking 3 hours, stirring occasionally.
3. Transfer the mixture to a medium baking pan, and cool until semi-solid. Turn out onto wax paper, and chill 1 hour in the refrigerator, or until firm.
4. Heat oil in a large, heavy skillet over medium high heat. Cut the refrigerated mixture into thin slices. Cook slices one at a time in the heated oil until evenly brown.
title: The Sarge'S Goetta - German Breakfast Treat

ingredients.text: 3 large potatoes, peeled, cooked and cubed

steps: 1. In a skillet, cook bacon over medium heat until crisp; remove to paper towel. Reserve 2 tablespoons drippings; add potatoes, green pepper, onion, salt and pepper. Cook and stir over medium heat for 6-8 minutes or until the potatoes are golden brown. Stir in cheese and bacon; remove mixture to a bowl and set aside. Beat eggs and milk; pour into the same skillet. Cook and stir gently over medium heat until eggs are completely set, about 3-5 minutes. Add the potato mixture; cook and stir gently until heated through.
title: German Farmer’S Breakfast

ingredients.text: 3 large potatoes, cooked and cubed (slightly undercooked)

steps: 1. In a skillet over low heat, cook bacon until crisp. Remove to paper towel. Reserve 2 tablespoons drippings; add potatoes, green pepper, onion, salt and pepper. Cook and stir over medium heat until the potatoes are golden brown.
2. Stir in eggs and milk, and cook and stir until eggs are almost set, about 2 minutes.
3. Reduce heat to low. Add cheese and bacon, stirring gently until heated through and eggs are set.
4. Serve immediately.
5. Leftovers are tasty the following day. Good wrapped in a flour tortilla for a breakfast burrito, breakfast on the go.
6. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Hearty German Farmer'S Breakfast (Bauernfruhstuck)

ingredients.text: 14 ounces kielbasa, cut into bite sized pieces

steps: 1. In crock pot, combine hash browns, kielbasa, broth and onions. Stir well and cook on low 6-8 hours.
2. 30 minutes before serving, cut cheese into cubes and stir into soup. Cover and cook on high 30 minutes or until cheese is melted.

3. We like this soup pretty thick, but if you prefer a thinner soup now is a good time to add some extra broth or milk. Wait until after the cheese has melted to add extra liquid so you can be sure of the consistency.
4. Serve hot with crusty bread!

5. To make this recipe A LOT healthier, use turkey kielbasa, fat free/low sodium chicken broth, and Light Velveeta. I routinely use these substitutions and the soup still turns out fantastic! If I have the time, I do like to remove the casings from the turkey kielbasa as I think they tend to get a little chewy when cooked all day. Just split them carefully with a knife and peel away the casings before chopping. Enjoy!
title: Cheesy Hash Browns And Kielbasa Soup (Crock Pot)

ingredients.text: 100 g turkey bacon, cut into strips

steps: 1. In a medium bowl, whisk eggs togeether well.
2. Add salt and pepper and whisk again.
3. Pour a little oil in a cast-iron pan and saute onion, bacon and potato.
4. Add the butter and allow it to melt before pouring in the egg.
5. Allow it to cook on low heat and, when golden-brown, garnish with chopped herbs (if desired).
6. Serve hot.
title: Bauern Omelette (German Omelette)

steps: 1. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Place cabbage head into water, cover pot, and cook until cabbage leaves are slightly softened enough to remove from head, 3 minutes. Remove cabbage from pot and let cabbage sit until leaves are cool enough to handle, about 10 minutes.

2. Remove 18 whole leaves from the cabbage head, cutting out any thick tough center ribs. Set whole leaves aside. Chop the remainder of the cabbage head and spread it in the bottom of a casserole dish.
3. Melt butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook and stir onion in hot butter until tender, 5 to 10 minutes. Cool.
4. Stir onion, beef, pork, rice, garlic, 1 teaspoon salt, and 1/4 teaspoon pepper together in a large bowl.
