7. For 'proper' fried bread it's best to cook it in a separate pan. Ideally, use bread that is a couple of days old. Heat a frying pan to a medium heat and cover the base with oil. Add the bread and cook for 2-3 minutes each side until crispy and golden. If the pan becomes too dry, add a little more oil. For a richer flavour, add a knob of butter after you turn the slice.

8. For the fried eggs, break the egg straight into the pan with the fried bread and leave for 30 seconds. Add a good knob of butter and lightly splash/baste the egg with the butter when melted. Cook to your preferred stage, season and gently remove with a fish slice.
9. Once all the ingredients are cooked, serve on warm plates and enjoy straight away with a good squeeze of tomato ketchup or brown sauce.
title: English Breakfast

steps: 1. Heat oven to 400.
2. Whisk eggs in bowl until smooth.
3. Whisk in milk.
4. Stir in seasonings, cheese, onion and bacon.
5. Melt butter in a 9" oven-proof frying pan or omelette pan.
6. Pour egg mixture into pan.
7. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
8. Bake at 400 for 20 minutes or until set and golden.
9. Garnish with additional bacon if desired.
10. Serve immediately.
title: Baked English Omelette

steps: 1. Separate the eggs and beat the yolks and add them to the mashed potato, mixing thoroughly and then add the lemon juice, chives, salt and pepper.
2. Whisk the egg whites until stiff and stir them into the potato mixture.
3. Melt the butter in a pan and cook until the mixture is golden and then place under the broiler to finish and puff it up.
4. Serve immediately.
title: Irish Omelette

steps: 1. In a saucepan, heat corn syrup and brandy over medium heat; bring to a simmer.
2. Add raisins and simmer 3 to 5 minutes.
3. Set aside to cool (I prepare the raisin-brandy sauce ahead of time, like the night before, to let the raisins soak up the brandy).
4. In a saucepan, add water and salt; bring to a boil.
5. Add butter and oats.
6. Lower heat and simmer until oats are tender, about 6 to 10 minutes.
7. Place 2 tablespoons of cream and 1 tablespoon of brown sugar, and 1 tablespoon of drained raisins in 4 bowls.
8. Add steaming cooked oats and top with fresh berries.
9. Each person stirs their bowl to enjoy the hidden surprise waiting underneath.
title: Irish Oatmeal

steps: 1. Add water, salt and oatmeal to rice cooker. This can be done the night before. The soaked oatmeal will cook faster.
2. Turn rice cooker on, or use the steam/cook setting.
3. When rice cooker turns off, enjoy with honey or brown sugar and milk.
title: Scottish Oatmeal (Rice Cooker)

steps: 1. Optional:
2. Use 1/2 butterscotch morsels and 1/2 chocolate morsels and 1/2 cup coconut (to make cookie chewy).
title: James' Irish Oatmeal Scotchies

ingredients.text: 1 teaspoon cinnamon (also good with pumpkin pie spice)

steps: 1. If you are making this in a crockpot, the first and only step is to throw everything together in a 2-quart crockpot [increase the water to 3-1/2 cups to allow for evaporation]. Okay, now nighty-nite! We'll see you in the morning!
2. Otherwise, bring 1 cup milk and 3 cups water to a boil in a 2-quart saucepan.
3. Stir in oats, spices, and raisins.
4. Reduce heat to low, cover, and cook for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
5. When cooking is complete, stir in brown sugar, maple syrup, vanilla, pecans, and salt (don't add the salt with the boil; the oats won't cook right).

6. If you are using a crockpot, you may notice that a crust has formed on the bottom of the crock after cooking. This is perfectly normal. You can eat it if you want to, or you can just leave it. Just make sure to transfer the recipe into a resealable bowl and soak your crockpot right away. This stuff will stick like glue if it dries.
7. Serve! You can add more fresh or dried fruit, butter, more milk, whathaveyou, but it's awesome all on its own.
title: Creamy Scottish Oatmeal (With Crock-Pot Instructions)

ingredients.text: 2 lbs pork (a good mix of fat and lean using a fine grind works best)

steps: 1. Place all ingredients in a large bowl,mixing well to assure spices are evenly distributed.
2. Form into patties, refrigerate several hours to allow spices to blend.
3. Fry over medium heat until well browned and cooked through, with no pink showing.
4. NOTE this mixture may be stuffed into small casings, making 3-4 inch links, your guests will be so impressed!
title: Old Fashioned English Breakfast Sausage (Or Sausage Patties)

steps: 1. Cut the tomatoes across the centre/or in half lengthways if using plum tomatoes , and with a small, sharp knife remove the green 'eye'. Season with salt and pepper and drizzle with a little olive oil. Place cut-side down on the grill plate and cook without moving for 2 minutes. Gently turn over and season again. Cook for a further 2-3 minutes until tender but still holding their shape. Recipe from the BBC Food Web site, see: Stress-free full English breakfast
title: English Breakfast Tomatoes

steps: 1. For the carrot cake, preheat the oven to 160C/325F/Gas 3. Grease and line a 26cm/10in springform cake tin.
2. Mix all of the ingredients for the carrot cake, except the carrots and walnuts, together in a bowl until well combined. Stir in the carrots and walnuts.

3. Spoon the mixture into the cake tin and bake for 1 hour 15 minutes, or until a skewer inserted into the middle comes out clean. Remove the cake from the oven and set aside to cool for 10 minutes, then carefully remove the cake from the tin and set aside to cool completely on a cooling rack.
4. Meanwhile, for the icing, beat the cream cheese, caster sugar and butter together in a bowl until fluffy. Spread the icing over the top of the cake with a palette knife.
title: Carrot Cake

steps: 1. Heat oven to 180C/fan 160C/gas 4. Butter and line the base of a 20cm square baking tin. Beat together the butter and sugar until pale and creamy, then beat in the eggs. Add 1 tbsp of the flour if the mix starts to curdle.

2. Sieve in the flour, baking powder and cocoa and fold in with a metal spoon. Stir in the milk. Scrape mix into the tin and level the top. Bake for 18-20 mins or until the cake springs back when pressed. Allow to cool in the tin.
3. To make the icing, put the chocolate, butter and 4 tbsp water in a pan and gently heat until melted. Allow to cool slightly, then beat in the icing sugar.
4. Remove cake from tin and peel away paper. Cut into 16 squares. Dip the squares into the icing, then roll in the coconut. Allow to set on cooling rack.
title: Chocolate Coconut Squares

steps: 1. Heat oven to 180C/fan 160C/gas 4. Put the oats, coconut, flour and sugar in a bowl. Melt the butter in a small pan and stir in the golden syrup. Add the bicarbonate of soda to 2 tbsp boiling water, then stir into the golden syrup and butter mixture.
2. Make a well in the middle of the dry ingredients and pour in the butter and golden syrup mixture. Stir gently to incorporate the dry ingredients.
3. Put dessertspoonfuls of the mixture on to buttered baking sheets, about 2.5cm/1in apart to allow room for spreading. Bake in batches for 8-10 mins until golden. Transfer to a wire rack to cool.
title: Anzac biscuits

steps: 1. Preheat the oven to 200C/400F/Gas 6 (180C fan).

2. Put the potatoes into a saucepan of cold salted water. Bring up to the boil and simmer until completely tender. Drain well and then mash with the butter and milk. Add pepper and taste to check the seasoning. Add salt and more pepper if necessary.

3. For the fish filling, melt the butter in a saucepan, add the leeks and stir over the heat. Cover with a lid and simmer gently for 10 minutes, or until soft. Measure the flour into a small bowl. Add the wine and whisk together until smooth.

4. Add the milk to the leeks, bring to the boil and then add the wine mixture. Stir briskly until thickened. Season and add the parsley and fish. Stir over the heat for two minutes, then spoon into an ovenproof casserole. Scatter over the eggs. Allow to cool until firm.
5. Spoon the mashed potatoes over the fish mixture and mark with a fork. Sprinkle with cheese.
6. Bake for 30-40 minutes, or until lightly golden-brown on top and bubbling around the edges.
title: Three Fish Pie

steps: 1. Heat a large frying pan and toast the cumin seeds for a few minutes, then set aside. Heat the oil in the same pan and fry the onion, garlic, chilli, pepper and a good pinch of salt for around eight minutes, until there is no moisture left. Remove from the heat, stir in the toasted cumin seeds, ground mace (or nutmeg) and ground coriander. Leave to cool.
2. In a large bowl mix together the minced lamb, white pepper, fresh coriander, and the cooled spiced onion mixture until combined. Set aside, covered, in the fridge.
3. Preheat the oven to 200C/400F/Gas 6 and generously grease a 20cm/8in diameter loose-bottomed or springform round cake tin with lard.
4. To make the pastry, sift the flour and salt in a large bowl and make a well in the centre.
5. Put the milk, lard and 90ml/3fl oz of water in a saucepan and heat gently. When the lard has melted, increase the heat and bring to the boil.
6. Pour the boiling liquid into the flour, and use a wooden spoon to combine until cool enough to handle. Bring together into a ball.

7. Dust a work surface with flour and, working quickly, knead the dough briefly – it will be soft and moist. Set aside a third of the pastry and roll the rest out on a well-floured surface. Line the pie dish with the pastry, pressing it right up the sides until it pokes just over the top of the tin.

8. Add the filling into the pastry-lined tin bit by bit. As you reach the top, form a slight peak. Roll out the reserved pastry and top the pie with it. Pinch the edges to seal and trim the excess. Poke a hole in the top of the pie and insert a small tube made from aluminium foil to allow steam to escape.

9. Brush the top of the pie with a little beaten egg yolk, and bake in the preheated oven for 30 minutes (put a tray on the shelf below to catch any drips). Then reduce the temperature to 160C/325F/Gas 3 and cook for a further 1¼ hours until golden-brown. Leave to cool completely before refrigerating for two hours, or overnight.
10. Run a knife around the edge of the pie, remove from the tin and serve with chutneys, salads or pickles.
title: McSinghs Scotch pie

steps: 1. In 2-quart saucepan, combine sugars and cornstarch.
2. Stir in half and half.
3. Add butter.
4. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until mixture comes to a full boil (6 to 10 minutes). Boil 1 minute.
5. Stir in pecans and vanilla.
6. Let cool 16 minutes. Meanwhile, core and chunk apples and place in 6 individual bowls. Serve about 1/2 cup warm sauce over each serving of apples. Yield:
7. 6 servings (1 3/4 cups sauce).
title: Old English Caramel Apples

steps: 1. Combine pecans and vanilla wafer crumbs.
2. Spread half on the bottom of a 9-inch square pan.
3. Melt the chocolate in a small pan and set aside to cool.
4. Cream butter.
5. Add sugar, mixing well and then egg yolks.
6. Beat until well blended.
7. Add chocolate.
8. Beat egg whites until stiff and fold into the chocolate mixture. Spread over the crumbs.
9. Top with remaining crumbs.
10. Chill 24 hours.
11. Cut into squares and serve with whipped cream or ice cream, if desired.
12. Serves 8 or 9.
title: Betsy'S English Toffee Icebox Dessert

steps: 1. Heat oven to 400°.
2. Sift flour and next 4 ingredients.
3. Cut in butter with 2 knives or pastry blender until mixture resembles coarse meal.
4. Stir in raisins and seeds.
5. Mix together vinegar and milk.
6. Make a well in flour mixture and add liquid all at once, stirring with a fork until dry ingredients are moistened.
7. Turn out on a lightly floured board.
8. Knead gently 8 to 10 times.
9. Shape into a ball.
10. Place in greased pie plate.
11. Cut a cross from side to side.
12. Brush top with milk.
13. Bake at 400° for 15 minutes, then 375° for 30 more minutes.
14. Serves 8 to 10.
title: Irish Soda Bread

steps: 1. Cook hamburger (drain).
2. Peel potatoes and boil until done, drain, mash with buttermilk.
3. Use a large square cake pan.
4. Put a layer of hamburger in pan, then mashed potatoes.
5. Add a layer of cheese.
6. Cover with foil, place in oven at 350° for 30 minutes or until cheese is melted.
7. Serve hot.
8. Serves 6.
title: Shepherd'S Pie

steps: 1. Combine buttermilk and eggs.
2. Set aside.
3. Combine dry ingredients (flour, sugar, baking powder, salt, baking soda and caraway seed) in a large bowl.
4. Using your fingers, work softened butter into the dry mixture until butter is the size of small peas and evenly distributed.
5. Stir in raisins.
6. Pour buttermilk and eggs into the dry mixture until mixture is moist.
7. If mixture is too moist, add a little extra flour.
8. Pour onto a floured surface. Shape into a large rounded loaf (or put into two 9 x 5-inch oiled loaf pans) and put on a teflon tray.
9. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes. Enjoy!
10. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Grandma O'Neill'S Irish Soda Bread

steps: 1. Boil and mash potatoes.
2. Combine bouillon cube, hot milk, butter, salt and pepper.
3. Beat into potatoes.
4. Reserve 1 1/2 tablespoons of the beaten egg and beat the remainder into the potatoes.
5. Pile into a buttered 9-inch cake pan and brush with reserved egg.
6. Sprinkle with paprika and broil until the top is browned.
7. Cut into wedges to serve.
8. Serves 8.
title: Yorkshire Potato Pudding

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°. Combine eggs and milk in bowl. Stir in flour; mix well. Pour into greased 8 inch square pan. Bake for 30 minutes. Yield: 4 to 6 serving.
title: Yorkshire Pudding

steps: 1. Saute onions in 2 tablespoons margarine until tender, about 5 minutes.
2. Stir in ground beef; saute until brown.
3. Mix in broth, catsup, Worcestershire sauce, mustard, salt and pepper.
4. Pour mixture into greased 9-inch square baking dish.
5. Spread mashed potatoes over meat mixture, sealing to edge of dish.
6. Run fork over potatoes for rippled surface.
7. Preheat oven to 400°.
8. Bake until potatoes are brown, about 30 minutes.
9. Serves 6.
title: Shepherd'S Pie

ingredients.text: 4 large cooking apples, peeled and sliced (about 6 c.)

steps: 1. In medium size bowl, beat butter and brown sugar with wooden spoon or electric mixer until light and fluffy.
2. Stir in flour, 1 teaspoon cinnamon and the water until smooth and thick.
3. Stir in pecans.
4. Mound apples in 9-inch pie pan.
5. Mix white granulated sugar with remaining 1 teaspoon cinnamon.
6. Spoon the pecan mixture, dropping in dollops onto the sliced apples.
7. Sprinkle the cinnamon and sugar over top of all.
8. Bake on lowest rack in preheated oven set at 375° for 45 to 50 minutes or until apples are tender when pierced with skewer.
9. Makes 8 servings.
title: English Apple Pie

steps: 1. Sift dry ingredients.
2. Add butter.
3. Gradually add buttermilk. Spread on baking sheet, 8-inches in diameter.
4. Put deep cross in center with knife.
5. Bake at 425° for 30 to 35 minutes.
title: Irish Soda Bread

ingredients.text: 2 tablespoons lemon juice (fresh squeezed is best)

steps: 1. Blend the blueberries and lemon juice in your blender.
2. Then fold the sugar and lemon zest into the blueberry/lemon juice mixture.
3. Pour into a saucepan and heat on medium (stirring constantly) until it comes to a boil.
4. Serve with my Simple & Yummy Blueberry Scones (Recipe #59337) or use it on whatever else you think it will taste good with!
5. ENJOY!
title: Yummy And Simple Blueberry Sauce (Goes With My Blueberry Scones!

steps: 1. In large bowl, beat egg yolks until thick.
2. Gradually add granulated sugar, beating until light.
3. Slowly stir in cognac and rum.
4. Add 1 1/2 quarts cream and about half the egg whites beating until very well combined.
5. Beat remaining egg until foamy.
6. Gradually add confectioner's sugar, beating well after each addition.
7. Continue beating until soft peaks form when beater is slowly raised.
8. Gently stir egg whites and remaining cream into egg-yolk mixture.
9. Refrigerate, covered until ready to serve.
title: English Eggnog

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°. In a large bowl, whisk flour, sugar and baking powder. Cut in butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. In another bowl, whisk eggs and cream until blended; stir into crumb mixture just until moistened. Stir in cranberries.
2. Turn onto a floured surface; knead gently 10 times. Transfer to a greased
3. . Pat into an 8-in. circle. Cut into eight wedges, but do not separate. In a small bowl, whisk egg with water; brush over dough.
4. Bake 22-25 minutes or until golden brown. For orange butter, in a small bowl, mix remaining ingredients until blended. Serve with warm scones.
title: Cranberry Scones With Orange Butter

steps: 1. Beat together the butter, sugar, and vanilla till well-blended.
2. Add the flour one cup at a time.
3. On a floured surface, roll out to 1/4" to 1/2" thick.
4. With a pizza cutter or sharp knife, cut into 2" squares.
5. Place on ungreased baking sheet and prick top of cookies with a fork.
6. Bake in a 325 degree oven for 25-30 minutes or till bottom is golden and top is light in color.
7. Cool on wire rack.
8. Store in air tight container.
title: Scottish Shortbread (For A Tea Party)

steps: 1. Heat oven to 325°.
2. Grease 9 x 5-inch loaf pan.
3. In a large bowl with electric mixer, beat sour cream, sugar and butter until light and fluffy.
4. Beat in eggs, poppy seed and orange juice until well mixed.
5. Add flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt.
6. Beat at low speed until combined.
7. Spoon batter into pan and bake for 50 to 55 minutes.
8. After cooling, remove from pan and wrap in plastic and let sit overnight.
title: Irish Poppy Tea Bread

steps: 1. Cut beef into 1-inch square cubes.
2. Chop celery and carrots. Peel potatoes and cut into eighths.
3. Place beef cubes in 3-quart microproof dish.
4. Sprinkle salt on beef.
5. Stir together gravy mix and water.
6. Pour over meat.
7. Cook on 70% power for 50 minutes, covered.
8. Stir once while cooking.
9. Add vegetables and mix to cover with gravy.
10. Cook, covered, on 50% power for 40 to 50 minutes or until vegies and meat are tender.
11. Let stand 5 minutes.
title: Microwave Irish Stew

steps: 1. Peel the prawns, leaving the tails intact, and, using a cocktail stick, remove the digestive tracts. Or, if you are using a frying pan rather than a terracotta pot, you can cook the prawns in their shells. Season with a little sea salt.

2. Put the garlic, olive oil and chillies in a flameproof terracotta pot or frying pan and set over a high heat. When the garlic starts to turn golden, add the prawns and cook for 1-2 mins on each side until just pink. Sprinkle over the chopped parsley and some freshly cracked black pepper, and serve immediately. If using a terracotta pot, you can take that straight to the table, but be careful with it as the oil and terracotta will remain hot for several minutes.
title: Gambas al ajillo

steps: 1. Heat the olive oil in a large frying pan. Tip in the garlic slices and cook for a few secs. Then stir through the prawns and cook for a couple of mins until they start to turn pink.
2. Pour over the sherry and cook for a few mins more, just until the prawns are cooked through. Sprinkle with parsley before serving.
title: Garlicky prawns with sherry

steps: 1. Whizz the almonds in a food processor until most are finely chopped, then tip into a large bowl. Roughly chop the figs, then whizz to a smooth sticky paste. Scrape onto the almonds then, using your hands, mix together well with the dried fruit, brandy, honey and cloves.

2. Divide the mixture into 6 and roll into balls. Tip the sesame seeds onto a tray, then roll the balls in them until covered. Cover the tray loosely with a clean tea towel, then leave the fig balls to dry for a week before packaging. Will keep in a cool place for 2 months.
title: Spanish fig & almond balls

steps: 1. Heat half the oil in a frying pan, and sauté the onion over a medium heat until soft and pale gold – this will take about 8 mins. Remove from the pan, set aside, and add the potatoes to the pan. Cook until they are tender but not falling apart, carefully turning every so often. Cover the pan some of the time to help the slices cook through. Add the onions back to the pan along with the garlic and cook for another 4 mins. Tip into a bowl with the eggs, parsley and some seasoning and mix together. Leave to sit for half an hour.

2. Meanwhile, put the cod in a saucepan and cover with water. Bring up to a simmer. Remove from the heat, cover and leave for 10 mins. Drain, leave to cool and remove the skin and any bones. Break into large flakes and add to the potato and egg mixture.

3. Heat the rest of the oil in a non-stick frying pan. Pour in the tortilla mix and cook over a medium-low heat until it is just set and coming away from the sides of the pan. You might need to cover it to help the centre set. Be careful not to overcook it. Put a spatula underneath the tortilla every so often to make sure it isn’t sticking. Slide the tortilla onto a plate, then put the pan on top and flip the tortilla into it, uncooked side-down. Cook over a low heat until golden, or grill until just set. Leave to cool a little before serving.
title: Salt cod tortilla

steps: 1. Put the fish into a lidded pan and pour over enough water to cover. Bring to a simmer and gently poach for 10 minutes over a low heat with the lid on. Drain and flake the fish.

2. Put the fish, potato, green chilli, coriander, cumin, black pepper, garlic and ginger in a large bowl. Season, add the rice flour, mix well and break in 1 egg. Stir the mixture and divide into 15, then form into small logs. Break the remaining eggs into a bowl and whisk lightly. Put the breadcrumbs into another bowl. Dip each fofo in the beaten egg followed by the breadcrumb mixture. Chill for 20 minutes.

3. Heat 1cm of oil in a large frying pan over a medium heat. Fry the fofos in batches for 2 minutes on each side, turning gently to get an even golden brown colour all over. Drain on kitchen paper and repeat with the remaining fofos.
4. For the onion salad, mix together the onion, coriander and lemon juice with a pinch of salt. Serve with the fofos and mango chutney.
title: Fish fofos

steps: 1. Heat the oil in a pan and fry the onion for about 5 mins until softened. Add the garlic, chopped tomatoes, tomato purée, sweet paprika, chilli powder, sugar and a pinch of salt, then bring to the boil, stirring occasionally. Lower to a simmer and cook for 10 mins until pulpy. Can be kept chilled for up to 24 hrs.

2. Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Pat the potatoes dry with kitchen paper, then tip into a roasting tin and toss in the olive oil and some seasoning. Roast for 40-50 mins until crisp and golden. Tip the potatoes into serving dishes and spoon over the tomato sauce. Sprinkle with some fresh parsley to serve.
title: Patatas bravas

ingredients.text: 10 ounces spinach, trimmed, washed, cooked, chopped and squeezed dry (or one 10 oz package thawed frozen chopped spinach, squeezed dry)

steps: 1. Place large nonstick skillet over medium heat 30 seconds.
2. Add oil; heat 30 seconds more.
3. Add onions; cook, stirring often until the pale gold, about 7 minutes.
4. add garlic; cook 1 minute more.
5. Add potatoes, spinach, egg substitute, parsley, salt, pepper, thyme and nutmeg.
6. Reduce heat to low.
7. cover and cook until set and browned on bottom, about 10-15 minute.
8. Loosen edges with knife and turn out onto warm platter, or serve directly from skillet.
title: Spanish Tortilla-Ww 2 Pts (Core)

steps: 1. In a large bowl or food processor combine flour, masa harina, baking and baking powder. Cut in lard and a slowly add in the water.
2. Knead dough on lightly floured surface until smooth. Shape into 12 balls and refrigerate for 20 minutes.
3. Preheat oven to 450°F Roll out each ball of dough into a 6 inch circle. Drop about 2 tablespoons of pork in the center of each circle.
4. Fold the circles and seal the dough using a fork or pastry tool. Brush with milk. Bake for about 20 minutes or untill golden brown.
title: Pork Empanadas

ingredients.text: 14 1/2 ounces diced tomatoes, fire roasted (can use stewed tomatoes)
1/2 cup peas (can use thawed frozen peas)

steps: 1. In large skillet with lid combine oil, onion, green pepper, red pepper, and garlic.
2. Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until softened (about 5 minutes).
3. Add bulgur, tomatoes, broth, carrots, paprika, and black pepper.
4. Cover, reduce heat to medium low for 10 minutes.
5. Add artichokes hearts, eggplant and zucchini.
6. Recover, and continue cooking for 10 more minutes.
7. Stir in peas and parsley.
8. Serve!
title: Spanish Bulgur

steps: 1. Heat oil in a paella pan.
2. If not available, use a 12 to 14-inch skillet.
3. Add chicken and saute until brown on all sides, about 5 minutes.
4. Remove from pan and set aside.
title: Paella Ala Valenciana

ingredients.text: 1 None small sweet potato, cut into wedges
1 None large red onion, cut into wedges

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 425°F. Combine sweet potato, pepper, Brussels sprouts, onion and garlic in a large baking dish. Sprinkle with paprika and drizzle with 1 tsp oil. Roast for 30 mins. Add tomato and roast for 10 mins, or until vegetables are tender.
2. Meanwhile, preheat grill. Brush pork with remaining oil. Grill for 4 mins per side, or until cooked to your liking. Remove from heat and let rest, covered, for 5 mins.
3. Boil, steam or microwave green beans until tender. Drain and cover to keep warm.
4. Squeeze garlic from skin. Transfer to a blender along with tomato, almonds and 1/2 the pepper. Blend until smooth.
5. Serve pork with roasted vegetables, green beans and roasted tomato, garlic and almond sauce.
title: Spanish Pork Chops

ingredients.text: 1 teaspoon fresh oregano, chopped or 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano

steps: 1. Adjust broiler rack to within a 4 inches of heat source.
2. Cover broiler pan with foil and preheat broiler.
3. Place peppers on hot foil.
4. Broil for 15-20 minutes, turning each pepper every 5 minutes until skin is blackened.
5. Remove peppers from broiler and place in a brown paper bag.
6. Roll top of bag down and set aside for 15 minutes, this steams the skins which makes removing the skin easier.
7. Peel peppers by cutting around the stem and twisting it, halve peppers and peel the skin back with a knife.
8. Rinse peppers with cold water and remove seeds.
9. Slice pepper halves lengthwise into 1/4 inch strips.
10. Place pepper strips into a jar.
11. Add oregano, garlic and oil.
12. Close the lid and shake to blend.
13. Allow to marinate an hour.
14. We like this served with garlic bread.
15. This will keep one week in the refrigerater in jar.
16. I haven't tried letting it marinate that long but I bet it would be great.
17. Cooking time includes steaming and marinating time.
title: Red Bell Pepper Tapas

steps: 1. Mix water, vinegar and sugar until dissolved.
2. Place pork chops in baking dish.
3. Pour mix over chops.
4. Add 1 tablespoon ketchup on each chop.
5. Add onion slices on each chop.
6. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
title: Spanish Pork Chops

ingredients.text: 5 lbs pork butt, cut to 1/2-inch cubes

steps: 1. In the pressure cooker, mix pork butt, olive oil, minced onion, garlic powder, and paprika until spices are evenly distributed.
2. Add lemon juice, red wine, and enough chicken stock to just cover the meat (you may need more than 2 cups stock).
3. Ensure that you have adequate space between the top of the liquid/meat and the top of the pressure cooker. Consult your pressure cooker manual if you're not sure.
4. Bring to pressure on high heat, then turn heat down to maintain pressure. Cook 45 minutes, then remove from heat and allow 15 minutes of cool-down before releasing pressure.
title: Spanish Braised Pork - Pressure Cooker

ingredients.text: 1 lb large shrimp, peeled and deveined, leaving tails on
1 1/2 lbs fish fillets, such as whiting, snapper or tilapia
1 large red pepper, quartered and seeded

steps: 1. For the mayonnaise, mix mayonnaise, 1/3 of the crushed garlic and lemon juice in a small bowl. Refrigerate until ready to serve.
2. Mix 1/4 cup of the oil, 1/3 of the crushed garlic, paprika, lemon peel, salt and pepper in a large bowl. Add seafood and fish; toss gently to coat
3. Preheat the grill to medium heat. Mix remaining 1/4 cup oil and remaining crushed garlic in a small bowl. Brush on zucchini and red pepper. Grill vegetables, turning, until browned and tender.
4. Grill the shrimp and fish until browned both sides and just cooked through. Serve with vegetables, mayonnaise and lemon wedges, if desired.
title: Spanish-Style Grilled Seafood With Garlic Mayo

steps: 1. Combine the sugar and water in a saucepan and cook over.
2. moderate heat, stirring frequently, until the sugar is dissolved.
3. Add the ground almonds and cook for 5 minutes, stirring frequently,.
4. until the mixture is thick and translucent. Set aside to cool.
5. Add the eggs and cinnamon, stirring to combine, and cook over the.
6. lowest possible heat, stirring frequently, until the mixture has.
7. thickened, about 10 minutes - do not boil. Pour into an 8-inch spring form pan that has been buttered and coated with sugar.
8. Bake in a preheated 350F (180C) oven until firm to the touch, 15.
9. to 20 minutes. Cool to room temperature before removing from the.
10. pan. Serve at room temperature.
title: Portuguese 'Bacon From Heaven' (Toucinho Do Ceu)

steps: 1. Heat oven to 375°.
2. Cut eggplant in cubes.
3. Boil 8 minutes in salted water.
4. Drain.
5. As you add the tomatoes and egg, also add the onion, bread crumbs and butter.
6. Place in 1 1/2-quart casserole dish.
7. Top with buttered bread crumbs and grated cheese.
title: Spanish Eggplant

ingredients.text: 3 red potatoes, peeled, quartered and sliced to 1/4-inch
1 yellow onion, peeled, quartered and sliced to 1/4-inch
8 eggs, beaten, with a pinch of salt

steps: 1. Heat olive oil in 10" skillet on medium high heat (until almost smoking).
2. Add potatoes, onion and kosher salt.
3. Turn gently until potatoes are all coated in oil. Reduce heat to medium and cover.
4. Cook, turning frequently (and GENTLY) until potatoes are tender, about 12 minutes.
5. Remove cover and cook 6 minutes, turning once after 3 minutes.
6. Remove potatoes and onions with a slotted spoon into a heat proof bowl. Reserve up to 3 T oil from pan.
7. In a separate bowl, beat eggs with pinch of salt. Combine with potato mixture.
8. Clean 10" skillet and reheat reserved oil (adding additional oil so that there is 3 T oil in skillet) on med/high heat.
9. Put egg mixture in pan. After 2 minutes reduce heat to medium - low. Cover.
10. Cook until eggs begin to set, 4-6 minutes.
11. Cover pan with large plate, flip tortilla and slide it back into the pan (the side that was facing up in the pan should now be facing down).
12. Cook 4-6 minutes until eggs are fully set and golden brown.
13. Flip again if necessary.
14. Turn onto a plate and let it rest for 20 minutes before slicing and serving.
title: Tortilla Espanola (Spanish Tortilla)

steps: 1. Boil eggplant and onion until very tender.
2. Drain and mash. Place in greased baking dish.
3. Add remaining ingredients.
4. Salt and pepper to taste.
5. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
title: Spanish Eggplant

ingredients.text: 3/4 lb shrimp, cooked, shelled and deveined

steps: 1. Combine shrimp and olives in a serving dish.
2. In a skillet over medium low heat the olive oil, adding the spices (curry powder - ginger) and cook for 30 seconds.
3. Toss spice mixture with shrimp and add lemon.
4. Refrigerate until chilled.
title: Shrimp Tapas

steps: 1. Heat oil in an oven-safe skillet (I use cast iron) over medium high heat. Add onion, bell pepper, garlic and zucchini. Cook 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Reduce heat to medium low, cover, and cook an additional 5 minutes until zucchini is crisp tender. Add tomato sauce, parsley, basil, and oregano. Simmer, uncovered for 5 minutes until sauce thickens slightly.
2. In a bowl, combine eggs, milk, salt and pepper. Whisk until blended. Pour over mixture in skillet. Cook until eggs are set, but still moist on top. Sprinkle cheese on top.
3. Meanwhile, preheat broiler. Place skillet under broiler and broil until cheese melts, about 1 minute. Cut into wedges and serve.
title: Eggs Portuguese Style

steps: 1. Combine garlic, oregano, chili powder, vinegar, and water in the container of an electric blender; process until mixture is well blended. Place ground meat in a large mixing bowl; pour sauce over top of meat. Cover and refrigerate mixture overnight.

2. Drain meat mixture through a colander, discarding any liquid. Crumble meat mixture into a large skillet, and cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until meat is browned. Drain well. Transfer sausage to a serving platter, and serve warm.
title: Chorizo

steps: 1. In a 4 quart heavy saucepan, heat the oil until a thermometer reaches 360 degrees.
2. In a bowl, combine the dry ingredients (except the 1/4 cup sugar and 1/2 teaspoons cinnamon - mix that in a small bowl and set aside).
3. Stir in the milk, vanilla, and egg. Drop a tablespoonful of batter into the hot oil, frying just until golden.
4. Drain on paper towels and sprinkle the hot churros with the cinnamon/sugar mixture.
5. Serve as-is or drizzled with chocolate, caramel, or with ice cream.
title: Crispy Churros Using Bisquick

steps: 1. Brown celery, onions and ground beef in butter.
2. Add vinegar, lemon juice, brown sugar, mustard, salt, pepper catsup and water. Simmer for 30 minutes.
title: Spanish Hamburgers

ingredients.text: 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon, or to taste

steps: 1. Soak raisins in hot water for 30 minutes. Preheat the oven to 425 degrees F (220 degrees C).

2. In a large bowl, mix together the flour and salt. Mix in shortening using a fork, until the entire mixture is in pea-sized pellets. Stir in yogurt, and just enough of the 1/2 cup of cold water to hold it together in a dough.

3. Roll out dough to a square 1/8 inch in thickness. Use a knife to cut into four 8x8 inch squares. Don't worry if they aren't perfect. Drain the raisins, and mix with the cinnamon and chopped bananas. Spoon some of the banana mixture onto half of each square, leaving at least 1/2 inch of dough exposed at the edge to seal the edges. Fold the dough over the fruit, and pinch the edges together. Make sure that they are secure. I like to roll the excess dough up around the edges and then pinch it until it's thin again. You'll want to have about a 1/2 inch closure in the end. You can trim the edges a bit to make them more aesthetically pleasing. Place empanadas on a baking sheet. Whisk together 1 tablespoon of cold water and egg white; brush over the tops.
4. Bake for 30 minutes in the preheated oven, or until golden brown.
title: Banana Empanadas

steps: 1. Prepare dough: sift flour with baking powder and salt. Add egg yolk, egg, milk, and butter. Mix to make a stiff dough. Divide into 20 pieces and roll each thinly into circle.
2. Stuffing (pino): In frying pan, heat oil with paprika and saute onions until soft. Add chili powder, oregano, cumin and salt. Add meat and mix onions, cook until it is no longer pink.
3. Prepare empanadas: place a spoonful of stuffing on half of each dough circle; add a slice of egg, 1 or 2 olives, and a 3 raisins (optional). Fold dough over filling. Wet the edge with milk.
4. Bake at 400 degree oven lightly browned.
title: Chilean Empanadas

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients together.
2. Chill before using.
title: Chorizo (Mexican Sausage)

steps: 1. Put a few drops of warm tap water in the bottom of a measuring cup. Mix in the sugar and salt until it thoroughly dissolves. Set it aside for a moment. Add ground pork to a large, vacuum freezer bag. Add everything else to bag, and, with your hands on the outside, thoroughly mix the seasoning into the pork. Let this sit overnight sealed in the freezer bag in your refrigerator.
title: Chorizo Sausage

steps: 1. Melt butter and oil in a frying pan over medium heat.
2. Fry onion and pepper until slightly brown then pour into the cazeula.
3. Carefully break all 6 eggs on top of the vegetable layer.
4. Mix the breadcrumbs and cheese and sprinkle over the eggs.
5. Bake in a moderate oven, 350 degrees F, gasmark 4 for about 10 minutes, until eggs have set, but are not hard.
6. (Oven temps and cooking vessels vary so keep an eye on it).
title: Spanish Baked Eggs

ingredients.text: 675 g potatoes, cut into small chunks

steps: 1. Heat oil in a large frying pan and fry potatoes and onion for 3-4 min, stirring often. Lower heat, cover and gently fry for a further 8-10 min until potatoes are almost tender.
2. Add mushrooms and cook 2-3 min, stirring often until soft.
3. Add peas and sweetcorn.
4. Put eggs and milk in a bowl. Add seasoning and beat well.
5. Level the top of the vegetables in the pan, and scatter parsley over. Pour egg mixture on and cook over low heat for 10-15 minute.
6. Put pan under a hot grill to set the top. Serve hot/cold in wedges.
title: Vegetarian Spanish Tortilla

ingredients.text: 1/2 pound uncooked medium shrimp, peeled and deveined
1 pound boneless skinless chicken breasts, thinly sliced

steps: 1. In a saucepan, combine the broth, rice, onion, half of the garlic, salt, turmeric, pepper and bay leaf; bring to a boil. Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 20 minutes or until rice is tender.

2. Meanwhile, in a large skillet, saute the green pepper, onions, parsley, thyme, hot pepper sauce and remaining garlic in oil for 2 minutes. Add mushrooms. Cook until green pepper is crisp-tender. Add tomato and peas; heat through.

3. Discard bay leaf; add rice mixture to vegetable mixture and keep warm. In a nonstick skillet, cook and stir shrimp in lemon juice for 2 minutes. Add chicken; cook until chicken is no longer pink and shrimp has turned pink, about 3-5 minutes. Add to rice mixture; toss.
title: Paella

steps: 1. In a large bowl, mix together the ground beef, ground pork, chili powder, oregano, garlic, salt, red wine and vinegar. I find that using my hands works the best. Cover, and refrigerate for 2 to 3 days. Take out daily, and mix thoroughly.
2. If you are not going to cook with it immediately, divide it into 1 to 2 pound portions, and store in freezer bags in the freezer.
title: Anne'S Homemade Chorizo

steps: 1. Cut shortening into flour. Add milk to vinegar. Add liquids and salt to flour mixture. Blend dough.
title: Empanadas

steps: 1. Cream the butter and add other ingredients.
2. Shape them.
3. Put them on buttered cookie sheet. Bake at 300° for 35 minutes.
4. Cool and roll in granulated sugar or confectioners sugar.
5. Preparation time:
6. 45 minutes.
title: Crescents(Portuguese)

ingredients.text: 1/2 lb boneless pork loin (cut into small pieces)
1 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes (or to taste, adjust to suit heat level)
1/2 teaspoon salt (or to taste, I use seasoned salt)
1/2 teaspoon fresh ground black pepper (or to taste)

steps: 1. Combine pork and all remaining ingredients in a food processor; pulse until coarsly blended.
2. Place the mixture in a ziploc plastic bag; seal and marinate in the refrigerator for 8 hours or overnight.
3. The next morning/day, place the mixture in a skillet over med-high heat until hot; add in the pork mixture; cook 5 minutes, or until done, stirring to crumble.
title: Mexican Chorizo

ingredients.text: 1 lb large shrimp, peeled and deveined (26-30 count)

steps: 1. Thinly slice garlic.
2. Combine oil, garlic, paprika, salt, pepper, and pepper flakes in the slow cooker and cook on high for half an hour.
3. Add shrimp, stir, cover, and continue cooking until shrimp are opaque, 20-30 minutes, stirring every 10 minutes.
4. Transfer to a serving dish and sprinkle with parsley before serving.
title: Spanish-Style Garlic Shrimp

ingredients.text: 1/2 teaspoon sea salt, to taste (or kosher salt)

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 300*F.

2. Warm the oil in a small saucepan over low heat. Add paprika dn cumin, and stir 1 minute to mix and release flavors. Remove from heat when mixutre just begins to bubble. Move to a medium bowl, and stir in the almonds.
3. Transfer almonds to parchment lined baking sheet, and bake 10 minutes.
4. Sprinkle right away with salt, and move to wire rack. Let dry at least 2 hours before serving. Enjoy!
title: Spanish Spiced Almonds

ingredients.text: 1 large sweet potato, peeled and finely diced

steps: 1. Preheat the oven to 400°F
2. Melt the butter in a frying pan, then add the onion and cook over a low heat for about 10 minutes until golden and very soft.
3. Add the sweet potato and paprika then cook, stirring, over a medium heat for 2-3 minutes.
4. Season and stir in the parsley. Leave to cool for about 5-10 minutes.
5. Meanwhile, roll out the pastry to 1/4 in thickness, then cut out about 18 rounds, using a 3-4in cutter or upturned cup.
6. Spoon a little of the filling onto one side of each round and brush the edges with beaten egg. Fold over to form a crescent shape and pinch the edges together firmly.

7. Place on a non-stick baking sheet, brush with egg and cook for 10-15 minutes, or until well risen and golden. Allow to cool on a wire rack or wrap in baking parchment and a layer of foil to keep warm for the picnic.
title: Picnic Empanadas

steps: 1. In a bowl, add the eggs with the milk and beat with an electric mixer.
2. Add the olive oil and finally the flour little by little not to form grain.
3. Beat well and finally add the chorizo, and beat some more.
4. Grease a baking pan with butter.
5. Add flour.
6. Heat the oven for 45 minutes at 400 F.
title: Chorizo Ball

steps: 1. Preheat the oven to 180 Celsius.
2. Mix the flour, sugar, cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg, and salt together in a large bowl.
3. Add the lard and butter together and mix with the fingertips to form a crumbly mixture.
4. Mix the milk with the vanilla and add to the mixture. Gather the dough together into a ball.
5. Divide the dough into 3 equal portions, cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
6. Remove 1 portion from the refrigerator and roll out on a floured surface. Cut the empanada shapes with a circular cutter and fill.
7. Pinch the edges together and place onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Brush with beaten egg.
8. Bake for 15 minutes, until the edges are golden.
title: Empanadas

ingredients.text: 1 medium-size green pepper, seeded and sliced into rings

steps: 1. Sprinkle steak with salt and pepper. Place in a greased 13- x 9- x 2-inch baking dish. Insert meat thermometer, if desired.
2. Combine catsup, chili sauce, and Worcestershire sauce; pour over steak. Place onion, green pepper, and lemon slices on top of steak. Dot with butter. Pour water around steak.
3. Bake at 400° for 1 hour or until meat thermometer registers 140° (rare). Discard lemon slices.
title: Spanish Steak

ingredients.text: 1 clove garlic, peeled and minced or pressed

steps: 1. In a large bowl, thoroughly mix pork, garlic, vinegar, chili powder, oregano, paprika, salt, and cumin. Cover and chill for 30 minutes before using (see notes).
title: Mexican Chorizo

ingredients.text: 2 habanero peppers, cut in half and seeded

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients in a jar and seal tightly.
2. Place the sealed jar in the refrigerator and let steep for minimum of two weeks, stirring every two or three days.
3. The longer it steeps the hotter it will become.
4. When it's hot enough for your tastes, you can (if you wish) strain out the chilies and bay leaves.
title: Piri-Piri Oil

steps: 1. Thinly filet the chicken breasts.
2. In a metal mixing bowl, combine chilies,lemon juice ginger,oil,paprika,garlicsugar and chili flakes, stir quickly.
3. Spoon half of the sauce into a separate bowl and set aside for later.
4. Add the chicken breasts to the remaining chili sauce, refrigerate for 1 hours.
5. Lightly dredge breasts in flour/salt mixture one by one.
6. Pan fry chicken for several minutes on each side.
7. Dress buns with mayonnaie, lettuce,chicken, provolone cheese and spoon some of the remaining chili sauce on top.
title: Portuguese Chicken Burger

steps: 1. Grind paprika, pepper, parsley, chili powder, cumin, oregano, lemon zest, cinnamon, ginger, cloves, allspice, nutmeg and bay leaf together.
title: Portuguese Spice Blend

steps: 1. 1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees F. Cover two baking sheets with parchment paper; set aside. In a medium saucepan, stir together 1 cup water, brown sugar and salt. Add butter and place over medium-high heat. Heat until butter is melted and mixture starts to boil. Remove from heat and add flour, stirring with a wooden spoon. Mixture will clump and pull away from the sides of the pan. Mix and mash with a wooden spoon until no streaks of flour can be seen.

2. 2. In a small bowl, combine eggs and vanilla. Scramble mixture with a fork and then add to the dough ball in the saucepan. Stir and mash, breaking up the dough until loosened. Stir well until eggs are incorporated and mixture has the appearance of mashed potatoes.
3. 3. Transfer dough to a piping bag fitted with Ateco decorator tip #867. You could also pipe the dough in a zip-top bag with the corner snipped to make churros with no ridges.

4. 4. Pipe dough into long, thin lengths on the parchment-covered pans. Use a pair of kitchen scissors to cut the end of the dough from the piping tip (image 1). Leave about 2 inches of space between the churros.

5. 5. Bake for 10-12 minutes or until slightly puffed. Turn oven to broiler setting and watch carefully as churros toast and turn deep golden brown. Remove from oven and let cool slightly. Transfer to a wire cooling rack. If you're baking the churros one pan at a time, be sure to return the oven setting to 425 degrees F before putting in the next pan.
6. 6. Combine sugar and cinnamon and pour onto a long dish (image 2). Roll churros in mixture. Serve.
title: Baked Churros Recipe

steps: 1. 1. Steam the sprouts until just tender, about 5 minutes. Fry the garlic and chorizo in 2 tbsp oil for a few minutes until crisp.
2. 2. Stir through the sprouts then put in a warm dish and sprinkle with the almonds.
3. 302 kcalories, protein 15.2g, carbohydrate 12g, fat 21.8 g, saturated fat 4g, fibre 11g, salt 0.38g
title: Sprouts, Chorizo & Almond Bowl

steps: 1. Mix the peri-peri sauce with the garlic. Add the shrimp.
2. Cover and marinade in your refrigerator for at least 30 minutes (the longer the better).
3. Thread shrimp onto skewers. Cook over hot coals or under your broiler for five minutes, turning once, until the shrimp are pink and cooked through.
title: Camarões Piri-Piri (Angola)

steps: 1. Brown pork chops in own fat.
2. Place in Dutch oven or roaster. Cover with slices of onion, green pepper and tomato soup.
3. Cover and bake at oven temperature 350°; baking time for 1 hour.
title: Spanish Pork Chops

steps: 1. In large glass bowl, combine all ingredients except chicken; mix well.
2. Add chicken, turning to coat.
3. Cover and refrigerate for 4 hours, turning occasionally; can be refrigerated for up to 24 hours if you want to make it ahead.
4. Reserving marinade, place chicken, skin side down, on a greased grill over medium heat; close lid and cook for 10 minutes.
5. Turn and brush with marinade; cook for 30 to 40 minutes or until juices run clear when chicken is pierced.

6. For a less spicy version, replace above marinade with Portuguese Paprika Marinade: 1/3 cup dry white wine, 1 tsp grated lemon rind, 3 tbsp lemon juice, 2 tbsp tomato paste, 1 tbsp olive oil, 1/2 tsp paprika, 1/4 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp hot pepper sauce, and 2 cloves of garlic, minced.
title: Portuguese Piri Piri Chicken

steps: 1. In a large saucepan over medium heat, combine milk and lemon zest. Bring to a simmer, then remove from heat and strain zest from milk. Set milk aside.
2. In a small bowl, combine water and lemon juice. Sprinkle gelatin over top and set aside until liquid is absorbed.
3. In a large bowl beat egg yolks, sugar, and salt until mixture is light yellow and forms a slowly dissolving ribbon when beaters are lifted.

4. Return milk to saucepan and bring it to a simmer over medium-high heat. Slowly pour the hot milk into yolk mixture, whisking constantly. Return it to the saucepan. Place mixture over medium heat and cook, stirring, until mixture coats the back of a metal spoon. Do not boil. Remove from heat and stir in gelatin mixture. Let cool to room temperature.

5. Oil a 3-quart ring mold. In a large bowl, combine cream and confectioners' sugar and whip until fluffy. Fold mixture into cooled custard. Spread in prepared mold, smoothing top. Cover tightly with plastic wrap and refrigerate until set, at least 2 hours, preferably overnight. To serve, briefly dip mold in warm water to loosen. Pat dry, then invert on a serving platter.
title: Portuguese Lemon Bavarois

steps: 1. Boil the kettle. In a non-stick frying or shallow pan with a lid, fry the onion, peppers, chorizo and garlic in the oil over a high heat for 3 mins. Stir in the rice and chopped tomatoes with 500ml boiling water, cover, then cook over a high heat for 12 mins.

2. Uncover, then stir – the rice should be almost tender. Stir in the prawns, with a splash more water if the rice is looking dry, then cook for another min until the prawns are just pink and rice tender.
title: Spanish rice & prawn one-pot

steps: 1. Beat oil and lemon juice. Stir in all other ingredients. Chill thoroughly. Serves 8 to 10.
title: Gazpacho

steps: 1. Saute onion, green pepper and celery in butter or oil.
2. Add remaining ingredients and simmer until thick.
3. (Add 1 pound of cooked hamburger for complete dinner.)
4. Makes 2 to 4 servings.
title: Spanish Rice

steps: 1. Cut bacon into small pieces.
2. Fry until done.
3. Remove bacon and brown onion in fat.
4. Add beef, paprika, red pepper flakes, cooked bacon, tomatoes and rice.
5. Turn into greased casserole. Cover tightly and bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.
6. Serves 5.
title: Spanish Rice

steps: 1. Place shortening in pan.
2. Heat and add beef.
3. Stir until brown.
4. Add onion, green pepper, tomato, rice and seasoning. Cover. Bring to a boil. Turn on low and cook 15 to 20 minutes. Serves 6.
title: Spanish Rice

steps: 1. Combine ingredients in a large glass or crockery bowl and chill overnight.
2. Serve soup cold with a dollop of sour cream on top of each serving.
3. Serve with croutons.
4. Hint: Serve in chilled bowls.
5. Serves 8.
title: Gazpacho

ingredients.text: 3 c. canned tomatoes (28 oz. crushed tomatoes equals 3 c.)

steps: 1. Fry bacon until crisp and crumble in small pieces.
2. Add green pepper and celery to bacon drippings; saute.
3. Combine in baking dish the remaining ingredients.
4. Cheese is optional (American or Cheddar) sprinkled over top (grated cheese, 1 cup or more).
5. Bake at 400° for 30 minutes.
6. Makes 6 servings.
title: Spanish Rice

steps: 1. Wash rice, drain and allow to dry thoroughly.
2. Heat oil in heavy skillet; add rice.
3. Cook, stirring constantly, until lightly browned, about 10 minutes.
4. Add onion, garlic, green pepper and beef.
5. Stir often to break up and brown meat.
6. Cook until onion is limp and lightly browned.
7. Add undrained, chopped tomatoes and seasonings.
8. Cover and simmer about 25 minutes or until rice is tender and most of the liquid has been absorbed.
9. Let stand, covered, about 5 minutes before serving.
10. Yield:
11. 6 servings. Carbohydrate 33 g, protein 17 g, fat 23 g, calories 407.
title: Spanish Rice

steps: 1. Heat oil.
2. Fry onion and squash cubes until light brown.
3. Add flour; stir until brown.
4. Add tomatoes and stir.
5. Salt and pepper to taste.
6. Cover and simmer.
7. Do not overcook.
8. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Spanish Style Squash

steps: 1. Combine in blender. Bam. Done. Let sit at least an hour before serving.
title: Martha'S Gazpacho

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients in a bowl & cover.
2. Chill in refrigerator at least 1 hour before serving.
title: Gazpacho Dip

steps: 1. Chop vegetables coarsely.
2. Put all ingredients in a blender and puree 5 seconds.
3. Chill 4 hours or overnight.
4. (Improves in sitting.)
5. Serve with diced tomatoes, cucumbers, green pepper, scallions and croutons.
title: Gazpacho(Spanish Cold Soup)

steps: 1. Cook the rice until tender (about 45 minutes).
2. Meanwhile, cook the sliced onions in the butter until tender.
3. Add the remaining
4. ingredients and simmer, uncovered, for 15 minutes. Remove bay leaf and cloves and add the rice.
5. Turn into a greased 1-quart casserole.
6. Bake in a moderately hot oven at 375° for 30 minutes.
title: Spanish Rice

steps: 1. Cook meat and onion together.
2. Add remaining ingredients.
3. Add 1/2 cup grated cheese over top.
4. Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.
title: Spanish Rice

steps: 1. In a skillet, melt butter and saute onions until tender.
2. Add tomatoes.
3. Stir in chili powder and garlic powder.
4. Blend in rice. Bring to a boil.
5. Reduce heat, cover and simmer for 5 minutes. Remove lid and sprinkle shredded cheese on top.
6. Cover until melted.
7. Serve.
title: Spanish Rice

steps: 1. Brown ground meat, green pepper and onion.
2. Add stewed tomatoes, sugar and rice.
3. Cook on low 10 to 15 minutes.
title: Spanish Rice

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients in sauce pan.
2. Bring to boil and stir well.
3. Cover, reduce heat to low and simmer till liquid is absorbed and rice is tender (20 to 30 minutes).
4. Note I cook this in the microwave so the time is approximate.

5. To microwave, mix all ingredients in a microwaveable bowl about 2 quart size. Cover loosely with plastic wrap with small vent. Push rice button and about midway through cycle press stop/pause and stir then continue cycle.
title: Tomato Spanish Rice

steps: 1. In a 1 or 1 1/2-quart saucepan, place 2 tablespoons oil and 2 garlic cloves (cut in half).
2. Apply heat and brown garlic, then remove.
3. Add 1 1/2 cups rice and brown slightly.
4. Add water, salsa and bouillon cubes.
5. Bring to a boiling point; stir contents. Cover pot; turn heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
6. (Do not uncover during 20 minutes.)
title: Spanish Rice

ingredients.text: 2 c. tomatoes, cooked and put in blender

steps: 1. Melt butter in saucepan.
2. Add rice, onion and green pepper. Cook and stir over high heat until lightly browned.
3. Add tomatoes, water and salt.
4. Mix well.
5. Bring to a boil.
6. Cover and simmer for 35 minutes.
title: Spanish Rice

ingredients.text: 3/4 lb. ground beef, cooked and drained

steps: 1. Fry bacon.
2. Add onions, green peppers and beef.
3. Brown for about 5 minutes.
4. Add tomatoes, rice, 1 teaspoon chili powder, garlic, salt and pepper.
5. Mix well and simmer, covered.
6. Toward end of cooking, add additional chili powder.
7. Add water if too dry; should be moist, not soupy.
title: Spanish Rice

steps: 1. Spray hot skillet with Pam cooking spray.
2. Pour in beaten eggs.
3. Add green onions and sliced mushroom.
4. Add shredded cheese.
5. Add avocado slices.
6. Flip in half; top with salsa.
7. Plate.
title: Dees Spanish Avocado Omelet

steps: 1. Dice chorizo into small chunks. Gently saute in a small saucepan for a couple of minutes.
2. Bring a pan of water to the boil then reduce to a simmer. Crack in each egg and poach for 3-6 minutes, depending on how runny you like your yolk.
3. Heat the beans in the microwave for 2-3 minutes.
4. Split beans between bowls. Top with poached eggs, chorizo and sprinkle over the chives.
title: Chorizo Breakfast Bowl

ingredients.text: 2 ounces Spanish chorizo, casing removed, and chopped

steps: 1. Pour 1 tablespoon of the olive oil into a large 12-inch nonstick skillet set over medium heat. Add the onion, scallions, and garlic. Stir occasionally, and cook until the onion is soft, about 5 minutes. Dump into a large bowl.
2. Coarsely grate the potatoes. Place them in a kitchen towel and squeeze out as much water as possible. Add this to the large bowl along with the chorizo, parsley, and the smoked paprika. Stir well.

3. Wipe out the large nonstick skillet. Then pour the rest of the oil in along with the butter. Turn the heat to medium. When the butter melts, add the potato and onion mixture. Press down the mixture with a spatula. Cook for 8 to 10 minutes, or until browned on the bottom. Turn off the heat, place a plate on top of the skillet, and carefully flip so the potato mixture is now on the plate. Then slide the potatoes back into skillet, cooked side up. Cook for another 8 minutes or so.
4. Slice up a serve with salt to taste, and maybe a fried egg.
title: Chorizo Hash Browns Recipe

steps: 1. Combine butter and lemon rind in large bowl; beat with electric beater until light and fluffy.
2. Gradually add 3/4 cup sugar; beat after each addition until smooth.
3. Add 1 egg, 1 tablespoon flour and salt; beat until smooth.
4. Add remaining eggs alternately with flour; beat thoroughly after each addition.

5. Spoon into well-greased and floured 9-inch square cake pan; spread evenly. Combine almonds and cherries; sprinkle with the remaining sugar. Bake in preheated 350° oven 35 minutes or until golden brown. Yields about 9 servings.
title: Spanish Sponge Cake

steps: 1. Boil milk, cinnamon and lemon peel; let cool.
2. Beat rapidly the egg yolks, egg whites, sugar and vanilla extract; add this to the milk mixture.
3. Pour desired amount of caramel into baking dish, then drain entire mixture onto dish.
4. Place a baking pan full of water in oven, then place other pan over and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Flan

steps: 1. In a small bowl, whisk the eggs, sugar, vanilla and salt. Gradually stir in milk. Spoon 1 teaspoon caramel topping into each of six ungreased 6-oz. custard cups.
2. Place cups in a 13-in. x 9-in. baking dish. Pour egg mixture into each cup (cups will be full). Fill baking dish with 1 in of hot water.
3. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 30-35 minutes or until centers are almost set (mixture will jiggle). Remove custard cups from water to a wire rack; cool for 30 minutes.
4. Refrigerate for 3 hours or until thoroughly chilled. Invert and unmold onto rimmed dessert dishes.
title: Quicker Caramel Flan

steps: 1. Preheat the oven to 160 degrees Celsius.
2. Add the chocolate to a food processor and grind into a powder.
3. Add the condensed milk, milk, sugar, coffee, and cinnamon stick to a large pot on medium-high heat. When the milk begins to boil, lower the heat and add the chocolate.
4. Mix everything and let the mixture cook on low heat until it begins to boil again. Turn off the stove and allow the mixture to sit for 10 minutes.
5. Mix the eggs, vanilla, and tequila in a separate bowl. Add this to the chocolate mixture little by little while mixing everything together slowly.
6. Once everything is completely mixed, pour the mixture into 6 small glass bowls.
7. Heat up some water in a pot and bring to a simmer. Add the water to a shallow baking sheet.
8. Place the glass bowls on the baking sheet and place the tray in the oven and let everything bake for 1 hour.
9. Remove the baking sheet from the oven allow the flan to cool. Place the glass bowls in the the refrigerator. Let the flan sit in the refrigerator for 6 hours before serving.

steps: 1. In a saucepan, whisk together water and sugar,make sure sugar is melted.
2. Heat the mixture and let it boil.
3. Once the mixture boils, turn the heat to low and simmer the mixture for 10 to 15 minutes or until it becomes syrup.
4. Pour mixture in a 9' deep dish pan or in any type of moulder pan that you like.
5. In a mixing bowl, beat cream cheese until soft and fluffy.
6. Add eggs one at a time
7. Then pour condensed milk and evaporated milk and vanilla, mix well until combined.
8. Transfer the mixture to the dish pan with caramelized sugar.
9. Use roasting pan when you bake the flan , put some water in the roasting pan ( just enough.. at least half filled) and then put the dish pan with the mixture.

steps: 1. Heat sugar in skillet over medium-high heat until melted, clear and light brown, stirring occasionally.

steps: 1. Cook Simple Chorizo in a large skillet over medium-high heat, stirring until it crumbles and is no longer pink; drain well. Set aside.
2. Place cornmeal in a large bowl.

3. Heat milk and garlic in a heavy-duty saucepan over medium-high heat (do not boil). Pour hot milk mixture over cornmeal, stirring until smooth. Add butter and salt, stirring until well blended; let stand 20 minutes.
4. Lightly beat egg yolks. Add yolks, baking powder, cheese, and Simple Chorizo to cornmeal mixture, stirring until blended.
5. Beat egg whites at high speed with an electric mixer until stiff peaks form. Fold egg whites gently into cornmeal mixture. Pour into a lightly greased 13- x 9-inch baking dish.
6. Bake at 375° for 25 to 30 minutes or until lightly browned.

steps: 1. In a large skillet over medium heat, cook sugar until melted, about 12 minutes. Do not stir. When sugar is melted, reduce heat to low and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until syrup is golden brown, about 2 minutes.
2. Quickly pour into an ungreased 2-qt. round souffle dish, tilting to coat the bottom; let stand for 10 minutes.
3. In a blender, combine the condensed milk, milk, eggs, yolks and vanilla. Cover and process for 15 seconds or until well blended. Slowly pour over syrup.

4. Place the souffle dish in a larger baking pan. Add 1 in. of boiling water to baking pan. Bake 350° for 55-60 minutes or until center is just set (mixture will jiggle). Remove souffle dish from larger pan. Place on a wire rack; cool for 1 hour. Cover and refrigerate overnight.
5. To unmold, run a knife around edge and invert flan onto a large rimmed serving platter. Cut into wedges or spoon onto dessert plates; spoon sauce over each serving.
title: Caramel Flan

3. Cook in the microwave at 50% power for 7 minutes, then cook at 100% power for 8 minutes. A knife inserted into the center of the flan should come out clean when it is done. If it is not done after the 8 minutes, cook at one minute intervals, checking each time. Cool and refrigerate before serving.

4. To serve, warm the bottom of the pie plate over a pan of simmering water to loosen the caramelized sugar. Place a serving plate on top of the dish, and invert so that the flan is on the serving dish and the caramelized coating is on top.

2. Add the pork mince and the egg yolk to the bowl, then beat well. Shape into 18 small meatballs. Wipe the pan, put on a medium-high heat, then add the oil. Fry the meatballs for 5 mins, just to colour, then lift onto a plate, but keep the oil in the pan. Sizzle the chorizo with the sliced garlic. Add the squid and fry to give a little colour. Now tip in the white wine and bring to the boil, scraping the bottom. Stir in the pulped tomatoes, bring to the boil, then add the meatballs and the clams. Cover and cook for 5 mins until the clam shells open. Discard any that stay shut. Sprinkle with the chopped parsley, drizzle with the extra virgin oil, then serve with crusty bread.

6. Shake pan often to keep balls round.
7. Remove meatballs; drain well.
8. Add flour to the grease and blend well.
9. Add bouillon and milk or cream; stir until sauce is thickened and smooth.
10. Add sherry and additional seasonings, if necessary.
11. Add meatballs; cover and simmer for 1 hour.
12. Makes 12 servings.
title: Swedish Meatballs

steps: 1. Place first 4 ingredients and 1/4 cup milk in mixer bowl and mix at low speed to blend well.
2. Add beef to mixer bowl and mix at low speed to blend well.
3. Shape 18 meatballs using about 1 1/2 tablespoons mix per meatball. (The mixture will be soft.)
4. Place in a 9 x 13 pan that has been lined with aluminum foil or sprayed with cooking spray.
5. Bake 30 minutes at 375F.
6. Remove from pan while still hot and place in a 1 1/2 quart casserole.
7. Mix soup and remaining 1/2 cup milk well and pour over meatballs.
8. Cover and bake at 350F for 30 minutes.
9. Serve 3 meatballs per serving with a little of the sauce.
title: Norwegian Meatballs

steps: 1. Soak bread crumbs in 1 cup milk.
2. Add onion, meat, egg and seasonings; mix thoroughly.
3. Shape into 1-inch balls and saute in butter in skillet until lightly browned on all sides.
4. Remove from pan.
5. Blend flour into butter remaining in skillet.
6. Add water, bouillon cube, 1/2 cup milk and the cream.
7. Cook and stir until smooth and slightly thickened.
8. Add the meatballs; cover and simmer gently 15 minutes.
9. Makes 6 servings.
title: Swedish Meatballs

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients thoroughly. Shape into balls the size of a walnut. Brown in 1/4 cup hot fat or vegetable oil. Remove meatballs and make gravy. Return meatballs to gravy; cook 15 to 20 minutes. Yield: 6 to 8 servings.
title: Swedish Meatballs I

ingredients.text: 6 slices whole wheat bread, cubed finely

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients; knead until tight.
2. Make small balls. Brown in skillet with small amount Mazola until crusty.
3. Put into large saucepan in which are 2 cups boiling water and 2 beef bouillons.
4. Simmer for 1 1/2 hours.
5. Remove some of broth; stir in flour to make gravy.
6. Pour pack into pan; reheat.
7. Serve with scalloped potatoes or egg noodles, or, if buffet, with potato salad.
8. Serves 4.
title: Corinne'S Swedish Meatballs(From Bombay, 1965)

steps: 1. In a medium bowl, whisk together flour, brown sugar, baking powder, and spices.
2. Add raisins and stir well, making sure to coat the raisins in the flour mixture.

3. Add melted butter, molasses and water and mix with a wooden spoon. Form a ball with the spoon or your hands and put the dough ball in a cotton pudding bag. Tie the bag, leaving at least 1 inch of room to allow the pudding to expand while cooking.
4. Boil pudding for 1.5 hours. (In NL, this is typically done in the pot along with Jiggs Dinner, but it can be done independently.)
5. When the duff is firm, remove it from the boiling water and let it cool slightly before removing it from the pudding bag.

6. Slice pudding like a cake and serve with the warm sauce of your choice: rum butter sauce, warmed molasses or Molasses Coady sauce (1 cup (250 mL) molasses, 1/4 cup (60 mL) butter, 1/4 cup (60 mL) water) is common in Newfoundland.
title: Figgy Duff

steps: 1. Heat the oil in a 12-inch skillet over high heat until shimmering. Add the eggplants and lower the heat to medium. Season with salt and pepper as you rotate the eggplants, browning them on all sides. Continue to cook, turning regularly, until a fork inserted into the eggplant meets no resistance (you may have to stand them up on their fat end to finish cooking the thickest parts), about 20 minutes, lowering the heat and sprinkling water into the pan as necessary if the eggplants threaten to burn or smoke excessively.

2. Mix the harissa, chickpeas and tomatoes together, then add to the eggplants. Cook until the tomatoes have blistered and broken down, about 5 minutes more. Season with salt and pepper and add water as necessary to thin to a saucy consistency. Meanwhile, combine the yogurt and cumin in a serving bowl. Season with salt and pepper.
3. Top the eggplant mixture with the parsley, drizzle with more extra virgin olive oil, and serve with the yogurt on the side.
title: Stovetop Eggplant With Harissa, Chickpeas, and Cumin Yogurt

steps: 1. Mix sugar, nutmeg, cinnamon and salt.
2. Slice apples in 1/2-inch slices.
3. Heat butter in heavy frying pan.
4. Add apple rings and 1/2 of sugar mixture; cook about 3 minutes.
5. Turn. Sprinkle with remainder of sugar mixture.
6. Continue cooking until apples are almost transparent.
7. Serve hot.
8. Makes 6 servings.
title: Southern Fried Apple Rings

steps: 1. Mix flour, salt, paprika
2. and
3. pepper.	Add
4. salad oil. Dip chicken in mixture coating well.
5. Bake in a shallow pan at 400° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.	Makes 6 servings.
title: Oven-Fried Chicken

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 lb. cooked shrimp (whole or cut in pieces)

steps: 1. Saute onion, green pepper, celery and the bay leaves in butter for 10 minutes, being careful not to burn them.
2. Add flour; stir until fully blended, 3 minutes.
3. Add tomatoes, salt, sugar, garlic powder, cayenne and lemon pepper.
4. Simmer gently for 15 minutes. Add shrimp; continue to simmer until shrimp are thoroughly heated. Serve on a bed of hot rice.
5. Makes 6 servings.
title: Shrimp Creole

ingredients.text: 1/2 c. parsley flakes, double if fresh
1 tsp. cayenne pepper, adjust to taste

steps: 1. In a 10 inch skillet, heat oil.
2. Add flour, stir on medium heat until flour begins to brown.
3. Add onion, bell pepper, garlic, parsley, cayenne, black pepper and salt.
4. Simmer on medium heat until onion is limp and clear.
5. Add shrimp, cook until all shrimp are pink.
6. Add tomato paste, tomato sauce and water.
7. Simmer 20 minutes on low heat.
8. Serve over rice.
9. Serves 3 to 4.
title: Cajun Shrimp Creole

ingredients.text: 2 (28 oz.) tomatoes, drained, juiced and chopped

steps: 1. Saut green peppers, onions and garlic in olive oil. Add a splash of water and cook until soft. Add brown sugar, pepper, thyme, cayenne pepper and bay leaf. Stir well. Stir in tomatoes and cook over low heat for 30 minutes or until sauce is thick. Add mushrooms and cook for a few more minutes. Mix in parsley and shrimp and cook for 5 to 10 minutes or until the shellfish is cooked thoroughly. Serve immediately so shrimp won't overcook. Serve over rice. Serves 6.
title: Shrimp Creole

steps: 1. Brown beef on all 4 sides. Mix 2 cups water.
2. Cook in a 350° oven until tender. Serve with brown gravy.
3. Serves 4.
title: Southern Pot Roast

steps: 1. Beat egg, add buttermilk and mix.
2. Set aside.
3. Shake together flour, parsley, pepper and paprika.
4. In another bag, shake together cornflake crumbs and cheese.
5. Drop chicken in egg mixture, the flour mixture, back in egg mixture then the cornflake mixture. Take chicken and press down in cornflake mixture.
6. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
7. Makes 4 servings.
title: Oven Fried Chicken

ingredients.text: 3 lb. chicken, cut into 8 pieces and skin taken off

steps: 1. Heat oven to 425°.
2. Coat roasting pan with cooking spray.
3. Mix crumbs, parsley, salt and peppers in bowl.
4. Brush chicken with melted butter.
5. Roll in crumb mixture.
6. Put in pan and bake 24 minutes.
7. Turn chicken over and bake 20 minutes longer.
8. Makes 6 servings.
title: Oven Fried Chicken

steps: 1. Remove skin and all visible fat from chicken.
2. Put all ingredients in a plastic bag with chicken pieces and shake. Spray baking sheet with Pam.
3. Bake at 325° to 350° (according to oven) for 1 hour.
4. Serves 4.
title: Better 'N Fried Chicken

ingredients.text: 1 (2 1/2 to 3 lb.) frying chicken, cut up and skinless

steps: 1. Heat oven to 375°.
2. In plastic bag, combine potato flakes, pepper and poultry seasoning. In shallow bowl combine egg whites and lemon juice.
3. Dip chicken, a few pieces at a time, in egg mixture.
4. Shake chicken in potato flake mixture to coat.
5. Place chicken in ungreased 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan.
6. Bake uncovered at 375° for 45 to 60 minutes or until chicken is fork-tender and juices run clear.
7. Makes 4 to 5 servings.
title: Oven-Fried Chicken

steps: 1. Cook bacon but not crisp.
2. Add chopped onion and cook until tender but not brown.
3. Stir in pineapple juice, catsup and chili powder.
4. Score franks diagonally at 1-inch intervals.
5. Add to the sauce.
6. Cover and bring to a boil; add pepper and simmer 8 to 10 minutes.
7. Serve on fluffy hot rice.
8. Makes 6 servings.
title: Creole Franks

steps: 1. Remove skin and fat from chicken.
2. Put pieces in plastic bag with all ingredients and shake to coat.
3. Place chicken in shallow nonstick baking pan.
4. Bake at 350° for 60 minutes.
5. Makes 4 servings.
title: Better "N" Fried Chicken

steps: 1. Slice okra in 1/2-inch slices.
2. Cook, covered, in small amount of
3. boiling
4. salted
5. water for 10 minutes or cook 1 (10 ounce) package
6. frozen
7. okra according to package directions. Drain. Cook
8. onions
9. and chopped peppers in oil until tender, but not brown.
10. Blend in sugar, flour, salt and pepper.
11. Add 3 peeled
12. and quartered

14. and
