16. Heat thoroughly. Serves 4.
title: Tomatoes And Okra

steps: 1. Combine cornmeal, salt and pepper, stir well. Put into plastic bag with okra and shake until coated. Spread oil in a 15 x 10 x 1 inch pan, spread okra evenly in pan.
2. Bake in 400 degree oven for 30 to 45 minutes, stirring often.
3. Yield: 10 to 12 servings.
title: Oven Fried Okra

ingredients.text: 6 chicken breasts, cut up in small pieces
3/4 lb. smoked sausage, cut in 1/4-inch slices

steps: 1. Melt shortening or
2. oil in a large thick pot; place on medium hot burner and add deboned chicken.
3. Cook until meat has lost all pink color.
4. Add sausage and cook until hot.
5. Add onions, pepper, salt and black pepper.
6. Reduce heat to medium low and cover pot. Cook until very dark, stirring and scraping bottom of pot often. Add Worcestershire sauce and stir around.
7. Pour in the water and bring to a boil.
8. Add rice and bring back to a boil.
9. Reduce heat to a simmer until moisture is absorbed by rice.
10. Let stand for 18 minutes in pot.
11. Makes 6 servings.
title: Chicken Jambalaya

ingredients.text: 3 c. okra, cut into 1/2-inch thick slices
4 or 5 medium tomatoes, peeled and coarsely chopped

steps: 1. Wash pods.
2. Cut off stems.
3. Cook, covered, in a small amount of boiling salted water for 10 to 15 minutes or until almost tender; drain.
4. Cook onion and green peppers in butter until tender, but not brown.
5. Stir in sugar, flour, 1/2 teaspoon salt and dash of pepper.
6. Add tomatoes.
7. Cook and stir until slightly thickened and bubbly.
8. Add cooked okra; heat through.
9. Serves 8.
title: Tomatoes And Okra

ingredients.text: 1/4 c. finely chopped celery, with some leaves

steps: 1. Melt butter in a heavy skillet.
2. Cook onion and celery over medium heat until translucent, about 20 minutes.
3. Add green onions and parsley.
4. Cook 10 minutes.
5. Stir in Creole seasoning.
6. Add shrimp and cook, covered, stirring 3 or 4 times, until just done, about 5 minutes.
7. Serve over white rice.
8. Serves 3 to 4.
title: Shrimp Etouffee

steps: 1. Place chicken into bowl.
2. Pour buttermilk over; marinate 1 hour.
3. In another bowl, mix flour, parsley, oregano, salt and pepper.
4. Remove the chicken from buttermilk; roll chicken pieces in seasoning mixture.
5. Reserve the buttermilk and pour into buttered casserole.
6. Heat shortening and margarine in heavy skillet; fry chicken just until brown.
7. Remove, scrape up brownings, and add chicken broth.
8. Cook for 2 minutes.
9. Place chicken on top of buttermilk in casserole.
10. Pour all your scraped up brownings over the chicken.
11. Bake, uncovered, in a 375° oven until tender, about 1 hour.
12. Makes 4 servings.
title: Buttermilk Fried Chicken

ingredients.text: 1/4 c. chicken stock, consomme or bouillon

steps: 1. Beat all seasoning into egg.
2. Dip chicken parts into egg mixture and coat with cornflakes.
3. Place in baking dish; add stock to dish.
4. Cover tightly.
5. Place in preheated oven at 375°.
6. Bake, covered, for 1/2 hour, then uncovered for 1/2 hour.
7. Serves 6.
title: Oven Fried Chicken

steps: 1. Wash and trim okra; slice into 1/4-inch pieces.
2. Heat vegetable oil in deep fryer or skillet to about 350°.
3. Mix buttermilk and egg.
4. Mix flour and salt.
5. Dip okra pieces into buttermilk and egg, then roll in flour.
6. Deep fry okra until golden brown, about 3 minutes.
7. Drain on paper towels.
8. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Fried Okra

steps: 1. Wash and drain okra.
2. Cut off tips and stem ends.
3. Cut into 1/2-inch slices and set aside.
4. Combine dry ingredients and mix well.
5. Stir egg into okra.
6. Dredge okra in flour mixture.
7. Heat shortening in large skillet until hot.
8. Add okra and fry until brown and crisp.
9. Drain well.
10. Serves 6.
title: Old-Time Fried Okra

steps: 1. Cook bacon in a large skillet until crisp; remove bacon, reserving drippings in skillet.
2. Crumble bacon and set aside. Saute onion and jalapeno pepper in bacon drippings until tender. Add remaining ingredients and cook over medium heat 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
3. Add bacon and serve immediately.
4. Yield: 6 servings.
title: Texas Okra And Tomatoes

steps: 1. Cook shrimp; remove veins.
2. Cook onion, green pepper and garlic until tender.
3. Blend in flour, seasonings and tomatoes.
4. Add shrimp and simmer for 20 minutes.
5. Serve over rice.
6. Serves 6.
title: Shrimp Creole

steps: 1. Chop all vegetables and saute onion, bell pepper and celery until onions are clear and bell pepper is tender.
2. The last minute of sauteing add garlic.
3. Set the vegetables aside.	Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces and season with Cajun seasoning (Konriko or Tony Chachere's).
4. Brown in bacon grease or butter.
5. Set chicken aside.
6. In the same pan, brown cut up sausage to get some of the grease out.
7. Leave some of the drippings in the pan and brown (stir while browning) rice until it's light brown.
8. Then add to your rice the vegetables, meats, chicken broth and some Cajun seasoning.
9. If using andouille sausage, add 1 teaspoon, if using regular smoked sausage, add 1 1/2 teaspoons and Kitchen Bouquet if the water doesn't look like it'll be dark enough (caramel brown).
10. Cover and cook on low-medium low for about 20 minutes.
11. Uncover and stir to check to see if rice is done.
12. Cook longer if needed.
13. Taste for seasoning and add more if needed.
14. Add green onions and stir. Serve with salad, garlic bread and sweetened ice tea.
15. Makes 8 servings.
title: "Louisiana Jambalaya"

steps: 1. Spray saucepan with nonstick cooking oil.
2. Place onion over medium heat.
3. Saute onion until clear.
4. Add all ingredients, except shrimp.
5. Stir well.
6. Add shrimp; cover and cook on very low heat for 35 minutes.
7. Uncover and toss rice.
8. Cover again and cook very slowly until rice is done.
9. Yields 2 servings.
title: Shrimp Jambalaya

steps: 1. Set out a large skillet, having a tight fitting cover.
2. Wash, cut off stems, ends, slice and set aside.
3. Chop okra and set aside.
4. Chop onion and green pepper (about 1/2 cup).
5. Add onions and green pepper; cook over medium heat until onions are transparent.
6. Add sliced okra and 2 cups canned tomatoes, cut up in small pieces.
7. Add salt and pepper to your taste.
8. Simmer, covered, for 30 to 40 minutes or until okra is tender.
9. Serves 8.
title: Okra And Tomatoes

ingredients.text: 1 frying chicken, cut up or use favorite pieces
2 c. green beans, broccoli, squash, cauliflower or carrots (optional)

steps: 1. In a skillet, fry bacon until crisp and remove.
2. Add chicken, browning well on all sides.
3. Remove to a 2-quart casserole dish as pieces brown.
4. Add vegetables, if desired, on top of chicken.
5. Cut potatoes into slices or chunks.
6. Add to bacon fat and brown. Remove.
7. Add as next layer in the casserole dish.
8. Top potatoes with onions.
9. Sprinkle with seasoning, salt, pepper, green onions and parsley.
10. Top with bacon.
11. Cover and bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.
12. Serves 4.
title: Southern Chicken Casserole

ingredients.text: 1 to 1-1/2 c. brown rice, prepared according to pkg. directions (not included in exchanges)

steps: 1. Peel, devein and wash shrimp; set aside.
2. (If shrimp are frozen, let thaw first in the refrigerator.)
3. Simmer tomato sauce, onion, celery, green pepper, mushrooms, parsley and pepper in skillet for 30 minutes.
4. Add shrimp and cook 10 to 15 minutes more, until shrimp are tender.
5. Serve over brown rice.
6. Serves 2.
title: Shrimp Creole

steps: 1. Remove skin and bone from chicken; slice thinly, holding knife at a diagonal slant.
2. Mix chicken with next six ingredients; set aside.
3. Thinly slice mushrooms and onion.
4. Stir-fry in 1/4 cup oil until tender (2 minutes).
5. Remove to bowl.
6. Add three tablespoons more oil; stir-fry chicken mixture until done (2 or 3 minutes). Add mushroom mixture and peas.
7. Heat through.
8. Serve with rice. Makes 4 servings.
title: Stir-Fried Chicken And Mushrooms

steps: 1. Cook shrimp according to directions but reserve 1 cup liquid. Fry bacon until crisp.
2. Saute onions, peppers, celery, garlic and parsley in skillet until tender.
3. (Do not add bacon at this time; drain and reserve until later.)
4. Add tomato sauce, tomato paste, reserved shrimp liquid, red pepper, black pepper, salt, sugar and bay leaf to ingredients that are sauteed.
5. Bring to boil.
6. Reduce heat and simmer covered 30 minutes.
7. Add shrimp and bacon (crumbled).
8. Bring to a boil; simmer 5 minutes.
9. Serve over rice. Serves 4 to 5 adults.
title: Shrimp Creole

ingredients.text: 2 lb. sausage, chicken, shrimp (in any combination)

steps: 1. In a large pot, saute chopped sausage and chicken in a little oil or butter until done. Chop vegetables and add.
2. Cook until soft.
3. Add spices and 3 cups of water, turn up the heat and bring to a boil.
4. Add tomato paste and rice.
5. Stir well.
6. Add peeled shrimp.
7. Cover the pot and turn the heat down to low. Cook for 20 to 30 minutes or until rice is done.
8. Converted rice is especially good in this recipe.
9. Serves 6.
title: Jambalaya

steps: 1. Wash chicken thighs; pat dry.
2. Combine bread crumbs, potato flakes and garlic salt. Beat egg and half and half.
3. Dip chicken pieces in egg mixture.
4. Coat chicken with crumb mixture.
5. Place chicken thighs in a micro-safe baking dish.
6. Microwave at High for about 10 minutes, turning once and rotating dish.
7. Sprinkle with melted butter and oil.
8. Microwave for another 10 minutes until chicken is done.
9. Test for doneness by piercing with a fork. If juice runs out clear, chicken is done.
10. Serves 4.
title: Oven Fried Chicken Thighs(Microwave)

steps: 1. Saute garlic, onion, bell pepper, celery, sausage and oleo in heavy pan for 5 minutes.
2. Add tomatoes, shrimp, water and seasoning to taste.
3. Cook 10 minutes.
4. Stir in rice.
5. Bring to a boil.
6. Reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes or until rice is cooked.
7. Serves 8 generously.
8. Be prepared to share recipe!
title: Jambalaya

ingredients.text: 4 slices bacon, fried with 1 medium onion, chopped

steps: 1. Boil peas in salted water until tender.
2. Add peas and 1 cup of pea liquid to rice, bacon with grease and onion.
3. Put in rice steamer or double boiler and cook 1 hour or until rice is thoroughly done.
4. Serves 8.
title: Hopping John

ingredients.text: 2 Tbsp. fresh parsley, chopped (3/4 tsp. dried)

steps: 1. Combine first 5 ingredients.
2. Dip chicken in dressing; dredge in bread crumb mixture.
3. Place, bone side down, in 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish.
4. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 45 to 55 minutes.
5. Yields 6 servings.
title: Oven Fried Chicken #2

steps: 1. Saute bacon until crisp.
2. Drain off all but one tablespoon of drippings. Add onion, green pepper and okra.
3. Cook until vegetables are tender-crisp.
4. Stir in rice, broth and seasonings. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat.
5. Cover and simmer for 15 minutes. Add tomatoes and fluff lightly.
6. Replace lid and let stand 12 minutes.
7. Serves 6.
title: Creole Okra

steps: 1. Beat eggs; add garlic, pepper and diced onions.
2. Dip chicken breasts in mixture.
3. Fry chicken until brown, then bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
4. Add vegetables to chicken and bake an additional 15 minutes.
5. Take chicken out of the oven and sprinkle the avocado over it before serving.
6. Serves 4.
title: Patti'S Chicken

steps: 1. In large bowl combine 1 1/2 cups water and the sugar; stir until sugar dissolves.
2. Stir in the rum and remaining water.
3. Pour into 6 heatproof mugs.
4. Add 1 teaspoon butter to each cup.
5. Garnish with cinnamon stick.
6. Serves 6.
title: Hot Buttered Rum

ingredients.text: 1/2 medium red bell pepper, chopped fine

steps: 1. Cut large chicken breast in half; roll in flour and stir-fry in shortening (1/2 cup).
2. Cook until golden brown, then put in casserole dish.
3. In stir-fry drippings, combine next 9 ingredients.
4. Pour over all chicken breasts; cover with foil. Bake for 25 minutes at 350°, then sprinkle for topping 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese over all; cover.
5. Bake for 10 minutes at 350°; let set 15 minutes and serve.
6. Makes 6 servings.
title: M.K.C.'S Creamed Mushroom Chicken Breasts

steps: 1. Cook macaroni 25 minutes in boiling water to which a teaspoon of salt has been added.
2. Drain; rinse with cold water and drain again.
3. Butter baking dish and put in layer of macaroni.
4. Add milk, salt, pepper, butter, dry mustard, chopped peppers and 3/4 cup grated cheese.
5. Add remaining macaroni and mix well.
6. Sprinkle remaining cheese over top; garnish with paprika and bake in a moderate oven (350°) for 45 minutes or until done.
7. Serves 6.
title: Macaroni And Cheese

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°.
2. The day before, combine chicken broth, celery and cheese.
3. Refrigerate.
4. Before baking, add eggs, soup and 3 cups of cracker crumbs.
5. Pour into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch greased pan.
6. Top with remaining crumbs.
7. Bake 1 hour at 350°.
8. Serves 12 to 15.
title: Chicken Casserole

steps: 1. Saute zucchini and onions in oil.
2. Whip the cottage cheese with basil and oregano in blender.
3. Place layers of squash, cottage cheese and tomatoes in a 1 1/2-quart casserole.
4. Top with Parmesan cheese.
5. Bake, uncovered, for 25 or 30 minutes.
6. Yields 6 servings, 130 calories per serving.
title: Zucchini, Cheese Casserole

ingredients.text: 3 chicken breasts, split in half to make 6

steps: 1. Combine soy sauce, oil, water, garlic, oregano and brown sugar.
2. Arrange chicken breasts in baking dish.
3. Pour wine mixture over breasts. Cover. Bake at 375° for
4. 1 hour and 30 minutes. Makes 6 servings.
title: Chicken Breasts Piquant

steps: 1. Mix ingredients. Put in well greased cups.
2. Bake at 450° for 25 to 30 minutes, then turn down to 300° for another 20 minutes. Watch em pop!
3. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Nana Buckley'S Popovers

steps: 1. Trim fat.
2. Place meat in clear plastic bag.
3. Place in a deep bowl.
4. Mix remaining ingredients.
5. Pour over meat; close bag. Marinate 2 to 3 hours at room temperature or overnight in refrigerator.
6. Turn bag occasionally.
7. Place meat on grill about 6 inches from heat.
8. Turn every 10 to 15 minutes.
9. Grill over medium coals for 35 to 45 minutes (total time for medium rare).
10. Brush with marinade during last 15 minutes.
11. Makes 8 servings; 291 calories per serving.
title: Barbecued Chuck Steak

steps: 1. Wash and dry eggplant; remove stems.
2. Leave eggplant whole and unpeeled.
3. Make a slit the length of each eggplant only to the center, not completely through the other side.
4. In each slit, drizzle 1 tablespoon olive oil and season with 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper.
5. Gently press eggplant together and rub completely with olive oil. Rub an 11 x 7-inch baking dish with olive oil.
6. Place eggplant in dish. Bake at 375° about 30 minutes or until tender.
7. Makes 6 to 8 servings.
title: Baked Eggplant

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients well.
2. Roll into 1-inch balls.
3. Place on cookie sheet.
4. Bake in a 350° oven for 15 minutes or until light brown.
5. Serve hot.
6. Yields 150 servings.
title: Sausage Balls

steps: 1. Mix egg, milk, salt and pepper.
2. Beat slightly.
3. Add crackers. Add remaining ingredients.
4. Mix well.
5. Shape mixture and bake. This recipe makes 4 meat loaves.
6. Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.
7. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Meat Loaves

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 375°.
2. Grease large baking pan; set aside. Meanwhile, combine instant potatoes, Parmesan cheese, parsley flakes and garlic salt in bowl; mix well.
3. Dip chicken pieces in margarine; roll in potato mixture to coat.
4. Place in greased pan. Bake at 375° for 45 to 60 minutes or until chicken is fork-tender and juices run clear.
5. Makes 4 servings.
title: Crispy Herbed Baked Chicken

steps: 1. Combine ingredients.
2. Cover and fry about 20 minutes.
3. Serves 6.
title: Fried Beets

steps: 1. Mix Jell-O according to directions on package using 1 cup cold water and 1 cup hot water.
2. Cool.
3. Fold Cool Whip into Jell-O mixture that has cooled.
4. Blend slowly but well.
5. Add fresh strawberries and chill until set.
6. Serves 6.
title: Strawberry Delight

steps: 1. Cook potatoes, carrots, onions and celery in saltwater until soft.
2. Add milk, sliced wieners and pepper and bring to a boil. Thicken with flour and butter that have been rubbed together to form a smooth paste.
3. Serves 8.
title: Wiener Stew

steps: 1. Saute onion in shortening; add seasonings and chicken and saute about 10 minutes. Add water, cover and simmer slowly until chicken is tender.*
2. Add sour cream to pan and mix well. Heat through and serve with mashed potatoes or dumplings. Serves 4.
title: Chicken Paprika

steps: 1. Put lightly browned hamburger in the bottom of a 2-quart casserole.
2. Layer the potatoes on top of the meat, then add onions, chopped green pepper and carrots.
3. Put tomatoes and seasonings next.
4. Last, top with
5. shredded cheese.
6. Bake 2 hours at 300°.
7. Serves 6.
title: Easy Hamburger Casserole

steps: 1. Mix together like pie crust.
2. Sprinkle mixture over one-quart peeled, sliced apples that have been placed in an 8 x 8-inch buttered baking pan.
3. For richer flavor, a little brown sugar may be added to apples before topping is sprinkled.
4. Bake 30 minutes at 350°.
5. Cool.
6. Turn upside down and serve with ice cream or whipped cream.
7. Makes 9 servings.
8. Double ingredients for a 9 x 13-inch pan.
title: Apple Crunch

steps: 1. Cook the rutabaga until soft (about 20 minutes) in salted water to cover; drain and mash.
2. Soak the bread crumbs in the cream and stir in the nutmeg, salt and beaten eggs; combine with the rutabaga.
3. Turn into a buttered 2 1/2-quart casserole, dot with butter and bake in a 350° oven for 1 hour or until lightly browned.
4. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Rutabaga Casserole

steps: 1. Dip chicken into eggs, then into bread crumbs to coat.
2. In a skillet on medium heat, add oleo.
3. When melted, place chicken in skillet and brown on both sides, then add sauce.
4. Lower flame and cover for 10 minutes.
5. Then sprinkle cheese and parsley on top and cook another 5 minutes or until cheese melts. Makes 4 servings.
title: Cheesy Chicken

steps: 1. Cut thin slice from top of each green pepper; remove stems and seeds.
2. In saucepan over medium heat, in 1-inch boiling water, heat peppers to boiling.
3. Reduce heat to low.
4. Cover; simmer 5 minutes or until peppers are tender to crisp.
5. Drain.
6. In shallow baking dish, arrange peppers.
7. Meanwhile, in a skillet, brown meat and cook with chopped peppers and onions until tender.
8. Add remaining ingredients and mix well.
9. Spoon mixture into green peppers.
10. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.
11. After the first 10 minutes of baking, baste with tomato basting sauce.
12. Baste after every 10 minutes of baking.
13. Serves 18.
title: Stuffed Bell Peppers

steps: 1. Heat oven to 400°. Cut chicken into bite-size pieces and coat with mayonnaise. Grind crackers into fine crumbs and place in a large Baggie. Add coated chicken and shake until all pieces are well coated. Put chicken into baking dish and bake at 400° for 1/2 hour. Serves 4.
title: Easy Chicken Nuggets

steps: 1. Chop onion and	green pepper in very small pieces. Beat eggs until creamy.
2. Chop
3. bread	into
4. small
5. pieces.
6. Mix all ingredients using
7. half
8. of
9. tomato
10. sauce.
11. Grease
12. a 2-quart Pyrex baking
13. dish.
14. Pour
15. ingredients into Pyrex dish. Shape, then pour remaining
16. tomato sauce over top of meat loaf.
17. Bake at 325° for 1	hour and 25 minutes or until well done.
18. Yields 6 to 8 servings.
title: Best Of The Meat Loaves

steps: 1. Cook onion in oil until tender.
2. Stir in next 6 ingredients, 1/2 cup of water and 1/2 teaspoon of salt.
3. Simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
4. Score franks diagonally at 1-inch intervals.
5. Add to sauce; simmer, covered, for 15 minutes.
6. Serve over toasted buns. Makes 4 to 5 servings.
title: Barbecue Frankfurters

steps: 1. Layer cranberries, apples and sugar in casserole.
2. Combine brown sugar, flour, oats, pecans and butter in bowl, mixing well. Sprinkle over layers. Bake at 350° until lightly browned.
3. Yields 12 servings.
title: Cranberry Delight

steps: 1. In a large pan, combine the oil, water, broccoli and garlic. Cook, covered, over medium heat for 5 minutes.
2. Add mushrooms and black pepper.
3. Cook until tender.
4. Remove from heat and stir in tomatoes, basil, pasta and cheese.
5. Makes 3 servings.
title: Vegetable Pasta

ingredients.text: 1 small head cabbage, cut into wedges

steps: 1. Cover corned beef with water and simmer until tender, about 3 1/2 hours.
2. Remove meat to a hot platter; keep hot in a low oven. Boil onions, turnip, carrots and potatoes in the broth for 30 minutes or until done.
3. Add cabbage during last 15 minutes of cooking.
4. Arrange vegetables around the corned beef on platter or to allow room for carving, serve separately.
5. (If corned beef has not been kept hot, return it to the pot for a few minutes.) Serves 6.
title: New England Boiled Beef Dinner

steps: 1. In a 5-quart kettle, combine sugar, cloves, cinnamon sticks and water.
2. Bring to a boil, stirring constantly.
3. Boil, uncovered, 5 minutes and remove from heat, adding sliced lemons. Let stand, covered, for 10 minutes. With a slotted spoon, lift out the cloves and cinnamon sticks. Add brandy and wine.
4. Simmer until hot.
5. Serve in mugs. Can be stored, covered, in refrigerator. Makes 25 servings.
title: Hot Mulled Wine

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients except pork in large bowl.
2. Place pork in bowl; cover and let stand at room temperature 1 hour or in refrigerator overnight, turning occasionally.
3. Drain and grill pork.
4. Makes 6 to 8 servings.
title: Grilled Pork

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 lb. ham, cut into serving pieces

steps: 1. Place ham and water in multi-cooker.
2. Set heat control at 250° and bring to a boil.
3. Reduce heat to 212°.
4. Cover and simmer 1 hour or until meat is nearly tender.
5. Add remaining ingredients, cover and simmer until vegetables are done.
6. Add water, if necessary.
7. Makes 3 to 4 servings.
title: New England Boiled Dinner

steps: 1. Combine first 5 ingredients in a plastic bag; shake well.
2. Cut chicken into 1 inch strips; dip chicken in margarine and shake in bread crumb mixture. Place in Pyrex dish. Bake at 400° for 20 minutes or until tender. Yields 4 servings.
title: Baked Chicken Planks

steps: 1. Preheat the oven to 375°.
2. Wash and stem the mushrooms.
3. Dip the caps into melted butter and place upside down in a buttered baking dish.

4. Combine crabmeat, eggs, mayonnaise, scallions, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce and half the bread crumbs. Fill mushroom caps with mixture. Sprinkle with remaining crumbs and butter. Bake 15 minutes.
5. Yields 4 to 6 servings.
title: Mushrooms Maryland

steps: 1. Mix in large bowl, then make into small bite size balls.
2. Bake in oven until golden brown on cookie sheet.
3. Bake at 325° for 25 to 30 minutes. Freezes well.
4. Makes 36 servings.
title: Sausage Balls

ingredients.text: 4 slices bacon, crisp fried and crumbled

steps: 1. Trim crusts from bread.
2. Combine cream cheese, bacon, milk, horseradish and Worcestershire sauce in bowl.
3. Mix well.
4. Spread mixture on half the bread slices.
5. Top with remaining bread.
6. Cut each sandwich into thirds.
7. Serves 6.
title: Zingy Bacon Bits

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients in a shallow dish or heavy-duty Ziploc plastic bag.
2. Add chicken.
3. Cover or seal and refrigerate one hour. Place chicken on a lightly greased grill rack.
4. Cook, covered, with grill lid over medium hot coals (350° to 400°) for 20 to 25 minutes or until done, turning halfway through cooking time.
5. If not cooking on grill, use grill or bake in oven.
6. Makes 6 servings.
title: Hawaiian Grilled Chicken

steps: 1. Season beef with salt and pepper.
2. Let stand 10 to 15 minutes. Dredge with flour and brown in hot oil.
3. Pour off all but 2 tablespoons of oil in pan; push beef to one side and saute garlic, onion and tomatoes until mixture is mushy.
4. Add vinegar, bay leaf and enough water to cover beef.
5. Bring to a boil; lower heat and simmer for 1 1/2 to 2 hours or until beef is tender.
6. Taste for seasoning.
7. Bring back to boiling; add green beans and carrots and cook until vegetables are done (about 10 minutes).
8. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Estofadong Carne(Tangy Braised Beef)

ingredients.text: 4 slices Fontina cheese (each 1/2 inch wide, 2 inches long, 1/4 inch thick)

steps: 1. Pound each chicken piece between pices of wax paper to 1/4 thickness. Place 1 sage leaf in center of cut side of each thigh. Top sage with cheese strip. Fold Thigh in half to enclose filling. Wrap bacon slice around each thigh and secure with wooden picks. Coat Chicken in Flour.
2. Heat oil in skillet over medium heat. Add chicken. Brown 5 minutes per side. Remove chicken. Add broth to skillet and scrape up browned bits. Return chicken to skillet.
3. Reduce heat to low. Cover skillet and simmer chicken 5 minutes or until tender and no longer pink. (170 F). Stir in lemon juice. Serves 4. [ I got this from a friend! ].
title: Chicken Thigh Saltimbocca

steps: 1. In large skillet, heat vegetable oil and butter.
2. Add garlic and saute 1 minute.
3. Add scallops, toss and saute until opaque, 3 to 4 minutes.
4. Drizzle with lemon juice and sprinkle with parsley. Serves 4.
title: Scallops Scampi

steps: 1. Blend ingredients together.
2. Serves 3 or 4.
title: Orange Julius

ingredients.text: 4 green peppers, cut into eighths lengthwise

steps: 1. Shape meat into 6 oval steaks.
2. Brown lightly in a large skillet. Top steaks with green peppers. Cover.
3. Cook over medium heat for about 8 to 10 minutes or to desired doneness and peppers are still crisp. Makes 6 servings.
title: Hamburger Pepper Steak

steps: 1. Saute the sausage, drain all the grease and set aside. Beat the eggs, add milk, salt and mustard, stir. Layer the bread cubes on the bottom of a 9 x 13 inch baking dish. Then layer the sausage, followed by cheese. Pour the egg mixture over the top, cover and refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Christmas Egg Casserole

ingredients.text: 3 large white onions, cut in thick slices

steps: 1. Shake chicken pieces in bag with cornstarch until coated.
2. Fry in oil until medium brown.
3. Remove chicken.
4. Put pineapple chunks, onions, celery and green peppers in deep Dutch oven or roaster. Mix remaining frying oil with brown sugar, soy sauce and ginger. Pour over vegetables.
5. Add chicken.
6. Cover and cook over low heat for 30 minutes or until tender.
7. Lightly mix so that chicken will be under vegetables and cornstarch will cook into sauce.
8. Cook until thickened.
9. Serves 10.
title: Hawaiian Chicken

steps: 1. Blend together sour cream and mayonnaise.
2. Toss first 6 ingredients with sour cream mixture.
3. Put half of the mixture into buttered 1 1/2-quart casserole.
4. Top with 1/2 cup chow mein noodles.
5. Add remaining mixture and top with 1/2 cup chow mein noodles.
6. Bake at 375° for 25 minutes.
7. Makes 6 servings.
title: Crunchy Chicken Casserole

steps: 1. Combine Crisco, salt and water.
2. Heat to boiling.
3. Sift flour; measure and add to boiling water.
4. Beat vigorously until mixture leaves sides of saucepan and does not cling to spoon.
5. Remove from fire.
6. Add the unbeaten eggs, one at a time, beating until mixture is smooth each time.
7. Drop by tablespoons into well-oiled muffin tins.
8. Bake 40 minutes in hot oven (400°).
9. Makes 12 servings. When cooled, fill with favorite filling and sprinkle with powdered sugar.
title: Cream Puffs

steps: 1. In order given, layer ingredients in greased 2-quart baking dish.
2. Season each layer with salt and pepper.
3. Bake, covered, at 350° for 1 hour.
4. Makes 6 servings.
title: Six Layer Dinner

steps: 1. In a saucepan cover carrots with water and cook until very tender.
2. Drain and mash.
3. In a large bowl beat eggs; add onion, celery, parsley, butter and salt.
4. Stir in carrots, add bread cubes and mix well.
5. Pour into
6. greased 2-quart baking dish.
7. Bake uncovered at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes or until set.
8. Makes 8 to 10 servings.
title: Carrot Casserole

steps: 1. Chop fine the eggs, onion, pepper and olives.
2. Mix with cheese, catsup and Worcestershire sauce.
3. Cut buns in half. Spread each half with mixture.
4. Toast in a 350° oven until cheese melts.
5. Serves 3.
title: Barbecue Cheese Sandwiches

steps: 1. Fry hamburger.
2. Drain off fat.
3. Mix all together and simmer for 20 minutes.
4. Serves 10.
title: Barbecued Sandwiches

steps: 1. Brown onions and green peppers in oil.
2. Add meat and brown. Add ketchup, brown sugar, vinegar and Worcestershire sauce.
3. Mix well.
4. Simmer for 5 or 10 minutes.
5. Serve on hamburger roll. Serves 6.
title: Barbecued Hamburger Sloppy Joes

steps: 1. In skillet, heat 1 tbsp (15 mL) oil over medium heat.
2. Cook onions, stirring often, until tender and golden brown, about 20 minutes. Transfer to bowl.
3. Meanwhile, cut pork into 1-inch (2.5 cm) thick medallions; season with 1/2 tsp (2 mL) salt and 1/4 tsp (1 mL) pepper. Set aside.
4. In same skillet, heat 1 tbsp (15 mL) oil over medium-high heat; fry fennel seeds for 10 seconds.
5. Add pork; brown on both sides, about 4 minutes.
6. Pour in wine and increase heat to high; cover and cook for 3 minutes.
7. Turn over pork and cook, uncovered, until wine is reduced to about 2 tbsp (30 mL), 2 to 3 minutes.
8. Transfer pork to warm serving plate. Set aside.
9. Add onions and parsley to skillet and heat through, about 1 minute; serve over pork.
10. Makes 4 servings.
11. Serving suggestion - nice with garlic spaghetti, and a tomato and lettuce leaf salad dressed with olive oil and lemon juice and sprinkled with chopped fresh mint.
title: Pork Tenderloin With Fennel Seed And Onions

steps: 1. Melt butter in skillet.
2. Add onion, zucchini and mushrooms. Cook for 5 minutes.
3. Add tomato slices and all other ingredients except the Cheddar cheese.
4. Cook 4 minutes.
5. Remove from heat and sprinkle shredded Cheddar on top.
6. Serves 6.
title: Zucchini-Tomato Skillet

ingredients.text: 6 small zucchini, cut in half lengthwise

steps: 1. Trim ends of zucchini; cut squash in half lengthwise.
2. Melt butter in large skillet.
3. Add grated onion and bouillon cube; crush cube.
4. Add zucchini, cut side down and cook until golden brown.
5. Turn; add water and cook, covered, over low heat, about 10 minutes or until tender.
6. Serves 5 to 6.
title: Zucchini On The Half Shell

steps: 1. Combine ingredients; Mix well.
2. Pack lightly into greased 6-cup ring mold; Chill several hours.
3. Unmold into jelly roll pan.
4. Bake in 325° gas oven for 1 hr.
5. Serve with scramble eggs in center. Makes 12 servings
title: Christmas Morning Sausage Ring

steps: 1. Combine all dry ingredients.
2. Dip chicken pieces in milk. Coat with meal mixture.
3. Place chicken, skin side up, in large baking dish.
4. Drizzle butter over chicken.
5. Bake in 375° oven 50 to 55 minutes or until done.
6. Serves 4.
title: Good Oven Chicken

steps: 1. Place brisket and all items in plastic bag.
2. Shake and rotate for 4 hours in refrigerator, then remove from marinade while coals are warming, grill for 15 minutes.
3. Save marinade.
4. Wrap brisket in heavy foil, allowing room for the marinade to be poured on brisket through small hole.
5. Seal up tight.
6. Grill 1 1/2 to 2 hours, turning occasionally.
7. To serve, slice diagonally across grain in thin slices.
8. Serves 12 to 16.
title: Texas Barbecue Brisket

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients thoroughly and roll into about 12 to 14 balls.
2. Bake at 350° until golden brown.
3. Serves 3.
title: Tuna Balls(Low Calorie)

steps: 1. Cut beef into 2-inch cubes and brown in salad oil in skillet. Place in casserole dish.
2. Combine remaining ingredients in a saucepan and bring to a boil; pour over beef.
3. Cover, and bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours.
4. Yields 4 servings.
title: Beef Burgundy

steps: 1. Season chicken with curry powder, salt and pepper.
2. Brown in oil until golden.
3. Combine orange juice, water, brown sugar, dry mustard and mix well.
4. Add to chicken; simmer covered for 20 minutes.
5. Lift chicken from broth and add rice.
6. Arrange chicken pieces over rice.
7. Bring to a boil.
8. Cover and simmer 20 minutes longer.
9. Remove from heat and let stand covered until liquid is absorbed, about 5 minutes.
10. Sprinkle with parsley.
11. Makes 6 servings.
title: Sunshine Chicken

steps: 1. Line a 9 x 13-inch pan with foil.
2. Melt the butter in the pan. Place chicken, skin side down, in the pan and sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoon of salt.
3. Blend the remaining salt, honey, mustard and lemon juice.
4. Brush half of the honey mixture on the chicken. Bake in a 350° oven for 30 minutes.
5. Turn the chicken and brush with the remaining honey mixture.
6. Bake for 30 minutes more, or until the chicken is tender.
7. Serves 4.
title: Gold Shipment Broiled Chicken

steps: 1. Brown onion and pepper slowly in olive oil.
2. Peel eggplant and tomatoes; cut into 1-inch cubes.
3. Add to onion and pepper; sprinkle seasonings.
4. Mix. Spoon about 1/3 mixture into 2-quart baking dish. Top with 1/2 rice.
5. Repeat layers; top with eggplant.
6. Cover and bake for 45 minutes, or until eggplant is tender.
7. Remove; sprinkle with cheese.
8. Bake for 15 minutes, uncovered, or until cheese has melted.
9. Serves 6.
title: Eggplant Supreme

steps: 1. Cut bacon in small pieces.
2. Place in an 8 x 12-inch baking pan.
3. Put under broiler to brown while mixing batter.
4. Beat eggs, salt and sugar.
5. Beat in milk and flour alternately.
6. Pour mixture into hot pan with browned bacon and grease.
7. Bake at 425° for 20 minutes.
8. Cut into squares and serve with syrup.
9. Serves 4.
title: Flaskpankaka

steps: 1. Cut peppers in halves; remove stalks and seeds and cut into thin slices.
2. Place onion and oil in skillet and simmer until transparent.
3. Add tomatoes and cook 5 minutes.
4. Add peppers, salt and pepper; cover and cook slowly 30 minutes, adding water if necessary, stirring frequently.
5. Serves 4.
title: Roman Style Peppers

ingredients.text: 1 c. coarsely chopped walnuts or pecans

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients until well mixed.
2. Pour into 2-quart shallow casserole dish or mold.
3. Freeze overnight.
4. Stand at room temperature 15 to 20 minutes before cutting or unmolding.
5. Cut into 8 or 10 squares or slices.
6. Yields 8 to 10 servings.
title: Christmas Cream

ingredients.text: 4 to 5 apples (cooking apples, hard, juicy and tart)

steps: 1. Core and slice apples.
2. Put oleo in skillet; add apples and cook on medium heat.
3. Add brown sugar and let cook down.
4. Add water to start cooking.
5. Serves 4 or 5.
6. Serve for breakfast or with pork dishes.
title: Fried Apples

steps: 1. Combine salad dressing, water, dill weed, salt and pepper. Place cucumber slices in shallow dish and top with dressing. Chill overnight.
2. To serve, top tomato slices with cucumbers and dressing.
3. Serves 6.
4. Calories: 33.
title: Dilled Tomato Slices

ingredients.text: 4 stalks broccoli, cut into bite size pieces
1 small head cauliflower, cut into bite size pieces

steps: 1. Combine first 5 ingredients; toss lightly.
2. Combine remaining 7 ingredients; mix well and pour over vegetables. Chill at least 3 hours. Yield: 10 to 12 servings.
title: Fresh Vegetable Marinate

steps: 1. Combine lemon juice, olive oil and water.
2. Add onion powder, basil leaves and black pepper.
3. Brush over chicken breasts.
4. Saute in nonstick skillet until lightly browned and thoroughly cooked. Makes 4 servings.
title: Herbed Chicken Saute

steps: 1. Make a white sauce of the first 6 ingredients.
2. Blanch, peel and mince finely green pepper.
3. Add Worcestershire sauce; stir in crabmeat.
4. Place in casserole dish and sprinkle with corn flake crumbs and butter.
5. Bake in 450° oven until brown.
6. Serves 4.
title: Crab Imperial

steps: 1. Saute bacon in skillet until crisp; remove.
2. Drain on towel. Crumble.
3. Saute chicken in bacon fat over medium heat until brown. Place in casserole and sprinkle crumbled bacon over top.
4. (Can have 2 layers if necessary.)
5. Melt butter in same skillet (after chicken is all sauteed), then remove from heat.
6. Stir in flour, salt, pepper, celery salt, sage and thyme.
7. Dissolve cubes in water; stir this into the ingredients in the skillet and add milk.
8. Stir over low heat until thickened and smooth.
9. (Don't turn your back on it or it will get lumps!)
10. Pour this over the chicken.
11. Cover and bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours uncovering for the last 15 minutes.
12. Serves 6 people.
title: Chicken With Herbs En Casserole

steps: 1. Brush pork chops with tomato paste.
2. Mix cheese with bread crumbs; pat into chops.
3. Pan-fry chops until brown; place in baking dish.
4. Add a small amount of water to prevent sticking. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
5. Serve with sauce.
6. Yield: 4 servings.
title: Pork Chops With Cheese

steps: 1. Sift the first 6 ingredients together. Add the dates and nuts. Cream the margarine, sugar, egg and flour mixture.
2. Add the pumpkin.
3. Mix lightly.
4. Pour into well-greased 2-quart mold. Cover and steam 2 hours.
5. Serves 8 to 12.
title: Pumpkin Puff

steps: 1. Heat oven to 400 degrees. Drizzle olive oil in 9" X 13" baking dish. Set aside.
2. Rinse the chicken breasts under cold water and dry with paper towels. Set aside.
3. In a large bowl, combine the bread crumbs, flour, oregano, basil, pepper, salt and garlic powder. Mix well.
4. Bread chicken breasts in flour mixture and arrange in olive oil coated baking dish. Bake at 400 degrees for 20 to 25 minutes or until browned. Remove from oven.
5. Top with marinara sauce, red wine and cheese. Cover and continue baking for 20 minutes. Remove cover and bake an additional 10 minutes.
6. Serve with pasta and tossed green salad.
7. Serves 4. Can be doubled.
title: Easy Oven Baked Chicken Parmesan

steps: 1. Rinse scallops and pat dry with paper towels.
2. Cook onion, celery and green pepper in butter until tender.
3. Blend in flour and seasonings.
4. Add milk gradually and cook until thick, stirring constantly.
5. Add scallops.
6. Place half of the rice in a buttered 1 1/2-quart dish.
7. Cover with half of the scallop mixture and half of the cheese.
8. Repeat.
9. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes. Serves 6.
title: Scallop Casserole

steps: 1. Steam or boil carrots until extra soft. Drain well. While carrots are warm, add sugar, baking powder and vanilla. Whip with mixer until smooth. Add flour and mix well. Whip eggs and add to flour mixture; blend well. Add softened margarine to mixture and blend well. Pour mixture into baking dish about half full, as the souffl will rise. Bake in 350° oven about 1 hour or until top is a light golden brown. Sprinkle lightly with powdered sugar over top before serving. Serves 10.
title: Carrot Souffl

steps: 1. Microwave bacon on High between several layers of paper toweling 5 to 6 minutes or until crisp.
2. Cool and crumble. Combine eggs, milk, salt, mustard, onion powder and pepper in a bowl.
3. Beat well.
4. Pour over croutons and cheese in a 10 x 6-inch baking dish.
5. Let stand 10 minutes. Stir.
6. Microwave on High 6 minutes, stirring 2 or 3 times.
7. Sprinkle with bacon and microwave on High an additional 1 to 2 minutes, depending on desired degree of doneness.
8. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Microwave Brunch Egg Casserole

steps: 1. Cook all ingredients, except cheese and bacon, in skillet until tender.
2. Top with cheese and bacon.
3. Brown under broiler. Serves 4.
title: Far East Eggplant

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients.
2. Pour into ice filled glasses. Serves 6.
title: Apple Honey Refresher

ingredients.text: 1 lb. pork sausage, browned and drained

steps: 1. Mix
2. all
3. ingredients together.
4. Cover and refrigerate. Heat oven to 350°.
5. Grease a 2-quart casserole.	Pour mixture into dish and
6. bake	until knife inserted in center comes out clean, about 1 hour.
7. Makes 6 servings.
title: Easy Egg Sausage Puff

ingredients.text: 2 lb. round steak, cut 1 inch thick

steps: 1. Combine flour, salt and pepper; rub into both sides of steak or pound in with meat mallet or edge of heavy plate.
2. Cut into 6 portions.
3. Peel and slice onions.
4. Preheat skillet; add half of shortening, then onions.
5. Brown lightly.
6. Remove from skillet. Add remaining shortening; brown steak on both sides.
7. Reduce heat. Add celery, garlic, chili sauce and water.
8. Cover; simmer 1 hour. Cut green pepper into slices.
9. Add pepper and onions to meat. Continue cooking 30 minutes or until meat is tender.
10. Makes 6 servings.
title: Swiss Steak

steps: 1. Saute chopped vegetables in oil.
2. Add tomato sauce and simmer 20 to 30 minutes.
3. Add shrimp, rice and seasoning.
4. Pour into shallow baking dish.
5. Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.
6. Serves 4.
title: Shrimp Bake

steps: 1. Place macaroni in a 2-quart pan of boiling water with a dash of salt.
2. Let cool for 10 to 12 minutes.
3. Drain macaroni.
4. Pour in a mixing bowl with diced, cooked ham, cheese, green pepper, butter and milk.
5. Stir vigorously and pour into a casserole dish (about 8 x 11 x 2-inch) and cover with glass lid.
6. Let cook in oven at 350° for 15 minutes.
7. Remove and let cool.
8. Garnish with parsley and ready to serve.
9. Will serve 6 to 8 adults.
title: Macaroni Casserole

steps: 1. In a skillet, cook mushrooms in butter until tender.
2. Stir in flour; gradually add the chicken broth.
3. Cook, stirring constantly until sauce comes to a boil.
4. Remove from the heat; stir in cream, parsley, salt, nutmeg and pepper.
5. Fold in chicken and spaghetti. Turn into a greased 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish.
6. Sprinkle with cheese.
7. Bake uncovered at 350° for 30 minutes or until heated through.
8. Yield:
9. 8 servings.

ingredients.text: 6 medium sweet onions (10 to 15 or similar)

steps: 1. Peel

9. Time of preparation: 1 hour.
