title: Onion Casserole

steps: 1. Line a colander with paper towels or cheesecloth and spoon the yogurt in so all the whey strains off into a bowl. Leave it in the fridge overnight (or for at least 8 hours or so).
2. Discard the whey and put the blob of strained yogurt into a mixing bowl. Add the vanilla and syrup.
3. Whip it up with an electric mixer to beat all the air bubbles out, thoroughly beating all the ingredients together.
4. Makes about 3-4 servings depending on how it's portioned. Doesn't last more than 2 or 3 servings in this house! Doubles nicely in bigger colanders, too!
title: Maple Yogurt

steps: 1. Place chicken in a glass 9-inch baking dish.
2. Mix remaining ingredients and pour over chicken.
3. Refrigerate 8 to 24 hours. Preheat oven to 350° and bake 1 hour.
4. Good served with rice and a steamed squash medley.
5. Serves 4.
title: Fast Paced Chicken

steps: 1. Cut bacon in 1-inch pieces.
2. Fry until most of the grease is extracted.
3. Remove bacon and put flour in the fat.
4. Blend smooth, then add water slowly.
5. Stir and cook until flour thickens, then add dried beef, potatoes and onions.
6. Cover skillet and cook 20 minutes.
7. Thin with a little hot water if too thick.
8. Serves 4.
title: Canuck Stew

steps: 1. Brown pork chops in butter.
2. Transfer to braising pan.
3. Saute onion and celery in pork chop drippings until tender.
4. Add wine and bring to a boil.
5. Pour over chops seasoned with salt and pepper.
6. Cover.
7. Braise in 300° oven 1 1/2 hours or until tender. Remove chops from pan.
8. Strain juices.
9. Stir mustard and capers into juices.
10. Pour over chops and simmer a few minutes more. Serves 4.
title: Braised Pork Chops

steps: 1. Mix all dry ingredients together.
2. Add egg and milk; beat with rotary beater until smooth.
3. Dip franks in batter and fry in hot deep fat until brown on one side, then turn and brown the other side.
4. Drain on paper towel.
5. Serve hot with mustard, mayonnaise or catsup.
6. Yields 8 to 10 servings.
title: Pronto Pups

ingredients.text: 6 chicken breast halves, boned and skinned

steps: 1. Cut chicken into 1-inch chunks.
2. Beat eggs and mix with water, flour, sesame seed and salt to make a batter.
3. Heat oil over medium heat.
4. Dip chicken
5. in
6. batter
7. and fry in hot oil until golden brown (about
8. 5 minutes), turning once.
9. Drain on a paper towel.
10. Serves
12. Good
13. served
14. with
15. sweet and sour sauce.
title: Chicken Chunks

steps: 1. In a saucepan, cook carrots until crisp-tender, drain, reserving 1/2 cup of liquid. Place carrots in a 3 quart lightly greased baking dish. Combine mayonnaise, onion, horseradish and liquid, spread over carrots. Sprinkle with cheese. Toss bread crumbs with butter and sprinkle over cheese. Bake uncovered 30 minutes at 350°. Yield 16-20 servings.
title: Creamy Carrot Casserole

steps: 1. Core and thinly slice apples.
2. In a 12-inch skillet, melt butter.
3. Add apples; saute 10 minutes.
4. Combine sugar and cinnamon; sprinkle over apples.
5. Cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, about 5 minutes more.
6. Makes 4 servings.
title: Country Fried Apples

steps: 1. For easy mixing, divide recipe.
2. Melt 1 1/2 cups margarine. Add 1 cup flour.
3. Cook 3 minutes.
4. Stir in 1 quart chicken broth and 1 1/2 quarts milk.
5. Cook and stir until thickened.
6. Add salt and pepper to taste.
7. Continue with next batch of cream sauce. When finished, pour all into electric roaster and add chicken. Heat.
8. Serve over biscuits, potatoes or waffles.
9. Serves 85.
title: Creamed Chicken

steps: 1. Wash mushrooms and place in casserole dish.
2. Add wine, seasoning salt, Worcestershire sauce and margarine (more if needed).
3. Bake in covered dish at 350° for 30 minutes.
4. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Baked Mushrooms

ingredients.text: 2 1/2 or 3 lb. white fish (trout, snapper or mackerel may be used)

steps: 1. Make 4 or 5 shallow slits on each side of fish.
2. Brush fish generously with a mixture of oil, lemon juice, salt, pepper, oregano and Accent.
3. Cook over coals until golden brown, brushing with mixture.
4. Turn fish gently to cook both sides.
5. When fish is done, put on serving platter and pour remaining mixture over fish. Serves 3 to 4.
title: Charcoal Grilled White Fish

steps: 1. Into greased casserole (I use margarine for greasing), add apples and cranberries.
2. Sprinkle with 3/4 cup sugar (this can be done the day before and refrigerated).
3. Mix melted margarine, oatmeal, flour, brown sugar and nuts.
4. Sprinkle over apples and cranberries.
5. Bake approximately 1 hour in 350° oven.
6. Serves 12 plus.
7. May be used as side dish or dessert.
title: Apple Casserole

steps: 1. Mix first 6 ingredients.
2. Place in 1 1/2-quart casserole.
3. Mix chips and cheese.
4. Sprinkle on top.
5. Bake, uncovered, at 375° for 30 minutes or heated.
6. Yields 6 servings.
title: Chicken Casserole

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 lb. sirloin steak, cut 1/8 inch thick

steps: 1. Cut steak into matchlike pieces.
2. Toss with cornstarch and 2 tablespoons soy sauce.
3. Heat 4 tablespoons oil in skillet and add the onions and salt.
4. Saute 3 minutes.
5. Remove the onions.
6. Heat the remaining oil in the skillet.
7. Saute meat until lightly browned.
8. Mix in onions, remaining soy sauce and pepper, stirring well, for 1 minute.
9. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Tawain Shredded Beef And Onion

steps: 1. In a medium bowl, mix all ingredients. Freeze for 4 hours, stirring hourly for the first 3 hours. Makes 4 servings.
title: Easy Frozen Yogurt

steps: 1. Sprinkle pork chops with salt, lemon pepper and oregano.
2. Place chops 4 to 5 inches from coals.
3. Grill over low to medium hot coals 25 minutes or until the chops are no longer pink, turning once. Yields 4 servings.
title: Grilled Pork Chops

ingredients.text: 2 to 3 chicken breasts, cooked and cut into bite size

steps: 1. Drain pineapple chunks, reserving juice.
2. Add enough water to juice to make 1 1/4 cups liquid.
3. In 2-quart casserole, thoroughly combine brown sugar, cornstarch and ginger.
4. Stir in soy sauce, vinegar and pineapple juice.
5. Microwave, uncovered, on Full power for 4 to 5 minutes or until mixture boils and thickens, stirring 3 times.
6. Stir in chicken, green pepper and pineapple.
7. Microwave, covered, on Full power for 5 to 6 minutes or until well heated, stirring once or twice.
8. Let stand, covered, 5 minutes.
9. Serves 4. Serve over rice.
title: Hawaiian Chicken

steps: 1. In saucepan, melt margarine. Blend in flour, salt and mustard. Add milk and heat, stirring constantly. The sauce will thicken a little.
2. Add 1 1/2 cups cheese, stirring often. Add macaroni with sauce. Top with remaining cheese, bread crumbs and a pinch of paprika.
3. Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour.
4. Makes 4 to 6 servings.
title: Baked Macaroni And Cheese

steps: 1. Cream together cream cheese and sugar.
2. Add fruit and just a little of the juice. Fold in Cool Whip and freeze in a 9 x 13-inch pan.
3. Serves 12.
title: Strawberry Freeze

steps: 1. Slice each tomato into 3 thick slices.
2. Pour evaporated milk in small bowl and place 1 cup flour and the bread crumbs in separate piles on waxed paper.
3. Dip tomatoes in flour, then milk, then crumbs, coating well.
4. Place in refrigerator to dry for about one hour.
5. Fry bacon in large skillet until crisp; remove and set aside.
6. In bacon drippings, saute tomato slices until brown.
7. Pour off all but two tablespoons of drippings.
8. Add remaining flour; cook and stir for two minutes more.
9. Season to taste.
10. To serve, place tomato slice on plate; pour sauce over and top with a bacon slice.
11. Yields 8 servings.
title: Fried Green Tomatoes

ingredients.text: 4 whole chicken breasts, split, skinned and boned

steps: 1. Mix together flour and seasonings.
2. Dredge chicken in mixture. Brown chicken in melted butter in skillet.
3. Transfer to a roasting pan.
4. Combine juice, soy sauce and sugar; mix well.
5. Pour over chicken.
6. Bake uncovered in 350° oven for 1 hour, basting every 15 minutes.
7. Makes 4 servings.
title: California Chicken

ingredients.text: 2 large peppers, red or green, seed and cut into 1/4-inch strips

steps: 1. Saute peppers in 1/2 the oil until they start to brown.
2. Add remaining oil, salt, sherry and wine vinegar; simmer 15 minutes. Chill.
3. Serves 2.
4. Nice with sandwiches.
title: Sauteed Peppers

steps: 1. If fish fillets are large, cut into 5 or 6 serving pieces. Arrange fish in ungreased square baking dish 8 x 8 x 2-inches. Sprinkle with salt and pepper.
2. Top with onions and tomato slices. Sprinkle with lime juice, oil and parsley.
3. Cover and cook in oven at 375° for 15 minutes.
4. Uncover and cook until fish flakes easily with fork, about 15 minutes longer.
5. Garnish with lime wedges, if desired.
6. Makes 5 or 6 servings.
title: Fish Fiesta

steps: 1. Dust beef with flour.
2. Thoroughly brown on all sides in hot oil, turning often.
3. Add salt, chili powder, pepper, thyme, bay leaf, tomatoes, green pepper, beef stock and water.
4. Cover and simmer over low heat until meat is almost tender, 1 1/2 to 2 hours, stirring occasionally to prevent foods from sticking.
5. Add potatoes, carrots, onions and celery.
6. Cover and cook 30 minutes. Add peas; cook until vegetables are done, about 15 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Chuckwagon Stew

steps: 1. Place carrots in a saucepan; cover with water.
2. Cook until tender, approximately 8 to 10 minutes.
3. Drain.
4. Combine butter, sugar, salt and cinnamon; pour over carrots and toss to coat. Serve immediately.
5. Yield: 4 to 6 servings.
title: Spiced Carrot Strips

steps: 1. Slice stem ends from peppers; scoop out seeds.
2. Blanch in boiling water (2 to 3 minutes).
3. Drain well.
4. Season insides of peppers with salt and pepper.
5. Combine ground beef and next 6 ingredients.
6. Stuff peppers with meat mixture; place in buttered 2-quart casserole.
7. Cover and bake in a 350° oven.
8. Top peppers with cheese and dollop of chili sauce.
9. Bake, uncovered, 5 minutes longer.
10. Makes 6 servings.
title: Easy Stuffed Peppers

ingredients.text: 1 lb. can crushed pineapple, well drained

steps: 1. Cream sugar and margarine.
2. Beat in the eggs.
3. Mix in pineapple; fold in bread.
4. Place in greased 1 1/2-quart casserole dish.
5. Bake 1 hour at 350°.
6. Serve hot or cold.
7. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Pineapple Casserole

ingredients.text: 20 medium shrimp, shelled and deveined (10 oz. with shells, 8 oz. cleaned)

steps: 1. Preheat broiler.
2. In small pan over low heat, melt margarine. Add garlic, salt and pepper.
3. Cook about 3 minutes until garlic is tender.
4. Stir in wine and parsley; cook about 2 minutes longer. Arrange shrimp on foil-lined broiler pan.
5. Pour margarine mixture evenly over shrimp.
6. Broil 3-inches from heat source, about 5 minutes until shrimp are pink.
7. Makes 4 servings.
title: Shrimp Scampi

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 400°.
2. Spray a cookie sheet with nonstick oil spray.
3. Arrange eggplant on cookie sheet and sprinkle Parmesan cheese over eggplant.
4. Layer one slice of tomato on each eggplant round.
5. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
6. Bake for 10 to 15 minutes. Makes 3 to 4 servings.
title: Eggplant Tomato Bake

ingredients.text: 1 lb. Italian sausage, cut in 1 1/2-inch pieces
4 medium potatoes, cut in bite size chunks
1 large onion, cut in bite size pieces

steps: 1. Heat oven to 425°.
2. Spray bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan with Pam. Put in sausage, onions and potatoes.
3. Bake for 20 minutes.
4. Add rest of ingredients and mix well.
5. Bake another 20 minutes. Serves 4.
title: Super Sausage Casserole

steps: 1. Place chicken in casserole dish.
2. Combine oil, lemon, oregano and garlic powder.
3. Brush on chicken.
4. Cover.
5. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.
6. Uncover; brush again with lemon mixture.
7. Continue for 20 minutes or until tender.
8. Sprinkle with parsley and paprika. Serves 2 to 4.
title: Lemon Baked Chicken

ingredients.text: 1 c. brown sugar or to taste

steps: 1. Wash, peel, core and quarter apples.
2. Place in large heavy skillet with a little water and cook apples until slightly tender. Add sugar and oleo and cook until right consistency, being careful not to burn.
3. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Granny'S Fried Apples

steps: 1. Combine squash, tomatoes and onion in greased casserole. Sprinkle with salt, pepper, basil and oregano.
2. Dot with butter. Bake in preheated 350° oven for 30 to 40 minutes or until squash is tender.
3. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Herbed Zucchini Casserole

steps: 1. Heat the cream.
2. Melt the chocolate.
3. Mix the chocolate with the cream.
4. Serve 3 scoops of vanilla ice-cream, with the chocolate sauce and whipped cream.
5. Enjoy!
title: Dame Blanche

steps: 1. Drain and flake salmon, discarding bone and skin.
2. Beat eggs. Grate onion.
3. Mix all ingredients.
4. Drop by teaspoons into hot fat; cook until golden brown.
5. Makes 4 to 6 servings.
title: Salmon Fritters

steps: 1. In 8-inch square dish place apples and 1/4 cup sugar.
2. With pastry blender mix flour, 1/3 cup sugar, oats, butter or margarine and cinnamon until crumbly.
3. Sprinkle over top of apples. Microwave on Auto Cook Code 2 or on 20% power for approximately 10 to 12 minutes.
4. Makes 6 to 8 servings.
title: Streuseled Apples(Microwave Recipe)

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 325°.
2. Lightly grease baking sheet.
3. Combine all ingredients except chicken and buttermilk in pie plate or shallow dish.
4. Dip chicken in buttermilk, then roll in dry mixture and place on baking sheet.
5. Bake until juices run clear when chicken is pricked with a fork, about 50 minutes.
6. Serves 4.
title: Oven-Fried Buttermilk Chicken

steps: 1. Remove skin and bones from the salmon, but do not drain. Mix salmon and liquid together with the remaining ingredients. Place in a greased casserole. Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes to 1 hour. 4 or 5 servings.
2. VARIATION: Shape salmon mixture into a loaf and cover with crescent roll dough before baking. Brush with egg yolk thinned in water. Serves 4 or 5.
title: Salmon Casserole

ingredients.text: 6 to 8 chicken breasts, boneless and skinned

steps: 1. Crisp
2. bacon in skillet.
3. Put washed chicken in shallow oven dish.
4. Wash
5. and dice leek.
6. Put leek and bacon on top of chicken; cover
7. dish.
8. Bake
9. in
10. oven until chicken is cooked (about an hour).
11. Bake
12. at
14. Add
15. half
16. and half in the final stages of cooking.
17. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Chicken Deluxe

ingredients.text: 3 or 4 chicken breasts, split and deboned

steps: 1. Cut up green onions and mix into softened cream cheese.
2. Put 1/8 of cream cheese mixture on each chicken breast half.
3. Roll up and wrap with slice of bacon to each half.
4. Bake at 350° to 375° until bacon is crisp.
5. Makes 6 to 8 servings.
title: San Francisco Chicken

ingredients.text: 2 lb. round steak, cut in 1-inch chunks

steps: 1. About 1 1/2 hours before serving, mix water and all other ingredients in large skillet.
2. Cover and let stand 30 minutes in refrigerator.
3. Cook mixture, covered over medium-low heat, about 50 minutes, or until steak is fork-tender.
4. Makes 6 servings.
title: Barbecued Beef

steps: 1. Saute onions with margarine in large skillet for 15 to 20 minutes over medium flame. Place half of onions in 13 x 19 x 2 inch baking dish. Top with half of crackers and half of parmesan cheese. Repeat with remaining ingredients. Bake, uncovered, in 325° gas oven for 30 minutes. Makes 8 to 10 servings.
title: Vidalia Onion Casserole

steps: 1. Cook noodles according to package directions, and set aside. Heat electric skillet to 350° and add ground chuck, onion and pepper.
2. Cook until meat is brown and vegetables are tender. Drain well.
3. Spread meat and vegetable mixture evenly in the skillet.
4. Place egg noodles in center.
5. Spoon tomato sauce and grated Cheddar cheese on top of mixture.
6. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Skillet Supper

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients and roll in powdered sugar.
2. Bake at 300° for 1 hour.
3. Serves 5.
title: Ladyfingers

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 325°.
2. Slit tenderloin lengthwise, but don't cut completely through.
3. Mix the next 6 ingredients together and fill tenderloin.
4. Tie with cord and wrap in aluminum foil.
5. Bake 1 hour.
6. Fold back foil and bake an additional 30 minutes or until meat is browned and tender.
7. Serves 4.
title: Stuffed Pork Tenderloin

steps: 1. Place chicken breasts in baking dish.
2. Melt margarine. Add other ingredients and stir until well blended.
3. Pour over chicken breasts and sprinkle each with paprika.
4. Cover with aluminum foil and bake at 350° for 1 hour. Serves 4.
title: Beth'S Tangy Chicken

steps: 1. Peel eggplant and cut into cubes.
2. Cook in boiling, salted water until tender (15 to 20 minutes).
3. Drain; mash with fork. Brown meat in 3 tablespoons margarine.
4. Add onion and pepper and cook until tender.
5. Stir in eggplant, rice, salt and pepper. Spoon into a 10 x 6 x 2-inch baking dish.
6. Saute bread crumbs in remaining 2 tablespoons margarine.
7. Sprinkle over eggplant mixture.
8. Bake at 375° for 20 minutes.
9. Makes 4 to 6 servings.
title: Baked Eggplant

ingredients.text: 2 c. fresh broccoli, cooked and chopped

steps: 1. Cube bread and place in melted butter; toss well.
2. In buttered 9 x 13-inch casserole, layer half of the bread cubes, half Cheddar cheese, half of the broccoli, all of the cubed ham, then layer remaining broccoli, cheese and bread.
3. Beat eggs and milk thoroughly with seasoning.
4. Pour over all layers.
5. Refrigerate overnight or at least several hours.
6. Bake at 350° for 1 hour, until puffy and nicely browned.
7. Serves 6.
title: Brunch Casserole

steps: 1. Cook onion until lightly browned in one tablespoon hot fat. Add ground beef and brown.
2. Mix with cooked rice, tomatoes and seasonings.
3. Turn into a 1 1/2-quart casserole, top with bacon and bake at 375° until bacon is crisp, about 30 minutes.
4. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Family Ground Beef Casserole

steps: 1. Melt butter.
2. Mix remaining ingredients.
3. Using "leg" part of wings, dip in butter, then cheese mixture.
4. Arrange in shallow pan or baking dish in foil.
5. Drizzle with remaining butter.
6. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.
7. May be prepared day before and reheated or freezes well.
8. Serves 20 to 25.
title: Baked Chicken Drummettes

steps: 1. Melt butter in casserole.
2. Add cubed bread and mix well.
3. Beat eggs until light.
4. Add flour, sugar, salt and pineapple to eggs. Mix.
5. Pour into casserole and mix with butter and bread.
6. Bake at 350° for 50 minutes or until like custard or when knife inserted in middle comes out clean.
7. Serves 8.
title: Baked Pineapple

steps: 1. Season pork chops with 1/2 teaspoon pepper.
2. Brown chops in hot oil in large skillet.
3. Add tomato juice and water.
4. Cover; simmer for 30 minutes.
5. Add cabbage, carrots, onions, potatoes and 1/4 teaspoon salt.
6. Cover; simmer for 35 minutes, or until vegetables are tender.
7. Yields 6 servings.
title: Pork Chop Skillet Dinner

steps: 1. Rub chicken with lemon juice.
2. Roll in flour, salt and pepper. Brown chicken in oleo.
3. Place in baking dish. Add remaining ingredients and cover with sour cream. Cover and cook in slow oven at 325° until tender, 1 1/2 to 2 1/2 hours.
4. Remove from oven. Sprinkle
5. with cheese. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Braised Chicken With Sour Cream

steps: 1. Cook onions and green peppers slowly in Crisco until mixture falls apart.
2. Add rice, tomatoes and seasonings.
3. Arrange in large casserole; cover and bake in moderate oven (375°) for 45 minutes or until done.
4. Serves 8.
title: Texas Hash

ingredients.text: 1 lb. bacon, cooked and crumbled or 1 lb. sausage, cooked, drained and crumbled

steps: 1. Combine croutons and cheese.
2. Place in greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish.
3. Combine eggs, milk, salt and pepper.
4. Mix until well blended.
5. Pour over crouton mixture.
6. Sprinkle crumbled bacon or sausage on top.
7. Bake at 325° for 1 hour.
8. Makes 8 to 12 servings.
title: Brunch Egg Casserole

steps: 1. Heat oven to 350°.
2. Mix all ingredients except walnuts.
3. Spoon into 2-quart casserole.
4. Sprinkle with walnuts.
5. Bake 40 minutes or until thoroughly heated.
6. Makes 6 servings.
title: Swiss 'N Chicken Casserole

steps: 1. Wash, trim and shred zucchini.
2. Mix zucchini in bowl with all the other ingredients, except Parmesan cheese and eggs.
3. Spoon the mixture into a greased baking dish.
4. Beat the 4 eggs and pour over zucchini.
5. Mix lightly with a fork.
6. Bake at 325° for 35 minutes or until the top is set.
7. Top with Parmesan cheese.
8. Makes 4 servings; 130 calories per serving.
title: Baked Zucchini Casserole

steps: 1. Peel bananas and cut them in half crosswise.
2. Insert a popsicle stick into each half.
3. Melt morsels in a saucepan over low heat or microwave in glass dish or measuring cup.
4. Heat on High power for 1 minute.
5. Morsels will keep their shape until stirred. Add milk to the chocolate and stir until smooth.
6. Dip each banana in melted chocolate and roll it in pecans.
7. Place on a plate covered with wax paper or plastic.
8. Freeze for about 3 hours. Serves 4.
title: Frozen Bananas(Microwave)

ingredients.text: 1 c. pitted dates, cut in halves lengthwise

steps: 1. In glass compote or serving dish, arrange alternate layers of orange slices, dates and coconut; chill.
2. Combine sour cream, sugar and 1 teaspoon orange peel; chill.
3. Serve over fruit, sprinkled with remaining orange peel.
4. Makes 6 to 8 servings.
title: Holiday Ambrosia

steps: 1. Brown meat in shortening in skillet. Drain fat.
2. Add remaining ingredients except buns.
3. Simmer for 15 to 20 minutes, adding more tomato juice, if necessary.
4. Spoon onto split hamburger buns. Yields 6 to 8 servings.
title: Sloppy Joes

ingredients.text: 6 large sweet potatoes, peeled and quartered

steps: 1. Place sweet potatoes in large saucepan.
2. Add sugar, lemon juice, water and lemons (cut in halves).
3. Stir to dissolve sugar. Pour over potatoes.
4. Let stand 15 minutes.
5. Cook over medium heat until potatoes are tender.
6. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Candied Yams

ingredients.text: 4 chicken breast halves, skinned and boned

steps: 1. Place each piece of chicken between 2 sheets of wax paper; flatten to 1/4-inch thickness using mallet or rolling pin.
2. Set aside.
3. Combine honey and mustard; spread on both sides of chicken, then dredge chicken in chopped pecans.
4. Arrange chicken in a lightly greased shallow baking dish.
5. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until tender.
6. Makes 4 servings.
title: Pecan Chicken

ingredients.text: 2 large apples, pared and sliced in eighths

steps: 1. Sift first 4 ingredients into mixing bowl.
2. Add egg, milk and shortening.
3. Beat until smooth.
4. Dip apples in batter and fry in deep hot shortening about 4 minutes or until brown.
5. Drain on paper towel.
6. Serve with maple syrup or a sprinkle of confectioners sugar.
7. Makes 6 servings.
title: Apple Fritters

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 c. green pepper, cut in 1-inch pieces

steps: 1. Cut beef into very thin strips and brown in hot oil.
2. Add garlic and cook until yellow.
3. Add soy sauce, salt and 1/3 cup water.
4. Cook on low heat for 45 minutes.
5. Add vegetables and cook 10 minutes.
6. Blend cornstarch with 1 cup cold water; add and stir into beef mixture.
7. Add tomatoes and cook 5 minutes.
8. Serve over hot, fluffy rice.
9. Serves 6.
10. Suitable for freezing.
title: Pepper Steak

ingredients.text: 3 c. soft bread crumbs (about 4 slices of bread)

steps: 1. Soak bread in milk.
2. Add eggs and beat.
3. Add meat, salt, pepper, onion, Worcestershire sauce and poultry seasoning.
4. Mix thoroughly.
5. Form into two loaves.
6. Place in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.
7. Bake,
8. uncovered, at 350° for 1 hour.
9. Top with catsup or chili sauce and cook 15 minutes longer.
10. Serves 8 to 10.
title: Twin Meat Loaves

steps: 1. In a large saucepan, combine sugar, cocoa and salt.
2. Stir in hot water and butter, bring to a boil.
3. Add the milk, maple flavoring, vanilla and 8 marshmallows.
4. Heat through, stirring occasionally, until marshmallows are melted.
5. Ladle into mugs and top each with a marshmallow.
6. Yields 4 servings.
title: Maple Hot Chocolate

steps: 1. In a large plastic bag, combine flour, 2 tablespoons Parmesan cheese, salt, dill weed and pepper.
2. Place pork chops in bag and shake to coat.
3. Shake off excess flour and reserve.
4. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat; brown pork chops on both sides. Reduce heat.
5. Place onion slices on chops.
6. Add water to skillet. Cover and simmer for 15 minutes.
7. Place zucchini slices over the onion.
8. Mix remaining Parmesan cheese with reserved flour mixture. Sprinkle over zucchini.
9. Sprinkle paprika on top.
10. Cover and simmer for 25 minutes or until pork chops are tender.
11. Serves 6.
title: Pork Chops And Zucchini

steps: 1. Peel and pit peaches.
2. In blender container, combine orange juice, milk powder, ice cubes and fruit.
3. Cover and blend until the mixture is smooth.
4. Pour into 2 glasses.
5. Garnish with additional peach slices and mint sprigs, if desired.
6. Makes 2 servings.
title: Orange-Peach Refresher

steps: 1. Spray crock pot with cooking spray.
2. Combine milk, egg, salt and pepper.
3. Mix with wire whisk.
4. Add cheese and macaroni, stirring gently to mix.
5. Cover and cook on low for 3 1/2 to 4 hours, or until custard is set and macaroni is tender.
6. Serves 8.
title: Crock- Pot Macaroni And Cheese

ingredients.text: 2 medium tomatoes, peeled and cut into wedges

steps: 1. Combine tomatoes, zucchini, yellow squash, seasonings and Cheddar cheese.
2. Place in a 1 1/2-quart casserole dish.
3. Top with Parmesan cheese and bread crumbs.
4. Bake at 350° for about 45 minutes or until vegetables are tender.
5. Sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese and let stand 5 minutes before serving.
6. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Cheesy Zucchini Bake

steps: 1. Cream sugar and butter.
2. Add egg and beat well.
3. Add apples and nuts.
4. Add remaining ingredients and mix well.
5. Bake in a greased 9 x 12-inch baking dish at 350° for 40 minutes.
6. Serves 9 to 14.
title: *Apple Torte

ingredients.text: 2 pt. fresh Brussels sprouts, halved or 2 (10 oz.) pkg. frozen Brussels sprouts, thawed
1 (8 oz.) water chestnuts, drained and diced

steps: 1. In a saucepan over medium heat, bring water, parsley, sugar and salt to a boil. Add Brussels sprouts. Cover and simmer for 6 to 8 minutes or until tender; drain. Add water chestnuts and butter; heat through. Yield: 6 servings.
title: Fancy Brussels Sprouts

steps: 1. Boil macaroni.
2. Place cooked macaroni, dots of margarine, cut up cheese, salt and pepper, in alternating layers in buttered 7 x 11 x 2-inch oblong baking dish.
3. Combine beaten eggs and milk and pour over the mixture.
4. Bake in 350° oven for 40 to 50 minutes. Makes 6 to 8 servings.
title: Macaroni And Cheese

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients.
2. Cover and refrigerate 4 to 6 hours. Stir occasionally.
3. Broil shrimp and marinate 4 to 5 inches from heat in preheated oven for 7 minutes.
4. Then shrimp and broil another 10 minutes.
5. Serve shrimp with the marinade.
6. Serves 4.
title: Shrimp Scampi

steps: 1. Heat oven to 350°.
2. Mix all ingredients, except walnuts.
3. Pour into casserole dish.
4. Sprinkle with walnuts.
5. Bake for 40 minutes at 350°.
6. Makes 6 servings.
title: Swiss Chicken Casserole

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients together.
2. Season with salt and pepper. Place in greased casserole.
3. Bake in a 350° oven for 45 minutes. Serves 6.
title: Green Onion Casserole

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°.
2. Cut fat from pork chops.
3. Place chops in an ungreased baking dish.
4. Mix the soy sauce, catsup and honey in a bowl; pour over the chops.
5. Cover baking dish with aluminum foil.
6. Bake for 45 minutes.
7. Uncover and bake 5 minutes more. Serves 4.
title: Yummy Pork Chops

steps: 1. In medium bowl, combine all ingredients; mix well.
2. Shape mixture into 4 patties.
3. Broil or grill patties 4 to 6 inches from heat 10 to 15 minutes or until browned on both sides and no longer pink in center.
4. Serves 4.
title: Savory Burgers

steps: 1. Melt butter in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish; set aside. Combine flour and next 5 ingredients.
2. Combine egg and buttermilk. Dip chicken in egg mixture, coating well.
3. Place chicken in baking dish, turning once to coat with butter.
4. Sprinkle with chopped pecans.
5. Bake chicken at 350° for 30 minutes.
6. Serves 8.
title: Buttermilk-Pecan Chicken

steps: 1. Cook green peppers in small amount of water, salted in saucepan until tender; drain.
2. Blend butter and flour in saucepan; stir in milk gradually.
3. Cook until thick, stirring constantly. Add cheese; stir until melted.
4. Add peppers.
5. Pour into baking dish; top with crumbs.
6. Bake at 350° until brown.
7. Yield:
8. 5 to 6 servings.
title: Green Pepper Casserole

steps: 1. Slice steak into narrow strips.
2. In skillet, brown steak in oil.
3. Combine with garlic, salt, pepper, soy sauce and sugar in crock-pot.
4. Cook on low 6 to 8 hours.
5. Turn control to high.
6. Add bean sprouts, tomatoes and green peppers.
7. Dissolve cornstarch in water and stir into pot.
8. Cover and cook on high 15 to 20 minutes. Serves 4.
title: Crock-Pot Pepper Steak

steps: 1. Combine chicken, stuffing mix, mayonnaise, chicken broth, onion and eggs in bowl; mix well.
2. Spoon into 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Top with bread crumbs.
3. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
4. Yield:
5. 6 servings.
title: Chicken Royal

steps: 1. Combine macaroni, hot water and evaporated milk in 2-quart casserole.
2. Microwave uncovered on High for 12 minutes or until macaroni is soft and most of liquid has evaporated, stirring twice.
3. Stir in 1 1/2 cups shredded Cheddar cheese.
4. Microwave on High for 1 minute or until cheese has melted.
5. Season to taste with minced fresh chives and herbs.
6. Serves 4.
title: Microwave Easy Macaroni And Cheese

steps: 1. Rinse, pat dry, trim and place mushrooms in center of sheet of heavy-duty foil.
2. Sprinkle with remaining ingredients.
3. Bring edges of foil up over mushroom mixture and crimp to seal.
4. Set in baking pan and bake in unpreheated 350° oven for 45 minutes or until mushrooms are cooked.
5. Makes 6 servings, about 24 calories each.
title: Mushrooms Baked In Foil

steps: 1. Brown floured meat in separate skillet.
2. In slow cooking pot, combine browned beef, bay leaf, Worcestershire, onion, bouillon, pepper, salt, sugar and vegetables.
3. Pour water all over.
4. Cover and cook on low 8 to 10 hours.
5. Turn control on high.
6. Thicken with leftover flour dissolved in small amount of water.
7. Cover and cook on high for 10 to 15 minutes.
8. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Crock-Pot Stew

steps: 1. Shell and devein the shrimp, leaving fantail on.
2. Combine all remaining ingredients.
3. Mix well.
4. Dip shrimp in mixture; place in shallow pan in single layer.
5. Pour remaining sauce over shrimp. Broil 6 to 8 minutes 3 inches from heat.
6. Makes 4 servings.
title: Shrimp Scampi

steps: 1. In a large skillet, cook beef and onion over medium heat until the meat is no longer pink; drain. Stir in the ketchup, relish and brown sugar; mix well. Cover and simmer for 30 minutes or until heated through. Spoon onto buns. Yields 8 servings.
title: Grandma'S Sloppy Joes

steps: 1. Mix chicken, celery, croutons, Miracle Whip, milk, onion and Swiss cheese.
2. Sprinkle almonds on top.
3. Bake in a 2-quart baking dish for 30 to 40 minutes at 350°.
4. Favorite dish at gatherings! Serves 6.
title: Alpine Chicken

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients together, except cheese, in a bowl.
2. Put in six 8-ounce casseroles; top with cheese.
3. Bake at 450° for 20 minutes, or until real hot.
4. Makes 6 servings.
title: Deep Dish Lobster

steps: 1. Combine bread crumbs with onion, seasoning and butter.
2. Line large casserole or 9 x 13-inch pan with crumb mixture.
3. Press in place; bake at 375° for 15 minutes.
4. Melt butter; blend in flour. Add milk, chicken broth and seasoning.
5. Cook until thickened, stirring constantly.
6. Add peas and chicken.
7. Serves 6.
title: Chicken In Crumb Basket

steps: 1. Heat oven to 400°.
2. Lightly grease a square baking dish, 8 x 8 x 2-inch or pie plate, 9 x 1 1/4-inch.
3. Sprinkle zucchini, tomato, onion and cheese evenly in pie plate.
4. Beat remaining ingredients together with mixer until smooth.
5. Pour evenly in dish.
6. Bake 30 to 35 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean.
7. Let stand 5 minutes before cutting.
8. Makes 6 servings.
title: Easy Garden Bake

steps: 1. Wash zucchini.
2. Cut lengthways into quarters.
3. Cook in microwave about 5 minutes.
4. (Cover with plastic wrap.)
5. Cut zucchini into bite size cubes and add to onion.
6. Stir together cheese, Accent, salt and pepper.
7. Add to vegetables and stir in beaten eggs.
8. Melt butter and add to bread crumbs; put on top of mixture.
9. Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes or until a knife, when inserted in the center, comes out clean.
10. Makes 4 to 6 servings.
title: Zucchini Casserole

steps: 1. Wash and slice zucchini, steam 5 to 6 minutes.
2. Drain and place in casserole dish.
3. Mix cottage cheese, Monterey Jack cheese, egg and dill weed.
4. Spread over zucchini and bake in 350° oven for 20 to 30 minutes until top is brown and crispy.
5. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Zucchini-Cheese Casserole

steps: 1. In shallow baking dish, combine all ingredients except shrimp. Microwave, uncovered, at High level for 4 to 5 minutes or until hot, stirring twice.
2. Stir shrimp into butter sauce.
3. Cover. Microwave at High for 5 to 7 1/2 minutes or until shrimp curl and turn pink.
4. Let stand, covered, 3 to 5 minutes before serving. Yield:
5. 4 servings.
title: Shrimp Scampi

steps: 1. Brown beef in 10-inch skillet.
2. Drain off fat.
3. Stir in water, rice, onion, bouillon cubes and dry mustard.
4. Bring to a boil; stir.
5. Reduce heat, cover and simmer 20 minutes.
6. Cut 4 slices of cheese into small pieces.
7. Stir cheese pieces, green pepper and tomato into cooked rice.
8. Cut remaining cheese slices into triangles.
9. Arrange on top.
10. Cover and remove from heat.
11. Let stand about 5 minutes.
12. Makes 6 servings.
title: Victory Garden Skillet Dinner

steps: 1. Soften cream cheese. Blend cream cheese in with mayonnaise and sugar, add fruits and nuts, fold in whipped cream.
2. Pour into a 8" x 2" x 2" loaf pan. Freeze firm (takes about 6 to 8 hours or overnight).
3. When ready to serve, let stand at room temperature about 15 minutes.
4. Turn out on lettuce; slice dessert into serving portions. Recipe makes 8 to 10 servings.
title: Cranberry Freeze

steps: 1. Melt 2 tablespoons butter over low heat.
2. Add the flour and stir until well blended.
3. Cook one minute.
4. Slowly add milk and cook, stirring constantly, until boiling.
5. Let sauce cool; add chopped chicken, egg yolk, salt and celery salt.
6. Form into twelve small cones.
7. Mix bread crumbs with ground sage.
8. Roll cones in crumbs.
9. Beat egg; add water.
10. Dip each cone in egg and roll again in crumbs.
11. Place on a greased baking pan and drizzle with melted butter.
12. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.
13. Yield:
14. 6 servings. Carbohydrate 11 g, protein 16 g, fat 16 g, calories 253.
title: Baked Turkey

steps: 1. Put hamburg in bottom of 2-quart casserole; layer the potatoes on top of hamburg.
2. Add carrots, onions and chopped peppers.
3. Put the tomatoes and seasonings in next.
4. Top with shredded cheese.
5. Bake 2 hours at 300°.
6. Serves 6.
title: Easy Hamburg Casserole

ingredients.text: 1 Chicken, 3 to 3 1/2 lbs., cut into 8 pieces

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°.
2. In small bowl stir together mint, lime zest, sugar, salt, garlic, turmeric, coriander, cardamom and red pepper flakes.
3. Prick chicken all over with fork.
4. Brush chicken with lime juice.
5. Rub mint mixture over all sides of chicken pieces.
6. Place pieces on rack set in roasting pan.
7. Roast until juices run clear when pierced with fork, about 1 hour.
8. Serve hot or let cool in pan on rack 30 minutes.
9. Wrap and refrigerate until ready to serve.
10. Serves 4.
title: Minty Spiced Chicken

ingredients.text: 4 whole chicken breasts, skinned, boned and halved

steps: 1. Melt butter in heavy skillet over medium heat.
2. Add onion and saute until very soft, 10 to 15 minutes.
3. Remove with slotted spoon.
4. Increase heat to medium-high.
5. Add chicken and cook until golden brown and juices run clear when pierced with tip of a knife.
6. Remove chicken.
7. Add vinegar and boil until reduced to 2/3, 1 to 2 minutes.
8. Add cream and boil until thickened, 3 to 4 minutes.
9. Return onion and
10. chicken to skillet and spoon sauce over.
11. Serve hot.
12. Serves 4.
title: Sauteed Chicken In Red Wine Vinegar

steps: 1. In a greased casserole, make a layer of each ingredient in the order listed.
2. Season each layer.
3. Bake for 2 hours at 350°. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Six-Layer Casserole

steps: 1. Cook macaroni according to package directions; drain and set aside. In a sauce pan add, melted butter, flour, salt and pepper. Stir until smooth then add milk slowly and cook mixture over medium heat. Cook until thick, stirring constantly. Add cheese and cook until melted. Mix the sauce and macaroni together. Pour into greased 8 inch baking dish. Bake 30 minutes at 350°. Makes 4 to 6 servings.
title: Baked Cheddar Macaroni

steps: 1. Wash chicken and pat dry.
2. Dip each piece in butter; roll in crumbs.
3. Place skin side up in casserole.
4. Sprinkle with salt and pepper.
5. Pour remaining butter around chicken.
6. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 50 minutes.
7. Serves 6.
title: Oven Baked Chicken

steps: 1. Brown hamburger; drain.
2. Cook celery and onion until slightly done.
3. Combine other ingredients and simmer until done.
4. Makes about 30 servings.
title: Sloppy Joes

steps: 1. Slice each zucchini lengthwise into 1/4-inch slices, taking care not to cut through the stem ends.
2. Place zucchini fans in a lightly greased shallow pan.
3. Combine remaining ingredients, stirring well.
4. Brush butter mixture over sliced zucchini.
5. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes or until tender, basting occasionally.
6. Makes 6 servings.
title: Baked Zucchini Fans

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 425°.
2. Spray shallow baking pan with Pam. Combine oats, milk, egg, onions, 1 1/2 teaspoons seasoned salt, basil and pepper.
3. Mix.
4. Add hamburger.
5. Mix.
6. Shape into pan. Bake 15 minutes.
7. Drain grease.
8. Arrange cheese on top of meat. Arrange Tater Tots on top cheese.
9. Sprinkle with remaining seasoned salt.
10. Bake 15 more minutes or until done.
11. Serve in squares.
12. Serves 4.
title: Tater Tot Beef Bake

steps: 1. Arrange 4 bread slices in the bottom of a large greased baking dish.
2. Cover with a slice of cheese.
3. Beat the eggs until they are frothy.
4. Add the milk, salt, pepper and dry mustard, mixing them well.
5. Pour over the sandwiches.
6. Heat the oven to 350°.
7. Place the baking dish in the refrigerator and let it stand until the milk mixture is absorbed by the bread.
8. Bake for 30 minutes.
9. The sandwiches will be puffed and lightly brown when done.
10. Serves 4.
title: Hannah'S Cheese Puffs

ingredients.text: 7 c. corn flakes, crushed to 1 3/4 c.

steps: 1. Measure corn flakes into shallow dish or pan.
2. Set aside.
3. In a small bowl, beat egg and milk slightly.
4. Add flour, salt and pepper.
5. Mix until smooth.
6. Dip chicken in batter.
7. Coat with crushed cereal.
8. Place in pan, in single layer, skin side up, in greased or foil-lined baking pan.
9. Drizzle with melted margarine. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
10. Do not cover pan or turn chicken while baking.
11. Makes 6 servings.
title: Double Crispy Chicken

steps: 1. Combine meat, oatmeal, milk, onion flakes, salt and pepper. Mix well; shape into 8 large meat balls and place in 2-quart casserole.
2. Combine catsup, vinegar, water and sugar; pour over meat balls.
3. Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.
4. Makes 8 servings. Double recipe if you'd like and bake in 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
title: Meat Ball Casserole

steps: 1. Heat oven
3. Grease 2-quart round casserole.
4. Mix all ingredients.
5. Pour into casserole and bake 1 hour or until knife inserted in center comes out clean.
6. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.
7. Makes 6 to 8 servings.
title: Zucchini Bake

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients.
2. Marinate steak for 6 hours or overnight. Broil 4 to 5 inches from heat.
3. Broil, brushing with marinade. Turn occasionally.
4. Carve in thin slices diagonally across grain of meat.
5. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Marinated Steak

steps: 1. Prepare a 9-inch cake pan by placing parchment paper in the bottom (cut to fit) and then buttering and flouring pan.
2. In a saucepan, gently heat eggs with sugar until lukewarm (be very careful not to overheat as eggs will "scramble").

3. In a separate saucepan, melt bittersweet chocolate with unsalted butter. Combine egg mixture with butter by first folding 1/4 of the egg into the chocolate, then folding the additional chocolate into the egg mixture.
4. Add flour until just combined.
5. Pour into pan. Bake at 425° for 15 minutes.
6. Refrigerate overnight or freeze for two hours.
7. Remove from refrigerator or freezer about 15 minutes before serving.
8. Serve in small wedges with raspberry sauce (pureed raspberries either plain or with lemon and a bit of sugar) and a dollop of unsweetened whipped cream.
9. Serves 8 to 10 polite people or 6 chocoholics.
title: Chocolate Decadence

steps: 1. Tear bread into chunks.
2. Place half of the pieces in bottom of a buttered 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
3. Layer cheese and ham over bread.
4. Place rest of bread over cheese and ham.
5. Combine eggs, milk, onion, salt and mustard.
6. Stir well.
7. Pour over bread, ham and cheese.
8. Cover and refrigerate at least 6 hours or overnight. Preheat oven to 325°.
9. Bake 55 minutes.
10. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.
11. Yields 10 to 12 servings.
title: Cheese-Ham Strata

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 c. (6 oz.) shredded sharp Cheddar cheese, divided
1 1/2 c. (4 oz.) rotini, cooked and drained

steps: 1. Heat oven to 350°.
2. Mix all ingredients, except 1/2 cup cheese and croutons.
3. Spoon into a 1 1/2-quart casserole.
4. Sprinkle with remaining cheese and croutons.
5. Bake for 30 minutes, or until thoroughly heated.
6. Makes 4 to 6 servings.
title: Cheesy Ham Casserole

steps: 1. Saute onion, green pepper and mushrooms.
2. Place sliced potatoes in bottom of a 2 1/2-quart nonstick baking dish. Alternate layers of carrot, rice, onion mixture and zucchini. Stir seasonings into mashed tomatoes and pour over vegetables.
3. Cover and bake at 350° for 2 hours.
4. Serves 8.
5. Contains 97 calories per serving and 1 gram fat.
title: Luscious Layers

steps: 1. Peel and slice cucumbers to about 1/4-inch thick.
2. Beat together the eggs, salt and pepper.
3. Dip the cucumber in the egg mixture then in the bread crumbs.
4. Fry a few slices at a time in the butter in a large skillet until light brown.
5. Drain well and serve while still hot.
6. Yields 6 servings.
title: Fried Cucumbers

steps: 1. Mix egg with milk.
2. Wash and dry catfish fillets.
3. Combine first 5 ingredients.
4. Dip fillets in egg mixture, then in dry mixture.
5. Arrange in a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Drizzle with melted butter, then sprinkle with almonds.
6. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes or until fish flakes.
7. Serves 6.
title: Catfish Parmesan

ingredients.text: 1 large yellow onion, diced or grated

steps: 1. Mix milk, eggs, salt, pepper and butter.
2. Then mix remaining ingredients except for a small amount of cheese.
3. Pour into 9 1/2 x 11-inch baking pan.
4. Sprinkle Cheddar cheese on top and bake for 45 minutes at 375°.
5. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Zucchini Casserole

steps: 1. Trim fat from meat; cut into serving size pieces.
2. Heat oil in a large skillet.
3. Add steak; brown on both sides.
4. Transfer steak to a 2-quart shallow baking dish.
5. Combine ingredients, stirring well.
6. Pour over steak.
7. Cover and bake at 325° for 1 1/2 hours, or until tender.
8. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Saucy Oven Barbecue Steak

steps: 1. Mix garlic, parsley and mustard into a paste.
2. Place both tenderloins together and cover with the paste.
3. Wrap tenderloins with bacon strips and secure with toothpicks, if necessary.
4. Bake at 420° for 40 minutes or until meat thermometer registers 170°. Deglaze pan with wine and broth and use as a sauce.
5. Slice and serve.
6. Serves 4.
title: Pork Tenderloin

steps: 1. Pound chicken to 1/4 inch thickness.
2. In a shallow bowl, combine bread crumbs and seasonings.
3. Dip chicken in egg, then in the crumb mixture.
4. In a skillet, brown the chicken in oil and butter over medium heat for 3-5 minutes on each side or until juices run clear.
5. Yield:
6. 4 servings.
title: Picnic Chicken

steps: 1. Blend eggs, milk and salt.
2. Stir in carrots and onion.
3. Pour into 5 cup ring mold.
4. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes or until knife inserted comes out clean.
5. Unmold; fill with peas and top with butter.
6. May garnish with parsley.
7. Serves 8.
title: Carrot Ring With Peas

steps: 1. Combine last 6 ingredients.
2. Add chicken breasts.
3. Refrigerate 8 to 12 hours.
4. Grill over hot coals.
5. Serves 12.
title: Marinated Chicken Breasts

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 375°. Cut peppers in half lengthwise. Remove stems, rubs and seeds. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat, swirling to cover bottom. Saut crookneck squash, zucchini, onion and garlic until zucchini is tender-crisp (about 4 minutes). Don't overcook. In a medium bowl, combine rice and cheese. Gently stir into skillet. Stuff pepper halves with vegetable mixture. Place in a 9-inch casserole dish. Carefully pour tomato sauce around peppers. Bake, uncovered, for 30 minutes. Serves 8.
title: Stuffed Bell Peppers

ingredients.text: 3 medium carrots, scraped and cut into 1/4 inch pieces
2 medium size green peppers, cut into 1/2 inch pieces
2 medium size yellow squash, cut into 1/4 inch slices
2 medium zucchini, cut into 1/4 inch slices

steps: 1. Combine water, butter, salt, pepper and garlic powder in a Dutch oven; bring to a boil. Add carrots; cover, reduce heat, and simmer 5 minutes. Add green pepper, onion, yellow squash and zucchini; cover and simmer 10 minutes. Stir in mushrooms; cover and simmer 3 to 4 minutes; drain. Place vegetables in a lightly greased 13 x 9 x 2 inch baking dish; sprinkle with cheese. Broil just until cheese melts. Yields 8 servings.
title: Fresh Vegetable Medley

steps: 1. Place 3 dozen drained oysters in shallow Pyrex dish.
2. (A Pyrex pie plate will do.)
3. Sprinkle with parsley and green onions and sprinkle cracker crumbs on top.
4. Melt 1 stick of butter.
5. Add juice of 1 lemon, mustard and Worcestershire sauce and pour over the crumbs.
6. This may be served in ramekins.
7. Bake in 450° oven until oysters curl and crumbs are brown, about 10 to 15 minutes. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Oyster Casserole

steps: 1. Cook pasta according to package directions, omitting salt in cooking water.
2. Drain and return to pan.
3. In a small bowl, combine butter, lemon juice, basil, garlic salt and pepper.
4. Toss with cooked pasta.
5. Sprinkle with cheese and serve.
6. Makes 4 servings.
title: Lemon Basil Pasta

steps: 1. Cut bacon into
2. pieces and cook.
3. Drain.
4. To 2 tablespoons of fat, add onions, mushrooms, cooked bacon pieces, salt and pepper and saute.
5. Add Worcestershire sauce and stir to mix.
6. Cover and keep warm until serving.
7. Serves 6.
title: Mushroom Supreme

steps: 1. Peel eggplant and cut into 1-inch cubes.
2. Saute eggplant and onion in butter or margarine in large frying pan for 10 minutes or until barely tender.
3. Stir in tomatoes, salt, oregano and pepper; cover.
4. Cook slowly over medium heat for 10 minutes or until vegetables are tender.
5. Remove from heat.
6. Stir in sour cream and parsley.
7. Yields 6 servings.
title: Skillet Eggplant

steps: 1. Brown meat.
2. Drain.
3. Put back into pot and remaining ingredients and slow cook for 2 hours.
4. Serve with bread or over pasta.
5. Serves 6.
title: Texas Chili

steps: 1. Reserve 4 whole strawberries; quarter remaining strawberries. Mix sugar with strawberries; let stand for 10 minutes.
2. Fold sugar mixture, marshmallows and coconut into sour cream.
3. Chill for 1 hour or longer.
4. Pile lightly into sherbet glasses.
5. Garnish with reserved whole strawberries.
6. Yield:
7. 4 servings.
title: Strawberry And Sour Cream Ambrosia

steps: 1. Wash greens thoroughly.
2. Drain.
3. Tear into bite size pieces. Combine greens, bacon and water in a Dutch oven and bring to a boil. Cover, reduce heat and simmer 30 minutes.
4. Add vinegar, pepper flakes, salt and
5. pepper. Cover and cook an additional hour.
6. Remove bacon slices before serving.
7. Yields 6 servings.
title: Turnip Greens

steps: 1. Cut cheese and butter into small cubes.
2. Combine with all ingredients and bake in a greased 2-quart baking dish at 350° approximately 1 hour.
3. Let set about 5 minutes and cut into squares.
4. Can be cooked ahead of time for 40 minutes, then reheated for 20 minutes.
5. Serves 8.
title: Cheese Casserole

steps: 1. Thinly slice all vegetables.
2. Heat oil in large skillet.
3. Add potatoes and saute for 5 minutes.
4. Add onion, squash, salt and pepper.
5. Cover and simmer until vegetables are tender.
6. Serves 8.
title: Vegetable Delight

ingredients.text: 1 lb. boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut into 1 1/2-inch pieces

steps: 1. In large skillet, melt 1 tablespoon margarine over medium-high heat.
2. Add bread crumbs.
3. Stir until lightly browned.
4. Transfer to medium bowl; combine with Parmesan cheese and parsley.
5. In same skillet, melt remaining 2 tablespoons margarine over medium-high heat.
6. Add garlic, mustard and chicken.
7. Saute 5 to 10 minutes or until chicken is cooked through.
8. Remove chicken with slotted spoon; toss with bread crumb mixture.
9. Serve warm.
10. Makes 6 servings.
title: Chicken Tidbits Parmesan(A Heart Healthy Recipe)

steps: 1. In large plastic bag, combine first five ingredients; mix well. Add roast, turning to coat on all sides. Cover and refrigerate 3 to 4 days (turning several times a day). Remove meat, discard marinade. Place with fat side down on a rack in shallow roasting pan. Bake uncovered at 325° 2 to 2 1/2 hours. Cover and let stand 15 minutes before carving. Yield: 8 to 10 servings.
title: Festive Pork Roast

steps: 1. Mix dry mustard, salt and pepper with flour and pound into steak.
2. Melt shortening on medium heat and brown on both sides. Place in a baking dish.
3. Combine onions, tomatoes, sauce and brown sugar.
4. Pour over steak and bake in 325° oven for 1 1/2 hours or until tender.
5. Serves 6 to 8
title: Swiss Steak

steps: 1. Sift dry ingredients together.
2. Cut in shortening and mix until mealy.
3. Add egg; mix well.
4. Add milk, 1 tablespoon at a time, until a soft ball of dough forms.
5. Roll dough on floured board 1/8-inch thick and cut into 1-inch wide strips.
6. Drop into boiling beef or chicken stock and cook 15 to 20 minutes.
7. Yield: 6 servings.
8. These will enhance any good homemade soup.
title: Noodle Dumps

steps: 1. Saute beef, onion, green pepper and garlic until meat loses its color.
2. Add salt and tomato sauce; cook over low heat 15 to 20 minutes, until thickened.
3. Spread 1/2 green tomato slices on greased casserole dish.
4. Top with 1/2 of the cheese, then 1/2 ground beef mixture.
5. Repeat layers.
6. Bake 30 minutes in 350° oven.
7. Serves 6.
title: Green Tomato Casserole

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients except cheese.
2. Put in greased casserole dish, putting cheese on top.
3. Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.
4. Serves 8.
5. This can be made and refrigerated overnight to be baked the next day.
title: Chicken Supreme

ingredients.text: 1 medium size can tomatoes (14 or 15 oz.)

steps: 1. Combine all the ingredients except the eggplant, olive oil and 1/2 cup of the cheese.
2. Wash eggplants; cut off top green stem and slice carefully lengthwise (approximately 6 to 7 slices) to form a fan, do not completely cut through to the base.
3. Line a pan with foil; place eggplant in the pan.
4. Take a portion of the filling and place between the layers.
5. Coat heavy with olive oil.
6. Cover pan with foil.
7. Bake 45 minutes at 350°.
8. After 45 minutes check for tenderness and if eggplant is tender, uncover and sprinkle with half cup cheese and bake another 10 to 15 minutes.
9. Transfer to serving plate with large spatula.
10. Serves 2 to 4.
title: Stuffed Eggplant

steps: 1. In a bowl, combine pork, ham, crumbs, eggs and milk.
2. Shape into 12 ovals, using 1 cup of mixture for each.
3. Place in an ungreased 15 x 10 x 1-inch baking pan.
4. Combine brown sugar, water, vinegar and mustard; pour over loaves.
5. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes, basting every 15 to 20 minutes. Place the loaves on a platter and spoon some of the sauce over them.
6. Yield:
7. 12 servings.
title: Ham Loaves

steps: 1. Saute over low heat in heavy skillet the macaroni, chopped onion and vegetable oil.
2. Stir until macaroni turns slightly yellow and add the tomato juice, salt and Worcestershire sauce. Bring to low boil.
3. Cover; reduce heat to lowest setting and cook for 15 minutes.
4. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Fried Macaroni

steps: 1. Beat egg whites until frothy; add cream of tartar and beat until stiff.
2. Beat in vanilla flavoring.
3. Crush soda crackers lightly with rolling pin.
4. They should not be too fine.
5. Mix well with sugar.
6. Fold in egg whites.
7. Add nuts; pour into 9-inch pie pan.
8. Bake 30 minutes in slow oven (325°).
9. Cut into pie wedge. Serve with whipped cream or ice cream.
10. Serves 6.
title: Crunch Torte

steps: 1. Cook onions in salted water until tender.
2. Spread drained onions in a shallow baking dish.
3. Place fish on onions.
4. Combine remaining ingredients.
5. Spread over fish.
6. Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 350°.
7. Serves 6.
title: Diet Ocean Perch

steps: 1. Place all ingredients in a blender.
2. Blend until frothy. Makes 4 servings.
title: Orange Julius

ingredients.text: 4 boneless chicken breast halves (about 4 oz. each)

steps: 1. Remove any skin and fat from chicken. Place chicken on broiler pan and sprinkle with lemon juice and cheese. Dust lightly with paprika. Broil 10 minutes or until just cooked through. Makes 4 servings.
title: Broiled Chicken Parmesan

ingredients.text: 1 tsp. oregano, cumin, sage and pepper

steps: 1. Heat oil in heavy frying pan or Dutch oven; cook onion and garlic slowly to golden brown.
2. Add ground beef and brown.
3. Add 3 cups water, vegetables and spices and bring to a boil.
4. Mix flour in one cup of water and slowly stir into mixture to thicken. Lower heat and simmer, uncovered, 1 hour.
5. Stir in ketchup and serve.
6. Serves 4.
title: Hamburger Stew

steps: 1. Lay pork chops in pan after seasoning with salt, pepper and garlic powder.
2. Put ketchup evenly on each pork chop and then pour Coke into pan.
3. Cover pan with tinfoil.
4. Put in oven at 350° and bake for 30 minutes.
5. Serve over rice.
6. Makes 4 servings.
title: Alvin'S Barbecue Pork Chops

steps: 1. Place fish in shallow baking dish and cover with milk. Refrigerate 1 hour.
2. Drain and pat dry.
3. Combine egg white and lemon juice in a separate shallow dish and set aside.
4. Combine oat bran, paprika and black pepper.
5. Dip fillets in egg mixture then oat mixture.
6. Saut in oil in nonstick skillet 3 minutes on each side or until evenly browned.
7. Serves 4.
title: Pan Toasted Fish

ingredients.text: 8 oz. processed cheese, shredded or cut in small pieces

steps: 1. Cook macaroni as directed on package; drain in colander. Return macaroni to cooking pan.
2. Add cheese, milk and butter. Stir until cheese melts.
3. If necessary, place over low heat a few minutes to help the melting.
4. Ready to serve.
5. Serves 4.
title: Breezy Cheesy Macaroni

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients in 9 x 12-inch baking dish.
2. Stir and let sit in refrigerator overnight.
3. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes. Serves 8 generously.
title: Ned'S Christmas Egg Casserole

steps: 1. Hard-cook eggs; peel, slice and set aside.
2. Fry bacon until crisp.
3. Drain, crumble and set aside.
4. Melt margarine; add flour, milk and half and half to make cream sauce.
5. Add basil, thyme, marjoram and cheese.
6. Cook until cheese melts.
7. Grease 9 x 6-inch baking dish.
8. Layer half the eggs, half the bacon and half the cheese; repeat.
9. Melt remaining margarine.
10. Add bread crumbs and sprinkle over top of casserole.
11. Let set 8 hours or overnight. Bake in 350° oven until brown on top, about 30 minutes.
12. Serves 6.
title: Egg Casserole(Brunch)

steps: 1. Wash mushrooms lightly.
2. Put in shallow casserole.
3. Add marjoram, salt and chives to butter.
4. Pour over mushrooms.
5. Mix chicken broth and cream.
6. Pour into casserole.
7. Cover and bake 20 minutes at 375°.
8. Remove cover last 5 minutes.
9. Serves 4.
title: Mushroom Herb Casserole

steps: 1. Cook ground beef, onion and green pepper in skillet until meat is lightly browned.
2. Pour off excess fat.
3. Add catsup, water, mustard, salt and pepper.
4. Simmer for 5 minutes.
5. Makes 4 servings.
title: Sloppy Joes

ingredients.text: 3/4 lb. cooked ham, cut in cubes

steps: 1. Melt butter in pan.
2. Add flour; stir until smooth.
3. Add hot milk, stirring constantly.
4. Cook over medium heat until thick. Add salt and pepper.
5. Pour cream sauce over macaroni.
6. Put alternate layers of creamed macaroni, ham and cheese in greased double boiler insert; sprinkle cheese on top.
7. Place one quart boiling water in bottom of Dutch oven; adjust rack and place pan on rack.
8. Cover; steam 15 minutes.
9. Serves 3.
title: Baked Macaroni, Ham And Cheese

steps: 1. Boil celery in water for 10 minutes, or until just tender-crisp; drain.
2. Melt butter.
3. Add chopped onion and green pepper; saute for about 5 minutes.
4. Stir in tomatoes and salt, then add celery.
5. Simmer for 15 minutes longer.
6. Serves 4.
title: Stewed Celery

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients well.
2. Roll ground beef into patties and roll in flour.
3. Put patties in casserole and pour 1 to 2 cans of mushroom soup over patties. Cover and bake for 45 minutes in a 350° oven. Serves 6.
title: Salisbury Steak

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients together, except crabmeat.
2. Remove 1/4 of your mixture and add crabmeat to remainder of mixture.
3. Blend lightly.
4. Divide this crab mixture into four 8-ounce casseroles; top with remaining mixture.
5. Bake in a 350° oven until lightly browned and thoroughly heated, 25 minutes, or until bubbly.
6. Makes 4 servings.
title: Crab Imperial

steps: 1. Place bread slices in greased casserole.
2. Cook sausage until slightly brown; drain.
3. Spoon sausage over bread.
4. Sprinkle with cheese.
5. Mix eggs and half and half.
6. Pour over cheese.
7. Chill overnight.
8. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes (until set).
9. Makes 6 to 8 servings.
title: Sausage Casserole

steps: 1. Place apples in shallow, greased baking dish.
2. Sprinkle with cinnamon, nutmeg and granulated sugar.
3. Add water.
4. Combine brown sugar and flour.
5. Cut in butter very fine.
6. Spread over apples. Bake at 400° for 20 minutes.
7. Reduce heat to 350° and bake for 25 minutes.
8. Cut in squares for serving.
9. Makes 8 servings.
title: Apple Crunch

steps: 1. Process cereal and walnuts until crumbs are fine.
2. Combine butter, a dash of garlic powder, salt and pepper; stir well. Dredge chicken in butter mixture, then in cereal mixture.
3. Arrange chicken in jelly roll pan.
4. Pour any remaining butter over chicken.
5. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
6. Serves 6.
title: Crispy Walnut Chicken

steps: 1. Cut crusts from bread; place in buttered 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
2. Place slices of cheese on top of each slice of bread.
3. Mix eggs, milk, dry mustard and salt in medium bowl.
4. Pour this mixture over cheese and bread.
5. Melt 1/4 cup oleo and drizzle over mixture.
6. Cover with foil overnight.
7. Bake 1 hour at 350° until light brown.
8. Let set 5 minutes before serving.
9. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Cheese Strata

ingredients.text: 1/4 c. slivered almonds, toasted in the oven

steps: 1. Cook onion in butter until tender (not brown).
2. Add noodles, broth, lemon peel, Accent and salt and bring to a boil.
3. Cover and cook over low heat until noodles are done.
4. Stir in sherry, sour cream and chicken and heat through.
5. Sprinkle with almonds and parsley.
6. Serve immediately.
7. Serves 6.
title: The Best Chicken Casserole

steps: 1. Break eggs into the center of 2 cups of flour.
2. Add water; with wire whisk beat until very smooth.
3. Add approximately 2 more cups of flour and work with your hands into a soft dough.
4. If the dough seems sticky, add more flour.
5. Turn dough onto a kneading surface and knead for at least 10 minutes.
6. Put the dough back into the bowl; cover and let rest for 30 minutes.
7. Roll the dough into desired thickness and shapes to make lasagna, fettuccine, etc., or use a pasta machine.
8. Serves 2.
title: Egg Pasta Dough

steps: 1. Place rinsed and dried chicken on a baking pan, skin side up. Sprinkle half the garlic, salt and soy on the chicken.
2. Turn and sprinkle bone side with remaining ingredients.
3. Grill 20 minutes, bone side down, 20 minutes skin side down and another 15 minutes bone side down over low heat.
4. Serves 6.
title: The Major'S Chicken

ingredients.text: 4 c. cooked beets, sliced or diced

steps: 1. Combine sugar and cornstarch.
2. Add vinegar and water; boil for 5 minutes.
3. Add beets and simmer 1/2 hour.
4. Add butter and season with salt and pepper.
5. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Harvard Beets

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients in order and mix.
2. Pour into paper baking cups and freeze.
3. Serve on lettuce.
4. Garnish with additional marschino cherries, nuts, lemon twists, mint leaves or orange slices.
5. Serves 12.
title: Banana-Sour Cream Jubilee

ingredients.text: 1 lb. catfish fillets (or substitute other fish)

steps: 1. Beat milk and egg in one bowl, combine cornmeal and seasonings in another shallow bowl.
2. Dip each fillet into egg and then into cornmeal, coating thoroughly.
3. Place in single layer in baking dish coated with oil.
4. Dot fillets with oleo.
5. Bake at 500° about 12 minutes, or until flaky.
6. Serves 4.
title: Oven-Fried Catfish(Tenn. River)

steps: 1. Mix juices together and chill. Serves 6.
title: Apple Wood Julep

ingredients.text: 1 fresh beef brisket (3 to 4 lb.), trimmed and cut in half*

steps: 1. Place the brisket in a 3-quart slow cooker. In a bowl, combine the remaining ingredients. Pour over brisket. Cover and cook on low for 6 hours or until tender. Remove the beef; set aside. Pour the sauce into a saucepan; cook, uncovered, over low heat for 13 to 15 minutes or until reduced and thickened, stirring occasionally. Slice the meat across the grain; serve with sauce. Yield: 6 to 8 servings.
title: Tender Beef Brisket

steps: 1. Trim fat from pork chops.
2. Brown in oil.
3. Sprinkle with salt and pepper.
4. Add orange juice, sugar, cinnamon and cloves.
5. Cover and simmer 45 minutes.
6. Add cornstarch dissolved in a little orange juice.
7. Heat until bubbling and clear.
8. Serves 4.
title: Orange Pork Chops

steps: 1. Cut off tips of wings and discard.
2. Divide each wing in half by cutting through joint with a sharp knife.
3. Place in a single layer
4. on
5. broiler pan rack.
6. Bake in hot oven (400°), turning once, 30 minutes.
7. Mix sugar, cornstarch, salt, ginger and pepper in a small saucepan; stir in water, lemon juice and soy
8. sauce. Cook,
9. stirring constantly until mixture thickens and boils 3 minutes.
10. Brush part over chicken wings.
11. Continue baking, turning and
12. brushing
13. several
14. times
15. with
16. remaining lemon mixture, 40 minutes
17. or until richly glazed.
18. When ready to serve, place in a chafing
19. dish or keep hot server.
20. Makes 12 servings.
title: Finger Drumsticks

steps: 1. Heat olive oil in skillet.
2. Add zucchini and saute over high heat for 3 minutes.
3. Stir in basil and remaining ingredients. Cook 1 minute, stirring constantly.
4. Makes 2 servings.
title: Sauteed Zucchini

steps: 1. Cut tomatoes in half crosswise and brush with melted butter or margarine.
2. Sprinkle with salt, pepper and Parmesan cheese.
3. Broil 6 inches from heat 5 to 7 minutes or until golden brown.
4. Serves 6.
title: Parmesan Broiled Tomatoes

steps: 1. Brown sausage; drain fat.
2. Cool completely.
3. Add garlic salt, mixing well.
4. Stir in cheese, Bisquick and water.
5. Roll into 1-inch balls; place on large cookie sheets, 2 inches apart.
6. Bake at 400° for 12 to 15 minutes.
7. This recipe serves 50 people and makes a great appetizer.
title: Hot Sausage Balls

ingredients.text: 2 cups macaroni cooked and drained, 7 oz.

steps: 1. Saute vegetables in butter.
2. Bake at 350 degrees.
3. Reduce heat to low.
4. Add cheese and milk, stir until cheese is melted.
5. Stir in macaroni.
6. Pour into 2 quart casserole dish.
7. Bake at 350 degrees for 15 minutes.
8. Serves 6.
title: Mac & Cheese

steps: 1. In a large skillet, cook beef, green pepper and onion, stirring to break up meat into small pieces.
2. When meat is brown and vegetables are tender, pour off excess drippings.
3. Mix vinegar, mustard, ketchup, sugar, Worcestershire and pepper; add to beef mixture.
4. Cook over low heat for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
5. Spoon onto hamburger buns.
6. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Hamburger Barbecue Sandwiches

ingredients.text: 1 pt. strawberries, hulled and halved (about 2 c.)

steps: 1. In an electric blender or food processor, blend the strawberries, pineapple and corn syrup together until pureed, about 1 minute.
2. Pour into 4 (5 ounce) paper cups.
3. Freeze until partly set.
4. Into each cup, insert 2 flat popsicle sticks, placing each on opposite sides halfway between center and edge.
5. Freeze until firm. Peel off paper and cut each pop in half between sticks.
6. Makes 8 servings.
title: Fruit Ice Pops

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°.
2. Make patty of ground beef.
3. Peel and slice vegetables.
4. Place on aluminum foil.
5. Bring corners up and twist to cover.
6. Place in oven on a baking pan and bake 45 minutes to 1 hour or until done.
7. Serves 1.
title: Hobo Pack

steps: 1. Wash turkey and pat dry.
2. If desired, rub cavity lightly with salt. Fasten neck skin to back and skewer.
3. Fold wings across back with tips touching.
4. Tuck drumsticks under band of skin at tail or tie together with heavy string, then tie to tail.
5. Place turkey breast side up on rack in open shallow roasting pan.
6. Brush with vegetable oil.
7. Insert meat thermome- ter so tip is in thickest part of inside thigh muscle or thickest part of breast meat and does not touch bone. Roast uncovered in 325 degrees oven for 3 hours.
8. Pare pineapple; cut lengthwise into halves.
9. Remove core; cut each half crosswise int o 8 slices.
10. Mix wine, honey, soy, ginger, paprika and garlic. Arrange pineapple on rack around turkey.

11. Brush turkey and pineapple with wine mixture. Continue roasting uncovered, brushing turkey and pineapple frequently with wine mixture, until thermometer registers 185 degrees, about 1 hour longer, or move drumstick up and down (when done the joint should give readily or break). Remove turkey and pineapple, keep warm.
12. Pour d rippings into 2 cup measuring cup; skim off any excess fat. Add enough water to drippings to measure 2 cups.
13. Heat dripping to boiling in saucepan.
14. Mix cornstarch and cold water; stir into drippings.
15. Boil and stir 1 minute. Serve with turkey.
16. Yields about 16 servings.
title: Pineapple Roast Turkey

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients in 1 1/2-quart glass casserole.
2. Cover with glass lid.
3. Microwave for 6 minutes on High.
4. Stir and continue cooking for 6 to 8 minutes on High, or until tender.
5. Let stand, covered, 2 minutes before servings.
6. Makes about 4 servings.
title: Buttered Rutabaga

steps: 1. Sift together the flour, sugar and salt.
2. Stir in lemon rind, lemon juice, egg yolks and milk.
3. Fold in egg whites.
4. Pour into 1 1/2-quart casserole.
5. Set in pan of water (1 inch).
6. Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes.
7. Makes 6 servings.
8. Good after a heavy meal!
title: Mama'S Lemon Sponge

steps: 1. Cook meat and onion in a large skillet over medium heat until meat is browned and onion is tender; drain.
2. Return beef mixture to skillet.
3. Stir in remaining ingredients, except hamburger buns.
4. Cook until thoroughly heated.
5. Spoon mixture evenly over bun halves.
6. This makes 2 servings, but may be enlarged.
title: Sloppy Joes

steps: 1. Cook carrots until tender; place in 1 quart casserole.
2. Combine onions, mayonnaise, water, horseradish and pepper and pour over carrots.
3. Combine bread crumbs and butter and sprinkle on top. Bake, uncovered, in 350° oven 25 to 30 minutes.
4. Sprinkle with cheese and bake 2 to 3 more minutes or until cheese is melted. Serve immediately.
5. Makes 6 servings.
title: Zesty Carrot Bake

steps: 1. In a large bowl, mix the flours, baking powder, spice and salt. Whisk in milk, honey and oil, then egg yolk.
2. In small bowl, beat the egg white to form stiff peaks.
3. Fold into yolk mixture.
4. Gently mix in pumpkin, then raisins.
5. Coat nonstick griddle or large skillet with vegetable cooking spray.
6. Heat over medium-low heat; with 1/3 cup measure portion batter on griddle.
7. Cook until lightly browned, about 4 minutes, turning once.
8. Makes 4 servings (12 flapjacks).
title: Raisin-Pumpkin Flapjacks

steps: 1. Lightly butter broiler pan and lay fillets on pan.
2. Baste fish with butter and sprinkle Old Bay on top.
3. Place oven rack on highest level and turn oven on broil.
4. Broil for 5 minutes or until top of fish turns brown.
5. Serve hot.
6. Serves 4.
title: Frogmore Broiled Fish

steps: 1. Place melted butter in casserole dish.
2. Arrange zucchini, onions and peppers in layers.
3. Sprinkle bread crumbs, oil and shredded cheese over mixture.
4. Top with sauce.
5. Cover and bake for 50 to 60 minutes in 375° oven.
6. Serves 4 to 6 people.
title: Zucchini Delight

steps: 1. Cook macaroni according to package directions; drain thoroughly.
2. Stir in butter and egg.
3. Mix mustard and salt with 1 tablespoon hot water and add to milk in medium bowl.
4. Add cheese, reserving enough to sprinkle on top.
5. Pour macaroni into buttered casserole dish.
6. Add milk/cheese mixture and sprinkle with reserved cheese.
7. Bake at 350° until custard is set and top is crusty, about 45 minutes.
8. Makes 4 to 6 servings.
title: Macaroni And Cheese

ingredients.text: 1 medium green pepper, finely diced (about 3/4 c.)

steps: 1. Cut any fat away from the meat.
2. Mix together flour, salt and pepper; pound into both sides of meat.
3. Melt a small amount of Crisco in a skillet.
4. Brown steak thoroughly on all sides.
5. Add remaining ingredients.
6. Cover tightly and simmer until meat is tender, about 1 1/2 hours.
7. Makes 4 to 6 servings.
title: Swiss Steak

steps: 1. Coat chicken with mixture of flour and salt. Brown in melted margarine in skillet. Meanwhile, combine remaining ingredients in saucepan and bring to boil. Spray casserole dish with Pam; arrange browned chicken breasts on the bottom of the dish and pour cranberry mixture over the chicken. Bake at 350°, uncovered, for 1 hour. Makes 4 servings.
title: Ruby Chicken

steps: 1. Place tomatoes in a buttered casserole.
2. Sprinkle with salt and pepper on top of tomatoes.
3. Spread mayonnaise over top, then green onions.
4. Sprinkle Cheddar cheese over last.
5. Bake in a 325° oven for 20 minutes.
6. Serves 4.
title: Stacked Tomatoes

ingredients.text: 2 lb. round steak, cut in small pieces

steps: 1. Brown meat in oil.
2. Add 2 cups water, barbecue sauce, carrots, potatoes, onions and salt.
3. Cover and simmer 1 hour.
4. Gradually add remaining water to flour, stirring until well blended.
5. Add flour mixture to hot meat and vegetables, stirring constantly until it boils and thickens.
6. Prepare biscuit mix like dumplings. Drop by tablespoons onto hot stew mixture.
7. Simmer 10 minutes. Cover; simmer another 15 minutes.
8. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Harvest Stew

steps: 1. Cook green peppers in olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat, stirring often, 10 minutes or until lightly browned.
2. Add garlic.
3. Cook 1 minute.
4. Stir in tomatoes, salt and pepper. Cook, stirring often, for 15 minutes or until slightly thickened. Yields 4 servings.
title: Stir-Fried Peppers With Tomatoes

steps: 1. Melt Crisco; add onion and cook until tender.
2. Stir in flour and salt.
3. Add milk and cook over low heat, stirring constantly until thickened and beginning to boil.
4. Remove from heat.
5. Stir in mustard and cheese.
6. Cut hot dogs in 1/4-inch slices.
7. Arrange alternate layers of potatoes, hot dogs and cheese sauce in 2-quart greased casserole.
8. Top with cheese sauce.
9. Bake at 325° for 1 1/4 hours.
10. Serve hot.
11. Makes 6 to 8 servings.
title: Sunday Supper Casserole

steps: 1. In food processor, combine turkey, onion, egg white, tomato paste and seasonings.
2. Process until turkey is ground.
3. Place flour on a piece of wax paper.
4. Roll sausages lightly in it after link sausages are formed.
5. To form link sausages, wet hands and form mixture into 8 link shaped sausages, use 1/4 cup for each.
6. Heat oil in large nonstick frying pan over medium heat.
7. Add links and sizzle until brownish on all sides and cooked throughout, about 8 minutes.
8. Makes 4 servings.
title: Turkey Links

steps: 1. Line jelly roll pan with graham crackers.
2. Mix butter and brown sugar.
3. Spoon over graham crackers.
4. Sprinkle with nuts.
5. Bake at 350° for 12 minutes.
6. Remove to cooling rack.
7. Break in rectangles.
8. Serves 60.
title: Glorified Grams

steps: 1. Pound steak to 1/4-inch thickness.
2. Sprinkle with lemon-pepper and salt.
3. Cut into 4 x 1/2-inch strips.
4. Dip steak in buttermilk.
5. Dredge in flour.
6. Brown steak on both sides in hot oil in a large skillet.
7. Drain well.
8. Yields 4 servings.
title: Steak Fingers

steps: 1. Boil milk.
2. Moisten the cornstarch with a little cold milk, then add to the boiling milk and stir until it thickens.
3. Add the sugar and salt.
4. Remove from heat and pour into custard cups. Refrigerate to harden.
5. Serve with cream sauce.
6. Serves 5.
title: Blanc Mange

ingredients.text: 4 to 6 slices bread, buttered on one side and cubed

steps: 1. Layer bread cubes over bottom of greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish.
2. Sprinkle sausage over bread cubes.
3. Beat eggs well. Stir in half and half and salt.
4. Pour over bread/sausage mixture and sprinkle with cheese.
5. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Bake at 400° for 45 minutes.
6. Serve hot.
7. Yield:
8. 6 servings.
title: Egg And Sausage Casserole

4. Cut chicken into 20 pieces, cutting breast into 2 pieces.
5. Heat oil in deep frying pan or Dutch oven.
6. Saute
7. chicken and bay leaves in oil until well browned,
