steps: 1. Cut ends off peppers and remove seeds.
2. Boil pepper 5 minutes.
3. Chop pepper ends and onions.
4. Saute with ground beef until brown, add other ingredients.
5. Bake in muffin pan for 20 minutes at 375 degrees.
6. Serves 6.
title: Stuffed Peppers

ingredients.text: 1 medium ripe banana, cut into chunks

steps: 1. In a blender, combine ingredients; cover and process until smooth.
2. Pour into Popsicle trays or small disposable cups.
3. If using disposable cups, insert a craft stick into the middle. Freeze until firm, about 5 hours or overnight.
4. Makes 6 servings.
title: Vanilla Pops

steps: 1. Sprinkle chicken with salt and paprika. Place in baking dish. Dot with margarine. Bake in hot oven (400°) for 25 minutes. Add wine, bouillon cube and rosemary. Continue to cook, basting chicken frequently, until done, about 15 to 20 minutes.
2. Makes 4 servings.
title: Chicken Rosemary

steps: 1. Combine beef, brown sugar, vinegar and water in 6-quart cast-iron or other heavy ovenproof pot.
2. Bake at 375° for 3 hours. Remove from oven; cool.
3. Remove all fat and any bones.
4. Shred beef; return to pot.
5. Add mixture of catsup, mustard, garlic and onion; stir to blend.
6. Reduce oven temperature to 300° and cook, covered, for up to 4 hours.
7. Stir every half hour, adding more water/catsup to keep well moistened.
8. Serve on buns with onion and cheese. Yields 12 to 14 servings.
title: Shredded Barbecued Beef

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients in blender container.
2. Cover and blend until smooth and frothy.
3. Makes 1 serving.
title: Morning Cooler

steps: 1. Combine onions, salt, pepper, butter and cooked okra.
2. Layer in casserole with cheese, egg and bread crumbs.
3. Top with buttered bread crumbs.
4. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
5. Makes 4 servings.
title: Escalloped Okra

steps: 1. Wash shrimp.
2. Combine 2 onions, vinegar and water; heat to boiling.
3. Add shrimp and boil 15 to 20 minutes or until pink. Remove shrimp; shell and clean.
4. Save the stock.
5. Chop remaining onion and brown in butter, then blend in flour and add okra.
6. Add strained stock slowly, stirring constantly.
7. Add rice, tomatoes, seasonings and shrimp.
8. Simmer until okra and tomatoes are cooked. Remove the bay leaves.
9. This will generously serve 8.
title: Shrimp Gumbo

steps: 1. Brown flour in oil to make a roux. Add next 4 ingredients. Cook until tender. Pour mixture into 1 gallon simmering water. Stir well, adding next 4 items. Boil slowly 2 1/2 hours. Add shrimp and crab; cook 1/2 hour. Add oysters for last 10 minutes. Serve over rice in soup bowls. Serves 14 to 16.
title: Seafood Gumbo

steps: 1. Saute onion and garlic in oil in a skillet until crisp-tender. Add zucchini and yellow squash; cook mixture over medium-high heat, stirring constantly for 5 minutes.
2. Add tomatoes and remaining ingredients; cook, stirring constantly for 2 minutes. Serve immediately.
3. Yield: 6 servings.
title: Cajun Squash

steps: 1. Combine salad dressing and seasonings.
2. Mix well. Add remaining ingredients.
3. Mix lightly. Chill. Add additional salad dressing just before serving, if desired. Serve on rice cakes, if desired.
4. Makes 4 to 6 servings.
title: Cajun Chicken Salad

steps: 1. Saut green pepper, celery and onion in margarine. Add rice, tomatoes and salt. Cover and simmer for 10 minutes. Add the franks and simmer for 5 minutes. Makes 4 servings.
title: Creole Franks And Rice

steps: 1. Shape beef into small patties and fry.
2. Remove from pan. Drain pan and saute onion, celery, garlic and basil with sauce. Add tomato paste and pasta.
3. Mix to blend flavors.
4. Add meat patties to sauce.
5. Serve over cooked rice.
6. Serves 6.
title: Rice Creole

steps: 1. Fry onion and bell pepper in butter.
2. Add rest of ingredients. Simmer about 20 minutes.
3. Serves 4.
title: Creole Corn

steps: 1. Combine cabbage, carrot, onion and salad oil.
2. Toss until cabbage is coated.
3. Chill.
4. Mix remaining ingredients; combine with cabbage mixture.
5. Serve cold.
6. Yield: 6 servings.
title: Southern Slaw

steps: 1. Chop vegetables and cook with ground beef.
2. In a separate skillet, cook sausage and save the drippings.
3. In meantime, cook rice.
4. Drain ground beef and add sausage and sausage drippings to beef and vegetables.
5. Add cooked rice.
6. Fry all in a skillet for 15 minutes.
7. Makes 4 to 6 servings.
title: Dirty Rice Casserole

steps: 1. Melt butter in a 10-inch skillet.
2. Add other ingredients. Cover and cook 10 to 12 minutes or until tender; do not overcook. Yields 8 servings.
title: Skillet Creole Cabbage

steps: 1. Melt corn oil in a large skillet.
2. Pour vegetables into pan. Sprinkle
3. salt
4. and
5. sugar on top of ingredients.
6. Cover and cook over
7. medium
8. heat for 10 to 12 minutes.
9. Vegetables will be crisp,
10. just
11. as
12. good
13. the next day, if there are any left. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Skillet Cabbage Creole

steps: 1. Place butter in a 2-quart casserole.
2. Microwave at High for 55 seconds or until melted.
3. Add sweet red peppers and green onions; cover tightly with heavy-duty plastic wrap.
4. Microwave at High for 1 1/2 to 2 minutes, or until vegetables are crisp-tender.
5. Add okra, corn, water, salt and pepper.
6. Cover tightly with heavy-duty plastic wrap.
7. Microwave at High for 3 minutes; stir well.
8. Cover; microwave at High for 7 to 9 minutes, or until corn is tender. Yields 6 servings.
title: Okra, Corn And Peppers

ingredients.text: 5 slices bacon, cooked, drained and crumbled

steps: 1. Cook beans until tender.
2. Saute onion in butter until transparent.
3. Blend in flour, salt, sugar and milk.
4. Cook until smooth.
5. Add vinegar and sour cream; pour over beans.
6. Place over low heat to heat to serving temperature.
7. Garnish with crumbled bacon.
8. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Saucy Green Beans

steps: 1. Peel and dice potatoes.
2. Melt butter in saucepan; add pepper and onion.
3. Saute until tender.
4. Add potatoes and 2 cups water with seasonings.
5. Cover and simmer until potatoes are tender. Make paste of flour and 1/3 cup water; add to potatoes.
6. Add milk and cook until slightly thickened.
7. Stir in undrained corn and ham.
8. Heat thoroughly.
9. Makes 6 servings.
title: Hearty Potato Ham Chowder

steps: 1. Cook cauliflower until tender-crisp and put in large casserole dish.
2. Combine milk, chicken soup, mayonnaise, cheese and curry powder and pour over cauliflower.
3. Mix together melted butter and crumbs and sprinkle over all.
4. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Serves 6.
title: Curried Cauliflower

steps: 1. Beat cream, sugar, vinegar and salt together thoroughly until the dressing is like whipped cream.
2. Discard outer leaves of cabbage. Shred the rest finely and combine with dressing just before it is ready to serve.
3. Serves 6.
4. Enjoy!
title: Pennsylvania Cole Slaw

steps: 1. 1. Melt butter in stock pot on medium, add onion and cook til' soft. Add pepper and garlic, and cook for a few minutes. Add broccoli and chicken broth. Bring to a boil, then simmer to broccoli is tender (10-15 minutes).

2. 2. In separate bowl, whisk flour into milk until completely dissolved. Stir into soup, stirring frequently ti'l thickened. Reduce heat to low, and then stir in cheese til smooth and heated through. Salt to taste.
3. Serves 4-5.
title: Broccoli Cheddar Soup

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients in large skillet; cover and simmer for 30 minutes until tender.
2. Serves 10 to 12.
title: Skillet Cabbage

steps: 1. Bring the water, 3 tablespoons margarine, salt and milk to a boil.
2. Remove from heat and add the potato flakes.
3. Cool the mixture a little and add the 2 well-beaten eggs.
4. Mix well.
5. Use an ice cream scoop and place mounds on a jelly roll sheet. Drizzle the melted 1/4 cup of margarine over the mounds and broil 3 inches from heat for 4 to 5 minutes.
6. Makes about 10 servings.
title: Potato Mounds

ingredients.text: 1/2 head broccoli, chopped (or 10 oz. frozen, thawed)

steps: 1. In large pot, bring chicken stock to boil. In skillet, saute onion in butter; add thyme and wine. Boil 2 to 3 minutes. Add flour, stirring briskly with a whisk. Boil 2 to 3 minutes whisking constantly until smooth. Add 1/2 of the chicken stock. Cook on low for 10 minutes. Add remainder of stock, white pepper, nutmeg, cheese, cream and broccoli. Simmer for 10 more minutes or until broccoli is just done. Serves 6.
title: Cream Of Broccoli Soup

steps: 1. Peel and slice carrots. Cook until tender and drain. Saute onion in oleo. Add cheese. Heat until melted, stirring constantly. Stir in carrots. Spoon in 2-quart baking dish. Top with potato chips. Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes until bubbly. Makes 12 servings.
title: Cheezy Carrots

steps: 1. Wash and cut broccoli into bite sized pieces.
2. Combine broccoli, bacon, raisins and onions.
3. In another bowl, combine mayonnaise, sugar and vinegar; mix well.
4. Pour dressing over broccoli and toss.
5. Refrigerate 2 hours.
6. Serves 8.
title: Fresh Broccoli Salad

steps: 1. Pare cucumbers and slice thinly into large bowl. Stir together other ingredients, except dill weed.
2. Pour over cucumbers and toss lightly.
3. Sprinkle with dill weed.
4. Cover and chill.
5. Just before serving, toss carefully.
6. Yields 8 to 10 servings.
title: Cucumber-Sour Cream Salad

steps: 1. In saucepan, melt butter.
2. Add onion, potatoes, water, salt and pepper.
3. Cover and cook slowly until potatoes are very soft. Mash the potatoes with masher until fairly smooth.
4. Add milk; continue cooking until soup comes to a boil.
5. Add parsley.
6. Makes 2 servings.
title: Easy Potato Soup

steps: 1. Combine first 8 ingredients. Coarsely chop eggs.
2. Add chopped eggs to potato mixture.
3. Chill.
4. Combine remaining ingredients; toss with potato mixture 1/2 hour before serving.
5. Makes 10 to 12 servings.
title: Calico Potato Salad

steps: 1. Heat butter in a large saucepan.
2. Add onions and fry 10 minutes.
3. Add flour and mix until smooth.
4. Add chicken broth gradually, stirring constantly, until boiling.
5. Add potatoes, saffron, salt and cayenne pepper; simmer 20 minutes.
6. Add milk and peas and continue cooking gently for 5 minutes.
7. Beat eggs and cream cheese together in bowl and gradually add 2 cups of hot soup, beating constantly to avoid curdling.
8. Return the contents of the bowl to the saucepan and heat, but do not boil.
9. Serve immediately.
10. Serves 6.
title: Potato Soup

steps: 1. Combine turkey, celery, green pepper, onions and lemon juice and peel.
2. Toss lightly.
3. Stir in mayo.
4. Pour into 2-quart casserole.
5. Top with grated cheese and then crushed potato chips. Bake in oven at 350° for about 30 minutes.
6. Serves 6.
title: Baked Turkey Salad

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 325°.
2. Cut olives into large pieces.
3. Brown the ground beef in the oil; remove the meat from the pan.
4. Add onion, celery, green pepper and rice.
5. Cook, stirring, until browned.
6. Add the tomatoes, water, seasonings, meat and olives; bring to a boil. Pour into a 2-quart casserole and cover.
7. Bake for 45 minutes to an hour.
8. Makes 6 to 8 servings.
title: Western Beef And Rice Casserole

steps: 1. Wash beans; cover with water and soak overnight.
2. Cook slowly until skins burst or until tender.
3. Drain; reserve liquid.
4. Place 1/2 the beans in bean pot or casserole.
5. Bury part of pork in beans and add 1/2 of combined remaining ingredients.
6. Add remaining beans and seasoning.
7. Place remaining pork over top.
8. Cover with bean liquor.
9. Cover and bake in slow oven (250° to 300°) for 6 to 8 hours.
10. Add more liquid if necessary.
11. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Home Baked Beans

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients in order listed.
2. Blend well.
3. Chill for 30 minutes before serving on lettuce.
4. Makes 6 servings.
title: Tasty Egg Salad

steps: 1. Spray a nonstick skillet with cooking spray and heat.
2. Saute mushrooms, onions and peppers for about 5 minutes or until tender. Add rice, curry, salt and chicken broth.
3. Bring to boil.
4. Reduce heat to simmer; cover and cook 20 to 25 minutes until rice is tender.
5. Serves 4.
title: Curried Basmati Rice

steps: 1. Mix cheese, flour, salt, pepper and garlic powder together in a plastic bag.
2. Toss wet potatoes to coat with cheese mixture. Place butter in an 8 x 10-inch baking dish to melt in a preheated 350° oven.
3. Add potatoes to melted butter and bake uncovered for 45 to 50 minutes or until tender and golden brown.
4. Turn potatoes once during baking time.
5. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Cheese Potatoes

steps: 1. Scrub potatoes, cover with water and boil until just tender. Drain and chill.
2. Slice and cut into cubes.
3. Combine mayo, yogurt, dill weed and onion powder.
4. Add remaining ingredients to potatoes.
5. Pour dressing over potato mixture and toss.
6. Yields 8 servings.
title: Creamy Potato Salad

ingredients.text: 2 medium onions, thinly sliced and separated into rings

steps: 1. Scrub potatoes and slice 1/8 inch thick.
2. Coat.
3. Put in shallow 2-quart casserole with Pam.
4. Combine potatoes and salad dressing in casserole; toss gently.
5. Cover and microwave it on High for 10 to 12 minutes, stirring at 4-minute intervals.
6. Stir in remaining ingredients.
7. Cover and microwave at High for 10 to 12 minutes, stirring at 4-minutes intervals.
8. Yields 6 servings (88 calories each).
title: Onion And Potato Bake

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients in a large skillet.
2. Cover and simmer 30 minutes or until tender.
3. Yield: About 10 to 12 servings.
title: Easy Cabbage Dish

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients, except chips and cheese.
2. Spoon into buttered baking dish.
3. Combine chips and cheese and place on top.
4. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
5. Makes 6 servings.
title: Hot Crunchy Chicken Salad

steps: 1. Cut onions into 1/2 inch rounds and separate rings. Place in a bowl and toss with buttermilk. In another bowl, combine breadcrumbs, salt and pepper. Dredge onion rings in dry mixture and place on lightly oiled baking sheet. Lightly mist with olive oil cooking spray. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes or until lightly browned. Makes 4 servings.
title: Onion Rings(Low Fat Recipe)

steps: 1. Scrub and peel potatoes; cut lengthwise into quarters.
2. Cut each quarter into 3 strips.
3. Roll in melted butter; then roll in combined remaining ingredients.
4. Place potato sticks in a single layer on a cookie sheet.
5. Drizzle melted butter over potatoes. Bake at 400° for 30 to 35 minutes or until potatoes are tender. Yield:
6. 6 servings.
title: Parmesan Potato Sticks

ingredients.text: 1 clove garlic, crushed or 1/8 tsp. garlic powder

steps: 1. Cook sausage and garlic until brown.
2. Drain off fat.
3. Cook squash, covered, in small amount of water until tender.
4. Drain. Stir squash and next 6 ingredients into meat.
5. Fold in eggs.
6. Bake in a 10 x 6 x 1 1/2-inch pan at 325° for 30 minutes.
7. Makes 4 to 6 servings.
title: Sausage Squash Casserole

steps: 1. Microwave Directions:
2. Power select: High Medium, Medium-stand approximately cooking time 35 minutes.
3. Yields about 6 servings.
title: Quick Scalloped Potatoes

steps: 1. Wash, core, peel and cut apples in 1/8's.
2. Melt 2 tablespoons butter in baking dish.
3. Place 1/2 of noodles in dish; then the apples.
4. Combine sugar and cinnamon.
5. Sprinkle with 1/2 of the sugar and cinnamon mixture.
6. Cover with remaining noodles.
7. Dot with remaining butter.
8. Sprinkle remaining sugar and cinnamon mixture on top.
9. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.
10. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Noodles And Apples

ingredients.text: 1 clove garlic, crushed or garlic powder

steps: 1. Cut potatoes and onions into 1/4-inch slices.
2. Alternate slices, slightly overlapping, in a single layer in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Combine the next 5 ingredients; drizzle over potato and onion slices.
3. Cover and bake at 400° for 40 minutes. Sprinkle with paprika and bake, uncovered, for an additional 20 minutes.
4. Yields 8 servings.
title: Easy Oven Baked Potatoes

ingredients.text: 1 c. raw wild rice (4 c. cooked)

steps: 1. Cook rice and toss with olive oil and raisins.
2. Season with 1 teaspoon salt and 1/2 teaspoon pepper.
3. Let cool to room temperature.
4. Add parsley, onion, tomato and mint.
5. Add vinegar and toss.
6. Serves 1.
title: Wild Rice Salad

steps: 1. Melt 1 tablespoon margarine; add onion and garlic.
2. Cook, stirring, until onion is wilted.
3. Add rice and stir to coat grains.
4. Add broth and bay leaf.
5. Bring to boil and cover.
6. Cook exactly 17 minutes.
7. Remove bay leaf and stir in remaining 1 tablespoon margarine.
8. Serves 6.
title: Rice With Onion And Bay Leaf

steps: 1. Melt butter in skillet.
2. Add cabbage and stir over low heat for 15 minutes.
3. Add salt, sugar and sour cream.
4. Stir until thoroughly heated, but do not boil.
5. Serves 4.
title: Sour Cream Cabbage

ingredients.text: 5 lb. potatoes, peeled and cut up

steps: 1. Place potatoes in pan. Cover with water. Add salt. Cook for 25 minutes. Drain. Mash the potatoes after draining. Add sour cream, milk and margarine. Add chives and pepper. Mix well. Makes 10 to 12 servings.
title: Sour Cream And Chive Potatoes

steps: 1. Saute vegetables in butter and honey.
2. Add rice and continue to saute until onions are clear.
3. Add water and boil 5 minutes. Turn heat to low; let rice absorb water, about 35 minutes.
4. In last 5 minutes of cooking, add apple and almonds.
5. Serves 4.
title: Spicy Rice And Vegetables

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 400°.
2. Spray a shallow baking dish with cooking spray.
3. Cut potatoes into wedges.
4. Combine mustard, paprika, cumin and garlic salt.
5. Add potatoes and toss.
6. Make sure the potatoes are well coated.
7. Spread in baking dish in single layer.
8. Bake 10 minutes; turn once.
9. Bake 10 minutes longer or until tender and crusty.
10. Serves 4.
title: Crusty Potato Wedges

steps: 1. Cook macaroni; drain and rinse in cold water. In a large bowl, combine the macaroni, green onions, tomato and celery. In a small bowl, combine mayonnaise, vinegar, salt and pepper. Pour over macaroni mixture and toss to coat. Cover and chill for at least 2 hours. Just before serving, add bacon. Yield: 12 servings.
title: Blt Macaroni Salad

steps: 1. Drain salmon; remove bones and skin.
2. Combine ingredients. Chill until serving.
3. Makes 4 servings.
title: Salmon Salad

ingredients.text: 2 medium sweet red peppers, thinly sliced

steps: 1. In a saucepan, bring to boil first 6 ingredients.
2. Reduce heat.
3. Simmer, uncovered, 5 minutes.
4. Remove from heat and allow to cool.
5. In a
6. large bowl, combine cabbage, onions and peppers. Pour vinegar mixture over vegetables and stir to coat.
7. Cover and refrigerate.
8. Yields 16 to 20 servings.
9. May be stored in refrigerator up to 3 months.
title: Winter Cabbage Salad

ingredients.text: 3 medium acorn squash, cut in halves and seeds removed

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°.
2. Combine all ingredients.
3. Place squash cut side down in apple juice mixture in roasting pan.
4. Bake 45 minutes.
5. Turn cut side up and spoon apple juice over tops.
6. Bake 10 minutes more or until tender.
7. Spoon apple juice into center of squash just before serving.
8. Makes 6 servings.
title: Acorn Squash

steps: 1. Add potatoes, carrots, celery, and onions, to boiling water--salted. Simmer for 10 minutes. Make a cream sauce with margarine, flour, and milk. stir in cheese until its melted. Add corn, cooked vegetables (with broth) to sauce, heat, but do not boil. serves 8-10
title: Piper'S Chowder

steps: 1. Mix ingredients together. Jam could be used in place of honey, or on fruit if you like.
2. Serves 2.
title: Morning Rice

ingredients.text: 2 medium-size yellow squash, cut lengthwise into 1/4-inch-thick slices
2 medium zucchini, cut lengthwise into 1/4-inch-thick slices

steps: 1. Combine first 3 ingredients in a small bowl.
2. Toss squash and zucchini slices with 1 Tbsp. oil in a large bowl; sprinkle vegetables with 1 tsp. Creole mixture. Arrange seasoned vegetables on an aluminum foil-lined baking sheet; set aside.
3. Stir remaining 1 Tbsp. olive oil into remaining Creole mixture. Rub mixture evenly on boneless pork loin roast.
4. Place roast on a lightly greased rack in a roasting pan. Place pan on middle rack in oven.
5. Bake at 425° for 30 minutes.

6. Place vegetables in oven on lowest rack, and bake, with roast, 15 to 20 more minutes or until a meat thermometer inserted into thickest portion of pork registers 155°. Remove roast and vegetables from oven. Let roast stand 10 minutes before slicing or until meat thermometer registers 160°.

7. Zesty Grilled Pork Chops: Toss vegetables with 1 Tbsp. oil, and sprinkle with 1 tsp. Creole mixture as directed. Do not place on baking sheet. Substitute 6 (1 1/4-inch-thick) bone-in pork chops for pork loin roast. Stir remaining oil into remaining Creole mixture. Rub evenly on pork chops. Grill vegetables and pork chops over high heat (400° to 500°) 3 minutes on each side or until pork is done. Makes 6 servings. Prep: 10 min., Grill: 6 min.
title: Zesty Pork Roast With Vegetables

steps: 1. Cover cooked rice and chill; add mayonnaise, celery, onion, mustard and salt to chilled rice; mix well.
2. Cover and chill. Stir in remaining ingredients before serving.
3. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Rice Salad

steps: 1. Combine carrots, water and salt in saucepan.
2. Bring to a boil; reduce heat and cook over medium heat about 10 to 12 minutes until crisp-tender.
3. Stir in brown sugar, crushed pineapple and butter.
4. Cook additional 3 to 5 minutes; watch to avoid sticking. Yields 2 to 3 servings.
title: Aloha Carrots

steps: 1. Pare potatoes and cut into quarters.
2. Combine flour, cheese, salt and pepper in a bag.
3. Moisten potatoes well with cheese mixture.
4. Melt butter in a 13 x 9-inch baking pan.
5. Place potatoes in a layer in pan.
6. Bake at 375° for about 1 hour, turning once during baking.
7. When golden brown, sprinkle with parsley.
8. Makes 6 to 8 servings.
title: Golden Parmesan Potatoes

steps: 1. Cook chicken, celery, bay leaves and onion together until chicken is done.
2. Remove chicken from broth and cool.
3. Remove bay leaves from broth and add carrots, noodles, salt and pepper. Cover and cook at medium heat 20 minutes.
4. Remove chicken from bone.
5. Add chicken to soup and cook 10 to 15 minutes longer. Yield: 6 servings.
title: Mamaw'S Homemade Chicken Soup

steps: 1. Combine cauliflower, broccoli and onion.
2. Combine mayonnaise and remaining ingredients, mixing well.
3. Pour over vegetables. Toss gently; cover and chill.
4. Miracle Whip Lite and NutraSweet may be substituted for mayonnaise and sugar.
5. Makes a good low-calorie dish.
6. Yields 10 servings.
title: Cauliflower-Broccoli Crunch

steps: 1. Combine ingredients, except cheese and potato chips.
2. Toss lightly and put in greased 2 quart casserole.
3. Sprinkle with cheese and potato chips.
4. Bake in a very hot oven at 450° for 10 minutes.
5. Serves 6.
title: Hot Turkey Salad

steps: 1. Coat roast with pepper.
2. Place, uncovered, in a roasting pan with drip rack.
3. Roast for 1 hour at 350°.
4. Add potatoes which have been tossed with oil and sprinkled with rosemary and salt. Bake 1 more hour.
5. Remove from oven and let rest for 10 minutes. Slice roast.
6. Serves 8.
title: Peppered Pork Roast With Rosemary Potatoes

steps: 1. Combine sugar, vinegar, soy sauce, salt and cayenne; mix well. Heat the oil over medium heat.
2. Add cabbage and stir-fry for 2 to 3 minutes until cabbage is well coated with the oil.
3. Remove from the heat and stir the liquid mixture into the cabbage.
4. Serve hot or cold.
5. Serves 4.
title: Stir-Fried Cabbage

steps: 1. Cook potatoes in jackets in salted boiling water until tender; drain.
2. Chop onions very fine and cook in melted shortening until limp.
3. Stir in sugar, salt and flour and stir until smooth; gradually add sour cream and milk.
4. Pour in vinegar and continue to cook until mixture bubbles again.
5. Remove skins from potatoes; toss potatoes in sauce and keep hot until ready to serve.
6. Serves 6.
title: New Potatoes In Sour Cream

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients except chives in saucepan.
2. Heat to simmer.
3. Cook about 15 to 20 minutes.
4. Sprinkle with chives last 5 minutes of cooking.
5. Yields 4 servings.
title: Herbed Squash

steps: 1. Combine broccoli, onion and cauliflower.
2. Toss well.
3. Combine remaining ingredients, mixing well.
4. Pour over vegetables.
5. Cover and refrigerate overnight.
6. Serves 6.
title: Broccoli And Cauliflower Salad

steps: 1. Bake potatoes on greased cookie sheet at 425° for 30 to 35 minutes.
2. Stir occasionally while baking so they don't stick.
3. Add all other ingredients in bowl and stir together.
4. Serve warm or cold.
5. Makes 6 servings.
title: Hot Or Cold Baked Potato Salad

steps: 1. Combine ingredients.
2. Roll thin on board.
3. Let stand 20 minutes.
4. Roll up loosely; spread out, let dry.
5. Cut in strips and slice thin noodles.
6. Serves 4.
title: Noodles

ingredients.text: 1/4 c. raisins, cook in water to puff up

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients; cover and chill.
2. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Pineapple Slaw

steps: 1. Combine 2 1/2 cups of water and salt in saucepan.
2. Bring to boil and add rice.
3. Cover.
4. Reduce heat.
5. Simmer 20 minutes.
6. Pour 1/2 cup of water over raisins.
7. Let stand 1 minute.
8. Drain raisins; set aside.
9. Combine butter and curry powder.
10. Stir curry mixture, raisins and walnuts into rice.
11. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Curried Rice

steps: 1. Heat oven to 350°.
2. Grease a 2-quart baking dish.
3. In a large skillet, melt butter over medium heat.
4. Add broccoli and onion and saute until onion is translucent (about 5 minutes).
5. Remove from heat.
6. Beat eggs in a large bowl.
7. Beat in cream and cheese. Stir in broccoli, onion, salt and pepper.
8. Pour mixture into greased baking dish and set dish in a larger pan filled with approximately 1 inch of hot water.
9. Bake 45 minutes or until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean.
10. Let stand about 20 minutes before serving.
11. Yields 6 to 8 servings.

title: Microwave-Herbed Potatoes

steps: 1. Cook potatoes in skins until tender; while hot, peel and slice into 1/4-inch pieces.
2. In a skillet, cook bacon until crispy. Remove from pan and crumble into potatoes.
3. Combine remaining ingredients, except parsley, and heat to boiling point.
4. After mixture thickens and boils, pour over potatoes.
5. Mix lightly. Place in 3-quart casserole.
6. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Hot Potato Salad

steps: 1. Cook macaroni as directed on package; drain.
2. Rinse with cold water; drain.
3. Mix mayonnaise, onion, salt and pepper.
4. Toss with macaroni, chicken and cucumber.
5. Cover and refrigerate about 2 hours or until chilled.
6. Makes 4 servings.
title: Chicken-Cucumber Salad

steps: 1. Heat the first 6 ingredients to boil.
2. Add some of mix to beaten eggs and then add this to the rest of the vinegar mixture. Cook until mix thickens and boils.
3. Remove from heat and add milk or cream.
4. Pour, while hot, over shredded cabbage and onions. Chill and serve.
5. Serves 18.
title: Dutch Coleslaw

steps: 1. In a large soup kettle, saute onion in butter until tender. Add water, cabbage, potatoes, bouillon cubes, pepper and garlic. Cover and simmer for 20 to 25 minutes.
2. Stir in ham.
3. Makes 12 to 14 servings.
title: Potato And Cabbage Soup

steps: 1. In medium bowl, mix well the mayonnaise, sour cream, lemon juice, sugar, salt and pepper; set aside.
2. With sharp knife, shred cabbage, diced celery and green pepper.
3. Add the vegetables to mayonnaise mixture; toss to mix well.
4. Cover and refrigerate. Makes 6 servings.
title: Easy Coleslaw

steps: 1. Cook potatoes, onion and celery in the boiling water, covered, until very tender.
2. Meanwhile melt the butter in top of double boiler.
3. Add flour; stir until smooth, then add seasonings and milk.
4. Cook while stirring until smooth and thickened, then rub the potato mixture, liquid and all, through a sieve.
5. You should have 3 cups puree.
6. Add to sauce with parsley.
7. Heat and serve.
8. Serves 6.
title: Cream Of Potato Soup

steps: 1. Combine apple, celery and raisins in a medium bowl.
2. Combine mayonnaise and lemon juice, stirring well to blend.
3. Add to fruit mixture and toss lightly to coat well. Cover and refrigerate until chilled.
4. Yields 5 servings.
5. Serving Size:
6. 1 cup. Exchanges:
7. 1 fruit, 1 fat.
title: Waldorf Salad

ingredients.text: 6 soda crackers, crumbled and mixed with 2 Tbsp. margarine

steps: 1. Cook cabbage in boiling water (salted) for 10 minutes; drain well.
2. Melt butter in saucepan.
3. Add flour; blend until smooth. Add milk; cook until smooth white sauce develops.
4. Place alternate layers of cabbage, white sauce and cheese in baking dish.
5. Top with cracker mixture.
6. Bake in 350° oven for 30 minutes.
7. Yields 6 to 8 servings.
title: Scalloped Cabbage

steps: 1. In a large saucepan, saute onion in butter until tender. Stir in flour, salt and pepper until blended. Gradually add milk. Bring to boil. Cook and stir for 2 minutes or until sauce thickens. Place half of potatoes in a greased 3-quart baking dish. Pour half of sauce over potatoes. Repeat layers. Bake uncovered at 350° for 70 minutes or until potatoes are tender and top is lightly browned.
2. Serve immediately. Yield: 8 servings.
title: Home-Style Scalloped Potatoes

ingredients.text: 1 1/2 lb. fresh broccoli, cut into florets

steps: 1. Steam broccoli for 1 to 2 minutes or until crisp-tender. Rinse in cold water and set aside.
2. In a bowl, combine lemon juice, salt, sugar, cornstarch and nutmeg.
3. Set aside.
4. In a large skillet or wok over high heat, stir-fry mushrooms, onion and garlic in oil for 3 minutes.
5. Add broccoli and lemon juice mixture.
6. Stir-fry for 1 to 2 minutes.
7. Serve immediately.
8. Yields 6 servings.
title: Broccoli-Mushroom Medley

steps: 1. Finely chop carrots and apples.
2. Mix all ingredients well. Makes 6 servings, 1/2 cup each.
title: Carrot Raisin Salad

steps: 1. Wash potatoes well.
2. Dry and pierce several times with fork. Bake at 400° for about 1 hour, or until soft.
3. Cool.
4. Cut potatoes in half lengthwise; carefully scoop potato pulp into bowl (leave 1/2 of pulp to keep the potato skin intact).
5. Set skins aside.
6. To the pulp, add yogurt, salt, pepper, paprika and 1/2 cheese; mix until light and fluffy.
7. Stuff potato skins with mixture.
8. Place on an ungreased baking sheet.
9. Top with remaining cheese and crumbled bacon.
10. Bake at 375° for 10 minutes, or until cheese is melted and bubbly.
11. Makes 8 servings.
title: Twice Baked Potatoes

steps: 1. Brown ground beef or ground turkey and onion. Drain and season to taste. Spread in baking dish. Top with cabbage. Pour diluted tomato soup on top and cover. Bake at 350° for 1 hour. Makes 6 servings, 1/2 cup each.
title: Cabbage And Beef Dish

steps: 1. Peel and dice potatoes and cook in water until fork goes through potatoes, then drain and rinse.
2. Boil eggs until hard. Dice onion and eggs.
3. Combine all other ingredients together in a large bowl.
4. Add potatoes while they are still warm.
5. Stir in mayonnaise.
6. Garnish if desired and place in refrigerator until ready to serve.
7. Serves 4 to 6 people.
title: Beverly'S Soulful Potato Salad

steps: 1. Brown hamburger with butter.
2. Add onion and tomato juice. Bring to a boil, then add baked beans, chili powder, salt and pepper.
3. Bring to a boil again.
4. Serves 12.
5. (Add chili powder, salt and pepper according to taste.)
title: Chili Soup

steps: 1. Cook potatoes in jackets until fork tender.
2. Peel, then shred into large bowl.
3. Stir in sour cream, chopped onions, 1 cup cheese, salt and pepper.
4. Turn into greased 2 quart casserole; top with remaining cheese.
5. Sprinkle with paprika.
6. Cover and refrigerate several hours or overnight.
7. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes until heated through.
8. Serves 8 to 10.
title: Potatoes Romanoff

steps: 1. In microwave-safe 2-quart casserole dish, combine potatoes and water. Cover and microwave on High power for 8 to 12 minutes or until potatoes are tender, stirring once during cooking.
2. Let stand, covered, 3 minutes.
3. Drain.
4. In 1 1/2-quart dish, combine milk and margarine.
5. Microwave, uncovered, on High power 1 minute. Mash potatoes and blend in hot milk mixture with salt and pepper. Place onion and garlic in the 1 1/2-quart casserole.
6. Microwave, uncovered, on High power for 1 to 2 minutes or until onion is soft.
7. Stir in cabbage.

8. Cover and microwave on High power 7 to 12 minutes or until cabbage is tender, stirring once while cooking. Stir in mashed potatoes. Cover and microwave on High power 2 to 3 minutes to heat through.
9. Makes 8 servings.
title: Microwave Cabbage And Potato Bake

steps: 1. Preheat the oven to 450°.
2. Line jelly roll pan with foil. Spray with vegetable cooking spray. Cut potatoes into 1/2-inch wide slices.
3. Toss potatoes with oil, garlic, salt and pepper to coat well. Bake 40 to 45 minutes, tossing once or twice, until potatoes are crisp and golden.
4. Makes 4 servings.
title: No-Fry French Fries

steps: 1. Melt butter in small casserole.
2. Mix remaining ingredients; stir into casserole.
3. Bake for 30 to 40 minutes in 350° oven. Yield:
4. 4 servings.
title: Carrots Amandine

steps: 1. Wash, peel and cut oranges into thin slices.
2. Chop pineapple into small chunks.
3. Slice bananas.
4. Combine fruit and stir in powdered sugar and shredded coconut.
5. Sprinkle some coconut on top.
6. Chill.
7. Serve in small individual bowls or large bowl. Garnish with cherries or strawberries.
8. Makes 8 servings.
title: Ambrosia Salad

steps: 1. Add salt to boiling water, add vegetable oil.
2. Add noodles and boil on low heat, stirring occasionally, until noodles are tender (about 7 minutes).
3. Saute almonds in butter in small skillet until lightly browned.
4. Drain noodles and toss with sauteed almonds and leftover butter from pan.
5. Yields 4 to 6 servings.
title: Almond Noodles

steps: 1. Cook unpeeled potatoes until tender, about 20 to 25 minutes. Cool, peel and grate into large bowl.
2. Add remaining ingredients, except paprika.
3. Mix well.
4. Spoon into 13 x 9-inch baking dish. Refrigerate 3 to 4 hours, covered, or overnight.
5. Bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes.
6. Sprinkle with paprika.
7. Yields 8 to 10 servings.
title: Potato Romanoff

steps: 1. Mix mustard, salad dressing, vinegar and seasonings.
2. Add to the chopped cabbage and celery.
3. Makes 4 servings.
4. Chopped chives may be sprinkled over the salad, if desired.
title: Celery And Cabbage Slaw

steps: 1. Break cauliflower in pieces and
2. cook in water for 5 minutes or until tender.
3. Put in casserole dish.
4. Mix mayonnaise, onion and mustard.
5. Pour over cauliflower. Top with cheese. Bake at 350° until cheese is melted.
6. Yields 6 servings.
title: Tangy Cauliflower

steps: 1. Soften cheese; add mayonnaise and lemon juice.
2. Beat until creamy.
3. Add fruit and nuts.
4. Fold in whipped cream.
5. Turn into individual molds and freeze.
6. Makes 6 to 8 servings.
title: Frozen Banana Cream Salad

steps: 1. Fry bacon until crisp. Drain on paper towels, crumble and set aside. Cut the broccoli into pieces.
2. Cook until crisp-tender.
3. In a large bowl, combine broccoli, raisins, sunflower seeds and onion.
4. In a small bowl, stir together salad dressing, sugar and vinegar until well blended. Spoon over broccoli mixture.
5. Toss to coat. Sprinkle bacon over salad and toss.
6. Cover and refrigerate 3 hours or overnight.
7. Serves 10 to 12.
title: Broccoli Salad

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients except cheese and chips.
2. Mix.
3. (May make ahead and refrigerate at this point, but leave out croutons and mix in just before baking.)
4. Spread into casserole, then add cheese and chips.
5. Bake at 450° for 10 to 15 minutes until bubbly. Increase baking time if refrigerated.
6. Serves 12.
title: Oven Baked Chicken Salad

ingredients.text: 2 c. diced chicken or turkey, cooked

steps: 1. Combine chicken or turkey, almonds, onions, celery, lemon juice, salt and mayonnaise.
2. Put in flat baking dish.
3. Sprinkle with Cheddar cheese and crushed potato chips.
4. Bake 20 minutes or until bubbly at 400°.
5. Serves 6.
title: Hot Chicken Or Turkey Salad

ingredients.text: 2 tart apples, peeled, cored and sliced

steps: 1. In a saucepan, combine shredded cabbage with all ingredients except apples and sugar.
2. Cover and cook over moderate heat for 15 minutes, tossing several times so the cabbage will cook evenly. Add apples; toss again.
3. Cover; cook 5 minutes longer.
4. Add sugar. If more water is needed during cooking, add 2 or 3 tablespoons but when the dish is done, all moisture should have cooked away. Yield:
5. 6 servings.
6. Approximate calories/serving:
title: Spiced Red Cabbage

ingredients.text: 2 large onions, sliced and separated into rings

steps: 1. Combine the oil, vinegar, sugar, salt, black pepper and parsley in a jar and shake until thoroughly mixed.
2. Pour over tomatoes, cucumbers and onions.
3. Marinate 2 hours before serving. Makes 6 servings.
title: Tomato And Cucumber Salad

steps: 1. In a soup pan, saute onion until golden brown.
2. Add veggie broth and finely chopped artichoke hearts.
3. Cook for 20 minutes on low heat.
4. Remove from the heat and puree.
5. Serve hot with grated cheese.
6. Serves 10.
title: Artichoke Hearts Soup

steps: 1. Clean and slice mushrooms.
2. Fry in butter 5 minutes.
3. Add flour and blend.
4. Add stock.
5. Cool slightly; add cream and seasonings. Heat through and serve.
6. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Cream Of Mushroom Soup

steps: 1. In a large salad bowl, combine broccoli, raisins and onion. In a small bowl, combine sugar, vinegar and mayonnaise.
2. Pour over broccoli.
3. Toss to coat.
4. Refrigerate.
5. Just before serving, sprinkle with bacon and sunflower seeds; toss.
6. Yields 6 to 8 servings.
title: Broccoli Delight Salad

ingredients.text: 1/2 cup fat free mayonnaise or salad dressing

steps: 1. In a large bowl, combine the broccoli, raisings and onion. In a small bow., combine the mayonnaise, vinegar, and sugar.
2. pour over broccoli mixture; toss to coat.
3. Sprinkle with bacon.
4. Chill for at least 2 hours.
5. Serves 6.
title: Broccoli Raisin Salad

steps: 1. Dice potatoes.
2. In saucepan over very low heat, melt butter. Stir in flour, salt, mustard and pepper. Slowly stir in milk. Cook, stirring until thickened.
3. Add horseradish and potatoes. Preheat oven to 375°.
4. Place potatoes in greased 1 1/2-quart casserole.
5. Sprinkle with cheese.
6. Bake 45 minutes.
7. Serves 8.
title: Oven Creamed Potatoes

steps: 1. Cook on high for 9 to 11 minutes the carrots, sugar and butter.
2. Mix water and cornstarch and add.
3. Add pecans, cover and cook on High 2 to 4 minutes.
4. Makes 6 to 8 servings.
title: Carrots

steps: 1. In a large saucepan, melt margarine over medium heat.
2. Saute celery and onion until tender.
3. Add potatoes and broth.
4. Cover and simmer until potatoes are tender (about 12 minutes).
5. Puree potato mixture in a blender.
6. Return to saucepan, stir in milk and seasoning.
7. Add cheese and heat only until melted.
8. Makes 8 servings.
title: Potato Cheese Soup

steps: 1. Mix tuna, pineapple, celery and nuts.
2. Mix mayonnaise, curry powder and parsley in another bowl.
3. Put contents into 2 bowls together.
4. Chill before serving.
5. Serve on lettuce leaves. Serves 6.
title: Hawaiian Delight Salad

steps: 1. In a large pan, cook potatoes, carrots and celery in water until tender, about 20 minutes.
2. Drain and save the liquid.
3. In same pan, saute the onion in butter until soft.
4. Stir in flour, salt and pepper.
5. Gradually add milk, stirring constantly, until thickened.
6. Gently stir in cooked vegetables and 1 cup or more of reserved liquid until soup is desired consistency.
7. You can also add cooked beef or fried ground beef to this.
8. Yields 8 to 10 servings/2 1/2 quarts.
title: Hearty Potato Soup

steps: 1. Shred lettuce and add to bowl. Dice tomato, red bell pepper and onion; add to the bowl. Loosely chop cilantro; add to the bowl. Add corn, black beans and cheese. Toss salad until well mixed. Place salad mix into individual bowls. Top with diced avocados and crushed corn chips.
2. For the dressing, in a small bowl combine taco seasoning and ranch dressing. Mix until well blended. Drizzle on each of the salads.
3. Yields about 8 servings.
title: Vegetarian Santa Fe Salad

steps: 1. Melt butter or margarine in large saucepan.
2. Add onions, carrots and peppers.
3. Cook until onions and carrots are tender. Add beef; cook until crumbly.
4. Stir in juice, potatoes and seasonings.
5. Cover and cook over low heat for 25 minutes.
6. Mix flour with 1 cup of milk; beat until free of lumps.
7. Add to soup. Add rest of milk.
8. Heat and serve.
9. Serves 4.
title: Hamburger Soup

steps: 1. Heat butter in large skillet.
2. Add cabbage, garlic and 1/4 cup water.
3. Cover tightly and steam over low heat 10 to 12 minutes. Blend next 4 ingredients, stir into cabbage.
4. Heat through but do not boil.
5. Sprinkle with caraway seed.
6. Serves 6.
title: Company Cabbage

steps: 1. Peel and cut potatoes into 1/2 inch cubes.
2. Cut celery into 1/2 inch pieces.
3. Core, blanch, peel and cut tomatoes into 1/2 inch chunks.
4. Cut marrow into 1/4 inch slices.
5. In a large saucepan, heat oil and brown garlic. Discard garlic. Add potatoes, stir to coat and cook for about 5 minutes.
6. Add onion, celery, parsley, and oregano, and cook until onions are softened.
7. Add stock, tomatoes, marrow, and salt and bring to a boil.
8. Reduce heat and simmer until zucchini is tender.
9. Pour soup into individual bowls and sprinkle freshly ground pepper and 1 teaspoon Parmesan cheese over each serving.
10. Serve hot. Makes 6 servings.
title: Country Style Zucchini Soup

ingredients.text: 4 bunches broccoli, cut into bite size flowerets

steps: 1. Fry bacon until crisp; crumble.
2. Combine broccoli, raisins, sunflower seeds and onion.
3. In small bowl, stir together mayonnaise, sugar and vinegar.
4. Spoon over broccoli mixture; toss to coat.
5. Sprinkle salad with bacon and toss.
6. Refrigerate for 3 hours or overnight. Yields 15 to 20 servings.
title: Broccoli Toss

steps: 1. Drain beans. Grease nonstick pan.
2. Mash beans. Add salsa. Heat thoroughly.
3. Serves 4.
4. This is low-fat version.
title: Refried Beans

steps: 1. Cook macaroni; drain.
2. Rinse with cold water.
3. In large bowl, combine mayonnaise, milk and mustard.
4. Add macaroni, cheese, ham and peas (thawed).
5. Mix well, cover and chill.
6. Serves 8.
title: Picnic Macaroni Salad

ingredients.text: 4 small ripe tomatoes, seeded and chopped

steps: 1. Steam green beans 5 minutes.
2. Heat oil in skillet.
3. Saute garlic, onion and beans 3 to 4 minutes.
4. Add tomatoes, parsley, red wine vinegar, oregano, salt and pepper.
5. Cook for 5 minutes more.
6. Chill.
7. Serve at room temperature.
8. Serves 4 to 6 people.
title: Green Beans With Tomatoes

ingredients.text: 1 Tbsp. salt (might want to decrease this)

steps: 1. Boil potatoes in salted water.
2. Peel potatoes and shell eggs. Dice potatoes into small cubes.
3. Mash eggs fine with fork.
4. Mix mayonnaise, mustard and Worcestershire sauce with eggs.
5. Add salt to taste.
6. Mix all ingredients.
7. Refrigerate immediately.
8. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Potato Salad

steps: 1. Combine oranges, pineapple, coconut and marshmallows in bowl; mix well.
2. Fold in sour cream.
3. Chill until serving time.
4. Yields 6 servings.
title: 6 Cup Fruit Salad

steps: 1. Combine vinegar, celery seed and mustard seed; set aside. Cook and drain potatoes. While potatoes are warm, drizzle with vinegar mixture. Sprinkle with sugar and 1/2 teaspoon salt; chill. Add cabbage, corned beef, pickle and onions. Mix dressing (mayonnaise, milk and 1/2 teaspoon salt). Pour over salad and mix lightly. Makes 8 servings.
title: Good Potato Salad

steps: 1. Run tines of fork lengthwise down side of unpared cucumber. Thinly slice cucumber and onion.
2. Mix vinegar, water, sugar and salt; pour on cucumber and onion in glass bowl.
3. Cover; refrigerate at least 2 hours.
4. Drain and serve on crisp salad greens.
5. Equal sweetener may be substituted for sugar.
6. Makes 4 to 6 servings.
title: Marinated Cucumber Salad

steps: 1. Drain mushrooms; reserve liquid.
2. Add hot water to reserved mushroom liquid to measure 1 1/2 cups.
3. Add bouillon.
4. In large skillet cook onion and mushrooms in butter until tender.
5. Stir in flour, bouillon and water and milk.
6. Heat until mixture boils and thickens slightly, stirring constantly.
7. Add rice, chicken, parsley, salt and pepper.
8. Simmer covered 15 minutes, until rice is tender.
9. Serves 5 to 6.
title: Chicken Rice Hot Dish

steps: 1. Cook and stir ground beef, celery, onion and green pepper in Dutch oven until vegetables are tender; drain.
2. Stir in cabbage and water.
3. Cover and cook over low heat, stirring occasionally until cabbage is done (about 10 minutes).
4. Stir in milk, cheese, flour, salt, pepper and nutmeg.
5. Heat to boiling, stirring constantly.
6. Boil and stir 1 minute.
7. Garnish with pimentos. Makes 8 servings.
title: Cabbage Cheddar Chowder

ingredients.text: 1 small fresh beet, peeled and finely shredded

steps: 1. Quarter and core cabbage.
2. Slice into thin slivers.
3. Place in large bowl.
4. Cover with ice water.
5. Refrigerate one hour.
6. Drain well.
7. Add beet, onion, carrots, sugar and salt to drained cabbage.
8. Toss.
9. Combine mayonnaise, sour cream, lemon juice and pepper in small bowl.
10. Stir well.
11. Pour over cabbage mixture. Toss to coat vegetables.
12. Cover.
13. Refrigerate several hours. Makes 10 to 12 servings.
title: Pink Cole Slaw

steps: 1. Lightly butter 1 1/2-quart casserole.
2. In medium saucepan, heat water, margarine and salt to rolling boil.
3. Remove from heat. Stir in milk and potato flakes.
4. Blend in egg, sour cream and cheese, mixing thoroughly.
5. Spoon into prepared casserole.
6. Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes until lightly golden brown and puffed.
7. Refrigerate leftovers.
8. Makes 6 to 8 servings.
title: Duchess Potato Puff

ingredients.text: 8 baking potatoes, peeled and quartered (about 4 lb.)

steps: 1. Bring potatoes, 1 teaspoon salt, and water to cover to a boil in a Dutch oven or stockpot; cover, reduce heat, and simmer 30 minutes or until tender; drain.
2. Beat potatoes, remaining 3/4 teaspoon salt, butter, half-and-half, garlic cloves, and pepper at medium speed with an electric mixer until smooth.
3. Stir in fresh parsley. Serve immediately.
4. Makes 8 servings.
title: Garlic Mashed Potatoes

ingredients.text: 4 c. diced, cooked chicken or turkey

steps: 1. Combine first 9 items.
2. Put in large baking dish (13 x 9-inch).
3. Mix last 3 items together and sprinkle on top.
4. Chill at least overnight.
5. Bake at 400° for 25 minutes.
6. Serves 8.
title: Baked Chicken Salad

ingredients.text: 2 cups Chopped Spinach (or 10 Ounces Frozen Chopped Spinach)

steps: 1. Combine the onion, garlic and 1/4 cup of the chicken broth in a sauce pan. Cook over medium heat until the onions are tender, about 2 minutes. Add the spinach, oregano and the remaining 2 3/4 cups chicken broth. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and cover. Simmer untli the spinach is tender, about 5 minutes.

2. Stir in the rice, lemon zest, lemon juice and salt. Return to a simmer. Remove 1/4 cup liquid and combine with egg. Whisk egg into liquid quickly. Pour into soup. Stir to combine. Add sour cream and stir until completely "creamed" into mixture.
3. Serve immediately. Makes 4 to 6 servings.
title: Spinach Soup With Lemon And Sour Cream

steps: 1. Add all ingredients into microwave-proof casserole.
2. Cover with lid.
3. Cook on High for 20 minutes.
4. Stir.
5. Cover, cook on (50) for 20 minutes.
6. Remove and let stand, covered, 5 minutes.
7. Discard bay leaves.
8. Serves 4 to 6. Cooking time:
9. 40 minutes.
title: Beefy Vegetable Soup

steps: 1. Fry sausage in skillet until lightly browned.
2. Drain sausage on paper towels.
3. Saute onion, celery and bell pepper in the drippings until wilted.
4. Add water and salt.
5. Bring to a boil for 2 minutes.
6. Remove from heat; add sausage and uncooked rice. Pour all into a greased casserole.
7. Put lid on; cook for 45 minutes.
8. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Sausage And Rice Royal

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients and stir well.
2. Yield:
3. 4 servings. Carbohydrate 6 g, protein 7 g, fat 12 g, calories 155.
title: Ham Salad

steps: 1. In a shallow bowl, combine the bread crumbs, paprika, salt and pepper. Brush potatoes with butter. Roll in crumb mixture until coated. Place in a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish or pan. Cover and bake at 350° for 1 hour or until tender. Makes 6 servings.
title: Crumb Coated Potatoes

steps: 1. Melt butter in saucepan and add cabbage.
2. Stir thoroughly, then add salt and water.
3. Cover and cook 10 minutes.
4. In a bowl, mix sugar, egg, flour and milk.
5. Add to cabbage.
6. Cook another minute.
7. Add the vinegar and serve.
8. Makes 4 servings.
title: Warm Slaw(Amish)

steps: 1. Combine all ingredients except cheese and potato chips.
2. Place in buttered baking dish.
3. Sprinkle cheese on top; add crushed potato chips.
4. Bake in 400° oven for 20 or 30 minutes.
5. Yields 6 servings.
title: Henny Penny(Hot Chicken Salad)

steps: 1. Mix the vinegar and sugar on stove until dissolved, not boiling.
2. Add the oil and pour over rest of ingredients.
3. Will keep for 2 weeks in refrigerator.
4. Serves 20.
5. Great for holidays.
title: Marinated Slaw

steps: 1. Place vegetables on a 24 x 18-inch piece of double thickness heavy-duty aluminum foil.
2. Sprinkle with remaining ingredients and add ice cubes on top.
3. Wrap foil securely.
4. Cover and grill packet 3 to 5 inches from medium coals for 20 to 25 minutes, turning once, until vegetables are tender.
5. Makes 4 servings.
title: Herbed Potatoes And Carrots

steps: 1. Chop apples, celery and pecans.
2. Mix Cool Whip and mayonnaise. Add chopped nuts to mayonnaise mixture.
3. Blend well.
4. Serves 6.
title: Waldorf Salad

steps: 1. Combine corn, egg, sugar, salt, pepper and butter.
2. Mix and sift flour and baking powder.
3. Add to first mixture.
4. Mix well. Drop batter from spoon into little fat in hot frying pan and brown on both sides.
5. Serves 6.
title: Corn Fritters

ingredients.text: 4 c. cooked lean beef, cut in strips

steps: 1. Put the meat strips on a rimmed platter and cover with sliced onions.
2. Sprinkle with parsley.
3. Mix together the oil, vinegar, oregano, mustard, and salt.
4. Pour over the meat, cover and chill for at least 3 hours to mingle flavors.
5. Makes 6 servings.
title: Marinated Beef Salad

steps: 1. Melt butter in a large saucepan.
2. Stir in celery, carrot and onion; coat with butter.
3. Add chicken.
4. Cook over low heat, covered, for 10 to 15 minutes.
5. Remove chicken, cut into small cubes and return to pan.
6. Add broth.
7. Bring to a boil and add noodles and corn.
8. Simmer for 15 minutes or until noodles are done.
9. Season with pepper and salt, if needed.
10. Makes about 4 servings.
title: Chicken Soup

steps: 1. Combine shredded cabbage, orange pieces, salt, pepper and raisins.
2. Mix mayonnaise and mustard together and blend through the salad.
3. Chill and serve.
4. Makes 4 to 6 servings.
title: Mission Coleslaw

steps: 1. Boil potatoes and slice 1/4-inch thick.
2. Slice onions 1/4-inch thick.
3. Layer 1/2 of the potatoes, onions and tomatoes.
4. Sprinkle with 1/2 each of salt, thyme and rosemary.
5. Repeat layers and seasonings.
6. Drizzle with oil, cover and bake 35 to 40 minutes at 425°.
7. Sprinkle with parsley before serving.
8. Serves 8.
9. Each 3/4 cup serving contains 105 calories.
title: Herbed Potatoes

ingredients.text: 1 small head cauliflower, cut into small pieces
1/2 c. Miracle Whip (spread over lettuce layer)

steps: 1. Layer in large casserole dish in order given.
2. Cover and refrigerate overnight.
3. Just before serving, mix to combine and serve.
4. Makes 10 to 12 servings.
title: Cauliflower Salad

steps: 1. Pare carrots and cut into 1/8-inch diagonal slices. Pare potatoes and cut into 1/8-inch crosswise slices. Place in alternating layers in lightly greased 1 1/2-quart baking dish or casserole. Melt butter in saucepan. Blend in flour and salt; stir in milk and cook, stirring constantly, until mixture thickens and comes to a boil. Add chives and caraway seed. Pour over carrots and potatoes in casserole.
2. Cover and bake in 350° oven 30 minutes. Remove cover and bake 30 minutes longer until carrots and potatoes are tender. Makes 4 to 6 servings.
title: Carrot-Potato Scallops

ingredients.text: 2 onions, peeled and sliced 1/4 inch thick

steps: 1. Sift flour and salt into a bowl.
2. Add milk, oil and egg.
3. Beat until smooth.
4. Separate onion into rings.
5. Dip each ring into batter.
6. Fry 2 to 3 minutes in heated oil (375°).
7. Drain; sprinkle with salt.
8. Makes 4 to 6 servings.
title: Fried Onion Rings

ingredients.text: 1 lb. fresh green beans, washed and tips removed

steps: 1. Heat oil in heavy saucepan.
2. Add onion and garlic.
3. Cook until golden.
4. Add remaining ingredients.
5. Juices should just cover beans in pan.
6. If not, add a little more water.
7. Cover. Cook over low heat for 45 minutes or until fork-tender.
8. Serve with pan juices.
9. Yields 4 servings.
title: Braised Green Beans

ingredients.text: 1 lb. green beans, trimmed1 tbsp. olive oil
3 red onions, each cut into 8 wedges (I used 2, but mine were big!)

steps: 1. 1. Bring water to a boil in a large saucepan; add beans. Cook 5-6 minutesor until crisp-tender. Drain; keep warm.2. Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Add onions;saute 8 minutes or until browned. Add broth; cook 3 minutes, stirringoccasionally. Stir in vinegar and remaining ingredients. Stir in beans;cover & cook 2 minutes. Yield: 14 servings.
title: Green Beans & Pan-Roasted Red Onions

ingredients.text: 4 c. cooked, cut up chicken (not too small)

steps: 1. Make night before serving.
2. Combine all ingredients except potato chips and cheese.
3. Place in flat rectangular dish; cover and place in refrigerator and let stand overnight.
4. Take out about an hour before baking.
5. Top with crushed potato chips and cheese. Bake at 400° for 30 or 40 minutes or until it bubbles.
6. Easy and good.
7. Serves 8 people.
title: Hot Chicken Salad Casserole

steps: 1. Work Bisquick into egg.
2. Roll and stretch dough until paper thin.
3. Cut into 1 1/2-inch squares or regular noodle strips.
4. Cover lightly with a towel and allow to dry at least 6 hours.
5. Drop into simmering broth or thin gravy.
6. Cover and cook gently about 15 minutes or until tender.
7. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Bisquick Noodles

steps: 1. Cut beans crosswise in 1-inch pieces.
2. Heat beans, water and salt to boiling point in a 2-quart saucepan.
3. Reduce heat; simmer, uncovered, for 5 minutes.
4. Add celery.
5. Cover and cook until beans are tender, about 10 minutes; drain.
6. Heat butter, lemon juice, seasoned salt, olives and pimento on low heat until butter melts.
7. Toss with beans.
8. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Green Beans Deluxe

steps: 1. In medium saucepan over medium to high heat, melt margarine. Add onion and celery.
2. Cook about 4 minutes or until soft, stirring frequently.
3. Add potatoes, chicken broth, parsley, thyme, celery seed, salt and pepper.
4. Bring to a boil.
5. Reduce heat and cover.
6. Simmer about 15 minutes or until potatoes are almost tender.
7. Add milk.
8. Simmer, uncovered, 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
9. In blender at medium speed, blend about 1/4 of the mixture at a time until smooth.
10. Return to saucepan, heat about 1 minute.
11. Makes 4 servings, about 1 cup each.
title: Cream Of Potato Soup(Heart Smart)

ingredients.text: 1 to 2 c. apple juice (depending on how moist you want the stuffing to be)

steps: 1. Place chops in ungreased casserole.
2. Saute celery and onion in margarine in saucepan over medium heat until onion is tender, about 5 minutes.
3. Toss celery mixture, croutons, nuts and apples in bowl. Stir in juice to desired moisture.
4. Spoon mixture evenly over chops.
5. Cover and cook in 350° oven for 30 minutes.
6. Uncover and cook until stuffing is dry on top, 15 to 20 minutes.
7. Serves 4.
title: Pork Chops And Apple Stuffing

steps: 1. Break up chilled, cooked cauliflower and head of lettuce, bite-size or to suit preference.
2. Combine.
3. Mix mayonnaise and sugar; add to cauliflower and lettuce.
4. Add cheese and bacon bits; mix well.
5. Serves 5.
title: Cauliflower Salad

steps: 1. Toast pecans in 350° oven for 8 to 10 minutes.
2. Mix pecans, chicken, celery, onions and bacon in large bowl.
3. Add mayonnaise, sour cream, salt and lemon juice, tossing well.
4. Spoon salad on bed of lettuce.
5. Garnish with tomato wedges, cold asparagus spears or hard-boiled eggs.
6. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Chicken Pecan Salad

steps: 1. In large kettle, saute onion in butter until soft.
2. Add cabbage; cook over low heat, stirring often, for 10 minutes.
3. Add the apples, wine, vinegar, sugar, salt and pepper; mix well. Cover kettle; lower heat and simmer for 1 hour, stirring several times.
4. Uncover kettle; raise heat.
5. Cook until all liquid is absorbed.
6. Pour into large serving bowl.
7. Makes 8 servings.
title: Savory Red Cabbage

ingredients.text: 3/4 c. chopped apple (with or without skins)

steps: 1. In medium bowl stir first 4 ingredients.
2. In cup stir dressing and brown sugar, pour over and gently toss to coat.
3. Serve on lettuce if you like.
4. Yields 2 or 3 servings.
title: Turkey Apple Salad

steps: 1. Toss carrots lightly with raisins. Blend remaining ingredients and stir into carrots, raisin mixture. Chill at least 30 minutes before serving. Makes 6 to 8 servings.
title: Carrot Raisin Salad

steps: 1. With a fork, gradually stir vinegar into mayonnaise, keeping smooth.
2. Add sugar and salt; mix well.
3. Pour over cabbage and mix thoroughly.
4. Refrigerate.
5. Makes 8 servings.
title: Tangy Cole Slaw

steps: 1. Mix together mayonnaise and lemon juice.
2. Toss together with other ingredients; chill.
3. Makes 6 to 8 servings.
title: Broccoli Salad

steps: 1. Core and dice apples to make about 4 cups. In a large bowl, sprinkle apples with lemon juice. Add celery, grapes, nuts and raisins. Combine mayonnaise, sugar and 1/2 teaspoon lemon juice. Spoon over apple mixture until well blended. Cover and chill. Serve on lettuce. Yields 8 servings.
title: Waldorf Salad

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients together.
2. Serve on crisp lettuce leaves. Serves 6.
title: Wilcox'S Apple Nut Salad

steps: 1. Drain salmon, saving juice.
2. Flake salmon; mix with potatoes, green onions, cucumber, celery, parsley and herb.
3. In small bowl, combine mayonnaise, lemon juice, salt, pepper and saved salmon juice.
4. Pour over salmon-potato mixture; mix gently but well.
5. Pack salad into 10-cup mold and chill.
6. When ready to serve, unmold and garnish with tomatoes and sprays of parsley.
7. Serves 8 to 10.
title: Salmon Potato Salad

steps: 1. Sprinkle meal into rapidly boiling water.
2. Add salt and heat, stirring over very low heat, about 1/2 hour until quite thick. Spoon into bowls, top with butter and serve hot for old-fashioned breakfast.
3. Serves 4.
title: Corn Meal Mush

steps: 1. Combine ingredients and mix well.
2. Serve on lettuce.
3. Makes 6 servings.
title: Carrot Apple Salad

steps: 1. * In a saucepan, melt butter; stir in flour, salt and pepper. Add chicken broth; cook and stir constantly until mixture boils. Cook for 1 minute; remove from the heat and mix in sour cream. Set aside.
2. In a skillet, brown pork chops in oil; season to taste with additional salt and pepper if desired.

3. * Place pork chops on bottom of a greased 13-in. x 9-in. baking dish. Layer potatoes and onion. Pour the broth mixture over. Cover and bake at 350° for 1 hour; uncover and bake 30 minute longer or until potatoes are tender. If desired, sprinkle with paprika and parsley. Yield: 6 servings.
title: Scalloped Potatoes With Pork Chops

ingredients.text: 15 oz. potatoes, cut like French fries (do not peel)

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 450°.
2. Beat egg white until frothy.
3. Add chili powder to egg white.
4. Dip potatoes in egg mixture.
5. Place on foil lined pan sprayed with nonstick cooking spray.
6. Bake for 25 minutes.
7. Serves 3.
title: French Fries

steps: 1. Wash and cut rhubarb.
2. Add sugar; let stand for a few minutes. Heat slowly and simmer gently until rhubarb is tender but still keeps its shape.
3. Soften gelatin in cold water; add to hot rhubarb.
4. Heat until gelatin is dissolved.
5. Add few drops of red coloring, if desired.
6. Cool until mixture begins to thicken.
7. Add nuts, celery and lemon juice.
8. Pour into molds.
9. Serves 6.
title: Rhubarb Salad

ingredients.text: 1 c. shredded medium sharp Cheddar cheese

steps: 1. Mash cooked squash; add to other ingredients and mix well. Pour into greased 1 quart casserole dish and bake at 375° for about 40 minutes.
2. Yields 6 servings.
title: Squash Casserole

steps: 1. Shred cabbage and put into a 13 x 9-inch casserole dish.
2. Add layer of sliced onion, separated into rings.
3. Add layer of sliced pepper.
4. Pour sugar over this.
5. Do not mix.
6. Combine vinegar, salt, celery seed, mustard and oil; bring to boil.
7. Pour over cabbage while hot.
8. Do not mix.
9. Put in refrigerator until cool or overnight.
10. It is best when it has had time to marinate.
11. Serves 8.
title: Dad'S Marinated Salad

steps: 1. In large skillet, heat oil until hot.
2. Saute potatoes 20 to 25 minutes, or until golden brown.
3. Stir in cayenne, tarragon, scallions, salt and pepper; toss to coat potatoes well.
4. Cook about one minute more.
5. Serves 4.
title: Cayenne Potatoes

ingredients.text: 2 Medium potatoes, peeled and cut in 1-inch cubes

steps: 1. In a deep pan, over a medium heat, saute the bacon, celery and onion until the onion is golden brown, about 5 minutes.

2. Add the potatoes, water and seasonings, raise the heat to high and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and cover, simmer for 15 minutes or until the potatoes are tender. Mash the potatoes slightly, about 1/4 of the cubes should be left whole. Remove the bay leaf, add the milk, Worcestershire sauce and parsley and bring back to a boil. Serves 4-6.
title: Country Potato Soup

steps: 1. Boil potatoes with skins on; cool and peel.
2. Add sour cream, salt and pepper to taste.
3. In nonstick pan, melt butter.
4. Add onions and shredded cheese.
5. After potatoes cool, grate them in bowl with mixture.
6. Put in buttered 13 x 9-inch glass Pyrex pan. Dot with butter and bake at 350° for 1 hour.
7. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Golden Potato Casserole

steps: 1. Place asparagus in a skillet; sprinkle with salt if desired. Add 1/2 inch of water; bring to a boil.
2. Reduce heat; cover and simmer until crisp-tender, about 4 minutes.
3. Meanwhile, melt butter; add lemon juice and sesame seeds.
4. Drain asparagus; drizzle with the butter mixture.
5. Makes 1 serving.
title: Sesame Asparagus

steps: 1. Mix flour, cheese, salt and pepper in bag.
2. Moisten potatoes with water coating each potato well with cheese mixture.
3. Melt butter in large baking pan (9 x 13-inch pan works well).
4. Put potatoes in single layers in pan.
5. Bake at 375° for 1 hour, turning potatoes halfway through baking time.
6. Serve hot.
7. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Roasted Potatoes With Parmesan Cheese

steps: 1. In large mixing bowl, mix Cool Whip, sour cream and sugar thoroughly.
2. Add pineapple, bananas and lemon juice.
3. Add pecans and cherries.
4. Keep covered in refrigerator or freezer.
5. This will serve 20 people.
6. Will keep from Thanksgiving until Christmas.
title: Snowball Salad

steps: 1. In large bowl, mix together mayonnaise, sugar, lemon juice, grated onion, salt and curry powder.
2. Add chicken, celery and bread cubes; toss lightly to mix.
3. Place in 13 x 9-inch baking dish.
4. Sprinkle with crushed potato chips, then cheese.
5. Bake at 450° for 15 minutes or until hot.
6. Serves 8.
7. Wonderful for ladies' luncheons or when company arrives unexpectedly.
