title: Ham And Cheese Omelet

steps: 1. Place 1/2 of the cubed bread on bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Arrange ham and cheeses over bread.
2. Beat eggs, milk and mustard together and pour over ham and cheese.
3. Add the remaining cubed bread and drizzle butter over top.
4. Serves 12 to 15.
title: Breakfast Casserole

ingredients.text: 4 slices white bread, cut in cubes

steps: 1. Layer bread, ham and cheese twice.
2. Mix eggs, milk, salt and mustard.
3. Pour over layers.
4. Refrigerate overnight.
5. Bake at 300° for 55 to 70 minutes.
6. Serves 6 for breakfast.
title: Breakfast Egg Casserole

steps: 1. In a large bowl, mix bread, ham, cheese, flour and mustard. Pour this mixture into a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
2. Beat eggs until foamy.
3. Add margarine and milk.
4. Beat again.
5. Pour this mixture over the first mixture.
6. Cover and chill overnight or at least 4 hours. Bake uncovered at 350° for 1 hour or so.
7. Serves 10 to 12.
title: Breakfast Casserole

steps: 1. Brown, drain and rinse sausage.
2. Mix all ingredients.
3. Pour into 11 x 7 x 2-inch casserole.
4. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Breakfast Sausage And Egg Casserole

steps: 1. Melt margarine in pan.
2. Fry onions and peppers until tender. Then add mushrooms, and ham then cook to desired doneness.
3. Beat eggs one at a time, and add them to pan.
4. Stir mixture, cooking until done.
5. Serves 2.
6. Preparation time: 1/2 hour.
title: Western Omelet With Mushrooms

ingredients.text: 1 lb. sausage, cooked, crumbled and drained

steps: 1. Grease 9 x 13-inch pan.
2. Sprinkle with cheeses.
3. Combine rest of ingredients together and mix well.
4. Pour over bread; refrigerate overnight.
5. Bake for 1 hour at 350° or until golden brown.
6. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Country Breakfast Casserole

steps: 1. Melt butter in baking dish.
2. Stir in sugar and cinnamon.
3. Place bread in double layers over sugar mixture.
4. Beat eggs and milk; pour over bread.
5. Cover and refrigerate overnight.
6. Bake in a 350° oven, covered, for 35 minutes.
7. Uncover and bake for 10 minutes. Cut into squares and invert onto plate.
8. Sprinkle with powdered sugar and serve with syrup.
9. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Company French Toast

steps: 1. Brown sausage and drain.
2. Spread crumbled sausage on bottom of 2-quart baking dish.
3. Sprinkle the grated cheese over the bread crumbs.
4. Mix the eggs and milk together and pour over the mixture. Cover the casserole and refrigerate for at least 8 hours.
5. It will keep 48 hours before baking.
6. Put in cold oven at 350° and bake for 40 minutes.
7. Let stand 2 minutes before serving.
8. Yields 8 servings.
title: Breakfast Casserole

ingredients.text: 3 oz. cooked ham, cut in cubes, or crumbled cooked bacon or sausage

steps: 1. Beat eggs, milk and seasoned salt.
2. Stir in remaining ingredients.
3. Pour into greased oblong baking dish or square 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish.
4. Cook, uncovered, in oven until omelet is set and top is golden brown, 40 to 45 minutes, at 325°.
5. Serves 6.
title: Ham-Cheese Oven Omelet

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°.
2. Trim bread and place in bottom of a 10 x 4-inch greased casserole.
3. Brown sausage and drain off grease. Add dry mustard to browned sausage.
4. Spoon over bread and sprinkle cheese on top of this.
5. Combine eggs, milk, half and half, salt and Worcestershire; pour over top.
6. Bake in a 350° oven for 30 to 35 minutes.
7. Serves 6.
8. Can be made in advance.
title: Sausage Strata(Breakfast Dish)

steps: 1. Tear up bread and place in a greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Brown sausage; drain. Spoon over bread. Sprinkle with grated cheese. Beat eggs, milk, salt and pepper together. Pour over mixture in baking dish. Let sit overnight. Bake next morning in preheated 350°oven for 35 to 45 minutes. Cheese will rise to top during baking. Makes 6 servings.
title: Breakfast Casserole

ingredients.text: 1/4 c. crushed onion, bacon or Canadian bacon, browned

steps: 1. Heat oven to 325°.
2. In oven melt butter in baking dish (9 x 13-inch) until dish is coated on bottom.
3. In a large mixing bowl beat eggs, sour cream, milk and salt until blended.
4. Stir in onion.
5. Pour into dish.
6. Bake until eggs are set but still moist, about 35 minutes.
7. Makes 12 servings.
title: Oven Omelet Brunch

ingredients.text: 2 c. cooked sausage, ham, 6 to 8 crumbled bacon strips or pepperoni

steps: 1. In a 7 x 11-inch greased baking dish, place bread and add cheese.
2. In medium bowl, beat eggs, salt, pepper and mustard.
3. Add milk to egg mixture and pour over bread and cheese.
4. Add meat. Refrigerate overnight.
5. Bake in morning at 350° for about 50 to 55 minutes.
6. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Breakfast Casserole

steps: 1. Brown and drain sausage.
2. Stir all ingredients together. Spoon into 12 x 17-inch pan.
3. Cover with foil and refrigerate overnight.
4. Bake the next morning at 350° for 1 hour or until knife inserted in the middle comes out clean.
5. Serves 10 to 12.
title: Breakfast Casserole

steps: 1. In a bowl, beat eggs and cream until light and fluffy.
2. Stir in the cheese, ham, green pepper and onion.
3. Pour into a greased 9-inch square baking dish.
4. Bake at 400 degrees for 25 minutes until golden brown.
5. Serves 4-6.
title: Oven Denver Omelet

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients in a casserole dish.
2. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until brown.
3. Serve with hot milk.
4. Serves 3 to 4 people.
title: Baked Oatmeal

ingredients.text: 3 slices white bread, cubed (or enough to cover bottom of dish)

steps: 1. Saute sausage.
2. Drain.
3. Beat eggs with milk, salt and mustard. Layer the bread cubes, sausage and cheese in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
4. Pour egg mixture on top.
5. Refrigerate overnight.
6. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
7. Place bacon across top during the last 5 minutes.
8. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Breakfast Casserole

steps: 1. Remove crust from bread.
2. Butter bread and place in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
3. Cook and drain sausage.
4. Spread over bread. Sprinkle cheese over sausage.
5. Combine eggs, half and half and salt.
6. Pour over all.
7. Chill overnight.
8. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
9. Serves 8.
title: Sausage Breakfast Casserole

steps: 1. Brown sausage in skillet, stirring until crumbly.
2. Drain. Line bottom of greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish with bread.
3. Layer cheese and sausage over bread.
4. Pour eggs over layers.
5. Chill, covered, overnight.
6. Bake for 30 minutes or until center is set in a preheated 350° oven.
7. Yields 8 servings.
title: Breakfast Casserole

steps: 1. Add milk and salt to slightly beaten eggs in mixing bowl.
2. Dip slices of bread into mixture.
3. Heat butter, margarine or shortening in skillet until hot enough to make a drop of water break into small bubbles and sputter.
4. Brown slices of bread on one side and then turn and brown on the other side.
5. Serve on hot plates with syrup or jelly.
6. Makes 3 servings.
title: French Toast

steps: 1. Mix sugar, eggs, baking powder, milk and butter.
2. Add oatmeal and salt.
3. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
4. Bake in 9 x 9-inch pan. Makes 6 servings.
title: Baked Oatmeal

steps: 1. Heat oven to 425°.
2. Melt butter in heavy 10-inch skillet in oven.
3. Beat eggs vigorously 30 seconds.
4. Gradually beat in flour. Mix in milk and salt.
5. Tip heated pan to coat with butter.
6. Pour in batter; bake 20 minutes.
7. Lower temperature to 300°.
8. Bake 5 minutes.
9. Cut into wedges.
10. Serve with maple syrup or with melted butter, lemon juice and confectioners sugar.
11. Serves 4.
title: Breakfast Flash:  Dutch Oven Omelet

steps: 1. Brown sausage; drain.
2. Combine eggs, milk, dry mustard and salt.
3. Add bread and sausage to egg mixture.
4. Pour into 8 x 8-inch casserole.
5. Sprinkle with cheese.
6. Refrigerate, covered, overnight. Bake, uncovered, at 325° for 45 to 50 minutes.
7. Yields 4 to 6 servings.
8. (You can double this recipe.)
title: Do Ahead Breakfast

steps: 1. Combine brown sugar, butter and 1 tsp. cinnamon in 9 x 13 baking dish.
2. Add apples and Craisins.
3. Spread mixture evenly over baking dish.
4. Arrange slices of bread on top.
5. Mix eggs, milk, vanilla, 2 tsp. cinnamon until well blended.
6. Pour egg mixture over bread evenly - cover and refrigerate for 24 hours.
7. Bake with foil over top in 375° oven for 40 minutes.
8. Uncover and bake another 5 minutes.
9. Remove from oven, pour maple syrup evenly over everything.
10. Let sit for 5 minutes before serving.
11. Serves 8.
title: French Toast

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 425°.
2. Mix together cottage cheese, milk, sugar, eggs and vanilla until smooth.
3. Transfer mixture to a shallow dish; place bread in it and let stand for 10 minutes. Turn bread over and let stand another 10 minutes.
4. Grease a baking sheet and place it in a preheated oven for 7 minutes. Remove baking sheet from oven; place bread on it.
5. Bake 6 minutes. Turn bread over and bake 5 to 6 minutes more, until golden brown. Serve with maple or jam.
6. Serves 4.
title: Baked French Toast

ingredients.text: 1 lb. pork sausage, cooked, crumbled and drained

steps: 1. Grease 9 x 13-inch pan well.
2. Place bread in pan.
3. Sprinkle with cheeses.
4. Combine rest of ingredients together and mix well. Pour over bread and refrigerate overnight.
5. Bake 1 hour at 350° or until golden brown.
6. Serves 6 to 8 people.
title: Country Breakfast Casserole(Great For Company)

steps: 1. Break eggs into a shallow dish.
2. Beat with fork lightly.
3. Stir in salt, sugar and milk.
4. Heat a little butter in a skillet.
5. Dip bread slices into mixture, both sides.
6. Brown both sides.
7. Serve with syrup.
8. Makes 10 to 12 servings.
title: French Toast

ingredients.text: 9 slices white bread, broken up (crusts off)

steps: 1. Brown sausage, break up and drain. Beat eggs and milk well. Break up and drop into egg mixture.
2. Add grated cheese and crumbled sausage.
3. Pour into greased pans and refrigerate. Take out of refrigerator ahead of cooking if you want it to cook quicker.
4. Serves 20. Bake at 350° for 2 hours.
title: Breakfast

steps: 1. Make this recipe the night before.
2. Fry sausage and drain off grease.
3. Combine eggs, salt, mustard and onion; beat well.
4. Add half and half.
5. Grease a 9 x 13-inch glass pan and line with bread cubes.
6. Sprinkle sausage and cheese on top.
7. Pour egg mixture over all.
8. Refrigerate overnight.
9. Bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Breakfast Casserole

ingredients.text: 7 or 8 slices bread, cut into 1/4-inch cubes

steps: 1. Cook sausage.
2. Drain and set aside.
3. Combine remaining ingredients, then add sausage.
4. Pour into well-greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
5. Refrigerate overnight before baking.
6. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
7. Serves 10.
title: Kitty'S Corner Breakfast Casserole

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 450°.
2. Add sugar and salt to unbeaten egg in shallow dish and stir until well mixed.
3. Stir in milk and oil.
4. Dip bread in mixture and place in well-greased large cookie sheet or jelly roll pan.
5. Bake until brown, about 10 minutes.
6. This is much easier than frying in deep fat and not nearly as fattening.
7. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Oven French Toast

ingredients.text: 6 slices bread, crusts removed and cubed
1 lb. sausage, cooked, crumbled and drained
1/3 c. sliced mushrooms (fresh or canned), drained

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients in a large bowl. Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
2. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes or until firm in center.
3. Yields 6 to 8 servings.
title: Make-Ahead Breakfast Casserole

steps: 1. Cook bacon; drain.
2. Curl 1 slice, chop 4 slices and leave others as whole slices.
3. Cut cheese slices into halves.
4. Arrange in the bottom of a lightly greased 9-inch pie pan.
5. Beat together the eggs and milk with fork.
6. Add chopped bacon.
7. Pour over cheese and bake in preheated 350° oven for 30 minutes.
8. Arrange whole bacon slices on top of omelet around bacon curl.
9. Bake 10 minutes longer.
10. Let stand 5 minutes before cutting.
11. Serves 6.
title: Bacon And Cheese Oven Omelet

ingredients.text: 1 lb. sausage, browned, drained and chopped

steps: 1. Grease 13 x 9-inch cake pan.
2. Place bread pieces in pan. Sprinkle browned and drained sausage over bread.
3. Add grated cheese, then add beaten eggs to milk, onion and pepper.
4. Pour over mixture.
5. Refrigerate overnight.
6. Bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes until brown on top.
7. Let set 15 minutes before cutting. Serves 9.
title: Breakfast Casserole

steps: 1. Brown sausage; drain.
2. Beat eggs.
3. Add the remaining ingredients, including the sausage.
4. Spread in a 9 x 13-inch pan. Refrigerate overnight.
5. Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.
6. Serves 12.
title: Breakfast Casserole

steps: 1. Cook sausage over low heat until done and a crumbly consistency; drain and set aside.
2. Spread butter on bread and cut into cubes.
3. Place bread in a 13 x 9-inch dish.
4. Sprinkle sausage on bread and cheese on top of sausage.
5. Combine remaining ingredients.
6. Beat well and pour over cheese.
7. Chill 8 hours or overnight.
8. Bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes until brown.
9. Serves 8 to 10.
title: Breakfast Casserole

steps: 1. Melt as much butter as desired in a frypan set at 320° or medium heat.
2. Cream the cream cheese in mixer bowl on #4 speed until creamy.
3. Add eggs; beat 1/2 minute on #8 speed.
4. Scrape bowl and beaters.
5. Add milk, salt and pepper.
6. Blend in on #4 speed.
7. Pour mixture into frypan.
8. Cook slowly, scraping a few times from bottom and sides with a spoon.
9. Do not stir constantly. Cook only until set, but still moist.
10. Serve with bacon, ham or sausage.
11. Garnish with chopped parsley or chives.
12. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Creamy Scrambled Eggs

steps: 1. In blender, combine milk, peanut butter and honey.
2. Blend until smooth, about 30 seconds.
3. Pour into 4 cup glass measure; cook at High 4 minutes just until bubbly.
4. Pour into 4 heatproof mugs.
5. Top with a marshmallow puff.
6. Makes 4 servings.
title: Peanutty Breakfast Mugs

ingredients.text: 6 slices Italian bread, butter both sides

steps: 1. Line buttered 9 x 13-inch baking dish with buttered bread. Spread sausage over bread. Add cheese and spread evenly.
2. Beat eggs and half and half together.
3. Pour over sausage and cheese layers. Refrigerate overnight. Bake at 350°, uncovered, for 40 minutes.
4. Serve hot.
5. Yields 6 to 8 servings.
title: Gretchen Fayhey'S Quick Breakfast Casserole

steps: 1. Mash tofu fine.
2. Saute onions in oil until soft.
3. Add tofu, parsley flakes, salt and turmeric.
4. Mix well.
5. Saute for 3 or 4 minutes.
6. Serves 6.
title: Tofu Scrambled

steps: 1. Beat the eggs and spices together in a medium bowl. Stir in green pepper, onions and tomato.

2. Microwave mixture on High for 3 1/2 to 5 minutes or until the eggs are soft-set, stirring 2 to 3 times during cooking. Sprinkle eggs with Monterey Jack cheese. Cover and let eggs stand for 1 to 2 minutes or until the cheese melts. Makes 4 servings.
title: Microwave Santa Fe Scrambled Eggs

steps: 1. Crumble and fry sausage.
2. Drain fat.
3. Break bread into pieces and place in bottom of greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
4. Place sausage on top of bread.
5. Mix together the eggs, milk and mustard.
6. Pour over bread and sausage.
7. Top with cheese.
8. Refrigerate overnight.
9. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
10. Cut into squares.
11. Serves 12 to 16.
title: Breakfast Casserole

steps: 1. Heat waffle iron according to manufacturers directions.
2. In a large bowl, beat eggs with a rotary beater or mixer until fluffy. Beat in flour, oil, milk, baking powder, sugar, cinnamon and salt. Stir in nuts.
3. Pour batter onto center of hot waffle iron using the amount suggested by manufacturer.
4. Bake about 5 minutes or until golden brown.
5. Makes 16 servings.
title: Cinnamon Nut Waffles

steps: 1. Mix ingredients and let sit overnight in a 11 x 7 x 1 1/2-inch Pyrex dish.
2. Bake in 350° oven for 45 minutes.
3. This is great for a Sunday brunch.
4. Serves 6.
title: Egg And Sausage Breakfast Dish

steps: 1. Crumble and brown sausage and drain.
2. Beat eggs with milk and salt.
3. Layer bread cubes, sausage and cheese in a 9 x 13 x 2 inch casserole dish.
4. Pour egg mixture on top.
5. Cover and refrigerate overnight.
6. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
7. Serves 6 - 8.
title: "The Night Before" Breakfast Casserole

steps: 1. Heat sour cream, salt and pepper in double boiler.
2. Add tomatoes and avocado.
3. Heat for another 5 minutes.
4. Meanwhile, blend the beaten eggs with milk and salt.
5. Pour into heated butter in skillet and cook gently, lifting edges occasionally to let uncooked part run underneath.
6. When set, pour half of sauce mixture over omelet and fold over.
7. Place on hot platter and pour on the rest of the sauce.
8. Makes 4 to 6 servings.
title: Avocado Omelet

ingredients.text: 14 slices white bread, trim crust and cube
2 lb. mild sausage, cooked and drained

steps: 1. Mix eggs, milk and mustard.
2. Layer bread, sausage and cheese in 11 x 13-inch pan.
3. Pour egg and milk mixture over layers.
4. Let sit overnight in refrigerator.
5. Bake at 325° for 1 hour.
6. Serves 12.
title: Breakfast Casserole

steps: 1. Saute sausage.
2. Trim crusts from bread.
3. Arrange in greased 9 x 13-inch pan.
4. Set aside.
5. Combine milk, eggs, salt, pepper and Worcestershire.
6. Beat well.
7. Drain sausage.
8. Mix with mustard. Spread over bread slices.
9. Add cheese. Pour egg mixture over bread, sausage and cheese.
10. Refrigerate overnight.
11. Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes, uncovered.
12. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Breakfast Casserole

steps: 1. In a buttered 9 x 12-inch pan, layer bread, cheese, bacon and sausage.
2. Combine other ingredients and pour over casserole. Cover and let stand overnight.
3. Bake at 325° for 45 minutes. Serves 10 to 12.
title: Breakfast Casserole

steps: 1. Break bread in small pieces. Brown sausage and drain fat.
2. Mix all ingredients well; put in casserole and bake at 350° for 45 minutes. This may be made in the evening, refrigerated overnight and baked the next morning. Serves 8.
title: Breakfast Dish

steps: 1. Place an 8-inch omelet pan over moderate heat.
2. Do not overheat or butter will smoke and burn.
3. Beat eggs, water, salt and pepper thoroughly with a fork.
4. Add remaining ingredients, except butter. When pan is hot, add butter and stir around quickly to coat bottom of pan.
5. Pour in egg mixture and shake pan with one hand, stirring mixture with the other.
6. An omelet should remain soft and creamy in the center.
7. To turn out of pan, hold handle.
8. If a filling is used, place a small amount in upper half of omelet.
9. Raise pan to a 45° angle and using a fork, start to roll omelet from the top down. Turn onto a warm plate and serve immediately.
10. Makes 1 serving.
title: Chicago Omelet

steps: 1. Lightly beat eggs together.
2. Add mayonnaise and water and scramble lightly.
3. Heat large skillet on medium-low; add margarine. Add egg mixture.
4. When eggs are set on the edges, stir slightly. Repeat whenever edges are set.
5. Add salt and pepper to taste.
6. Do not overcook.
7. Serves 4.
title: Scrambled Eggs

steps: 1. Fry sausage until crumbled.
2. Drain and pour into casserole dish.
3. Mix eggs, salt, mustard and milk.
4. Sprinkle with bread crumbs and cheese.
5. For best flavor, let set overnight in refrigerator.
6. Cook for 45 minutes at 350° in a 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan.
7. Freezes well.
8. Makes 6 to 8 servings.
title: Breakfast Before

ingredients.text: 2 c. half and half (2% milk can be used)

steps: 1. Place croutons in greased 13 x 9 x 2 casserole. Cook sausage until brown, crumble and drain well. Spoon over croutons. Sprinkle with cheese. Combine eggs, milk or cream and salt. Pour over cheese. Cover and chill overnight. Remove from refrigerator 15 minutes before baking. Bake at 350° uncovered for 45 minutes or until set. Serves 8.
title: Sausage Breakfast Casserole

ingredients.text: 1 c. (4 oz.) sharp Cheddar cheese, shredded

steps: 1. Crumble sausage in a medium skillet.
2. Cook over medium heat until brown; drain well.
3. Spread bread cubes in a buttered 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish and top with sausage and cheese.
4. Combine eggs, milk and seasonings.
5. Beat well and pour over cheese.
6. Cover and refrigerate overnight.
7. Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes or until set.
8. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Make Ahead Breakfast Bake

steps: 1. Serves 2

2. Adjust racks to top and middle positions and preheat oven to 450 degrees. Wash and dry all produce. Dice sweet potatoes into 1/2-inch pieces. Toss on a baking sheet with a drizzle of oil, salt, and pepper. Roast on top rack for 12 minutes (we'll roast the zucchini then).

3. Meanwhile, halve and core apple; thinly slice into half-moons. Peel and finely chop garlic. Quarter lemon. Trim and halve zucchini lengthwise; cut crosswise into 1/2-inch-thick half-moons. Toss on a second baking sheet with a drizzle of oil and a pinch of salt and pepper. Set aside.

4. Pat pork dry with paper towels and season all over with salt and pepper. Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add pork and cook until browned and cooked through, 4-5 minutes per side. Turn off heat; transfer to a plate.
5. Once sweet potatoes have roasted 12 minutes, transfer baking sheet with zucchini to middle rack and continue roasting until both veggies are browned and softened, 12-15 minutes more.

6. Meanwhile, melt 1 TBSP butter (2 TBSP for 4 servings) in pan used for pork over medium-high heat. Add apple and season with salt and pepper. Cook, scraping up any browned bits from bottom of pan, until apple is slightly softened, 2-3 minutes. Add garlic; cook until fragrant, 30 seconds. Add 1/z cup water (3/4 cup for 4), stock concentrate, and 11/2 tsp sugar (3 tsp for 4). Cook, stirring, until sauce has thickened and apple is very tender, 3-5 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.

7. Remove pan with apple from heat; stir in 1 TBSP butter (2 TBSP for 4 servings) and a squeeze of lemon juice. Divide pork, zucchini, and sweet potatoes between plates. Top pork with glazed apple sauce. Top zucchini with a squeeze of lemon juice.
title: Skillet Apple Pork Chops with Roasted Sweet Potatoes & Zucchini

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°F (180°C). Grease an 8-inch (20 cm) square baking pan.

2. To make the date filing: Combine the dates and water in a medium saucepan over high heat and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low and simmer gently, stirring occasionally until the mixture thickens, around 6 to 8 minutes. Remove from heat, stir in vanilla and let cool. Set aside.

3. Combine rolled oats, flour, sugar, baking soda and salt in a food processor. Pulse 3 times (careful not to overmix, you don’t want the mixture to be powdery, just combined). Add butter and pulse again until the mixture is crumbly in pea-sized clumps. Transfer to a mixing bowl to thoroughly mix in the butter.

4. Spread half of the oat mixture on the bottom of the prepared baking pan, pressing down to make a flat, equal bottom later. Add the date mixture over the crust and then spread evenly. Layer with the remaining oat mixture and press down to flatten the top layer.

5. Bake in the centre of the oven until the top is golden brown, 30 to 35 minutes. Let cool completely in the pan before cutting and serving. Date Squares keep well, covered in the refrigerator for up to a week, and frozen for 2 to 3 months.
title: Date squares

steps: 1. Combine flour, sugar and salt in 1 1/2-quart bowl.
2. Add syrup and eggs, one at a time, beating after each addition.
3. Add milk, pecans and vanilla; blend well.
4. Pour into pie shell.
5. Bake near center of oven at 375° for 50 minutes.
6. Cool before serving. Yield: 8 servings.
title: Pecan Pie

steps: 1. Bring milk to full rapid boil.
2. Stir in cornmeal.
3. Cook until very thick, stirring constantly, to prevent scorching.
4. Remove from heat and cool slightly.
5. Beat eggs well.
6. Add to cornmeal mixture with salt, butter and baking powder.
7. Beat for 5 minutes.
8. Pour into well-greased 1-quart round casserole.
9. Bake in preheated oven at 375° for 30 minutes or until golden brown.
10. Serves 4 to 5.
title: Southern Spoon Bread

steps: 1. Mix altogether except pecans.
2. Add pecans last.
3. Pour into unbaked 9-inch pie shell.
4. Heat oven to 425°.
5. Reduce heat to 325° when you put pie in.
6. Bake 1 hour.
7. Makes 6 to 8 servings.
title: Pecan Pie

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°.

2. Prepare your favorite flaky pie crust. Beat eggs well in medium bowl. Add next 4 ingredients, beating until well blended. Arrange pecans in bottom of pie crust and carefully pour mixture over them. Bake 1 hour or until knife inserted from edge comes out clean. Allow to cool. Serves 8.
title: Granny'S Pecan Pie

steps: 1. Beat all ingredients except pecans in medium bowl with wire whisk or hand beater until well blended. Stir in pecans. Pour into unbaked pie crust. Bake in preheated 375° oven 40 to 50 minutes or until center is set. Serves 8.
title: Pecan Pie

steps: 1. Mix dry ingredients.
2. Add onion, cheese, egg and milk.
3. Drop into hot cooking oil from a spoon.
4. The hush puppies will float on top when done.
5. Serve with fried fish.
6. This recipe is about 60 years old.
7. Serves 8 to 10.
title: Hush Puppies

steps: 1. Use fresh or canned whole corn.
2. Combine all of the dry ingredients and add the milk.
3. Add this to the lightly beaten eggs.
4. Add melted butter and the corn.
5. Turn into a buttered casserole and bake 30 to 40 minutes at 325°.
6. Serves 6.
title: Southern Corn Pudding(Recipe Originated With My Grandmother)

steps: 1. In a large bowl, beat eggs until foamy.
2. Add sugar, corn syrup, butter, salt and vanilla.
3. Continue to beat until thoroughly blended.
4. Stir in peanuts.
5. Pour into pie shell and bake at 375° for 50 to 55 minutes or until set.
6. Serve warm or cold.
7. Garnish with whipped cream or ice cream.
8. Makes 6 to 8 servings.
title: Southern Peanut Pie

steps: 1. Sift first 3 ingredients together into top of double boiler and add milk. Cook, stirring constantly, until medium thick. Separate 1 egg with yolk in a cup. Add some of hot milk mixture to egg yolk and beat together, then add to double boiler. Stir a minute more and add vanilla extract. Layer custard over sliced bananas and vanilla wafers, twice. Top with meringue made from the egg white, a pinch of cream of tartar and 2 tablespoons of sugar beaten together. May broil meringue topped pudding for a skinny minute to turn meringue golden. Serves 6 to 8.
title: The Best Banana Pudding(Serves 6 To 8)

steps: 1. Beat eggs; add sugar, corn syrup and salt and mix well.
2. Stir in oleo, vanilla and pecans.
3. Pour into pie shell and bake at 350° for 45 to 55 minutes.
4. Is done when knife inserted comes out clean.
5. Serves 8.
title: Pecan Pie

steps: 1. Beat eggs until light.
2. Add milk, corn, seasonings and oil in a large mixing bowl.
3. Mix well.
4. Turn into a 1-quart buttered casserole.
5. Bake in a 350° oven for 30 minutes.
6. Makes 6 servings.
title: Southern Corn Pudding

steps: 1. Mix sugar and flour.
2. Beat egg yolks.
3. Add milk and butter. Mix in flour and sugar.
4. Pour into unbaked pie shell.
5. Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes or until firm.
6. Add meringue and brown. Best served warm.
7. Serves 8.
title: Chess Pie

steps: 1. Beat together egg, milk and cooking oil.
2. Combine dry ingredients and beat next 3. Add and mix.
3. Grease loaf pan and microwave on Medium 9 to 11 minutes until toothpick comes out clean.
4. Serves 6.
title: Microwave Cornbread(For Summertime Baking - Cool)

steps: 1. In medium saucepan, gradually stir in cornmeal and salt into boiling water.
2. Cook over medium flame, stirring constantly until thick.
3. Add butter and milk; beat until smooth.
4. Let cool to room temperature.
5. Beat egg whites until stiff peaks form; set aside. Using same beaters, beat egg yolks until thick and lemon colored. Stir egg yolks and baking powder into cornmeal mixture, mixing well.
6. Gently fold in egg whites until well combined.
7. Pour into a greased 2-quart casserole.
8. Bake in a preheated 375° gas oven for 40 to 50 minutes until golden brown and puffy.
9. To serve, spoon from casserole and serve hot with butter.
10. Yield:
11. 8 servings.
title: Southern Spoon Bread

steps: 1. Cook in saucepan all ingredients, except egg whites, 5 tablespoons sugar and vanilla, until thick and caramel colored. Pour in a baked pie shell.
2. Make meringue with egg whites, adding remaining sugar a little at a time.
3. Add vanilla.
4. Brown.
5. Serves 8.
title: Raisin And Pecan Pie

steps: 1. Pour 3 tablespoons oil in skillet and spread to cover completely.
2. Mix remaining ingredients; pour into skillet.
3. Bake 20 to 25 minutes at 400°.
4. Serves 8.
title: Cornbread

steps: 1. Combine dry ingredients.
2. Add combined milk, margarine and egg, mixing until moistened.
3. Stir in cheese.
4. For each serving, spoon approximately 1/4 cup mixture onto hot, lightly greased griddle. Flatten slightly.
5. Cook until lightly browned on both sides.
6. Serve warm with butter.
7. If batter becomes too thick, add small amount of milk.
8. Makes 20 servings.
title: Fried Cornbread

steps: 1. Preheat oven and cookie sheet to 350°.
2. In a large bowl, stir the first 5 ingredients until well blended.
3. Stir in pecans.
4. Pour into pie shell.
5. Bake on cookie sheet 50 to 55 minutes or until knife inserted halfway between center and edge comes out clean. Cool.
6. Serves 8.
title: Pecan Pie

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 325°.
2. Grease bottom of an 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch loaf pan.
3. Stir together flour, baking powder, salt and spices in mixing bowl.
4. With a spoon, stir in sugar, eggs, oil and milk.
5. Stir to blend.
6. Stir in sweet potatoes, pecans and raisins. Pour batter into prepared pan.
7. Bake for 1 hour and 10 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.
8. Cool in pan for 15 minutes.
9. Remove from pan and cool on wire rack.
10. For easier slicing, wrap loaf and store overnight in a cool place.
11. Makes 8 to 10 servings.
title: Southern Sweet Potato Pecan Bread

steps: 1. Heat oven to 375°.
2. In small mixer bowl, beat eggs, sugar, salt, butter, syrup and cream.
3. Stir in vanilla, brandy and pecans.
4. Pour into a 9-inch unbaked pie shell.
5. Bake 40 to 50 minutes or until filling is set and pastry is golden brown.
6. Cool. Makes 10 to 12 servings.
title: Deluxe Pecan Pie

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 375°.
2. Melt butter in heavy skillet, medium heat.
3. Add next 7 ingredients and cook until vegetables are tender stirring frequently (about 10 minutes).
4. While vegetables are cooking combine egg, meat, breadcrumbs, 1/4 cup catsup and Worcestershire in medium size bowl Blend in sauteed vegetables. Form mixture into loaf in baking dish.
5. Bake 20 minutes.
6. Spread top with remaining 1/4 cup catsup and bake 40 minutes or more. Makes 2 to 4 servings.
title: Cajun Meat Loaf

steps: 1. Combine cornmeal, flour, salt and baking powder; add egg and milk and stir into cornmeal mixture until moist.
2. Put shortening into a 10-inch skillet and put into a preheated 425° oven.
3. As soon as shortening is hot, coat sides of skillet and stir remaining shortening into cornbread mixture.
4. Pour mixture into hot skillet and bake at 425° for 30 minutes or until golden brown. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

steps: 1. Combine first 4 ingredients and stir well.
2. Add beaten egg and buttermilk; stir until smooth.
3. Pour batter into a 9-inch pan coated with cooking spray.
4. Bake at 400° for 35 minutes or until golden brown.
5. Makes 9 servings; 120 calories per serving.
title: Dieter'S Cornbread

steps: 1. Heat oven to 375 degrees. Beat eggs in large bowl using electric mixer on medium speed for 15 seconds. Add syrup, vanilla, flour and brown sugar and beat for 15 more seconds. Stir in chocolate chips and pecan halves with a large spoon. Pour pecan mixture into frozen pie crust. Bake on center oven rack for 45 minutes or until a knife inserted in center comes out clean. Serves 10.
title: Mission Trail Chocolate Pecan Pie

steps: 1. Saute onion, celery and pepper in butter until tender.
2. Stir in ketchup.
3. Combine 1/2 cup of this mixture with ground beef, bread crumbs, egg and salt.
4. Form into loaf (8 x 4 x 1/2-inch) in shallow pan.
5. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
6. Let stand 5 minutes before slicing.
7. Serve remaining sauce cold or heated over meat loaf. Makes 6 servings.
title: Creole Meat Loaf

steps: 1. Mix everything and pour mixture into greased pan.
2. Bake at 400° for 30 minutes.
3. Makes 8 servings.
title: Tim'S Cornbread

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 425°.
2. Sift together flour, sugar, cornmeal, baking soda and salt.
3. Add beaten egg and milk to make a stiff batter.
4. Add shortening and beat until well mixed.
5. Pour into greased pan.
6. Bake for 15 minutes.
7. Brush top with melted butter or margarine and bake 5 to 10 minutes longer.
8. Serve while hot. Makes 6 to 8 servings.
title: Grandmother'S Cornbread Cake

steps: 1. In small mixer bowl, beat eggs, sugar, salt, butter, syrup and cream.
2. Stir in vanilla, brandy and pecans.
3. Pour into pastry-lined pie pan.
4. Bake 40 to 50 minutes or until filling is set and pastry is golden brown.
5. Cool.
6. Makes 10 to 12 servings.
title: Deluxe Pecan Pie

steps: 1. Boil sweet potatoes until tender.
2. Peel and mash.
3. Melt butter in milk and add to sweet potatoes.
4. Mix well.
5. Beat egg whites until stiff.
6. Set aside.
7. Add yolks and remaining ingredients to potatoes.
8. Gently fold in egg whites.
9. Pour into pie shell and bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.
10. Makes 6 to 8 servings.
title: Sweet Potato Pie

steps: 1. Sift dry ingredients together until well mixed. Cut in fat until well blended. Place in a glass jar. Keep tightly closed in a cool place. Mixture will keep for 1 to 6 months on the shelf in dry weather. In hot and humid weather, store in the refrigerator.

2. Cornmeal Muffins-Grease 8 medium-size muffin cups. Combine 2-1/4 cups Cornmeal Mix, 2/3 cup water and 1 beaten egg. Stir just enough to moisten dry ingredients. Fill muffin cups 2/3 full. Bake at 425 degrees F for about 20 minutes. Makes 8.
3. Cornmeal Biscuits-Add about 1/2 cup water to 2 cups Cornmeal Mix to make a soft dough. Drop by tablespoonfuls onto a greased baking sheet. Bake at 425 degrees F for 12 minutes. Makes 12 biscuits.

4. Cornbread-Combine 4 1/2 cups Cornmeal Mix, 2 beaten eggs and 1 1/3 cups water. Stir just enough to moisten dry ingredients. Pour into a greased pan, about 8 inches square. Bake at 425 degrees F for about 25 minutes. Serves 12.
5. Blueberry Cornbread-Add 1 cup fresh or partially-thawed frozen blueberries to Cornbread batter and mix gently. Bake as directed.
6. Cheese Cornbread-After turning Cornbread batter into pan, sprinkle with shredded Cheddar cheese and sesame seed. Bake as directed.
title: Cornmeal (Cornbread)  Mix

ingredients.text: 2 c. fresh grated corn or chopped, canned, frozen, cooked corn

steps: 1. Put in a buttered baking dish.
2. Set in a pan of hot water. Bake at 325° until firm (about 45 minutes).
3. Serves 4 to 6.
title: Southern Corn Pudding

steps: 1. Beat eggs lightly; add sugar, syrups, salt, vanilla and melted butter.
2. Line pie crust with pecans and pour filling over the nuts.
3. Bake slowly in a 350° oven for 50 to 60 minutes.
4. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Pecan Pie

steps: 1. Boil potatoes in enough water to cover till tender.
2. Peel and mash, add all other ingredients.
3. Flavor with lemon or nutmeg and bake in pie shell at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.
4. Yield:
5. 8 to 10 servings.
title: Homesteader'S Sweet Potato Pie

steps: 1. Mix and bake in 8 x 8-inch pan sprayed with nonstick cooking spray.
2. Bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.
3. Makes 6 servings.
4. One serving = 1 bread, 1/4 fat and 15 optional calories.
title: Cornbread

steps: 1. Mix first 6 ingredients together.
2. Stir in pecans.
3. Bake at 400° for 15 minutes.
4. Reduce heat and bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.
5. Outer edge of filling should be set, center slightly soft.
6. Makes 8 to 10 servings.
title: Easy Pecan Pie

steps: 1. Combine brown sugar and cornstarch in a saucepan.
2. Gradually add milk.
3. Cook, stirring constantly, until mixture comes to a boil.
4. Cook 1 minute.
5. Stir one-fourth of hot milk into egg.
6. Add to remaining hot mixture.
7. Cook until thick.
8. Stir in margarine and vanilla.
9. Cool.
10. Put layer of vanilla wafers, then layer of bananas and pour custard over.
11. Repeat layer.
12. Beat egg whites until stiff.
13. Add 2 tablespoons sugar.
14. Spread on top.
15. Bake at 325° for 20 minutes or until golden brown.
16. Makes 6 servings.
title: Banana Pudding(Only 1 Mg Cholesterol Per Serving)

steps: 1. Beat eggs slightly; add sugar, melted butter, vanilla, syrup, salt and cocoa.
2. Mix well.
3. Arrange pecans in pie crust.
4. Pour filling over pecans.
5. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes, then lower oven temperature to 300° and bake for an additional 30 minutes.
6. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Chocolate Pecan Pie

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°.
2. Butter and flour 13 x 9-inch baking pan.
3. Heat water, butter, sugar and salt to boiling in saucepan over medium heat.
4. Whisk in cornmeal and cook 2 minutes.
5. Remove from heat and place in large bowl.
6. Whisk in milk until smooth. Add eggs and baking powder.
7. Pour into pan.
8. Bake 35 to 40 minutes until puffed and golden brown.
9. Makes 12 servings.
title: Southern Spoon Bread

ingredients.text: 2 c. cooked, mashed sweet potatoes (I used baked potatoes)

steps: 1. Mix first 8 ingredients together while potatoes are warm.
2. Add milk.
3. Beat egg whites until stiff, adding gradually 1/4 cup sugar.
4. Fold into mixture and pour into unbaked pie shell.
5. Bake at 400° for 10 minutes.
6. Lower temperature to 350° and bake until set.
7. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Sweet Potato Pie

steps: 1. In a bowl, combine cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder, salt and baking soda. Add egg, milk and corn. Stir just until moistened. In a deep fryer, heat oil to 375°. Drop batter by teaspoonfuls into oil. Fry until golden brown. Yield: 12 to 15 servings.
title: Hush Puppies

steps: 1. In large bowl, stir first 4 ingredients until well blended. Stir in pecans.
2. Pour into pie shell.
3. Bake in 350° oven for 50 to 55 minutes or until knife inserted halfway between center and edge comes out clean.
4. Cool.
5. Serves 8.
title: Pecan Pie

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°.
2. Combine butter, sugar and corn syrup; mix well.
3. Beat in eggs until fluffy; stir in bourbon and vanilla; set aside.
4. Sprinkle chips over the bottom of pan.
5. Sprinkle pecans over the chips; pour filling on top.
6. Bake 45 to 50 minutes. Makes 8 servings.

steps: 1. In mixing bowl, cream margarine and sugar. Add eggs and milk. Combine flour, cornmeal, baking powder and salt; add to creamed mixture. Pour into a greased 13 x 9 x 2 baking pan. Bake at 400° for 22 to 27 minutes. Makes 12 to 15 servings.
title: 1St Place State Fair Cornbread

steps: 1. Line pastry shell with pecans. Set aside. Blend sugar, salt, corn syrup and vanilla. Beat in eggs, one at a time, mixing well. Pour mixture over pecans and dot with butter.
2. Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until knife inserted in center of pie comes out clean. Makes 6 to 8 servings.
title: Best-Ever Pecan Pie

steps: 1. Combine first 5 ingredients; cook over medium heat until thickened, stirring constantly.
2. Remove from heat.
3. Beat eggs at medium speed of an electric mixer.
4. Gradually stir about one-fourth of the hot mixture into eggs; add to the remaining hot mixture, stirring constantly.
5. Pour into a lightly greased 1 1/2-quart casserole.
6. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes or until a knife inserted in center comes out clean.
7. Yield:
8. 6 servings.
title: Southern Spoonbread

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°.
2. Mix all ingredients together.
3. Grease and flour a 9 x 12-inch pan.
4. Bake bread in it for 20 minutes. Serves 12.
title: Cheese Cornbread

steps: 1. Mix dry ingredients together.
2. Add oil and milk.
3. Beat thoroughly.
4. Bake in 9-inch square or pie pan in microwave for 9 minutes.
5. No need to cover.
6. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Microwave Eggless Cornbread

steps: 1. Mix flour with sugar; add remaining ingredients.
2. Pour filling into unbaked crust and bake at 350° until done.
3. Yields 8 servings.
title: Pineapple Chess Pie

ingredients.text: 5 large sweet potatoes (3 lb.), peeled and cut in 1/2-inch cubes

steps: 1. In a 3-quart saucepan over high heat, bring potatoes and enough water to cover to a boil.
2. Reduce heat, simmer, covered, for 10 minutes until just tender.
3. Drain.
4. In a 12-inch pan over medium heat, melt butter.
5. Add potatoes, pecans, brown sugar, salt and cinnamon.
6. Cook about 5 minutes, stirring frequently, until sugar is melted and potatoes are tender.
7. Makes 8 servings.
title: Cajun-Style Sweet Potatoes

steps: 1. Peel and grate potatoes and onion.
2. Drain liquid.
3. Stir in eggs.
4. Add other ingredients.
5. Mix well.
6. Drop a spoonful at a time into hot greased skillet.
7. Brown on both sides.
8. Drain on paper towels.
9. Serve with sour cream and sugar or applesauce. Serves 6.
title: Potato Latkes(Pancakes)

steps: 1. Mix ingredients and pour into a greased loaf pan.
2. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.
3. Serves 8.
title: Vegetable Chicken Loaf

ingredients.text: 1 lb. tart apples (2 to 3), peeled, cored and thinly sliced

steps: 1. Preheat the oven to 450°.
2. Grate 1 teaspoon of lemon peel and squeeze 2 teaspoons of juice from the lemon.
3. Set aside.
4. Toss the apples with the sugar, flour, cinnamon, lemon peel and juice. Place the pie crust on a rimless baking sheet lightly dusted with flour.
5. Dust a rolling pin with flour and roll the pastry to a rough 13-inch circle.
6. Heap the apples on the pastry, leaving a 2-inch border all around.
7. Scatter the butter on the fruit.
8. Fold the pastry border back over the apples to make an uneven rustic edge of about 1 1/2 inches, leaving the slices in the center exposed.
9. Sprinkle the reserved sugar over the pastry border.
10. Bake 12 minutes then reduce the temperature to 425° and bake until the apples are softened and bubbly and the pastry is golden brown (12 to 15 minutes).
11. Serve warm.
12. Serves 4 to 6.
title: "Country Apple Tart"

steps: 1. Grease bottom and sides of a 15 x 10 x 1 jellyroll pan with vegetable oil; line with wax paper and grease wax paper with oil. Set pan aside.

2. With electric mixer, beat egg yolks in a large bowl until thick and lemon colored; stir in vanilla and set aside. Beat egg whites until foamy; add cream of tartar and salt, beating until stiff, but not dry.
3. Fold in 3/4 cup powdered sugar. Fold whites into yolk mixture.
4. Gradually fold flour into egg mixture.
5. Spread batter evenly into prepared pan.
6. Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.
7. Sift 1 to 2 tablespoons powdered sugar in a 15 x 10-inch rectangle on a cloth towel.
8. When cake is done, immediately loosen from sides of pan and turn out onto sugared towel.
9. Peel off wax paper.
10. Starting at narrow end; roll up cake and towel together.
11. Let cool completely on a wire rack, seam side down.
12. Combine sliced strawberries and 2 tablespoons sugar; set aside.
13. Beat whipping cream until foamy; gradually add 3 tablespoons sugar, beating until soft peaks form.
14. Unroll cake. Spread cake with sliced strawberries and half of whipped cream, reroll cake (without towel).
15. Place on serving plate, seam side down; spread remaining whipped cream on all sides.
16. Garnish with whole strawberries, if desired.
17. Chill until serving time.
18. Yields 8 to 10 servings.
title: Strawberries And Cream Cake Roll

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 375°.
2. Grease a 9-inch square pan.
3. Beat margarine and sugar until light and fluffy.
4. Add combined flour and crumbs; mix well.
5. Press onto bottom of pan.
6. Sprinkle with remaining ingredients.
7. Bake 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown. Cool and cut into bars.
8. Makes 16 servings.
title: Rocky Road S'Mores Bars

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°.
2. Grease and flour a 13 x 9-inch loaf pan.
3. Mix ingredients together and beat with a mixer for 1 minute. Bake 55 minutes.
4. Serves 6.
title: Banana Nut Bread

steps: 1. Combine cheese, beaten eggs, jalapenos and onion in bowl; mix well.
2. Spread in ungreased 8-inch square baking dish.
3. Bake at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes or until knife inserted near center comes out clean.
4. Let stand for 10 minutes.
5. Cut into squares. Yield:
6. 36 servings.
title: Jalapeno Cheese Squares

steps: 1. Put apples in shallow 2-quart casserole.
2. Add water.
3. Combine sugars, cinnamon, nutmeg, salt and flour.
4. Cut in margarine with pastry blender.
5. Spoon mixture evenly over apples.
6. Cover and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.
7. Uncover and bake for 30 minutes longer.
8. Makes 6 servings.
title: Apple Crisp

ingredients.text: 3 c. soft bread crumbs (use 4 c. for firmer)
2 c. milk, scalded with 1/4 c. butter*

steps: 1. Mix all ingredients in a 1 1/2-quart baking dish thoroughly. Place baking dish and a pan of hot water (1-inch deep) in oven. Bake until knife inserted 1 inch from edge comes out clean, about 30 to 45 minutes at 350°.
2. Makes 6 servings.
3. Serve warm, with or without a hard sauce.
title: Old Fashioned Bread Pudding

ingredients.text: 2 to 4 c. fresh blueberries, dewberries, elderberries, huckleberries or strawberries

steps: 1. Combine flour, sugar, baking powder and milk; stir with wire whisk until smooth.
2. Add melted butter and blend.
3. Pour batter into 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan.
4. Pour berries (amount depends on personal preference) evenly over batter.
5. Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes or until golden brown.
6. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Wild Berry Cobbler

steps: 1. Cream butter, sugar and vanilla in mixer bowl until light and fluffy.
2. Add potato chips, walnuts and flour.
3. Mix well.
4. Shape into 1-inch balls.
5. Arrange on cookie sheet.
6. Press flat with glass dipped in sugar.
7. Bake at 350° for 13 minutes or until golden brown.
8. Yields 24 servings.
title: Potato Chip Cookies

steps: 1. Place eggs, milk and corn in a large bowl.
2. Mix well.
3. Add cornmeal; mix well.
4. Add onion; mix well.
5. Pour into greased casserole.
6. Bake in a preheated 350° oven for 1 hour.
7. Serves 6.
title: Corn Pudding

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°.
2. Combine ingredients; mix well.
3. Bake in 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 1/2-inch pan.
4. Bake about 1 hour.
5. Makes 8 servings.
title: Diabetic Meat Loaf

steps: 1. Combine sugar and water in a saucepan; stir well.
2. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until sugar dissolves.
3. Stir in vanilla and lemon juice.
4. Set aside.
5. Cut shortening into flour until mixture resembles coarse meal; add milk, stirring just until dry ingredients are moistened.
6. Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface and knead lightly, 4 or 5 minutes.
7. Roll dough to a 12 x 9-inch rectangle.
8. Spread blueberries over dough; roll up, jelly roll fashion, beginning with long side.
9. Set aside.
10. Melt butter in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish.
11. Cut dough into 12 (1-inch) slices.
12. Place slices, cut side down, in butter.
13. Pour sugar syrup around slices; bake at 350° for 55 to 60 minutes or until golden brown.
14. Serve warm with vanilla ice cream or whipped topping.
15. Yields 8 to 10 servings.
title: Blueberry Pinwheel Cobbler

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°.
2. Combine sugar, oats, flour and cinnamon.
3. Cut in butter until mixture is crumbly.
4. Arrange 1/2 the apple slices in buttered 8-inch square baking dish.
5. Sprinkle 1/2 the sugar mixture over apples.
6. Top with remaining apples and sugar mixture.
7. Bake for 30 to 40 minutes, or until apples are tender.
8. Serve warm.
9. Serves 6.
title: Apple Crisp

steps: 1. Beat sugar and oil; add flour, baking powder, cinnamon, soda and salt.
2. Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition.
3. Stir in carrots and nuts.
4. Bake at 350° for 45 to 50 minutes in a greased 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan.
5. Yields 8 servings.
title: Carrot Cake

steps: 1. Place peaches in bottom of 9-inch square baking dish. Sprinkle cinnamon and 1/2 cup of the sugar over peaches.
2. Melt margarine slightly, then mix it into the cream cheese, vanilla and remaining 1/2 cup of sugar.
3. Beat in the egg and then the Bisquick.
4. Scoop mixture on top of the peaches and spread evenly. Bake at 350° for about 40 minutes or until golden.
5. Serve with ice cream, if desired.
6. Makes 9 servings.
title: Peach Cobbler

steps: 1. Cook peeled potatoes in boiling water until tender but not mushy.
2. Drain and cool. Combine next four ingredients in medium saucepan.
3. Stir in apricot nectar, hot water, and orange peel. Bring to full boil, stirring constantly.
4. Remove from heat.
5. Stir in butter.
6. Cool slightly; stir in pecans.
7. Cut sweet potatoes in halves and place in casserole.
8. Pour sauce over potatoes so all are glazed.
9. If desired, cover and refrigerate overnight.
10. Bake, covered, in 375° oven for 25 minutes, or until sauce is bubbling. Makes 6 to 8 servings.
title: Sweet Potato Bake

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°.
2. Sift together the flour, baking powder, salt, granulated sugar and 2 tablespoons of the cocoa into a large bowl.
3. Add the milk, butter and vanilla; mix only until smooth. Stir in the nuts, then transfer to a buttered 1-quart (10 x 6-inch) baking dish.
4. In a medium bowl, combine brown sugar and remaining 4 tablespoons cocoa; sprinkle over the top of the chocolate mixture. Pour boiling water over all; do not stir in!!
5. Bake for 40 minutes, or until the top appears to be firm.
6. Allow to stand for 10 minutes before cutting into squares.
7. Serve warm, pudding side up, or over ice cream.
8. Serves 8.
title: Chocolate Fudge Pudding

steps: 1. Sift flour.
2. Measure and sift again with baking powder and salt.
3. Cut in butter and cheese with 2 knives.
4. Add milk; mix lightly.
5. Drop by teaspoon on well-oiled baking sheet.
6. Bake in hot oven at 450° for 12 minutes.
7. Makes 8 servings.
title: Cheese Biscuits

steps: 1. Mix beef, pork, oatmeal and eggs.
2. Blend in rest of ingredients.
3. Pack in 9 x 5-inch loaf pan, shaping into a rounded top.
4. Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.
5. Let stand 10 minutes before slicing.
6. Drain off any excess juice.
7. Serves 8.
title: Diner Meat Loaf

steps: 1. Combine apples, 3/4 cup sugar, butter and cinnamon in saucepan.
2. Cook until tender, stirring frequently.
3. Pour into well-greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan.
4. Sift together flour, baking powder and salt.
5. Set aside.
6. Cream together shortening with sugar.
7. Blend in eggs, one at a time, beating well.
8. Combine milk and vanilla.
9. Add alternately with dry ingredients to creamed mixture, beginning and ending with dry ingredients.
10. Spread over apples in pan.
11. Bake at 350° in oven for 35 to 40 minutes or until done.
12. Remove from oven.
13. Turn cake upside-down over large serving plate.
14. Let stand a few minutes, then remove pan.
15. Makes 16 servings.
title: Apple Upside-Down Cake

steps: 1. Combine sweet potatoes, sugar, eggs, 1/2 cup margarine, milk and vanilla in bowl.
2. Mix well.
3. Spoon into greased 2-quart baking dish.
4. Combine remaining ingredients in bowl; mix well.
5. Sprinkle over sweet potato mixture.
6. Bake for 35 minutes in preheated 350° oven..
7. Yields 6 servings.
title: Sweet Potato Praline

steps: 1. 1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Wash and dry all produce. Dice potatoes into 1/2-inch pieces. Trim, peel, and cut carrots on a diagonal into 1/2-inch-thick pieces. Trim and thinly slice scallions, separating whites from greens; finely chop whites. Peel and finely chop garlic.

2. 2. In a medium bowl, soak bread with 2 TBSP water (4 TBSP for 4 servings); break up with your hands until pasty. Stir in beef, sriracha, scallion whites, half the garlic, salt (we used 3/4 tsp kosher salt; 11/2 tsp for 4), and pepper. Form into two 1-inch-tall loaves (four loaves for 4). Place on one side of a baking sheet. Toss carrots on empty side of same sheet with a drizzle of oil, salt, and pepper. (For 4, spread meatloaves out across whole sheet and add carrots to a second sheet.) Bake for 20 minutes (we'll glaze the meatloaves then).
3. 3. Meanwhile, place potatoes in a medium pot with enough salted water to cover by 2 inches. Bring to a boil and cook until very

4. tender, 12-15 minutes. Reserve 1/2 cup potato cooking liquid, then drain. While potatoes cook, in a small bowl, combine soy sauce, garlic powder, 1/4 cup ketchup (1/2 cup for 4 servings), and 2 tsp sugar (4 tsp for 4).
5. 4. Once meatloaves and carrots have baked 20 minutes, remove from oven. Spoon half the ketchup glaze over meatloaves (save
6. the rest for serving); return to oven until carrots are browned and tender, meatloaves are cooked through, and glaze is tacky, 4-5 minutes more.
7. 5. Meanwhile, melt 2 TBSP butter (4 TBSP for 4 servings) in pot used for potatoes over medium heat. Add remaining garlic and cook

8. until fragrant, 30 seconds. Add potatoes and 1/4 tsp wasabi. Mash, adding splashes of reserved potato cooking liquid as necessary until smooth. Season with salt and pepper. (If you like things spicy, stir in more wasabi!)
9. 6. Divide meatloaves, mashed potatoes, and roasted carrots between plates. Sprinkle with scallion greens and serve with remaining ketchup glaze on the side for dipping.
title: Soy-Glazed Meatloaves with Wasabi Mashed Potatoes & Roasted Carrots

steps: 1. For the Lentils: Adjust oven rack to center position and preheat oven to 450°F to prepare for roasting eggplant. Meanwhile, heat 2 tablespoons olive oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat until shimmering. Add carrots, celery, and onion and cook, stirring, until softened but not browned, about 4 minutes. Add garlic and cook, stirring, until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Add lentils, bay leaves, stock or water, and a pinch of salt. Bring to a simmer, cover with the lid partially ajar, and cook until lentils are tender, about 30 minutes. (Top up with water if lentils are at any point not fully submerged.) Remove lid, stir in vinegar, and reduce until lentils are moist but not soupy. Season to taste with salt and pepper, cover, and keep warm until ready to serve.

2. For the Eggplant: While lentils cook, cut each eggplant in half. Score flesh with the tip of a paring knife in a cross-hatch pattern at 1-inch intervals. Transfer to a foil-lined rimmed baking sheet, cut side up, and brush each eggplant half with 1 tablespoon oil, letting each brushstroke be fully absorbed before brushing with more. Season with salt and pepper. Place a rosemary sprig on top of each one. Transfer to oven and roast until completely tender and well charred, 25 to 35 minutes. Remove from oven and discard rosemary.

3. To Serve: Heat 2 tablespoons olive oil and pine nuts in a medium skillet set over medium heat. Cook, tossing nuts frequently, until golden brown and aromatic, about 4 minutes. Transfer to a bowl to halt cooking. Stir half of parsley and rosemary into lentils and transfer to a serving platter. Arrange eggplant halves on top. Spread a few tablespoons of tahini sauce over each eggplant half and sprinkle with pine nuts. Sprinkle with remaining parsley and rosemary, drizzle with additional olive oil, and serve.
title: Roasted Eggplant With Tahini, Pine Nuts, and Lentils

title: Steamed Green Beans With Lemon-Mint Dressing

steps: 1. Place yogurt in small bowl. Cover and freeze at least 6 hours or up to 2 days. Transfer frozen yogurt to blender. Add bananas, pineapple juice, ice cubes, and brown sugar. Blend until smooth. Makes 4 servings.
title: Banana-Pineapple Yogurt Smoothie

steps: 1. Cook carrots 15 to 25 minutes or until carrots are just tender.
2. Meanwhile, melt in a skillet butter.

title: Glazed Carrots

3. Add to cider along with nutmeg.

5. Remove and discard cheesecloth bag.
6. Stick a cinnamon stick in each serving cup.

title: Wassail Bowl

1 whole Medium Sweet Onion, Cut Into Large Dice
1/4 teaspoons Salt, Plus More To Taste

steps: 1. In a medium saucepan, place carrots, onion, sugar, bouillon, salt, and 1/2 cup water. Cover and bring to a boil over medium-high heat.

title: Glazed Carrots And Onions

steps: 1. Whisk together eggs, egg whites, salt and pepper in a bowl. Heat butter in large nonstick skillet over medium heat.
2. Add onion, tomato, jalapenos and cilantro.
3. Saute 2 to 3 minutes until onion is clear.
4. Add egg mixture to skillet.
5. Cook, stirring, until desired consistency, 4 to 6 minutes.
6. Makes 4 servings.
title: Mexican Style Eggs

ingredients.text: 1/2 cup steak, cooked medium, sliced thin

steps: 1. Preheat skillet over medium heat. Heat tortillas for 1 minute each side. Remove tortillas from skillet and cover with towel to keep warm.

2. Combine both cheeses in a small bowl. Layer warm tortillas with half the cheese, half the steak slices and half the mushrooms. Add remaining half of cheese and top with other tortilla. Over medium heat, warm 2 teaspoons of corn oil in skillet then add quesadilla. Lightly brush top with remaining 2 teaspoons of corn oil. Cook 5 minutes or until bottom is light brown. Turn over and brown other side. Cut into 4 or 6 wedges. Serve with sour cream and salsa on side.
3. Yield: 1-2 servings.
title: Steak Quesadilla - Restaurant Quality!

steps: 1. Combine water and 2 tablespoons picante sauce in a large shallow dish.
2. Place tortillas in mixture; let stand 5 minutes and drain.
3. Brown ground beef and onions; drain.
4. Stir in salt, pepper, cumin, chili powder, olives and 1/4 cup picante sauce; simmer meat mixture 5 minutes.

6. Remove from heat and add sour cream.

title: Sour Cream Enchilada Casserole

title: Beef Enchiladas

steps: 1. Make filling by stirring together cheese, chicken and onion. Place spoonful of filling on each tortilla.
2. Add a spoonful of sauce made of soup, sour cream, green chilies and salt.

title: Mexican Chicken Casserole

steps: 1. Fry meat and onion in shortening until browned.

title: Chili Con Carne

steps: 1. Saute zucchini, celery, carrot, onion and green pepper in hot oil in large skillet for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.

3. Add tomatoes and cook 5 minutes.

title: Zucchini Mexican Style

5. Serve hot with cornbread or crackers.
6. Serves 6 to 8.
title: Spicy Chili Con Carne

steps: 1. In small bowl, combine tomatoes, taco sauce, 3 tablespoons onions, lemon juice and peppers.
2. Combine cheese with remaining onions.
3. For each quesadilla, sprinkle about 1/2 cup cheese mixture over it.
4. Spoon 2 tablespoons sauce over cheese.
5. Top with another tortilla, pressing gently.
6. Fry in skillet in small amount of hot oil until golden and cheese has melted, turning once.
7. Repeat with remaining ingredients.
8. Heat remaining sauce and serve with quesadillas for dipping.

title: Spicy Quesadillas

steps: 1. Melt chocolate chips over low heat.
2. Stir in 2 cups of sour cream.

3. Add sour cream and chilies, and stir until smooth.
4. Pour over tortillas. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

title: Creamy Cheese Enchiladas

steps: 1. Use a 12-inch or larger skillet. In a large skillet over medium heat, cook onion, bell pepper, crumbled ground beef, sausage and garlic until meat is lightly brown. Add tomato sauce, tomatoes, chili powder, cayenne, salt and beans; stir to blend. Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer 45 minutes, covered. Serves 8 to 10.
title: Chili Con Carne Americano

steps: 1. In a saucepan, brown ground beef.

6. Stir in cheese.
7. Serves 6 to 8.

steps: 1. Combine sugar, cocoa powder, flour, cinnamon, and salt in a large saucepan.
2. Stir in cold water and bring to a boil stirring constantly.
3. Reduce heat and simmer, stirring often.
4. Slowly stir in milk and heat almost to boiling.

title: Beef Fajitas

steps: 1. Preheeat the oven to 225. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.

3. Place the remaining ingredients in a medium size bowl and toss until well combined. Add the sugar mixture to the pecans, a quarter of it at a time, and very gently toss until well coated.

4. Transfer the pecans to the prepared sheet and arrange in a single layer. Try to not let the pecans touch each other. Place the sheet in the oven and cook, stirring every 15 minutes, until the coating is lightly colored and dried out, about 1 hour and 15 minutes trotal.

5. Cover with aluminum foil and bake at 220°C for about 5 minutes.
6. Cut into 8 slices each.
title: Quesadillas With Chilies And Olives

steps: 1. In a greased baking dish layer flour tortillas until bottom is covered.
2. Spread refried beans on top and sprinkle with onions.

4. Repeat until you end up with a layer of flour tortillas on top.

steps: 1. Mix and cook over low heat until cheese melts and is blended.

title: Vegetable Quesadillas

steps: 1. Whisk masa harina and salt together; stir enough water into mixture until dough is smooth and holds together. Form dough into 2-inch balls. Flatten each ball to a 1/2-inch thick circle.
2. Heat oil to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C) in a deep-fryer or large saucepan.

Pinch the edges of each sope together forming little 'boats'. Return to hot oil and fry until golden and cooked through, 1 to 2 minutes.
title: Easy Mexican Sopes

ingredients.text: 4 lbs boneless pork butt, fat trimmed and cut into 2-inch cubes
1 medium orange, juiced and keep the spent halves

steps: 1. Adjust oven rack to lower middle position and heat to 300 degrees.
2. Combine all ingredients in a large dutch oven, including the spent orange halves and juice.
3. Bring the mixture to a boil over medium-high heat, uncovered. Once it simmers, cover pot and transfer it to the oven.
4. Cook until the meat falls apart when prodded with a fork, about 2 hours.
5. Remove the pot from the oven and use a slotted spoon to remove the meat from the pan and place it on a large foil-lined jelly roll pan.
6. Remove and discard everything from the pot except the cooking liquid.
7. Place pot over medium-high hear on the stove and boil until thick and syrupy, about 20-25 minutes. You should have about 1 cup of liquid remaining when it is finished.
8. While the liquid is reducing, break each cube of pork into three pieces. Once the liquid has become syrup, gently fold the pieces of pork into the pot, trying not to break up the pork any further.

9. Spread the pork back onto the foil-lined pan and evenly spread so there is a single layer. Place the pan of meat on an upper middle rack of the oven and broil on high until the top of the meat is well browned and the edges are slightly crisp, about 7-8 minutes. Using a wide spatula, flip the pieces of meat the broil the other side the same way.
10. Serve in a tortilla will your favorite toppings.

steps: 1. Combine cheese, bacon, tomato, onions and ham in a bowl.

3. Sprinkle mixture evenly over half the tortillas to within 1/2 inch of edge.
4. Top with remaining tortillas.
5. Spray skillet with Pam.
6. Cook quesadillas 1 to 2 minutes on each side until lightly browned and cheese melts.
7. Cut into four wedges each. Serve with shredded lettuce, sour cream, and/or guacamole.
title: Quesadillas

steps: 1. Whisk cold water, sugar, cocoa powder, flour, cinnamon, cloves, and salt in a saucepan until smooth. Place over low heat; bring to a simmer, whisking constantly, until mixture is thickened and hot, about 4 minutes. Stir in milk; heat until hot chocolate just forms bubbles around the edge. Mix vanilla extract into hot chocolate. Blend until smooth with an immersion blender to make the drink slightly frothy.
title: Mexican-Style Hot Chocolate

steps: 1. Beat eggs lightly.
2. Add flour and baking powder.
3. Blend.
4. Melt butter; add to eggs along with chilies and cheeses (and ham). Blend gently.
5. Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan.
6. Bake at 400° for 15 minutes, 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.
title: Baked Mexican Eggs

steps: 1. BROWN meat in large skillet; drain.
2. STIR in water, catsup and seasoning mix.
3. Bring to boil.
4. Stir in macaroni.
5. Reduce heat to medium-low; cover.
6. Simmer 8 to 10 minutes or until macaroni is tender.
7. ADD Velveeta; stir until melted.
8. Garnish with crushed tortilla chips, chopped green onions and tomatoes.
title: Taco Macaroni And Cheese

steps: 1. Brown ground beef with onion drain.

4. This can be a little dry.
5. This is not Health Food!
6. I have added a little cooking oil to the Mix.

9. Top with cheese, sour cream, lettuce, tomato, etc.
10. Enjoy!
title: Taco Filling (Ground Beef)

steps: 1. Cut up fryer and brown in butter. Combine remaining ingredients and boil 4 minutes. Place chicken in roaster and pour sauce over. Cover. Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hour or until chicken is tender. Baste often.
title: Mexican Chicken

steps: 1. Mix ingredients together and roll 1-2 tbsps of mixture on a floured surface.
2. Fry in hot dry pan (for tacos) or hot oil (for taco salad).
3. Enjoy!
title: Flour Taco Shells

steps: 1. Brown pork chops and put into 9 x 13-inch pan.
2. Sprinkle rice around pork chops.
3. Mix tomato juice, chili powder and garlic powder and pour over pork chops and rice, making sure rice is covered with juice.
4. Cover and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.
title: Mexican Pork Chops

ingredients.text: 2 pounds boneless beef chuck roast, trimmed of fat

steps: 1. Place beef in a Dutch oven over medium heat. Pour in water. Cover, and cook for 30 minutes. Remove cover, and cook until liquid has evaporated, and beef is well browned, about 10 minutes. In a medium bowl, combine beef broth, red wine vinegar, chili powder and cumin. Pour over beef. Cover, and cook until meat is very tender, and pulls apart easily, about 2 hours. Allow to cool, then shred and mix with pan juices.
2. Preheat oven to 500 degrees F (260 degrees C).

3. Brush both sides of each tortilla with melted butter. Spoon shredded beef filling down center of each tortilla. Fold ends over filling, then fold sides to center to make a packet. Place chimichangas, seam side down, in a 9- by 13-inch baking pan.
4. Bake in preheated oven for 8 to 10 minutes, or until golden brown. Serve with shredded cheese, sour cream and salsa.
title: Shredded Beef Chimichangas

steps: 1. Brown beef in skillet, stirring until crumbly; drain excess fat.
2. Stir in remaining ingredients; simmer, covered, for 10 minutes.
3. Makes filling for 8 taco shells.
title: Taco Meat Filling

steps: 1. Mix ingredients in order.
2. Roll in small balls.
3. Bake on greased cookie sheet at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes. When cool, roll in powdered sugar.
title: Mexican Wedding Balls

ingredients.text: 1/3 cup cider vinegar, or as needed

steps: 1. Line a colander with a damp piece of muslin or cheesecloth. Place colander over a bowl or in the sink.
2. Pour milk into a large saucepan; bring to 185 degrees F (85 degrees C), stirring frequently. Stir in salt.
3. Pour vinegar into milk, a little at a time, stirring well after each addition until curds begin to separate from the whey.

4. Spoon curds into the muslin-lined colander using a slotted spoon. Fold the muslin over the top of the curds. Fill a smaller container with water and place on top of the muslin to press down on the cheese. Let rest for 1 to 3 hours, allowing the liquid to drain from the cheese (the longer you allow the cheese to drain, the drier the cheese will be).
title: Queso Blanco

ingredients.text: 14 1/2 ounces whole canned tomatoes, drained (OR 3 medium tomatoes, chopped)

steps: 1. Preheat oven to 350°F.

2. Saute the onion, green pepper and garlic in the oil until just tender. Crumble the ground beef into the skillet and brown. Add the tomatoes, salt, pepper and chili powder. Cook over med-low heat for about 20 minutes.

3. While the meat mixture is simmering, bring 3 cups of the water to a boil. Slowly pour the corn meal into the remaining 1 cup of cold water, stirring until smooth. Add the salt and chili powder to the boiling water, and then, stirring constantly, add the cold corn meal mixture to the boiling water. Cook and stir for 5 minutes. Remove from heat and cover.

4. Spray a casserole or baking dish with vegetable cooking spray. Using half of the cornmeal mixture, fill the bottom and sides of the dish. Fill with the meat mixture. You can sprinkle some black olives over the meat, if preferred. Using the remaining half of the cornmeal mixture, cover the top of the pie.
5. Bake at 350°F for 20 minutes or until nicely browned. Or until knife inserted in top crust portion comes out clean.
title: Tamale Casserole

steps: 1. Combine first 4 ingredients in a food processor; process until smooth. Combine jalapeno sauce and onion in a small bowl.

2. Combine paprika and next 6 ingredients (through ground red pepper); sprinkle evenly over fish. Heat oil in a large cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat. Add fish to pan; cook 3 minutes on each side or until desired degree of doneness.
3. Warm tortillas according to package directions. Divide fish, onion mixture, and avocado evenly among tortillas. Serve with lime wedges.
